pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Due to its distinctive institutional background, Oman offers a valuable opportunity to examine stock price reactions to dividend announcements. Raw markdown: alyahyaee-2011-the-information-content-of-cash-dividend-announcements-in Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: The information content of cash dividend announcements in a unique environment (2011) Paper claim — Due to its distinctive institutional background, Oman offers a valuable opportunity to examine stock price reactions to dividend announcements. Raw markdown: alyahyaee-2011-the-information-content-of-cash-dividend-announcements-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Al-Yahyaee, KH, Pham, TM, Walter, TS Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2010.03.004 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, transparency)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Due to its distinctive institutional background, Oman offers a valuable opportunity to examine stock price reactions to dividend announcements. In Oman, (1) there are no taxes on dividends and capital gains, (2) there is a high concentration of share ownership, (3) there is low corporate transparency, and (4) firms frequently change their dividends. Our results show that announcements of dividend increases are associated with increased stock prices, while announcements of dividend decreases cause decreases in stock prices. Firms that do not change their dividends experience insignificant negative returns. These results contradict tax-based signaling models, which argue that higher taxes on dividends relative to capital gains are a necessary condition for dividends to be informative. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 由于其独特的制度背景，阿曼为考察股价对股利公告的反应提供了宝贵的机会。在阿曼，(1)股利和资本利得均不征税，(2)股份所有权高度集中，(3)公司透明度低，以及(4)企业频繁改变其股利。我们的结果表明，股利增加的公告与股价上涨相关联，而股利减少的公告导致股价下跌。不改变股利的企业经历了不显著的负收益。这些结果与基于税收的信号模型相矛盾，后者认为股利相对于资本利得更高的税收是股利具有信息含量的必要条件。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We test the impact of taxes and governance systems on dividend payouts across countries. Raw markdown: alzahrani-2012-investor-protection-taxation-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Alzahrani, M, Lasfer, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2012…
pages.text: Investor protection, taxation, and dividends (2012) Paper claim — We test the impact of taxes and governance systems on dividend payouts across countries. Raw markdown: alzahrani-2012-investor-protection-taxation-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Alzahrani, M, Lasfer, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2012.06.003 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, investor protection)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We test the impact of taxes and governance systems on dividend payouts across countries. We show that, unlike previous studies, firms in strong investor protection countries pay lower cash dividends than in weak protection countries when the classical tax system is implemented, but they repurchase more shares to maximise their shareholders' after-tax returns. In weak protection countries, cash dividends and repurchases are low and less responsive to taxes. Our results suggest that when investors are protected, they weigh the tax cost of dividends against the benefit of mitigating the agency cost, but, when they are not, they accept whatever dividends they can extract, even when this entails high tax costs. Crown Copyright (C) 2012 Published by Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们检验了税收和治理体系对各国股利支付的影响。我们表明，与以往研究不同，当实行古典税制时，投资者保护强的国家的企业支付的现金股利比投资者保护弱的国家更低，但它们回购更多股份以最大化其股东的税后回报。在投资者保护弱的国家，现金股利和回购都较低，且对税收的反应较不敏感。我们的结果表明，当投资者受到保护时，他们会权衡股利的税收成本与缓解代理成本的收益；但当他们不受保护时，他们会接受任何能攫取到的股利，即使这需要承担高额税收成本。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Volatility of Tax Payments and Dividend Payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Dividends are a key mechanism for shareholders to discipline managers and mitigate agency conflicts. Raw markdown: amberger-2023-volatility-of-tax-payments-and-dividend-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Amberger, HJ Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH…
pages.text: Volatility of Tax Payments and Dividend Payouts (2023) Paper claim — Dividends are a key mechanism for shareholders to discipline managers and mitigate agency conflicts. Raw markdown: amberger-2023-volatility-of-tax-payments-and-dividend-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Amberger, HJ Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12831 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Dividends are a key mechanism for shareholders to discipline managers and mitigate agency conflicts. This study examines whether the volatility of tax payments is associated with dividend payouts. Consistent with the predictions, results suggest that firms with more volatile tax payments are less likely to pay dividends overall and their dividends are lower in magnitude when doing so. These effects are economically significant and incremental to a firm's operating risk. The link between volatile tax payments and the likelihood of dividend payouts is weaker for firms that distribute dividends to alleviate agency conflicts. Similarly, the link between volatile tax payments and the amount of dividend payouts is weaker for firms that hold more cash for tax reasons. Taken together, these findings add to our understanding of the economic consequences of volatile tax payments and the determinants of dividend payouts. 摘要（中文） 股利是股东约束管理者并缓解代理冲突的关键机制。本研究考察了税款支付的波动性是否与股利支付相关。与预测相一致，结果表明，税款支付更为波动的企业总体上更不可能派发股利，且在派发时其股利在规模上更低。这些效应在经济上是显著的，且是在企业经营风险之外的增量效应。对于那些为缓解代理冲突而分配股利的企业，波动的税款支付与股利支付可能性之间的联系较弱。同样，对于那些出于税收原因持有更多现金的企业，波动的税款支付与股利支付金额之间的联系较弱。综合来看，这些发现增进了我们对波动税款支付的经济后果以及股利支付决定因素的理解。 Key Findings Firms with more volatile tax payments (measured as the coefficient of variation of annual cash ETRs over five years, orthogonalized for operating risk) are 4.9 percentage points less likely to pay dividends per one standard deviation increase in tax payment volatility. Among dividend-paying firms, a one standard deviation increase in tax payment volatility is associated with 3% lower dividend levels, equivalent to approximately $6.8 million less for the average firm. The effect of volatile tax payments on payout probability is weaker for firms with high institutional ownership, consistent with agency motives (willingness to incur liquidity shortfall costs) moderating the link. The effect on dividend levels is weaker for firms with high unrecognized tax benefit (UTB) balances, consistent with precautionary cash holdings for tax purposes buffering against cash flow volatility. Firms with more volatile tax payments prefer more flexible payout channels (share repurchases, special dividends) over regular dividends. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.text: Dividends, taxes, and signaling: Evidence from Germany (1997) Paper claim — The higher taxation of dividends in the United States gave rise to theories that explain why companies pay dividends. Raw markdown: amihud-1997-dividends-taxes-and-signaling-evidence-from-germany Bibliographic Record Authors: Amihud, Y, Murgia, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1997 DOI: 10.2307/2329570 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract The higher taxation of dividends in the United States gave rise to theories that explain why companies pay dividends. Tax-based signaling models propose that the higher tax on dividends is a necessary condition to make them informative about companies' values. In Germany, where dividends are not tax-disadvantaged and in fact are taxed lower for most investor classes, these models predict that dividends are not informative. However, we find that the stock price reaction to dividend news in Germany is similar to that found in the United States. This suggests other reasons, beyond taxation, that make dividends informative. 摘要（中文） 美国对股利的更高征税催生了解释公司为何支付股利的理论。基于税收的信号模型提出，对股利的更高税收是使其对公司价值具有信息量的必要条件。在德国，股利没有税收劣势，事实上对大多数投资者类别而言征税更低，这些模型预测股利不具有信息量。然而，我们发现德国股价对股利消息的反应与美国的发现相似。这表明存在税收之外的其他原因使股利具有信息量。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The declining information content of dividend announcements and the effects of institutional holdings
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose an explanation for the "disappearing dividend" phenomenon: a decline in the information content of dividend announcements, which reduces the propensity of firms to use dividends as a costly signal. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The declining information content of dividend announcements and the effects of institutional holdings (2006) Paper claim — We propose an explanation for the "disappearing dividend" phenomenon: a decline in the information content of dividend announcements, which reduces the propensity of firms to use dividends as a costly signal. Raw markdown: amihud-2006-the-declining-information-content-of-dividend-announcements-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Amihud, Y, Li, KF Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000002568 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We propose an explanation for the "disappearing dividend" phenomenon: a decline in the information content of dividend announcements, which reduces the propensity of firms to use dividends as a costly signal. A reason for a decline in the information content of dividends is the rise in holdings by institutional investors that are more sophisticated and informed. Indeed, we find a decline in CAR at dividend change announcements since the mid-1970s. Across firms, CAR is a decreasing function of institutional holdings. Institutional investors exploit their superior information and buy before dividend increases. In addition, dividends are less likely to rise in firms with high institutional holdings. 摘要（中文） 我们为"消失的股利"（disappearing dividend）现象提出一种解释：股利公告信息含量的下降，这降低了公司将股利用作一种代价高昂信号的意愿。股利信息含量下降的一个原因是机构投资者持股的上升，这些投资者更为老练且信息灵通。的确，我们发现自20世纪70年代中期以来，股利变动公告时的累积异常收益（CAR）出现下降。在公司之间，CAR是机构持股的递减函数。机构投资者利用其信息优势，在股利增加之前买入。此外，在机构持股较高的公司中，股利较不可能上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Institutional shareholding and information content of dividend surprises: Re-examining the dynamics in dividend-reappearance era
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the role of institutional investors' investment horizon on the information content associated with dividend announcement surprises in the "dividend-reappearance era". Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Institutional shareholding and information content of dividend surprises: Re-examining the dynamics in dividend-reappearance era (2015) Paper claim — We examine the role of institutional investors' investment horizon on the information content associated with dividend announcement surprises in the "dividend-reappearance era". Raw markdown: amin-2015-institutional-shareholding-and-information-content-of-dividend-surprises Bibliographic Record Authors: Amin, AS, Dutta, S, Saadi, S, Vora, PP Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2015.02.002 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine the role of institutional investors' investment horizon on the information content associated with dividend announcement surprises in the "dividend-reappearance era". We find that the presence of institutional investors negatively affects the announcement period cumulative abnormal return (CAR), which suggests that institutional investors reduce information content of dividend announcements. This result is primarily driven by the fact that institutional investors, especially the not-short-horizon investors, do not prefer dividend surprises which leads to lower announcement period CAR. We do not find support for institutional investors' informed trading argument. Our study reveals that in order to understand the dynamics between institutional ownership and information content of dividend announcements, it is important to differentiate the institutional investors' investment horizons. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察在“股利重现时代”，机构投资者的投资持有期限对股利公告意外所关联的信息含量的作用。我们发现机构投资者的存在对公告期累计异常收益（CAR）产生负面影响，这表明机构投资者降低了股利公告的信息含量。这一结果主要由如下事实驱动：机构投资者、尤其是非短期投资者，不偏好股利意外，从而导致更低的公告期CAR。我们没有发现支持机构投资者知情交易论点的证据。我们的研究揭示，为了理解机构持股与股利公告信息含量之间的动态关系，区分机构投资者的投资持有期限非常重要。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the impact of VC ownership beyond the IPO listing on important and consequential corporate decisions in a firm's lifetime. Raw markdown: amini-2022-impact-of-venture-capital-holding-on-firm-life Bibliographic Record Authors: Amini, S, Mohamed,…
pages.text: Impact of venture capital holding on firm life cycle: Evidence from IPO firms (2022) Paper claim — This paper examines the impact of VC ownership beyond the IPO listing on important and consequential corporate decisions in a firm's lifetime. Raw markdown: amini-2022-impact-of-venture-capital-holding-on-firm-life Bibliographic Record Authors: Amini, S, Mohamed, A, Schwienbacher, A, Wilson, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102224 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper examines the impact of VC ownership beyond the IPO listing on important and consequential corporate decisions in a firm's lifetime. We find that VC funds delay the initiation of dividends by approximately two years, delay the use of external growth strategies, and postpone introduction to the corporate bond market. These results are consistent with the view that VC funds extend the growth phase of the firm. We show that their presence at the time of these decisions leads to positive stock price reactions, suggesting that they provide a certification effect that signals continued growth opportunities, and that VC certification is not limited to the IPO listing. 摘要（中文） 本文考察风险投资（VC）所有权在IPO上市之后对企业生命周期中重要且具影响力的公司决策的影响。我们发现VC基金将股利的首次发放推迟约两年，推迟外部增长战略的使用，并延后进入公司债券市场。这些结果与VC基金延长企业成长阶段的观点一致。我们表明，在做出这些决策时VC的存在会带来正向的股价反应，这表明它们提供了一种认证效应，向市场传递持续成长机会的信号，且VC认证并不局限于IPO上市。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: CAPITAL GAINS TAX AND EQUITY VALUES - EMPIRICAL-TEST OF STOCK-PRICE REACTION TO THE INTRODUCTION AND REDUCTION OF CAPITAL GAINS TAX-EXEMPTION (1992) Paper claim — This paper evaluates the differential effect on stock prices of the introduction in Canada of $500,000 capital gains tax exemption and the reduction of this limit to $100,000 two years later. Raw markdown: amoakoadu-1992-capital-gains-tax-and-equity-values-empirical-test Bibliographic Record Authors: AMOAKOADU, B, RASHID, M, STEBBINS, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1992 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(92)90014-Q Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, reform)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper evaluates the differential effect on stock prices of the introduction in Canada of $500,000 capital gains tax exemption and the reduction of this limit to $100,000 two years later. Using the seemingly unrelated regression methodology and controlling for thin-trading and heteroscedasticity, the empirical evidence indicates that the changes in capital gains tax laws had a differential effect on low-dividend yield and high-dividend yield stocks on both occasions. While the evidence indicates that the stock market anticipated the 1985 capital gains tax law changes, the significant market reaction to the 1987 reduction of the exemption occurred a day before and after the reading of the tax reform proposals in Parliament. Thus, it can be inferred from the results that, despite the presence of tax-sheltering opportunities in Canada. changes in capital gains tax laws affect equity values. 摘要（中文） 本文评估在加拿大引入50万美元资本利得税免除以及两年后将这一上限降至10万美元对股票价格的差别性影响。使用似不相关回归方法并控制稀薄交易和异方差性，经验证据表明，资本利得税法的这些变化在两次场合下都对低股利收益率股票和高股利收益率股票产生了差别性影响。虽然证据表明股票市场预期到了1985年资本利得税法的变化，但对1987年削减免除额的显著市场反应发生在议会宣读税改提案的前一天和后一天。因此，可以从结果推断，尽管加拿大存在税收庇护机会，资本利得税法的变化仍会影响权益价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Design and valuation of debt contracts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article studies the design and valuation of debt contracts in a general dynamic setting under uncertainty. Raw markdown: anderson-1996-design-and-valuation-of-debt-contracts Bibliographic Record Authors: Anderson, RW, Sundaresan, S Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: Design and valuation of debt contracts (1996) Paper claim — This article studies the design and valuation of debt contracts in a general dynamic setting under uncertainty. Raw markdown: anderson-1996-design-and-valuation-of-debt-contracts Bibliographic Record Authors: Anderson, RW, Sundaresan, S Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/9.1.37 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(payout) Abstract This article studies the design and valuation of debt contracts in a general dynamic setting under uncertainty. We incorporate some insights of the recent corporate finance literature into a valuation framework. The basic framework is an extensive form game determined by the terms of a debt contract and applicable bankruptcy laws. Debtholders and equityholders behave noncooperatively, The firm's reorganization boundary is determined endogenously. Strategic debt service results In significantly higher default premia at even small liquidation costs. Deviations from absolute priority, and forced liquidations occur along the equilibrium path. The design tends to stress higher coupons and sinking funds when firms have a higher cash payout ratio. 摘要（中文） 本文在不确定性下的一般动态环境中研究债务契约的设计与估值。我们将近期公司金融文献的一些洞见纳入一个估值框架。基本框架是一个由债务契约条款和适用破产法所决定的展开式博弈。债权持有人和股权持有人以非合作方式行事。公司的重组边界被内生地确定。即使在很小的清算成本下，策略性债务偿还也会导致显著更高的违约溢价。绝对优先权的偏离和强制清算沿均衡路径发生。当公司具有较高的现金支付比率时，该设计倾向于强调更高的息票和偿债基金。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Financial contracting under extreme uncertainty: an analysis of Brazilian corporate debentures
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Economic volatility, high transaction costs, and fragile institutions hinder financial contracting in emerging markets. Raw markdown: anderson-1999-financial-contracting-under-extreme-uncertainty-an-analysis-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Anderson, CW Journal:…
pages.text: Financial contracting under extreme uncertainty: an analysis of Brazilian corporate debentures (1999) Paper claim — Economic volatility, high transaction costs, and fragile institutions hinder financial contracting in emerging markets. Raw markdown: anderson-1999-financial-contracting-under-extreme-uncertainty-an-analysis-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Anderson, CW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(98)00043-9 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Economic volatility, high transaction costs, and fragile institutions hinder financial contracting in emerging markets. These conditions characterize the economy of Brazil, yet a nascent corporate bond marker thrives. I analyze 50 Brazilian indenture agreements and find that sample debentures are characterized by (i) features that mitigate inflation risk for investors, (ii) contingent-maturity mechanisms that provide periodic opportunities for exit or renegotiation, (iii) a paucity of covenants that restrict the debtor's investment, financing, and dividend decisions, and(iv) self-enforcement mechanisms that avoid reliance on inefficient institutions. Analysis of these features enhances our understanding of contracting in emerging economies. (C) 1999 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 经济波动性、高交易成本以及脆弱的制度阻碍了新兴市场中的金融契约。这些状况刻画了巴西的经济，然而一个新生的公司债券市场却蓬勃发展。我分析了50份巴西的债券契约（indenture）协议，发现样本债券具有以下特征：（i）为投资者缓解通胀风险的特征，（ii）提供定期退出或重新谈判机会的或有期限机制，（iii）鲜少有限制债务人投资、融资和股利决策的契约条款（covenants），以及（iv）避免依赖低效制度的自我执行机制。对这些特征的分析增进了我们对新兴经济体中契约的理解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Corporate Liquidity and Capital Structure (2012) Paper claim — We solve for a firm's optimal cash holding policy within a continuous time, contingent claims framework using dividends, short-term borrowing, and equity issues as controls assuming mean reversion of earnings. Raw markdown: anderson-2012-corporate-liquidity-and-capital-structure Bibliographic Record Authors: Anderson, RW, Carverhill, A Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhr103 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We solve for a firm's optimal cash holding policy within a continuous time, contingent claims framework using dividends, short-term borrowing, and equity issues as controls assuming mean reversion of earnings. Optimal cash is non-monotone in business conditions and increasing in the level of long-term debt. The model matches closely a wide range of empirical benchmarks and predicts cash and leverage dynamics in line with the empirical literature. Firm value is quite insensitive to changes in the level of long-term debt. The model has interesting implications for asset substitution, hedging, and pecking order. Growth opportunities do not greatly affect cash holding policy. 摘要（中文） 我们在一个连续时间、或有求偿权框架内，以股利、短期借款和股权发行作为控制变量，并假设盈余均值回复，求解公司的最优现金持有政策。最优现金随经营状况非单调变化，并随长期债务水平升高而增加。该模型与广泛的实证基准高度吻合，并预测出与实证文献相一致的现金和杠杆动态。公司价值对长期债务水平的变化相当不敏感。该模型对资产替代、对冲和优序融资具有有趣的含义。成长机会对现金持有政策影响不大。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We construct a present-value model with a rational bubble identified using stock market data and survey expectations. Raw markdown: andreasen-2026-identifying-a-stock-price-bubble-and-its-macroeconomic Bibliographic Record Authors: Andreasen, MM, Bro, J Journal:…
pages.text: Identifying a stock price bubble and its macroeconomic implications (2026) Paper claim — We construct a present-value model with a rational bubble identified using stock market data and survey expectations. Raw markdown: andreasen-2026-identifying-a-stock-price-bubble-and-its-macroeconomic Bibliographic Record Authors: Andreasen, MM, Bro, J Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfag011 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We construct a present-value model with a rational bubble identified using stock market data and survey expectations. The model captures the 1970s "nifty-fifty" bubble, the dot-com bubble, the bubble prior to the 2007-2009 recession, a COVID-19 bubble, and a recent bubble possibly linked to artificial intelligence. When bubble-adjusting the price-dividend ratio, we no longer find explosive dynamics and excess volatility in stock prices. To examine the macroeconomic implications of a bubble, we use the bubble innovation as an instrument in a structural vector autoregression. The results show that a positive bubble shock is expansionary and leads to a higher monetary policy rate. 摘要（中文） 我们构建了一个现值模型，其中的理性泡沫是使用股票市场数据和调查预期来识别的。该模型捕捉了20世纪70年代的“漂亮五十”（nifty-fifty）泡沫、互联网泡沫、2007-2009年衰退之前的泡沫、COVID-19泡沫，以及一个近期可能与人工智能相关的泡沫。当对价格—股利比进行泡沫调整后，我们不再发现股价中的爆炸性动态和过度波动。为考察泡沫的宏观经济含义，我们在结构性向量自回归中将泡沫创新用作工具变量。结果表明，一个正向泡沫冲击是扩张性的，并导致更高的货币政策利率。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The Lintner model revisited: Dividends versus total payouts (2015) Paper claim — We analyze how the introduction of repurchases in 1998 affected the payout policy of German firms. Raw markdown: andres-2015-the-lintner-model-revisited-dividends-versus-total-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Andres, C, Doumet, M, Fernau, E, Theissen, E Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2015.01.005 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We analyze how the introduction of repurchases in 1998 affected the payout policy of German firms. To this end, we estimate Lintner (1956) partial adjustment models for both dividends and total payouts. We also analyze the implications for payout of changes in both permanent and transitory earnings. Our results are inconsistent with the hypothesis that dividends and repurchases are perfect substitutes. We also find that repurchases have not taken over the role of special dividends. Our results support the flexibility hypothesis that predicts that (regular) dividends are used to disburse permanent, and more flexible payout methods (special dividends and repurchases) transitory, earnings. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们分析1998年引入回购如何影响德国企业的支付政策。为此，我们对股利和总支付均估计了Lintner（1956）部分调整模型。我们还分析了永久性收益和暂时性收益变化对支付的含义。我们的结果与股利和回购是完美替代品这一假设不一致。我们还发现回购并未接管特别股利的角色。我们的结果支持灵活性假说，该假说预测（常规）股利被用来发放永久性收益，而更灵活的支付方式（特别股利和回购）被用来发放暂时性收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do what you did four quarters ago: Trends and implications of quarterly dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — By analyzing the inter-temporal structure of quarterly dividends, we show that as more firms announce dividend increases exactly every four quarters, dividend policy has become more persistent and more predictable. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Do what you did four quarters ago: Trends and implications of quarterly dividends (2017) Paper claim — By analyzing the inter-temporal structure of quarterly dividends, we show that as more firms announce dividend increases exactly every four quarters, dividend policy has become more persistent and more predictable. Raw markdown: andres-2017-do-what-you-did-four-quarters-ago-trends Bibliographic Record Authors: Andres, C, Hofbaur, U Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.01.003 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract By analyzing the inter-temporal structure of quarterly dividends, we show that as more firms announce dividend increases exactly every four quarters, dividend policy has become more persistent and more predictable. Recently, nearly 60% of all dividend increases have been announced in four-quarter cycles. Valuation, earnings stability, and size are positively related to the propensity to adopt four-quarter cycles. More importantly, we provide evidence that this structure is incorporated into market participants' expectations about future dividend announcements. These findings may provide an explanation for two phenomena described in the literature: the declining information content of dividends and the higher degree of dividend smoothing. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 通过分析季度股利的跨期结构，我们表明，随着越来越多的企业恰好每四个季度宣布一次股利增长，股利政策已变得更具持续性和更可预测。近来，几乎60%的所有股利增长都是以四季度周期宣布的。估值、盈利稳定性和规模与采用四季度周期的倾向正相关。更重要的是，我们提供证据表明这种结构已被纳入市场参与者对未来股利公告的预期。这些发现可能为文献中描述的两种现象提供一种解释：股利信息含量的下降和更高程度的股利平滑。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Information disclosure, CEO overconfidence, and share buyback completion rates
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — An open market share buyback is not a firm commitment, and there is limited evidence on whether firms repurchase the intended shares. Raw markdown: andriosopoulos-2013-information-disclosure-ceo-overconfidence-and-share-buyback-completion Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Information disclosure, CEO overconfidence, and share buyback completion rates (2013) Paper claim — An open market share buyback is not a firm commitment, and there is limited evidence on whether firms repurchase the intended shares. Raw markdown: andriosopoulos-2013-information-disclosure-ceo-overconfidence-and-share-buyback-completion Bibliographic Record Authors: Andriosopoulos, D, Andriosopoulos, K, Hoque, H Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2013.04.011 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, external director, regulat)；股利政策(buyback) Abstract An open market share buyback is not a firm commitment, and there is limited evidence on whether firms repurchase the intended shares. Unlike US studies, we use data from unique UK regulatory and disclosure environment that allows to accurately measure the share buyback completion rates. We show that information disclosure and CEO overconfidence are significant determinants of the share buyback completion rate. In addition, we find that large and widely held firms that conduct subsequent buyback programs and have a past buyback completion reputation exhibit higher completion rates. Finally, we assess whether other CEO characteristics affect buyback completion rates and find that firms with senior CEOs who hold external directorships and have a longer tenure as CEO are more likely to complete the buyback programs. In sum, our results suggest there is a clear relationship between information disclosure, CEO overconfidence, and buyback completion rates. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 公开市场股票回购并非一项确定性承诺，关于公司是否会回购其计划回购的股份，现有证据有限。与美国的研究不同，我们使用来自英国独特监管和披露环境的数据，从而能够准确衡量股票回购完成率。我们表明，信息披露和CEO过度自信是股票回购完成率的重要决定因素。此外，我们发现，规模大、股权分散、且开展后续回购计划并具有既往回购完成声誉的公司表现出更高的完成率。最后，我们评估了其他CEO特征是否影响回购完成率，发现拥有资深CEO（其持有外部董事职位且任CEO时间较长）的公司更可能完成回购计划。总之，我们的结果表明，信息披露、CEO过度自信与回购完成率之间存在明确的关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The market valuation of share repurchases in Europe
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze a uniquely constructed data set of open market share repurchases across a sample of European firms. Raw markdown: andriosopoulos-2015-the-market-valuation-of-share-repurchases-in-europe Bibliographic Record Authors: Andriosopoulos, D, Lasfer, M Journal:…
pages.text: The market valuation of share repurchases in Europe (2015) Paper claim — We analyze a uniquely constructed data set of open market share repurchases across a sample of European firms. Raw markdown: andriosopoulos-2015-the-market-valuation-of-share-repurchases-in-europe Bibliographic Record Authors: Andriosopoulos, D, Lasfer, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2014.04.017 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution, reform, regulat)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract We analyze a uniquely constructed data set of open market share repurchases across a sample of European firms. We find that the announcement date market reaction is lower than that in the US, mainly because of (i) the relatively large number of recurring announcements which generate significantly lower returns than the initial announcements of intention to repurchase shares; (ii) the rather low market reaction in France, due probably to specific governance and corporate cultural issues; and (iii) the regulatory reform that allowed UK firms to keep the repurchased shares as treasury stock, which decreased their market impact. Across our countries, taxation, shareholder protection, and the European Union's Market Abuse Directive do not affect significantly the market valuation of repurchases. Our results imply that ultimately, domestic institutional specificities and reforms play significant roles in the market valuation and popularity of share repurchases. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们分析了一个独特构建的欧洲企业公开市场股份回购数据集。我们发现，公告日的市场反应低于美国，主要原因是：（i）经常性公告数量相对较多，其收益显著低于回购股份意向的初次公告；（ii）法国的市场反应相当低，这可能是由于特定的公司治理和企业文化问题；以及（iii）允许英国企业将回购的股份作为库存股保留的监管改革，降低了其市场影响。在我们考察的各个国家中，税收、股东保护以及欧盟《市场滥用指令》并未显著影响回购的市场估值。我们的结果意味着，归根结底，国内的制度特殊性和改革在股份回购的市场估值和普及程度中发挥着重要作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock return predictability: Is it there?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the predictive power of the di backslash vidend yields for forecasting excess returns, cash flows, and interest rates. Raw markdown: ang-2007-stock-return-predictability-is-it-there Bibliographic Record Authors: Ang, A, Bekaert, G Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: Stock return predictability: Is it there? (2007) Paper claim — We examine the predictive power of the di backslash vidend yields for forecasting excess returns, cash flows, and interest rates. Raw markdown: ang-2007-stock-return-predictability-is-it-there Bibliographic Record Authors: Ang, A, Bekaert, G Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhl021 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We examine the predictive power of the di backslash vidend yields for forecasting excess returns, cash flows, and interest rates. Dividend yields predict excess returns only at short horizons together with the short rate and do not have any long-horizon predictive power. At short horizons, the short rate strongly negatively predicts returns. These results are robust in international data and are not due to lack of power. A present value model that matches the data shows that discount rate and short rate movements play a large role in explaining the variation in dividend yields. Finally, we find that earnings yields significantly predict future cash flows. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了股利收益率在预测超额收益、现金流和利率方面的预测能力。股利收益率仅在短视野下与短期利率一起预测超额收益，而不具有任何长视野预测能力。在短视野下，短期利率强烈地负向预测收益。这些结果在国际数据中是稳健的，并且不是由于缺乏检验功效。一个与数据相匹配的现值模型表明，贴现率和短期利率的变动在解释股利收益率的变动中发挥了重要作用。最后，我们发现盈余收益率显著预测未来现金流。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Good Apples, Bad Apples: Sorting Among Chinese Companies Traded in the US
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Committing financial fraud is a serious breach of business ethics. Raw markdown: ang-2016-good-apples-bad-apples-sorting-among-chinese-companies Bibliographic Record Authors: Ang, JS, Jiang, ZQ, Wu, CP Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2016 DOI:…
pages.text: Good Apples, Bad Apples: Sorting Among Chinese Companies Traded in the US (2016) Paper claim — Committing financial fraud is a serious breach of business ethics. Raw markdown: ang-2016-good-apples-bad-apples-sorting-among-chinese-companies Bibliographic Record Authors: Ang, JS, Jiang, ZQ, Wu, CP Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-014-2387-1 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(audit, governance, law, monitor, regulat)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Committing financial fraud is a serious breach of business ethics. However, there are few large scale studies of financial fraud, which involve ethical considerations. In this study, we investigate the pervasive financial scandals, which by the end of 2012 involved more than a third of the US-listed Chinese companies. Based on a sample of 262 US-listed Chinese companies, we analyze factors that differentiate between firms that commit financial fraud and those that do not. We find that firms more predisposed to unethical behavior, due to their low regional social trust in the home country and low respect for regulations and laws as proxied by political connections, are more likely to commit accounting and financial fraud. They take advantage of low hurdles for listing via reverse mergers and avoid third-party monitoring through poor governance and auditors. Finally, we find evidence, after these scandals, of non-fraudulent firms differentiating themselves from the fraudulent firms by sending costly signals such as insiders purchasing shares, increasing dividends, and going private. 摘要（中文） 实施财务欺诈是对商业伦理的严重违背。然而，涉及伦理考量的财务欺诈的大规模研究却很少。在本研究中，我们考察了普遍存在的财务丑闻，到2012年底，这些丑闻涉及超过三分之一的美国上市中国企业。基于262家美国上市中国企业的样本，我们分析了区分实施财务欺诈的企业与未实施财务欺诈的企业的因素。我们发现，由于本国区域社会信任度低、以及以政治关联为代理变量所反映的对法规和法律尊重程度低，从而更倾向于不道德行为的企业，更可能实施会计和财务欺诈。它们利用通过反向并购上市的低门槛，并通过不佳的治理和审计师规避第三方监督。最后，我们发现证据表明，在这些丑闻之后，非欺诈企业通过发出成本高昂的信号（如内部人购买股份、增加股利和私有化）来将自身与欺诈企业区分开来。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Time for gift giving: Abnormal share repurchase returns and uncertainty
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study share repurchase announcements for nine European countries between 2000 and 2017. Raw markdown: anolick-2021-time-for-gift-giving-abnormal-share-repurchase-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Anolick, N, Batten, JA, Kinateder, H, Wagner, N Journal:…
pages.text: Time for gift giving: Abnormal share repurchase returns and uncertainty (2021) Paper claim — We study share repurchase announcements for nine European countries between 2000 and 2017. Raw markdown: anolick-2021-time-for-gift-giving-abnormal-share-repurchase-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Anolick, N, Batten, JA, Kinateder, H, Wagner, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101787 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(information asymmetry, signal) Abstract We study share repurchase announcements for nine European countries between 2000 and 2017. In contrast to previous studies, we address the role of market uncertainty as a market-based determinant of positive average abnormal announcement returns, while including governance, liquidity risk and firm related control variables. Economic policy uncertainty and financial uncertainty, individually as well as jointly, positively affect abnormal returns. We suggest that this relation is due to a stronger signaling effect under increased uncertainty, as both information asymmetry and underpricing tend to increase. Also, a potential hedge against adverse market movements is more valuable. Optimal timing of repurchase announcements should therefore consider market uncertainty conditions. 摘要（中文） 我们研究2000年至2017年间九个欧洲国家的股份回购公告。与以往研究不同，我们在纳入治理、流动性风险和企业相关控制变量的同时，探讨市场不确定性作为正向平均异常公告收益的一种市场决定因素的作用。经济政策不确定性和金融不确定性，无论单独还是共同，都会正向影响异常收益。我们认为，这种关系源于不确定性上升时更强的信号效应，因为信息不对称和抑价往往都会增加。此外，对不利市场变动进行对冲的潜在价值也更高。因此，回购公告的最优时机选择应当考虑市场不确定性状况。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Territorial Tax System Reform and Corporate Financial Policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the effect of a permanent change to a country corporate income repatriation tax system on corporate financial policies. Raw markdown: arena-2015-territorial-tax-system-reform-and-corporate-financial-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Arena, MP,…
pages.text: Territorial Tax System Reform and Corporate Financial Policies (2015) Paper claim — We examine the effect of a permanent change to a country corporate income repatriation tax system on corporate financial policies. Raw markdown: arena-2015-territorial-tax-system-reform-and-corporate-financial-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Arena, MP, Kutner, GW Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhv005 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract We examine the effect of a permanent change to a country corporate income repatriation tax system on corporate financial policies. In 2009, Japan and the United Kingdom switched from a worldwide system to a territorial system for the taxation of repatriated foreign earnings, effectively reducing the tax liabilities of most multinational firms when repatriating earnings. We find that after the change firms accumulate less cash, pay out larger amounts through dividends and share repurchases, and invest less abroad. We do not find that the tax system change has significantly affected domestic investments even when controlling for capital constraints. 摘要（中文） 我们考察一国企业所得税汇回制度的永久性变化对公司财务政策的影响。2009年，日本和英国从全球征税制（worldwide system）转向属地征税制（territorial system）来对汇回的海外收益征税，从而在汇回收益时有效降低了大多数跨国公司的税负。我们发现，在此变化之后，公司积累的现金减少，通过股利和股票回购派发的金额增加，并减少了海外投资。我们没有发现该税制变化显著影响了国内投资，即便在控制了资本约束后亦然。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Litigation Risk Management Through Corporate Payout Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms modify their payout policy in anticipation of future litigation costs. Raw markdown: arena-2023-litigation-risk-management-through-corporate-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Arena, MP, Julie, B Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE…
pages.text: Litigation Risk Management Through Corporate Payout Policy (2023) Paper claim — Firms modify their payout policy in anticipation of future litigation costs. Raw markdown: arena-2023-litigation-risk-management-through-corporate-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Arena, MP, Julie, B Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1017/S002210902200076X Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract Firms modify their payout policy in anticipation of future litigation costs. We examine a comprehensive sample of U.S. corporate lawsuits and find that firms facing significant litigation risk pay lower dividends, and in some cases omit dividends while distributing more cash through share repurchases. Litigation risk changes the distribution of payouts but not the total payout yield as the increase in share repurchases offsets the decrease in dividends. Cash-poor firms cut share repurchases when settlement costs are incurred. The results suggest that firms at a higher risk of litigation increase their payout flexibility. 摘要（中文） 企业会预期未来的诉讼成本而调整其支付政策。我们考察了美国企业诉讼的全面样本，发现面临显著诉讼风险的企业支付更低的股利，在某些情况下会停发股利，同时通过股份回购分配更多现金。诉讼风险改变了支付的分布，但不改变总支付收益率，因为股份回购的增加抵消了股利的减少。当承担和解成本时，现金匮乏的企业会削减股份回购。这些结果表明，诉讼风险较高的企业会增加其支付灵活性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Are pension contributions a threat to shareholder payouts? (2019) Paper claim — UK companies have been making large contributions to reduce the deficits of their pension funds, and are believed to fund such contributions in part by reducing dividends. Raw markdown: armitage-2019-are-pension-contributions-a-threat-to-shareholder-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Armitage, S, Gallagher, R Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.04.001 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract UK companies have been making large contributions to reduce the deficits of their pension funds, and are believed to fund such contributions in part by reducing dividends. Using data from 2003 to 16, we find little evidence that large deficit-reduction contributions are associated with reductions in regular dividends, though we find some restraint in dividend increases and total payout. Most companies make large contributions when they have healthy cash flows and strong profitability, or inflows from disposals of assets. This suggests that the Pensions Regulator allows companies flexibility regarding the timing of contributions. 摘要（中文） 英国公司一直在大量缴款以减少其养老基金的赤字，并且被认为部分通过削减股利来为此类缴款融资。使用2003年至2016年的数据，我们几乎没有发现证据表明大额赤字削减缴款与常规股利的削减相关联，尽管我们发现在股利增加和总支付方面有一些克制。大多数公司在现金流健康、盈利能力强，或有资产处置流入时才进行大额缴款。这表明养老金监管机构允许公司在缴款时机方面具有灵活性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Can Noise Create the Size and Value Effects?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — If the price of a stock differs from its intrinsic value by a random noise, then value stocks are more likely to have negative noise; they are thus more likely undervalued and have higher expected return than justified by risk. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Can Noise Create the Size and Value Effects? (2015) Paper claim — If the price of a stock differs from its intrinsic value by a random noise, then value stocks are more likely to have negative noise; they are thus more likely undervalued and have higher expected return than justified by risk. Raw markdown: arnott-2015-can-noise-create-the-size-and-value-effects Bibliographic Record Authors: Arnott, RD, Hsu, JC, Liu, J, Markowitz, H Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2014.1995 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract If the price of a stock differs from its intrinsic value by a random noise, then value stocks are more likely to have negative noise; they are thus more likely undervalued and have higher expected return than justified by risk. The same intuition applies to small capitalization stocks. We formally verify and explore this intuition by using a standard noise-in-price model. This intuition is different from the Jensen's inequality effect studied by Blume and Stambaugh [Blume ME, Stambaugh RF (1983) Biases in computed returns: An application to the size effect. J. Financial Econom. 12(3):387-404]. Our model is parsimonious: the value premium as well as size premium are computed in closed form and depend on only four parameters: mean of stock return, volatility of stock return, volatility of the price-to-dividend ratio, and noise volatility. We emphasize that only a moderate volatility of price noise is needed to generate the observed value premium. However, the model cannot generate the observed size premium. 摘要（中文） 如果一只股票的价格与其内在价值相差一个随机噪声，那么价值股更有可能带有负噪声；因此它们更有可能被低估，其预期收益高于风险所应有的水平。同样的直觉也适用于小市值股票。我们运用一个标准的价格噪声模型，正式地验证并探究了这一直觉。这一直觉不同于Blume和Stambaugh（1983）所研究的詹森不等式效应。我们的模型十分简约：价值溢价和规模溢价均以闭式解形式计算得出，且仅取决于四个参数：股票收益的均值、股票收益的波动率、价格-股利比的波动率，以及噪声波动率。我们强调，只需适度的价格噪声波动率即可产生观测到的价值溢价。然而，该模型无法产生观测到的规模溢价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Terminal valuations, growth rates and the implied cost of capital
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a model based on the notion that prices lead earnings, allowing for a simultaneous estimation of the implied growth rate and the cost of equity capital for US industrial sectors. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Terminal valuations, growth rates and the implied cost of capital (2013) Paper claim — We develop a model based on the notion that prices lead earnings, allowing for a simultaneous estimation of the implied growth rate and the cost of equity capital for US industrial sectors. Raw markdown: ashton-2013-terminal-valuations-growth-rates-and-the-implied-cost Bibliographic Record Authors: Ashton, D, Wang, PG Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-012-9208-5 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We develop a model based on the notion that prices lead earnings, allowing for a simultaneous estimation of the implied growth rate and the cost of equity capital for US industrial sectors. The major difference between our approach and that in prior literature is that ours avoids the necessity to make assumptions about terminal values and consequently about future growth rates. In fact, growth rates are an endogenous variable, which is estimated simultaneously with the implied cost of equity capital. Since we require only 1-year-ahead forecasts of earnings and no assumptions about dividend payouts, our methodology allows us to estimate ex ante aggregate growth and risk premia over a larger sample of firms than has previously been possible. Our estimate of the risk premium being between 3.1 and 3.9 % is at the lower end of recent estimates, reflecting the inclusion of these short-lived companies. Our estimate of the long run growth is from 4.2 to 4.7 %. 摘要（中文） 我们基于价格领先于盈余这一理念构建了一个模型，从而能够同时估计美国工业部门的隐含增长率和权益资本成本。我们的方法与以往文献的主要区别在于，我们的方法避免了必须对终值以及由此对未来增长率做出假设。事实上，增长率是一个内生变量，它与隐含权益资本成本同时被估计。由于我们只需要提前1年的盈余预测，且无需对股利派现做任何假设，我们的方法使我们能够在比以往可能范围更大的公司样本上估计事前的总量增长和风险溢价。我们估计的风险溢价在3.1%至3.9%之间，处于近期估计的低端，这反映了纳入了这些短寿命公司的影响。我们对长期增长的估计为4.2%至4.7%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate governance and dividend policy: Evidence of tunneling from master limited partnerships
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a sample of 85 Delaware master limited partnerships ("MLPs") from 2004 to 2016, we examine the relation between cash dividend policy and the strength of corporate governance measured by contractual governance provisions, such as fiduciary waiver, mandatory…
pages.text: Corporate governance and dividend policy: Evidence of tunneling from master limited partnerships (2018) Paper claim — Using a sample of 85 Delaware master limited partnerships ("MLPs") from 2004 to 2016, we examine the relation between cash dividend policy and the strength of corporate governance measured by contractual governance provisions, such as fiduciary waiver, mandatory distributions, and voting rights, and by ownership structure. Raw markdown: atanassov-2018-corporate-governance-and-dividend-policy-evidence-of-tunneling Bibliographic Record Authors: Atanassov, J, Mandell, AJ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2018.10.004 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, law, policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, distribution, dividend)；影响机制(tunneling) Abstract Using a sample of 85 Delaware master limited partnerships ("MLPs") from 2004 to 2016, we examine the relation between cash dividend policy and the strength of corporate governance measured by contractual governance provisions, such as fiduciary waiver, mandatory distributions, and voting rights, and by ownership structure. We find support for the tunneling model of dividend determination. Specifically, we document that firms with weaker governance pay out more cash dividends than better governed firms. We also find that, in the presence of low quality governance, these payments reduce firm value as well as the value of the firm's cash holdings, suggesting that they are viewed by the market as a tunneling (extraction) of resources by the general partner at the expense of limited unitholders. 摘要（中文） 使用2004年至2016年85家特拉华州业主有限合伙企业（"MLP"）的样本，我们考察了现金股利政策与公司治理强度之间的关系，治理强度以契约性治理条款（如受信义务豁免、强制分配和投票权）以及所有权结构来衡量。我们发现支持股利决定的掏空模型的证据。具体而言，我们记录到，治理较弱的企业比治理较好的企业支付更多的现金股利。我们还发现，在治理质量低的情况下，这些支付降低了企业价值以及企业现金持有的价值，这表明市场将其视为普通合伙人以牺牲有限合伙人为代价对资源的掏空（攫取）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and economic policy uncertainty: International evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We provide the first international evidence on the impact of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) on dividend policy. Raw markdown: attig-2021-dividends-and-economic-policy-uncertainty-international-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Attig, N, El Ghoul, S,…
pages.text: Dividends and economic policy uncertainty: International evidence (2021) Paper claim — We provide the first international evidence on the impact of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) on dividend policy. Raw markdown: attig-2021-dividends-and-economic-policy-uncertainty-international-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Attig, N, El Ghoul, S, Guedhami, O, Zheng, XL Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101785 Relevance score: 14.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, enforce, governance, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract We provide the first international evidence on the impact of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) on dividend policy. Using data from 19 countries, we find that a high level of EPU is positively associated with dividend payout. This evidence is robust to using alternative dividend payout measures, to controlling for other sources of uncertainty, and to addressing endogeneity. We further find that the effect of EPU on dividend policy is moderated by firms' free cash flows and governance quality, and by the quality of country-level indicators of shareholder protection, disclosure, enforcement, and creditor protection. Collectively, our novel evidence suggests that dividends help mitigate agency problems during high-EPU periods. 摘要（中文） 我们首次提供了关于经济政策不确定性（EPU）对股利政策影响的国际证据。使用来自19个国家的数据，我们发现高水平的EPU与股利支付正相关。这一证据在使用替代性股利支付度量、控制其他不确定性来源以及处理内生性问题后依然稳健。我们进一步发现，EPU对股利政策的影响受到企业自由现金流和治理质量、以及国家层面股东保护、信息披露、执法和债权人保护指标质量的调节。总体而言，我们的新证据表明，股利有助于在高EPU时期缓解代理问题。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stakeholder-centric corporate misconduct and financing policies: A precautionary tale
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate how stakeholder-centric corporate misconduct (CM) influences firms' financing policies. Raw markdown: attig-2026-stakeholder-centric-corporate-misconduct-and-financing-policies-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Attig, N, El Ghoul, S, Hossain, A…
pages.text: Stakeholder-centric corporate misconduct and financing policies: A precautionary tale (2026) Paper claim — We investigate how stakeholder-centric corporate misconduct (CM) influences firms' financing policies. Raw markdown: attig-2026-stakeholder-centric-corporate-misconduct-and-financing-policies-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Attig, N, El Ghoul, S, Hossain, A Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2025.107582 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, replace) Abstract We investigate how stakeholder-centric corporate misconduct (CM) influences firms' financing policies. CM is associated with higher cash holdings and lower dividend payouts and debt financing. These effects are more pronounced in firms with stronger governance. We further show that higher cash holdings in CM firms are associated with greater firm value and a lower implied cost of capital. Firms that replace their CEOs following CM adopt more conservative financing policies. Taken together, our evidence supports the precautionary motive for cash holdings, indicating that such reserves are unlikely to result from agency conflicts or increased managerial discretion in CM firms. 摘要（中文） 我们考察以利益相关者为中心的企业不当行为（CM）如何影响企业的融资政策。CM与更高的现金持有以及更低的股利支付和债务融资相关。这些效应在治理更强的企业中更为显著。我们进一步表明，CM企业中更高的现金持有与更大的企业价值以及更低的隐含资本成本相关。在CM之后更换首席执行官的企业会采取更为保守的融资政策。综合来看，我们的证据支持现金持有的预防性动机，表明CM企业中这类储备不太可能源于代理冲突或管理者自由裁量权的增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Complementarity between Tax Avoidance and Manager Diversion: Evidence from Tax Haven Firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate whether tax avoidance and manager diversion are complementary when the costs of diversion are low by comparing dividend payouts, performance, and overinvestments of tax haven firms versus other multinational firms based in countries with weak and…
pages.text: The Complementarity between Tax Avoidance and Manager Diversion: Evidence from Tax Haven Firms (2019) Paper claim — We investigate whether tax avoidance and manager diversion are complementary when the costs of diversion are low by comparing dividend payouts, performance, and overinvestments of tax haven firms versus other multinational firms based in countries with weak and strong investor protections. Raw markdown: atwood-2019-the-complementarity-between-tax-avoidance-and-manager-diversion Bibliographic Record Authors: Atwood, TJ, Lewellen, C Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12421 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, investor protection)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, overinvestment) Abstract We investigate whether tax avoidance and manager diversion are complementary when the costs of diversion are low by comparing dividend payouts, performance, and overinvestments of tax haven firms versus other multinational firms based in countries with weak and strong investor protections. Desai and Dharmapala (2006, 2009a, b) and Desai et al. (2007) set forth a theory of tax avoidance within an agency framework (the D&D theory) based on the assumption that tax avoidance and manager diversion are complementary when the corporate governance system is "ineffective" (i.e., the manager's expected costs of diversion are low). Tax haven firms are corporate groups whose parent firms are incorporated in tax haven countries that are not the countries where the groups' headquarters or primary operations are located (i.e., their "base" countries). We argue that tax haven incorporation potentially lowers the costs of diversion for managers of firms based in countries with weak investor protections. Using a sample from 28 base countries, we provide evidence that manager diversion and tax avoidance are complementary for tax haven firms based in countries with weak investor protections but not for tax haven firms based in countries with strong investor protections. Our results are consistent with the complementarity assumption underlying the D&D model and provide additional insights into the potential impact of the decentralization of the global firm. 摘要（中文） 我们考察当侵占（diversion）成本较低时，避税与经理人侵占是否互补，方法是比较避税天堂企业与其他总部位于投资者保护弱和强的国家的跨国企业的股利支付、业绩和过度投资。德赛和达尔马帕拉（Desai and Dharmapala，2006, 2009a, b）以及德赛等（Desai et al，2007）在一个代理框架内提出了一种避税理论（D&D理论），其基于这样一个假设：当公司治理体系"无效"时（即经理人的预期侵占成本较低），避税与经理人侵占是互补的。避税天堂企业是指其母公司注册于避税天堂国家的企业集团，而这些国家并非集团总部或主要运营所在的国家（即其"基地"国家）。我们认为，避税天堂注册可能降低总部位于投资者保护弱的国家的企业经理人的侵占成本。使用来自28个基地国家的样本，我们提供的证据表明，对于总部位于投资者保护弱的国家的避税天堂企业，经理人侵占与避税是互补的，但对于总部位于投资者保护强的国家的避税天堂企业则不然。我们的结果与D&D模型背后的互补性假设相一致，并为全球企业去中心化的潜在影响提供了额外洞见。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate whether corporate finance incentives affect the extent of corporate hedging with property insurance. Raw markdown: aunonnerin-2008-why-firms-purchase-property-insurance Bibliographic Record Authors: Aunon-Nerin, D, Ehling, P Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Why firms purchase property insurance (2008) Paper claim — We investigate whether corporate finance incentives affect the extent of corporate hedging with property insurance. Raw markdown: aunonnerin-2008-why-firms-purchase-property-insurance Bibliographic Record Authors: Aunon-Nerin, D, Ehling, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2008.01.003 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, substitut) Abstract We investigate whether corporate finance incentives affect the extent of corporate hedging with property insurance. Using a database that contains detailed insurance information, we document a positive relation between the expected costs of distress and property insurance coverage. We also show that the dividend payout ratio is negatively associated with property insurance coverage, consistent with the view that firms with high payout ratios insure a smaller fraction of properties due to cash flows in excess of investment needs, easy access to capital markets, or both. Different incentives are important for the insurance deductible and limit of coverage, and the deductible and limit of coverage are substitutes. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察公司财务激励是否影响企业以财产保险进行企业对冲的程度。使用一个包含详细保险信息的数据库，我们记录了预期困境成本与财产保险覆盖之间的正向关系。我们还表明，股利支付率与财产保险覆盖呈负相关，这与如下观点一致：支付率高的企业由于现金流超出投资需求、更容易进入资本市场，或两者兼有，因而为较小比例的财产投保。不同的激励对保险免赔额和承保限额很重要，且免赔额和承保限额互为替代。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate share repurchases and the 2023 excise tax
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 imposes a 1 % excise tax on US corporate share repurchases, effective January 1, 2023. Raw markdown: autore-2025-corporate-share-repurchases-and-the-2023-excise-tax Bibliographic Record Authors: Autore, DM, Barnes, S, Clarke, N,…
pages.text: Corporate share repurchases and the 2023 excise tax (2025) Paper claim — The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 imposes a 1 % excise tax on US corporate share repurchases, effective January 1, 2023. Raw markdown: autore-2025-corporate-share-repurchases-and-the-2023-excise-tax Bibliographic Record Authors: Autore, DM, Barnes, S, Clarke, N, Schrowang, A Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2025.102881 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 imposes a 1 % excise tax on US corporate share repurchases, effective January 1, 2023. The tax's implementation is associated with a significant decline in corporate repurchases that is not offset by a corresponding increase in dividends. Aggregate repurchases decline from about $1 trillion in 2022 to just over $800 billion in 2023, and the average firm reduces quarterly repurchases (as a fraction of market capitalization) by roughly 25 %. The decline in repurchases by US firms far exceeds a contemporaneous decline in repurchases by Canadian firms, is large in a historical context, and is not driven by firm fundamentals. Taxinduced cuts to repurchases are associated with an increase in cash but no increase in investment, implying that the tax has not generated the stated policy objective. 摘要（中文） 2022年《通胀削减法案》对美国公司股份回购征收1%的消费税，自2023年1月1日起生效。该税的实施与公司回购的显著下降相关，而这种下降并未被股利的相应增加所抵消。总回购从2022年约1万亿美元下降到2023年略高于8000亿美元，平均而言企业将季度回购（占市值的比例）削减了大约25%。美国企业回购的下降幅度远超同期加拿大企业回购的下降，在历史背景下也属较大，且并非由企业基本面所驱动。税收诱发的回购削减与现金增加相关，但与投资增加无关，这意味着该税并未产生其所声称的政策目标。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Information tradeoffs in dynamic financial markets
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In dynamic financial markets the stochastic supply of risky assets has a significant informational role. Raw markdown: avdis-2016-information-tradeoffs-in-dynamic-financial-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Avdis, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year:…
pages.text: Information tradeoffs in dynamic financial markets (2016) Paper claim — In dynamic financial markets the stochastic supply of risky assets has a significant informational role. Raw markdown: avdis-2016-information-tradeoffs-in-dynamic-financial-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Avdis, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2015.11.005 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(tradeoff) Abstract In dynamic financial markets the stochastic supply of risky assets has a significant informational role. Contrary to static models, where it acts as "noise," in dynamic markets stochastic supply contains information about risk premiums. Acquiring private dividend information helps investors disentangle dividend information from discount-rate information contained in prices. For uninformed investors, however, as more informed investors enter the economy prices become more informative about dividends but less informative about discount rates. This tradeoff creates complementarities in information acquisition and multiple equilibria in the information market. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在动态金融市场中，风险资产的随机供给具有重要的信息作用。与静态模型不同——在静态模型中它充当“噪声”——在动态市场中随机供给包含关于风险溢价的信息。获取私有股利信息有助于投资者将股利信息与价格中所包含的贴现率信息区分开来。然而，对于不知情投资者而言，随着更多知情投资者进入经济，价格对股利的信息量增加，但对贴现率的信息量下降。这种权衡在信息获取中造成了互补性，并在信息市场中造成了多重均衡。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Maximum likelihood estimation of the equity premium (2017) Paper claim — xThe equity premium the expected return on the aggregate stock market less the government bill rate - is of central importance to the portfolio allocation of individuals, to the investment decisions of firms, and to model calibration and testing. Raw markdown: avdis-2017-maximum-likelihood-estimation-of-the-equity-premium Bibliographic Record Authors: Avdis, E, Wachter, JA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2017.06.003 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract xThe equity premium the expected return on the aggregate stock market less the government bill rate - is of central importance to the portfolio allocation of individuals, to the investment decisions of firms, and to model calibration and testing. This quantity is usually estimated from the sample average excess return. We propose an alternative estimator, based on maximum likelihood, that takes into account information contained in dividends and prices. Applied to the postwar sample, our method leads to an economically significant reduction from 6.4% to 5.1%. Simulation results show that our method produces more reliable estimates under a wide range of specifications. (c) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 股权溢价——即总体股票市场的预期收益减去政府票据利率——对个人的投资组合配置、企业的投资决策以及模型校准和检验都具有核心重要性。这一数量通常由样本平均超额收益来估计。我们提出了一种基于最大似然的替代估计量，该估计量考虑了股利和价格中所包含的信息。应用于战后样本，我们的方法带来了从6.4%到5.1%的经济上显著的下降。模拟结果表明，在广泛的设定下，我们的方法产生了更可靠的估计。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Credibility of Open Market Share Repurchase Signaling
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Open market share repurchase announcements are commonly associated with equity undervaluation, but their signal about firm value can often be misleading. Raw markdown: babenko-2012-the-credibility-of-open-market-share-repurchase-signaling Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: The Credibility of Open Market Share Repurchase Signaling (2012) Paper claim — Open market share repurchase announcements are commonly associated with equity undervaluation, but their signal about firm value can often be misleading. Raw markdown: babenko-2012-the-credibility-of-open-market-share-repurchase-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Babenko, I, Tserlukevich, Y, Vedrashko, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109012000312 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Open market share repurchase announcements are commonly associated with equity undervaluation, but their signal about firm value can often be misleading. We conjecture that executives who buy shares of their firm before an announcement add credibility to the undervaluation signal. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that announcement returns are positively related to past insider purchases, especially for firms that are priced less efficiently. Firms whose insiders bought more shares are also more likely to complete their repurchase plans. Finally, we find that insider purchases predict post-announcement stock returns. 摘要（中文） 公开市场股份回购公告通常与股权低估相关联，但它们关于公司价值的信号往往可能具有误导性。我们推测，在公告之前买入本公司股份的高管为低估信号增添了可信度。与这一假说相一致，我们发现公告收益与过去内部人的购买正相关，对于定价效率较低的公司尤其如此。内部人买入股份更多的公司也更可能完成其回购计划。最后，我们发现内部人的购买能够预测公告后的股票收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Taxes and the Allocation of Capital: Commentt
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Boissel and Matray (2022) find that investment increased after 2013 in French firms facing higher dividend taxes. Raw markdown: bach-2023-dividend-taxes-and-the-allocation-of-capital-commentt Bibliographic Record Authors: Bach, L, Bozio, A, Guillouzouic, A,…
pages.text: Dividend Taxes and the Allocation of Capital: Commentt (2023) Paper claim — Boissel and Matray (2022) find that investment increased after 2013 in French firms facing higher dividend taxes. Raw markdown: bach-2023-dividend-taxes-and-the-allocation-of-capital-commentt Bibliographic Record Authors: Bach, L, Bozio, A, Guillouzouic, A, Malgouyres, C Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1257/aer.20221432 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Boissel and Matray (2022) find that investment increased after 2013 in French firms facing higher dividend taxes. We identify an alteration in the code plotting the event study of the effect of this reform on investment. Using identical data and removing this alteration, we find differential pre-trends between treated and control firms. We also establish that the controls referred to as "size growth," used in all the difference-in-difference specifications, effectively are controls for lagged investment, i.e., the main outcome variable. Removing such controls attenuates differential pre-trends but leaves no clear event study evidence of a positive effect of dividend taxation on investment. 摘要（中文） Boissel与Matray（2022）发现，2013年之后，面临更高股利税的法国企业投资有所增加。我们识别出该研究在绘制这一改革对投资影响的事件研究代码中存在一处改动。使用相同的数据并移除这一改动后，我们发现处理组和对照组企业之间存在差异性的前趋势（pre-trends）。我们还证实，所有双重差分设定中使用的、被称为“规模增长”（size growth）的控制变量，实际上是对滞后投资（即主要结果变量）的控制。移除此类控制变量会减弱差异性前趋势，但没有留下清晰的事件研究证据表明股利税对投资有正向影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Term structures of asset prices and returns (2018) Paper claim — We explore the term structures of claims to a variety of cash flows, namely, US government bonds (claims to dollars), foreign government bonds (claims to foreign currency), inflation-adjusted bonds (claims to the price index), and equity (claims to future equity indexes or dividends). Raw markdown: backus-2018-term-structures-of-asset-prices-and-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Backus, D, Boyarchenko, N, Chernov, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2018.04.005 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We explore the term structures of claims to a variety of cash flows, namely, US government bonds (claims to dollars), foreign government bonds (claims to foreign currency), inflation-adjusted bonds (claims to the price index), and equity (claims to future equity indexes or dividends). The average term structures reflect the dynamics of the dollar pricing kernel, cash flow growth, and the interaction between the two. We use an affine model to illustrate how these two components can deliver term structures with a wide range of levels and shapes. Finally, we calibrate a representative agent economy to show that the evidence is consistent with the equilibrium models. (C) 2018 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们探讨了对各类现金流索取权的期限结构，即美国政府债券（对美元的索取权）、外国政府债券（对外币的索取权）、通胀调整债券（对价格指数的索取权）以及股权（对未来股权指数或股利的索取权）。平均期限结构反映了美元定价核、现金流增长以及二者相互作用的动态。我们使用一个仿射模型来说明这两个成分如何能够产生具有广泛水平和形状的期限结构。最后，我们校准了一个代表性主体经济，以表明证据与均衡模型相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Board Reforms and Dividend Policy: International Evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the impact of board reforms implemented in 40 countries worldwide on corporate dividend policy. Raw markdown: bae-2021-board-reforms-and-dividend-policy-international-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Bae, KH, El Ghoul, S, Guedhami, O, Zheng, XL…
pages.text: Board Reforms and Dividend Policy: International Evidence (2021) Paper claim — We study the impact of board reforms implemented in 40 countries worldwide on corporate dividend policy. Raw markdown: bae-2021-board-reforms-and-dividend-policy-international-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Bae, KH, El Ghoul, S, Guedhami, O, Zheng, XL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109020000319 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, monitor, policy, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(outcome model) Abstract We study the impact of board reforms implemented in 40 countries worldwide on corporate dividend policy. Using a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that firms pay higher dividends following the reforms. The increase in dividend payouts is more pronounced for firms with weak board governance in the pre-reform period and those in countries with strong external governance mechanisms. Our findings corroborate the dividend outcome model, which postulates that board reforms strengthen the monitoring role of the board and empower outside shareholders to force management to disgorge dividends. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了全球40个国家实施的董事会改革对企业股利政策的影响。使用双重差分分析，我们发现企业在改革之后支付更高的股利。股利支付的增加，对于改革前董事会治理薄弱的企业以及位于外部治理机制强的国家的企业更为显著。我们的发现印证了股利结果模型，该模型认为董事会改革强化了董事会的监督作用，并赋予外部股东迫使管理层吐出股利的能力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A catering theory of dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose that the decision to pay dividends is driven by prevailing investor demand for dividend payers. Raw markdown: baker-2004-a-catering-theory-of-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Wurgler, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI:…
pages.text: A catering theory of dividends (2004) Paper claim — We propose that the decision to pay dividends is driven by prevailing investor demand for dividend payers. Raw markdown: baker-2004-a-catering-theory-of-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Wurgler, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2004.00658.x Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We propose that the decision to pay dividends is driven by prevailing investor demand for dividend payers. Managers cater to investors by paying dividends when investors put a stock price premium on payers, and by not paying when investors prefer nonpayers. To test this prediction, we construct four stock price-based measures of investor demand for dividend payers. By each measure, nonpayers tend to initiate dividends when demand is high. By some measures, payers tend to omit dividends when demand is low. Further analysis confirms that these results are better explained by catering than other theories of dividends. 摘要（中文） 我们提出，支付股利的决策是由投资者对股利派发者的当下需求所驱动的。管理者迎合投资者的方式是：当投资者对派发者赋予股价溢价时支付股利，而当投资者偏好不派发者时不支付股利。为检验这一预测，我们构建了四个基于股价的、关于投资者对股利派发者需求的度量。按每一种度量，不派发者往往在需求高时发起股利。按某些度量，派发者往往在需求低时取消股利。进一步分析证实，这些结果用迎合理论比用其他股利理论能得到更好的解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Appearing and disappearing dividends: The link to catering incentives
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We document a close link between fluctuations in the propensity to pay dividends and catering incentives. Raw markdown: baker-2004-appearing-and-disappearing-dividends-the-link-to-catering Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Wurgler, J Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Appearing and disappearing dividends: The link to catering incentives (2004) Paper claim — We document a close link between fluctuations in the propensity to pay dividends and catering incentives. Raw markdown: baker-2004-appearing-and-disappearing-dividends-the-link-to-catering Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Wurgler, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2003.08.001 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We document a close link between fluctuations in the propensity to pay dividends and catering incentives. First, we use the methodology of Fama and French (J. Finan. Econ. (2001)) to identify a total of four distinct trends in the propensity to pay dividends between 1963 and 2000. Second, we show that each of these trends lines up with a corresponding fluctuation in catering incentives: The propensity to pay increases when a proxy for the stock market dividend premium is positive and decreases when it is negative. The lone disconnect is attributable to Nixon-era controls. (C) 2004 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们记录了支付股利倾向的波动与迎合激励之间的密切联系。第一，我们使用Fama和French（《金融经济学杂志》，2001）的方法，识别出1963年至2000年间支付股利倾向的共计四个不同趋势。第二，我们表明，这些趋势中的每一个都与迎合激励的相应波动相吻合：当股票市场股利溢价的代理变量为正时，支付倾向上升，当其为负时下降。唯一的脱节可归因于尼克松时代的管制。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Predicting returns with managerial decision variables:: Is there a small-sample bias?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Many studies find that aggregate managerial decision variables, such as aggregate equity issuance, predict stock or bond market returns. Raw markdown: baker-2006-predicting-returns-with-managerial-decision-variables-is-there Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M,…
pages.text: Predicting returns with managerial decision variables:: Is there a small-sample bias? (2006) Paper claim — Many studies find that aggregate managerial decision variables, such as aggregate equity issuance, predict stock or bond market returns. Raw markdown: baker-2006-predicting-returns-with-managerial-decision-variables-is-there Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Taliaferro, R, Wurgler, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2006.00887.x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Many studies find that aggregate managerial decision variables, such as aggregate equity issuance, predict stock or bond market returns. Recent research argues that these findings may be driven by an aggregate time-series version of Schultz's (2003, Journal of Finance 58, 483-517) pseudo market-timing bias. Using standard simulation techniques, we find that the bias is much too small to account for the observed predictive power of the equity share in new issues, corporate investment plans, insider trading, dividend initiations, or the maturity of corporate debt issues. 摘要（中文） 许多研究发现，总体管理层决策变量（如总体股权发行）能够预测股票或债券市场收益。近期研究认为，这些发现可能由Schultz（2003）伪市场择时偏差的一个总体时间序列版本所驱动。运用标准的模拟技术，我们发现这一偏差过小，不足以解释新发行中股权份额、企业投资计划、内部人交易、股利首发或企业债务发行期限所观测到的预测能力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends as Reference Points: A Behavioral Signaling Approach
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We outline a dividend signaling model that features investors who are averse to dividend cuts. Raw markdown: baker-2016-dividends-as-reference-points-a-behavioral-signaling-approach Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Mendel, B, Wurgler, J Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: Dividends as Reference Points: A Behavioral Signaling Approach (2016) Paper claim — We outline a dividend signaling model that features investors who are averse to dividend cuts. Raw markdown: baker-2016-dividends-as-reference-points-a-behavioral-signaling-approach Bibliographic Record Authors: Baker, M, Mendel, B, Wurgler, J Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhv058 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We outline a dividend signaling model that features investors who are averse to dividend cuts. Managers with strong unobservable cash earnings pay high dividends but retain enough to be likely not to fall short next period. The model is consistent with a Lintner partial-adjustment model, modal dividend changes of zero, stronger market reactions to dividend cuts than increases, comparatively infrequent and irregular repurchases, and a mechanism that does not depend on public destruction of value, which managers reject in surveys. New tests involve stronger reactions to changes from longer-maintained dividend levels and reference point currencies of American Depository Receipt dividends. 摘要（中文） 我们勾勒了一个股利信号模型，其中特点是投资者厌恶股利削减。拥有强劲的不可观测现金盈余的管理者支付高股利，但保留足够的现金以使其在下一期很可能不会短缺。该模型与Lintner部分调整模型相一致，与股利变动的众数为零、市场对股利削减的反应强于对增加的反应、相对不频繁且不规则的回购、以及一种不依赖于公开价值销毁的机制相一致——在调查中管理者拒绝这种价值销毁。新的检验涉及对来自更长期维持的股利水平变动的更强反应，以及美国存托凭证股利的参考点货币。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
