pages.title: Dividend reductions, the timing of dividend payments and information content
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Australian companies pay dividends semi-annually with smaller "interim" payments and larger "final" payments. Raw markdown: balachandran-2012-dividend-reductions-the-timing-of-dividend-payments-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Balachandran, B, Krishnamurti, C,…
pages.text: Dividend reductions, the timing of dividend payments and information content (2012) Paper claim — Australian companies pay dividends semi-annually with smaller "interim" payments and larger "final" payments. Raw markdown: balachandran-2012-dividend-reductions-the-timing-of-dividend-payments-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Balachandran, B, Krishnamurti, C, Theobald, M, Vidanapathirana, B Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2012.08.002 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract Australian companies pay dividends semi-annually with smaller "interim" payments and larger "final" payments. Interim dividends are declared and paid within a less full information environment than final dividends. We analyze the interactions between the timing of dividends and their information content, controlling for share repurchase and tax effects. Dividend reductions that are not associated with share repurchases are statistically significantly related to future abnormal earnings and provide strong support for the information content of dividend reductions. The percentage of dividend reduction is stronger for interim than for final dividend reductions. The market reaction is negatively related to the reduction in imputation tax credit and reacts more aggressively and negatively to interim as compared to final dividend reductions. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 澳大利亚公司每半年支付一次股利，其中"期中"支付较小，"期末"支付较大。期中股利是在比期末股利信息更不充分的环境中宣布和支付的。我们分析了股利时点与其信息含量之间的相互作用，并控制了股份回购和税收效应。与股份回购无关的股利削减在统计上显著地与未来的异常盈余相关，并为股利削减的信息含量提供了有力支持。股利削减的百分比在期中股利削减中比在期末股利削减中更强。市场反应与归集税收抵免（imputation tax credit）的减少负相关，并且相较于期末股利削减，对期中股利削减的反应更为激进和负面。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does carbon risk matter in firm dividend policy? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in an imputation environment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the role of carbon risk in dividend policy, and how its effect varies between imputation (paying franked dividends) and classical (paying unfranked dividends) tax environments in the unique experimental setting in Australia. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Does carbon risk matter in firm dividend policy? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in an imputation environment (2018) Paper claim — We examine the role of carbon risk in dividend policy, and how its effect varies between imputation (paying franked dividends) and classical (paying unfranked dividends) tax environments in the unique experimental setting in Australia. Raw markdown: balachandran-2018-does-carbon-risk-matter-in-firm-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Balachandran, B, Nguyen, JH Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2018.09.015 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine the role of carbon risk in dividend policy, and how its effect varies between imputation (paying franked dividends) and classical (paying unfranked dividends) tax environments in the unique experimental setting in Australia. We find that the probability of paying dividend and dividend payout ratio is lower for firms in the highest-emitting industries (polluters) relative to non-polluters, subsequent to ratification of the Kyoto Protocol. While the post-Kyoto reduction in the likelihood of paying dividend is not significantly different, the reduction in payout ratio is smaller in the imputation environment than classical tax system, highlighting the significance of imputation tax environment only on the impact of carbon risk on dividend payout rather than decision to pay. We further document that the post-Kyoto reduction in dividend payout of polluters is driven by their relative increase in earnings uncertainty. The evidence suggests a causal influence of carbon risk on firm dividend policy. (C) 2018 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了碳风险在股利政策中的作用，以及其影响如何在归集抵免（imputation，派发已完税股利）税制与古典（classical，派发未完税股利）税制之间有所不同，采用澳大利亚这一独特的实验环境。我们发现，在《京都议定书》批准之后，相较于非污染企业，排放最高行业的企业（污染者）派发股利的概率和股利支付率都更低。虽然京都后派发股利可能性的降低没有显著差异，但支付率的降低在归集抵免环境下小于古典税制，这凸显了归集抵免税制仅对碳风险对股利支付的影响（而非对派发决定）有重要意义。我们进一步记录到，污染者京都后股利支付的降低是由其盈余不确定性的相对增加所驱动的。证据表明，碳风险对企业股利政策具有因果影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Insider ownership and dividend policy in an imputation tax environment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms are more likely to pay dividends with higher payout ratios in an imputation environment. Raw markdown: balachandran-2019-insider-ownership-and-dividend-policy-in-an-imputation Bibliographic Record Authors: Balachandran, B, Khan, A, Mather, P, Theobald, M…
pages.text: Insider ownership and dividend policy in an imputation tax environment (2019) Paper claim — Firms are more likely to pay dividends with higher payout ratios in an imputation environment. Raw markdown: balachandran-2019-insider-ownership-and-dividend-policy-in-an-imputation Bibliographic Record Authors: Balachandran, B, Khan, A, Mather, P, Theobald, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.01.014 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Firms are more likely to pay dividends with higher payout ratios in an imputation environment. The effects of profitability and earned/contributed capital mix on the decision to pay dividends and dividend payout are weaker for firms following imputation tax system than traditional tax system. Insider ownership is positively related to the decision to pay dividends and dividend payout and this effect does not vary between traditional and imputation tax systems. Firms with higher foreign institutional ownership are less likely to pay dividends and have lower payout ratios. The study demonstrates the significance of the imputation tax system upon dividend policy. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在归集抵免（imputation）税制环境下，企业更有可能派发股利并采用更高的支付率。在归集抵免税制下的企业，相较于传统税制下的企业，盈利能力以及留存资本/缴入资本结构对是否派发股利及股利支付的影响较弱。内部人持股与派发股利的决策及股利支付正相关，且这一效应在传统税制与归集抵免税制之间没有差异。外国机构持股比例更高的企业更不可能派发股利，且支付率更低。本研究揭示了归集抵免税制对股利政策的重要意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Ex dividend day stock price behavior: Discreteness or tax-induced clienteles?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Since prices are constrained to discrete tick multiples while dividends are essentially continuous, ex day price changes will not equal dividends. Raw markdown: bali-1998-ex-dividend-day-stock-price-behavior-discreteness-or Bibliographic Record Authors: Bali, R,…
pages.text: Ex dividend day stock price behavior: Discreteness or tax-induced clienteles? (1998) Paper claim — Since prices are constrained to discrete tick multiples while dividends are essentially continuous, ex day price changes will not equal dividends. Raw markdown: bali-1998-ex-dividend-day-stock-price-behavior-discreteness-or Bibliographic Record Authors: Bali, R, Hite, GL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(97)00041-X Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract Since prices are constrained to discrete tick multiples while dividends are essentially continuous, ex day price changes will not equal dividends. We argue that the expected price drop is strictly less than the dividend but within one tick of the dividend. The price-drop-to-dividend ratio will(i) be less than one, (ii) increase with dividends generally, and (iii) decline between tick multiples, giving a sawtooth pattern in the data, Since dividends and dividend yields are highly correlated, discreteness will give the impression of tax-induced dividend clienteles even if there are none. Taxable cash dividends and nontaxable stock dividends exhibit similar ex day behavior. (C) 1998 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 由于价格被约束为离散的最小报价单位（tick）倍数，而股利本质上是连续的，除息日的价格下跌不会等于股利。我们论证，预期的价格下跌严格小于股利，但在股利的一个tick范围之内。价格下跌与股利之比将（i）小于1，（ii）总体上随股利增加而上升，以及（iii）在tick倍数之间下降，从而在数据中呈现锯齿状模式。由于股利和股利收益率高度相关，即便根本不存在由税收诱发的股利投资者群体，离散性也会给人以存在这种群体的印象。应税现金股利和免税股票股利表现出类似的除息日行为。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Aggregate earnings, firm-level earnings, and expected stock returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper provides an analysis of the predictability of stock returns using market-, industry-, and firm-level earnings. Raw markdown: bali-2008-aggregate-earnings-firm-level-earnings-and-expected-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Bali, TG, Demirtas, KO,…
pages.text: Aggregate earnings, firm-level earnings, and expected stock returns (2008) Paper claim — This paper provides an analysis of the predictability of stock returns using market-, industry-, and firm-level earnings. Raw markdown: bali-2008-aggregate-earnings-firm-level-earnings-and-expected-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Bali, TG, Demirtas, KO, Tehranian, H Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000004245 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper provides an analysis of the predictability of stock returns using market-, industry-, and firm-level earnings. Contrary to Lamont (1998), we find that neither dividend payout ratio nor the level of aggregate earnings can forecast the excess market return. We show that these variables do not have robust predictive power across different stock portfolios and sample periods. In contrast to the aggregate-level findings, earnings yield has significant explanatory power for the time-series and cross-sectional variation in firm-level stock returns and the 48 industry portfolio returns. The mean reversion of stock prices as well as the earnings' correlation with expected stock returns are responsible for the forecasting power of earnings yield. These results are robust after controlling for book-to-market, size, price momentum, and post-earnings announcement drift. At the aggregate level, the information content of firm-level earnings about future cash flows is diversified away and higher aggregate earnings do not forecast higher returns. 摘要（中文） 本文利用市场层面、行业层面和企业层面的盈余，对股票收益的可预测性进行了分析。与Lamont（1998）相反，我们发现无论是股利支付率还是总量盈余水平都无法预测超额市场收益。我们表明，这些变量在不同的股票组合和样本期间不具有稳健的预测能力。与总量层面的发现相反，盈余收益率对企业层面股票收益以及48个行业组合收益的时间序列和横截面差异具有显著的解释力。股价的均值回归以及盈余与预期股票收益的相关性，是盈余收益率预测能力的原因。在控制了账面市值比、规模、价格动量和盈余公告后漂移之后，这些结果仍然稳健。在总量层面，企业层面盈余关于未来现金流的信息内容被分散化掉了，且更高的总量盈余并不预测更高的收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Deflating profitability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Gross profit scaled by book value of total assets predicts the cross section of average returns. Raw markdown: ball-2015-deflating-profitability Bibliographic Record Authors: Ball, R, Gerakos, J, Linnainmaa, JT, Nikolaev, VV Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS…
pages.text: Deflating profitability (2015) Paper claim — Gross profit scaled by book value of total assets predicts the cross section of average returns. Raw markdown: ball-2015-deflating-profitability Bibliographic Record Authors: Ball, R, Gerakos, J, Linnainmaa, JT, Nikolaev, VV Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2015.02.004 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract Gross profit scaled by book value of total assets predicts the cross section of average returns. Novy-Marx (2013) concludes that it outperforms other measures of profitability such as bottom line net income, cash flows, and dividends. One potential explanation for the measure's predictive ability is that its numerator (gross profit) is a cleaner measure of economic profitability. An alternative explanation lies in the measure's deflator. We find that net income equals gross profit in predictive power when they have consistent deflators. Deflating profit by the book value of total assets results in a variable that is the product of profitability and the ratio of the market value of equity to the book value of total assets, which is priced. We then construct an alternative measure of profitability, operating profitability, which better matches current expenses with current revenue. This measure exhibits a far stronger link with expected returns than either net income or gross profit. It predicts returns as far as ten years ahead, seemingly inconsistent with irrational pricing explanations. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 以总资产账面价值缩放的毛利润能够预测平均收益的横截面。Novy-Marx（2013）得出结论认为，它优于其他盈利能力度量指标，例如底线净利润、现金流和股利。该指标预测能力的一个潜在解释是其分子（毛利润）是对经济盈利能力更为纯净的度量。另一种解释在于该指标的缩放因子（deflator）。我们发现，当净利润和毛利润采用一致的缩放因子时，二者的预测能力相同。以总资产账面价值缩放利润所得到的变量，是盈利能力与股权市值对总资产账面价值之比的乘积，而该比率是被定价的。我们随后构建了另一种盈利能力度量指标——经营性盈利能力（operating profitability），它更好地将当期费用与当期收入相匹配。该指标与预期收益的联系远强于净利润或毛利润。它能预测远至十年之后的收益，这似乎与非理性定价的解释不相容。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Return predictability with endogenous growth
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The component of the volatility of total factor productivity (TFP) that is orthogonal to the dividend price ratio is shown to have long-run predictive ability for excess market returns. Raw markdown: bandi-2023-return-predictability-with-endogenous-growth…
pages.text: Return predictability with endogenous growth (2023) Paper claim — The component of the volatility of total factor productivity (TFP) that is orthogonal to the dividend price ratio is shown to have long-run predictive ability for excess market returns. Raw markdown: bandi-2023-return-predictability-with-endogenous-growth Bibliographic Record Authors: Bandi, FM, Bretscher, L, Tamoni, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2023.103724 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract The component of the volatility of total factor productivity (TFP) that is orthogonal to the dividend price ratio is shown to have long-run predictive ability for excess market returns. This finding implies that TFP volatility should also predict real cash flows and/or real interest rates: it is found to mainly predict real cash flows through inflation. A model with endogenous growth, Epstein-Zin preferences and price rigidities reconciles both TFP volatility-driven long-run predictability and its real implications. Within the model, we justify the similar (to that of TFP volatility) predictive ability of a low-frequency notion of market volatility as well as the cross-sectional pricing of TFP volatility risk in alternative asset classes. 摘要（中文） 全要素生产率（TFP）波动率中与股利价格比正交的成分被证明对超额市场收益具有长期预测能力。这一发现意味着TFP波动率还应预测实际现金流和/或实际利率：结果发现它主要通过通胀来预测实际现金流。一个具有内生增长、Epstein-Zin偏好和价格黏性的模型调和了TFP波动率驱动的长期可预测性及其实际影响。在该模型中，我们解释了低频市场波动率概念具有（与TFP波动率）相似的预测能力，以及TFP波动率风险在替代资产类别中的截面定价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock market liquidity and firm dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We provide evidence of a link between firm dividend policy and stock market liquidity. Raw markdown: banerjee-2007-stock-market-liquidity-and-firm-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Banerjee, S, Gatchev, VA, Spindt, PA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND…
pages.text: Stock market liquidity and firm dividend policy (2007) Paper claim — We provide evidence of a link between firm dividend policy and stock market liquidity. Raw markdown: banerjee-2007-stock-market-liquidity-and-firm-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Banerjee, S, Gatchev, VA, Spindt, PA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000003318 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We provide evidence of a link between firm dividend policy and stock market liquidity. In the cross section, owners of less (more) liquid common stock are more (less) likely to receive cash dividends. Predictions of the proportion of dividend payers based on 19631977 cross-sectional estimates account for most of the declining propensity of firms to pay dividends as documented by Fama and French (2001). Furthermore, historic liquidity is an important determinant of dividend initiations and omissions. Finally, we show that sensitivity of firm value to aggregate liquidity declines after dividend initiations, suggesting that investors view stock market liquidity and dividends as substitutes. 摘要（中文） 我们提供证据表明企业股利政策与股票市场流动性之间存在关联。在横截面上，持有流动性较低（较高）普通股的所有者更（更不）可能获得现金股利。基于1963—1977年横截面估计对派息企业比例的预测，解释了Fama和French（2001）所记录的企业派息倾向下降的大部分。此外，历史流动性是股利发起和取消的重要决定因素。最后，我们表明，企业价值对总体流动性的敏感性在股利发起后下降，这表明投资者将股票市场流动性和股利视为替代品。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Restraining Overconfident CEOs through Improved Governance: Evidence from the Sarbanes-Oxley Act
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The literature posits that some CEO overconfidence benefits shareholders, though high levels may not. Raw markdown: banerjee-2015-restraining-overconfident-ceos-through-improved-governance-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Banerjee, S, Humphery-Jenner, M,…
pages.text: Restraining Overconfident CEOs through Improved Governance: Evidence from the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (2015) Paper claim — The literature posits that some CEO overconfidence benefits shareholders, though high levels may not. Raw markdown: banerjee-2015-restraining-overconfident-ceos-through-improved-governance-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Banerjee, S, Humphery-Jenner, M, Nanda, V Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhv034 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The literature posits that some CEO overconfidence benefits shareholders, though high levels may not. We argue that adequate controls and independent viewpoints provided by an independent board mitigates the costs of CEO overconfidence. We use the concurrent passage of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and changes to the NYSE/NASDAQ listing rules (collectively, SOX) as natural experiments, to examine whether board independence improves decision making by overconfident CEOs. The results are strongly supportive: after SOX, overconfident CEOs reduce investment and risk exposure, increase dividends, improve postacquisition performance, and have better operating performance and market value. Importantly, these changes are absent for overconfident-CEO firms that were compliant prior to SOX. 摘要（中文） 文献认为，一定程度的CEO过度自信有利于股东，尽管过高的程度可能并非如此。我们认为，由独立董事会提供的充分控制和独立观点能够缓解CEO过度自信的成本。我们利用《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》的同期通过以及纽约证券交易所/纳斯达克上市规则的变化（合称SOX）作为自然实验，来考察董事会独立性是否改善了过度自信的CEO的决策。结果强有力地予以支持：在SOX之后，过度自信的CEO减少了投资和风险暴露，增加了股利，改善了并购后的绩效，并拥有更好的经营业绩和市场价值。重要的是，对于在SOX之前就已合规的过度自信CEO公司而言，这些变化并不存在。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does CEO bias escalate repurchase activity?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose and test the hypothesis that overconfident-CEOs, with upwardly-biased estimates of own firm-value, are more predisposed to repurchasing stock. Raw markdown: banerjee-2018-does-ceo-bias-escalate-repurchase-activity Bibliographic Record Authors: Banerjee,…
pages.text: Does CEO bias escalate repurchase activity? (2018) Paper claim — We propose and test the hypothesis that overconfident-CEOs, with upwardly-biased estimates of own firm-value, are more predisposed to repurchasing stock. Raw markdown: banerjee-2018-does-ceo-bias-escalate-repurchase-activity Bibliographic Record Authors: Banerjee, S, Humphery-Jenner, M, Nanda, V Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2018.02.003 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We propose and test the hypothesis that overconfident-CEOs, with upwardly-biased estimates of own firm-value, are more predisposed to repurchasing stock. An implication is that the stock-market, recognizing overconfident-CEO behavior, will react less positively to repurchase announcements. The hypothesis is strongly supported: Overconfident managers repurchase stock at lower levels of cash holdings, and respond more to stock-price declines. Entrenchment exacerbates this behavior. Interestingly, institutional investors appear to encourage repurchases, perhaps to curb excessive investment. Overconfident-CEOs are also more likely to substitute repurchases for dividends or capital expenditure. Consistent with our hypothesis, the stock-market reaction to these share repurchase announcements is less positive. (C) 2018 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们提出并检验这一假设：对自身企业价值有向上偏误估计的过度自信CEO更倾向于回购股票。其一个含义是，认识到过度自信CEO行为的股票市场将对回购公告作出不那么正面的反应。该假设得到有力支持：过度自信的经理人在更低的现金持有水平上回购股票，并对股价下跌反应更强烈。固守地位加剧了这种行为。有趣的是，机构投资者似乎会鼓励回购，或许是为了抑制过度投资。过度自信的CEO也更可能用回购替代股利或资本支出。与我们的假设一致，股票市场对这些股份回购公告的反应不那么正面。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Consumption, dividends, and the cross section of equity returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that aggregate consumption risks embodied in cash flows can account for the puzzling differences in risk premia across book-to-market, momentum, and size-sorted portfolios. Raw markdown: bansal-2005-consumption-dividends-and-the-cross-section-of-equity…
pages.text: Consumption, dividends, and the cross section of equity returns (2005) Paper claim — We show that aggregate consumption risks embodied in cash flows can account for the puzzling differences in risk premia across book-to-market, momentum, and size-sorted portfolios. Raw markdown: bansal-2005-consumption-dividends-and-the-cross-section-of-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Bansal, R, Dittmar, RF, Lundblad, CT Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2005.00776.x Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We show that aggregate consumption risks embodied in cash flows can account for the puzzling differences in risk premia across book-to-market, momentum, and size-sorted portfolios. The dynamics of aggregate consumption and cash flow growth rates, modeled as a vector autoregression, are used to measure the consumption beta of discounted cash flows. Differences in these cash flow betas account for more than 60% of the cross-sectional variation in risk premia. The market price for risk in cash flows is highly significant. We argue that cash flow risk is important for interpreting differences in risk compensation across assets. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，现金流中所蕴含的总体消费风险可以解释账面市值比、动量和按规模排序的组合之间风险溢价的令人困惑的差异。总体消费和现金流增长率的动态被建模为一个向量自回归，并用于度量贴现现金流的消费贝塔。这些现金流贝塔的差异解释了风险溢价横截面变动的60%以上。现金流中风险的市场价格高度显著。我们认为，现金流风险对于解释资产之间风险补偿的差异很重要。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The term structure of equity risk premia
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We estimate a regime-switching model for the equity term structure with Bayesian methods. Raw markdown: bansal-2021-the-term-structure-of-equity-risk-premia Bibliographic Record Authors: Bansal, R, Miller, S, Song, DH, Yaron, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: The term structure of equity risk premia (2021) Paper claim — We estimate a regime-switching model for the equity term structure with Bayesian methods. Raw markdown: bansal-2021-the-term-structure-of-equity-risk-premia Bibliographic Record Authors: Bansal, R, Miller, S, Song, DH, Yaron, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.05.043 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We estimate a regime-switching model for the equity term structure with Bayesian methods. Our approach accounts for the data sample being unrepresentative of the population distribution of regimes. We find that (i) the term structure of expected equity dividend strip returns is downward sloping in recessions and upward sloping in expansions, and (ii ) the unconditional term structure of expected equity returns is positively sloped. Our estimation shows that the sample unrepresentativeness induces a downward bias in the estimate of the equity term structure slope. We present a regime-switching consumption based asset-pricing model that matches the empirical findings. (C) 2021 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们用贝叶斯方法估计了一个关于股票期限结构的区制转换模型。我们的方法考虑了数据样本对区制总体分布不具代表性的问题。我们发现：（i）预期股票股利条带收益的期限结构在衰退期向下倾斜，在扩张期向上倾斜；以及（ii）预期股票收益的无条件期限结构呈正斜率。我们的估计表明，样本不具代表性会导致股票期限结构斜率的估计出现向下偏差。我们提出了一个基于消费的区制转换资产定价模型，它与这些经验发现相匹配。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the accuracy of various estimates of firms' repurchases of common stock used in earlier studies, and find high error rates in the most commonly used estimators. Raw markdown: banyi-2008-errors-in-estimating-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Errors in estimating share repurchases (2008) Paper claim — We examine the accuracy of various estimates of firms' repurchases of common stock used in earlier studies, and find high error rates in the most commonly used estimators. Raw markdown: banyi-2008-errors-in-estimating-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Banyi, ML, Dyl, EA, Kahle, KM Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2008.06.004 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract We examine the accuracy of various estimates of firms' repurchases of common stock used in earlier studies, and find high error rates in the most commonly used estimators. We also find that the procedure used to estimate open market share repurchases can significantly impact results. The Compustat-based measure, which is the most accurate, deviates from the actual number of shares repurchased by more than 30% in about 16% of the cases. We conclude that many studies should be revisited now that the SEC mandates disclosure of precise information about share repurchases in Forms 10-Q and 10-K. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了此前研究中所使用的对公司普通股回购的各种估计的准确性，发现最常用的估计量存在高错误率。我们还发现用于估计公开市场股份回购的程序可能显著影响结果。基于Compustat的度量是最准确的，但在约16%的案例中偏离实际回购股份数超过30%。我们得出结论，鉴于SEC现在强制要求在10-Q和10-K表格中披露关于股份回购的精确信息，许多研究应当重新审视。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Declining propensity to pay? A re-examination of the lifecycle theory (2014) Paper claim — Our results indicate that the declining propensity to pay is a function of the changing composition of firms over time and not a declining propensity in individual firms themselves. Raw markdown: banyi-2014-declining-propensity-to-pay-a-re-examination-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Banyi, ML, Kahle, KM Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.06.001 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Our results indicate that the declining propensity to pay is a function of the changing composition of firms over time and not a declining propensity in individual firms themselves. In particular, the propensity to pay is greater than expected following the 2003 dividend tax cut. The decade a firm went public is also a major determinant of its initial payout policy. Finally, while the strength of the relation between earned/contributed capital and payout propensity declines across IPO decades, there is still a lifecycle effect - within a given IPO cohort, the likelihood of payout increases as firms age. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们的结果表明，派发意愿的下降是公司构成随时间变化的结果，而非公司个体自身派发意愿的下降。特别是，在2003年股利减税之后，派发意愿高于预期。公司上市的年代也是其初始支付政策的一个主要决定因素。最后，尽管留存/贡献资本与派发意愿之间关系的强度在各个IPO年代之间有所下降，但生命周期效应依然存在——在给定的IPO同批公司内，随着公司年龄增长，派发的可能性增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and Corporate Shareholders
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Corporations uniquely have a tax preference for cash dividends. Raw markdown: barclay-2009-dividends-and-corporate-shareholders Bibliographic Record Authors: Barclay, MJ, Holderness, CG, Sheehan, DP Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2009 DOI:…
pages.text: Dividends and Corporate Shareholders (2009) Paper claim — Corporations uniquely have a tax preference for cash dividends. Raw markdown: barclay-2009-dividends-and-corporate-shareholders Bibliographic Record Authors: Barclay, MJ, Holderness, CG, Sheehan, DP Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhn060 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Corporations uniquely have a tax preference for cash dividends. Nevertheless, dividends do not increase following trades of large-percentage blocks of stock from individuals to corporations. Moreover, although one-third of firms have corporate blockholders, 68% of these firms pay no dividends, and ownership is not clustered at levels that increase the tax benefits of dividends. These findings are not driven by the investing firms' tax rates or by agency problems. Instead, operating companies expand the target firms and pursue joint ventures. Dividends are lower with these investors. Financial investors are not attracted to dividend-paying firms and tend to be passive. 摘要（中文） 企业独特地对现金股利具有税收偏好。然而，在大比例股票区块从个人转让给企业之后，股利并未增加。此外，尽管三分之一的企业拥有企业型区块持股人，但这些企业中有68%不派发股利，且所有权并未集中在能够增加股利税收利益的水平上。这些发现并非由投资企业的税率或代理问题所驱动。相反，经营性公司会扩大目标企业并寻求合资经营。有这些投资者时股利更低。金融投资者不被派发股利的企业所吸引，且往往是被动的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Seasoned equity offerings and corporate financial management
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We assume executives managing corporate financial policy consider the firm's current and target leverage, investment plans, anticipated cash flows, and consequences of alternative sequences of financing transactions, operating within efficient markets. Raw…
pages.text: Seasoned equity offerings and corporate financial management (2021) Paper claim — We assume executives managing corporate financial policy consider the firm's current and target leverage, investment plans, anticipated cash flows, and consequences of alternative sequences of financing transactions, operating within efficient markets. Raw markdown: barclay-2021-seasoned-equity-offerings-and-corporate-financial-management Bibliographic Record Authors: Barclay, MJ, Fu, FJ, Smith, CW Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101700 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract We assume executives managing corporate financial policy consider the firm's current and target leverage, investment plans, anticipated cash flows, and consequences of alternative sequences of financing transactions, operating within efficient markets. Our analysis yields time-series and cross-sectional predictions for management of investment spending and leverage; use of maturity, priority, and convertibility covenants; and management of dividends, share repurchases, cash balances, and credit lines. Our evidence from 8608 SEOs covering 1970-2015 is consistent with implications of our theory, helps to resolve an array of issues in corporate finance, and offers a step toward a more unified analysis of rational corporate financial management. 摘要（中文） 我们假设，管理企业财务政策的高管在有效市场中运作，会考虑企业当前和目标杠杆、投资计划、预期现金流以及各种融资交易序列的后果。我们的分析针对投资支出与杠杆的管理；期限、优先级和可转换性契约条款的使用；以及股利、股份回购、现金余额和信贷额度的管理，给出了时间序列和横截面预测。我们来自涵盖1970—2015年的8608次增发（SEO）的证据与我们理论的推论一致，有助于解决公司金融中的一系列问题，并朝着对理性企业财务管理进行更加统一的分析迈出了一步。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Accelerated share repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Accelerated share repurchases (ASRs) are credible commitments by firms to repurchase shares immediately. Raw markdown: bargeron-2011-accelerated-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Bargeron, L, Kulchania, M, Thomas, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: Accelerated share repurchases (2011) Paper claim — Accelerated share repurchases (ASRs) are credible commitments by firms to repurchase shares immediately. Raw markdown: bargeron-2011-accelerated-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Bargeron, L, Kulchania, M, Thomas, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.02.004 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Accelerated share repurchases (ASRs) are credible commitments by firms to repurchase shares immediately. Including an ASR in a repurchase program reduces the flexibility that firms have to alter an announced program in response to subsequent changes in the price and liquidity of its shares, unexpected shocks to cash flow and/or investment, etc. Thus, we investigate whether firms' decisions to include ASRs in their repurchase programs are associated with factors expected to influence the costs of lost flexibility and the benefits of enhanced credibility and immediacy. We find robust evidence consistent with the costs of lost flexibility and the benefits of credibility and immediacy being important determinants of ASR adoption. Additionally, we find that ASR announcements are associated with positive average abnormal stock returns. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 加速股份回购（ASRs）是公司立即回购股份的可信承诺。在回购计划中纳入ASR会降低公司为应对随后股价和股份流动性的变化、对现金流和/或投资的意外冲击等而更改已宣布计划的灵活性。因此，我们考察公司在其回购计划中纳入ASR的决策，是否与预期会影响损失灵活性的成本以及增强可信度和即时性收益的因素相关。我们发现了稳健的证据，与损失灵活性的成本以及可信度和即时性的收益是ASR采用的重要决定因素相一致。此外，我们发现ASR公告与正的平均异常股票收益相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Permanent Capital Losses after Banking Crises
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. Raw markdown: baron-2026-permanent-capital-losses-after-banking-crises Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Permanent Capital Losses after Banking Crises (2026) Paper claim — We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. Raw markdown: baron-2026-permanent-capital-losses-after-banking-crises Bibliographic Record Authors: Baron, M, Laeven, L, Pénasse, J, Usenko, Y Journal: QUARTERLY JOURNAL OF ECONOMICS Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1093/qje/qjaf052 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. We find that bank stocks experience large, permanent declines at the onset of crises. These losses predict commensurate long-term declines in banks' earnings and dividends, rather than elevated future equity returns. Bank losses are primarily driven by write-downs of nonperforming assets, not asset sales during panics. Forceful liquidity-based interventions during crises predict only small, temporary increases in bank market value. Overall, these results suggest that bank losses during crises are not primarily due to temporary price dislocations. Early liquidity interventions can avert banking crises, but only under specific conditions. Once large bank equity declines have occurred, policy responses have historically failed to prevent persistent undercapitalization in the banking sector. 摘要（中文） 我们研究在46个经济体的历史性银行危机中驱动银行损失的机制，以及政策干预在恢复银行资本化方面的有效性。我们发现，银行股票在危机爆发时经历巨大的、永久性的下跌。这些损失预示着银行盈利和股利相应的长期下降，而非未来股权收益的提升。银行损失主要由不良资产的减记所驱动，而非恐慌期间的资产出售。危机期间强有力的基于流动性的干预只预示着银行市场价值小幅、暂时的增加。总体而言，这些结果表明，危机期间的银行损失并非主要归因于暂时性的价格错位。早期的流动性干预能够避免银行危机，但只在特定条件下如此。一旦大规模的银行股权下跌已经发生，从历史上看政策应对未能阻止银行部门持续的资本不足。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Rare Disasters, Asset Prices, and Welfare Costs
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A representative-consumer model with Epstein-Zin-Weil preferences and i.i.d. Raw markdown: barro-2009-rare-disasters-asset-prices-and-welfare-costs Bibliographic Record Authors: Barro, RJ Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1257/aer.99.1.243…
pages.text: Rare Disasters, Asset Prices, and Welfare Costs (2009) Paper claim — A representative-consumer model with Epstein-Zin-Weil preferences and i.i.d. Raw markdown: barro-2009-rare-disasters-asset-prices-and-welfare-costs Bibliographic Record Authors: Barro, RJ Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1257/aer.99.1.243 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract A representative-consumer model with Epstein-Zin-Weil preferences and i.i.d. shocks, including rare disasters, accords with observed equity premia rates if the and coefficient of relative risk aversion equals 3-4. If the inter-risk-free temporal elasticity of substitution exceeds one, an increase in uncertainty lowers the price-dividend ratio for equity, and a rise in the expected growth rate raises this ratio. Calibrations indicate that society would willingly reduce GDP by around 20 percent each year to eliminate rare disasters. The welfare cost from usual economic fluctuations is much smaller, though still important, corresponding to lowering GDP by about 1.5 percent each Year. (JEL E13, E21, E22, E32) 摘要（中文） 一个具有Epstein-Zin-Weil偏好和独立同分布冲击（包括罕见灾难）的代表性消费者模型，如果相对风险厌恶系数等于3-4，则与观察到的股权溢价率和无风险利率相一致。如果跨期替代弹性超过1，则不确定性的增加会降低股权的价格-股利比，而预期增长率的上升会提高这一比率。校准表明，社会将愿意每年将GDP减少约20%以消除罕见灾难。来自通常经济波动的福利成本要小得多，尽管仍然重要，相当于每年将GDP降低约1.5%。（JEL E13, E21, E22, E32） Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate Postretirement Benefit Plans and Real Investment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper shows that the real investment by nonfinancial firms is systematically related to the size of their defined-benefit plan. Raw markdown: bartram-2017-corporate-postretirement-benefit-plans-and-real-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Bartram, SM…
pages.text: Corporate Postretirement Benefit Plans and Real Investment (2017) Paper claim — This paper shows that the real investment by nonfinancial firms is systematically related to the size of their defined-benefit plan. Raw markdown: bartram-2017-corporate-postretirement-benefit-plans-and-real-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Bartram, SM Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2015.2307 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, alternative, cash flow, substitut) Abstract This paper shows that the real investment by nonfinancial firms is systematically related to the size of their defined-benefit plan. In particular, these plans allow research and development (R&D)-intensive firms to retain and borrowfrom their employees, which is attractive since they have high adjustment costs, require a stable cash flow, have less collateral, have assets that are harder to value, and have high asymmetric information and agency costs. By contrast, capital expenditures benefit from credit multiplier effects with regard to regular debt, which substitutes for postretirement obligations. As a result, firms with defined-benefit plans have 12% more R&D and 5% less capital expenditure compared with otherwise similar firms, and they vary contributions as a function of cash flow and real investment. The role of postretirement plans is attenuated in countries with available alternative funding sources. The results are robust to controlling for other dimensions of financial policy-cash holdings, debt maturity, dividends, preferred stock, convertible debt, and leverage-that also affect real investment. 摘要（中文） 本文表明，非金融企业的实物投资与其固定收益（defined-benefit）计划的规模存在系统性关联。特别是，这些计划使研发（R&D）密集型企业能够留住员工并向其借款，这颇具吸引力，因为这类企业调整成本高、需要稳定的现金流、抵押品较少、资产更难估值、且信息不对称和代理成本高。相比之下，资本支出受益于常规债务的信用乘数效应，而常规债务替代了退休后义务。因此，与其他方面相似的企业相比，拥有固定收益计划的企业研发多出12%、资本支出少出5%，且它们根据现金流和实物投资来调整缴款。在存在替代融资来源的国家，退休后计划的作用被削弱。这些结果在控制影响实物投资的其他财务政策维度（现金持有、债务期限、股利、优先股、可转换债务和杠杆）之后依然稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: DIVIDEND SURPRISES INFERRED FROM OPTION AND STOCK-PRICES
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper introduces a new method to measure the unexpected component of dividend announcements. Raw markdown: baryosef-1992-dividend-surprises-inferred-from-option-and-stock-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: BARYOSEF, S, SARIG, OH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE…
pages.text: DIVIDEND SURPRISES INFERRED FROM OPTION AND STOCK-PRICES (1992) Paper claim — This paper introduces a new method to measure the unexpected component of dividend announcements. Raw markdown: baryosef-1992-dividend-surprises-inferred-from-option-and-stock-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: BARYOSEF, S, SARIG, OH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2328957 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper introduces a new method to measure the unexpected component of dividend announcements. While measures used previously were based on various arbitrary models of dividend expectations, our suggested method compares the reaction of stock and option prices to dividend announcements. Our measure is compared to commonly used model-based measures, to a Box-Jenkins time-series-based measure, and to a Value-Line Investor Survey-based measure of dividend surprises. The new measure is more highly correlated with the market's reaction to the announcements than are alternative measures of dividend surprises. The new measure is also shown to be insensitive to the extent to which the options used to identify unexpected dividend announcements are in- or out-of-the-money. 摘要（中文） 本文引入了一种新方法来度量股利公告的意外成分。此前所使用的度量基于关于股利预期的各种任意模型，而我们所建议的方法比较了股价和期权价格对股利公告的反应。我们的度量与常用的基于模型的度量、一种基于Box-Jenkins时间序列的度量以及一种基于Value-Line投资者调查的股利意外度量进行了比较。这一新度量与市场对公告的反应的相关性高于股利意外的替代度量。新度量还被证明对用于识别意外股利公告的期权是实值还是虚值的程度不敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: US stock prices and the dot.com-bubble: Can dividend policy rescue the efficient market hypothesis?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper thoroughly integrates speculative bubbles to corporate finance literature by focusing on dividend policy issues. Raw markdown: basse-2021-us-stock-prices-and-the-dot-com-bubble Bibliographic Record Authors: Basse, T, Klein, T, Vigne, SA, Wegener, C…
pages.text: US stock prices and the dot.com-bubble: Can dividend policy rescue the efficient market hypothesis? (2021) Paper claim — This paper thoroughly integrates speculative bubbles to corporate finance literature by focusing on dividend policy issues. Raw markdown: basse-2021-us-stock-prices-and-the-dot-com-bubble Bibliographic Record Authors: Basse, T, Klein, T, Vigne, SA, Wegener, C Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.101892 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper thoroughly integrates speculative bubbles to corporate finance literature by focusing on dividend policy issues. More specifically, we examine the importance of dividend policy when testing for speculative bubbles in the S&P500 equity index on a data set spanning 1871 to 2014. Given the phenomenon of dividend smoothing, in particular in the U.S., we question the usefulness of observed dividend payments as fundamental factor in testing for bubbles. Circumventing dividend smoothing, we construct hypothetical dividend payouts which are based on reported corporate earnings instead. The empirical evidence presented here indeed suggests that the dividend policy of firms affects testing for speculative bubbles. While the dot.com-bubble-commonly seen as the prime example for a stock price bubble not only in the NASDAQ but also in other, broader equity indices-is detected with the observed dividend series as fundamental factor, this is not necessarily the case with our adjusted dividend time series. Some of our results argue against a speculative price bubble in the broader U.S. stock market in the late 1990s. 摘要（中文） 本文通过聚焦于股利政策问题，将投机性泡沫充分纳入公司金融文献。更具体地说，我们在1871至2014年的数据集上考察了股利政策在检验标普500股票指数投机性泡沫时的重要性。鉴于股利平滑现象（尤其在美国），我们质疑观察到的股利支付作为泡沫检验中基本面因素的有用性。为规避股利平滑，我们构建了基于报告的公司盈余的假设性股利支付。这里呈现的实证证据确实表明，企业的股利政策会影响泡沫检验。虽然使用观察到的股利序列作为基本面因素能够检测到互联网泡沫（dot.com-bubble）——它通常被视为不仅在纳斯达克而且在其他更广泛股票指数中股价泡沫的典型例子——但使用我们调整后的股利时间序列则未必如此。我们的一些结果反驳了1990年代末更广泛的美国股市存在投机性价格泡沫的观点。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Asset sales, investment opportunities, and the use of proceeds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the allocation of cash proceeds following 400 subsidiary sales between 1990 and 1998. Raw markdown: bates-2005-asset-sales-investment-opportunities-and-the-use-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bates, TW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2005…
pages.text: Asset sales, investment opportunities, and the use of proceeds (2005) Paper claim — This study examines the allocation of cash proceeds following 400 subsidiary sales between 1990 and 1998. Raw markdown: bates-2005-asset-sales-investment-opportunities-and-the-use-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bates, TW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2005.00726.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution)；影响机制(agency, trade-off) Abstract This study examines the allocation of cash proceeds following 400 subsidiary sales between 1990 and 1998. Retention probabilities are increasing in the divesting firm's contemporaneous growth opportunities and expected investment. Retaining firms, however, also systematically overinvest relative to an industry benchmark. Shareholder returns to retention decisions are positively correlated with growth opportunities and benchmarked investment, but negatively correlated with benchmarked investment for firms with poor growth opportunities. Shareholder returns to debt distributions are increasing in industry-benchmarked leverage. Overall, the results of this study cohere with the hypothesized trade-off between the investment efficiencies associated with retained proceeds and the agency costs of managerial discretion and debt. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了1990年至1998年间400笔子公司出售之后现金收益的配置。剥离企业当期成长机会和预期投资越高，保留（收益）的概率越高。然而，保留（收益）的企业相对于行业基准也系统性地过度投资。保留决策的股东收益与成长机会和基准化投资正相关，但对于成长机会较差的企业，则与基准化投资负相关。债务分配的股东收益随行业基准化杠杆的上升而增加。总体而言，本研究结果与所假设的权衡相符，即保留收益带来的投资效率与管理者自由裁量权和债务的代理成本之间的权衡。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: CEO political ideology and payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates how CEO political ideology affects payout policy. Raw markdown: bayat-2025-ceo-political-ideology-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bayat, A, Goergen, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI:…
pages.text: CEO political ideology and payout policy (2025) Paper claim — This study investigates how CEO political ideology affects payout policy. Raw markdown: bayat-2025-ceo-political-ideology-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bayat, A, Goergen, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107375 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract This study investigates how CEO political ideology affects payout policy. Studying the CEOs of S&P 500 firms during 1997-2019 and measuring CEO political ideology by CEO political donations, we find that conservative CEOs are more likely to pay dividends and to make share repurchases, while also paying higher dividends. We find that conservative CEOs finance the higher dividends and share repurchases by utilizing the cash holdings and reducing capital and R&D expenditures. Nevertheless, CEO political ideology does not explain dividend cuts. This suggests that firms led by conservative CEOs exhibit levels of dividend flexibility comparable to those of firms led by other CEOs. Finally, we find that CEO conservatism has no effect on firm performance, firm value, R&D expenditure, and capital expenditure. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察CEO政治意识形态如何影响支付政策。研究1997—2019年间标普500企业的CEO，并以CEO的政治捐款来度量CEO政治意识形态，我们发现，保守派CEO更可能派发股利和进行股份回购，同时也支付更高的股利。我们发现，保守派CEO通过动用现金持有以及削减资本支出和研发支出来为更高的股利和股份回购提供资金。然而，CEO政治意识形态并不能解释股利削减。这表明，由保守派CEO领导的企业所表现出的股利灵活性水平与由其他CEO领导的企业相当。最后，我们发现CEO保守主义对企业业绩、企业价值、研发支出和资本支出均无影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The impact of CEO political ideology on labor cost reductions and payout decisions during the COVID-19 pandemic (2025) Paper claim — Using a hand-collected dataset, we study whether CEO political ideology affected S&P 500 firms' reactions to the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. Raw markdown: bayat-2025-the-impact-of-ceo-political-ideology-on-labor Bibliographic Record Authors: Bayat, A, Goergen, M, Koutroumpis, P, Wei, XJ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2024.102692 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Using a hand-collected dataset, we study whether CEO political ideology affected S&P 500 firms' reactions to the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. During the pandemic, CEOs had the option to distribute the pain of the pandemic's impact onto shareholders by paying lower dividends, onto the workforce by reducing labor costs, or to share the pain. We hypothesize that conservative CEOs were more likely to aggressively reduce labor costs while still meeting dividend expectations. Conversely, other CEOs would have been less likely to meet dividend expectations and less likely to reduce labor costs. Our findings support this hypothesis. We also find that during the pandemic, conservative CEOs used temporary downsizing to avoid earnings losses, enabling them to meet dividend expectations. 摘要（中文） 使用手工收集的数据集，我们研究CEO政治意识形态是否影响标普500企业在2020年对COVID-19疫情的反应。在疫情期间，CEO可以选择将疫情冲击的痛苦分摊给股东（通过派发较低股利）、分摊给劳动力（通过削减劳动力成本），或者共同分担痛苦。我们假设保守派CEO更有可能在仍然满足股利预期的同时积极削减劳动力成本。相反，其他CEO则不太可能满足股利预期，也不太可能削减劳动力成本。我们的发现支持这一假设。我们还发现，在疫情期间，保守派CEO使用暂时性裁员来避免盈利损失，从而使他们能够满足股利预期。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A basic question for the design of bankruptcy law concerns whether value should be divided in accordance with absolute priority. Raw markdown: bebchuk-2002-ex-ante-costs-of-violating-absolute-priority-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Bebchuk, LA Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Ex ante costs of violating absolute priority in bankruptcy (2002) Paper claim — A basic question for the design of bankruptcy law concerns whether value should be divided in accordance with absolute priority. Raw markdown: bebchuk-2002-ex-ante-costs-of-violating-absolute-priority-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Bebchuk, LA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00427 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract A basic question for the design of bankruptcy law concerns whether value should be divided in accordance with absolute priority. Research done in the past decade has suggested that deviations from absolute priority have beneficial ex ante effects. In contrast, this paper shows that ex post deviations from absolute priority also have negative effects on ex ante decisions taken by shareholders, Such deviations aggravate the moral hazard problem with respect to project choice-increasing the equityholders' incentive to favor risky projects-as well as with respect to borrowing and dividend decisions. 摘要（中文） 破产法设计的一个基本问题涉及价值是否应按绝对优先权进行分配。过去十年所做的研究表明，偏离绝对优先权具有有益的事前效应。相比之下，本文表明，事后偏离绝对优先权对股东所采取的事前决策也具有负面效应。此类偏离加剧了在项目选择方面的道德风险问题——增加了股权持有者偏好高风险项目的激励——同时也加剧了在借款和股利决策方面的道德风险问题。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Local Dividend Clienteles
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We exploit demographic variation to identify the effect of dividend demand on corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: becker-2011-local-dividend-clienteles Bibliographic Record Authors: Becker, B, Ivkovic, Z, Weisbenner, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI:…
pages.text: Local Dividend Clienteles (2011) Paper claim — We exploit demographic variation to identify the effect of dividend demand on corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: becker-2011-local-dividend-clienteles Bibliographic Record Authors: Becker, B, Ivkovic, Z, Weisbenner, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2010.01645.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We exploit demographic variation to identify the effect of dividend demand on corporate payout policy. Retail investors tend to hold local stocks and older investors prefer dividend-paying stocks. Together, these tendencies generate geographically varying demand for dividends. Firms headquartered in areas in which seniors constitute a large fraction of the population are more likely to pay dividends, initiate dividends, and have higher dividend yields. We also provide indirect evidence as to why managers may respond to the demand for dividends from local seniors. Overall, these results are consistent with the notion that the investor base affects corporate policy choices. 摘要（中文） 我们利用人口结构差异来识别股利需求对公司支付政策的影响。散户投资者倾向于持有本地股票，而年长投资者偏好支付股利的股票。这两种倾向共同产生了随地理区域而变化的股利需求。总部位于老年人占人口比例较大地区的公司，更可能支付股利、开始派发股利并拥有更高的股利收益率。我们还提供了间接证据，说明为何管理者可能会回应本地老年人对股利的需求。总体而言，这些结果与投资者基础会影响公司政策选择这一观点相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout taxes and the allocation of investment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — When corporate payout is taxed, internal equity (retained earnings) is cheaper than external equity (share issues). Raw markdown: becker-2013-payout-taxes-and-the-allocation-of-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Becker, B, Jacob, M, Jacob, M Journal: JOURNAL…
pages.text: Payout taxes and the allocation of investment (2013) Paper claim — When corporate payout is taxed, internal equity (retained earnings) is cheaper than external equity (share issues). Raw markdown: becker-2013-payout-taxes-and-the-allocation-of-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Becker, B, Jacob, M, Jacob, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2012.08.003 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract When corporate payout is taxed, internal equity (retained earnings) is cheaper than external equity (share issues). If there are no perfect substitutes for equity finance, payout taxes may therefore have an effect on the investment of firms. High taxes will favor investment by firms who can finance internally. Using an international panel with many changes in payout taxes, we show that this prediction holds well. Payout taxes have a large impact on the dynamics of corporate investment and growth. Investment is "locked in" in profitable firms when payout is heavily taxed. Thus, apart from any level effects, payout taxes change the allocation of capital. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 当企业支付被征税时，内部股权（留存收益）比外部股权（股票发行）更便宜。如果不存在股权融资的完美替代品，那么支付税因此可能对企业投资产生影响。高税收将有利于能够依靠内部融资的公司进行投资。利用一个包含许多支付税变动的国际面板数据，我们表明这一预测很好地成立。支付税对企业投资和增长的动态具有重大影响。当支付被大量征税时，投资被“锁定”在盈利的公司中。因此，除了任何水平效应之外，支付税改变了资本的配置。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: CHARACTERIZING PREDICTABLE COMPONENTS IN EXCESS RETURNS ON EQUITY AND FOREIGN-EXCHANGE MARKETS (1992) Paper claim — The paper first characterizes the predictable components in excess rates of returns on major equity and foreign exchange markets using lagged excess returns, dividend yields, and forward premiums as instruments. Raw markdown: bekaert-1992-characterizing-predictable-components-in-excess-returns-on-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: BEKAERT, G, HODRICK, RJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2329113 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract The paper first characterizes the predictable components in excess rates of returns on major equity and foreign exchange markets using lagged excess returns, dividend yields, and forward premiums as instruments. Vector autoregressions (VARs) demonstrate one-step-ahead predictability and facilitate calculations of implied long-horizon statistics, such as variance ratios. Estimation of latent variable models then subjects the VARs to constraints derived from dynamic asset pricing theories. Examination of volatility bounds on intertemporal marginal rates of substitution provides summary statistics that quantify the challenge facing dynamic asset pricing models. 摘要（中文） 本文首先使用滞后超额收益、股利收益率和远期溢价作为工具变量，刻画了主要股权市场和外汇市场超额收益率中的可预测成分。向量自回归（VAR）证明了向前一步的可预测性，并便于计算隐含的长视野统计量，例如方差比率。潜变量模型的估计随后使VAR受到源于动态资产定价理论的约束。对跨期边际替代率波动率界的考察提供了汇总统计量，量化了动态资产定价模型所面临的挑战。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Liquidity and expected returns: Lessons from emerging markets
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Given the cross-sectional and temporal variation in their liquidity, emerging equity markets provide an ideal setting to examine the impact of liquidity on expected returns. Raw markdown: bekaert-2007-liquidity-and-expected-returns-lessons-from-emerging-markets…
pages.text: Liquidity and expected returns: Lessons from emerging markets (2007) Paper claim — Given the cross-sectional and temporal variation in their liquidity, emerging equity markets provide an ideal setting to examine the impact of liquidity on expected returns. Raw markdown: bekaert-2007-liquidity-and-expected-returns-lessons-from-emerging-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Bekaert, G, Harvey, CR, Lundblad, C Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm030 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Given the cross-sectional and temporal variation in their liquidity, emerging equity markets provide an ideal setting to examine the impact of liquidity on expected returns. Our main liquidity measure is a transformation of the proportion of zero daily firm returns, averaged over the month. We find that it significantly predicts future returns, whereas alternative measures such as turnover do not. Consistent with liquidity being a priced factor, unexpected liquidity shocks are positively correlated with contemporaneous return shocks and negatively correlated with shocks to the dividend yield. We consider a simple asset-pricing model with liquidity and the market portfolio as risk factors and transaction costs that are proportional to liquidity. The model differentiates between integrated and segmented countries and time periods. Our results suggest that local market liquidity is an important driver of expected returns in emerging markets, and that the liberalization process has not fully eliminated its impact. 摘要（中文） 鉴于新兴股票市场流动性的横截面和时间序列变动，它们为考察流动性对预期收益的影响提供了一个理想的环境。我们的主要流动性度量是对每日公司收益为零的比例（在整个月内取平均）的一种变换。我们发现它显著预测未来收益，而诸如换手率之类的替代度量则不能。与流动性作为一个被定价的因子相一致，意外的流动性冲击与同期收益冲击正相关，与股利收益率冲击负相关。我们考虑了一个简单的资产定价模型，其中流动性和市场组合作为风险因子，并且交易成本与流动性成比例。该模型区分了一体化和分割的国家及时期。我们的结果表明，本地市场流动性是新兴市场预期收益的一个重要驱动因素，并且自由化进程尚未完全消除其影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the impact of a major change in dividend taxation introduced in the United Kingdom in July 1997, The reform was structured in such a way that the immediate impact fell almost entirely on the largest investor class in the United Kingdom, namely…
pages.text: New evidence of the impact of dividend taxation and on the identity of the marginal investor (2002) Paper claim — This paper examines the impact of a major change in dividend taxation introduced in the United Kingdom in July 1997, The reform was structured in such a way that the immediate impact fell almost entirely on the largest investor class in the United Kingdom, namely pension funds. Raw markdown: bell-2002-new-evidence-of-the-impact-of-dividend-taxation Bibliographic Record Authors: Bell, L, Jenkinson, T Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00462 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines the impact of a major change in dividend taxation introduced in the United Kingdom in July 1997, The reform was structured in such a way that the immediate impact fell almost entirely on the largest investor class in the United Kingdom, namely pension funds. We find significant changes in the valuation of dividend income after the reform, in particular for high-yielding companies. These results provide strong support for the hypothesis that taxation affects the valuation of companies, and that pension funds were the effective marginal investors for high-yielding companies. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了1997年7月在英国引入的股利税重大变革的影响。这项改革的结构方式使得其直接冲击几乎完全落在英国最大的投资者类别（即养老基金）身上。我们发现改革后股利收入的估值发生了显著变化，尤其是对高收益率公司而言。这些结果为如下假设提供了有力支持：税收会影响公司的估值，且养老基金是高收益率公司的有效边际投资者。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Dynamics and the Term Structure of Dividend Strips
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Many leading asset pricing models are specified so that the term structure of dividend volatility is either flat or upward sloping. Raw markdown: belo-2015-dividend-dynamics-and-the-term-structure-of-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Belo, F, Collin-Dufresne,…
pages.text: Dividend Dynamics and the Term Structure of Dividend Strips (2015) Paper claim — Many leading asset pricing models are specified so that the term structure of dividend volatility is either flat or upward sloping. Raw markdown: belo-2015-dividend-dynamics-and-the-term-structure-of-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Belo, F, Collin-Dufresne, P, Goldstein, RS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12242 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(replace) Abstract Many leading asset pricing models are specified so that the term structure of dividend volatility is either flat or upward sloping. These models predict that the term structures of expected returns and volatilities on dividend strips (i.e., claims to dividends paid over a prespecified interval) are also upward sloping. However, the empirical evidence suggests otherwise. This discrepancy can be reconciled if these models replace their proposed dividend dynamics with processes that generate stationary leverage ratios. Under such policies, shareholders are forced to divest (invest) when leverage is low (high), which shifts risk from long- to short-horizon dividend strips. 摘要（中文） 许多主要的资产定价模型的设定方式使得股利波动率的期限结构要么是平坦的，要么是向上倾斜的。这些模型预测股利条（即对在预先规定区间内支付的股利的索取权）的预期收益和波动率的期限结构也是向上倾斜的。然而，实证证据却表明并非如此。如果这些模型用能够产生平稳杠杆比率的过程来替代其所提出的股利动态，则这一差异可以得到调和。在这类政策下，股东被迫在杠杆较低（较高）时撤资（投资），这将风险从长期股利条转移到短期股利条。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do changes in dividends signal the future or the past?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Many dividend theories imply that changes in dividends have information content about the future earnings of the firm. Raw markdown: benartzi-1997-do-changes-in-dividends-signal-the-future-or Bibliographic Record Authors: Benartzi, S, Michaely, R, Thaler, R…
pages.text: Do changes in dividends signal the future or the past? (1997) Paper claim — Many dividend theories imply that changes in dividends have information content about the future earnings of the firm. Raw markdown: benartzi-1997-do-changes-in-dividends-signal-the-future-or Bibliographic Record Authors: Benartzi, S, Michaely, R, Thaler, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1997 DOI: 10.2307/2329514 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Many dividend theories imply that changes in dividends have information content about the future earnings of the firm. We investigate this implication and find only limited support for it. Firms that increase dividends in year 0 have experienced significant earnings increases in years -1 and 0, but show no subsequent unexpected earnings growth. Also, the size of the dividend increase does not predict future earnings. Firms that cut dividends in year 0 have experienced a reduction in earnings in year 0 and in year -1, but these firms go on to show significant increases in earnings in year 1. However, consistent with Lintner's model on dividend policy, firms that increase dividends are less likely than nonchanging firms to experience a drop in future earnings. Thus, their increase in concurrent earnings can be said to be somewhat '' permanent.'' In spite of the lack of future earnings growth, firms that increase dividends have significant (though modest) positive excess returns for the following three years. 摘要（中文） 许多股利理论意味着股利变化包含关于企业未来盈利的信息含量。我们考察这一含义，只发现对它的有限支持。在第0年提高股利的企业在第-1年和第0年经历了显著的盈利增长，但随后没有表现出意外的盈利增长。而且，股利增长的规模并不预测未来盈利。在第0年削减股利的企业在第0年和第-1年经历了盈利下降，但这些企业随后在第1年表现出显著的盈利增长。然而，与Lintner关于股利政策的模型一致，提高股利的企业相比未变动股利的企业更不可能经历未来盈利的下降。因此，可以说它们当期盈利的增长在某种程度上是“永久性的”。尽管缺乏未来盈利增长，提高股利的企业在随后三年中获得显著（尽管适度）的正向超额收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Incentive and entrenchment effects in European ownership
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In a large sample of European firms we analyze the value discount associated with disproportional ownership structures first documented by Claessens et al. Raw markdown: bennedsen-2010-incentive-and-entrenchment-effects-in-european-ownership Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Incentive and entrenchment effects in European ownership (2010) Paper claim — In a large sample of European firms we analyze the value discount associated with disproportional ownership structures first documented by Claessens et al. Raw markdown: bennedsen-2010-incentive-and-entrenchment-effects-in-european-ownership Bibliographic Record Authors: Bennedsen, M, Nielsen, KM Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2010.02.007 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract In a large sample of European firms we analyze the value discount associated with disproportional ownership structures first documented by Claessens et al. (2002). Consistent with a theoretical model of incentive and entrenchment effects, we find higher value discount in family firms, in firms with low cash flow concentration, and in industries with higher amenity value. Furthermore, the discount is higher in countries with good investor protection and higher for dual class shares than for pyramids. We find no impact on operating performance, likelihood of bankruptcy, dividend policy, or growth. Finally, we discuss policy implications of these findings. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在一个大型欧洲企业样本中，我们分析了Claessens等（2002）首次记录的与不成比例所有权结构相关的价值折价。与一个关于激励效应和壕沟（entrenchment）效应的理论模型一致，我们发现家族企业、现金流集中度低的企业以及具有较高“便利价值”（amenity value）的行业中价值折价更高。此外，在投资者保护良好的国家折价更高，且双重股权（dual class shares）的折价高于金字塔结构（pyramids）。我们发现对经营业绩、破产可能性、股利政策或增长没有影响。最后，我们讨论了这些发现的政策含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do Firms Buy Their Stock at Bargain Prices? Evidence from Actual Stock Repurchase Disclosures
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using new monthly data, we investigate open-market repurchase executions of US firms. Raw markdown: benrephael-2014-do-firms-buy-their-stock-at-bargain-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Ben-Rephael, A, Oded, J, Wohl, A Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI:…
pages.text: Do Firms Buy Their Stock at Bargain Prices? Evidence from Actual Stock Repurchase Disclosures (2014) Paper claim — Using new monthly data, we investigate open-market repurchase executions of US firms. Raw markdown: benrephael-2014-do-firms-buy-their-stock-at-bargain-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Ben-Rephael, A, Oded, J, Wohl, A Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rft028 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(stock repurchase) Abstract Using new monthly data, we investigate open-market repurchase executions of US firms. We find that firms repurchase at prices that are significantly lower than average market prices. This price discount is negatively related to size and positively related to market-to-book ratio. Firms' repurchase activity is followed by a positive and significant abnormal return. Importantly, the market response occurs when firms disclose their actual repurchase data in earnings announcements, and this positive response is followed by a 1-month drift. Consistent with these results, we find that insider trading is positively related to actual repurchases. 摘要（中文） 利用新的月度数据，我们考察了美国企业的公开市场回购执行情况。我们发现，企业以显著低于平均市场价格的价格进行回购。这一价格折扣与规模负相关，与市账率正相关。企业的回购活动之后跟随着正的、显著的异常收益。重要的是，市场反应发生在企业于盈利公告中披露其实际回购数据之时，而这一正向反应之后跟随着一个持续1个月的漂移。与这些结果相一致，我们发现内部人交易与实际回购正相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Expropriation through loan guarantees to related parties: Evidence from China (2009) Paper claim — We identify and analyze a sample of publicly traded Chinese firms that issued loan guarantees to their related Parties (usually the controlling, block holders). Raw markdown: berkman-2009-expropriation-through-loan-guarantees-to-related-parties-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Berkman, H, Cole, RA, Fu, LJ Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2007.11.001 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri, tunneling) Abstract We identify and analyze a sample of publicly traded Chinese firms that issued loan guarantees to their related Parties (usually the controlling, block holders). thereby expropriating wealth from minority shareholders. Our results show that the issuance of related guarantees is less likely at smaller firms, at more profitable firms and at firms with higher growth prospects. We also find that the identity and ownership of block holders affect the likelihood of expropriation. In addition, we use this sample to provide new evidence on the relation between tunneling and proxies for firm value and financial performance. We find that Tobin's Q, ROA and dividend yield are significantly lower, and that leverage is significantly higher at firms that issued related guarantees. (C) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们识别并分析了一个向其关联方（通常是控股的大宗持股人）发放贷款担保的中国上市公司样本，这些公司借此从中小股东处侵占（掏空）财富。我们的结果表明，关联担保的发放在规模较小的公司、盈利能力更强的公司以及成长前景更好的公司中较不可能发生。我们还发现，大宗持股人的身份和所有权会影响掏空的可能性。此外，我们利用这一样本就利益输送（tunneling）与公司价值和财务绩效的代理变量之间的关系提供了新的证据。我们发现，在发放关联担保的公司中，托宾Q、资产收益率（ROA）和股利收益率显著更低，而杠杆显著更高。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A TAX-BASED TEST OF THE DIVIDEND SIGNALING HYPOTHESIS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose and implement a new test of the dividend signaling hypothesis. Raw markdown: bernheim-1995-a-tax-based-test-of-the-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: BERNHEIM, BD, WANTZ, A Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 1995 DOI: n/a Relevance…
pages.text: A TAX-BASED TEST OF THE DIVIDEND SIGNALING HYPOTHESIS (1995) Paper claim — We propose and implement a new test of the dividend signaling hypothesis. Raw markdown: bernheim-1995-a-tax-based-test-of-the-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: BERNHEIM, BD, WANTZ, A Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 1995 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We propose and implement a new test of the dividend signaling hypothesis. Dividend signaling models generally imply that an increase in dividend taxation should increase the share price response per dollar of dividends (or ''bang-for-the-buck''). Many other dividend-preference theories have the opposite implication. An analysis of recent variations in tax policy reveals a strong positive relation between dividend tax rates and the bang-for-the-buck. Additional evidence on the relation between the bang-for-the-buck and other variables that are related to the marginal cost of paying dividend's provides further support for dividend signaling. 摘要（中文） 我们提出并实施了一项对股利信号传递假说的新检验。股利信号传递模型通常意味着，股利税的提高应当会提高每一美元股利所对应的股价反应（即"每美元效果"，bang-for-the-buck）。许多其他的股利偏好理论则有相反的含义。对近期税收政策变化的分析揭示，股利税率与每美元效果之间存在强正向关系。关于每美元效果与其他同支付股利边际成本相关变量之间关系的额外证据，为股利信号传递提供了进一步的支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Information Spillover and Corporate Policies: The Case of Listed Options (2025) Paper claim — Information production associated with derivatives markets is not a sideshow; rather, it has significantly positive spillover effects on an array of corporate decisions of underlying firms. Raw markdown: bernile-2025-information-spillover-and-corporate-policies-the-case-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bernile, G, Hu, JF, Li, GZ, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109023001229 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Information production associated with derivatives markets is not a sideshow; rather, it has significantly positive spillover effects on an array of corporate decisions of underlying firms. Using a regression-discontinuity design based on exogenous variation in options availability as an instrument for changes in the information environment, we show that options introductions have causal effects on corporate policies on both sides of the balance sheet. Through improved information efficiency, options availability reduces the need for debt and payout, increases efficient investment, and yields superior innovation. We conduct two independent experiments demonstrating that our instrument's impact is not derived from alternative channels. 摘要（中文） 与衍生品市场相关的信息生产并非无关紧要的插曲；相反，它对底层公司的一系列公司决策具有显著为正的溢出效应。我们使用一种基于期权可得性外生变化的断点回归设计，将其作为信息环境变化的工具变量，表明期权的引入对资产负债表两侧的公司政策都具有因果效应。通过改善信息效率，期权可得性降低了对债务和派现的需求，增加了有效投资，并带来了更优的创新。我们进行了两个独立的实验，证明我们工具变量的影响并非源自替代性渠道。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how dividend policy is used to mitigate potential conflicts of interest between majority and minority shareholders in private Norwegian firms. Raw markdown: berzins-2018-shareholder-conflicts-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Berzins, J,…
pages.text: Shareholder Conflicts and Dividends (2018) Paper claim — We examine how dividend policy is used to mitigate potential conflicts of interest between majority and minority shareholders in private Norwegian firms. Raw markdown: berzins-2018-shareholder-conflicts-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Berzins, J, Bohren, O, Stacescu, B Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfx046 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, signal) Abstract We examine how dividend policy is used to mitigate potential conflicts of interest between majority and minority shareholders in private Norwegian firms. The average payout is 50% higher if the majority shareholder's equity stake is 55% (high conflict potential) rather than 95% (low conflict potential). Such minority-friendly payout is also associated with higher subsequent minority shareholder investment. These results suggest that controlling shareholders voluntarily use dividends to reduce agency conflicts and build trust, rather than opportunistically preferring private benefits to dividends. We show that our results are unlikely to arise from liquidity or signaling motives. 摘要（中文） 我们考察在挪威私人企业中如何运用股利政策来缓解大股东与小股东之间潜在的利益冲突。当大股东的股权比例为55%（冲突潜势高）而非95%（冲突潜势低）时，平均支付要高出50%。这种对小股东友好的支付还与随后更高的小股东投资相关联。这些结果表明，控股股东是自愿运用股利来减少代理冲突并建立信任，而非机会主义地偏好私人收益而非股利。我们表明，我们的结果不太可能源于流动性或信号传递动机。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and taxes: The moderating role of agency conflicts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find that potential conflicts between majority and minority shareholders strongly influence how dividends respond to taxes. Raw markdown: berzins-2019-dividends-and-taxes-the-moderating-role-of-agency Bibliographic Record Authors: Berzins, J, Bohren, O,…
pages.text: Dividends and taxes: The moderating role of agency conflicts (2019) Paper claim — We find that potential conflicts between majority and minority shareholders strongly influence how dividends respond to taxes. Raw markdown: berzins-2019-dividends-and-taxes-the-moderating-role-of-agency Bibliographic Record Authors: Berzins, J, Bohren, O, Stacescu, B Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.07.003 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We find that potential conflicts between majority and minority shareholders strongly influence how dividends respond to taxes. When the controlling shareholder has a smaller stake, the incentives to extract private benefits are stronger - a shareholder conflict that can be mitigated by dividend payout. We study a large and clean regulatory shock in Norway that increases the dividend tax rate for all individuals from 0% to 28%. We find that dividends drop less the higher the potential shareholder conflict, suggesting that dividend policy trades off tax and agency considerations. The average payout ratio falls by 30 percentage points when the conflict potential is low, but by only 18 points when it is high. These lower dividends cannot be explained by higher salaries to shareholders or diverse liquidity needs. We also observe a strong increase in indirect ownership of high-conflict firms through tax-exempt holding companies and suggest policy implications for intercorporate dividend taxation. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，大股东与小股东之间的潜在冲突强烈影响股利对税收的反应方式。当控股股东持股比例较小时，攫取私人收益的动机更强——这种股东冲突可以通过股利支付来缓解。我们研究了挪威一项规模大且干净的监管冲击，它将所有个人的股利税率从0%提高到28%。我们发现，潜在股东冲突越高，股利下降幅度越小，这表明股利政策在税收考量与代理考量之间进行权衡。当冲突潜势低时，平均支付率下降30个百分点，而当冲突潜势高时仅下降18个百分点。这些较低的股利无法用向股东支付更高薪酬或多样化的流动性需求来解释。我们还观察到，高冲突企业通过免税控股公司进行的间接所有权大幅增加，并就公司间股利征税提出了政策启示。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
