pages.text: Predictable Corporate Distributions and Stock Returns (2015) Paper claim — Corporate managers frequently announce corporate distributions, including stock splits, stock dividends, special dividends, and increases in regular dividends, on the anniversary of a like announcement at the same firm. Raw markdown: bessembinder-2015-predictable-corporate-distributions-and-stock-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessembinder, H, Zhang, F Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhu145 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Corporate managers frequently announce corporate distributions, including stock splits, stock dividends, special dividends, and increases in regular dividends, on the anniversary of a like announcement at the same firm. The market appears to not fully appreciate the implications of current distributions for future distributions and stock returns, as a simple strategy that involves purchasing firms with high predicted probabilities of distribution announcements earns significant abnormal monthly returns. These results are distinct from previously documented return regularities related to regular earnings and dividend announcements and return seasonality. 摘要（中文） 公司管理者经常在同一公司类似公告的周年日宣布公司分配，包括拆股、股票股利、特别股利以及常规股利的增加。市场似乎并未充分领会当期分配对未来分配和股票收益的含义，因为一个简单的策略——即买入具有高预测分配公告概率的公司——就能赚取显著的异常月度收益。这些结果不同于以往记录的与常规盈余和股利公告相关的收益规律以及收益的季节性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Characteristic-Based Benchmark Returns and Corporate Events
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose that fitted values from market-wide regressions of firm returns on lagged firm characteristics provide useful benchmarks for assessing whether average returns to certain stocks are abnormal. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Characteristic-Based Benchmark Returns and Corporate Events (2019) Paper claim — We propose that fitted values from market-wide regressions of firm returns on lagged firm characteristics provide useful benchmarks for assessing whether average returns to certain stocks are abnormal. Raw markdown: bessembinder-2019-characteristic-based-benchmark-returns-and-corporate-events Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessembinder, H, Cooper, MJ, Zhang, F Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhy037 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract We propose that fitted values from market-wide regressions of firm returns on lagged firm characteristics provide useful benchmarks for assessing whether average returns to certain stocks are abnormal. To illustrate, we study eight documented events with abnormal returns, including credit rating and analyst recommendation downgrades, initial and seasoned public equity offerings, mergers and acquisitions, dividend initiations, share repurchases, and stock splits. We show that the apparently abnormal returns in the months after these events are substantially reduced or eliminated when compared to characteristic-based benchmarks. Characteristic-based benchmarks perform better in explaining post-event returns than do recent four- and five-factor models. Received September 19, 2016; editorial decision February 16, 2018 by Editor Andrew Karolyi. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web Site next to the link to the final published paper online. 摘要（中文） 我们提出，用滞后的公司特征对公司收益进行全市场回归所得的拟合值，为评估某些股票的平均收益是否异常提供了有用的基准。为说明这一点，我们研究了八个已被记录的具有异常收益的事件，包括信用评级和分析师推荐下调、首次和增发公开权益发行、并购、股利发起、股份回购以及拆股。我们表明，与基于特征的基准相比，这些事件之后数月内看似异常的收益被大幅降低或消除。在解释事件后收益方面，基于特征的基准优于近期的四因子和五因子模型。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Long-run post-event returns in global stock markets
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms often experience significant abnormal stock returns following major corporate events, but these returns vary widely across countries. Raw markdown: bessembinder-2025-long-run-post-event-returns-in-global-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessembinder, H,…
pages.text: Long-run post-event returns in global stock markets (2025) Paper claim — Firms often experience significant abnormal stock returns following major corporate events, but these returns vary widely across countries. Raw markdown: bessembinder-2025-long-run-post-event-returns-in-global-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessembinder, H, Cooper, MJ, Jiao, W, Zhang, F Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1057/s41267-025-00810-1 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution, investor protection)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Firms often experience significant abnormal stock returns following major corporate events, but these returns vary widely across countries. We examine how national institutions-particularly financial system development, investor protection, and governance practices-influence post-event stock returns for over 164,000 events across 58 countries. Our analysis covers six frequent corporate events: dividend initiations, share repurchases, seasoned equity offerings, stock splits, mergers and acquisitions, and initial public offerings. Using a characteristic-based benchmarking approach that accounts for cross-country differences in firm fundamentals, we find that firms in countries with more developed financial systems and stronger investor protections exhibit significantly smaller long-run post-event abnormal returns. These findings are robust to alternative benchmarks and model specifications. Our results suggest that the institutional environment can reduce informational frictions and promote more efficient investor responses to corporate announcements. In countries with strong financial and governance institutions, market reactions to corporate events are more muted-indicating fewer pricing anomalies and more efficient capital markets. By demonstrating how national institutions help shape the outcomes of firm-level events, our study highlights the value of incorporating institutional context into international finance research and helps explain why post-event return patterns often differ across countries. Les entreprises connaissent souvent des rendements boursiers anormaux importants & agrave; la suite d'& eacute;v & eacute;nements d'entreprise majeurs, mais ces rendements varient consid & eacute;rablement d'un pays & agrave; l'autre. Nous examinons comment les institutions nationales-en particulier le d & eacute;veloppement du syst & egrave;me financier, la protection des investisseurs et les pratiques de gouvernance-influencent les rendements boursiers post-& eacute;v & eacute;nement pour plus de 39,000 & eacute;v & eacute;nements dans 45 pays. Notre analyse porte sur six & eacute;v & eacute;nements d'entreprise fr & eacute;quents: les initiations de dividendes, les rachats d'actions, les & eacute;missions d'actions secondaires, les divisions d'actions, les fusions et acquisitions, et les & eacute;missions de dette. En utilisant une approche de benchmarking bas & eacute;e sur les caract & eacute;ristiques qui tient compte des diff & eacute;rences entre les pays en mati & egrave;re de fondamentaux des entreprises, nous constatons que les entreprises situ & eacute;es dans des pays dot & eacute;s de syst & egrave;mes financiers plus d & eacute;velopp & eacute;s et de protections des investisseurs plus solides affichent des rendements anormaux post-& eacute;v & eacute;nement & agrave; long terme significativement plus faibles. Ces r & eacute;sultats sont robustes face & agrave; des benchmarks alternatifs et & agrave; diff & eacute;rentes sp & eacute;cifications de mod & egrave;le. Nos r & eacute;sultats sugg & egrave;rent que l'environnement institutionnel peut r & eacute;duire les frictions informationnelles et favoriser des r & eacute;actions plus efficaces des investisseurs aux annonces d'entreprise. Dans les pays dot & eacute;s d'institutions financi & egrave;res et de gouvernance solides, les r & eacute;actions du march & eacute; aux & eacute;v & eacute;nements d'entreprise sont plus mod & eacute;r & eacute;es-indiquant moins d'anomalies de prix et des march & eacute;s de capitaux plus efficients. En d & eacute;montrant comment les institutions nationales contribuent & agrave; fa & ccedil;onner les r & eacute;sultats des & eacute;v & eacute;nements au niveau de l'entreprise, notre recherche met en lumi & egrave;re l'importance d'int & eacute;grer le contexte institutionnel dans la recherche en finance internationale, et aide d'ailleurs & agrave; expliquer pourquoi les configurations de rendements post-& eacute;v & eacute;nement diff & egrave;rent souvent d'un pays & agrave; l'autre. Las empresas a menudo experimentan rendimientos anormales significativos en sus acciones tras eventos corporativos importantes, pero estos rendimientos var & iacute;an considerablemente entre pa & iacute;ses. Examinamos c & oacute;mo las instituciones nacionales, particularmente el desarrollo del sistema financiero, la protecci & oacute;n al inversor y las pr & aacute;cticas de gobernanza, influyen en los rendimientos de las acciones posteriores a eventos en m & aacute;s de 39.000 eventos en 45 pa & iacute;ses. Nuestro an & aacute;lisis abarca seis eventos corporativos frecuentes: declaraci & oacute;n inicial de dividendos, recompra de acciones, ofertas p & uacute;blicas secundarias de emisiones de acciones secundarias, divisi & oacute;n de acciones, fusiones y adquisiciones, y emisiones de deuda. Utilizando un enfoque de benchmarking basado en caracter & iacute;sticas que contrala las diferencias entre pa & iacute;ses en las caracter & iacute;sticas fundamentales de las empresas, encontramos que las empresas en pa & iacute;ses con sistemas financieros m & aacute;s desarrollados y protecciones al inversor m & aacute;s s & oacute;lidas presentan rendimientos anormales a largo plazo posteriores a los eventos significativamente menores. Estos hallazgos son consistentes con diferentes referencias y especificaciones de modelos. Nuestros resultados sugieren que el entorno institucional puede reducir las asimetr & iacute;as de informaci & oacute;n y promover respuestas m & aacute;s eficientes de los inversores a los anuncios corporativos. En pa & iacute;ses con instituciones financieras y de gobernanza s & oacute;lidas, las reacciones del mercado a los eventos corporativos son m & aacute;s moderadas, lo que indica menos anomal & iacute;as en los precios y mercados de capital m & aacute;s eficientes. Al demostrar c & oacute;mo las instituciones nacionales ayudan a configurar los resultados de los eventos a nivel empresarial, nuestro estudio destaca el valor de incorporar el contexto institucional en la investigaci & oacute;n de finanzas internacionales y ayuda a explicar por qu & eacute; los patrones de rendimientos posteriores a los eventos a menudo difieren entre pa & iacute;ses. Empresas frequentemente experimentam retornos anormais significativos em suas a & ccedil;& otilde;es ap & oacute;s grandes eventos corporativos, mas esses retornos variam amplamente entre pa & iacute;ses. Examinamos como institui & ccedil;& otilde;es nacionais-particularmente desenvolvimento do sistema financeiro, prote & ccedil;& atilde;o a investidores e pr & aacute;ticas de governan & ccedil;a-influenciam retornos das a & ccedil;& otilde;es ap & oacute;s eventos em mais de 39.000 eventos em 45 pa & iacute;ses. Nossa an & aacute;lise abrange seis eventos corporativos frequentes: in & iacute;cio de pagamento de dividendos, recompra de a & ccedil;& otilde;es, ofertas p & uacute;blicas de a & ccedil;& otilde;es adicionais, desdobramentos de a & ccedil;& otilde;es, fus & otilde;es e aquisi & ccedil;& otilde;es, e emiss & otilde;es de d & iacute;vida. Utilizando uma abordagem de benchmarking baseada em caracter & iacute;sticas que considera diferen & ccedil;as entre pa & iacute;ses nos fundamentos das empresas, descobrimos que empresas em pa & iacute;ses com sistemas financeiros mais desenvolvidos e prote & ccedil;& otilde;es mais fortes a investidores apresentam retornos anormais de longo prazo significativamente menores ap & oacute;s os eventos. Esses resultados s & atilde;o robustos em rela & ccedil;& atilde;o a benchmarks alternativos e especifica & ccedil;& otilde;es de modelos. Nossos achados sugerem que o ambiente institucional pode reduzir fric & ccedil;& otilde;es informacionais e promover respostas mais eficientes de investidores a an & uacute;ncios corporativos. Em pa & iacute;ses com institui & ccedil;& otilde;es financeiras e de governan & ccedil;a fortes, rea & ccedil;& otilde;es de mercado a eventos corporativos s & atilde;o mais moderadas-indicando menos anomalias de precifica & ccedil;& atilde;o e mercados de capitais mais eficientes. Ao demonstrar como institui & ccedil;& otilde;es nacionais auxiliam a moldar os resultados de eventos no n & iacute;vel da empresa, nosso estudo destaca o valor de incorporar o contexto institucional na pesquisa de finan & ccedil;as internacionais e ajuda a explicar por que padr & otilde;es de retorno p & oacute;s-evento frequentemente diferem entre pa & iacute;ses. offerings）、股票拆分、并购以及首次公开发行。采用一种基于特征的基准化方法（该方法考虑了各国企业基本面的差异），我们发现，位于金融体系更发达、投资者保护更强的国家的企业，其长期事件后异常收益显著更小。这些发现对于替代基准和不同的模型设定都是稳健的。我们的结果表明，制度环境可以降低信息摩擦，并促使投资者对公司公告作出更有效率的反应。在拥有强健金融与治理制度的国家，市场对公司事件的反应更为温和——这表明定价异常更少、资本市场更有效率。通过展示国家制度如何帮助塑造企业层面事件的结果，我们的研究凸显了将制度背景纳入国际金融研究的价值，并有助于解释为何事件后收益模式在不同国家之间常常存在差异。 pages.title: The stock-market reaction to dividend cuts and omissions by commercial banks
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We postulate that the announcement effect of dividend reductions should be more severe for banks than for non-financial firms because bank customers may avoid financially weak institutions and discontinue the relationship when negative information is released. Raw…
pages.text: The stock-market reaction to dividend cuts and omissions by commercial banks (1996) Paper claim — We postulate that the announcement effect of dividend reductions should be more severe for banks than for non-financial firms because bank customers may avoid financially weak institutions and discontinue the relationship when negative information is released. Raw markdown: bessler-1996-the-stock-market-reaction-to-dividend-cuts-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessler, W, Nohel, T Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(96)00004-0 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We postulate that the announcement effect of dividend reductions should be more severe for banks than for non-financial firms because bank customers may avoid financially weak institutions and discontinue the relationship when negative information is released. To test our hypothesis we investigate a total of 81 dividend reductions by 56 commercial banks listed on the NYSE, AMEX and NASDAQ for the period 1974-1991. We find significant abnormal returns of -8.02% for the two-day event window and -11.46% for a two-week period. These negative valuation effects are stronger than those reported in studies for dividend reductions of non-financial firms and for other negative bank announcements. We also explore the relationship between abnormal returns and specific bank characteristics cross-sectionally and find a stronger reaction for larger banks. 摘要（中文） 我们假设，股利削减的公告效应对银行应比对非金融企业更为严重，因为银行客户可能会在负面信息发布时回避财务薄弱的机构并中断关系。为检验我们的假设，我们考察了1974至1991年间在纽约证券交易所、美国证券交易所和纳斯达克上市的56家商业银行的共计81次股利削减。我们发现两日事件窗口的显著异常收益为-8.02%，两周期间为-11.46%。这些负面估值效应比针对非金融企业股利削减以及针对其他负面银行公告的研究所报告的更强。我们还横截面地探究了异常收益与特定银行特征之间的关系，发现较大的银行反应更强。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Asymmetric information, dividend reductions, and contagion effects in bank stock returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In an environment of asymmetric information, banks face information externalities due to their role as intermediaries of information. Raw markdown: bessler-2000-asymmetric-information-dividend-reductions-and-contagion-effects-in Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Asymmetric information, dividend reductions, and contagion effects in bank stock returns (2000) Paper claim — In an environment of asymmetric information, banks face information externalities due to their role as intermediaries of information. Raw markdown: bessler-2000-asymmetric-information-dividend-reductions-and-contagion-effects-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessler, W, Nohel, T Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(99)00097-7 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract In an environment of asymmetric information, banks face information externalities due to their role as intermediaries of information. In particular, bank insiders will possess private information from monitoring loan customers. Accordingly, outsiders may interpret changes in a bank's financial policy as signals about the quality of its loan portfolio and to the extent that the assets (loans) of different banks are viewed as similar, they will interpret such signals as pertaining to non-announcing banks as well leading to contagion effects. We test for the presence of contagion effects in stock returns associated with announcements of dividend cuts by money-center banks. We find that dividend cuts induce negative abnormal returns in the stocks of non-announcing money-center banks and to a lesser extent in the stocks of large regional banks. The observed contagion effects appear consistent with informed rather than contagious panic behavior because these effects are systematically related to risks that are common to all affected banks. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在非对称信息的环境中，银行由于其作为信息中介的角色而面临信息外部性。特别是，银行内部人将从监督贷款客户中获得私人信息。因此，外部人可能将银行财务政策的变化解读为关于其贷款组合质量的信号，且在不同银行的资产（贷款）被视为相似的程度上，他们会将此类信号解读为也适用于未发布公告的银行，从而导致传染效应。我们检验了与货币中心银行削减股利公告相关联的股票收益中传染效应的存在。我们发现，削减股利在未发布公告的货币中心银行股票中引起负向异常收益，并在较小程度上在大型区域性银行股票中引起负向异常收益。观察到的传染效应似乎与知情行为而非传染性恐慌行为相一致，因为这些效应与所有受影响银行共同面临的风险系统性相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The international zero-leverage phenomenon
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze the zero-leverage phenomenon around the world. Raw markdown: bessler-2013-the-international-zero-leverage-phenomenon Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessler, W, Drobetz, W, Haller, R, Meier, I Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI:…
pages.text: The international zero-leverage phenomenon (2013) Paper claim — We analyze the zero-leverage phenomenon around the world. Raw markdown: bessler-2013-the-international-zero-leverage-phenomenon Bibliographic Record Authors: Bessler, W, Drobetz, W, Haller, R, Meier, I Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.08.004 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We analyze the zero-leverage phenomenon around the world. Countries with a common law system, high creditor protection, and a dividend imputation or dividend relief tax system exhibit the highest percentage of zero-leverage firms. The increasing prevalence of zero-leverage firms in all sample countries is related to market-wide forces during our sample period, such as IPO waves, shifts in industry composition, increasing asset volatility, and decreasing corporate tax rates. Firm-level comparisons reveal that only a small number of firms deliberately maintain zero-leverage. Most zero-leverage firms are constrained by their debt capacity. Analyzing the time-series dynamics of leverage and investment behavior, we further show that firms which pursue a zero-leverage policy only for a short period of time seek financial flexibility. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们分析了世界范围内的零杠杆现象。具有普通法系、高债权人保护以及股利归集（dividend imputation）或股利减免（dividend relief）税制的国家，表现出最高比例的零杠杆公司。在我们的样本期内，所有样本国家中零杠杆公司日益普遍，这与市场层面的力量相关，例如IPO浪潮、行业构成的变化、资产波动性的上升以及公司税率的下降。公司层面的比较揭示，只有一小部分公司是刻意维持零杠杆的。大多数零杠杆公司受制于其债务承受能力。通过分析杠杆和投资行为的时间序列动态，我们进一步表明，那些仅在短期内奉行零杠杆政策的公司是在寻求财务灵活性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Effect of Introducing a Non-Redundant Derivative on the Volatility of Stock-Market Returns When Agents Differ in Risk Aversion
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the effect of introducing a nonredundant derivative on the volatilities of the stock market return and the locally risk-free interest rate. Raw markdown: bhamra-2009-the-effect-of-introducing-a-non-redundant-derivative Bibliographic Record Authors: Bhamra,…
pages.text: The Effect of Introducing a Non-Redundant Derivative on the Volatility of Stock-Market Returns When Agents Differ in Risk Aversion (2009) Paper claim — We study the effect of introducing a nonredundant derivative on the volatilities of the stock market return and the locally risk-free interest rate. Raw markdown: bhamra-2009-the-effect-of-introducing-a-non-redundant-derivative Bibliographic Record Authors: Bhamra, HS, Uppal, R Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm076 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We study the effect of introducing a nonredundant derivative on the volatilities of the stock market return and the locally risk-free interest rate. Our analysis uses a standard, frictionless, full-information, dynamic, continuous-time, general-equilibrium, Lucas endowment economy in which there are two classes of agents who have time-additive power utility functions and differ only in their risk aversion. Our main result is to show analytically that if the intensity of the precautionary demand for savings is not too high, then the introduction of a nonredundant derivative increases the volatility of stock market returns. Furthermore, in the economy with the derivative, the volatility of stock market returns can be substantially greater than that of aggregate dividend growth (fundamental volatility). We also show that the volatility of the locally risk-free interest rate increases with the introduction of the derivative. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了引入一种非冗余衍生品对股票市场收益波动率和局部无风险利率波动率的影响。我们的分析使用了一个标准的、无摩擦的、完全信息的、动态的、连续时间的一般均衡Lucas禀赋经济，其中存在两类主体，他们具有时间可加的幂效用函数，仅在风险厌恶程度上有所不同。我们的主要结果是解析地表明，如果预防性储蓄需求的强度不太高，那么引入非冗余衍生品会增加股票市场收益的波动率。此外，在带有衍生品的经济中，股票市场收益的波动率可以大大超过总股利增长的波动率（基本面波动率）。我们还表明，局部无风险利率的波动率会随衍生品的引入而增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Share Repurchase Announcement Puzzle: Theory and Evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Why is the mere announcement of an open-market share repurchase program, which involves no commitment to purchase shares, regarded as good news by the market? We develop a theoretical model to resolve this puzzle. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The Share Repurchase Announcement Puzzle: Theory and Evidence (2016) Paper claim — Why is the mere announcement of an open-market share repurchase program, which involves no commitment to purchase shares, regarded as good news by the market? We develop a theoretical model to resolve this puzzle. Raw markdown: bhattacharya-2016-the-share-repurchase-announcement-puzzle-theory-and-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Bhattacharya, U, Jacobsen, SE Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfv020 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Why is the mere announcement of an open-market share repurchase program, which involves no commitment to purchase shares, regarded as good news by the market? We develop a theoretical model to resolve this puzzle. The model predicts that firms with large underpricing can attract attention from speculators by announcing repurchases, and the subsequent trades from these speculators lead to value corrections. Firms with small underpricing, however, cannot attract attention by announcing repurchases, and these firms have to use costly share repurchases as a value-correcting signal. We then provide empirical evidence corroborating the predictions of the theoretical model. 摘要（中文） 为什么仅仅宣布一项不涉及购买股份承诺的公开市场股份回购计划，就会被市场视为好消息？我们发展了一个理论模型来解开这一谜题。该模型预测，具有较大低估的公司可以通过宣布回购来吸引投机者的关注，而这些投机者随后的交易会导致价值修正。然而，低估较小的公司无法通过宣布回购来吸引关注，这些公司不得不使用代价高昂的股份回购作为一种价值修正信号。随后我们提供了证实该理论模型预测的经验证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dynamic security design: Convergence to continuous time and asset pricing implications
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — An entrepreneur with limited liability needs to finance an infinite horizon investment project. Raw markdown: biais-2007-dynamic-security-design-convergence-to-continuous-time-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Biais, B, Mariotti, T, Plantin, G, Rochet, JC Journal:…
pages.text: Dynamic security design: Convergence to continuous time and asset pricing implications (2007) Paper claim — An entrepreneur with limited liability needs to finance an infinite horizon investment project. Raw markdown: biais-2007-dynamic-security-design-convergence-to-continuous-time-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Biais, B, Mariotti, T, Plantin, G, Rochet, JC Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1467-937X.2007.00425.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow) Abstract An entrepreneur with limited liability needs to finance an infinite horizon investment project. An agency problem arises because she can divert operating cash flows before reporting them to the financiers. We first study the optimal contract in discrete time. This contract can be implemented by cash reserves, debt, and equity. The latter is split between the financiers and the entrepreneur and pays dividends when retained earnings reach a threshold. To provide appropriate incentives to the entrepreneur, the firm is downsized when it runs short of cash. We then study the continuous-time limit of the model. We prove the convergence of the discrete-time value functions and optimal contracts. Our analysis yields rich implications for the dynamics of security prices. Stock prices follow a diffusion reflected at the dividend barrier and absorbed at 0. Their volatility, as well as the leverage ratio of the firm, increase after bad performance. Stock prices and book-to-market ratios are in a non-monotonic relationship. A more severe agency problem entails lower price-earning ratios and firm liquidity and higher default risk. 摘要（中文） 一位负有有限责任的企业家需要为一个无限期投资项目融资。由于她可以在向出资人报告经营现金流之前将其转移挪用，因而产生了代理问题。我们首先在离散时间中研究最优合约。该合约可通过现金储备、债务和股权来实现。股权在出资人与企业家之间分配，并在留存收益达到某一阈值时支付股利。为向企业家提供适当的激励，当公司现金短缺时对其进行缩减（downsized）。我们随后研究该模型的连续时间极限。我们证明了离散时间价值函数和最优合约的收敛性。我们的分析对证券价格的动态给出了丰富的含义。股价服从一个在股利边界处反射、在0处被吸收的扩散过程。它们的波动性以及公司的杠杆比率在糟糕业绩之后上升。股价与市账比（book-to-market）之间呈非单调关系。更严重的代理问题意味着更低的市盈率和公司流动性以及更高的违约风险。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Uncertainty Shocks, Asset Supply and Pricing over the Business Cycle
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article estimates a business cycle model with endogenous financial asset supply and ambiguity averse investors. Raw markdown: bianchi-2018-uncertainty-shocks-asset-supply-and-pricing-over-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Bianchi, F, Ilut, CL, Schneider, M…
pages.text: Uncertainty Shocks, Asset Supply and Pricing over the Business Cycle (2018) Paper claim — This article estimates a business cycle model with endogenous financial asset supply and ambiguity averse investors. Raw markdown: bianchi-2018-uncertainty-shocks-asset-supply-and-pricing-over-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Bianchi, F, Ilut, CL, Schneider, M Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1093/restud/rdx035 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(payout)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract This article estimates a business cycle model with endogenous financial asset supply and ambiguity averse investors. Firms' shareholders choose not only production and investment, but also capital structure and payout policy subject to financial frictions. An increase in uncertainty about profits lowers stock prices and leads firms to substitute away from debt as well as reduce shareholder payout. This mechanism parsimoniously accounts for the postwar comovement in investment, stock prices, leverage, and payout, at both business cycle and medium term cycle frequencies. Ambiguity aversion permits aMarkov-switching VAR representation of the model, while preserving the effect of uncertainty shocks on the time variation in the equity premium. 摘要（中文） 本文估计了一个具有内生金融资产供给和模糊厌恶投资者的商业周期模型。公司股东不仅选择生产和投资，还在财务摩擦的约束下选择资本结构和支付政策。关于利润的不确定性增加会拉低股价，并促使公司减少对债务的使用以及降低股东派发。这一机制简约地解释了投资、股价、杠杆和派发在商业周期和中期周期频率上观察到的共同变动。模糊厌恶允许对该模型进行马尔可夫转换VAR表示，同时保留了不确定性冲击对股权溢价时间变化的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Cash holdings in private firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Evidence from a wide sample of Italian private firms shows that cash holdings are significantly related with smaller size, higher risk and lower effective tax rates, therefore supporting predictions from the trade-off model. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Cash holdings in private firms (2012) Paper claim — Evidence from a wide sample of Italian private firms shows that cash holdings are significantly related with smaller size, higher risk and lower effective tax rates, therefore supporting predictions from the trade-off model. Raw markdown: bigelli-2012-cash-holdings-in-private-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Bigelli, M, Sánchez-Vidal, J Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2011.06.004 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut, trade-off) Abstract Evidence from a wide sample of Italian private firms shows that cash holdings are significantly related with smaller size, higher risk and lower effective tax rates, therefore supporting predictions from the trade-off model. More cash is also held by firms with longer cash conversion cycles and lower financing deficits, as predicted by the financing hierarchy theory. Reported evidence also shows that dividend payments are associated with more cash holdings, and both bank debt and net working capital represent good cash-substitutes. When controlling for macroeconomic and industry factors, some variables lose their significance, but the general findings are confirmed. Finally, cash-rich companies are found to be more profitable, to pay more dividends and to invest more in a medium-term future horizon. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 来自意大利大量私营公司样本的证据表明，现金持有与较小的规模、较高的风险和较低的有效税率显著相关，从而支持了权衡模型（trade-off model）的预测。现金转换周期较长、融资赤字较低的公司也持有更多现金，正如融资等级理论（financing hierarchy theory）所预测。所报告的证据还表明，股利支付与更多的现金持有相关联，而银行债务和净营运资本都是良好的现金替代品。在控制宏观经济和行业因素时，一些变量丧失了显著性，但总体发现得到了证实。最后，现金充裕的公司被发现盈利能力更强、支付更多股利，并在中期未来视野内进行更多投资。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The takeover deterrent effect of open market share repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines whether open market share repurchases deter takeovers. Raw markdown: billett-2007-the-takeover-deterrent-effect-of-open-market-share Bibliographic Record Authors: Billett, MT, Xue, H Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI:…
pages.text: The takeover deterrent effect of open market share repurchases (2007) Paper claim — This paper examines whether open market share repurchases deter takeovers. Raw markdown: billett-2007-the-takeover-deterrent-effect-of-open-market-share Bibliographic Record Authors: Billett, MT, Xue, H Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2007.01258.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow, information asymmetry) Abstract This paper examines whether open market share repurchases deter takeovers. We model pre-repurchase takeover probability as a latent variable and examine its impact on the firm's decision to repurchase shares. Given specification tests reject the Tobit model, we turn to the censored quantile regression method of Powell (1986, Journal of Econometrics 32, 143-155). We find a significantly positive relation between open market share repurchases and takeover probability, and we reconcile empirical findings in previous studies that contradict predictions. Repurchase activity is inversely related to firm size, consistent with smaller firms having greater information asymmetry, and is related to temporary, but not permanent, cash flows. 摘要（中文） 本文考察公开市场股票回购是否能够阻遏收购。我们将回购前的收购概率建模为一个潜变量，并考察其对公司回购股票决策的影响。鉴于设定检验拒绝了Tobit模型，我们转而采用Powell（1986, Journal of Econometrics 32, 143-155）的删截分位数回归方法。我们发现公开市场股票回购与收购概率之间存在显著的正向关系，并调和了先前研究中与预测相矛盾的实证发现。回购活动与公司规模呈反向关系，这与规模较小的公司存在更大信息不对称相一致，并且回购与暂时性现金流相关，而与永久性现金流无关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We explore the link between open-market share repurchases (OMRs) and asymmetric information based on financial reporting quality and find that opaque firms experience positive abnormal returns of twice the magnitude of those of transparent firms. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Asymmetric Information, Financial Reporting, and Open-Market Share Repurchases (2016) Paper claim — We explore the link between open-market share repurchases (OMRs) and asymmetric information based on financial reporting quality and find that opaque firms experience positive abnormal returns of twice the magnitude of those of transparent firms. Raw markdown: billett-2016-asymmetric-information-financial-reporting-and-open-market-share Bibliographic Record Authors: Billett, MT, Yu, MM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109016000612 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract We explore the link between open-market share repurchases (OMRs) and asymmetric information based on financial reporting quality and find that opaque firms experience positive abnormal returns of twice the magnitude of those of transparent firms. These significant differences remain after controlling for governance, earnings management, and firm characteristics. We document significantly positive long-run postannouncement returns for opaque firms, but not for transparent firms. We find that takeover activity and premiums rise with repurchase activity by opaque firms, which may explain some of the wealth effects. Our results suggest that asymmetric information plays an important role in the wealth effects around OMRs. 摘要（中文） 我们基于财务报告质量探讨公开市场股份回购（OMRs）与信息不对称之间的联系，发现不透明企业所经历的正向异常收益是透明企业的两倍。在控制了治理、盈余管理和企业特征之后，这些显著差异依然存在。我们记录到不透明企业在公告后存在显著为正的长期收益，而透明企业则不存在。我们发现收购活动和溢价随着不透明企业回购活动的增加而上升，这可能解释了部分财富效应。我们的结果表明，信息不对称在公开市场股份回购前后的财富效应中扮演着重要角色。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Flexibility and dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a model of corporate dividend policy based on the idea that management values operating flexibility. Raw markdown: blau-2008-flexibility-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Blau, BM, Fuller, KP Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2008…
pages.text: Flexibility and dividends (2008) Paper claim — We develop a model of corporate dividend policy based on the idea that management values operating flexibility. Raw markdown: blau-2008-flexibility-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Blau, BM, Fuller, KP Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2008.02.003 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We develop a model of corporate dividend policy based on the idea that management values operating flexibility. By reducing dividends and conserving cash, management increases its flexibility. This improves its ability to invest in projects that it believes are good for the shareholders in the long run but which shareholders would not provide the capital for because they think the projects are value reducing. However, the cost of not paying dividends is a reduction in the current stock price. Management trades off these two aspects of dividends. Flexibility considerations help us understand various dimensions of dividend policy that existing theories do not explain. Our theory generates numerous testable predictions that we confront with the data. The evidence is supportive of the model. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们基于管理层重视经营灵活性这一思想，建立了一个公司股利政策模型。通过减少股利和保存现金，管理层增加了其灵活性。这提高了其投资于以下项目的能力：管理层认为这些项目从长远看对股东有利，但股东不会为其提供资本，因为股东认为这些项目会减损价值。然而，不支付股利的成本是当期股价的下降。管理层在股利的这两个方面之间进行权衡。灵活性考量帮助我们理解现有理论无法解释的股利政策的各个维度。我们的理论生成了众多可检验的预测，我们用数据加以对照。证据支持该模型。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We document significant reductions in corporate payouts-both dividends and (to a larger extent) share repurchases-during the 2008-2009 financial crisis. Raw markdown: bliss-2015-corporate-payout-cash-retention-and-the-supply-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bliss,…
pages.text: Corporate payout, cash retention, and the supply of credit: Evidence from the 2008-2009 credit crisis (2015) Paper claim — We document significant reductions in corporate payouts-both dividends and (to a larger extent) share repurchases-during the 2008-2009 financial crisis. Raw markdown: bliss-2015-corporate-payout-cash-retention-and-the-supply-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bliss, BA, Cheng, YM, Denis, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2014.10.013 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We document significant reductions in corporate payouts-both dividends and (to a larger extent) share repurchases-during the 2008-2009 financial crisis. Payout reductions are more likely in firms with higher leverage, more valuable growth options, and lower cash balances, i.e., those more susceptible to the negative consequences of an external financing shock. Moreover, firms appear to use the proceeds from the reduction in payout to maintain cash levels and to fund investment. These findings are consistent with the view that a shock to the supply of credit (net of demand effects) during the financial crisis increased the marginal benefit of cash retention, leading some firms to turn to payout reductions as a substitute form of financing. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们记录了在2008—2009年金融危机期间企业支付——包括股利和（在更大程度上）股份回购——的显著下降。支付削减在杠杆更高、增长期权更有价值以及现金余额更低的企业中更可能发生，即那些更易受外部融资冲击负面后果影响的企业。此外，企业似乎将削减支付所得的资金用于维持现金水平和为投资提供资金。这些发现与如下观点一致：金融危机期间信贷供给（扣除需求效应）的冲击提高了现金留存的边际收益，导致一些企业转向削减支付作为一种替代性融资形式。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Bringing It Home: A Study of the Incentives Surrounding the Repatriation of Foreign Earnings Under the American Jobs Creation Act of 2004
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The American Jobs Creation Act of 2004 (the Act) creates a temporary tax holiday that effectively reduces the U.S. Raw markdown: blouin-2009-bringing-it-home-a-study-of-the-incentives Bibliographic Record Authors: Blouin, J, Krull, L Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING…
pages.text: Bringing It Home: A Study of the Incentives Surrounding the Repatriation of Foreign Earnings Under the American Jobs Creation Act of 2004 (2009) Paper claim — The American Jobs Creation Act of 2004 (the Act) creates a temporary tax holiday that effectively reduces the U.S. Raw markdown: blouin-2009-bringing-it-home-a-study-of-the-incentives Bibliographic Record Authors: Blouin, J, Krull, L Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2009.00342.x Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract The American Jobs Creation Act of 2004 (the Act) creates a temporary tax holiday that effectively reduces the U.S. tax rate on repatriations from foreign subsidiaries from 35% to 5.25%. Firms receive the reduced tax rate by electing to take an 85% dividends received deduction on repatriations in 2004 or 2005. This paper investigates the characteristics of firms that repatriate under the Act and how they use the repatriated funds. We find that firms that repatriate under the Act have lower investment opportunities and higher free cash flows than nonrepatriating firms. Further, we find that repatriating firms increase share repurchases during 2005 by approximately $60 billion more than nonrepatriating firms, an amount that cannot be explained by differences in earnings between the two groups of firms. This increase represents about 20% of the $291.6 billion repatriated by our sample firms under the Act. 摘要（中文） 2004年《美国就业创造法》（下称该法）创设了一项临时税收假期，实际上将美国对来自海外子公司汇回利润的税率从35%降至5.25%。企业通过选择在2004年或2005年对汇回利润享受85%的股利收入扣除来获得这一降低的税率。本文考察根据该法进行利润汇回的企业的特征以及它们如何使用汇回的资金。我们发现，根据该法汇回利润的企业相比不汇回的企业投资机会更低、自由现金流更高。此外，我们发现，汇回利润的企业在2005年增加的股份回购比不汇回的企业约多600亿美元，这一数额无法用两组企业收益的差异来解释。这一增量约占我们样本企业根据该法汇回的2916亿美元的20%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Shareholder Base and Payout Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the relation between the shareholder base and payout policy. Raw markdown: bodnaruk-2013-the-shareholder-base-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bodnaruk, A, Östberg, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2013 DOI:…
pages.text: The Shareholder Base and Payout Policy (2013) Paper claim — We examine the relation between the shareholder base and payout policy. Raw markdown: bodnaruk-2013-the-shareholder-base-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bodnaruk, A, Östberg, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109013000252 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine the relation between the shareholder base and payout policy. Consistent with the idea that the shareholder base is related to the cost of external financing, we find that firms with small shareholder bases have lower payout levels and maintain higher cash holdings. We show that undertaking an open market repurchase results in a significant reduction in the size of the shareholder base. Consequently, we find that firms with small shareholder bases are less likely to undertake a repurchase (reduce the shareholder base even further) and are more likely to pay special dividends. 摘要（中文） 我们考察股东基础与支付政策之间的关系。与股东基础与外部融资成本相关这一观点相一致，我们发现，股东基础较小的公司支付水平较低，并维持较高的现金持有量。我们表明，进行公开市场回购会导致股东基础规模显著缩小。因此，我们发现，股东基础较小的公司较不可能进行回购（以免进一步缩小股东基础），而更可能派发特别股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Using 10-K Text to Gauge Financial Constraints
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Measuring the extent to which a firm is financially constrained is critical in assessing capital structure. Raw markdown: bodnaruk-2015-using-10-k-text-to-gauge-financial-constraints Bibliographic Record Authors: Bodnaruk, A, Loughran, T, McDonald, B Journal:…
pages.text: Using 10-K Text to Gauge Financial Constraints (2015) Paper claim — Measuring the extent to which a firm is financially constrained is critical in assessing capital structure. Raw markdown: bodnaruk-2015-using-10-k-text-to-gauge-financial-constraints Bibliographic Record Authors: Bodnaruk, A, Loughran, T, McDonald, B Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109015000411 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Measuring the extent to which a firm is financially constrained is critical in assessing capital structure. Extant measures of financial constraints focus on macro firm characteristics such as age and size, variables highly correlated with other firm attributes. We parse 10-K disclosures filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) using a unique lexicon based on constraining words. We find that the frequency of constraining words exhibits very low correlation with traditional measures of financial constraints and predicts subsequent liquidity events, such as dividend omissions or increases, equity recycling, and underfunded pensions, better than widely used financial constraint indexes. 摘要（中文） 衡量一家企业在多大程度上受到财务约束，对于评估资本结构至关重要。现有的财务约束度量聚焦于企业的宏观特征，如年龄和规模，而这些变量与其他企业属性高度相关。我们利用一个基于约束性词汇的独特词典，解析向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的10-K披露文件。我们发现，约束性词汇的出现频率与传统的财务约束度量之间相关性极低，并且在预测后续流动性事件（如股利省略或增加、股权回收和养老金不足）方面，比广泛使用的财务约束指数表现更好。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Consumption Volatility Risk
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that time variation in macroeconomic uncertainty affects asset prices. Raw markdown: boguth-2013-consumption-volatility-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Boguth, O, Kuehn, LA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12058 Relevance score:…
pages.text: Consumption Volatility Risk (2013) Paper claim — We show that time variation in macroeconomic uncertainty affects asset prices. Raw markdown: boguth-2013-consumption-volatility-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Boguth, O, Kuehn, LA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12058 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We show that time variation in macroeconomic uncertainty affects asset prices. Consumption volatility is a negatively priced source of risk for a wide variety of test portfolios. At the firm level, exposure to consumption volatility risk predicts future returns, generating a spread across quintile portfolios in excess of 7% annually. This premium is explained by cross-sectional differences in the sensitivity of dividend volatility to consumption volatility. Stocks with volatile cash flows in uncertain aggregate times require higher expected returns. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，宏观经济不确定性的时变会影响资产价格。对于各种各样的检验组合，消费波动率是一个被负向定价的风险来源。在公司层面，对消费波动率风险的暴露可以预测未来收益，在五分位组合之间产生每年超过7%的收益差。这一溢价可由股利波动率对消费波动率敏感性的横截面差异来解释。在总体不确定的时期具有波动性现金流的股票要求更高的预期收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stakeholder conflicts and dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper compares the dividend policy of owner-controlled firms with that of firms where the owners are a minority relative to non-owner employees, customers, and community citizens. Raw markdown: bohren-2012-stakeholder-conflicts-and-dividend-policy…
pages.text: Stakeholder conflicts and dividend policy (2012) Paper claim — This paper compares the dividend policy of owner-controlled firms with that of firms where the owners are a minority relative to non-owner employees, customers, and community citizens. Raw markdown: bohren-2012-stakeholder-conflicts-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bohren, O, Josefsen, MG, Steen, PE Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2012.06.007 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This paper compares the dividend policy of owner-controlled firms with that of firms where the owners are a minority relative to non-owner employees, customers, and community citizens. We find that regardless of whether owners or non-owners control the firm, the strong stakeholder uses the dividend payout decision to mitigate rather than to intensify the conflict of interest with the weak stakeholder. Hence, the higher the potential agency cost as reflected in the firm's stakeholder structure, the more the actual agency cost is reduced by the strong stakeholder's dividend payout decision. These findings are consistent with a dividend policy in which opportunistic power abuse in stakeholder conflicts is discouraged by costly consequences for the abuser at a later stage. Indirect evidence supports this interpretation. (c) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文比较所有者控制的企业与那些所有者相对于非所有者员工、客户和社区居民而言处于少数地位的企业的股利政策。我们发现，无论是所有者还是非所有者控制企业，强势利益相关者都会利用股利支付决策来缓解而非加剧与弱势利益相关者的利益冲突。因此，企业利益相关者结构所反映的潜在代理成本越高，强势利益相关者的股利支付决策所减少的实际代理成本就越多。这些发现与如下股利政策相一致：利益相关者冲突中机会主义的权力滥用会因在后续阶段给滥用者带来代价高昂的后果而受到遏制。间接证据支持这一解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Financial Flexibility, Risk Management, and Payout Choice
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Both risk management and payout decisions affect a firm's financial flexibility-the ability to avoid costly financial distress as well as underinvestment. Raw markdown: bonaim-2014-financial-flexibility-risk-management-and-payout-choice Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Financial Flexibility, Risk Management, and Payout Choice (2014) Paper claim — Both risk management and payout decisions affect a firm's financial flexibility-the ability to avoid costly financial distress as well as underinvestment. Raw markdown: bonaim-2014-financial-flexibility-risk-management-and-payout-choice Bibliographic Record Authors: Bonaimé, AA, Hankins, KW, Harford, J Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hht045 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract Both risk management and payout decisions affect a firm's financial flexibility-the ability to avoid costly financial distress as well as underinvestment. We provide evidence of substitution between hedging and payout decisions using samples of both financial and nonfinancial firms. We find that a more flexible distribution, favoring repurchases over dividends, is negatively related to financial hedging within a firm, consistent with financial flexibility in payout decisions and hedging being substitutes. Our findings, which are robust to controlling for the endogeneity of hedging and payout choices, suggest that payout flexibility offers operational hedging benefits. 摘要（中文） 风险管理和支付决策都会影响企业的财务灵活性——即避免代价高昂的财务困境以及投资不足的能力。我们使用金融企业和非金融企业的样本，提供了对冲与支付决策之间存在替代关系的证据。我们发现，更灵活的分配方式（偏好回购而非股利）在企业内部与金融对冲呈负相关，这与支付决策中的财务灵活性和对冲互为替代相一致。我们的发现在控制了对冲和支付选择的内生性后依然稳健，表明支付灵活性提供了运营对冲的收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The cost of financial flexibility: Evidence from share repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Over the last two decades, share repurchases have emerged as the dominant payout channel, offering a more flexible means of returning excess cash to investors. Raw markdown: bonaim-2016-the-cost-of-financial-flexibility-evidence-from-share Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: The cost of financial flexibility: Evidence from share repurchases (2016) Paper claim — Over the last two decades, share repurchases have emerged as the dominant payout channel, offering a more flexible means of returning excess cash to investors. Raw markdown: bonaim-2016-the-cost-of-financial-flexibility-evidence-from-share Bibliographic Record Authors: Bonaimé, AA, Hankins, KW, Jordan, BD Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.02.002 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, monitor)；股利政策(payout, share repurchase) Abstract Over the last two decades, share repurchases have emerged as the dominant payout channel, offering a more flexible means of returning excess cash to investors. However, little is known about the costs associated with payout-related financial flexibility. Using a unique identification strategy, we document a significant cost. We find that actual repurchase investments underperform hypothetical investments that mechanically smooth repurchase dollars through time by approximately two percentage points per year on average. This cost of financial flexibility is correlated with earnings management, managerial entrenchment, and less institutional monitoring. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在过去二十年中，股份回购已成为主导性的支付渠道，为向投资者返还多余现金提供了更灵活的方式。然而，关于与支付相关的财务灵活性所带来的成本，人们知之甚少。利用一种独特的识别策略，我们记录了一项显著的成本。我们发现，实际的回购投资相较于将回购资金随时间机械平滑的假设性投资，平均每年低表现约两个百分点。这种财务灵活性成本与盈余管理、管理者壕沟效应以及较少的机构监督相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout Policy Trade-Offs and the Rise of 10b5-1 Preset Repurchase Plans
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We are the first to document and study the use of Rule 10b5-1 preset repurchase plans. Raw markdown: bonaim-2020-payout-policy-trade-offs-and-the-rise-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bonaimé, A, Harford, J, Moore, D Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2020 DOI:…
pages.text: Payout Policy Trade-Offs and the Rise of 10b5-1 Preset Repurchase Plans (2020) Paper claim — We are the first to document and study the use of Rule 10b5-1 preset repurchase plans. Raw markdown: bonaim-2020-payout-policy-trade-offs-and-the-rise-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Bonaimé, A, Harford, J, Moore, D Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2019.3322 Relevance score: 13.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy, rule)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative, signal, substitut, trade-off) Abstract We are the first to document and study the use of Rule 10b5-1 preset repurchase plans. Though the rule's original intent was to clarify conditions for enforcing insider trading laws, generally thought to apply to individuals classified as firm insiders, we find strong use of the rule at the firm level to repurchase company stock. We exploit this new and widespread form of payout to examine an issue at the core of payout decisions-the trade-off between commitment and financial flexibility. Relative to open market repurchases, preset plans provide an expanded repurchase window and increased legal cover, albeit at the cost of reducing repurchase flexibility and the option to time repurchases. These costs and benefits are significantly associated with Rule 10b5-1 adoption: Firms with alternative sources of financial flexibility are more likely to precommit to a repurchase plan, as are firms with a history of poor repurchase timing and firms constrained by blackout windows. Consistent with preset plans signaling commitment, Rule 10b5-1 repurchase announcements are associated with greater and faster completion rates, with more positive market reactions, and with more dividend substitution than open market repurchases. Lastly, we find that preset repurchase plans represent a unique payout tool whose introduction encouraged a different set of firms to buy back stock and significantly altered the payout landscape. 摘要（中文） 我们首次记录并研究了对规则10b5-1预设回购计划的使用。尽管该规则最初的意图是澄清执行内幕交易法的条件（一般认为该法适用于被归类为公司内部人的个人），我们却发现该规则在企业层面被广泛用于回购公司股票。我们利用这一新兴且广泛的支付形式，考察一个位于支付决策核心的问题——承诺与财务灵活性之间的权衡。相对于公开市场回购，预设计划提供了更宽的回购窗口和更强的法律保护，但代价是降低了回购灵活性以及择时回购的选择权。这些成本与收益与规则10b5-1的采用显著相关：拥有其他财务灵活性来源的企业更可能预先承诺一项回购计划，回购择时历史不佳的企业以及受封锁窗口约束的企业也是如此。与预设计划发出承诺信号相一致，规则10b5-1回购公告与更高、更快的完成率相关，与更正面的市场反应相关，且相比公开市场回购具有更强的股利替代性。最后，我们发现预设回购计划代表了一种独特的支付工具，其引入促使一批不同的企业回购股票，并显著改变了支付格局。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Buying High and Selling Low: Stock Repurchases and Persistent Asymmetric Information
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Share prices generally fall when a firm announces a seasoned equity offering (SEO). Raw markdown: bond-2016-buying-high-and-selling-low-stock-repurchases-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Bond, P, Zhong, HD Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2016 DOI:…
pages.text: Buying High and Selling Low: Stock Repurchases and Persistent Asymmetric Information (2016) Paper claim — Share prices generally fall when a firm announces a seasoned equity offering (SEO). Raw markdown: bond-2016-buying-high-and-selling-low-stock-repurchases-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Bond, P, Zhong, HD Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhw005 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(stock repurchase) Abstract Share prices generally fall when a firm announces a seasoned equity offering (SEO). A standard explanation is that an SEO communicates negative information to investors. We show that if repeated capital market transactions are possible, this same asymmetry of information between firms and investors implies that some firms also repurchase shares in equilibrium. A subset of these firms directly profit from repurchases, while other firms repurchase in order to improve the terms of a subsequent SEO. The possibility of repurchases reduces both SEOs and investment. Overall, our analysis highlights the importance of analyzing SEOs and repurchases in a unified framework. 摘要（中文） 当公司宣布首次增发（SEO）时，股价通常下跌。一个标准的解释是，SEO向投资者传递了负面信息。我们表明，如果重复的资本市场交易是可能的，那么公司与投资者之间的这种相同的信息不对称意味着一些公司在均衡中也会回购股份。这些公司中的一部分直接从回购中获利，而其他公司回购是为了改善后续SEO的条件。回购的可能性同时减少了SEO和投资。总体而言，我们的分析强调了在一个统一框架下分析SEO和回购的重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose an asset pricing model with generalized disappointment aversion preferences and long-run volatility risk. Raw markdown: bonomo-2011-generalized-disappointment-aversion-long-run-volatility-risk-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Bonomo, M, Garcia, R,…
pages.text: Generalized Disappointment Aversion, Long-run Volatility Risk, and Asset Prices (2011) Paper claim — We propose an asset pricing model with generalized disappointment aversion preferences and long-run volatility risk. Raw markdown: bonomo-2011-generalized-disappointment-aversion-long-run-volatility-risk-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Bonomo, M, Garcia, R, Meddahi, N, Tédongap, R Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhq116 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We propose an asset pricing model with generalized disappointment aversion preferences and long-run volatility risk. With Markov switching fundamentals, we derive closed-form solutions for all returns moments and predictability regressions. The model produces first and second moments of price-dividend ratios and asset returns as well as return predictability patterns in line with the data. Compared to Bansal and Yaron (2004), we generate (i) more predictability of excess returns by price-dividend ratios; (ii) less predictability of consumption growth rates by price-dividend ratios. Our results do not depend on a value of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution greater than one. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一个具有广义失望厌恶偏好和长期波动率风险的资产定价模型。在马尔可夫状态转换基本面下，我们为所有收益矩和可预测性回归推导出封闭形式解。该模型产生的价格-股利比和资产收益的一阶和二阶矩以及收益可预测性模式与数据相一致。与Bansal和Yaron（2004）相比，我们生成了（i）价格-股利比对超额收益更强的可预测性；（ii）价格-股利比对消费增长率更弱的可预测性。我们的结果不依赖于跨期替代弹性大于1的取值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A re-examination of disclosure level and the expected cost of equity capital
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the association between the cost of equity capital and levels of annual report and timely disclosure, and investor relations activities. Raw markdown: botosan-2002-a-re-examination-of-disclosure-level-and-the Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: A re-examination of disclosure level and the expected cost of equity capital (2002) Paper claim — This paper examines the association between the cost of equity capital and levels of annual report and timely disclosure, and investor relations activities. Raw markdown: botosan-2002-a-re-examination-of-disclosure-level-and-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Botosan, CA, Plumlee, MA Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.00037 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines the association between the cost of equity capital and levels of annual report and timely disclosure, and investor relations activities. We estimate the cost of equity capital using the classic dividend discount model. We find that the cost of equity capital decreases in the annual report disclosure level but increases in the level of timely disclosures. The latter result is contrary to theory but is consistent with managers' claims that greater timely disclosures may increase the cost of equity capital, possibly through increased stock price volatility. We find no association between the cost of equity capital and the level of investor relations activities. We conclude that aggregating across different disclosure types results in a loss of information. Failing to include all disclosure types in regression analyses may lead to a correlated omitted variable bias and erroneous conclusions. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了股权资本成本与年报及及时披露水平、投资者关系活动之间的关联。我们使用经典的股利贴现模型估计股权资本成本。我们发现，股权资本成本随年报披露水平的提高而下降，但随及时披露水平的提高而上升。后一结果与理论相悖，但与管理者的说法相一致，即更多的及时披露可能提高股权资本成本，这可能是通过增加股价波动实现的。我们发现股权资本成本与投资者关系活动水平之间不存在关联。我们的结论是，跨不同披露类型进行汇总会导致信息损失。在回归分析中未纳入所有披露类型可能会导致相关遗漏变量偏差和错误结论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: On the importance of measuring payout yield: Implications for empirical asset pricing (2007) Paper claim — We investigate the empirical implications of using various measures of payout yield rather than dividend yield for asset pricing models. Raw markdown: boudoukh-2007-on-the-importance-of-measuring-payout-yield-implications Bibliographic Record Authors: Boudoukh, J, Michaely, R, Richardson, M, Roberts, MR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2007.01226.x Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We investigate the empirical implications of using various measures of payout yield rather than dividend yield for asset pricing models. We find statistically and economically significant predictability in the time series when payout (dividends plus repurchases) and net payout (dividends plus repurchases minus issuances) yields are used instead of the dividend yield. Similarly, we find that payout (net payout) yields contains information about the cross section of expected stock returns exceeding that of dividend yields, and that the high minus low payout yield portfolio is a priced factor. 摘要（中文） 我们考察对于资产定价模型而言，使用各种派现收益率度量而非股利收益率的实证含义。我们发现，当使用派现（股利加回购）收益率和净派现（股利加回购减发行）收益率而非股利收益率时，时间序列中存在统计上和经济上显著的可预测性。类似地，我们发现派现（净派现）收益率所包含的关于预期股票收益横截面的信息超过了股利收益率，并且高减低派现收益率组合是一个被定价的因子。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The myth of long-horizon predictability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The prevailing view in finance is that the evidence for long-horizon stock return predictability is significantly stronger than that for short horizons. Raw markdown: boudoukh-2008-the-myth-of-long-horizon-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Boudoukh, J,…
pages.text: The myth of long-horizon predictability (2008) Paper claim — The prevailing view in finance is that the evidence for long-horizon stock return predictability is significantly stronger than that for short horizons. Raw markdown: boudoukh-2008-the-myth-of-long-horizon-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Boudoukh, J, Richardson, M, Whitelaw, RF Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhl042 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract The prevailing view in finance is that the evidence for long-horizon stock return predictability is significantly stronger than that for short horizons. We show that for persistent regressors, a characteristic of most of the predictive variables used in the literature, the estimators are almost perfectly correlated across horizons under the null hypothesis of no predictability. For the persistence levels of dividend yields, the analytical correlation is 99% between the 1- and 2-year horizon estimators and 94% between the 1- and 5- ear horizons. Common sampling error across equations leads to ordinary least squares coefficient estimates and R(2)s that are roughly proportional to the horizon under the null hypothesis. This is the precise pattern found in the data. We perform joint tests across horizons for a variety of explanatory variables and provide an alternative view of the existing evidence. 摘要（中文） 金融领域的主流观点认为，长视野股票收益可预测性的证据显著强于短视野的证据。我们表明，对于持久性回归变量（文献中所使用的大多数预测变量的特征），在无可预测性的原假设下，估计量在不同视野之间几乎完全相关。对于股利收益率的持久性水平，1年与2年视野估计量之间的解析相关性为99%，1年与5年视野之间为94%。方程间共同的抽样误差导致普通最小二乘系数估计和R平方在原假设下大致与视野成比例。这正是在数据中发现的确切模式。我们针对各种解释变量在不同视野之间进行了联合检验，并对现有证据提供了一种替代性看法。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout policy in Brazil: Dividends versus interest on equity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the impact of tax burden on cash distribution using a sample of Brazilian firms, which are allowed by law to distribute cash to shareholders in two forms: dividends and tax-advantaged interest on equity. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Payout policy in Brazil: Dividends versus interest on equity (2012) Paper claim — We examine the impact of tax burden on cash distribution using a sample of Brazilian firms, which are allowed by law to distribute cash to shareholders in two forms: dividends and tax-advantaged interest on equity. Raw markdown: boulton-2012-payout-policy-in-brazil-dividends-versus-interest-on Bibliographic Record Authors: Boulton, TJ, Braga-Alves, MV, Shastri, K Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.09.004 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, law, policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We examine the impact of tax burden on cash distribution using a sample of Brazilian firms, which are allowed by law to distribute cash to shareholders in two forms: dividends and tax-advantaged interest on equity. The Brazilian institutional setting is superior to those used in prior studies that examine the choice between dividends and capital gains because, in some cases, dividends provide advantages that outweigh their negative tax consequences, leading firms to rationally choose payout policies that are not optimal when viewed only from the perspective of taxes. We find that taxes are a primary determinant of Brazilian firms' payout policy decisions, as profitability and payout ratios (nonequity tax shields) are positively (negatively) related to the likelihood that a firm pays interest on equity. However, many firms continue to pay dividends despite the tax advantages of interest on equity payments. Abnormal returns around payout policy announcements suggest that these firms are, at least in part, catering to investor demand. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们使用巴西企业样本，考察税负对现金分配的影响，巴西法律允许企业以两种形式向股东分配现金：股利和享有税收优惠的股本利息（interest on equity）。巴西的制度环境优于以往研究中考察股利与资本利得之间选择的环境，因为在某些情况下，股利提供的优势超过其负面的税收后果，从而导致企业理性地选择那些仅从税收角度看并非最优的支付政策。我们发现，税收是巴西企业支付政策决策的主要决定因素，因为盈利能力和支付率（非股本税盾）与企业支付股本利息的可能性正（负）相关。然而，尽管股本利息支付具有税收优势，许多企业仍继续支付股利。支付政策公告前后的异常回报表明，这些企业至少在一定程度上是在迎合投资者需求。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines common stock prices around ex-dividend dates. Raw markdown: boyd-1994-ex-dividend-price-behavior-of-common-stocks Bibliographic Record Authors: BOYD, JH, JAGANNATHAN, R Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/7.4.711…
pages.text: EX-DIVIDEND PRICE BEHAVIOR OF COMMON-STOCKS (1994) Paper claim — This study examines common stock prices around ex-dividend dates. Raw markdown: boyd-1994-ex-dividend-price-behavior-of-common-stocks Bibliographic Record Authors: BOYD, JH, JAGANNATHAN, R Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/7.4.711 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This study examines common stock prices around ex-dividend dates. Such price data usually contain a mixture of observations-some with and some without arbitrageurs and/or dividend capturers active. Our theory predicts that such mixing will result in a nonlinear relation between percentage price drop and dividend yield-not the commonly assumed linear relation. This prediction and another important prediction of theory are supported empirically. In a variety of tests, marginal price drop is not significantly different from the dividend amount. Thus, over the last several decades, one-for-one marginal price drop has been an excellent (average) rule of thumb. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了除息日前后的普通股价格。此类价格数据通常包含混合的观测值——有些有套利者和/或股利捕获者活跃，有些则没有。我们的理论预测，这种混合将导致价格百分比下跌与股利收益率之间呈现非线性关系，而非通常假设的线性关系。这一预测以及理论的另一个重要预测得到了实证支持。在各种检验中，边际价格下跌与股利额没有显著差异。因此，在过去几十年中，一比一的边际价格下跌一直是一条出色的（平均）经验法则。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Policies in an Unregulated Market: The London Stock Exchange, 1895-1905
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Miller and Modigliani (1961) show that in perfect and complete financial markets a firm's value is unaffected by its dividend policy. Raw markdown: braggion-2011-dividend-policies-in-an-unregulated-market-the-london Bibliographic Record Authors: Braggion, F, Moore,…
pages.text: Dividend Policies in an Unregulated Market: The London Stock Exchange, 1895-1905 (2011) Paper claim — Miller and Modigliani (1961) show that in perfect and complete financial markets a firm's value is unaffected by its dividend policy. Raw markdown: braggion-2011-dividend-policies-in-an-unregulated-market-the-london Bibliographic Record Authors: Braggion, F, Moore, L Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhr026 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy, regulat)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Miller and Modigliani (1961) show that in perfect and complete financial markets a firm's value is unaffected by its dividend policy. Much of the more recent research has demonstrated that dividend policy becomes important in the presence of taxation, asymmetric information, incomplete contracts, institutional constraints, and transaction costs. By examining the effects of dividend policies on 475 British firms existing between 1895 and 1905, and consequently operating in an environment of very low taxation with an absence of institutional constraints, we find strong support for asymmetric information theories of dividend policy, and little support for agency models. (JEL N23, G14, G35) 摘要（中文） Miller和Modigliani（1961）表明，在完美且完全的金融市场中，企业价值不受其股利政策的影响。更多近期研究已经证明，在存在税收、信息不对称、不完全契约、制度约束和交易成本的情况下，股利政策变得重要。通过考察1895年至1905年间存续的475家英国企业的股利政策，从而是在税收极低且没有制度约束的环境中运营的企业，我们发现对股利政策的信息不对称理论有力支持，而对代理模型几乎不支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops a nonparametric approach to examine how portfolio and consumption choice depends on variables that forecast time-varying investment opportunities. Raw markdown: brandt-1999-estimating-portfolio-and-consumption-choice-a-conditional-euler…
pages.text: Estimating portfolio and consumption choice: A conditional Euler equations approach (1999) Paper claim — This paper develops a nonparametric approach to examine how portfolio and consumption choice depends on variables that forecast time-varying investment opportunities. Raw markdown: brandt-1999-estimating-portfolio-and-consumption-choice-a-conditional-euler Bibliographic Record Authors: Brandt, MW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00162 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper develops a nonparametric approach to examine how portfolio and consumption choice depends on variables that forecast time-varying investment opportunities. I estimate single-period and multiperiod portfolio and consumption rules of an investor with constant relative risk aversion and a one-month to 20-year horizon. The investor allocates wealth to the NYSE index and a 30-day Treasury bill. I find that the portfolio choice varies significantly with the dividend yield, default premium, term premium, and lagged excess return. Furthermore, the optimal decisions depend on the investor's horizon and rebalancing frequency. 摘要（中文） 本文提出了一种非参数方法，用以考察组合与消费选择如何取决于那些预测时变投资机会的变量。我估计了一位具有常相对风险厌恶、投资期限从一个月到20年不等的投资者的单期和多期组合与消费规则。该投资者将财富配置于纽约证券交易所指数和一只30天期国库券。我发现组合选择随股利收益率、违约溢价、期限溢价和滞后超额收益的变化而显著变化。此外，最优决策取决于投资者的期限和再平衡频率。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We present a simulation-based method for solving discrete-time portfolio choice problems involving non-standard preferences, a large number of assets with arbitrary return distribution, and, most importantly, a large number of state variables with potentially…
pages.text: A simulation approach to dynamic portfolio choice with an application to learning about return predictability (2005) Paper claim — We present a simulation-based method for solving discrete-time portfolio choice problems involving non-standard preferences, a large number of assets with arbitrary return distribution, and, most importantly, a large number of state variables with potentially path-dependent or non-stationary dynamics. Raw markdown: brandt-2005-a-simulation-approach-to-dynamic-portfolio-choice-with Bibliographic Record Authors: Brandt, MW, Goyal, A, Santa-Clara, P, Stroud, JR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhi019 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We present a simulation-based method for solving discrete-time portfolio choice problems involving non-standard preferences, a large number of assets with arbitrary return distribution, and, most importantly, a large number of state variables with potentially path-dependent or non-stationary dynamics. The method is flexible enough to accommodate intermediate consumption, portfolio constraints, parameter and model uncertainty, and learning. We first establish the properties of the method for the portfolio choice between a stock index and cash when the stock returns are either iid or predictable by the dividend yield. We then explore the problem of an investor who takes into account the predictability of returns but is uncertain about the parameters of the data generating process. The investor chooses the portfolio anticipating that future data realizations will contain useful information to learn about the true parameter values. 摘要（中文） 我们提出一种基于模拟的方法，用以求解涉及非标准偏好、大量具有任意收益分布的资产，以及——最重要的是——大量可能具有路径依赖或非平稳动态的状态变量的离散时间组合选择问题。该方法足够灵活，可容纳中间消费、组合约束、参数和模型不确定性以及学习。我们首先针对在股票指数与现金之间的组合选择确立该方法的性质，其中股票收益要么是独立同分布的，要么可由股利收益率预测。随后我们探讨这样一位投资者的问题：他考虑到收益的可预测性，但对数据生成过程的参数不确定。该投资者在选择组合时预期到未来的数据实现将包含有用信息，可用于了解真实的参数值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Pricing Two Heterogeneous Trees
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We consider a Lucas-type exchange economy with two heterogeneous stocks (trees) and a representative investor with constant relative risk aversion. Raw markdown: branger-2011-pricing-two-heterogeneous-trees Bibliographic Record Authors: Branger, N, Schlag, C, Wu, L…
pages.text: Pricing Two Heterogeneous Trees (2011) Paper claim — We consider a Lucas-type exchange economy with two heterogeneous stocks (trees) and a representative investor with constant relative risk aversion. Raw markdown: branger-2011-pricing-two-heterogeneous-trees Bibliographic Record Authors: Branger, N, Schlag, C, Wu, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1017/S002210901100038X Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We consider a Lucas-type exchange economy with two heterogeneous stocks (trees) and a representative investor with constant relative risk aversion. The dividend process for one stock follows a geometric Brownian motion with constant and known parameters. The expected dividend growth rate for the other tree is stochastic and in general unobservable, although there may be a signal from which the investor can learn about its current value. We find that the equilibrium quantities in our model significantly depend on the information structure and on the level of risk aversion. While an observable stochastic drift mainly makes the economy more risky, a latent expected growth rate process with learning significantly changes the equilibrium price-dividend ratios, price reactions to dividend and drift innovations, expected returns, volatilities, correlations, and differences between the stocks. These effects are the more pronounced the more risk averse the representative investor. 摘要（中文） 我们考虑一个Lucas型交换经济，其中有两只异质的股票（树）以及一个具有恒定相对风险厌恶的代表性投资者。一只股票的股利过程遵循具有恒定且已知参数的几何布朗运动。另一只树的预期股利增长率是随机的，且通常不可观测，尽管可能存在一个信号，投资者可以从中了解其当前值。我们发现我们模型中的均衡数量显著依赖于信息结构和风险厌恶水平。虽然可观测的随机漂移主要使经济更具风险，但一个具有学习的潜在预期增长率过程会显著改变均衡价格-股利比、价格对股利和漂移创新的反应、预期收益、波动率、相关性以及股票之间的差异。代表性投资者越是风险厌恶，这些效应就越明显。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout policy in the 21st century
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We survey 384 financial executives and conduct in-depth interviews with an additional 23 to determine the factors that drive dividend and share repurchase decisions. Raw markdown: brav-2005-payout-policy-in-the-21st-century Bibliographic Record Authors: Brav, A,…
pages.text: Payout policy in the 21st century (2005) Paper claim — We survey 384 financial executives and conduct in-depth interviews with an additional 23 to determine the factors that drive dividend and share repurchase decisions. Raw markdown: brav-2005-payout-policy-in-the-21st-century Bibliographic Record Authors: Brav, A, Graham, JR, Harvey, CR, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2004.07.004 Relevance score: 12.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, signal) Abstract We survey 384 financial executives and conduct in-depth interviews with an additional 23 to determine the factors that drive dividend and share repurchase decisions. Our findings indicate that maintaining the dividend level is on par with investment decisions, while repurchases are made out of the residual cash flow after investment spending. Perceived stability of future earnings still affects dividend policy as in Lintner (1956. American Economic Review 46, 97-113). However, 50 years later, we find that the link between dividends and earnings has weakened. Many managers now favor repurchases because they are viewed as being more flexible than dividends and can be used in an attempt to time the equity market or to increase earnings per share. Executives believe that institutions are indifferent between dividends and repurchases and that payout policies have little impact on their investor clientele. In general, management views provide little support for agency, signaling, and clientele hypotheses of payout policy. Tax considerations play a secondary role. (c) 2005 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们调查了384位财务高管，并对另外23位进行了深度访谈，以确定驱动股利和股份回购决策的因素。我们的发现表明，维持股利水平的重要性与投资决策相当，而回购则由投资支出后的剩余现金流进行。正如林特纳（Lintner，1956，《美国经济评论》46, 97-113）所述，对未来盈利稳定性的感知仍然影响股利政策。然而，50年后，我们发现股利与盈利之间的联系已经减弱。许多管理者如今偏好回购，因为回购被视为比股利更灵活，且可用于尝试择时股票市场或提高每股收益。高管们相信，机构对股利和回购持无差异态度，且支付政策对其投资者群体影响甚微。总体而言，管理层观点几乎不支持支付政策的代理、信号和群体假说。税收考量则起次要作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
