pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the relation between stock returns, measures of risk, and several non-risk security characteristics, including the book-to-market ratio, firm size, the stock price, the dividend yield, and lagged returns. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Alternative factor specifications, security characteristics, and the cross-section of expected stock returns (1998) Paper claim — We examine the relation between stock returns, measures of risk, and several non-risk security characteristics, including the book-to-market ratio, firm size, the stock price, the dividend yield, and lagged returns. Raw markdown: brennan-1998-alternative-factor-specifications-security-characteristics-and-the-cross Bibliographic Record Authors: Brennan, MJ, Chordia, T, Subrahmanyam, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(98)00028-2 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract We examine the relation between stock returns, measures of risk, and several non-risk security characteristics, including the book-to-market ratio, firm size, the stock price, the dividend yield, and lagged returns. Our primary objective is to determine whether non-risk characteristics have marginal explanatory power relative to the arbitrage pricing theory benchmark, with factors determined using, in turn, the Conner and Korajczyk (CK; 1988) and the Fama and French (FF; 1993b) approaches. Fama-MacBeth-type regressions using risk adjusted returns provide evidence of return momentum, size, and book-to-market effects, together with a significant and negative relation between returns and trading volume, even after accounting for the CK factors. When the analysis is repeated using the FF factors, we find that the size and book-to-market effects are attenuated, while the momentum and trading volume effects persist. In addition, Nasdaq stocks show significant underperformance after adjusting for risk using either method. (C) 1998 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了股票收益、风险度量与若干非风险证券特征之间的关系，这些特征包括账面市值比、公司规模、股价、股利收益率和滞后收益。我们的主要目标是确定相对于套利定价理论基准，非风险特征是否具有边际解释力，其中因子分别使用Conner和Korajczyk（CK；1988）以及Fama和French（FF；1993b）的方法确定。使用风险调整收益的Fama-MacBeth型回归提供了收益动量、规模和账面市值比效应的证据，以及收益与交易量之间显著的负向关系，即使在考虑CK因子之后也是如此。当使用FF因子重复分析时，我们发现规模和账面市值比效应被削弱，而动量和交易量效应依然存在。此外，纳斯达克股票在用任一方法进行风险调整后都表现出显著的表现不佳。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The behavioral foundations of corporate dividend policy a cross-country analysis
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study a model that relates dividend payout policy to behavioral issues based on the ideas of mental accounting. Raw markdown: breuer-2014-the-behavioral-foundations-of-corporate-dividend-policy-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Breuer, W, Rieger, MO, Soypak, KC…
pages.text: The behavioral foundations of corporate dividend policy a cross-country analysis (2014) Paper claim — We study a model that relates dividend payout policy to behavioral issues based on the ideas of mental accounting. Raw markdown: breuer-2014-the-behavioral-foundations-of-corporate-dividend-policy-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Breuer, W, Rieger, MO, Soypak, KC Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2014.02.001 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We study a model that relates dividend payout policy to behavioral issues based on the ideas of mental accounting. A panel analysis across 29 countries and over 43,000 firm-years demonstrates that our model studying the relation between dividends and patience, loss aversion, and ambiguity aversion can be verified empirically. Our paper seems to be the first that highlights empirically in a straightforward way the relevance of behavioral patterns as important determinants for corporate dividend policy, while previous empirical studies could tackle this issue only indirectly. With several robustness tests we also address potential doubts concerning the quality of our data and analyze further implications of our theory. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了一个基于心理账户（mental accounting）思想将股利支付政策与行为问题相联系的模型。跨越29个国家、超过43000个企业-年的面板分析表明，我们研究股利与耐心、损失厌恶和模糊性厌恶之间关系的模型能够得到实证验证。我们的论文似乎是首篇以直截了当的方式实证凸显行为模式作为公司股利政策重要决定因素相关性的研究，而先前的实证研究只能间接地探讨这一问题。通过若干稳健性检验，我们还处理了关于数据质量的潜在疑虑，并分析了我们理论的进一步含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock market liquidity and the decision to repurchase
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the impact of stock market liquidity on managerial payout decisions. Raw markdown: brockman-2008-stock-market-liquidity-and-the-decision-to-repurchase Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Howe, JS, Mortal, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: Stock market liquidity and the decision to repurchase (2008) Paper claim — We examine the impact of stock market liquidity on managerial payout decisions. Raw markdown: brockman-2008-stock-market-liquidity-and-the-decision-to-repurchase Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Howe, JS, Mortal, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2008.06.001 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We examine the impact of stock market liquidity on managerial payout decisions. We argue that stock market liquidity influences payout policy through a first-order effect on the share repurchase decision, and a second-order or residual effect on the dividend decision. Managers compare the tax and flexibility advantages of a repurchase against its liquidity cost disadvantage. All else equal, higher market liquidity encourages the use of repurchases over dividends. Our empirical results confirm that stock market liquidity plays a significant role in repurchase and dividend initiations, as well as in recurring payout decisions. Unlike previous studies that measure liquidity changes following the repurchase decision, we examine liquidity levels prior to the payout decision. We show that managers condition their repurchase decision on a sufficient level of market liquidity, consistent with Barclay and Smith's [Barclay, M.J., Smith, C.W.Jr., 1988. Corporate payout policy: cash dividends versus open-market repurchases. journal of Financial Economics 22, 61-82.] theoretical analysis and Brav et al.'s [Brav, A., Graham, J.R., Campbell, R.H., Michaely, R., 2005. Payout policy in the 21st century. journal of Financial Economics 77, 483-528.] CFO survey results. Repurchases have recently become the payout decision of choice in part because of rising stock market liquidity. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察股票市场流动性对管理层支付决策的影响。我们认为，股票市场流动性通过对股份回购决策的一阶效应以及对股利决策的二阶或残余效应来影响支付政策。管理者将回购的税收和灵活性优势与其流动性成本劣势相权衡。在其他条件相同时，更高的市场流动性鼓励使用回购而非股利。我们的实证结果证实，股票市场流动性在回购和股利的启动以及经常性支付决策中都发挥了重要作用。与以往研究衡量回购决策之后的流动性变化不同，我们考察的是支付决策之前的流动性水平。我们表明，管理者以充足的市场流动性水平为条件做出回购决策，这与巴克莱和史密斯（Barclay, M.J., Smith, C.W.Jr., 1988. 《公司支付政策：现金股利与公开市场回购》，《金融经济学杂志》22, 61-82）的理论分析以及布拉夫等（Brav, A., Graham, J.R., Campbell, R.H., Michaely, R., 2005. 《21世纪的支付政策》，《金融经济学杂志》77, 483-528）的首席财务官调查结果相一致。回购近来成为首选的支付决策，部分原因在于股票市场流动性的上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Managers increase the frequency and magnitude of bad news announcements during the 1-month period prior to repurchasing shares. Raw markdown: brockman-2008-voluntary-disclosures-around-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Khurana, IK,…
pages.text: Voluntary disclosures around share repurchases (2008) Paper claim — Managers increase the frequency and magnitude of bad news announcements during the 1-month period prior to repurchasing shares. Raw markdown: brockman-2008-voluntary-disclosures-around-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Khurana, IK, Martin, X Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.08.004 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract Managers increase the frequency and magnitude of bad news announcements during the 1-month period prior to repurchasing shares. To a lesser extent, they also increase the frequency and magnitude of good news announcements during the 1-month period following their repurchases. These results are consistent with Barclay and Smith's [1988. Corporate payout policy: Cash dividends versus open-market repurchases. journal of Financial Economics 22, 64-82.] conjecture that share repurchases, unlike dividends, create incentives for managers to manipulate information flows. We further show that managers provide downward-biased earnings forecasts before repurchases and that managers' propensity to alter information flows prior to share repurchases increases with their ownership interest in the firm. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在回购股份之前的1个月期间，管理者增加了坏消息公告的频率和幅度。在较小程度上，他们也在回购之后的1个月期间增加了好消息公告的频率和幅度。这些结果与巴克莱和史密斯（Barclay and Smith，1988，《公司支付政策：现金股利与公开市场回购》，《金融经济学杂志》22, 64-82）的推测相一致，即股份回购不同于股利，会为管理者操纵信息流创造动机。我们进一步表明，管理者在回购之前提供向下偏误的盈利预测，且管理者在股份回购之前改变信息流的倾向随其在企业中的持股权益增加而增强。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend policy, creditor rights, and the agency costs of debt
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that country-level creditor rights influence dividend policies around the world by establishing the balance of power between debt and equity claimants. Raw markdown: brockman-2009-dividend-policy-creditor-rights-and-the-agency-costs Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Dividend policy, creditor rights, and the agency costs of debt (2009) Paper claim — We show that country-level creditor rights influence dividend policies around the world by establishing the balance of power between debt and equity claimants. Raw markdown: brockman-2009-dividend-policy-creditor-rights-and-the-agency-costs Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Unlu, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2008.03.007 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative, substitut) Abstract We show that country-level creditor rights influence dividend policies around the world by establishing the balance of power between debt and equity claimants. Creditors demand and managers consent to a more restrictive Payout policy as a substitute for weak creditor rights in an effort to minimize the firm's agency costs of debt. Using a sample of 120,507 firm-years from 52 countries, we find that both the probability and amount of dividend payouts are significantly lower in countries with poor creditor rights. A reduction in the creditor rights index from its highest value to its lowest value implies a 41% reduction in the probability of paying a dividend, and a 60% reduction in dividend payout ratios. These results are robust to numerous control variables, sample variations, model specifications, and alternative hypotheses. We also show that the agency costs of debt play a more decisive role in determining dividend policies than the previously documented agency costs of equity. Overall, our findings contribute to the growing literature arguing that creditors exert significant influence over corporate decision-making outside of bankruptcy. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，国家层面的债权人权利通过确立债权索取人与股权索取人之间的力量平衡，影响着世界各地的股利政策。债权人要求、管理者同意采取更具限制性的支付政策，作为对薄弱债权人权利的替代，以努力将企业的债务代理成本最小化。使用来自52个国家的120,507个企业-年度样本，我们发现，在债权人权利差的国家，支付股利的概率和金额都显著更低。债权人权利指数从最高值降至最低值，意味着支付股利概率降低41%、股利支付率降低60%。这些结果对众多控制变量、样本变化、模型设定和替代性假说都是稳健的。我们还表明，债务代理成本在决定股利政策中所起的作用，比此前记录的股权代理成本更具决定性。总体而言，我们的发现为日益增长的一支文献做出了贡献，该文献认为债权人在破产之外对企业决策施加了重大影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Earned/contributed capital, dividend policy, and disclosure quality: An international study
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the agency cost version of the lifecycle theory of dividends by taking advantage of cross-country variations in disclosure environments. Raw markdown: brockman-2011-earned-contributed-capital-dividend-policy-and-disclosure-quality Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Earned/contributed capital, dividend policy, and disclosure quality: An international study (2011) Paper claim — We examine the agency cost version of the lifecycle theory of dividends by taking advantage of cross-country variations in disclosure environments. Raw markdown: brockman-2011-earned-contributed-capital-dividend-policy-and-disclosure-quality Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Unlu, E Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2010.11.014 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, substitut) Abstract We examine the agency cost version of the lifecycle theory of dividends by taking advantage of cross-country variations in disclosure environments. The outcome hypothesis posits that transparent disclosure environments lead to higher dividend payouts because shareholders can more accurately measure (and therefore demand) excess cash flows. In contrast, the substitute hypothesis argues that opaque disclosure environments lead to higher payouts because managers have stronger incentives to establish their reputation for fair treatment. Our empirical results confirm both hypotheses and contribute to the literature in two primary ways. First, we confirm that the lifecycle theory of dividends explains dividend payout patterns around the world. Second, and more important, we show that the firm's disclosure environment plays a significant role in dividend payouts through its effect on agency costs; that is, we confirm an agency cost-inclusive lifecycle theory of dividends. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用信息披露环境的跨国差异，检验股利生命周期理论的代理成本版本。结果假说认为，透明的信息披露环境导致更高的股利支付，因为股东能够更准确地衡量（并因此要求）多余的现金流。相比之下，替代假说认为，不透明的信息披露环境导致更高的支付，因为管理者有更强的动机去建立其公平对待股东的声誉。我们的实证结果同时证实了这两个假说，并从两个主要方面对文献做出贡献。第一，我们证实股利生命周期理论能够解释世界各地的股利支付模式。第二，也更重要的是，我们表明企业的信息披露环境通过其对代理成本的影响，在股利支付中发挥了重要作用；也就是说，我们证实了一个纳入代理成本的股利生命周期理论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of insider trading laws on dividend payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We posit that firms use dividend payout policy to reduce information asymmetry and agency costs caused by country-level institutional weaknesses. Raw markdown: brockman-2014-the-impact-of-insider-trading-laws-on-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P,…
pages.text: The impact of insider trading laws on dividend payout policy (2014) Paper claim — We posit that firms use dividend payout policy to reduce information asymmetry and agency costs caused by country-level institutional weaknesses. Raw markdown: brockman-2014-the-impact-of-insider-trading-laws-on-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Tresl, J, Unlu, E Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.09.002 Relevance score: 15.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, institution, law, legal protection, policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, information asymmetry, substitut) Abstract We posit that firms use dividend payout policy to reduce information asymmetry and agency costs caused by country-level institutional weaknesses. Firms operating in countries with weak insider trading laws attempt to mitigate this institutional weakness by committing themselves to paying out large and stable cash dividends. We test this central hypothesis (among others) using an international sample of firms across 24 countries, as well as by conducting a case study during an enforcement action. The results show that weak insider trading laws lead to a higher propensity of paying dividends, larger dividend amounts and greater dividend smoothing. We also show that the market's valuation of dividend payouts is significantly higher when insider trading protection is weak. It is important to note that these insider trading results are not due to cross-country variations in investor or creditor protection, nor are they contingent on the enforcement of insider trading laws. Overall, our evidence supports the view that dividend payouts serve as a substitute bonding mechanism when country-level legal protections fail. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们提出，企业利用股利支付政策来降低由国家层面制度薄弱所导致的信息不对称和代理成本。在内幕交易法薄弱的国家经营的企业，试图通过承诺支付大额且稳定的现金股利来缓解这一制度缺陷。我们使用涵盖24个国家的国际企业样本，并结合一次执法行动期间的案例研究，检验了这一核心假设（及其他假设）。结果表明，薄弱的内幕交易法导致更高的股利支付倾向、更大的股利金额以及更强的股利平滑。我们还表明，当内幕交易保护薄弱时，市场对股利支付的估值显著更高。值得注意的是，这些内幕交易结果并非源于投资者保护或债权人保护的跨国差异，也不取决于内幕交易法的执行。总体而言，我们的证据支持这样一种观点：当国家层面的法律保护失效时，股利支付充当了一种替代性的约束机制。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Smoothing and Firm Valuation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the relationship between dividend smoothing and firm valuation across 21 countries using several empirical methods and smoothing measures. Raw markdown: brockman-2022-dividend-smoothing-and-firm-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P,…
pages.text: Dividend Smoothing and Firm Valuation (2022) Paper claim — We examine the relationship between dividend smoothing and firm valuation across 21 countries using several empirical methods and smoothing measures. Raw markdown: brockman-2022-dividend-smoothing-and-firm-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Brockman, P, Hanousek, J, Tresl, J, Unlu, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109021000673 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract We examine the relationship between dividend smoothing and firm valuation across 21 countries using several empirical methods and smoothing measures. Our main results show that dividends are capitalized at significantly larger values for high-smoothing firms than for low-smoothing firms. We also find that dividend-smoothing premiums are higher in countries with weak shareholder protection - suggesting that smoothing serves as a substitute mechanism to reduce agency costs. Overall, our findings support the view that managers use dividend smoothing predominantly as a bonding mechanism to reduce agency costs (Leary and Michaely (2011)), and not as a rent extraction mechanism (Lambrecht and Myers (2012)). 摘要（中文） 我们使用若干经验方法和平滑度量，考察21个国家中股利平滑（dividend smoothing）与企业估值之间的关系。我们的主要结果表明，高平滑企业的股利被以显著高于低平滑企业的价值资本化。我们还发现，在股东保护较弱的国家，股利平滑溢价更高——这表明平滑充当了一种降低代理成本的替代机制。总体而言，我们的发现支持这样一种观点：管理者使用股利平滑主要作为一种降低代理成本的约束机制（Leary与Michaely（2011）），而非一种租金攫取机制（Lambrecht与Myers（2012））。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Executive financial incentives and payout policy: Firm responses to the 2003 dividend tax cut
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We test whether executive stock ownership affects firm payouts using the 2003 dividend tax cut to identify an exogenous change in the after-tax value of dividends. Raw markdown: brown-2007-executive-financial-incentives-and-payout-policy-firm-responses…
pages.text: Executive financial incentives and payout policy: Firm responses to the 2003 dividend tax cut (2007) Paper claim — We test whether executive stock ownership affects firm payouts using the 2003 dividend tax cut to identify an exogenous change in the after-tax value of dividends. Raw markdown: brown-2007-executive-financial-incentives-and-payout-policy-firm-responses Bibliographic Record Authors: Brown, JR, Liang, N, Weisbenner, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2007.01261.x Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract We test whether executive stock ownership affects firm payouts using the 2003 dividend tax cut to identify an exogenous change in the after-tax value of dividends. We find that executives with higher ownership were more likely to increase dividends after the tax cut in 2003, whereas no relation is found in periods when the dividend tax rate was higher. Relative to previous years, Firms that initiated dividends in 2003 were more likely to reduce repurchases. The stock price reaction to the tax cut suggests that the substitution of dividends for repurchases may have been anticipated, consistent with agency conflicts. 摘要（中文） 我们利用2003年股利减税这一识别股利税后价值外生变化的事件，检验高管持股是否影响企业支付。我们发现，持股较高的高管在2003年减税后更可能提高股利，而在股利税率较高的时期则未发现这种关系。相较于往年，2003年发起派息的企业更可能减少回购。股价对减税的反应表明，用股利替代回购的行为可能已被预期，这与代理冲突相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Consuming Dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies why investors buy dividend-paying assets and how they time consumption accordingly. Raw markdown: bruer-2022-consuming-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Bräuer, K, Hackethal, A, Hanspal, T Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2022…
pages.text: Consuming Dividends (2022) Paper claim — This paper studies why investors buy dividend-paying assets and how they time consumption accordingly. Raw markdown: bruer-2022-consuming-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Bräuer, K, Hackethal, A, Hanspal, T Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhac010 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract This paper studies why investors buy dividend-paying assets and how they time consumption accordingly. We combine administrative bank data linking customers' consumption and income to portfolio data and survey responses on financial behavior. We find that private consumption is excessively sensitive to dividend income. Investors across wealth, income, and age distributions increase spending precisely around days of dividend receipt. Our results are at odds with a number of existing rational and behavioral explanations, such as financial constraints and impulsiveness. Instead, consumption responses reflect "planned" excess sensitivity, driven by investors who select dividend portfolios, anticipate dividend income, and plan consumption accordingly. 摘要（中文） 本文研究投资者为何购买派息资产，以及他们如何相应地安排消费时点。我们结合将客户消费和收入与投资组合数据相联系的银行行政数据以及关于金融行为的调查回应。我们发现，私人消费对股利收入过度敏感。跨财富、收入和年龄分布的投资者恰好在收到股利的日子前后增加支出。我们的结果与若干现有的理性和行为解释（如融资约束和冲动性）相矛盾。相反，消费反应反映了“有计划的”过度敏感，其驱动者是那些选择股利组合、预期股利收入并相应地计划消费的投资者。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Evidence on the outcome of Say-On-Pay votes: How managers, directors, and shareholders respond
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The economic value of the Say-On-Pay (SOP) provision of the Dodd-Frank Act has been a subject of debate. Raw markdown: brunarski-2015-evidence-on-the-outcome-of-say-on-pay Bibliographic Record Authors: Brunarski, KR, Campbell, TC, Harman, YS Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Evidence on the outcome of Say-On-Pay votes: How managers, directors, and shareholders respond (2015) Paper claim — The economic value of the Say-On-Pay (SOP) provision of the Dodd-Frank Act has been a subject of debate. Raw markdown: brunarski-2015-evidence-on-the-outcome-of-say-on-pay Bibliographic Record Authors: Brunarski, KR, Campbell, TC, Harman, YS Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.12.007 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The economic value of the Say-On-Pay (SOP) provision of the Dodd-Frank Act has been a subject of debate. Proponents of this provision suggest these votes benefit shareholders by increasing investor influence over managerial compensation. Opponents of the SOP provision believe compensation contracting is better done by well-informed and unobstructed boards of directors. Our study provides direct evidence on the impact of the shareholder SOP votes by examining responses to the vote. We find that overcompensated managers with low SOP support tend to react by increasing dividends, decreasing leverage and increasing corporate investment. However, we find no evidence that management's response to the vote affects subsequent vote outcomes, nor do we find a subsequent change in firm value. Finally, we find excess compensation increases for managers that were substantially overpaid prior to the SOP vote, regardless of the outcome of the vote. Thus, it does not appear that the SOP legislation has had the intended effect of improving executive contracting. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 《多德-弗兰克法案》中"薪酬话语权"（SOP）条款的经济价值一直是争论的主题。该条款的支持者认为，这些投票通过增强投资者对管理者薪酬的影响力而使股东受益。SOP条款的反对者则认为，薪酬契约应由信息充分且不受阻碍的董事会来完成。我们的研究通过考察对投票的反应，为股东SOP投票的影响提供了直接证据。我们发现，SOP支持率低的过度受薪管理者往往通过增加股利、降低杠杆和增加企业投资来做出反应。然而，我们没有发现证据表明管理层对投票的反应会影响后续的投票结果，也没有发现企业价值随后发生变化。最后，我们发现，对于那些在SOP投票之前被大幅超额支付的管理者，其超额薪酬会增加，无论投票结果如何。因此，SOP立法似乎并未达到改善高管契约的预期效果。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Uncertainty and firm dividend policy-A natural experiment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how firms respond to uncertainty around U.S. Raw markdown: buchanan-2017-uncertainty-and-firm-dividend-policy-a-natural-experiment Bibliographic Record Authors: Buchanan, BG, Cao, CX, Liljeblom, E, Weihrich, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: Uncertainty and firm dividend policy-A natural experiment (2017) Paper claim — We examine how firms respond to uncertainty around U.S. Raw markdown: buchanan-2017-uncertainty-and-firm-dividend-policy-a-natural-experiment Bibliographic Record Authors: Buchanan, BG, Cao, CX, Liljeblom, E, Weihrich, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.11.008 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine how firms respond to uncertainty around U.S. tax policy changes, namely the individual level tax rate increases set to take effect on January 1, 2011 and January 1, 2013. We provide evidence that firms time the uncertainty in the tax environment and revise their dividend policy to an expected tax increase. We find that firms are likely to initiate their dividends or intensively increase their existing dividend amount one year before the expected tax increase. In addition, in 2012 when there is much less uncertainty on dividend tax changes than in 2010, firms are less likely to initiate a regular dividend but are more likely to initiate special dividends. The results suggest that firms facing less tax uncertainty are less likely to make long-term commitments on regular dividend payments but are more likely to take advantage of the last-minute low tax benefits by issuing special dividends. Furthermore, the response to the possible elimination of a tax cut was strongest in firms with high levels of tax affected ownership, supporting the argument that when facing policy uncertainty, firms behave to prepare for the worst scenarios from the viewpoint of the shareholders, which in this case is a tax increase. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了公司如何应对围绕美国税收政策变化的不确定性，即定于2011年1月1日和2013年1月1日生效的个人层面税率上调。我们提供的证据表明，公司会把握税收环境中的不确定性并针对预期的税收上调修正其股利政策。我们发现公司很可能在预期税收上调的一年前首次发放股利或大幅增加其现有股利数额。此外，在2012年，当股利税变动的不确定性远小于2010年时，公司不太可能首次发放常规股利，但更可能首次发放特别股利。结果表明，面临较少税收不确定性的公司不太可能对常规股利支付作出长期承诺，但更可能通过发放特别股利来利用最后时刻的低税收益。此外，对可能取消减税的反应在拥有高水平受税收影响所有权的公司中最强，这支持了以下论点：当面临政策不确定性时，公司从股东的角度出发为最坏情形（本例中即税收上调）做准备而行事。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Should Insider Trading be Prohibited When Share Repurchases are Allowed?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper considers share repurchases as the way long-term shareholders preserve their ability to use corporate information for Speculative purposes when insider trading regulation is enforced. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Should Insider Trading be Prohibited When Share Repurchases are Allowed? (2008) Paper claim — This paper considers share repurchases as the way long-term shareholders preserve their ability to use corporate information for Speculative purposes when insider trading regulation is enforced. Raw markdown: buffa-2008-should-insider-trading-be-prohibited-when-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Buffa, AM, Nicodano, G Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfn009 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, regulat)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract This paper considers share repurchases as the way long-term shareholders preserve their ability to use corporate information for Speculative purposes when insider trading regulation is enforced. This use of corporate information increases the adverse selection losses of short-term shareholders. Thus, buy-back programs reduce their incentive to invest in stocks that back the most productive technology, leading to a socially inefficient equilibrium. It follows that insider trading should not be banned when share repurchases are allowed. More generally, the paper argues that the regulation of insider trading and repurchases can not be considered in isolation, and analyzes their interplay. 摘要（中文） 本文将股份回购视为长期股东在内幕交易监管得到执行时保留其利用公司信息进行投机的能力的方式。这种对公司信息的利用增加了短期股东的逆向选择损失。因此，回购计划降低了他们投资于支撑最具生产力技术的股票的动机，从而导致一个社会无效率的均衡。由此得出，当允许股份回购时不应禁止内幕交易。更一般地，本文认为，对内幕交易和回购的监管不能孤立地考虑，并分析了二者之间的相互作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Institutional investors, heterogeneous benchmarks and the comovement of asset prices
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the equilibrium implications of a multi-asset economy in which asset managers performance is tied to different benchmarks, reflecting heterogeneity in their investment mandates. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Institutional investors, heterogeneous benchmarks and the comovement of asset prices (2023) Paper claim — We study the equilibrium implications of a multi-asset economy in which asset managers performance is tied to different benchmarks, reflecting heterogeneity in their investment mandates. Raw markdown: buffa-2023-institutional-investors-heterogeneous-benchmarks-and-the-comovement-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Buffa, AM, Hodor, I Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2022.11.002 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We study the equilibrium implications of a multi-asset economy in which asset managers performance is tied to different benchmarks, reflecting heterogeneity in their investment mandates. Fluctuations in the capital asset managers invest for benchmarking purposes, scaled by the size of the economy, induce price pressure that results in negative spillovers across assets. We characterize a rich structure of asset price comovement within and across benchmarks by analyzing shock elasticities and cross-elasticities of price-dividend ratios. Evidence on the heterogeneity of mutual fund mandates and the benchmarking-induced return comovement across cap-style and industry-sector portfolios corroborates the model assumptions and predictions. 摘要（中文） 我们研究一个多资产经济体的均衡含义，其中资产管理人的业绩与不同的基准挂钩，反映了其投资授权（mandate）的异质性。资产管理人出于对标基准目的而投资的资本的波动（以经济规模缩放）会引发价格压力，从而导致资产间的负溢出效应。我们通过分析价格-股利比率的冲击弹性和交叉弹性，刻画了基准内部和跨基准的资产价格共动的丰富结构。关于共同基金授权异质性以及跨市值风格和行业部门组合的对标引致收益共动的证据，印证了模型的假设和预测。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Democracy, dividends, and corporate valuation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the impact of institutional democracy on firm value through the lens of dividend policies. Raw markdown: bui-2025-democracy-dividends-and-corporate-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Bui, LT Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI:…
pages.text: Democracy, dividends, and corporate valuation (2025) Paper claim — We examine the impact of institutional democracy on firm value through the lens of dividend policies. Raw markdown: bui-2025-democracy-dividends-and-corporate-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Bui, LT Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2025.102879 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, legal protection)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, alternative) Abstract We examine the impact of institutional democracy on firm value through the lens of dividend policies. Using instrumental variables, we find strong evidence that democracy improves dividends in an international sample of 18,410 unique firms across 63 countries over the 1991-2018 period. This effect is more pronounced for firms with high agency costs, or those in countries with weak legal protection for shareholders. Our evidence is robust to alternative measures of democracy and a battery of tests addressing the challenges associated with the instruments. Furthermore, dividends are capitalized at a higher rate in more democratic countries, especially for firms with high growth options. To the extent that investors are willing to pay a premium for firms that distribute more dividends, the democracy-induced dividends add to corporate value beyond the premium associated with shareholder rights-induced dividends. Overall, our results highlight that institutional democracy is an important, yet unexplored, determinant of corporate valuation. 摘要（中文） 我们通过股利政策的视角考察制度性民主对企业价值的影响。使用工具变量，我们发现有力证据表明，在1991至2018年期间横跨63个国家的18410家独特企业的国际样本中，民主改善了股利。对于代理成本高的企业，或处于对股东法律保护薄弱国家的企业，这种效应更为显著。我们的证据对民主的替代度量以及一系列应对与工具相关挑战的检验都稳健。此外，股利在更民主的国家以更高的比率被资本化，尤其是对于成长期权高的企业。就投资者愿意为派发更多股利的企业支付溢价而言，民主诱发的股利在与股东权利诱发的股利相关的溢价之外，进一步增加了公司价值。总体而言，我们的结果凸显出制度性民主是公司估值的一个重要却尚未被探索的决定因素。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of technical defaults on dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines how loan covenant violations impact firm dividend policy. Raw markdown: bulan-2013-the-impact-of-technical-defaults-on-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bulan, L, Hull, T Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI:…
pages.text: The impact of technical defaults on dividend policy (2013) Paper claim — This paper examines how loan covenant violations impact firm dividend policy. Raw markdown: bulan-2013-the-impact-of-technical-defaults-on-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Bulan, L, Hull, T Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2012.10.014 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines how loan covenant violations impact firm dividend policy. Using contract-level loan data for nonfinancial firms in the US, this study provides evidence that the occurrence of a covenant violation significantly increases the likelihood of a dividend reduction in the subsequent quarter. Moreover, we show that the degree of creditor-shareholder conflict and firm financial constraints are important determinants of dividend cuts upon technical default. Additionally, this paper finds the tendency of dividend cuts upon technical default weakened after the repeal of the Glass-Steagall Act. These findings suggest that loan covenants serve a critical role in mitigating creditor-shareholder conflicts. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了贷款契约违约如何影响公司股利政策。使用美国非金融公司的合同层面贷款数据，本研究提供的证据表明，契约违约的发生显著增加了随后一个季度削减股利的可能性。此外，我们表明债权人-股东冲突的程度和公司融资约束是技术性违约时削减股利的重要决定因素。另外，本文发现技术性违约时削减股利的倾向在《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》废除后减弱了。这些发现表明贷款契约在缓解债权人-股东冲突中发挥着关键作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Equity-incentive compensation and payout policy in Europe
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the effects of executive compensation and investor protection on payout policy in Europe. Raw markdown: burns-2015-equity-incentive-compensation-and-payout-policy-in-europe Bibliographic Record Authors: Burns, N, McTier, BC, Minnick, K Journal: JOURNAL…
pages.text: Equity-incentive compensation and payout policy in Europe (2015) Paper claim — We examine the effects of executive compensation and investor protection on payout policy in Europe. Raw markdown: burns-2015-equity-incentive-compensation-and-payout-policy-in-europe Bibliographic Record Authors: Burns, N, McTier, BC, Minnick, K Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.10.019 Relevance score: 12.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow, substitut) Abstract We examine the effects of executive compensation and investor protection on payout policy in Europe. We find a negative (positive) relationship between both option and restricted stock compensation and dividends (repurchases). However, when the incentive compensation is dividend protected, dividend payouts increase. Firms in weak investor protection countries pay higher dividends consistent with maintaining a reputation for distributing excess free cash flows. However, growth firms in weak investor protection countries reduce dividends (increase repurchases) in relation to increases in equity-incentive compensation. Our results are consistent with growth firms in weak investor protection countries using equity incentives as a substitute for dividends to reduce agency costs. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察高管薪酬和投资者保护对欧洲支付政策的影响。我们发现，期权薪酬和限制性股票薪酬与股利（回购）之间存在负（正）相关关系。然而，当激励薪酬受到股利保护时，股利支付会增加。投资者保护薄弱国家的企业支付更高的股利，这与维护分配多余自由现金流的声誉相一致。然而，投资者保护薄弱国家的成长型企业，其股利减少（回购增加）与股权激励薪酬的增加相关。我们的结果与以下观点相一致：投资者保护薄弱国家的成长型企业使用股权激励作为股利的替代品，以降低代理成本。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Robustness and pricing with uncertain growth
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study how decision-makers' concerns about robustness affect prices and quantities in a stochastic growth model. Raw markdown: cagetti-2002-robustness-and-pricing-with-uncertain-growth Bibliographic Record Authors: Cagetti, M, Hansen, LP, Sargent, T, Williams, N…
pages.text: Robustness and pricing with uncertain growth (2002) Paper claim — We study how decision-makers' concerns about robustness affect prices and quantities in a stochastic growth model. Raw markdown: cagetti-2002-robustness-and-pricing-with-uncertain-growth Bibliographic Record Authors: Cagetti, M, Hansen, LP, Sargent, T, Williams, N Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/15.2.363 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal, trade-off) Abstract We study how decision-makers' concerns about robustness affect prices and quantities in a stochastic growth model. In the model economy, growth rates in technology are altered by infrequent large shocks and continuous small shocks. An investor observes movements in the technology level but cannot perfectly distinguish their sources. Instead the investor solves a signal extraction problem. We depart from most of the macroeconomics and finance literature by presuming that the investor treats the specification of technology evolution as an approximation. To promote a decision rule that is robust to model misspecification. an investor acts as if a malevolent player threatens to perturb the actual data-generating process relative to his approximating model. We study how a concern about robustness alters asset prices. We show that the dynamic evolution of the risk-return trade-off is dominated by movements in the growth-state probabilities and that the evolution of the dividend-price ratio is driven primarily by the capital-technology ratio. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了决策者对稳健性的关切如何在一个随机增长模型中影响价格和数量。在该模型经济中，技术增长率会受到不频繁的大冲击和连续的小冲击的改变。投资者观察到技术水平的变动，但无法完全区分其来源。相反，投资者需要求解一个信号提取问题。我们偏离了大多数宏观经济学和金融学文献，假设投资者将技术演变的设定视为一种近似。为促成一个对模型误设稳健的决策规则，投资者的行为如同一个恶意参与者威胁要相对于其近似模型扰动实际的数据生成过程。我们研究了对稳健性的关切如何改变资产价格。我们表明，风险收益权衡的动态演变主要由增长状态概率的变动所主导，而股利价格比的演变主要由资本技术比所驱动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了诱发风险厌恶的CEO薪酬是否促使管理者无论投资者偏好如何都派发更多股利。使用内部债务（即养老金和递延薪酬）以及CEO股权薪酬对股价变化的敏感性（即高CEO delta）作为CEO风险厌恶的代理变量，我们记录到内部债务促使CEO派发股利，而凸性的CEO薪酬则降低股利支付。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Tax-induced trading of equity securities: Evidence from the ADR market
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine ex-dividend date trading of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) using a sample of 1,043 dividends over the period 1988 to 1995. Raw markdown: callaghan-2003-tax-induced-trading-of-equity-securities-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Callaghan,…
pages.text: Tax-induced trading of equity securities: Evidence from the ADR market (2003) Paper claim — We examine ex-dividend date trading of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) using a sample of 1,043 dividends over the period 1988 to 1995. Raw markdown: callaghan-2003-tax-induced-trading-of-equity-securities-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Callaghan, SR, Barry, CB Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00578 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We examine ex-dividend date trading of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) using a sample of 1,043 dividends over the period 1988 to 1995. ADR dividends are often subject to foreign withholding taxes, creating incentives for certain investors to avoid the distribution. ADRs exhibit negative abnormal ex-dividend day returns, and their prices behave consistently with their related withholding taxes. Abnormal trading volume for taxable issues exceeds 130 percent and 300 percent of normal volume on the cum- and ex-dates, respectively. Abnormal volume is an increasing function of foreign withholding tax rates and decreasing function of transactions costs. This abnormal ex-date trading activity is consistent with tax-motivated trading. 摘要（中文） 我们使用1988年至1995年期间1,043个股利的样本，考察美国存托凭证（ADRs）的除息日交易。ADR股利往往需缴纳外国预提税，这为某些投资者创造了规避该分配的激励。ADR表现出为负的异常除息日收益，且其价格行为与其相关的预提税相一致。应税发行的异常交易量在除息前一日和除息日分别超过正常交易量的130%和300%。异常交易量是外国预提税率的增函数，是交易成本的减函数。这种异常的除息日交易活动与税收驱动的交易相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Accounting Conservatism and Performance Covenants: A Signaling Approach
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the relation between performance covenants in private debt contracting and conservative accounting under adverse selection. Raw markdown: callen-2016-accounting-conservatism-and-performance-covenants-a-signaling-approach Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Accounting Conservatism and Performance Covenants: A Signaling Approach (2016) Paper claim — This study examines the relation between performance covenants in private debt contracting and conservative accounting under adverse selection. Raw markdown: callen-2016-accounting-conservatism-and-performance-covenants-a-signaling-approach Bibliographic Record Authors: Callen, JL, Chen, F, Dou, YW, Xin, BH Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12208 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(alternative, information asymmetry, signal) Abstract This study examines the relation between performance covenants in private debt contracting and conservative accounting under adverse selection. We find that under severe adverse selection (i.e., high information asymmetry), accounting conservatism and performance covenants act as complements to signal that the borrower is unlikely to appropriate wealth from the lender. No such relation obtains in a low information asymmetry regime. We further show that in the high information asymmetry regime, borrowers with high levels of conservatism and tight performance covenants generally enjoy lower interest rate spreads than borrowers with low levels of conservatism and loose performance covenants. Consistent with our signaling theory, in the high information asymmetry regime, borrowers with high levels of conservatism and tight performance covenants are less likely to make abnormal payouts to shareholders. Our empirical results are robust to alternative measures of conservatism and covenant restrictiveness. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察私人债务契约中的业绩契约条款与逆向选择下的稳健会计（accounting conservatism）之间的关系。我们发现，在严重逆向选择（即高信息不对称）下，会计稳健性和业绩契约条款作为互补物，共同传递借款人不太可能从贷款人处攫取财富的信号。在低信息不对称机制下不存在这种关系。我们进一步表明，在高信息不对称机制下，具有高稳健性水平和紧缩业绩契约条款的借款人，通常比具有低稳健性水平和宽松业绩契约条款的借款人享有更低的利率利差。与我们的信号理论一致，在高信息不对称机制下，具有高稳健性水平和紧缩业绩契约条款的借款人不太可能向股东进行异常派现。我们的经验结果对稳健性和契约条款限制性的替代度量都稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: By force of habit: A consumption-based explanation of aggregate stock market behavior
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We present a consumption-based model that explains a wide variety of dynamic asset pricing phenomena, including the procyclical variation of stock prices, the long-horizon predictability of excess stock returns, and the countercyclical variation of stock market…
pages.text: By force of habit: A consumption-based explanation of aggregate stock market behavior (1999) Paper claim — We present a consumption-based model that explains a wide variety of dynamic asset pricing phenomena, including the procyclical variation of stock prices, the long-horizon predictability of excess stock returns, and the countercyclical variation of stock market volatility. Raw markdown: campbell-1999-by-force-of-habit-a-consumption-based-explanation Bibliographic Record Authors: Campbell, JY, Cochrane, JH Journal: JOURNAL OF POLITICAL ECONOMY Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1086/250059 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We present a consumption-based model that explains a wide variety of dynamic asset pricing phenomena, including the procyclical variation of stock prices, the long-horizon predictability of excess stock returns, and the countercyclical variation of stock market volatility. The model captures much of the history of stock prices from consumption data. It explains the short- and long-run equity premium puzzles despite a low and constant risk-free rate. The results are essentially the same whether we model stocks as a claim to the consumption stream or as a claim to volatile dividends poorly correlated with consumption. The model is driven by an independently and identically distributed consumption growth process and adds a slow-moving external habit to the standard power utility function. These features generate slow countercyclical variation in risk premia. The model posits a fundamentally novel description of risk premia: Investors fear stocks primarily because they do poorly in recessions unrelated to the risks of long-run average consumption growth. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一个基于消费的模型，该模型解释了各种各样的动态资产定价现象，包括股价的顺周期变动、超额股票收益的长期可预测性，以及股票市场波动率的逆周期变动。该模型从消费数据中捕捉到了股价历史的很大一部分。它在低而恒定的无风险利率下解释了短期和长期股权溢价难题。无论我们将股票建模为对消费流的索取权，还是建模为对与消费相关性差的波动性股利的索取权，结果基本相同。该模型由一个独立同分布的消费增长过程驱动，并在标准幂效用函数上添加了一个缓慢变动的外部习惯。这些特征产生了风险溢价缓慢的逆周期变动。该模型提出了一种从根本上新颖的风险溢价描述：投资者主要害怕股票，是因为它们在与长期平均消费增长风险无关的衰退中表现不佳。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Explaining the poor performance of consumption-based asset pricing models
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that the external habit-formation model economy of Campbell and Cochrane (1999) can explain why the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and its extensions are better approximate asset pricing models than is the standard consumption-based model. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Explaining the poor performance of consumption-based asset pricing models (2000) Paper claim — We show that the external habit-formation model economy of Campbell and Cochrane (1999) can explain why the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and its extensions are better approximate asset pricing models than is the standard consumption-based model. Raw markdown: campbell-2000-explaining-the-poor-performance-of-consumption-based-asset Bibliographic Record Authors: Campbell, JY, Cochrane, JH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00310 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We show that the external habit-formation model economy of Campbell and Cochrane (1999) can explain why the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and its extensions are better approximate asset pricing models than is the standard consumption-based model. The model economy produces time-varying expected returns, tracked by the dividend-price ratio. Portfolio-based models capture some of this variation in state variables, which a state-independent function of consumption cannot capture. Therefore, though the consumption-based model and CAPM are both perfect conditional asset pricing models, the portfolio-based models are better approximate unconditional asset pricing models. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，Campbell和Cochrane（1999）的外部习惯形成模型经济能够解释为何资本资产定价模型（CAPM）及其扩展比标准的基于消费的模型是更好的近似资产定价模型。该模型经济产生时变的预期收益，可由股利-价格比追踪。基于组合的模型捕捉到了状态变量中的部分此类变动，而消费的状态无关函数无法捕捉这一点。因此，尽管基于消费的模型和CAPM都是完美的条件资产定价模型，但基于组合的模型是更好的近似无条件资产定价模型。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Non-dividend protected executive options and dividend policy: Evidence from SFAS 123R
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how granting non-dividend protected executive options affects payout policy during the period 2001-2008. Raw markdown: canil-2017-non-dividend-protected-executive-options-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Canil, J Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Non-dividend protected executive options and dividend policy: Evidence from SFAS 123R (2017) Paper claim — We examine how granting non-dividend protected executive options affects payout policy during the period 2001-2008. Raw markdown: canil-2017-non-dividend-protected-executive-options-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Canil, J Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.03.003 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine how granting non-dividend protected executive options affects payout policy during the period 2001-2008. Using a difference-in-difference estimation along with the introduction of SFAS 123R, we find that firms with non-optioned executives increase dividends more than firms with optioned executives, post- versus pre-SFAS 123R. Our result questions whether non-dividend protected executive options are an impediment to paying dividends. Our result is robust pre-SFAS 123R dividends, consistent and inconsistent dividend payers and firms dropping options completely post-SFAS 123R, as well as controlling for endogeneity. Our evidence suggests that expensing of options has no effect on dividend policy. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察在2001-2008年期间授予非股利保护型高管期权如何影响支付政策。利用双重差分估计以及SFAS 123R的引入，我们发现，与拥有持有期权高管的公司相比，拥有非持有期权高管的公司在SFAS 123R实施后（相对于实施前）更多地增加了股利。我们的结果对非股利保护型高管期权是否构成派发股利的障碍提出了质疑。我们的结果对以下情形均稳健：SFAS 123R之前的股利、持续和非持续的股利支付者、以及在SFAS 123R之后完全放弃期权的公司，同时也控制了内生性。我们的证据表明，期权费用化对股利政策没有影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The value of dividend imputation tax credits in Australia (2004) Paper claim — A dividend imputation tax system provides shareholders with a credit (for corporate tax paid) that can be used to offset personal tax on dividend income. Raw markdown: cannavan-2004-the-value-of-dividend-imputation-tax-credits-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Cannavan, D, Finn, F, Gray, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2003.09.001 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract A dividend imputation tax system provides shareholders with a credit (for corporate tax paid) that can be used to offset personal tax on dividend income. This paper shows how to infer the value of imputation tax credits from the prices of derivative securities that are unique to Australian retail markets. We also test whether a tax law amendment that was designed to prevent the trading of imputation credits affected their economic value. Before the amendment, tax credits were worth up to 50% of face value in large, high-yielding companies, but Subsequently it is difficult to detect any value at all. (C) 2003 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 股利抵免税制向股东提供一种抵免（针对已缴纳的公司税），可用以抵减股利收入的个人税。本文展示了如何从澳大利亚零售市场特有的衍生证券价格中推断出抵免税额的价值。我们还检验了一项旨在阻止抵免税额交易的税法修正案是否影响了其经济价值。在修正案之前，在大型高收益率公司中，抵免税额的价值最高可达面值的50%，但此后则难以检测到任何价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Foreign Institutional Investors and Dividend Policy: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In China's QFII setting, foreign institutional investors self-select into high-dividend firms rather than actively promoting dividends post-investment; dividend changes predict subsequent foreign shareholding changes, but not vice versa, supporting the signaling…
pages.text: Foreign Institutional Investors and Dividend Policy: Evidence from China (2017) Paper claim — In China's QFII setting, foreign institutional investors self-select into high-dividend firms rather than actively promoting dividends post-investment; dividend changes predict subsequent foreign shareholding changes, but not vice versa, supporting the signaling over the monitoring interpretation. Raw markdown: cao-2017-foreign-institutional-investors-and-dividend-policy-evidence-from-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Cao, Lihong; Du, Yan; Hansen, Jens Ørding Journal: International Business Review Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.ibusrev.2017.02.001 Abstract This study examines whether foreign institutional investment influences firms' dividend policies. Using data from all domestically listed non-financial firms in China during the period of 2003–2013, we find that foreign shareholding influences dividend decisions and vice versa. Furthermore, changes in dividend payments over time positively affect subsequent changes in foreign shareholding, but the opposite is not true. Our study indicates that foreign institutional investors do not change firms' future dividend payments once they have made their investment choices in China. Moreover, they self-select into Chinese firms that pay high dividends. Our evidence suggests that in an institutional setting where foreign investors have tightly restricted access to local securities markets and a relatively high risk of expropriation by controlling shareholders exists, firms can use dividends to signal good investment opportunities to foreign investors. Key Findings Foreign institutional shareholding (QFII presence and proportion) is positively and significantly associated with both dividend levels and dividend-paying probability in cross-sectional Tobit and probit regressions. Simultaneous equation models (GMM) show foreign shareholding and dividends are jointly determined and mutually reinforcing: foreign shareholding promotes dividends, and higher dividends attract foreign investors. Change regressions reveal the direction of causation: changes in dividend payments significantly predict subsequent changes in foreign shareholding, while changes in foreign shareholding do not significantly predict subsequent dividend changes. Conclusion favors signaling over monitoring: QFIIs self-select into high-dividend firms due to restricted investment access and information disadvantages, rather than actively pressing incumbents to raise dividends after investing. Results are robust to alternative dividend measures (yield, payout ratio), alternative foreign ownership measures, and fixed-effect specifications. Linked Pages dividend-signaling international-evidence-on-dividends

pages.title: Soft activism and corporate dividend policy: Evidence from institutional investors site visits
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the governance effect of institutional site visits and focus on corporate payout. Raw markdown: cao-2022-soft-activism-and-corporate-dividend-policy-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Cao, J, Wang, HY, Zhou, SL Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE…
pages.text: Soft activism and corporate dividend policy: Evidence from institutional investors site visits (2022) Paper claim — We study the governance effect of institutional site visits and focus on corporate payout. Raw markdown: cao-2022-soft-activism-and-corporate-dividend-policy-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Cao, J, Wang, HY, Zhou, SL Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102221 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution, investor protection, policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout) Abstract We study the governance effect of institutional site visits and focus on corporate payout. Due to the weak investor protection and poor information quality in China, institutional investors resort to site visits as a form of soft activism. We show that site visits lead to an increase of corporate cash dividend, through the mechanism of disciplining management with exit threats. Such effect is more pronounced for visits by state-owned institutions. We further confirm the causal link with both difference-in-difference analysis and instrumental variable regression. The paper contributes to the research on soft activism and governance device of institutional investors in weak institutional environments. 摘要（中文） 我们研究机构实地调研的治理效应，并聚焦于企业支付。由于中国投资者保护薄弱、信息质量不佳，机构投资者诉诸实地调研作为一种柔性积极主义（soft activism）的形式。我们表明，实地调研通过以退出威胁约束管理层的机制，导致企业现金股利增加。这一效应对于国有机构的调研更为显著。我们进一步用双重差分分析和工具变量回归确认了这一因果联系。本文对薄弱制度环境下机构投资者的柔性积极主义和治理工具的研究做出了贡献。 Key Findings Firms with institutional site visits increase cash dividend payout ratio (DPS/EPS) by 1.4% in the subsequent year compared to firms without visits; a one-standard-deviation increase in site visit intensity leads to a 4.1% increase in the standard deviation of the payout ratio. The causal link is confirmed via propensity score matching with difference-in-differences (using the first-visit year as event year) and instrumental variable regression (distance between firm's and institutional visitor's headquarter city). The mechanism is disciplining management through credible exit threats: visiting institutional investors significantly increase equity sales when the visited firm underpays dividends relative to peers. State-owned institutional investors have a stronger dividend-inducing effect than non-state-owned institutions, attributed to their longer investment horizon and greater power. The governance effect of site visits does not significantly differ between SOE and non-SOE target firms, suggesting exit threat is effective in both ownership contexts. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.text: 人工智能技术应用与企业股利分配：影响与机制 (2026) Paper claim — AI technology adoption by Chinese listed firms significantly reduces both the probability and intensity of cash dividend distributions, operating through three channels: increased R&D investment, elevated risk-taking, and enhanced ESG performance. Raw markdown: cao-zhiming-2026-ai-technology-corporate-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Cao Zhiming (曹志明); Tan Chunfeng (谭春风); Wang Jianxin (王建新) Journal: 财经研究 (Collected Essays on Finance and Economics), Vol. 42, No. 4 Year: 2026 (April 2026) DOI: 10.13762/j.cnki.cjlc.20260224.003 Sample: A-share listed firms, China, 2013–2023; 25,164 firm-year observations Abstract 在数智时代，人工智能（AI）已成为企业转型升级、实现可持续发展的重要战略工具。基于2013—2023年A股上市公司的数据，实证检验了人工智能赋能应用对企业股利分配政策的影响及其机制。研究发现，人工智能赋能应用对企业股利发放的可能性和强度均有显著负向影响。机制分析表明，人工智能赋能应用通过增强研发投入、提高承担风险水平以及提升ESG绩效等三个方面抑制企业股利的分配。 English summary: Using data from A-share listed companies from 2013 to 2023, this study empirically tests the impact and mechanism of AI technology application on corporate dividend distribution policies. The research finds that the application of AI technology inhibits the probability and intensity of corporate dividend distribution. Mechanism analysis shows that AI technology inhibits dividend distribution through: strengthening R&D investment, improving risk-taking levels, and enhancing ESG performance. The inhibitory effect is more significant in small-scale enterprises, non-capital-intensive enterprises, and enterprises with low industry competition. Key Findings AI technology adoption (measured by ln(keyword frequency + 1) from annual reports) significantly reduces both dividend payout probability (Div1) and intensity (Div2) at 1% significance; the negative association holds after IV estimation (lagged AI disclosure), Heckman selection correction, and PSM. Three mechanism channels confirmed via mediation analysis (Bootstrap, 1000 replications, 95% CI excludes zero): AI → increased R&D intensity (RD) → lower dividends (H1a); AI → higher risk-taking (Risk) → lower dividends (H1b); AI → improved ESG performance → lower dividends (H1c). Heterogeneity by firm size: the inhibitory effect is significant only for small-scale enterprises; large firms show no significant effect, consistent with large firms having more stable cash flows and better access to external financing. Heterogeneity by capital intensity: the effect is concentrated in non-capital-intensive enterprises; capital-intensive firms' AI adoption may complement rather than crowd out dividends due to scale economies and stable asset bases. Heterogeneity by factor market development: AI inhibits dividend intensity (Div2) at both high and low levels of factor market development, but inhibits dividend probability (Div1) only when factor market development is high. Alternative AI proxies (AI_Invest: AI fixed asset investment intensity; AI_Adopt: fixed asset value / employee count above sector median) yield consistent results. Linked Pages financial-flexibility-and-payout dividend-payout-policy overview

pages.title: Does gender diversity on banks' boards matter? Evidence from public bailouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We are the first to examine the impact of gender diversity on banks' boards on the probability and size of public bailouts. Raw markdown: cardillo-2021-does-gender-diversity-on-banks-boards-matter-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Cardillo, G, Onali, E,…
pages.text: Does gender diversity on banks' boards matter? Evidence from public bailouts (2021) Paper claim — We are the first to examine the impact of gender diversity on banks' boards on the probability and size of public bailouts. Raw markdown: cardillo-2021-does-gender-diversity-on-banks-boards-matter-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Cardillo, G, Onali, E, Torluccio, G Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101560 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, monitor, reform, standard)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We are the first to examine the impact of gender diversity on banks' boards on the probability and size of public bailouts. Our findings, based on a sample of listed European banks over the period 2005-2017, suggest that banks with more gender-diverse boards are less likely to receive a public bailout and receive a lower amount of bailout funds as a percentage of total assets than banks with less gender-diverse boards. Specifically, an increase by one standard deviation in gender diversity decreases the probability of a bailout by at least 2.44%, a significant reduction considering that the unconditional probability is 18.7%. Gender diversity is also positively related to bank performance, as proxied by ROA and Tobin's Q and with dividend payout ratios, consistent with the hypothesis that female directors are better monitors than male directors. These results are robust to a variety of econometric approaches and provide support for recent reforms in several EU countries regarding gender quotas. 摘要（中文） 我们首次考察银行董事会性别多元化对公开救助的概率和规模的影响。基于2005—2017年间上市欧洲银行样本的发现表明，董事会性别更多元的银行比性别多元程度较低的银行更不可能接受公开救助，且接受的救助资金占总资产的比例更低。具体而言，性别多元化每增加一个标准差，救助概率至少降低2.44%，考虑到无条件概率为18.7%，这是一个显著的降幅。性别多元化还与银行业绩（以净资产收益率ROA和托宾q为代理变量）以及股利支付率正相关，这与女性董事比男性董事是更好的监督者这一假说相一致。这些结果对各种计量经济学方法都是稳健的，并为若干欧盟国家近来关于性别配额的改革提供了支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The coupling of ownership and control and the allocation of financial resources: Evidence from Hong Kong
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Theoretical and empirical research regarding the impact of corporate ownership on the behaviour and performance of firms have typically focused on consequences stemming from the separation of ownership and control. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The coupling of ownership and control and the allocation of financial resources: Evidence from Hong Kong (2002) Paper claim — Theoretical and empirical research regarding the impact of corporate ownership on the behaviour and performance of firms have typically focused on consequences stemming from the separation of ownership and control. Raw markdown: carney-2002-the-coupling-of-ownership-and-control-and-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Carney, M, Gedajlovic, E Journal: JOURNAL OF MANAGEMENT STUDIES Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1111/1467-6486.00285 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Theoretical and empirical research regarding the impact of corporate ownership on the behaviour and performance of firms have typically focused on consequences stemming from the separation of ownership and control. While large scale business enterprise characterized by such a separation is dominant in the US, Japan and the UK, firms in which ownership and control is coupled in the hands of individuals and their families are apparent in many other large developed economies and are dominant in most emerging markets. This paper examines consequences regarding the generation and allocation of financial resources stemming from the coupling of ownership and control among Hong Kong based firms. In doing so, we join insights from the economics literature regarding the incentive and risk bearing consequences of coupled ownership and control with the extant management, sociology and history literatures regarding Chinese family business groups and develop and six hypotheses pertaining to patterns in the allocation of financial resources. Results indicate that coupled ownership and control is positively related with dividend payout levels and financial liquidity while it is negatively related to investments in capital expenditures. Consistent with these results, we also find that coupled ownership and control is positively related to short-term (accounting) profitability. 摘要（中文） 关于公司所有权对公司行为和绩效影响的理论与实证研究，通常聚焦于所有权与控制权分离所产生的后果。虽然以这种分离为特征的大规模企业在美国、日本和英国占主导地位，但在许多其他大型发达经济体中，所有权与控制权集于个人及其家族之手的公司也很常见，并且在大多数新兴市场中占据主导地位。本文考察香港公司中所有权与控制权耦合所产生的、关于财务资源生成与配置的后果。在此过程中，我们将经济学文献中关于所有权与控制权耦合的激励和风险承担后果的见解，与现有关于华人家族企业集团的管理学、社会学和历史学文献相结合，并提出六个关于财务资源配置模式的假设。结果表明，所有权与控制权耦合与股利派现水平和财务流动性正相关，而与资本支出投资负相关。与这些结果相一致，我们还发现所有权与控制权耦合与短期（会计）盈利能力正相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Mutual holding companies: Evidence of conflicts of interest through disparate dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The mutual holding company (MHC) structure establishes a dual-class stock that creates a unique opportunity to transfer wealth from thrift depositor-owners to new minority shareholders through the disparate payment of dividends. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Mutual holding companies: Evidence of conflicts of interest through disparate dividends (2004) Paper claim — The mutual holding company (MHC) structure establishes a dual-class stock that creates a unique opportunity to transfer wealth from thrift depositor-owners to new minority shareholders through the disparate payment of dividends. Raw markdown: carow-2004-mutual-holding-companies-evidence-of-conflicts-of-interest Bibliographic Record Authors: Carow, KA, Cox, SR, Roden, DM Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2003.06.001 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, supervis)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The mutual holding company (MHC) structure establishes a dual-class stock that creates a unique opportunity to transfer wealth from thrift depositor-owners to new minority shareholders through the disparate payment of dividends. We show that MHCs are priced higher than comparable non-MHCs and dividend policy is a significant component of this valuation. We also show that MHC thrifts pay significantly higher dividends than non-MHC thrifts and that an Office of Thrift Supervision (OTS) ruling reducing the potential for disparate dividends between the two classes of shareholders resulted in lower dividends. These results have policy implications of special significance given that the OTS reversed its position in 2000 and because of the current controversy over the use of the MHC structure in the financial service industry. (C) 2003 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 互助控股公司（MHC）结构设立了一种双重股权类别，这创造了一个独特的机会，可以通过差别化的股利支付将财富从储蓄机构的存款人—所有者转移给新的少数股东。我们表明，MHC的定价高于可比的非MHC，且股利政策是这一估值的一个重要组成部分。我们还表明，MHC储蓄机构支付的股利显著高于非MHC储蓄机构，并且储蓄机构监理局（OTS）一项旨在降低两类股东之间出现差别化股利可能性的裁定导致了股利下降。鉴于OTS在2000年逆转了其立场，以及当前围绕金融服务业中使用MHC结构的争议，这些结果具有特别重要的政策意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Policy at Firms Accused of Accounting Fraud
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent studies and some policy experts have posited that dividends indicate higher-quality earnings. Raw markdown: caskey-2013-dividend-policy-at-firms-accused-of-accounting-fraud Bibliographic Record Authors: Caskey, J, Hanlon, M Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING…
pages.text: Dividend Policy at Firms Accused of Accounting Fraud (2013) Paper claim — Recent studies and some policy experts have posited that dividends indicate higher-quality earnings. Raw markdown: caskey-2013-dividend-policy-at-firms-accused-of-accounting-fraud Bibliographic Record Authors: Caskey, J, Hanlon, M Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1111/j.1911-3846.2012.01173.x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Recent studies and some policy experts have posited that dividends indicate higher-quality earnings. In this study, we test this conjecture by comparing the dividend policies of firms accused of accounting fraud to those of firms not accused of accounting fraud. Specifically, we examine whether alleged fraud firms are as likely to be dividend payers as non-fraud firms, and whether managers of dividend-paying fraud firms increase dividends at the same rate as managers of non-fraud firms. Our data reveal that dividend paying status is negatively associated with the probability of committing accounting fraud. In addition, we also find that, during the alleged fraud period, the earnings-dividends relation is weaker for the alleged fraud firms relative to firms not accused of fraud. Finally, using propensity score match tests, the data provide evidence that managers of alleged fraud firms increase dividends less often than managers of firms not accused of fraud, consistent with the alleged fraud firms not being able to match the dividend policies of firms not accused of fraud. Overall, our results suggest that dividends, especially dividend increases, are associated with higher earnings quality. 摘要（中文） 近期的研究和一些政策专家认为，股利表明更高质量的盈利。在本研究中，我们通过比较被指控会计舞弊的企业与未被指控会计舞弊的企业的股利政策，来检验这一推测。具体而言，我们考察被指控舞弊的企业是否与非舞弊企业一样有可能成为股利派发者，以及派息舞弊企业的管理者是否以与非舞弊企业管理者相同的速度提高股利。我们的数据显示，派息状态与实施会计舞弊的概率负相关。此外，我们还发现，在被指控舞弊期间，相对于未被指控舞弊的企业，被指控舞弊企业的盈利—股利关系更弱。最后，使用倾向得分匹配检验，数据提供证据表明被指控舞弊企业的管理者比未被指控舞弊企业的管理者更少地提高股利，这与被指控舞弊企业无法匹配未被指控舞弊企业的股利政策相一致。总体而言，我们的结果表明股利、尤其是股利增长，与更高的盈利质量相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Policy at Firms Accused of Accounting Fraud
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Dividend-paying firms are significantly less likely to commit accounting fraud; among fraud firms that do pay dividends, managers are 11–17 percentage points less likely to increase dividends than comparable non-fraud firms, consistent with fraudulent earnings…
pages.text: Dividend Policy at Firms Accused of Accounting Fraud (2013) Paper claim — Dividend-paying firms are significantly less likely to commit accounting fraud; among fraud firms that do pay dividends, managers are 11–17 percentage points less likely to increase dividends than comparable non-fraud firms, consistent with fraudulent earnings being unable to sustain the expected dividend-earnings relation. Raw markdown: caskey-hanlon-2013-dividend-policy-at-firms-accused-of-accounting-fraud Bibliographic Record Authors: Caskey, Judson; Hanlon, Michelle Journal: Contemporary Accounting Research Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1111/j.1911-3846.2012.01173.x Abstract Recent studies and some policy experts have posited that dividends indicate higher-quality earnings. In this study, we test this conjecture by comparing the dividend policies of firms accused of accounting fraud to those of firms not accused of accounting fraud. Specifically, we examine whether alleged fraud firms are as likely to be dividend payers as non-fraud firms, and whether managers of dividend-paying fraud firms increase dividends at the same rate as managers of non-fraud firms. Our data reveal that dividend paying status is negatively associated with the probability of committing accounting fraud. In addition, we also find that, during the alleged fraud period, the earnings-dividends relation is weaker for the alleged fraud firms relative to firms not accused of fraud. Finally, using propensity score match tests, the data provide evidence that managers of alleged fraud firms increase dividends less often than managers of firms not accused of fraud, consistent with the alleged fraud firms not being able to match the dividend policies of firms not accused of fraud. Overall, our results suggest that dividends, especially dividend increases, are associated with higher earnings quality. Key Findings Dividend-paying status is negatively associated with the probability of committing accounting fraud (SEC AAER): being a dividend payer reduces the likelihood of fraud on average. During the alleged fraud period, the Lintner/Fama-Babiak earnings-dividends relation is significantly weaker for AAER firms than for matched non-AAER firms in years of earnings increases, consistent with fraudulent earnings not supporting standard dividend increases. Propensity score tests show managers of dividend-paying fraud firms are 11–17 percentage points less likely to increase dividends compared to managers of non-fraud firms. AAER firms have lower share repurchases in the year prior to fraud but show no significant difference in repurchase changes during the fraud period. 72 dividend-paying AAER firms paid over $19.9 billion in dividends while perpetrating fraud, demonstrating dividends do not guarantee against fraud but constrain it on average. Linked Pages dividend-signaling earnings-quality

pages.title: Governance and post-repurchase performance
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Payout policies based on share repurchase programs provide greater flexibility than do those based on cash dividends. Raw markdown: caton-2016-governance-and-post-repurchase-performance Bibliographic Record Authors: Caton, GL, Goh, J, Lee, YT, Linn, SC Journal:…
pages.text: Governance and post-repurchase performance (2016) Paper claim — Payout policies based on share repurchase programs provide greater flexibility than do those based on cash dividends. Raw markdown: caton-2016-governance-and-post-repurchase-performance Bibliographic Record Authors: Caton, GL, Goh, J, Lee, YT, Linn, SC Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.02.005 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract Payout policies based on share repurchase programs provide greater flexibility than do those based on cash dividends. We develop and test an empirical model in which strongly governed companies outperform weakly governed companies after announcing share repurchase programs. Our findings include positive associations between strong governance and both post announcement adjusted operating performance and abnormal stock returns. The results are robust to sample selection bias, different sample criteria, governance measurement, and various control variables. In addition, governance strength is associated with larger post-announcement changes in CEO incentive compensation and merger and acquisition activity, both of which we argue are consistent with strongly governed companies using the financial flexibility derived from choosing share repurchases over cash dividends to drive better performance. Consistent with current literature on attenuation of former anomalies, the associations we find between governance and post-announcement performance tend to disappear in the latter half of our sample period. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 基于股份回购计划的支付政策比基于现金股利的支付政策提供更大的灵活性。我们建立并检验了一个实证模型，其中治理强的公司在宣布股份回购计划之后表现优于治理弱的公司。我们的发现包括：治理强度与公告后经调整的经营业绩以及异常股票回报之间均存在正相关关系。这些结果对样本选择偏误、不同的样本标准、治理度量和各种控制变量都是稳健的。此外，治理强度与公告后首席执行官激励薪酬以及并购活动的较大变化相关，我们认为这两者都与以下观点相一致：治理强的公司利用选择股份回购而非现金股利所带来的财务灵活性来驱动更好的业绩。与当前关于既往异象减弱的文献相一致，我们发现治理与公告后业绩之间的关联在我们样本期的后半段趋于消失。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Local peer influence on dividend payout decisions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a large sample of US -listed firms, we examine how firms' dividend payout decisions are influenced by the dividend policies of their local peers. Raw markdown: cave-2024-local-peer-influence-on-dividend-payout-decisions Bibliographic Record Authors: Cave, J,…
pages.text: Local peer influence on dividend payout decisions (2024) Paper claim — Using a large sample of US -listed firms, we examine how firms' dividend payout decisions are influenced by the dividend policies of their local peers. Raw markdown: cave-2024-local-peer-influence-on-dividend-payout-decisions Bibliographic Record Authors: Cave, J, Lancheros, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107206 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Using a large sample of US -listed firms, we examine how firms' dividend payout decisions are influenced by the dividend policies of their local peers. We find that the decisions to increase and decrease dividends are both influenced by the payout choices of firms headquartered in the same locality. We show that local peer effects are driven by the desire to compete for local dividend clineteles, with local peer effects proving more pronounced in geographies with greater retail investors clienteles, institutional -tax clienteles, and agency -cost clienteles. In contrast to dividends, share repurchases are not influenced by local peer repurchase decisions. Our findings prove robust to various sampling methods, peer portfolios, model specifications, and estimation techniques. 摘要（中文） 使用美国上市企业的大样本，我们考察企业的股利支付决策如何受其本地同行股利政策的影响。我们发现，增加和减少股利的决策都受到总部位于同一地区的企业支付选择的影响。我们表明，本地同行效应是由竞争本地股利群体的愿望所驱动的，在拥有更多散户投资者群体、机构-税收群体和代理成本群体的地区，本地同行效应更为显著。与股利相反，股份回购不受本地同行回购决策的影响。我们的发现对各种抽样方法、同行组合、模型设定和估计技术都是稳健的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
