pages.title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Corporate Dividend Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article shows that, for major equity markets, the proportion of index values attributable to the first 5 years of dividends dropped substantially in the first quarter of 2020 and that this drop was not reversed by the end of the year. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Corporate Dividend Policy (2021) Paper claim — This article shows that, for major equity markets, the proportion of index values attributable to the first 5 years of dividends dropped substantially in the first quarter of 2020 and that this drop was not reversed by the end of the year. Raw markdown: cejnek-2021-the-covid-19-pandemic-and-corporate-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Cejnek, G, Randl, O, Zechner, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109021000533 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This article shows that, for major equity markets, the proportion of index values attributable to the first 5 years of dividends dropped substantially in the first quarter of 2020 and that this drop was not reversed by the end of the year. In the cross section, this breakdown of dividend smoothing due to COVID-19 was less severe for firms with higher operating cash flows and more positively coskewed stock returns, and it was more pronounced for those with higher leverage and in the financial sector. Heavy dividend cutters also experienced a substantial increase in exposure to systematic risk. 摘要（中文） 本文表明，对于主要股票市场而言，可归因于前五年股利的指数价值比例在2020年第一季度大幅下降，且这一下降到年底仍未被扭转。在横截面上，这种由COVID-19导致的股利平滑瓦解，对于经营现金流较高、股票收益正共偏度（coskewed）更高的公司而言不那么严重，而对于杠杆较高以及处于金融行业的公司而言更为显著。大幅削减股利者还经历了系统性风险暴露的大幅增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Reaction of Stock Returns to News About Fundamentals
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In good times, stock prices react negatively to good news and positively to bad news, whereas in bad times, they react positively to good news and negatively to bad news. Raw markdown: cenesizoglu-2015-the-reaction-of-stock-returns-to-news-about Bibliographic…
pages.text: The Reaction of Stock Returns to News About Fundamentals (2015) Paper claim — In good times, stock prices react negatively to good news and positively to bad news, whereas in bad times, they react positively to good news and negatively to bad news. Raw markdown: cenesizoglu-2015-the-reaction-of-stock-returns-to-news-about Bibliographic Record Authors: Cenesizoglu, T Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2013.1859 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract In good times, stock prices react negatively to good news and positively to bad news, whereas in bad times, they react positively to good news and negatively to bad news. To account for this stylized fact, we consider an asset pricing model where the dividend growth rate switches between different values depending on the underlying state of the economy. Investors never observe the true dividend growth rate, but learn about it through not only its realizations but also external signals such as macroeconomic indicators. Under plausible assumptions, the differing precision of external signals across different states of the economy can change the sign of the market reaction to news from external signals in good and bad times. 摘要（中文） 在好时期，股价对好消息反应为负、对坏消息反应为正，而在坏时期，股价对好消息反应为正、对坏消息反应为负。为解释这一典型化事实，我们考虑一个资产定价模型，其中股利增长率根据经济的潜在状态在不同数值之间切换。投资者从不观察到真实的股利增长率，而是不仅通过其实现值，还通过诸如宏观经济指标之类的外部信号来了解它。在合理假设下，外部信号在不同经济状态下精度的差异可以改变市场在好时期和坏时期对来自外部信号的消息反应的符号。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Collateral constraints and asset prices
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the effects of collateral constraints in an economy populated by investors with nonpledgeable labor incomes and heterogeneous preferences and beliefs. Raw markdown: chabakauri-2020-collateral-constraints-and-asset-prices Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Collateral constraints and asset prices (2020) Paper claim — We study the effects of collateral constraints in an economy populated by investors with nonpledgeable labor incomes and heterogeneous preferences and beliefs. Raw markdown: chabakauri-2020-collateral-constraints-and-asset-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Chabakauri, G, Han, BY Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.06.012 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We study the effects of collateral constraints in an economy populated by investors with nonpledgeable labor incomes and heterogeneous preferences and beliefs. We show that these constraints inflate stock prices and generate spikes and crashes in price-dividend ratios and volatilities, clustering of volatilities, and leverage cycles. They also lead to substantial decreases in interest rates and increases in Sharpe ratios when investors are anxious about hitting constraints due to production crises in the economy. Furthermore, stock prices have large collateral premiums over nonpledgeable incomes. We derive asset prices and stationary distributions of the investors' consumption shares in closed form. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们在一个由具有不可质押劳动收入以及异质偏好和信念的投资者所构成的经济体中，研究抵押约束的效应。我们表明，这些约束会抬高股票价格，并在价格—股利比率和波动性中产生骤升与骤降、波动性的聚集以及杠杆周期。当投资者因经济体中的生产危机而对触及约束感到焦虑时，这些约束还会导致利率大幅下降和夏普比率大幅上升。此外，相对于不可质押收入，股票价格具有较大的抵押溢价。我们以闭式解推导出资产价格以及投资者消费份额的平稳分布。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How corporate governance affects payout policy under agency problems and external financing constraints
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper analyzes the effect of corporate governance on the payout policy when a firm has both agency problems and external financing constraints. Raw markdown: chae-2009-how-corporate-governance-affects-payout-policy-under-agency Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: How corporate governance affects payout policy under agency problems and external financing constraints (2009) Paper claim — This paper analyzes the effect of corporate governance on the payout policy when a firm has both agency problems and external financing constraints. Raw markdown: chae-2009-how-corporate-governance-affects-payout-policy-under-agency Bibliographic Record Authors: Chae, J, Kim, S, Lee, EJ Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2009.05.003 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(payout)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract This paper analyzes the effect of corporate governance on the payout policy when a firm has both agency problems and external financing constraints. We empirically test whether strong corporate governance would lead to higher payout to minimize agency problems (outcome hypothesis), or to lower payout to avoid costly external financing (substitute hypothesis). We find that firms with higher (lower) external financing constraints tend to decrease (increase) payout ratio with an improvement in their corporate governance. The results are consistent with our hypothesis that the relation between payout and corporate governance is reversed depending on the relative sizes of agency and external financing costs. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文分析当企业同时存在代理问题和外部融资约束时，公司治理对支付政策的影响。我们实证检验强公司治理会导致更高的支付以使代理问题最小化（结果假说），还是导致更低的支付以避免代价高昂的外部融资（替代假说）。我们发现，外部融资约束较高（较低）的企业倾向于随着其公司治理的改善而降低（提高）支付率。这些结果与我们的假设一致，即支付与公司治理之间的关系会依据代理成本与外部融资成本相对大小的不同而反转。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do managers time the market? Evidence from open-market share repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A contentious debate exists over whether executives possess market timing skills when announcing certain corporate transactions. Raw markdown: chan-2007-do-managers-time-the-market-evidence-from-open Bibliographic Record Authors: Chan, K, Ikenberry, DL, Lee, I…
pages.text: Do managers time the market? Evidence from open-market share repurchases (2007) Paper claim — A contentious debate exists over whether executives possess market timing skills when announcing certain corporate transactions. Raw markdown: chan-2007-do-managers-time-the-market-evidence-from-open Bibliographic Record Authors: Chan, K, Ikenberry, DL, Lee, I Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2006.09.017 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(buyback, share repurchase)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract A contentious debate exists over whether executives possess market timing skills when announcing certain corporate transactions. Pseudo-market timing, however, has recently emerged as an important alternative hypothesis as to why the appearance of timing might be evident when, in fact, none exists. We reconsider this debate in the context of share repurchases. Consistent with prior studies, we also report evidence of abnormal stock performance following buyback announcements. Pseudo-market timing, however, does not appear to be a viable explanation. Our results are more consistent with the notion that managers possess timing ability, at least in the context of share repurchases. (c) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 关于高管在宣布某些公司交易时是否具备市场择时技能，存在一场有争议的辩论。然而，伪市场择时（pseudo-market timing）最近作为一个重要的替代假说浮现出来，用以解释为什么在实际上并不存在择时的情况下，择时的表象却可能显现。我们在股份回购的背景下重新审视这一辩论。与先前研究相一致，我们也报告了在回购公告后出现异常股票表现的证据。然而，伪市场择时似乎并非一个可行的解释。我们的结果更符合管理者具备择时能力的观点，至少在股份回购的背景下是如此。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Share repurchases as a potential tool to mislead investors
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A rich literature argues that stock repurchases often serve as positive economic signals beneficial to investors. Raw markdown: chan-2010-share-repurchases-as-a-potential-tool-to-mislead Bibliographic Record Authors: Chan, KN, Ikenberry, DL, Lee, I, Wang, YZ…
pages.text: Share repurchases as a potential tool to mislead investors (2010) Paper claim — A rich literature argues that stock repurchases often serve as positive economic signals beneficial to investors. Raw markdown: chan-2010-share-repurchases-as-a-potential-tool-to-mislead Bibliographic Record Authors: Chan, KN, Ikenberry, DL, Lee, I, Wang, YZ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2009.10.003 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(buyback, share repurchase, stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract A rich literature argues that stock repurchases often serve as positive economic signals beneficial to investors. Yet due to their inherent flexibility, open-market repurchase programs have long been criticized as weak signals lacking commitment. We evaluate whether some managers potentially use buyback announcements to mislead investors. We focus on cases where managers were seemingly under heavy pressure to boost stock prices and might have announced a repurchase only to convey a false signal. For suspect cases, the immediate market reaction to a buyback announcement does not differ from that generally observed. However over longer horizons, suspect firms do not enjoy the improvement in economic performance otherwise observed. Suspect firms repurchase less stock. Further, managers in suspect firms have comparatively higher exposure to stock options, a potentially endogenous result suggesting greater sensitivity to both stock valuation and to future equity dilution. Overall, the results suggest only a limited number of managers may have used buybacks in a misleading way as "cheap talk." Yet as theory also suggests, we find no long-run economic benefit to this behavior. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 丰富的文献认为，股票回购常常充当有益于投资者的积极经济信号。然而，由于其固有的灵活性，公开市场回购计划长期以来一直被批评为缺乏承诺的弱信号。我们评估某些管理者是否可能利用回购公告来误导投资者。我们聚焦于管理者似乎承受着推高股价的巨大压力、并可能仅为传递虚假信号而宣布回购的情形。对于可疑情形，回购公告的即时市场反应与通常观察到的没有差异。然而在较长期限内，可疑企业并未享有原本观察到的经济绩效改善。可疑企业回购的股票较少。此外，可疑企业的管理者拥有相对更高的股票期权敞口，这是一个可能内生的结果，表明其对股票估值和未来股权稀释都更为敏感。总体而言，结果表明只有数量有限的管理者可能以误导性方式将回购用作“廉价谈话”（cheap talk）。然而，正如理论所暗示的那样，我们发现这种行为没有长期经济益处。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Unintended Benefits of Mandatory Dividend Regulations on Investment Efficiency: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — China's 2006 mandatory dividend payout regulation produced an unintended benefit beyond investor protection: constraining free cash flows reduced overinvestment, particularly in SOEs, while the refinancing nexus amplified this effect for firms that sought public…
pages.text: Unintended Benefits of Mandatory Dividend Regulations on Investment Efficiency: Evidence from China (2022) Paper claim — China's 2006 mandatory dividend payout regulation produced an unintended benefit beyond investor protection: constraining free cash flows reduced overinvestment, particularly in SOEs, while the refinancing nexus amplified this effect for firms that sought public capital. Raw markdown: chan-2022-unintended-benefits-of-mandatory-dividend-regulations-on-investment-ef Bibliographic Record Authors: Chan, Raymond Siu Yeung; Fan, Lyu; Song, Byron Y. Journal: Accounting and Finance Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1111/acfi.12829 Abstract We investigate the unintended benefits of mandatory dividend payout regulations for Chinese listed firms seeking refinancing to enhance their investment efficiency, even though the initial intention of these regulations is to protect powerless external minority shareholders. We find that, while these regulations mitigate the overinvestment of all listed firms, this effect is more pronounced among refinancing firms than among non-refinancing firms. We further find evidence partially showing that the mitigating effect of these regulations on overinvestment is driven mainly by state-owned enterprises (SOEs). These findings suggest dividend payout regulations are used to partially ameliorate Chinese listed firms' investment inefficiency, particularly those of SOEs. Key Findings Since the 2006 CSRC regulation linking refinancing eligibility to cumulative dividend payout (minimum 20% of net profit over three years), cash dividend distributions mitigate overinvestment across all listed Chinese firms, and the effect is more pronounced for refinancing firms than non-refinancing firms. The overinvestment-mitigating effect is driven primarily by SOEs; the effect on non-SOEs is only minor, consistent with SOEs facing softer budget constraints and having greater propensity for empire-building. No significant effect of the regulation on underinvestment, suggesting the regulation is not excessively restrictive for firms with genuine investment needs. Similar results obtained for the 2008 regulation (minimum payout ratio raised to 30%, cash-only requirement). Identification strategy combines lagged dividends in regression models, propensity score matching with difference-in-differences, and three-way interaction tests around the regulatory change. pages.title: PAYOUT POLICY, CAPITAL STRUCTURE, AND COMPENSATION CONTRACTS WHEN MANAGERS VALUE CONTROL
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The optimal contract between managers and investors is endogenously derived when managers have preferences for both monetary compensation and corporate resources under their control. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: PAYOUT POLICY, CAPITAL STRUCTURE, AND COMPENSATION CONTRACTS WHEN MANAGERS VALUE CONTROL (1993) Paper claim — The optimal contract between managers and investors is endogenously derived when managers have preferences for both monetary compensation and corporate resources under their control. Raw markdown: chang-1993-payout-policy-capital-structure-and-compensation-contracts-when Bibliographic Record Authors: CHANG, C Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1993 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/6.4.911 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(payout) Abstract The optimal contract between managers and investors is endogenously derived when managers have preferences for both monetary compensation and corporate resources under their control. When the optimal payout is privately known to managers, they can be induced to make payouts by linking their compensation to the payout. Public equity is a claim on this discretionary payout. If investors can obtain new information about the firm's optimal payout level, it can be utilized by transferring the control from management to investors. The new information allows the firm to achieve a more efficient allocation through recontracting. We show that the new information will be obtained if and only if the payout falls below a promised level. 摘要（中文） 当管理者对货币薪酬和其所掌控的公司资源都有偏好时，管理者与投资者之间的最优合约被内生地推导出来。当最优派现水平仅为管理者私下所知时，可以通过将其薪酬与派现挂钩来诱使他们进行派现。公众股权是对这种自由裁量派现的一项索取权。如果投资者能够获得关于企业最优派现水平的新信息，就可以通过将控制权从管理层转移到投资者手中来加以利用。新信息使企业能够通过重新缔约实现更有效率的配置。我们表明，当且仅当派现低于承诺水平时，才会获得新信息。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Ex-Day Returns of Stock Distributions: An Anchoring Explanation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We offer a new anchoring explanation for the ex-day abnormal returns of stock distributions, including stock dividend distributions, splits, and reverse splits. Raw markdown: chang-2019-ex-day-returns-of-stock-distributions-an-anchoring Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Ex-Day Returns of Stock Distributions: An Anchoring Explanation (2019) Paper claim — We offer a new anchoring explanation for the ex-day abnormal returns of stock distributions, including stock dividend distributions, splits, and reverse splits. Raw markdown: chang-2019-ex-day-returns-of-stock-distributions-an-anchoring Bibliographic Record Authors: Chang, EC, Lin, TC, Luo, Y, Ren, JJ Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2017.2843 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We offer a new anchoring explanation for the ex-day abnormal returns of stock distributions, including stock dividend distributions, splits, and reverse splits. We propose that investors tend to anchor on cum-day prices in valuating ex-distribution stocks, resulting in a positive association between ex-day returns and adjustment factors. We find that this positive return-factor relation exists for all three types of stock distributions and in both the pre- and post-decimalization periods. Furthermore, we find that this positive return-factor relation is more pronounced among events that are more subject to investors' anchoring propensity, featured by less investor attention, greater arbitrage difficulty, greater valuation uncertainty, less investor sophistication, and higher market sentiment. Last, using brokerage account data, we show that stocks that are traded by investors with more investment experience demonstrate a weaker return-factor relation. 摘要（中文） 我们为股票分配（包括股票股利分配、拆股和反向拆股）的除权日异常收益提供了一种全新的锚定解释。我们提出，投资者在对除权股票估值时往往锚定于除权前一日的价格，从而导致除权日收益与调整因子之间存在正向关联。我们发现，这种正向的收益—因子关系存在于所有三种类型的股票分配中，并且在十进制化之前和之后的时期均存在。此外，我们发现，这种正向的收益—因子关系在那些更易受投资者锚定倾向影响的事件中更为明显，这些事件的特征是投资者关注度较低、套利难度较大、估值不确定性较大、投资者老练程度较低以及市场情绪较高。最后，利用经纪账户数据，我们表明，由投资经验更丰富的投资者交易的股票表现出更弱的收益—因子关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Climate risk and payout flexibility around the world
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a large sample of firms from 45 countries, we find that firms in countries with high-climate risk reduce their cash dividends but increasingly use share repurchases to make payouts. Raw markdown: chang-2024-climate-risk-and-payout-flexibility-around-the-world…
pages.text: Climate risk and payout flexibility around the world (2024) Paper claim — Using a large sample of firms from 45 countries, we find that firms in countries with high-climate risk reduce their cash dividends but increasingly use share repurchases to make payouts. Raw markdown: chang-2024-climate-risk-and-payout-flexibility-around-the-world Bibliographic Record Authors: Chang, YY, He, W, Mi, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107233 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract Using a large sample of firms from 45 countries, we find that firms in countries with high-climate risk reduce their cash dividends but increasingly use share repurchases to make payouts. The evidence suggests that firms substitute dividends with repurchases to increase their payout flexibility in response to heightened climate risk. Operating volatility and financial constraints are two channels through which climate risk affects firms' payout flexibility. Further analysis shows that the effect of climate risk on payout flexibility is more pronounced for firms that are more vulnerable to climate risk, and in countries where people are more concerned about climate risk and the national culture emphasizes uncertainty avoidance and long-term orientation. 摘要（中文） 使用来自45个国家的大样本企业，我们发现，位于气候风险高的国家的企业会减少其现金股利，但越来越多地使用股份回购来进行支付。证据表明，企业用回购替代股利，以在气候风险加剧时提高其支付灵活性。经营波动性和财务约束是气候风险影响企业支付灵活性的两个渠道。进一步分析表明，气候风险对支付灵活性的影响，对于更易受气候风险冲击的企业、以及在人们更关注气候风险且国家文化强调不确定性规避和长期导向的国家更为显著。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Increases and Initiations and Default Risk in Equity Returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study extends the Grullon, Michaely, and Swaminathan (2002) analysis by incorporating default risk. Raw markdown: charitou-2011-dividend-increases-and-initiations-and-default-risk-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Charitou, A, Lambertides, N, Theodoulou, G…
pages.text: Dividend Increases and Initiations and Default Risk in Equity Returns (2011) Paper claim — This study extends the Grullon, Michaely, and Swaminathan (2002) analysis by incorporating default risk. Raw markdown: charitou-2011-dividend-increases-and-initiations-and-default-risk-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Charitou, A, Lambertides, N, Theodoulou, G Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109011000305 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract This study extends the Grullon, Michaely, and Swaminathan (2002) analysis by incorporating default risk. Using data for firms that either increased or initiated cash dividend payments during the 23-year period 1986-2008, we find reduction in default risk. This reduction is shown to be a priced risk factor beyond the Fama and French (1993) risk measures, and it explains the dividend payment decision and the positive market reaction around dividend increases and initiations. Further analysis reveals that the reduction in default risk is a significant factor in explaining the 3-year excess returns following dividend increases and initiations. 摘要（中文） 本研究通过纳入违约风险，扩展了Grullon、Michaely和Swaminathan（2002）的分析。使用在1986—2008年这23年期间增加或发起现金股利支付的公司数据，我们发现违约风险的降低。研究表明，这一降低是超越Fama和French（1993）风险度量之外的一个被定价的风险因子，它既解释了股利支付决策，也解释了股利增加和发起前后市场的正面反应。进一步分析揭示，违约风险的降低是解释股利增加和发起后3年超额收益的一个重要因素。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The economic impact of right-to-work laws: Evidence from collective bargaining agreements and corporate policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze the economic and financial impact of right-to-work (RTW) laws in the US. Raw markdown: chava-2020-the-economic-impact-of-right-to-work-laws Bibliographic Record Authors: Chava, S, Danis, A, Hsu, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI:…
pages.text: The economic impact of right-to-work laws: Evidence from collective bargaining agreements and corporate policies (2020) Paper claim — We analyze the economic and financial impact of right-to-work (RTW) laws in the US. Raw markdown: chava-2020-the-economic-impact-of-right-to-work-laws Bibliographic Record Authors: Chava, S, Danis, A, Hsu, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.02.005 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We analyze the economic and financial impact of right-to-work (RTW) laws in the US. Using data from collective bargaining agreements, we show that there is a decrease in wages for unionized workers after RTW laws. Firms increase investment and employment but reduce financial leverage. Labor-intensive firms experience higher profits and labor-to-asset ratios. Dividends and executive compensation also increase post-RTW. Our results are consistent with a canonical theory of the firm augmented with an exogenous bargaining power of labor and suggest that RTW laws impact corporate policies by decreasing that bargaining power. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们分析了美国"工作权"（RTW）法的经济与金融影响。利用集体谈判协议的数据，我们表明，在RTW法实施后，工会化工人的工资出现下降。企业增加了投资和雇佣，但降低了财务杠杆。劳动密集型企业的利润和劳动与资产比率更高。RTW法实施后，股利和高管薪酬也有所增加。我们的结果与一个经外生劳动谈判力扩展的经典企业理论相一致，并表明RTW法通过削弱劳动谈判力来影响公司政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Market valuation of tax-timing options: Evidence from capital gains distributions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine a distribution that is taxed as a capital gain rather than as a dividend. Raw markdown: chay-2006-market-valuation-of-tax-timing-options-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Chay, JB, Choi, DS, Pontiff, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006…
pages.text: Market valuation of tax-timing options: Evidence from capital gains distributions (2006) Paper claim — We examine a distribution that is taxed as a capital gain rather than as a dividend. Raw markdown: chay-2006-market-valuation-of-tax-timing-options-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Chay, JB, Choi, DS, Pontiff, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2006.00856.x Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We examine a distribution that is taxed as a capital gain rather than as a dividend. Since the distribution induces a realized capital gain while the price change is an unrealized gain, ex-day return behavior provides evidence of the value of tax-timing capital gains. We show that investors are compensated 7 cent in unrealized gains for each dollar of realized capital gains, that is, $1 of realized capital gains is equivalent to 93 cent of unrealized gains. An investor with a tax rate on realized gains of 15% has an effective tax rate on unrealized capital gains of 8.6%. 摘要（中文） 我们考察一种被作为资本利得而非股利征税的分配。由于该分配诱发了已实现资本利得，而价格变化是未实现利得，除权日的收益行为为资本利得税收择时（tax-timing）的价值提供了证据。我们表明，投资者每获得一美元已实现资本利得会在未实现利得上得到7美分的补偿，也就是说，1美元的已实现资本利得等价于93美分的未实现利得。一个对已实现利得税率为15%的投资者，其未实现资本利得的有效税率为8.6%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout policy and cash-flow uncertainty
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The importance of cash-flow uncertainty in payout policy has received little attention in empirical studies, while survey studies such as [Lintner, J., 1956. Raw markdown: chay-2009-payout-policy-and-cash-flow-uncertainty Bibliographic Record Authors: Chay, JB,…
pages.text: Payout policy and cash-flow uncertainty (2009) Paper claim — The importance of cash-flow uncertainty in payout policy has received little attention in empirical studies, while survey studies such as [Lintner, J., 1956. Raw markdown: chay-2009-payout-policy-and-cash-flow-uncertainty Bibliographic Record Authors: Chay, JB, Suh, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2008.12.001 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract The importance of cash-flow uncertainty in payout policy has received little attention in empirical studies, while survey studies such as [Lintner, J., 1956. Distribution of incomes of operations among dividends, retained earnings, and taxes. American Economic Review 46, 97-113.] and [Brav. A., Graham, J., Harvey C., Michaely, R., 2005. Payout policy in the 21st century. journal of Financial Economics 77, 483-527.] indicate its importance. With worldwide firm-level data, we present evidence that cash-flow uncertainty is an important cross-sectional determinant of corporate payout policy. Our results show that across countries, cash-flow uncertainty, as proxied by stock return volatility, has a negative impact on the amount of dividends as well as the probability of paying dividends. The impact of cash-flow uncertainty on dividends is generally stronger than the impact of other potential determinants of payout policy-such as the earned/contributed capital mix, agency conflicts, and investment opportunities. We also find that the effect of cash-flow uncertainty on dividends is distinct from the effect of a firm's financial life-cycle stage. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 现金流不确定性在支付政策中的重要性在实证研究中鲜有受到关注，而诸如[Lintner, J., 1956. 《经营收入在股利、留存收益和税收之间的分配》，《美国经济评论》46, 97-113]和[Brav. A., Graham, J., Harvey C., Michaely, R., 2005. 《21世纪的支付政策》，《金融经济学杂志》77, 483-527]等调查研究却表明其重要性。使用全球范围的企业层面数据，我们提供证据表明，现金流不确定性是企业支付政策的一个重要横截面决定因素。我们的结果表明，在各国之间，以股票回报波动率作为代理变量的现金流不确定性，对股利金额以及支付股利的概率都有负面影响。现金流不确定性对股利的影响通常比支付政策的其他潜在决定因素（如已赚取/已缴入资本组合、代理冲突和投资机会）的影响更强。我们还发现，现金流不确定性对股利的影响不同于企业财务生命周期阶段的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Management Quality, Financial and Investment Policies, and Asymmetric Information
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop measures of the management quality of firms and make use of a unique sample of hand-collected data to examine the relationship between the reputation and quality of,I firm's management and its financial and investment policies, a relationship that has so…
pages.text: Management Quality, Financial and Investment Policies, and Asymmetric Information (2009) Paper claim — We develop measures of the management quality of firms and make use of a unique sample of hand-collected data to examine the relationship between the reputation and quality of,I firm's management and its financial and investment policies, a relationship that has so far received little attention in the literature. Raw markdown: chemmanur-2009-management-quality-financial-and-investment-policies-and-asymmetric Bibliographic Record Authors: Chemmanur, TJ, Paeglis, I, Simonyan, K Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109009990299 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(information asymmetry, signal) Abstract We develop measures of the management quality of firms and make use of a unique sample of hand-collected data to examine the relationship between the reputation and quality of,I firm's management and its financial and investment policies, a relationship that has so far received little attention in the literature. We hypothesize that better and more reputable managers are able to convey the intrinsic value of their firm more credibly to outsiders, thus reducing the information asymmetry facing their firm in the equity market. Given this, firms with better and more reputable managers will have more access to the equity market, so that we expect lower leverage ratios for these firms. In addition, they will have less need to signal using dividends, so that they will have lower dividend payout ratios. Further, since better managers are likely to select better projects (having a larger net present value (NPV) for any given scale) and to implement them more ably, higher management quality will also be associated with higher levels of investment. We present evidence consistent with the above hypotheses. Our direct tests of the relationship between management quality and asymmetric information also indicate that higher management quality leads to a reduction in the extent of information asymmetry facing I firm in the equity market. 摘要（中文） 我们构建了企业管理质量的度量指标，并利用一个独特的手工收集数据样本来考察企业管理层的声誉和质量与其融资和投资政策之间的关系——这一关系迄今在文献中鲜有关注。我们假设，更优秀、声誉更好的经理人能够更可信地向外部人传达其企业的内在价值，从而降低其企业在股权市场面临的信息不对称。鉴于此，拥有更优秀、声誉更好的经理人的企业将更容易进入股权市场，因此我们预期这些企业的杠杆率更低。此外，它们用股利进行信号传递的需要更少，因此其股利支付率会更低。进一步地，由于更优秀的经理人更可能选择更好的项目（在任何给定规模下具有更大的净现值NPV）并更有能力地实施这些项目，更高的管理质量还将与更高的投资水平相关联。我们提供了与上述假设一致的证据。我们对管理质量与信息不对称之间关系的直接检验还表明，更高的管理质量导致企业在股权市场面临的信息不对称程度降低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Is dividend smoothing universal? New insights from a comparative study of dividend policies in Hong Kong and the US
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper, we develop new insights about the dynamics of corporate dividend policy by performing the natural experiment of comparing corporate dividend policies in Hong Kong and the U.S., two economies where the tax regime and equity ownership structure are…
pages.text: Is dividend smoothing universal? New insights from a comparative study of dividend policies in Hong Kong and the US (2010) Paper claim — In this paper, we develop new insights about the dynamics of corporate dividend policy by performing the natural experiment of comparing corporate dividend policies in Hong Kong and the U.S., two economies where the tax regime and equity ownership structure are significantly different. Raw markdown: chemmanur-2010-is-dividend-smoothing-universal-new-insights-from-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Chemmanur, TJ, He, J, Hu, G, Liu, H Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2010.03.001 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract In this paper, we develop new insights about the dynamics of corporate dividend policy by performing the natural experiment of comparing corporate dividend policies in Hong Kong and the U.S., two economies where the tax regime and equity ownership structure are significantly different. Our empirical results can be summarized as follows. First, a test of the Lintner model reveals that the extent of dividend smoothing by firms in Hong Kong is significantly less than those in the U.S. Second, the signaling effects of dividend changes on stock returns are stronger in the U.S. compared to those in Hong Kong. Third, our logit analysis of the determinants of dividend changes indicates that, while the lagged dividend yield significantly affects dividend changes in both countries in the same fashion, prior year stock returns have opposite effects on dividend changes in the two countries. Finally, the extent of dividend smoothing is not systematically related to blockholder equity ownership in either country. Overall, our results suggest that, compared to U.S. firms, Hong Kong firms pursue a more flexible dividend policy commensurate with earnings, and that the differences between the dividend policies of firms in the two countries are consistent with the signaling implications of the differences in the tax regime across the two countries. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在本文中，我们通过比较香港和美国这两个税收制度和股权所有权结构显著不同的经济体的公司股利政策这一自然实验，对公司股利政策的动态形成了新的认识。我们的实证结果可总结如下。第一，对Lintner模型的检验揭示，香港公司的股利平滑程度显著低于美国公司。第二，股利变动对股票收益的信号效应在美国比在香港更强。第三，我们对股利变动决定因素的logit分析表明，尽管滞后的股利收益率在两个国家以相同方式显著影响股利变动，但前一年的股票收益对两个国家的股利变动具有相反的影响。最后，股利平滑程度在两个国家均与大宗持股人的股权所有权没有系统性关系。总体而言，我们的结果表明，与美国公司相比，香港公司奉行一种与盈余相称、更为灵活的股利政策，且两国公司股利政策之间的差异与两国税收制度差异的信号传递含义相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: "Preparing" the Equity Market for Adverse Corporate Events: A Theoretical Analysis of Firms Cutting Dividends (2012) Paper claim — This paper presents the first theoretical analysis of the choice of firms between "preparing" and not preparing the equity market in advance of a possible dividend cut. Raw markdown: chemmanur-2012-preparing-the-equity-market-for-adverse-corporate-events Bibliographic Record Authors: Chemmanur, TJ, Tian, X Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109012000439 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper presents the first theoretical analysis of the choice of firms between "preparing" and not preparing the equity market in advance of a possible dividend cut. In our model, insiders have private information about their firm's intermediate cash flow as well as about the net present value of its growth opportunity. We show that, in equilibrium, firms in temporary financial difficulties but with good long-term growth prospects are more likely to prepare the market in advance of dividend cuts, while those with permanently declining earnings are less likely to prepare the market. Our model generates several new testable predictions. 摘要（中文） 本文首次对企业在“预先准备”与不预先准备股权市场以应对可能的股利削减之间的选择进行了理论分析。在我们的模型中，内部人拥有关于其公司中期现金流以及其增长机会净现值的私有信息。我们表明，在均衡中，处于暂时性财务困难但具有良好长期增长前景的公司更有可能在股利削减之前预先准备市场，而收益永久性下降的公司则不太可能预先准备市场。我们的模型生成了若干新的可检验预测。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper presents the first empirical analysis of the choice of firms regarding whether to release private information ("prepare the market") in advance of a possible dividend cut and the consequences of such market preparation. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Communicating Private Information to the Equity Market Before a Dividend Cut: An Empirical Analysis (2014) Paper claim — This paper presents the first empirical analysis of the choice of firms regarding whether to release private information ("prepare the market") in advance of a possible dividend cut and the consequences of such market preparation. Raw markdown: chemmanur-2014-communicating-private-information-to-the-equity-market-before Bibliographic Record Authors: Chemmanur, TJ, Tian, X Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109014000672 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, signal) Abstract This paper presents the first empirical analysis of the choice of firms regarding whether to release private information ("prepare the market") in advance of a possible dividend cut and the consequences of such market preparation. We use a hand-collected data set of dividend cutting firms, which allows us to distinguish between prepared and nonprepared dividend cutters and to test the implications of two alternative theories: the "signaling through market preparation" theory and the "stock return volatility reduction" theory. We document several important differences between prepared and nonprepared dividend cutters. Overall, our empirical results are consistent with the signaling theory. 摘要（中文） 本文首次对公司在可能的股利削减之前是否选择披露私人信息（"为市场做准备"）以及此类市场准备的后果进行了实证分析。我们使用手工收集的股利削减公司数据集，据此得以区分有准备的与无准备的股利削减者，并检验两种备选理论的含义："通过市场准备进行信号传递"理论和"股票收益波动性降低"理论。我们记录了有准备与无准备的股利削减者之间若干重要差异。总体而言，我们的实证结果与信号传递理论相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does the pricing of financial reporting quality change around dividend changes?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine whether accrual earnings quality is a priced information risk factor in a dividend change setting. Raw markdown: chen-2007-does-the-pricing-of-financial-reporting-quality-change Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, SP, Shevlin, T, Tong, YH Journal:…
pages.text: Does the pricing of financial reporting quality change around dividend changes? (2007) Paper claim — We examine whether accrual earnings quality is a priced information risk factor in a dividend change setting. Raw markdown: chen-2007-does-the-pricing-of-financial-reporting-quality-change Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, SP, Shevlin, T, Tong, YH Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2007.00225.x Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract We examine whether accrual earnings quality is a priced information risk factor in a dividend change setting. We define information risk as the probability that firm-specific financial statement information pertinent to investor pricing decisions is of low precision, and use the factor-mimicking portfolio returns formed on the Dechow-Dichev [2002] accrual quality (AQ) metric to proxy for the information risk (IR) factor returns. We augment the Fama-French three-factor model with this IR factor, and find that dividend initiation and increase firms exhibit a decrease in the factor loadings on the IR factor while dividend decrease firms exhibit an increase in the corresponding factor loadings, but such changes in the factor loadings occur months prior to the dividend change announcements. The results are robust to further controls for operating risk and using an alternative measure of information risk. Further analysis on changes in information characteristics such as AQ, the probability of informed trading score (PIN), forecast dispersion, and return volatility surrounding dividend change events are consistent with the asset pricing results. Overall, we interpret our results as being consistent with investors treating the information risk associated with the precision of financial statement information as a priced risk factor, with both the precision and pricing changing in predictable directions around dividend changes. However, while we attempt to control for operating risk changes in additional tests, we cannot completely rule out changes in operating risk as a competing alternative explanation for our observed results. 摘要（中文） 我们考察在股利变动情境下，应计盈余质量是否是一个被定价的信息风险因子。我们将信息风险定义为与投资者定价决策相关的公司特定财务报表信息精确度较低的概率，并使用基于Dechow-Dichev [2002]应计质量（AQ）指标构建的因子模拟组合收益来代理信息风险（IR）因子收益。我们用这一IR因子扩展了Fama-French三因子模型，发现股利开始派发和增加的公司在IR因子上的因子载荷下降，而股利减少的公司在相应因子载荷上上升，但因子载荷的这些变化发生在股利变动公告之前数月。这些结果在进一步控制经营风险以及使用信息风险的替代度量时依然稳健。对股利变动事件前后信息特征变化（例如AQ、知情交易概率得分PIN、预测分歧和收益波动性）的进一步分析与资产定价结果相一致。总体而言，我们将结果解读为与以下情形相一致：投资者将与财务报表信息精确度相关的信息风险视为一个被定价的风险因子，且其精确度和定价都在股利变动前后沿可预测的方向变化。然而，尽管我们在额外检验中试图控制经营风险的变化，我们无法完全排除经营风险变化作为我们所观察到结果的一个竞争性替代解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Smoothing and Predictability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The relative predictability of returns and dividends is a central issue because it forms the paradigm to interpret asset price variation. Raw markdown: chen-2012-dividend-smoothing-and-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, L, Da, Z, Priestley, R…
pages.text: Dividend Smoothing and Predictability (2012) Paper claim — The relative predictability of returns and dividends is a central issue because it forms the paradigm to interpret asset price variation. Raw markdown: chen-2012-dividend-smoothing-and-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, L, Da, Z, Priestley, R Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1120.1528 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract The relative predictability of returns and dividends is a central issue because it forms the paradigm to interpret asset price variation. A little studied question is how dividend smoothing, as a choice of corporate policy, affects predictability. We show that even if dividends are supposed to be predictable without smoothing, dividend smoothing can bury this predictability. Because aggregate dividends are dramatically more smoothed in the postwar period than before, the lack of dividend growth predictability in the postwar period does not necessarily mean that there is no cash flow news in stock price variations; rather, a more plausible interpretation is that dividends are smoothed. Using two alternative measures that are less subject to dividend smoothing-net payout and earnings-we reach the consistent conclusion that cash flow news plays a more important role than discount rate news in price variations in the postwar period. 摘要（中文） 收益与股利的相对可预测性是一个核心问题，因为它构成了解释资产价格变动的范式。一个鲜有研究的问题是，作为一种公司政策选择的股利平滑如何影响可预测性。我们表明，即便股利在没有平滑的情况下本应是可预测的，股利平滑也可能掩盖这种可预测性。由于战后时期的总股利相比之前被大幅平滑，战后时期股利增长可预测性的缺失并不必然意味着股价变动中不含现金流信息；相反，一个更为合理的解释是股利被平滑了。运用两种受股利平滑影响较小的替代指标——净支付和收益——我们得出一致的结论：在战后时期，现金流信息在价格变动中比贴现率信息发挥了更重要的作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The average cash holdings of Chinese-listed firms decreased significantly after the split share structure reform in China, which specified a process that allowed previously nontradable shares held by controlling shareholders to be freely tradable on the exchanges.…
pages.text: The Sensitivity of Corporate Cash Holdings to Corporate Governance (2012) Paper claim — The average cash holdings of Chinese-listed firms decreased significantly after the split share structure reform in China, which specified a process that allowed previously nontradable shares held by controlling shareholders to be freely tradable on the exchanges. Raw markdown: chen-2012-the-sensitivity-of-corporate-cash-holdings-to-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, Q, Chen, X, Schipper, K, Xu, YX, Xue, J Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhs099 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract The average cash holdings of Chinese-listed firms decreased significantly after the split share structure reform in China, which specified a process that allowed previously nontradable shares held by controlling shareholders to be freely tradable on the exchanges. The reduction in cash holdings is greater for firms with weaker governance and firms facing more financial constraints prior to the reform. The reform also significantly reduced the average corporate savings rate, as measured by cash-to-cash-flow sensitivity. These findings are consistent with the premise that the reform removed a significant market friction, which led to better incentive alignment between controlling shareholders and minority shareholders and relaxed financial constraints. Additional analyses show that the reform affects firms' cash management policies, investment decisions, dividend payout policies, and financing choices differently in private firms than in state-owned enterprises. 摘要（中文） 在中国股权分置改革之后，中国上市公司的平均现金持有量显著下降，该改革规定了一个允许控股股东此前持有的非流通股在交易所自由交易的过程。对于改革前公司治理较弱以及面临更多财务约束的企业，现金持有的下降幅度更大。改革还显著降低了以现金对现金流敏感性衡量的平均公司储蓄率。这些发现与以下前提相一致：改革消除了一个重大的市场摩擦，从而使控股股东与中小股东之间的激励更好地一致，并放松了财务约束。进一步的分析表明，改革对民营企业和国有企业的现金管理政策、投资决策、股利支付政策和融资选择的影响有所不同。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Sustainable growth rate, optimal growth rate, and optimal payout ratio: A joint optimization approach (2013) Paper claim — This study investigates the investment decision and dividend policy jointly from a non-steady state to a steady state. Raw markdown: chen-2013-sustainable-growth-rate-optimal-growth-rate-and-optimal Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, HY, Gupta, MC, Lee, AC, Lee, CF Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2012.11.019 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This study investigates the investment decision and dividend policy jointly from a non-steady state to a steady state. We extend Higgins' (1977, 1981, 2008) sustainable growth rate model and develop a dynamic model which jointly optimizes the growth rate and payout ratio. We optimize the firm value to obtain the optimal growth rate in terms of a logistic equation and find that the steady state growth rate can be used as the benchmark for the mean-reverting process of the optimal growth rate. We also investigate the specification error of the mean and variance of dividend per share when introducing the stochastic growth rate. Empirical results support the mean-reverting process of the growth rate and the importance of covariance between the profitability and the growth rate in determining dividend payouts. The intertemporal behavior of the covariance may shed some light on the fact of disappearing dividends over decades. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究从非稳态到稳态联合考察投资决策和股利政策。我们扩展了Higgins（1977, 1981, 2008）的可持续增长率模型，并建立了一个联合优化增长率和支付率的动态模型。我们对企业价值进行优化，以logistic方程的形式得到最优增长率，并发现稳态增长率可用作最优增长率均值回归过程的基准。我们还考察了在引入随机增长率时每股股利均值和方差的设定误差。实证结果支持增长率的均值回归过程，以及盈利能力与增长率之间的协方差在决定股利支付中的重要性。这一协方差的跨期行为可能为数十年来股利消失的事实提供某些启示。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The white squire defense: Evidence from private investments in public equity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms can effectively stave off outside takeover bids using private investments in public equity (PIPEs) when they face strong takeover pressure. Raw markdown: chen-2016-the-white-squire-defense-evidence-from-private-investments Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen,…
pages.text: The white squire defense: Evidence from private investments in public equity (2016) Paper claim — Firms can effectively stave off outside takeover bids using private investments in public equity (PIPEs) when they face strong takeover pressure. Raw markdown: chen-2016-the-white-squire-defense-evidence-from-private-investments Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, SS, Hsu, CY, Huang, CW Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2015.11.017 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Firms can effectively stave off outside takeover bids using private investments in public equity (PIPEs) when they face strong takeover pressure. Greater takeover pressure makes PIPE issuers more likely to grant investors large blocks of shares, price discounts, generous dividends, and board seats. Takeover pressure also encourages issuers to place more shares with friendly investors such as managerial investors and strategic alliance investors. The evidence is consistent with the regular methods of the white squire defense. PIPEs can be a preferred method in the choice of a white squire defense when poorly performing and highly overleveraged firms face severe takeover pressure. There is a negative relation between takeover probability and post-issue performance of issuers, which supports the managerial entrenchment hypothesis over the shareholder interest hypothesis. Therefore PIPEs can increase, not mitigate, agency problems. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 当公司面临强烈的收购压力时，可以有效地利用上市公司私募（private investments in public equity，PIPEs）来抵御外部收购要约。更大的收购压力使PIPE发行方更可能向投资者授予大宗股份、价格折扣、慷慨的股利以及董事会席位。收购压力还促使发行方将更多股份配售给友好投资者，例如管理层投资者和战略联盟投资者。这些证据与白衣护卫（white squire）防御的常规方法相一致。当业绩不佳且高度过度举债的公司面临严峻收购压力时，PIPEs可能成为选择白衣护卫防御时的首选方法。收购概率与发行方发行后业绩之间存在负向关系，这支持了管理层壕沟自守假说而非股东利益假说。因此，PIPEs可能增加而非缓解代理问题。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of board gender composition on dividend payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates whether female independent directors are more likely to impose high dividend payouts. Raw markdown: chen-2017-the-impact-of-board-gender-composition-on-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, J, Leung, WS, Goergen, M Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: The impact of board gender composition on dividend payouts (2017) Paper claim — This paper investigates whether female independent directors are more likely to impose high dividend payouts. Raw markdown: chen-2017-the-impact-of-board-gender-composition-on-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, J, Leung, WS, Goergen, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.01.001 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, independent director)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper investigates whether female independent directors are more likely to impose high dividend payouts. We find evidence that firms with a larger fraction of female directors on their board have greater dividend payouts. This finding is robust to alternative econometric specifications, and alternative measures of dividend payouts and female board representation. The positive effect of board gender composition on dividends remains when we employ propensity score matching, the instrumental variable approach, and difference-in-differences approach to address potential endogeneity concerns. Furthermore, we find that board gender composition significantly increases the dividend payout only for firms with weak governance, suggesting that female directors use dividend payouts as a governance device. (C) 2017 The Authors. Published by Elsevier B.V. This is an open access article under the CC BY license (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). 摘要（中文） 本文考察女性独立董事是否更可能推动高股利支付。我们发现证据表明，董事会中女性董事比例较大的企业股利支付更高。这一发现对替代性计量经济学设定、以及股利支付和女性董事会代表性的替代性度量都是稳健的。在我们采用倾向得分匹配、工具变量方法和双重差分方法来处理潜在内生性顾虑时，董事会性别构成对股利的正向影响依然存在。此外，我们发现，董事会性别构成只对治理薄弱的企业显著增加股利支付，这表明女性董事将股利支付用作一种治理工具。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends from unrealized earnings and default risk
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using hand-collected data on Israeli firms' unrealized earnings and debt restructurings following adoption of the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), we investigate whether and how dividend payouts based on unrealized revaluation earnings affect a…
pages.text: Dividends from unrealized earnings and default risk (2019) Paper claim — Using hand-collected data on Israeli firms' unrealized earnings and debt restructurings following adoption of the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), we investigate whether and how dividend payouts based on unrealized revaluation earnings affect a firm's default risk. Raw markdown: chen-2019-dividends-from-unrealized-earnings-and-default-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, E, Gavious, I, Steinberg, N Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-019-9483-5 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Using hand-collected data on Israeli firms' unrealized earnings and debt restructurings following adoption of the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), we investigate whether and how dividend payouts based on unrealized revaluation earnings affect a firm's default risk. Our results indicate that, in the era of fair value accounting, whether the dividend payment originates from unrealized or realized earnings has a significant effect on a firm's default risk, above and beyond the effect of the extent of the payment. Specifically, controlling for various determinants of financial risk, including the amount of the dividends paid, we find that firms are four times more likely to subsequently require debt restructuring, if they distribute dividends based on unrealized earnings. However, this enhanced risk seems to be mispriced by the market: cost of debt proxies are generally insignificantly different for these firms, following payouts originating from unrealized earnings, than for firms that never make such risky payouts. 摘要（中文） 利用手工收集的以色列公司在采用《国际财务报告准则》（IFRS）后的未实现收益及债务重组数据，我们考察基于未实现的重估收益进行的股利派现是否以及如何影响公司的违约风险。我们的结果表明，在公允价值会计的时代，股利支付源自未实现收益还是已实现收益，会对公司违约风险产生显著影响，其影响超出了派现规模本身的影响。具体而言，在控制了包括所派股利金额在内的各种财务风险决定因素后，我们发现，如果公司基于未实现收益分配股利，其随后需要债务重组的可能性是其他公司的四倍。然而，这种增强的风险似乎被市场错误定价：在源自未实现收益的派现之后，这些公司的债务成本代理变量与从不进行此类高风险派现的公司相比，通常并无显著差异。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Passing the dividend baton: The impact of dividend policy on new CEOs' initial compensation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how firms' dividend policy affects the initial compensation of their newly appointed CEOs. Raw markdown: chen-2019-passing-the-dividend-baton-the-impact-of-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, J, Song, W, Goergen, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE…
pages.text: Passing the dividend baton: The impact of dividend policy on new CEOs' initial compensation (2019) Paper claim — We examine how firms' dividend policy affects the initial compensation of their newly appointed CEOs. Raw markdown: chen-2019-passing-the-dividend-baton-the-impact-of-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, J, Song, W, Goergen, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.04.004 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine how firms' dividend policy affects the initial compensation of their newly appointed CEOs. We focus on newly appointed CEOs to isolate the effect of dividends on compensation and to provide new insights into an aspect largely neglected by compensation research. We show that the dividend payout is positively related to new CEO compensation. Further, the positive effect of dividends is stronger for firms with no dividend cuts over the past two, three and four years, firms with relatively high institutional ownership, and those with strong boards, consistent with new CEOs receiving higher pay as compensation for greater dividend pressure. 摘要（中文） 我们考察企业的股利政策如何影响其新任CEO的初始薪酬。我们聚焦于新任CEO，以隔离股利对薪酬的影响，并为薪酬研究中一个在很大程度上被忽视的方面提供新的洞见。我们表明，股利支付与新任CEO薪酬呈正相关。此外，股利的正向效应在过去两年、三年和四年未削减股利的企业、机构持股相对较高的企业以及董事会强势的企业中更强，这与新任CEO因承受更大股利压力而获得更高薪酬相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate governance and cash holdings: Evidence from worldwide board reforms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using staggered board reforms as a quasi-natural experiment and a difference-in-differences approach, this study examines the impact of corporate governance on cash holdings in 41 countries. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Corporate governance and cash holdings: Evidence from worldwide board reforms (2020) Paper claim — Using staggered board reforms as a quasi-natural experiment and a difference-in-differences approach, this study examines the impact of corporate governance on cash holdings in 41 countries. Raw markdown: chen-2020-corporate-governance-and-cash-holdings-evidence-from-worldwide Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, RY, Guedhami, O, Yang, Y, Zaynutdinova, GR Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101771 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, institution, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract Using staggered board reforms as a quasi-natural experiment and a difference-in-differences approach, this study examines the impact of corporate governance on cash holdings in 41 countries. We find that board reforms are followed by significant reductions in cash holdings. This effect is more pronounced for firms with weaker pre-reform corporate governance and for firms from countries with weaker institutional environments. Analysis of cash spending suggests that, following board reforms, firms are more likely to use cash to increase R&D expenditures, dividend payouts, and share repurchases, but not to increase capital or acquisition expenditures. Finally, the results indicate that enhanced corporate governance following board reforms leads to higher (lower) cash (dividend payouts) values, consistent with the view that board reforms strengthen corporate governance. 摘要（中文） 本研究以交错实施的董事会改革作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法，考察公司治理对41个国家现金持有的影响。我们发现，董事会改革之后现金持有显著减少。这一效应对于改革前公司治理较弱的企业以及来自制度环境较弱国家的企业更为显著。对现金支出的分析表明，在董事会改革之后，企业更可能利用现金来增加研发（R&D）支出、股利支付和股份回购，而非增加资本支出或收购支出。最后，结果表明，董事会改革之后公司治理的增强导致更高（更低）的现金（股利支付）价值，这与董事会改革强化公司治理的观点相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Internal controls, risk management, and cash holdings
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Exploiting a unique setting in China where internal controls are intended to manage risks, we investigate how internal controls shape the cash holding policies. Raw markdown: chen-2020-internal-controls-risk-management-and-cash-holdings Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Internal controls, risk management, and cash holdings (2020) Paper claim — Exploiting a unique setting in China where internal controls are intended to manage risks, we investigate how internal controls shape the cash holding policies. Raw markdown: chen-2020-internal-controls-risk-management-and-cash-holdings Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, HW, Yang, DG, Zhang, JH, Zhou, HY Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101695 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, internal control)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Exploiting a unique setting in China where internal controls are intended to manage risks, we investigate how internal controls shape the cash holding policies. Results show that firms with higher internal control quality (ICQ) are less likely to have abnormal cash holdings, either excess or deficit cash, and this effect is not driven by corporate governance quality. We also find that firms with higher ICQ are more likely to increase dividend payments and are less likely to increase M&A investments, especially when the firms have had a negative experience with prior M &A investments. Furthermore, our tests on the market valuation of cash holdings show that investors place a higher value on cash holdings of firms with higher ICQ. Collectively, our findings suggest that internal controls help companies shape reasonable cash policies that lead to value creation. 摘要（中文） 利用中国这一内部控制旨在管理风险的独特情境，我们考察内部控制如何塑造现金持有政策。结果表明，内部控制质量（ICQ）较高的公司更不可能出现异常现金持有（无论是超额现金还是现金不足），且这一效应并非由公司治理质量驱动。我们还发现，ICQ较高的公司更可能增加股利支付，更不可能增加并购投资，尤其是在公司此前有过并购投资负面经历的情况下。此外，我们对现金持有市场估值的检验表明，投资者对ICQ较高公司的现金持有赋予更高的价值。综合而言，我们的研究结果表明，内部控制有助于公司制定合理的现金政策，从而带来价值创造。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Misvaluation and the corporate propensity to hold cash
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study adopts a new perspective, misvaluation, to explain corporate propensity to hold cash. Raw markdown: chen-2021-misvaluation-and-the-corporate-propensity-to-hold-cash Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, HC, Chou, RK, Lu, CL Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE…
pages.text: Misvaluation and the corporate propensity to hold cash (2021) Paper claim — This study adopts a new perspective, misvaluation, to explain corporate propensity to hold cash. Raw markdown: chen-2021-misvaluation-and-the-corporate-propensity-to-hold-cash Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, HC, Chou, RK, Lu, CL Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.102076 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(agency, alternative) Abstract This study adopts a new perspective, misvaluation, to explain corporate propensity to hold cash. We find a strong cross-sectional relationship between misvaluation and the propensity to hold cash, which can be attributed to firms' investment, cash dividends, and equity raising activities. We further show that the equity issuance channel is driven by both firm-initiated issuance activities and the exercise of employee stock options. The results are robust after controlling for endogeneity issues. Several additional robustness tests reject alternative explanations, such as precautionary motives, agency conflicts, near-term cash needs, and tax motives. 摘要（中文） 本研究采用一个新的视角——错误估值——来解释企业持有现金的倾向。我们发现错误估值与持现倾向之间存在很强的横截面关系，这可归因于企业的投资、现金股利和股权募集活动。我们进一步表明，股权发行渠道由企业发起的发行活动和员工股票期权的行权共同驱动。这些结果在控制了内生性问题后依然稳健。若干额外的稳健性检验排除了替代性解释，如预防性动机、代理冲突、近期现金需求和税收动机。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Risk Aversion Sensitive Real Business Cycles
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Technology choice allows for substitution of production across states of nature and depends on state-dependent risk aversion. Raw markdown: chen-2021-risk-aversion-sensitive-real-business-cycles Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, ZH, Cooper, I, Ehling, P, Xiouros,…
pages.text: Risk Aversion Sensitive Real Business Cycles (2021) Paper claim — Technology choice allows for substitution of production across states of nature and depends on state-dependent risk aversion. Raw markdown: chen-2021-risk-aversion-sensitive-real-business-cycles Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, ZH, Cooper, I, Ehling, P, Xiouros, C Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2019.3561 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract Technology choice allows for substitution of production across states of nature and depends on state-dependent risk aversion. In equilibrium, endogenous technology choice can counter a persistent negative productivity shock with an increase in investment. An increase in risk aversion intensifies transformation across states, which directly leads to higher investment volatility. In our model and the data, the conditional volatility of investment correlates negatively with the price-dividend ratio and predicts excess stock market returns. In addition, the same mechanism generates predictability of consumption growth and produces fluctuations in the risk-free rate. 摘要（中文） 技术选择允许在自然状态之间进行生产替代，并取决于状态依赖的风险规避。在均衡中，内生的技术选择能够以投资增加来对冲持续的负向生产率冲击。风险规避的增加会加剧跨状态的转移，这直接导致更高的投资波动性。在我们的模型和数据中，投资的条件波动性与价格—股利比率负相关，并能预测超额股票市场收益。此外，同一机制生成了消费增长的可预测性，并产生了无风险利率的波动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Cross-border enforcement of securities laws and dividend payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Signing the MMoU (Multilateral Memorandum of Understanding on securities enforcement) increases dividend payouts for cross-listed firms, supporting the dividend outcome model: better cross-border legal enforcement reduces agency costs and compels insiders to…
pages.text: Cross-border enforcement of securities laws and dividend payouts (2022) Paper claim — Signing the MMoU (Multilateral Memorandum of Understanding on securities enforcement) increases dividend payouts for cross-listed firms, supporting the dividend outcome model: better cross-border legal enforcement reduces agency costs and compels insiders to disgorge more cash. Raw markdown: chen-2022-cross-border-enforcement-of-securities-laws-and-dividend-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, Xiaoqi; Hsieh, Chih-Chieh Chris; Tsang, Albert; Xiang, Yi Journal: The British Accounting Review Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.bar.2022.101117 Abstract Following the September 11, 2001 attacks, numerous countries signed a special nonbinding arrangement to enhance cross-border enforcement of securities laws. This agreement is the Multilateral Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Consultation and Cooperation and the Exchange of Information (MMoU). This study examines whether and how a country's MMoU entry affects firms' dividend payout policies. Relative to domestic US firms, foreign firms cross-listed in the US report a significant increase in dividend payouts after their home country entered the MMoU. Furthermore, the effect of MMoU on corporate dividend payouts is pronounced for (1) firms with high agency costs, (2) countries with low external governance quality, and (3) countries with poor disclosure environments. The findings collectively corroborate the prediction of the dividend outcome model and are consistent with the notion that strengthening cross-border regulatory enforcement of foreign firms improves protection for outside shareholders and increases dividend payouts. Key Findings Using 9,732 ADR firm-years matched to 9,732 domestic US firm-years (2000–2018), the difference-in-differences estimate shows cross-listed firms' dividend payout ratio increases by approximately 0.6% from a mean of 3% (a 20% increase) after their home country signs MMoU (ADR×POST coefficient = 0.005, p < 0.01). The effect is concentrated among firms with higher agency costs: ADR_HighAgencyCost×POST = 0.008–0.010 (p < 0.05), significantly larger than the low-agency-cost group, consistent across both country-level (investor protection, earnings quality) and firm-level (free cash flow, asset turnover, cash holdings) proxies. MMoU's dividend-increasing effect is stronger for firms from countries with poor external governance (NATION_GOV) and poor disclosure environments (DISCLOSURE), with statistically significant differences between high- and low-regulation groups (p < 0.05). Dynamic DID confirms no pre-trend; placebo tests (randomized MMoU years) yield near-zero mean effects; results hold across seven alternative dividend payout measures and restricted sample windows of ±3 and ±5 years. Results support the dividend outcome model over the substitute model: improved cross-border enforcement acts as an effective legal shareholder protection system, compelling insiders to disgorge cash rather than reducing firms' need to signal. pages.title: Cash Induced Demand
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — I show that cash distributions through cash mergers, dividend payments, and stock buybacks are, in principle, similar to investor fund flows in generating demand for investable assets. Raw markdown: chen-2024-cash-induced-demand Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen,…
pages.text: Cash Induced Demand (2024) Paper claim — I show that cash distributions through cash mergers, dividend payments, and stock buybacks are, in principle, similar to investor fund flows in generating demand for investable assets. Raw markdown: chen-2024-cash-induced-demand Bibliographic Record Authors: Chen, HZ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109022001454 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(buyback, distribution, dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract I show that cash distributions through cash mergers, dividend payments, and stock buybacks are, in principle, similar to investor fund flows in generating demand for investable assets. Abnormal returns on certain assets can be forecasted because delegated investors predictably reinvest cash returns toward certain holdings. Novel measures of stock-level demand constructed using proportional reinvestments by mutual funds predict abnormal returns and issuances in noncash-paying stocks. These results highlight an alternative and substantial source of price fluctuations in the cross section of equities. 摘要（中文） 我提出，通过现金并购、股利支付和股票回购进行的现金分配，原则上与投资者的资金流入在为可投资资产产生需求方面是相似的。某些资产的异常收益是可以被预测的，因为受托投资者会可预测地把现金收益再投资于某些持仓。运用共同基金按比例再投资构建的股票层面需求的新颖度量指标，可以预测非现金派息股票的异常收益和发行。这些结果凸显了权益横截面价格波动的一个替代性且重要的来源。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How do dividends signal when they are highly volatile?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In China's high-volatility dividend environment, dividend changes primarily convey short-term rather than long-term earnings information; CSRC regulatory requirements diminish signaling efficiency; and dividend changes align informationally with MD&A tone and…
pages.text: How do dividends signal when they are highly volatile? (2025) Paper claim — In China's high-volatility dividend environment, dividend changes primarily convey short-term rather than long-term earnings information; CSRC regulatory requirements diminish signaling efficiency; and dividend changes align informationally with MD&A tone and investor platform inquiries as complementary disclosure channels. Raw markdown: cheng-2025-how-do-dividends-signal-when-they-are-highly-volatile Bibliographic Record Authors: Cheng, Liubing; Chen, Yanyan; Liu, Feng Journal: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2025.102794 Abstract This study investigates the signaling role of dividends in China, a market characterized by high dividend volatility. We show that dividend changes, especially increases, primarily signal short-term earnings information. Dividend changes generate only short-term market reactions, with no significant long-term price drift. Notably, the regulation from the China Securities Regulatory Commission diminishes the efficiency of dividend signaling. The information conveyed by dividend changes aligns with that from two other channels: Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) tone and investor platform inquiries. Companies strategically adjust the combination of dividends and MD&A tone based on future earnings to convey information. Collectively, these findings suggest that the efficiency of dividend signaling in the Chinese market is limited. Key Findings Dividend changes predict short-term earnings (ΔDt coefficient = 0.003 for ΔEt+1, t = 6.63), but lose predictive power by year t+3 (insignificant). Dividend increases signal earnings improvements only for t+1, while dividend decreases predict earnings declines for at least three years — an asymmetry where the negative signal is roughly twice as strong and more persistent. No long-term price drift (BHARt+1) follows dividend changes, contrasting with U.S. evidence. Chinese firms exhibit average dividend adjustment speeds of 0.82 (versus 0.14 for U.S. firms), and this high volatility limits dividends' ability to signal long-term earnings, primarily because operating expenses and R&D expenditures are sticky following dividend changes. CSRC regulation (minimum 30% payout ratio for SEO eligibility, adopted 2008) weakens dividend signaling: the predictive power of dividend decreases for future earnings is one-third as large for firms already meeting the threshold (Targ30t=1) versus non-constrained firms; only unexpected dividend changes maintain significant predictive power across three years (Unexpected ΔDt coefficient = 0.004, p < 0.01), while expected dividend changes are insignificant. Dividend increases are positively correlated with MD&A positive tone (coefficient = 0.001, t = 2.99), while dividend decreases do not reduce positive tone — reflecting managerial asymmetry in communicating bad versus good news. During earnings growth periods, firms use both dividends and positive MD&A tone; during earnings decline, firms prefer dividend reductions over explicit negative MD&A language. Dividend decreases trigger 3.8× more investor platform inquiries within one month than dividend increases (p < 0.01); over one year, increases and decreases generate 5.2% and 10.7% more inquiries, respectively. pages.title: Managed Distribution Policies in Closed-End Funds and Shareholder Activism
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In closed-end funds, a managed distribution policy (MDP) is a dividend commitment potentially requiring the liquidation of assets. Raw markdown: cherkes-2014-managed-distribution-policies-in-closed-end-funds-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Cherkes, M, Sagi, JS,…
pages.text: Managed Distribution Policies in Closed-End Funds and Shareholder Activism (2014) Paper claim — In closed-end funds, a managed distribution policy (MDP) is a dividend commitment potentially requiring the liquidation of assets. Raw markdown: cherkes-2014-managed-distribution-policies-in-closed-end-funds-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Cherkes, M, Sagi, JS, Wang, ZJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109014000544 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract In closed-end funds, a managed distribution policy (MDP) is a dividend commitment potentially requiring the liquidation of assets. We argue that MDPs lower managerial claims on fund assets and, when the fund is at a discount, increase shareholder value. This transfer of wealth can be rationalized by managers wishing to deter a challenge from activist shareholders through a costly proxy vote. We find strong empirical evidence that managers respond to the presence of activists using MDPs, that MDPs constitute an effective wealth transfer to shareholders, and that activists are less likely to challenge management when an MDP is in place. 摘要（中文） 在封闭式基金中，托管分配政策（managed distribution policy，MDP）是一种可能要求变卖资产的股利承诺。我们认为，MDP会降低管理者对基金资产的求偿权，并在基金处于折价状态时提升股东价值。这种财富转移可以由管理者希望通过一场代价高昂的委托投票来阻遏维权股东（activist shareholders）的挑战来加以合理化。我们发现强有力的实证证据表明，管理者会利用MDP来回应维权者的存在，MDP构成了向股东的有效财富转移，且当MDP到位时维权者较不可能挑战管理层。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend taxes and corporate behavior: Evidence from the 2003 dividend tax cut
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper analyzes the effects of dividend taxation on corporate behavior using the large tax cut on individual dividend income enacted in 2003. Raw markdown: chetty-2005-dividend-taxes-and-corporate-behavior-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Chetty,…
pages.text: Dividend taxes and corporate behavior: Evidence from the 2003 dividend tax cut (2005) Paper claim — This paper analyzes the effects of dividend taxation on corporate behavior using the large tax cut on individual dividend income enacted in 2003. Raw markdown: chetty-2005-dividend-taxes-and-corporate-behavior-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Chetty, R, Saez, E Journal: QUARTERLY JOURNAL OF ECONOMICS Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1162/003355305774268174 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(independent director, institution, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper analyzes the effects of dividend taxation on corporate behavior using the large tax cut on individual dividend income enacted in 2003. We document a 20 percent increase in dividend payments by nonfinancial, nonutility publicly traded corporations following the tax cut. An unusually large number of firms initiated or increased regular dividend payments in the year after the reform. As a result, the number of firms paying dividends began to increase in 2003 after a continuous decline for more than two decades. Firms with high levels of nontaxable institutional ownership did not change payout policies, supporting the causality of the tax cut in increasing aggregate dividend payments. The response to the tax cut was strongest in firms with strong principals whose tax incentives changed (those with large taxable institutional owners or independent directors with large share holdings), and in firms where agents had stronger incentives to respond (high share ownership and low options ownership among top executives). Hence, principal-agent issues appear to play an important role in corporate responses to taxation. 摘要（中文） 本文利用2003年颁布的对个人股利收入的大幅减税，分析股利税对企业行为的影响。我们记录到，减税后非金融、非公用事业类公开上市公司的股利支付增加了20%。改革后的一年里，异常多的企业发起或提高了常规股利支付。结果，派息企业的数量在连续下降二十多年后于2003年开始回升。拥有高比例免税机构所有权的企业没有改变支付政策，这支持了减税在增加总股利支付中的因果作用。对减税的反应在拥有强势委托人且其税收激励发生变化的企业（拥有大型应税机构所有者或持股较多的独立董事的企业），以及代理人有更强动机作出反应的企业（高层高管高持股、低期权持有的企业）中最为强烈。因此，委托—代理问题似乎在企业对税收的反应中扮演了重要角色。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
