pages.title: Do labor unions affect firm payout policy?: Operating leverage and rent extraction effects
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — While previous literature documents weak effects of unionization on payout policy on average, we find that this average relationship hides significant heterogeneous effects of unionization on payouts across firms that depend on firm profitability. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Do labor unions affect firm payout policy?: Operating leverage and rent extraction effects (2016) Paper claim — While previous literature documents weak effects of unionization on payout policy on average, we find that this average relationship hides significant heterogeneous effects of unionization on payouts across firms that depend on firm profitability. Raw markdown: chino-2016-do-labor-unions-affect-firm-payout-policy-operating Bibliographic Record Authors: Chino, A Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.08.017 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(payout) Abstract While previous literature documents weak effects of unionization on payout policy on average, we find that this average relationship hides significant heterogeneous effects of unionization on payouts across firms that depend on firm profitability. The effect of unionization on payouts is negative for low-profitability firms but positive for high-profitability firms. We posit that labor unions (i) increase operating risk, which negatively affects payouts, but (ii) increase potential for rent extraction from unions, which could induce shareholders to demand positive payouts. Higher profitability mitigates the negative effect while strengthening the positive effect, making the relation between unionization and payouts less negative or more positive. We provide evidence consistent with both the negative and positive effects of unionization on payouts. Our empirical design mitigates endogeneity concerns. Further, an instrumental variable analysis and a cross-sectional test using right-to-work laws confirm that endogeneity is unlikely to drive our results. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 尽管以往文献记录了工会化平均而言对派现政策的影响较弱，但我们发现，这一平均关系掩盖了工会化对各公司派现的显著异质性效应，这种效应取决于公司的盈利能力。工会化对派现的效应，在低盈利能力公司中为负，但在高盈利能力公司中为正。我们提出，工会（i）会增加经营风险，从而对派现产生负面影响，但（ii）会增加从工会攫取租金的可能性，这可能促使股东要求正的派现。较高的盈利能力会缓解负面效应，同时增强正面效应，使工会化与派现之间的关系变得不那么负或更加正。我们提供了与工会化对派现的负面效应和正面效应均一致的证据。我们的实证设计缓解了内生性担忧。此外，一项工具变量分析以及一项使用工作权利法（right-to-work laws）的横截面检验证实，内生性不太可能驱动我们的结果。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Landmines and Spatial Development
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Landmines affect the lives of millions in many conflict-ridden communities long after the end of hostilities. Raw markdown: chiovelli-2025-landmines-and-spatial-development Bibliographic Record Authors: Chiovelli, G, Michalopoulos, S, Papaioannou, E Journal:…
pages.text: Landmines and Spatial Development (2025) Paper claim — Landmines affect the lives of millions in many conflict-ridden communities long after the end of hostilities. Raw markdown: chiovelli-2025-landmines-and-spatial-development Bibliographic Record Authors: Chiovelli, G, Michalopoulos, S, Papaioannou, E Journal: ECONOMETRICA Year: 2025 DOI: 10.3982/ECTA17951 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Landmines affect the lives of millions in many conflict-ridden communities long after the end of hostilities. However, there is little research on the role of demining. We examine the economic consequences of landmine removal in Mozambique, the only country to transition from heavily contaminated in 1992 to mine-free in 2015. First, we present the self-assembled georeferenced catalog of areas suspected of contamination, along with a detailed record of demining operations. Second, the event-study analysis reveals a robust association between demining activities and subsequent local economic performance, reflected in luminosity. Economic activity does not pick up in the years leading up to clearance, nor does it increase when operators investigate areas mistakenly marked as contaminated in prior surveys. Third, recognizing that landmine removal reshapes transportation access, we use a market-access approach to explore direct and indirect effects. To advance on identification, we isolate changes in market access caused by removing landmines in previously considered safe areas, far from earlier nationwide surveys. Fourth, policy simulations reveal the substantial economywide dividends of clearance, but only when factoring in market-access effects, which dwarf direct productivity links. Additionally, policy counterfactuals uncover significant aggregate costs when demining does not prioritize the unblocking of transportation routes. These results offer insights into the design of demining programs in Ukraine and elsewhere, highlighting the need for centralized coordination and prioritization of areas facilitating commerce. 摘要（中文） 在许多饱受冲突之苦的社区，地雷在敌对行动结束后很长时间内仍影响着数百万人的生活。然而，关于排雷作用的研究却很少。我们考察了莫桑比克排雷的经济后果，该国是唯一一个从1992年重度污染过渡到2015年无雷状态的国家。首先，我们呈现了自行汇编的、经地理坐标标注的疑似污染区域目录，以及排雷作业的详细记录。其次，事件研究分析揭示了排雷活动与随后当地经济表现（以灯光亮度反映）之间存在稳健的关联。在清除作业前的几年里经济活动并未回升，当作业方调查那些在先前勘测中被错误标记为污染的区域时经济活动也没有增加。第三，认识到排雷会重塑交通可达性，我们采用市场可达性方法来探究直接和间接效应。为增强识别性，我们分离出那些通过清除先前被认为安全、远离早期全国性勘测区域中的地雷所引起的市场可达性变化。第四，政策模拟揭示了清除作业带来的可观的全经济范围红利，但只有在计入市场可达性效应时才会显现，而这种效应远超直接的生产率联系。此外，政策反事实分析还揭示出，当排雷未优先打通交通路线时会产生显著的总体成本。这些结果为乌克兰及其他地方排雷项目的设计提供了启示，凸显了集中协调以及优先处理便利商贸区域的必要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a novel way to estimate a portfolio's abnormal price, the percentage gap between price and the present value of dividends computed with a chosen asset pricing model. Raw markdown: cho-2024-putting-the-price-in-asset-pricing Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Putting the Price in Asset Pricing (2024) Paper claim — We propose a novel way to estimate a portfolio's abnormal price, the percentage gap between price and the present value of dividends computed with a chosen asset pricing model. Raw markdown: cho-2024-putting-the-price-in-asset-pricing Bibliographic Record Authors: Cho, T, Polk, C Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13391 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract We propose a novel way to estimate a portfolio's abnormal price, the percentage gap between price and the present value of dividends computed with a chosen asset pricing model. Our method, based on a novel identity, resembles the time-series estimator of abnormal returns, avoids the issues in alternative approaches, and clarifies the role of risk and mispricing in long-horizon returns. We apply our techniques to study the cross-section of price levels relative to the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) and find that a single characteristic, adjusted value, provides a parsimonious model of CAPM-implied abnormal price. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一种估计投资组合异常价格（abnormal price）的新方法，该异常价格是指价格与用所选资产定价模型计算的股利现值之间的百分比差距。我们的方法基于一个新颖的恒等式，类似于异常收益的时间序列估计量，避免了替代方法中的问题，并阐明了风险和错误定价在长期收益中的作用。我们运用这些技术来研究相对于资本资产定价模型（CAPM）的价格水平截面，发现单一特征——调整后价值（adjusted value）——提供了一个关于CAPM隐含异常价格的简洁模型。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Momentum Effect as Part of a Market Equilibrium
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Does the momentum effect arise naturally from the determination of asset prices in market equilibrium? We calibrate a standard endowment model of multiple assets under recursive preferences. Raw markdown: choi-2014-momentum-effect-as-part-of-a-market-equilibrium…
pages.text: Momentum Effect as Part of a Market Equilibrium (2014) Paper claim — Does the momentum effect arise naturally from the determination of asset prices in market equilibrium? We calibrate a standard endowment model of multiple assets under recursive preferences. Raw markdown: choi-2014-momentum-effect-as-part-of-a-market-equilibrium Bibliographic Record Authors: Choi, SM, Kim, H Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109014000234 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Does the momentum effect arise naturally from the determination of asset prices in market equilibrium? We calibrate a standard endowment model of multiple assets under recursive preferences. The momentum effect partly comes from investors' aversion to consumption risks. An unexpected dividend increase generates a positive return and increases the asset's proportion of consumption, raising the correlation between its future dividend growth and consumption growth. This is compensated by a higher expected return, generating the momentum effect. The cross-sectional difference in expected returns is also a key contributor. The quantified model produces sizable momentum profits, often close to the observed profits. 摘要（中文） 动量效应是否自然地源于市场均衡中资产价格的决定？我们在递归偏好下校准了一个包含多种资产的标准禀赋模型。动量效应部分来自投资者对消费风险的厌恶。一次未预期到的股利增加会产生正收益，并提高该资产在消费中的占比，从而提高其未来股利增长与消费增长之间的相关性。这一相关性由更高的预期收益予以补偿，从而产生动量效应。预期收益的横截面差异也是一个关键贡献因素。经量化的模型产生了可观的动量利润，往往接近观测到的利润。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: US political corruption and quarterly conference calls (2024) Paper claim — We find that managers obfuscate during conference calls when their firm's headquarters is in a politically corrupt state, and they do so to shield assets from corrupt officials. Raw markdown: chourou-2024-us-political-corruption-and-quarterly-conference-calls Bibliographic Record Authors: Chourou, L, Hossain, AT, Jha, A Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107108 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract We find that managers obfuscate during conference calls when their firm's headquarters is in a politically corrupt state, and they do so to shield assets from corrupt officials. The positive association between corruption and obfuscation by managers is much stronger when the expropriation risks are higher, such as when the firm (a) does not pay dividends, (b) is making a profit, (c) has more cash, (d) has fewer subsidiaries, and (e) is not making any political contributions. We do not find evidence that managers obfuscate during conference calls to hide their self -dealing. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，当企业总部位于政治腐败的州时，管理者会在电话会议中进行含糊其辞（obfuscate），他们这样做是为了保护资产免受腐败官员的侵占。腐败与管理者含糊其辞之间的正向关联在侵占风险较高时更为强烈，例如当企业（a）不派发股利、（b）正在盈利、（c）拥有较多现金、（d）拥有较少子公司以及（e）没有进行任何政治捐款时。我们没有发现证据表明管理者在电话会议中含糊其辞是为了掩盖其自我交易（self-dealing）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose that it is precisely because firms' repurchases of their own stock through tender offers are associated with large stock-price increases that repurchases are unattractive as a means of distributing cash. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: REPURCHASE PREMIA AS A REASON FOR DIVIDENDS - A DYNAMIC-MODEL OF CORPORATE PAYOUT POLICIES (1994) Paper claim — We propose that it is precisely because firms' repurchases of their own stock through tender offers are associated with large stock-price increases that repurchases are unattractive as a means of distributing cash. Raw markdown: chowdhry-1994-repurchase-premia-as-a-reason-for-dividends-a Bibliographic Record Authors: CHOWDHRY, B, NANDA, V Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/7.2.321 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, stock repurchase) Abstract We propose that it is precisely because firms' repurchases of their own stock through tender offers are associated with large stock-price increases that repurchases are unattractive as a means of distributing cash. As a result, firms distribute some cash in the form of dividend-despite the tax disadvantage-and carry the rest to future periods. However, when their stock is sufficiently undervalued, firms distribute all accumulated cash through stock repurchases. We show that dividends are smoothed and are positively related both to earnings innovations and to previous period's dividends. Also, the stock-price reaction to a repurchase announcement, of a given size, is increasing in the previous period's dividends. 摘要（中文） 我们提出，正是因为企业通过要约收购回购自身股票与大幅股价上涨相关联，回购作为一种分配现金的手段才不具吸引力。因此，企业尽管面临税收劣势，仍以股利形式分配部分现金，并将其余部分结转至未来各期。然而，当其股票被充分低估时，企业会通过股票回购分配所有累积的现金。我们表明，股利是被平滑的，并且与盈余创新以及上一期的股利都正相关。此外，给定规模的回购公告所引起的股价反应，随上一期股利的增加而增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines whether promotion-based tournament incentives affect corporate dividend payouts. Raw markdown: chowdhury-2023-do-tournament-incentives-affect-corporate-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Chowdhury, H, Rahman, S Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Do tournament incentives affect corporate dividend policy? (2023) Paper claim — This paper examines whether promotion-based tournament incentives affect corporate dividend payouts. Raw markdown: chowdhury-2023-do-tournament-incentives-affect-corporate-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Chowdhury, H, Rahman, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2023.106877 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper examines whether promotion-based tournament incentives affect corporate dividend payouts. Using the pay gap between the CEO and non-CEO executives as a proxy for tournament incentives, we find that tournament incentives are negatively related to corporate dividends. Further analyses show that the negative effect is stronger in firms that are financially constrained, have volatility in cash flows and earnings, and operate in less homogeneous industries. We also provide evidence that tournament incen-tives are positively related to payout flexibility. Our findings are consistent with the notion that firms reduce dividends to mitigate potential cash shortfalls associated with increased risk-taking induced by tournament incentives.Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 本文考察基于晋升的锦标赛激励是否影响企业股利支付。以CEO与非CEO高管之间的薪酬差距作为锦标赛激励的代理变量，我们发现锦标赛激励与企业股利呈负相关。进一步分析表明，这一负向效应在受财务约束、现金流和收益波动、以及在同质性较低行业经营的企业中更强。我们还提供证据表明锦标赛激励与支付灵活性呈正相关。我们的发现与如下观点一致：企业减少股利以缓解与锦标赛激励所诱发的风险承担增加相关联的潜在现金短缺。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Despite the direct costs of the tax, its announcement produced a positive revaluation of corporate equity, particularly among lower-payout firms. We interpret this as evidence of a divergence between managerial and shareholder preferences regarding dividend payout policies, consistent with the presence of agency costs. We also find that despite the incentives created by the tax, the actual growth in dividends during 1936 was lower among firms judged more likely to be subject to higher agency costs after controlling for liquidity, debt, and the growth in earnings. 摘要（中文） 1936年，联邦政府出人意料地对企业未分配利润征税。尽管该税具有直接成本，但其宣布产生了企业股权的正向重估，尤其是在低支付企业中。我们将此解释为管理者与股东在股利支付政策偏好上存在分歧的证据，这与代理成本的存在相一致。我们还发现，尽管该税创造了激励，但在控制流动性、债务和盈利增长之后，1936年股利的实际增长在被判定更可能承受更高代理成本的企业中反而更低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. We focus on the conflict between the taxable and retirement accounts of international funds, which face different tradeoffs between dividends and capital gains. In principle, managers could resolve this conflict through dividend arbitrage, but a proprietary database of dividend-arbitrage transactions shows that in practice they cannot. Thus, managers must resolve it through their investment policies. We find robust evidence that managers with more retirement money favor the preferences of retirement investors and further evidence for this view in the difference between U.S. and Canadian funds' portfolio weights. Using a natural experiment based on a ruling by the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, I find that increasing the difficulty of class action suits decreases loan spreads. The effect is stronger for firms with higher institutional ownership, which is consistent with the argument that class actions suits help shareholders extract wealth from creditors when the firm is in bankruptcy. Further analysis shows that the effect is weaker for firms with stronger creditor protection in bankruptcy. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use a variance decomposition approach to examine why aggregate valuation ratios differ across countries. Raw markdown: chue-2015-understanding-cross-country-differences-in-valuation-ratios-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Chue, TK Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING…
pages.text: Understanding Cross-Country Differences in Valuation Ratios: A Variance Decomposition Approach (2015) Paper claim — We use a variance decomposition approach to examine why aggregate valuation ratios differ across countries. Raw markdown: chue-2015-understanding-cross-country-differences-in-valuation-ratios-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Chue, TK Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12127 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We use a variance decomposition approach to examine why aggregate valuation ratios differ across countries. In a cross-section of 22 developed countries from 1980 to 2009, we find that 50 percent of all cross-country differences in the aggregate price-to-book ratio (P/B) can be explained by cross-country differences in expected future five-year profitability. In the second half of our sample period, this percentage exceeds that of the first half, rising to almost 64 percent. Although international differences in accounting standards and conventions may have made earnings from different countries more difficult to compare relative to dividends, we find that it is still cross-country differences in expected future profitability, rather than dividend growth rates, that are more closely related to international differences in valuation ratios. Even among 25 emerging markets, we find that expected future profitability at the five-year horizon can account for 29 percent of all cross-country P/B variations. Our results show that international investors are able to identify substantial cross-country differences in future-earnings prospects and incorporate them into stock market valuations. 摘要（中文） 我们采用方差分解方法，考察总体估值比率为何在国家之间存在差异。在1980至2009年间22个发达国家的横截面中，我们发现总体市账率（P/B）的所有跨国差异中，有50%可由预期未来五年盈利能力的跨国差异来解释。在我们样本期的后半段，这一比例超过了前半段，升至近64%。尽管会计准则和惯例的国际差异可能使不同国家的盈利相比股利更难比较，但我们发现，与国际估值比率差异更密切相关的，仍然是预期未来盈利能力的跨国差异，而非股利增长率。即便在25个新兴市场中，我们也发现五年期预期未来盈利能力可解释所有跨国P/B变动的29%。我们的结果表明，国际投资者能够识别未来盈利前景的重大跨国差异，并将其纳入股票市场估值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We test both the unconditional and conditional Mean Variance Efficiency of the UK stockmarket, paying particular attention to choosing a suitable set of instruments for the conditional version of the model. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: UK stock returns and robust tests of mean variance efficiency (1997) Paper claim — We test both the unconditional and conditional Mean Variance Efficiency of the UK stockmarket, paying particular attention to choosing a suitable set of instruments for the conditional version of the model. Raw markdown: clare-1997-uk-stock-returns-and-robust-tests-of-mean Bibliographic Record Authors: Clare, AD, Smith, PN, Thomas, SH Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1997 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(96)00058-1 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We test both the unconditional and conditional Mean Variance Efficiency of the UK stockmarket, paying particular attention to choosing a suitable set of instruments for the conditional version of the model. By considering more carefully than previous authors the pricing of economic risk within the mean-variance framework we show that certain instruments can enhance the basic model structure. Given the tendency for financial market data to display non-constancy in variance and non-normality we employ the GMM procedure described in Hansen (1982), which requires much weaker distributional assumptions than the more traditional OLS techniques. We discuss forming portfolios of stocks using both size and dividend yield as a criterion to achieve a suitable spread of risk and return, acid find that our conclusions are sensitive both to the method of portfolio formation and to the choice of estimator. This is an important finding given the problem of thin trading associated with the size ordering of UK stocks. We find some support for both the unconditional and conditional version of the CAPM, though we are cautious about our conclusions given the instability of the parameter estimates. 摘要（中文） 我们检验英国股票市场的无条件和条件均值—方差有效性，尤其注意为该模型的条件版本选择一组合适的工具变量。通过比以往作者更审慎地考虑均值—方差框架内经济风险的定价，我们表明某些工具变量能够增强基本的模型结构。鉴于金融市场数据倾向于表现出方差的非恒定性和非正态性，我们采用了Hansen（1982）所描述的GMM方法，该方法所要求的分布假设远弱于更为传统的OLS技术。我们讨论了同时使用规模和股利收益率作为标准来构建股票组合，以实现风险与收益的适当分散，并发现我们的结论既对组合构建方法敏感，也对估计量的选择敏感。鉴于与英国股票按规模排序相关的稀薄交易问题，这是一个重要发现。我们发现了对CAPM的无条件版本和条件版本的一些支持，尽管鉴于参数估计的不稳定性，我们对结论持谨慎态度。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Evidence from analysts' earnings forecasts for domestic and international stock markets (2001) Paper claim — The returns earned by U.S. Raw markdown: claus-2001-equity-premia-as-low-as-three-percent-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Claus, J, Thomas, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00384 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The returns earned by U.S. equities since 1926 exceed estimates derived from theory, from other periods and markets, and from surveys of institutional investors. Rather than examine historic experience, we estimate the equity premium from the discount rate that equates market valuations with prevailing expectations of future flows. For each year between 1985 and 1998, we find that the equity premium is around three percent (or less) in the United States and five other markets. 摘要（中文） 自1926年以来美国股票所获得的收益超过了由理论、由其他时期和市场以及由机构投资者调查所得出的估计。我们没有考察历史经验，而是从使市场估值与当前对未来现金流预期相等的贴现率中估计股权溢价。我们所预测的会计现金流与所预测的股利同构，但使用了更多可获得的信息，并缩小了合理增长率的范围。对于1985至1998年间的每一年，我们发现美国和另外五个市场的股权溢价约为3%（或更低）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Raw markdown: cleary-2006-international-corporate-investment-and-the-relationships-between-financial Bibliographic Record Authors: Cleary, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2005.03.023 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper uses international panel data to examine the interrelationships among some commonly used measures of financial constraint. The analysis reveals the following insights: (1) firms with stronger financial positions are more investment-cash flow sensitive than firms with weaker financial positions even after controlling for size and dividend payout and (2) higher payout firms are more investment-cash flow sensitive than lower payout firms even after controlling for size and financial strength. pages.text: Information dynamics, dividend displacement, conservatism, and earnings measurement: a development of the Ohlson (1995) valuation framework (2013) Paper claim — This paper extends the Ohlson (Contemp Account Res 11, 661-687, 1995) equity valuation framework by demonstrating that dividend displacement continues to hold when dividends have a positive forecast coefficient in the linear abnormal earnings dynamic. Raw markdown: clubb-2013-information-dynamics-dividend-displacement-conservatism-and-earnings-measuremen Bibliographic Record Authors: Clubb, CDB Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-012-9211-x Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(replace, signal) Abstract This paper extends the Ohlson (Contemp Account Res 11, 661-687, 1995) equity valuation framework by demonstrating that dividend displacement continues to hold when dividends have a positive forecast coefficient in the linear abnormal earnings dynamic. The analysis demonstrates that such a predictive role for dividends implies a positive association between cum div book value of equity and the present value of expected abnormal earnings, consistent with both dividend displacement and accounting conservatism. While a signaling role for dividends is ruled out, a link between dividends, expected performance, and equity value is, however, demonstrated. The paper also considers a linear information model where an undefined variable replaces realized abnormal comprehensive earnings as an indicator of future performance. The role of this variable as a predictor of future abnormal comprehensive earnings is highlighted and the special case where it corresponds to recurring abnormal earnings is considered. This latter case provides useful implications for implementation of asset revaluations. 摘要（中文） 本文扩展了Ohlson（Contemp Account Res 11, 661-687, 1995）的股权估值框架，证明了当股利在线性异常盈余动态中具有正的预测系数时，股利替代（dividend displacement）仍然成立。分析表明，股利的这种预测作用意味着含息股权账面价值（cum div book value of equity）与预期异常盈余现值之间存在正相关关系，这与股利替代和会计稳健性都相一致。虽然股利的信号传递作用被排除，但仍证明了股利、预期业绩与股权价值之间的联系。本文还考虑了一个线性信息模型，其中一个未定义的变量取代已实现的异常综合盈余作为未来业绩的指标。该变量作为未来异常综合盈余预测因子的作用得到了强调，并考察了其对应于经常性异常盈余的特殊情形。后一种情形为资产重估的实施提供了有用的启示。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We solve a model with two i.i.d. Raw markdown: cochrane-2008-two-trees Bibliographic Record Authors: Cochrane, JH, Longstaff, FA, Santa-Clara, P Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm059 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes:…
pages.text: Two trees (2008) Paper claim — We solve a model with two i.i.d. Raw markdown: cochrane-2008-two-trees Bibliographic Record Authors: Cochrane, JH, Longstaff, FA, Santa-Clara, P Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm059 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We solve a model with two i.i.d. Lucas trees. Although the corresponding one-tree model produces a constant price-dividend ratio and i.i.d. returns, the two-tree model produces interesting asset-pricing dynamics. Investors want to rebalance their portfolios after any change in value. Because the size of the trees is fixed, prices must adjust to offset this desire. As a result, expected returns, excess returns, and return volatility all vary through time. Returns display serial correlation and are predictable from price-dividend ratios. Return volatility differs from cash-flow volatility, and return shocks can occur without news about cash flows. 摘要（中文） 我们求解了一个具有两只独立同分布Lucas树的模型。尽管相应的单树模型产生恒定的价格-股利比和独立同分布的收益，但双树模型产生了有趣的资产定价动态。投资者希望在任何价值变动后重新平衡其投资组合。由于树的规模是固定的，价格必须进行调整以抵消这种愿望。因此，预期收益、超额收益和收益波动率都随时间变动。收益表现出序列相关性，并可由价格-股利比预测。收益波动率不同于现金流波动率，并且收益冲击可以在没有关于现金流消息的情况下发生。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Two conceptual frameworks may help: first, look directly at the stream of payments that a portfolio and payout policy can produce. Raw markdown: cochrane-2022-portfolios-for-long-term-investors Bibliographic Record Authors: Cochrane, JH Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfab038 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(payout) Abstract How should long-term investors form portfolios in our time-varying, multi-factor and friction-filled world? Two conceptual frameworks may help: first, look directly at the stream of payments that a portfolio and payout policy can produce. Second, include a general equilibrium view of the markets' economic purpose, and the nature of investors' different preferences, risk-taking ability, and function in that equilibrium. These perspectives can rationalize some of investors' behaviors, suggest substantial revisions to standard portfolio theory, and help us to apply portfolio theory in a way that is useful in practice. 摘要（中文） 在我们这个时变的、多因子的、充满摩擦的世界中，长期投资者应如何构建组合？两个概念框架可能有所帮助：第一，直接关注组合和派现政策所能产生的支付流。第二，纳入对市场经济目的以及投资者不同偏好、风险承担能力及其在该均衡中所起作用的一般均衡视角。这些视角可以为投资者的某些行为提供合理解释，对标准组合理论提出实质性修正，并帮助我们以在实践中有用的方式应用组合理论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Bank capital ratios have increased steadily since the financial crisis. Raw markdown: cohen-2016-banks-and-capital-requirements-channels-of-adjustment Bibliographic Record Authors: Cohen, BH, Scatigna, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI:…
pages.text: Banks and capital requirements: Channels of adjustment (2016) Paper claim — Bank capital ratios have increased steadily since the financial crisis. Raw markdown: cohen-2016-banks-and-capital-requirements-channels-of-adjustment Bibliographic Record Authors: Cohen, BH, Scatigna, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2015.09.022 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Bank capital ratios have increased steadily since the financial crisis. For a sample of 101 large banks from advanced and emerging economies, retained earnings account for the bulk of their higher risk-weighted capital ratios, with reductions in risk weights playing a lesser role. On average, banks continued to expand their lending in real terms, though lending contracted among European banks. Lower dividend payouts and (for advanced economy banks) wider lending spreads have contributed to banks' ability to use retained earnings to build capital. Banks that came out of the crisis with higher capital ratios and stronger profitability were able to expand lending more. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 自金融危机以来，银行资本比率稳步上升。对于来自发达和新兴经济体的101家大型银行样本，留存收益构成了其较高风险加权资本比率的主要来源，而风险权重的下降所起的作用较小。平均而言，银行继续按实际值扩大放贷，尽管欧洲银行的放贷有所收缩。较低的股利派现以及（对发达经济体银行而言）更宽的放贷利差，促成了银行能够利用留存收益来积累资本。在危机后拥有较高资本比率和较强盈利能力的银行，能够更多地扩大放贷。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The role of taxes and the interdependence among corporate financial policies: Evidence from a natural experiment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper, we investigate whether and how firms respond to an exogenous tax variation at the investor level by examining their financial decisions following a tax reform for pension funds in Brazil. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The role of taxes and the interdependence among corporate financial policies: Evidence from a natural experiment (2018) Paper claim — In this paper, we investigate whether and how firms respond to an exogenous tax variation at the investor level by examining their financial decisions following a tax reform for pension funds in Brazil. Raw markdown: colombo-2018-the-role-of-taxes-and-the-interdependence-among Bibliographic Record Authors: Colombo, JA, Caldeira, JF Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.09.007 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, law, reform)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, substitut) Abstract In this paper, we investigate whether and how firms respond to an exogenous tax variation at the investor level by examining their financial decisions following a tax reform for pension funds in Brazil. Consistent with the tax-preference theory of dividends, we find that after implementation of the new law, firms tend to distribute more tax-deductible dividends called Interest on Equity (10E) when the largest or second largest shareholder is a pension fund rather than other types of agents. Surprisingly, control firms also increased (but less than treated firms) their tax-deductible dividend payments, probably to attract more institutional investors and to reduce their cost of capital. We also find that treated firms reduced their leverage relative to control firms after the new law, suggesting that equity tax shields and debt tax shields act as substitute financial instruments. These results are robust to falsification tests and an alternative control group of firms based on a Propensity Score Matching procedure. Overall, our evidence suggests that tax is a first-order determinant of corporate financial decisions and firms adjust their policies in consideration of the interdependence among alternative financial instruments. (C) 2017 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 本文通过考察巴西养老基金税制改革后企业的财务决策，研究企业是否以及如何对投资者层面的外生税收变动作出反应。与股利的税收偏好理论一致，我们发现，在新法实施后，当最大或第二大股东是养老基金而非其他类型的主体时，企业倾向于派发更多可税前扣除的股利，即所谓的权益利息（IOE）。令人意外的是，控制组企业也提高了（但幅度小于处理组企业）其可税前扣除的股利支付，这可能是为了吸引更多机构投资者并降低其资本成本。我们还发现，新法实施后，处理组企业相对于控制组企业降低了杠杆，这表明权益税盾与债务税盾是相互替代的财务工具。这些结果对证伪检验以及基于倾向得分匹配程序构建的另一组替代控制组企业均稳健。总体而言，我们的证据表明，税收是企业财务决策的一阶决定因素，企业会考虑各种替代性财务工具之间的相互依赖关系来调整其政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Optimal Investment with Stock Repurchase and Financing as Signals
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — When management has private information it has an incentive to finance investment by issuing a security that is overpriced in the market. Raw markdown: constantinides-1989-optimal-investment-with-stock-repurchase-and-financing-as Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Optimal Investment with Stock Repurchase and Financing as Signals (1989) Paper claim — When management has private information it has an incentive to finance investment by issuing a security that is overpriced in the market. Raw markdown: constantinides-1989-optimal-investment-with-stock-repurchase-and-financing-as Bibliographic Record Authors: Constantinides, GM, Grundy, BD Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1989 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/2.4.445 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract When management has private information it has an incentive to finance investment by issuing a security that is overpriced in the market. The market's valuation of the issued security may lead management either to forego profitable investments or to invest suboptimally. With investment fixed, there exist fully revealing signaling equilibria in which the covenants of the issued claim serve as signals. A straight bond issue cannot provide the signals but a convertible bond issue can. With investment endogenous, fully revealing equilibria exist in which the par value of a straight bond issue and the announced level of investment jointly serve as signals and investment is optimal. The article also investigates the role of a stock repurchase in these equilibria. 摘要（中文） 当管理层拥有私人信息时，它有动机通过发行一种在市场上被高估的证券来为投资融资。市场对所发行证券的估值可能导致管理层要么放弃有利可图的投资，要么进行次优投资。在投资固定的情况下，存在完全揭示的信号均衡，其中所发行索取权的契约条款充当信号。直接债券发行无法提供信号，但可转换债券发行可以。在投资内生的情况下，存在完全揭示的均衡，其中直接债券发行的面值与所宣布的投资水平共同充当信号，且投资是最优的。本文还考察了股票回购在这些均衡中的作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Asset pricing with heterogeneous consumers (1996) Paper claim — Empirical difficulties encountered by representative-consumer models are resolved in an economy with heterogeneity in the form of uninsurable, persistent, and heteroscedastic labor income shocks. Raw markdown: constantinides-1996-asset-pricing-with-heterogeneous-consumers Bibliographic Record Authors: Constantinides, GM, Duffie, D Journal: JOURNAL OF POLITICAL ECONOMY Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1086/262023 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(replace) Abstract Empirical difficulties encountered by representative-consumer models are resolved in an economy with heterogeneity in the form of uninsurable, persistent, and heteroscedastic labor income shocks. Given the joint process of arbitrage-free asset prices, dividends, and aggregate income, satisfying a certain joint restriction, it is shown that this process is supported in the equilibrium of an economy with judiciously modeled income heterogeneity. The Euler equations of consumption in a representative-agent economy are replaced by a set of Euler equations that depend not only on the per capita consumption growth but also on the cross-sectional variance of the individual consumers' consumption growth. 摘要（中文） 代表性消费者模型所遇到的实证困难，在一个具有以不可保险的、持久的和异方差的劳动收入冲击形式存在的异质性的经济中得到解决。给定无套利资产价格、股利和总收入的联合过程（满足某一联合约束），可以证明该过程在一个审慎建模了收入异质性的经济的均衡中得到支撑。代表性主体经济中消费的欧拉方程被一组欧拉方程所取代，这组方程不仅取决于人均消费增长，还取决于个体消费者消费增长的横截面方差。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Raw markdown: cooper-2018-large-dividend-increases-and-leverage Bibliographic Record Authors: Cooper, IA, Lambertides, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.10.011 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This study documents the fact that large dividend increases are followed by a significant increase in leverage, consistent with management increasing the dividend to use up excess debt capacity. However, the leverage increase is not captured by a standard partial adjustment model of leverage. Nor does it reflect variables known to be related to dividend increases, such as firm maturity, investment, and risk. Instead, the dividend increase signals a complex change in the way firms adjust to their leverage target, but it does not signal a change in the target. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究记录了这样一个事实：大幅提高股利之后会伴随杠杆的显著上升，这与管理层通过提高股利来用尽多余债务容量的观点一致。然而，这种杠杆上升并不能被标准的杠杆部分调整模型所捕捉。它也不反映已知与股利增长相关的变量，如企业成熟度、投资和风险。相反，股利增长所传递的是企业向其目标杠杆水平进行调整的方式发生复杂变化的信号，但它并不传递目标本身发生变化的信号。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Early Exercise Decision in American Options with Dividends, Stochastic Volatility, and Jumps (2020) Paper claim — Using a fast numerical technique, we investigate a large database of investors' suboptimal nonexercise of short-maturity American call options on dividend-paying stocks listed on the Dow Jones. Raw markdown: cosma-2020-early-exercise-decision-in-american-options-with-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Cosma, A, Galluccio, S, Pederzoli, P, Scaillet, O Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109018001229 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Using a fast numerical technique, we investigate a large database of investors' suboptimal nonexercise of short-maturity American call options on dividend-paying stocks listed on the Dow Jones. The correct modeling of the discrete dividend is essential for a correct calculation of the early exercise boundary, as confirmed by theoretical insights. Pricing with stochastic volatility and jumps instead of the Black-Scholes-Merton benchmark cuts the amount lost by investors through suboptimal exercise by one-quarter. The remaining three-quarters are largely unexplained by transaction fees and may be interpreted as an opportunity cost for the investors to monitor optimal exercise. 摘要（中文） 我们运用一种快速数值技术，考察了一个庞大数据库，该数据库记录了投资者对道琼斯指数成分股中派息股票短期美式看涨期权的次优不行权行为。正如理论洞见所证实的，对离散股利进行正确建模，对于正确计算提前行权边界至关重要。与Black-Scholes-Merton基准相比，采用带随机波动率和跳跃的定价模型，可将投资者因次优行权而损失的金额削减四分之一。剩下的四分之三在很大程度上无法由交易费用解释，可被诠释为投资者为监控最优行权所付出的机会成本。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The Effect of Institutional Ownership on Payout Policy: Evidence from Index Thresholds (2016) Paper claim — We show that higher institutional ownership causes firms to pay more dividends. Raw markdown: crane-2016-the-effect-of-institutional-ownership-on-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Crane, AD, Michenaud, S, Weston, JP Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhw012 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We show that higher institutional ownership causes firms to pay more dividends. Our identification relies on a discontinuity in ownership around Russell index thresholds. Our estimates indicate that a one-percentage-point increase in institutional ownership causes a $7 million (8%) increase in dividends. We also find differences in shareholder proposals and voting patterns that suggest that even nonactivist institutions play an important role in monitoring firm behavior. The effect of institutional ownership on dividends is stronger for firms with higher expected agency costs. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，更高的机构持股会促使企业支付更多股利。我们的识别依赖于罗素（Russell）指数阈值附近所有权的断点。我们的估计表明，机构持股增加一个百分点，会使股利增加700万美元（8%）。我们还发现，股东提案和投票模式方面的差异表明，即使是非积极主义机构，在监督企业行为中也发挥了重要作用。机构持股对股利的影响，对于预期代理成本较高的企业更强。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Signaling managerial optimism through stock dividends and stock splits: A reexamination of the retained earnings hypothesis (2005) Paper claim — The retained earnings hypothesis predicts that stock distributions accounted for by reducing retained earnings are a more credible signal of managerial optimism than stock distributions that do not reduce retained earnings. Raw markdown: crawford-2005-signaling-managerial-optimism-through-stock-dividends-and-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Crawford, D, Franz, DR, Lobo, GJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000001861 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract The retained earnings hypothesis predicts that stock distributions accounted for by reducing retained earnings are a more credible signal of managerial optimism than stock distributions that do not reduce retained earnings. This study examines the costs of false signaling that are a necessary pre-condition for the hypothesis and finds them to be generally very small, calling the validity of the hypothesis into question for most firms. However, prior studies report broad-based market evidence consistent with the hypothesis. To resolve this apparent inconsistency, the study replicates and extends tests of the retained earnings hypothesis contained in three prior studies, and shows that the findings in support of the retained earnings hypothesis can be attributed to specification and measurement choices that bias the results in favor of the hypothesis. The support for the retained earnings hypothesis is weaker when the sources of the bias are removed. However, some support for the hypothesis remains for a limited set of distributing firms. 摘要（中文） 留存收益假说预测，通过减少留存收益来核算的股票分配，是比不减少留存收益的股票分配更可信的管理层乐观信号。本研究考察了作为该假说必要前提条件的虚假信号成本，发现它们总体上非常小，从而对该假说对大多数企业的有效性提出了质疑。然而，先前的研究报告了与该假说相一致的广泛市场证据。为解决这一表面上的不一致，本研究复制并扩展了三项先前研究中所包含的对留存收益假说的检验，并表明支持留存收益假说的发现可归因于使结果偏向该假说的设定和度量选择。当消除偏差来源后，对留存收益假说的支持较弱。然而，对于一小部分进行分配的企业，仍有一些证据支持该假说。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA) on U.S. Raw markdown: crawford-2024-the-effect-of-the-tax-cuts-and-jobs Bibliographic Record Authors: Crawford, S, Markarian, G Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI:…
pages.text: The effect of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 on corporate investment1 (2024) Paper claim — This study examines the impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA) on U.S. Raw markdown: crawford-2024-the-effect-of-the-tax-cuts-and-jobs Bibliographic Record Authors: Crawford, S, Markarian, G Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2024.102619 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This study examines the impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA) on U.S. corporate investment. We examine U.S. firms and compare them to Canadian firms from 2010 to 2019 in a multivariate firm fixed-effects difference-in-differences analysis. Our results indicate that investment increases for U.S. firms relative to Canadian firms after the tax cuts. We also find that capital intensive and financially constrained firms increase investment the most. We explore how the TCJA impacted firm payouts and find some evidence that the tax cuts are associated with increased dividends. The paper contributes to the literature by providing evidence on the effects of the TCJA on corporate investment which have been debated extensively by politicians, journalists, tax policy experts, and academics. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察2017年《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）对美国企业投资的影响。我们考察美国企业，并在一个多元固定效应双重差分分析中将其与2010至2019年的加拿大企业进行比较。我们的结果表明，减税后美国企业相对于加拿大企业的投资有所增加。我们还发现，资本密集型和受融资约束的企业投资增加最多。我们探究了TCJA如何影响企业派现，并发现了一些证据表明减税与股利增加相关联。本文通过提供关于TCJA对企业投资影响的证据，为文献作出了贡献，而这一问题曾被政界人士、记者、税收政策专家和学者广泛争论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: ARE DIVIDEND OMISSIONS TRULY THE CRUELEST CUT OF ALL
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Signaling and agency cost theories of dividend policy predict that omissions will produce a larger average decline in equity values than will reductions of less than 100 percent. Raw markdown: cristie-1994-are-dividend-omissions-truly-the-cruelest-cut-of…
pages.text: ARE DIVIDEND OMISSIONS TRULY THE CRUELEST CUT OF ALL (1994) Paper claim — Signaling and agency cost theories of dividend policy predict that omissions will produce a larger average decline in equity values than will reductions of less than 100 percent. Raw markdown: cristie-1994-are-dividend-omissions-truly-the-cruelest-cut-of Bibliographic Record Authors: CRISTIE, WG Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1994 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, signal) Abstract Signaling and agency cost theories of dividend policy predict that omissions will produce a larger average decline in equity values than will reductions of less than 100 percent. However, this paper identifies a U-shaped relation between announcement day risk-adjusted excess returns and the percentage decline in dividends. The significantly smaller than expected price reaction to dividend omissions cannot be traced to growth opportunities, nor to a tendency for firms to delay omission announcements. While omitting firms provide higher per share dividends within five years of the dividend action than do firms that severely reduce payments, future dividends are unrelated to the market's response. 摘要（中文） 股利政策的信号理论和代理成本理论预测，股利完全取消相比不足100%的削减会带来更大的股权价值平均下降。然而，本文发现公告日风险调整超额收益与股利下降百分比之间存在U形关系。对股利取消显著小于预期的价格反应，既不能归因于成长机会，也不能归因于企业推迟发布取消公告的倾向。虽然取消股利的企业在股利行动后五年内提供的每股股利高于那些大幅削减派发的企业，但未来股利与市场反应无关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper we test for the presence of rational bubbles in the NASDAQ stock market index over the period 1994:06-2003:11 by means of a methodology based on fractional processes. Raw markdown: cuado-2005-a-test-for-rational-bubbles-in-the-nasdaq Bibliographic…
pages.text: A test for rational bubbles in the NASDAQ stock index: A fractionally integrated approach (2005) Paper claim — In this paper we test for the presence of rational bubbles in the NASDAQ stock market index over the period 1994:06-2003:11 by means of a methodology based on fractional processes. Raw markdown: cuado-2005-a-test-for-rational-bubbles-in-the-nasdaq Bibliographic Record Authors: Cuñado, J, Gil-Alana, LA, de Gracia, FP Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2004.10.003 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract In this paper we test for the presence of rational bubbles in the NASDAQ stock market index over the period 1994:06-2003:11 by means of a methodology based on fractional processes. The results suggest that the existence of bubbles depends on the sampling frequency used in the analysis. We cannot reject the unit root hypothesis when using monthly data on price-dividend ratios, which according to the present value model suggests the existence of rational bubbles. However, we reject this hypothesis in favor of fractional alternatives when using daily and weekly data. This might be explained by the temporal aggregation and/or the sample sizes used in the application. (c) 2004 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在本文中，我们借助一种基于分数过程的方法，检验了1994年6月至2003年11月期间纳斯达克股票市场指数中是否存在理性泡沫。结果表明，泡沫的存在取决于分析中所使用的抽样频率。当使用价格-股利比的月度数据时，我们无法拒绝单位根假设，根据现值模型这表明存在理性泡沫。然而，当使用日度和周度数据时，我们拒绝这一假设而支持分数备择假设。这或许可以用应用中所使用的时间聚合和/或样本量来解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Are Companies Offloading Risk onto Employees in Times of Uncertainty? Insights from Corporate Pension Plans
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate how firms adjust corporate pension plans in response to economic policy uncertainty (EPU). Raw markdown: cumming-2024-are-companies-offloading-risk-onto-employees-in-times Bibliographic Record Authors: Cumming, D, Lu, FY, Xu, LM, Yu, CF Journal:…
pages.text: Are Companies Offloading Risk onto Employees in Times of Uncertainty? Insights from Corporate Pension Plans (2024) Paper claim — We investigate how firms adjust corporate pension plans in response to economic policy uncertainty (EPU). Raw markdown: cumming-2024-are-companies-offloading-risk-onto-employees-in-times Bibliographic Record Authors: Cumming, D, Lu, FY, Xu, LM, Yu, CF Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-024-05655-6 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, information asymmetry) Abstract We investigate how firms adjust corporate pension plans in response to economic policy uncertainty (EPU). Using a sample of US-listed firms, we find that firms increase pension underfunding levels when facing higher EPU. The result is robust to controlling for pension portfolio returns, discount rates, plan sizes, pension liability, numbers of employees, other macroeconomic factors, difference-in-differences and instrumental variable estimation, and additional evidence of pension risk-shifting. Further analysis reveals that financial distress and information asymmetry induced through EPU are the potential channels. The effect is stronger for firms having CEOs being excessively paid, using cash flow as a performance metric in CEO compensation, paying high dividends, and having short-term institutional investors, whereas the presence of unions, positive corporate culture, and social capital alleviate the effect. Notably, managers, not shareholders, appear to be the party reaping the benefits. Our findings suggest that firms may shift risk to employees in response to heightened uncertainty and institutional characteristics play a moderating role in this crucial business ethics issue. 摘要（中文） 我们考察企业如何调整公司养老金计划以应对经济政策不确定性（EPU）。使用美国上市公司样本，我们发现企业在面临更高EPU时会提高养老金的资金不足水平。在控制养老金组合收益、贴现率、计划规模、养老金负债、员工人数、其他宏观经济因素、双重差分和工具变量估计，以及养老金风险转移的额外证据之后，这一结果依然稳健。进一步分析揭示，由EPU引发的财务困境和信息不对称是潜在的渠道。对于以下企业，这一效应更强：CEO获得过度薪酬、在CEO薪酬中使用现金流作为业绩指标、派发高股利以及拥有短期机构投资者的企业；而工会的存在、积极的企业文化和社会资本则会缓解这一效应。值得注意的是，获益的一方似乎是管理者而非股东。我们的发现表明，企业可能在不确定性加剧时将风险转移给员工，而制度特征在这一重要的商业伦理问题中发挥调节作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does stakeholder orientation mitigate shareholder-employee conflicts? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the influence of stakeholder orientation on the shareholder-employee conflict characterized by the propensity of firms to engage in share purchases and leave employee pensions underfunded. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Does stakeholder orientation mitigate shareholder-employee conflicts? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment (2025) Paper claim — This paper examines the influence of stakeholder orientation on the shareholder-employee conflict characterized by the propensity of firms to engage in share purchases and leave employee pensions underfunded. Raw markdown: cumming-2025-does-stakeholder-orientation-mitigate-shareholder-employee-conflicts-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Cumming, D, Lu, FY, Xu, LM, Yu, CF Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2025.102736 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, institution)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract This paper examines the influence of stakeholder orientation on the shareholder-employee conflict characterized by the propensity of firms to engage in share purchases and leave employee pensions underfunded. Utilizing the enactment of US state-level constituency statutes, we find that firms in states that have adopted constituency statutes exhibit a weaker share repurchasepension underfunding propensity, especially those with high default risk. The mechanism is through union intervention and labor representatives on boards. The effect is moderated for firms headquartered in high-social-capital regions, operating with higher human capital, possessing a history of employee litigation, and maintaining lower and short-horizon institutional ownership. After implementing constituency statutes, share repurchase announcements are associated with lower returns for firms with higher pension deficits. Our findings suggest that stakeholder orientation can discipline the shareholder-employee conflict. 摘要（中文） 本文考察利益相关者导向对股东—员工冲突的影响，这种冲突以企业进行股份回购却使员工养老金资金不足的倾向为特征。利用美国州一级利益相关者法规（constituency statutes）的颁布，我们发现，位于已采纳利益相关者法规的州的企业表现出较弱的股份回购—养老金资金不足倾向，尤其是那些违约风险高的企业。其机制是通过工会干预和董事会中的劳工代表实现的。对于总部位于高社会资本地区、以更高人力资本运营、拥有员工诉讼历史以及维持较低且短期机构持股的企业，这一效应有所缓和。在实施利益相关者法规之后，对于养老金赤字较高的企业，股份回购公告与更低的收益相关联。我们的发现表明，利益相关者导向能够约束股东—员工冲突。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: TAX MANAGEMENT AND INVESTMENT STRATEGIES OF PROPERTY-LIABILITY INSURERS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The Tax Reform Act (TRA) of 1986 reduced the incentives for institutional investors to participate in the tax exempt bond market. Raw markdown: cummins-1994-tax-management-and-investment-strategies-of-property-liability Bibliographic Record Authors: CUMMINS, JD,…
pages.text: TAX MANAGEMENT AND INVESTMENT STRATEGIES OF PROPERTY-LIABILITY INSURERS (1994) Paper claim — The Tax Reform Act (TRA) of 1986 reduced the incentives for institutional investors to participate in the tax exempt bond market. Raw markdown: cummins-1994-tax-management-and-investment-strategies-of-property-liability Bibliographic Record Authors: CUMMINS, JD, GRACE, E Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00078-6 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, reform)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The Tax Reform Act (TRA) of 1986 reduced the incentives for institutional investors to participate in the tax exempt bond market. This paper develops a model of profit maximization incorporating the TRA provisions applicable to property-liability (PL) insurers. The theory predicts that PL insurers will use underwriting losses to shelter taxable investment income and invest the balance of their portfolios in tax favored securities. Our empirical evidence reveals that insurers continued to invest in tax exempts following the TRA, suggesting that implicit tax rates are low enough to attract insurers into the long-term tax exempt market. However, insurers reduced the proportions of income derived from tax exempt interest and dividends following the TRA. 摘要（中文） 1986年的《税收改革法案》（TRA）降低了机构投资者参与免税债券市场的激励。本文构建了一个纳入了适用于财产—责任（PL）保险公司的TRA条款的利润最大化模型。该理论预测，PL保险公司将利用承保损失来庇护应税投资收入，并将其组合的余额投资于税收优惠证券。我们的经验证据揭示，保险公司在TRA之后继续投资于免税债券，这表明隐含税率低到足以吸引保险公司进入长期免税市场。然而，保险公司在TRA之后降低了来自免税利息和股利的收入比例。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Stock Options and Total Payout
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper, we examine how stock option usage affects total corporate payout. Raw markdown: cuny-2009-stock-options-and-total-payout Bibliographic Record Authors: Cuny, CJ, Martin, GS, Puthenpurackal, JJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS…
pages.text: Stock Options and Total Payout (2009) Paper claim — In this paper, we examine how stock option usage affects total corporate payout. Raw markdown: cuny-2009-stock-options-and-total-payout Bibliographic Record Authors: Cuny, CJ, Martin, GS, Puthenpurackal, JJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109009090115 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract In this paper, we examine how stock option usage affects total corporate payout. Using fixed-effects panel data estimators on various samples of ExecuComp firms from 1993 to 2005, we find the higher the executive stock options, the lower the total payout, ceteris paribus. We also find some evidence that firms increase payouts through repurchases in order to offset earnings per share dilution that occurs due to usage of executive and non-executive stock options. However, incentives from not having dividend protection for options appear to dominate those from antidilution, resulting in lower total payout for firms with higher options usage. 摘要（中文） 本文考察股票期权的使用如何影响公司总派现。使用固定效应面板数据估计量，对1993年至2005年ExecuComp公司的各类样本进行估计，我们发现，在其他条件相同的情况下，高管股票期权越高，总派现越低。我们还发现了一些证据表明，公司通过回购来增加派现，以抵消因使用高管和非高管股票期权而产生的每股收益稀释。然而，期权不受股利保护所带来的激励似乎主导了反稀释所带来的激励，从而导致期权使用较高的公司总派现较低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Financial expert CEOs: CEO's work experience and firm's financial policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study CEOs with a career background in finance. Raw markdown: custdio-2014-financial-expert-ceos-ceo-s-work-experience-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Custódio, C, Metzger, D Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2014.06.002…
pages.text: Financial expert CEOs: CEO's work experience and firm's financial policies (2014) Paper claim — We study CEOs with a career background in finance. Raw markdown: custdio-2014-financial-expert-ceos-ceo-s-work-experience-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Custódio, C, Metzger, D Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2014.06.002 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We study CEOs with a career background in finance. Firms with financial expert CEOs hold less cash, more debt, and engage in more share repurchases. Financial expert CEOs are more financially sophisticated: they are less likely to use one companywide discount rate instead of a project-specific one, they manage financial policies more actively, and their firm investments are less sensitive to cash flows. Financial expert CEOs are able to raise external funds even when credit conditions are tight, and they were more responsive to the dividend and capital gains tax cuts in 2003. Analyzing CEO-firm matching based on financial experience, we find that financial expert CEOs tend to be hired by more mature firms. Our results are consistent with employment histories of CEOs being relevant for corporate policies. However, we cannot formally rule out that our findings are partly explained by endogenous CEO-firm matching. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究具有金融职业背景的CEO。拥有金融专家型CEO的企业持有更少现金、更多债务，并进行更多股份回购。金融专家型CEO在财务上更为老练：他们更不可能使用单一的全公司统一贴现率而非项目特定贴现率，他们更积极地管理财务政策，且其企业投资对现金流的敏感性更低。金融专家型CEO即便在信贷条件紧张时也能筹集外部资金，并且他们对2003年的股利和资本利得减税反应更为积极。分析基于金融经验的CEO—企业匹配，我们发现金融专家型CEO往往被更成熟的企业所雇用。我们的结果与CEO的雇佣历史对企业政策具有相关性相一致。然而，我们无法正式排除我们的发现部分是由内生的CEO—企业匹配所解释的这一可能性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: PROMPT CORRECTIVE ACTION AND BANK EFFORTS TO RECOVER FROM UNDERCAPITALIZATION
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study empirically examines the likelihood and timing of bank recoveries from positions of undercapitalization. Raw markdown: dahl-1995-prompt-corrective-action-and-bank-efforts-to-recover Bibliographic Record Authors: DAHL, D, SPIVEY, MF Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: PROMPT CORRECTIVE ACTION AND BANK EFFORTS TO RECOVER FROM UNDERCAPITALIZATION (1995) Paper claim — This study empirically examines the likelihood and timing of bank recoveries from positions of undercapitalization. Raw markdown: dahl-1995-prompt-corrective-action-and-bank-efforts-to-recover Bibliographic Record Authors: DAHL, D, SPIVEY, MF Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1995 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00055-8 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This study empirically examines the likelihood and timing of bank recoveries from positions of undercapitalization. Our findings indicate that: (1) There appears to be only a limited capacity for banks to 'correct' positions of undercapitalization by growth limitations or dividend restrictions; (2) the impact of profitability on recovery is greater the longer a bank remains undercapitalized; and (3) equity infusions are the primary mechanism by which banks can recapitalize quickly. This evidence is relevant to regulators in their implementation of the FDIC Improvement Act of 1991, which requires that undercapitalized banks take 'prompt corrective actions' to recapitalize quickly under threat of early closure. 摘要（中文） 本研究实证考察了银行从资本不足状态中恢复的可能性和时机。我们的发现表明：（1）银行通过增长限制或股利限制来"纠正"资本不足状态的能力似乎有限；（2）盈利能力对恢复的影响随银行处于资本不足状态的时间越长而越大；以及（3）注入股权是银行能够快速重新资本化的主要机制。这一证据与监管者实施1991年《联邦存款保险公司改进法案》相关，该法案要求资本不足的银行采取"迅速纠正行动"以在早期关闭的威胁下快速重新资本化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Direct foreign ownership, institutional investors, and firm characteristics
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper, we characterize foreign ownership using a dataset of ownership and attributes of Swedish firms. Raw markdown: dahlquist-2001-direct-foreign-ownership-institutional-investors-and-firm-characteristics Bibliographic Record Authors: Dahlquist, M,…
pages.text: Direct foreign ownership, institutional investors, and firm characteristics (2001) Paper claim — In this paper, we characterize foreign ownership using a dataset of ownership and attributes of Swedish firms. Raw markdown: dahlquist-2001-direct-foreign-ownership-institutional-investors-and-firm-characteristics Bibliographic Record Authors: Dahlquist, M, Robertsson, G Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(00)00092-1 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract In this paper, we characterize foreign ownership using a dataset of ownership and attributes of Swedish firms. The analysis reveals that foreigners show a preference for large firms, firms paying low dividends, and firms with large cash positions on their balance sheets. When we further analyze the preference for large firms, we find that market liquidity and presence in international markets, measured through export sales or listings on other exchanges, seem to characterize foreign holdings better than firm size alone. Foreigners also tend to underweight firms with a dominant owner. Importantly, we demonstrate that most of the features associated with foreign ownership are driven by the fact that foreign investors typically are mutual funds or other institutional investors. Hence. we identify an institutional investor bias rather than a foreign investor bias. Finally, using ownership data on a country level, we conclude that the results are particularly strong among U.S. investors, who comprise the largest institutions among foreign investors. (C) 2001 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification. G1; G15. 摘要（中文） 在本文中，我们利用瑞典企业所有权和属性的数据集刻画外国所有权。分析揭示，外国人偏好大型企业、支付低股利的企业以及资产负债表上现金头寸较大的企业。当我们进一步分析对大型企业的偏好时，我们发现市场流动性以及在国际市场中的存在（通过出口销售或在其他交易所上市来衡量），似乎比企业规模本身更能刻画外国持股。外国人还倾向于低配拥有支配性股东的企业。重要的是，我们证明与外国所有权相关的大多数特征，是由外国投资者通常为共同基金或其他机构投资者这一事实所驱动的。因此，我们识别出的是机构投资者偏向，而非外国投资者偏向。最后，利用国家层面的所有权数据，我们得出结论，这些结果在美国投资者中尤为显著，他们构成了外国投资者中最大的机构。JEL分类：G1；G15。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The determinants of organizational form changes: evidence and implications from real estate
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study changes in the real estate industry among organizational forms with varying degrees of restrictiveness and document the associated changes in profitability, free cash flow, debt, dividends, and investment policies. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The determinants of organizational form changes: evidence and implications from real estate (1997) Paper claim — We study changes in the real estate industry among organizational forms with varying degrees of restrictiveness and document the associated changes in profitability, free cash flow, debt, dividends, and investment policies. Raw markdown: damodaran-1997-the-determinants-of-organizational-form-changes-evidence-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Damodaran, A, John, K, Liu, CH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1997 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(97)00015-9 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract We study changes in the real estate industry among organizational forms with varying degrees of restrictiveness and document the associated changes in profitability, free cash flow, debt, dividends, and investment policies. All troubled firms in our sample move to a more flexibile organizational structure, with subsequent reductions in dividends, improvements in performance, and increases in asset sales and investments. Healthy firms that move to a tighter structure have larger free cash flows before the change; they increase dividends, reduce free cash flows and improve profitability after the change. We document evidence of tax considerations in organizational changes. 摘要（中文） 我们研究房地产行业在具有不同限制程度的组织形式之间的变化，并记录了随之而来的盈利能力、自由现金流、债务、股利和投资政策的变化。我们样本中所有陷入困境的公司都转向了更为灵活的组织结构，随后股利减少、业绩改善，资产出售和投资增加。转向更为紧密结构的健康公司在变化之前拥有更大的自由现金流；在变化之后，它们增加股利、减少自由现金流并改善盈利能力。我们记录了组织变化中存在税收考量的证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Employment protection and share repurchases: Evidence from wrongful discharge laws
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use the staggered adoption of Wrongful Discharge Laws (WDLs) by U.S. Raw markdown: dang-2021-employment-protection-and-share-repurchases-evidence-from-wrongful Bibliographic Record Authors: Dang, VA, De Cesari, A, Phan, H Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: Employment protection and share repurchases: Evidence from wrongful discharge laws (2021) Paper claim — We use the staggered adoption of Wrongful Discharge Laws (WDLs) by U.S. Raw markdown: dang-2021-employment-protection-and-share-repurchases-evidence-from-wrongful Bibliographic Record Authors: Dang, VA, De Cesari, A, Phan, H Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.102036 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, law)；股利政策(buyback, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We use the staggered adoption of Wrongful Discharge Laws (WDLs) by U.S. state courts as a quasi natural experiment to examine the causal impact of firing costs and employment protection on corporate payouts. We find that the greater employment protection imposed by WDLs leads to higher share repurchases, and that this finding is more pronounced among firms with greater financial resources and better governance. Our results support the argument that as higher firing costs enhance employee entrenchment and encourage rent extraction behavior, firms have an incentive to increase share buybacks to mitigate a wealth transfer from shareholders to employees. 摘要（中文） 我们利用美国州法院对《不当解雇法》（WDLs）的分阶段采纳作为一项准自然实验，考察解雇成本与雇佣保护对企业支付的因果影响。我们发现，WDLs带来的更强雇佣保护导致更高的股份回购，且这一发现在财务资源更充裕、公司治理更好的企业中更为显著。我们的结果支持这样一种论点：由于更高的解雇成本增强了员工的固守地位并鼓励了寻租行为，企业有动机增加股份回购，以缓解财富从股东向员工的转移。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.text: Optimal Portfolios under Time-Varying Investment Opportunities, Parameter Uncertainty, and Ambiguity Aversion (2020) Paper claim — We study the implications of predictability on the optimal asset allocation of ambiguity-averse long-term investors and analyze the term structure of the multivariate risk-return trade-off considering parameter uncertainty. Raw markdown: dangl-2020-optimal-portfolios-under-time-varying-investment-opportunities-parameter Bibliographic Record Authors: Dangl, T, Weissensteiner, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109019000425 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract We study the implications of predictability on the optimal asset allocation of ambiguity-averse long-term investors and analyze the term structure of the multivariate risk-return trade-off considering parameter uncertainty. We calibrate the model to real returns of U.S. stocks, long-term bonds, cash, real estate, and gold using the term spread and the dividend-price ratio as additional predictive variables, and we show that over long horizons, the optimal asset allocation is significantly influenced by the covariance structure induced by estimation errors. The ambiguity-averse long-term investor optimally tilts his or her portfolio toward a seemingly inefficient portfolio, which shows maximum robustness against estimation errors. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了可预测性对厌恶模糊性的长期投资者最优资产配置的影响，并在考虑参数不确定性的情况下分析了多变量风险-收益权衡的期限结构。我们使用期限利差和股利-价格比作为附加预测变量，将模型校准至美国股票、长期债券、现金、房地产和黄金的实际收益，我们表明在长期视野下，最优资产配置显著受到估计误差所引致的协方差结构的影响。厌恶模糊性的长期投资者会最优地将其投资组合向一个看似无效的组合倾斜，该组合表现出对估计误差的最大稳健性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Monetary Policy and Reaching for Income (2021) Paper claim — Using data on individual portfolio holdings and on mutual fund flows, we find that low interest rates lead to significantly higher demand for income-generating assets such as high-dividend stocks and high-yield bonds. Raw markdown: daniel-2021-monetary-policy-and-reaching-for-income Bibliographic Record Authors: Daniel, K, Garlappi, L, Xiao, KR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13004 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Using data on individual portfolio holdings and on mutual fund flows, we find that low interest rates lead to significantly higher demand for income-generating assets such as high-dividend stocks and high-yield bonds. We argue that this "reaching-for-income" phenomenon is driven by investors who follow the "living off income" rule-of-thumb. Our empirical analysis shows that this preference for current income affects both household portfolio choices and the prices of income-generating assets. In addition, we explore the implications of reaching for income for capital allocation and the effectiveness of monetary policy. 摘要（中文） 利用个人组合持有以及共同基金资金流的数据，我们发现低利率会导致对高股利股票和高收益债券等创收资产的需求显著上升。我们论证，这种"追逐收入"（reaching-for-income）现象是由遵循"依靠收入生活"经验法则的投资者所驱动的。我们的实证分析表明，这种对当期收入的偏好既影响家庭组合选择，也影响创收资产的价格。此外，我们探讨了追逐收入对资本配置以及货币政策有效性的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Analysts' use of dividends in earnings forecasts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates the association between current dividends and analysts' subsequent earnings forecast errors. Raw markdown: das-2024-analysts-use-of-dividends-in-earnings-forecasts Bibliographic Record Authors: Das, S, Schaberl, PD, Sen, PK Journal: REVIEW…
pages.text: Analysts' use of dividends in earnings forecasts (2024) Paper claim — This paper investigates the association between current dividends and analysts' subsequent earnings forecast errors. Raw markdown: das-2024-analysts-use-of-dividends-in-earnings-forecasts Bibliographic Record Authors: Das, S, Schaberl, PD, Sen, PK Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-022-09735-8 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper investigates the association between current dividends and analysts' subsequent earnings forecast errors. This investigation is motivated by the evidence on analyst optimism and Ohlson's (1991, 1995) fundamental valuation theory that dividends displace future permanent earnings. For the sample period 1985-2016, we document that current dividends are positively correlated with analysts' future forecast errors, suggesting that analysts potentially ignore the displacement effect of dividends on future earnings. Consistent with theory, this association persists in settings with stable dividends, (i.e., where dividends have limited or no signaling implications) and varies predictably with dividend payouts and cost of capital. We also find that this empirical regularity that analysts do not fully incorporate the effect of dividends on future earnings provides opportunities for arbitrage. More interestingly, we find that the strength of the association between dividends and analysts' forecast errors has declined over the sample period; this decline appears to correspond with the underlying change in the discount rate over time. The finding that analysts' do not fully incorporate the implications of current dividends on future earnings is consistent with previously documented inefficiencies in analysts' use of publicly available information. However, such a systematic association with dividends also suggests that it may be a source of the persistence in analysts' optimistic bias and thus offers new insights into analyst behavior. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了当期股利与分析师随后盈余预测误差之间的关联。这一考察的动机来自关于分析师乐观主义的证据以及Ohlson（1991, 1995）的基本面估值理论，即股利替代未来永久性盈余。对于1985至2016年的样本期，我们记录到当期股利与分析师未来预测误差正相关，这表明分析师可能忽视了股利对未来盈余的替代效应。与理论相一致，这种关联在股利稳定（即股利具有有限或没有信号含义）的情形下持续存在，并随股利支付和资本成本可预测地变化。我们还发现，分析师未能充分纳入股利对未来盈余影响的这一实证规律为套利提供了机会。更有趣的是，我们发现，在样本期内，股利与分析师预测误差之间关联的强度有所下降；这一下降似乎与贴现率随时间的潜在变化相对应。分析师未能充分纳入当期股利对未来盈余影响这一发现，与此前记录的分析师在使用公开可得信息时的低效率相一致。然而，与股利如此系统性的关联也表明，它可能是分析师乐观偏差持续存在的一个来源，从而为分析师行为提供了新的洞见。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Marginal Value of Cash: Structural Estimates from a Model with Financing and Agency Frictions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — How much value does an additional dollar of cash create for a firm? It is generally recognized that the marginal value of cash (MVC) can either exceed or fall below one dollar. Raw markdown: dasgupta-2025-the-marginal-value-of-cash-structural-estimates-from…
pages.text: The Marginal Value of Cash: Structural Estimates from a Model with Financing and Agency Frictions (2025) Paper claim — How much value does an additional dollar of cash create for a firm? It is generally recognized that the marginal value of cash (MVC) can either exceed or fall below one dollar. Raw markdown: dasgupta-2025-the-marginal-value-of-cash-structural-estimates-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Dasgupta, S, Li, D, Li, EXN Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2022.01013 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract How much value does an additional dollar of cash create for a firm? It is generally recognized that the marginal value of cash (MVC) can either exceed or fall below one dollar. Estimates of MVC can guide corporate cash and payout policy, indicate the quality of governance, and make a firm a target for takeover or activism. Yet the existing methods of estimation lack a rigorous theoretical foundation and often provide implausibly high or low estimates. In this paper, we provide a formulation of MVC and structurally estimate the MVC based on a model that encompasses the important determinants for the choice of cash savings, including financing and agency costs. We find that firms with large cash and capital stocks have lower marginal value of cash, whereas the relationship between leverage and marginal value of cash is hump shaped. Two quasi-natural experiments validate the MVC estimates. 摘要（中文） 一美元额外现金能为企业创造多少价值？人们普遍认识到，现金的边际价值（MVC）既可能超过、也可能低于一美元。对MVC的估计可以指导公司现金和派现政策、指示治理质量，并使一家企业成为收购或维权行动的目标。然而，现有的估计方法缺乏严格的理论基础，且常常提供高得或低得不合理的估计。在本文中，我们提供了MVC的一个表述，并基于一个涵盖现金储蓄选择重要决定因素（包括融资成本和代理成本）的模型对MVC进行结构性估计。我们发现，拥有大量现金和资本存量的企业其现金边际价值较低，而杠杆与现金边际价值之间的关系呈驼峰形。两个准自然实验验证了MVC估计值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: When cutting dividends is not bad news: The case of optional stock dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We provide evidence on optional stock dividends, a mechanism that allows shareholders to choose between cash dividends and the equivalent number of new shares in lieu of dash. Raw markdown: david-2016-when-cutting-dividends-is-not-bad-news-the Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: When cutting dividends is not bad news: The case of optional stock dividends (2016) Paper claim — We provide evidence on optional stock dividends, a mechanism that allows shareholders to choose between cash dividends and the equivalent number of new shares in lieu of dash. Raw markdown: david-2016-when-cutting-dividends-is-not-bad-news-the Bibliographic Record Authors: David, T, Ginglinger, E Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.07.008 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract We provide evidence on optional stock dividends, a mechanism that allows shareholders to choose between cash dividends and the equivalent number of new shares in lieu of dash. We find that, in contrast to dividend cuts, shareholders do not view this option as bad news. When firms offer optional stock dividend in lieu of cash dividends, the market does not react negatively. Facing the choice between cash and stock dividend, shareholders choose 55% of the total dividend in the form of stock dividend. Our findings suggest that firms that are more committed to paying dividends are more likely to offer optional stock dividends to their shareholders. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们就可选股票股利（optional stock dividends）提供证据，这是一种允许股东在现金股利与等额新股（以代替现金）之间进行选择的机制。我们发现，与股利削减相反，股东并不将这一选择权视为坏消息。当公司提供可选股票股利以代替现金股利时，市场不会做出负面反应。在面对现金与股票股利的选择时，股东选择将股利总额的55%以股票股利的形式领取。我们的发现表明，更致力于支付股利的公司更可能向其股东提供可选股票股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
