pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use market data on corporate bonds and equities to measure the value of U.S. Raw markdown: davydiuk-2023-how-risky-are-us-corporate-assets Bibliographic Record Authors: Davydiuk, T, Richard, S, Shaliastovich, I, Yaron, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2023…
pages.text: How Risky Are US Corporate Assets? (2023) Paper claim — We use market data on corporate bonds and equities to measure the value of U.S. Raw markdown: davydiuk-2023-how-risky-are-us-corporate-assets Bibliographic Record Authors: Davydiuk, T, Richard, S, Shaliastovich, I, Yaron, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13196 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We use market data on corporate bonds and equities to measure the value of U.S. corporate assets and their payouts to investors. In contrast to equity dividends, total corporate payouts are highly volatile, turn negative when corporations raise capital, and are acyclical. At the same time, corporate asset returns are similar to returns on equity, and both are exposed to fluctuations in economic growth. To reconcile this evidence, we argue that acyclical but volatile net repurchases mask the exposure of total payouts' cash components to economic growth risks. We develop an asset pricing framework to quantitatively illustrate this economic channel. 摘要（中文） 我们使用公司债券和股票的市场数据来衡量美国公司资产的价值及其对投资者的派现。与股票股利不同，公司派现总额高度波动，在公司筹集资本时转为负值，且是非周期性的。与此同时，公司资产收益与股票收益相似，两者都暴露于经济增长的波动。为调和这一证据，我们认为，非周期性但波动的净回购掩盖了派现总额中现金部分对经济增长风险的暴露。我们发展了一个资产定价框架，以定量地阐明这一经济渠道。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend distributions and closed-end fund discounts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Empirical support for the hypothesis that closed-end fund discounts are related to overhanging tax liabilities has been mixed. Raw markdown: day-2011-dividend-distributions-and-closed-end-fund-discounts Bibliographic Record Authors: Day, TE, Li, GZ, Xu, YX Journal:…
pages.text: Dividend distributions and closed-end fund discounts (2011) Paper claim — Empirical support for the hypothesis that closed-end fund discounts are related to overhanging tax liabilities has been mixed. Raw markdown: day-2011-dividend-distributions-and-closed-end-fund-discounts Bibliographic Record Authors: Day, TE, Li, GZ, Xu, YX Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.01.004 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Empirical support for the hypothesis that closed-end fund discounts are related to overhanging tax liabilities has been mixed. We introduce a new approach to testing this hypothesis by examining changes in discount levels following distributions of dividends and capital gains. Since distributions reduce future shareholder tax liabilities, the tax liability hypothesis implies that closed-end fund discounts should decline following distributions. Focusing on changes in discounts isolates this tax effect by eliminating the impact of other fund-specific factors on discount levels. Our results support the tax liability hypothesis, showing that short-run fluctuations in discounts are directly affected by taxable distributions. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 对于封闭式基金折价与悬置税负相关这一假说，实证支持一直不一。我们引入了一种检验该假说的新方法，即考察股利和资本利得分配之后折价水平的变化。由于分配会减少未来股东的税负，税负假说意味着封闭式基金折价应在分配之后下降。聚焦于折价的变化，通过消除其他基金特有因素对折价水平的影响，从而分离出这一税收效应。我们的结果支持税负假说，表明折价的短期波动直接受到应税分配的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a dynamic model of a firm facing agency costs of free cash flow and external financing costs, and derive an explicit solution for the firm's optimal balance sheet dynamics. Raw markdown: dcamps-2011-free-cash-flow-issuance-costs-and-stock-prices…
pages.text: Free Cash Flow, Issuance Costs, and Stock Prices (2011) Paper claim — We develop a dynamic model of a firm facing agency costs of free cash flow and external financing costs, and derive an explicit solution for the firm's optimal balance sheet dynamics. Raw markdown: dcamps-2011-free-cash-flow-issuance-costs-and-stock-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Décamps, JP, Mariotti, T, Rochet, JC, Villeneuve, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2011.01680.x Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract We develop a dynamic model of a firm facing agency costs of free cash flow and external financing costs, and derive an explicit solution for the firm's optimal balance sheet dynamics. Financial frictions affect issuance and dividend policies, the value of cash holdings, and the dynamics of stock prices. The model predicts that the marginal value of cash varies negatively with the stock price, and positively with the volatility of the stock price. This yields novel insights on the asymmetric volatility phenomenon, on risk management policies, and on how business cycles and agency costs affect the volatility of stock returns. 摘要（中文） 我们构建了一个动态模型，刻画了一家企业同时面临自由现金流代理成本与外部融资成本的情形，并推导出企业最优资产负债表动态的显式解。金融摩擦影响企业的发行政策与股利政策、现金持有的价值以及股价的动态变化。该模型预测现金的边际价值与股价负相关，与股价波动率正相关。这为理解非对称波动率现象、风险管理政策以及经济周期和代理成本如何影响股票收益波动率提供了新的洞见。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies managerial compensation, financial reporting, and dividend policies of the seven major domestic steel producers during requests for union concessions. Raw markdown: deangelo-1991-union-negotiations-and-corporate-policy-a-study-of Bibliographic…
pages.text: UNION NEGOTIATIONS AND CORPORATE-POLICY - A STUDY OF LABOR CONCESSIONS IN THE DOMESTIC STEEL-INDUSTRY DURING THE 1980S (1991) Paper claim — This paper studies managerial compensation, financial reporting, and dividend policies of the seven major domestic steel producers during requests for union concessions. Raw markdown: deangelo-1991-union-negotiations-and-corporate-policy-a-study-of Bibliographic Record Authors: DEANGELO, H, DEANGELO, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1991 DOI: 10.1016/0304-405X(91)90025-F Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper studies managerial compensation, financial reporting, and dividend policies of the seven major domestic steel producers during requests for union concessions. Substantial layoffs, reported losses, and sacrifices by nonunion stakeholders buttressed managers' case for union concessions. From 1980 to 1988, sample firms reduced their work force by about 300,000 (almost two-thirds) and annual wage payments from $16.1 to $8.6 billion. Reported income is lower during union negotiations, controlling for cash flows, as is managerial pay, with average CEO salary plus bonus declining 18%. Dividend reductions and white-collar pay cuts are substantial, pervasive, and clustered during union negotiations. 摘要（中文） 本文研究七家主要国内钢铁生产商在提出工会让步要求期间的高管薪酬、财务报告和股利政策。大规模裁员、报告亏损以及非工会利益相关者的牺牲，强化了管理者要求工会让步的理由。从1980年到1988年，样本公司将其劳动力减少了约30万人（几乎减少三分之二），年度工资支付从161亿美元降至86亿美元。在控制现金流的情况下，报告收入在工会谈判期间较低，管理者薪酬亦然，CEO平均工资加奖金下降了18%。股利削减和白领减薪幅度大、范围广，且集中出现在工会谈判期间。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: DIVIDENDS AND LOSSES (1992) Paper claim — An annual loss is essentially a necessary condition for dividend reductions in firms with established earnings and dividend records: 50.9% of 167 NYSE firms with losses during 1980-1985 reduced dividends, versus 1.0% of 440 firms without losses. Raw markdown: deangelo-1992-dividends-and-losses Bibliographic Record Authors: DEANGELO, H, DEANGELO, L, SKINNER, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2328998 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract An annual loss is essentially a necessary condition for dividend reductions in firms with established earnings and dividend records: 50.9% of 167 NYSE firms with losses during 1980-1985 reduced dividends, versus 1.0% of 440 firms without losses. As hypothesized by Miller and Modigliani, dividend reductions depend on whether earnings include unusual items that are likely to temporarily depress income. Dividend reductions are more likely given greater current losses, less negative unusual items, and more persistent earnings difficulties. Dividend policy has information content in that knowledge that a firm has reduced dividends improves the ability of current earnings to predict future earnings. 摘要（中文） 对于拥有稳定盈利和股利记录的公司而言，出现年度亏损基本上是削减股利的必要条件：在1980至1985年期间出现亏损的167家纽约证券交易所公司中，有50.9%削减了股利，而在440家未出现亏损的公司中，这一比例仅为1.0%。正如Miller和Modigliani所假设的，股利削减取决于盈利中是否包含可能暂时压低收入的非常规项目。当前亏损越大、非常规项目的负面程度越小、盈利困难越持久，股利削减的可能性就越大。股利政策具有信息含量，因为得知一家公司削减了股利，能够提高当前盈利对未来盈利的预测能力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the signaling content of managers' dividend decisions for 145 NYSE firms whose annual earnings decline after nine or more consecutive years of growth. Raw markdown: deangelo-1996-reversal-of-fortune-dividend-signaling-and-the-disappearance Bibliographic…
pages.text: Reversal of fortune - Dividend signaling and the disappearance of sustained earnings growth (1996) Paper claim — We study the signaling content of managers' dividend decisions for 145 NYSE firms whose annual earnings decline after nine or more consecutive years of growth. Raw markdown: deangelo-1996-reversal-of-fortune-dividend-signaling-and-the-disappearance Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L, Skinner, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1016/0304-405X(95)00850-E Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We study the signaling content of managers' dividend decisions for 145 NYSE firms whose annual earnings decline after nine or more consecutive years of growth. Using a variety of model specifications and definitions of favorable dividend signals, we find virtually no support for the notion that dividend decisions help identify firms with superior future earnings. Dividends tend not to be reliable signals because (i) a behavioral bias (overoptimism) leads managers to overestimate future earnings when growth prospects fade; and (ii) managers make only modest cash commitments when they increase dividends, undermining the reliability of such signals. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了145家纽约证券交易所公司在连续九年或更长时间的增长后年度盈余下降时，管理者股利决策的信号内容。使用各种模型设定和有利股利信号的定义，我们几乎没有发现支持股利决策有助于识别未来盈余卓越的公司这一观点的证据。股利往往不是可靠的信号，因为（i）一种行为偏差（过度乐观）导致管理者在增长前景消退时高估未来盈余；以及（ii）管理者在增加股利时只作出适度的现金承诺，这削弱了此类信号的可靠性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Controlling stockholders and the disciplinary role of corporate payout policy: a study of the Times Mirror Company (2000) Paper claim — The Times Mirror Company, a NYSE-listed Fortune 500 firm controlled for 100 years by the Chandler family, hired an industry outsider as CEO in 1995 following an extended period of poor operating and stock price performance under non-family management. Raw markdown: deangelo-2000-controlling-stockholders-and-the-disciplinary-role-of-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(00)00039-8 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract The Times Mirror Company, a NYSE-listed Fortune 500 firm controlled for 100 years by the Chandler family, hired an industry outsider as CEO in 1995 following an extended period of poor operating and stock price performance under non-family management. This change was apparently an unintended consequence of actions taken by old management to fund its capital expansion plans while satisfying the family's desire for dividends. Specifically, in 1994 old management agreed to (1) sell TM's cable business and reinvest most of the $1.3 billion proceeds in new technology, and (2) maintain the Chandlers' dividends while radically cutting those to minority stockholders. While Wall Street reacted favorably to the cable sale, it punished TM's stock when it later learned about management's reinvestment plans. Shortly thereafter TM's board brought in a noted financial disciplinarian, who as CEO substantially increased stockholder value by terminating low return investments and distributing free cash flow. While pressure to pay dividends and monitoring by large block stockholders ultimately improved TM's performance, the path to this outcome was slow and circuitous, so that these disciplinary forces were weaker than theory typically implies. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G35; G32. 摘要（中文） 时代镜报公司（The Times Mirror Company）是一家在纽约证券交易所上市的《财富》500强企业，由钱德勒（Chandler）家族控制了100年，在非家族管理层执掌期间经历了长期的经营和股价表现不佳，遂于1995年聘请了一位行业外部人士担任首席执行官。这一变化显然是旧管理层为其资本扩张计划筹资、同时满足家族对股利的渴望而采取的行动所导致的意外后果。具体而言，1994年旧管理层同意：(1) 出售时代镜报的有线电视业务，并将13亿美元收益的大部分再投资于新技术；(2) 维持钱德勒家族的股利，同时大幅削减对中小股东的股利。虽然华尔街对有线电视业务的出售反应良好，但当后来得知管理层的再投资计划时，却重挫了时代镜报的股价。不久之后，时代镜报董事会引入了一位著名的财务纪律执行者，他作为首席执行官通过终止低回报投资和分配自由现金流，大幅提升了股东价值。虽然支付股利的压力以及大股东的监督最终改善了时代镜报的业绩，但通向这一结果的道路缓慢而曲折，因此这些约束力量比理论通常所暗示的更弱。JEL分类：G35; G32。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper documents that (1) special dividends were once commonly paid by NYSE firms, but are now rarely paid; (2) firms typically paid specials almost as predictably as they paid regular dividends; (3) despite the dramatic overall decline in specials, the…
pages.text: Special dividends and the evolution of dividend signaling (2000) Paper claim — This paper documents that (1) special dividends were once commonly paid by NYSE firms, but are now rarely paid; (2) firms typically paid specials almost as predictably as they paid regular dividends; (3) despite the dramatic overall decline in specials, the incidence of very large specials increased in recent years; and (4) special dividends were not displaced by stock repurchases. Raw markdown: deangelo-2000-special-dividends-and-the-evolution-of-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L, Skinner, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(00)00060-X Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal, substitut) Abstract This paper documents that (1) special dividends were once commonly paid by NYSE firms, but are now rarely paid; (2) firms typically paid specials almost as predictably as they paid regular dividends; (3) despite the dramatic overall decline in specials, the incidence of very large specials increased in recent years; and (4) special dividends were not displaced by stock repurchases. Most plausibly, small specials disappeared because their predictability made them close substitutes for regular dividend signals, while large specials survived because their sheer size automatically differentiates them from regulars. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G35; D82. 摘要（中文） 本文记录了：(1)特别股利曾经普遍由纽交所企业支付，但现在很少支付；(2)企业支付特别股利的可预测性几乎与支付常规股利一样高；(3)尽管特别股利总体上急剧下降，但近年来极大额特别股利的发生率有所上升；以及(4)特别股利并未被股票回购所取代。最合理的解释是，小额特别股利消失是因为其可预测性使其成为常规股利信号的近似替代品，而大额特别股利得以存续是因为其庞大的规模自动将其与常规股利区分开来。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend policy and the earned/contributed capital mix: a test of the life-cycle theory
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Consistent with a life-cycle theory of dividends, the fraction of publicly traded industrial firms that pay dividends is high when retained earnings are a large portion of total equity (and of total assets) and falls to near zero when most equity is contributed…
pages.text: Dividend policy and the earned/contributed capital mix: a test of the life-cycle theory (2006) Paper claim — Consistent with a life-cycle theory of dividends, the fraction of publicly traded industrial firms that pay dividends is high when retained earnings are a large portion of total equity (and of total assets) and falls to near zero when most equity is contributed rather than earned. Raw markdown: deangelo-2006-dividend-policy-and-the-earned-contributed-capital-mix Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L, Stulz, RM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.07.005 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Consistent with a life-cycle theory of dividends, the fraction of publicly traded industrial firms that pay dividends is high when retained earnings are a large portion of total equity (and of total assets) and falls to near zero when most equity is contributed rather than earned. We observe a highly significant relation between the decision to pay dividends and the earned/contributed capital mix, controlling for profitability, growth, firm size, total equity, cash balances, and dividend history, a relation that also holds for dividend initiations and omissions. In our regressions, the mix of earned/contributed capital has a quantitatively greater impact than measures of profitability and growth opportunities. We document a massive increase in firms with negative retained earnings (from 11.8% of industrials in 1978 to 50.2% in 2002). Controlling for the earned/contributed capital mix, firms with negative retained earnings show virtually no change in their propensity to pay dividends from the mid-1970s to 2002, while those whose earned equity makes them reasonable candidates to pay dividends have a propensity reduction that is twice the overall reduction in Fama and French [2000, Journal of Financial Economics 76, 549-582]. Finally, our simulations show that, if well-established firms had not paid dividends, their cash balances would be enormous and their long-term debt trivial, thus granting extreme discretion to managers of these mature firms. (c) 2006 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 与股利的生命周期理论相一致，当留存收益占总股权（及总资产）的很大部分时，支付股利的公开交易工业企业的比例很高，而当大部分股权是缴入而非赚取时，这一比例降至接近于零。我们观察到支付股利的决策与赚取/缴入资本比之间存在高度显著的关系，同时控制了盈利能力、增长、公司规模、总股权、现金余额和股利历史，这一关系对于股利首次发放和取消也成立。在我们的回归中，赚取/缴入资本比在数量上的影响大于盈利能力和增长机会的度量。我们记录到留存收益为负的公司大幅增加（从1978年占工业企业的11.8%增至2002年的50.2%）。在控制赚取/缴入资本比后，留存收益为负的公司从1970年代中期到2002年支付股利的倾向几乎没有变化，而那些赚取股权使其成为支付股利合理候选者的公司的倾向下降幅度是Fama和French（2000，《金融经济学杂志》76, 549-582）中总体下降幅度的两倍。最后，我们的模拟表明，如果成熟的老牌公司不曾支付股利，其现金余额将极其庞大而长期债务微不足道，从而赋予这些成熟公司的管理者极大的自由裁量权。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The irrelevance of the MM dividend irrelevance theorem
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Contrary to Miller and Modigliani [1961. Raw markdown: deangelo-2006-the-irrelevance-of-the-mm-dividend-irrelevance-theorem Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.03.003…
pages.text: The irrelevance of the MM dividend irrelevance theorem (2006) Paper claim — Contrary to Miller and Modigliani [1961. Raw markdown: deangelo-2006-the-irrelevance-of-the-mm-dividend-irrelevance-theorem Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.03.003 Relevance score: 12.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, rule, standard)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract Contrary to Miller and Modigliani [1961. Dividend policy, growth, and the valuation of shares. Journal of Business 34, 411-433], payout policy is not irrelevant and investment policy is not the sole determinant of value, even in frictionless markets. MM ask "Do companies with generous distribution policies consistently sell at a premium above those with niggardly payouts?" But MM's analysis does not address this question because the joint effect of their assumptions is to mandate 100% free cash flow payout in every period, thereby rendering "niggardly payouts" infeasible and forcing distributions to a global optimum. Irrelevance obtains. but in an economically vacuous sense because the firm's opportunity set is artificially constrained to payout policies that fully distribute free cash flow. When MM's assumptions are relaxed to allow retention, payout policy matters in exactly the same sense that investment policy does. Moreover (i) the standard Fisherian model is empirically refutable, predicting that firms will make large payouts in present value terms, (ii) only when payout policy is optimized will the present value of distributions equal the PV of project cash flows, (iii) the NPV rule for investments is not sufficient to ensure value maximization, rather an analogous rule for payout policy is also necessary, and (iv) Black's [1976. The dividend puzzle. Journal of Portfolio Management 2, 5-8] "dividend puzzle" is a non-puzzle because it is rooted in the mistaken idea that MM's irrelevance theorem applies to payout/retention decisions, which it does not. (c) 2005 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 与米勒和莫迪利亚尼（Miller and Modigliani，1961，《股利政策、成长与股份估值》，《商业杂志》34, 411-433）相反，即使在无摩擦市场中，支付政策也并非无关紧要，投资政策也并非价值的唯一决定因素。MM问道："分配政策慷慨的公司，其售价是否始终比支付吝啬的公司更高？"但MM的分析并未回答这个问题，因为他们假设的联合效应是强制每一期100%地支付自由现金流，从而使"吝啬的支付"不可行，并迫使分配趋向全局最优。无关性成立，但这是在一种经济上空洞的意义上成立的，因为企业的机会集被人为地限制在完全分配自由现金流的支付政策上。当放松MM的假设以允许留存时，支付政策的重要性与投资政策完全相同。此外：(i) 标准的费雪模型在实证上是可反驳的，它预测企业将做出现值意义上的大额支付；(ii) 只有当支付政策被优化时，分配的现值才等于项目现金流的现值；(iii) 投资的净现值（NPV）法则不足以确保价值最大化，还必须有一个类似的支付政策法则；以及 (iv) 布莱克（Black，1976，《股利之谜》，《投资组合管理杂志》2, 5-8）的"股利之谜"是一个伪命题，因为它植根于一个错误的观念，即MM的无关性定理适用于支付/留存决策，而事实上并不适用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Corporate financial policy: What really matters? (2021) Paper claim — Reliable access to funding, as in Myers and Majluf (1984), is what really matters, but there are nontrivial indeterminacies in how such access is arranged and in the debt, cash-balance, and payout components of financial policy. Raw markdown: deangelo-2021-corporate-financial-policy-what-really-matters Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.101925 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Reliable access to funding, as in Myers and Majluf (1984), is what really matters, but there are nontrivial indeterminacies in how such access is arranged and in the debt, cash-balance, and payout components of financial policy. These inferences are from a corporate "twins" comparison study of the financial policies of Henry Ford at Ford Motor Co. and Alfred P. Sloan, Jr. at General Motors Corp. The documented testimony of Ford and Sloan indicates that both focused on funding their business, with debt as a funding tool, not an element of an optimized leverage ratio. Their financial policies differ in five important respects, including (i) the use of debt versus large cash balances to meet funding needs and (ii) a commitment to paying large dividends versus a strong aversion to payouts. The data also point to the importance of the inability of managers to identify optimal policies with reliable precision. 摘要（中文） 如Myers和Majluf（1984）所述，可靠的资金获取渠道才是真正重要的，但在如何安排这种获取渠道以及财务政策的债务、现金余额和派现构成方面存在着并非微不足道的不确定性。这些推论来自一项关于福特汽车公司的Henry Ford与通用汽车公司的Alfred P. Sloan Jr.财务政策的公司“双胞胎”比较研究。Ford和Sloan有据可查的证词表明，二者都专注于为其业务融资，将债务作为一种融资工具，而非最优杠杆比率的一个要素。他们的财务政策在五个重要方面存在差异，包括：(i) 使用债务还是大量现金余额来满足资金需求，以及 (ii) 承诺派发大量股利还是对派现有强烈的厌恶。数据还指出了管理者无法以可靠精度识别最优政策这一点的重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Agency cost of free cash flow, capital allocation, and payouts (2025) Paper claim — Jensen's (1986) analysis of the agency costs of free cash flow radically transformed our understanding of corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: deangelo-2025-agency-cost-of-free-cash-flow-capital-allocation Bibliographic Record Authors: DeAngelo, H, Kahle, K, Skinner, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2025.104117 Relevance score: 11.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract Jensen's (1986) analysis of the agency costs of free cash flow radically transformed our understanding of corporate payout policy. This paper details the main pre-Jensen advances in the payout literature, explains how his analysis profoundly altered the way financial economists view payout policy, and discusses prominent regularities that provide real-world texture for understanding the importance of his insights about payout policy. These regularities include: (i) the dominance (measured as a percent of value or earnings) of the public equity markets by firms in the distribution phase of the corporate lifecycle; (ii) changes since the 1980s in aggregate cash payouts, the profitability of payers, payout rates, and the set of firms that dominate the payout supply; and (iii) the recent politicization of share repurchases. 摘要（中文） 詹森（Jensen，1986）对自由现金流代理成本的分析彻底改变了我们对企业支付政策的理解。本文详述了詹森之前支付文献中的主要进展，解释了他的分析如何深刻改变了金融经济学家看待支付政策的方式，并讨论了为理解他关于支付政策洞见之重要性提供现实质感的若干显著规律。这些规律包括：(i) 处于企业生命周期分配阶段的企业在公共股权市场中的主导地位（以价值或盈利的百分比衡量）；(ii) 自20世纪80年代以来，总现金支付、支付企业的盈利能力、支付率以及主导支付供给的企业集合的变化；以及 (iii) 近来股份回购的政治化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Can companies reduce the volatility and increase the liquidity of their stocks by trading them? In the context of the Italian stock market, where companies have far more leeway to sell as well as buy their own stocks than in the U.S., the answer is yes. Raw…
pages.text: Stock repurchases and treasury share sales: Do they stabilize price and enhance liquidity? (2011) Paper claim — Can companies reduce the volatility and increase the liquidity of their stocks by trading them? In the context of the Italian stock market, where companies have far more leeway to sell as well as buy their own stocks than in the U.S., the answer is yes. Raw markdown: decesari-2011-stock-repurchases-and-treasury-share-sales-do-they Bibliographic Record Authors: De Cesari, A, Espenlaub, S, Khurshed, A Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.08.002 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase, stock repurchase) Abstract Can companies reduce the volatility and increase the liquidity of their stocks by trading them? In the context of the Italian stock market, where companies have far more leeway to sell as well as buy their own stocks than in the U.S., the answer is yes. We examine the effects of trading (open-market share repurchases and treasury shares sales) on liquidity (bid-ask spread) and volatility (return variance). Further, we examine the impact of shareholder approvals of repurchase programs on liquidity and volatility. We find clear evidence that trading increases liquidity and reduces volatility. These results are consistent with our analysis of the motives Italian companies give for making share repurchases. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 公司能否通过交易自身股票来降低其股价波动性并提高流动性？在意大利股票市场的背景下——那里公司在出售和买入自身股票方面比在美国拥有更大的回旋余地——答案是肯定的。我们检验了交易（公开市场股份回购和库存股出售）对流动性（买卖价差）和波动性（收益方差）的影响。此外，我们检验了股东批准回购计划对流动性和波动性的影响。我们发现明确的证据表明交易增加了流动性并降低了波动性。这些结果与我们对意大利公司进行股份回购所给出动机的分析相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend changes and stock price informativeness
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate how private information in stock prices impacts quarterly dividend changes. Raw markdown: decesari-2015-dividend-changes-and-stock-price-informativeness Bibliographic Record Authors: De Cesari, A, Huang-Meier, W Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: Dividend changes and stock price informativeness (2015) Paper claim — We investigate how private information in stock prices impacts quarterly dividend changes. Raw markdown: decesari-2015-dividend-changes-and-stock-price-informativeness Bibliographic Record Authors: De Cesari, A, Huang-Meier, W Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2015.08.004 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We investigate how private information in stock prices impacts quarterly dividend changes. We find that the positive relationship between past returns and current dividend changes strengthens when returns convey more private information. This finding is robust to the use of several price informativeness measures and the inclusion of managerial private information and stock over-valuation measures. Managers seem to learn new information from stock prices that they use when deciding on their dividend policy. This study highlights private information in stock prices as an important determinant of dividend policy and contributes to the literature on the real effects of financial markets. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了股价中的私有信息如何影响季度股利变动。我们发现过去收益与当期股利变动之间的正向关系在收益传递更多私有信息时会增强。这一发现对使用若干价格信息量度量以及纳入管理者私有信息和股票高估度量都是稳健的。管理者似乎从股价中学到了新信息，并在决定其股利政策时加以运用。本研究强调股价中的私有信息是股利政策的一个重要决定因素，并为关于金融市场实体经济效应的文献做出了贡献。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate how corporate payout policy is influenced by executive incentives, i.e. Raw markdown: decesari-2015-executive-incentives-and-payout-policy-empirical-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: De Cesari, A, Ozkan, N Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING &…
pages.text: Executive incentives and payout policy: Empirical evidence from Europe (2015) Paper claim — We investigate how corporate payout policy is influenced by executive incentives, i.e. Raw markdown: decesari-2015-executive-incentives-and-payout-policy-empirical-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: De Cesari, A, Ozkan, N Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2014.12.011 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract We investigate how corporate payout policy is influenced by executive incentives, i.e. stock and option holdings, stock option deltas and stock-based pay-performance sensitivity for 1,650 publicly listed firms from the UK, Germany, France, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain, over the period from 2002 to 2009. Our results show that executive stock option holdings and stock option deltas are associated with lower dividend payments in our sample of European countries, where we do not observe any presence of dividend protection for executive stock options. We find that this relationship is mainly driven by exercisable stock options and by options that are in the money. Additionally, we observe that executive stock option holdings and stock option deltas have a negative impact on total payout, suggesting that executives do not substitute share repurchases for dividends. Furthermore, the fraction of share repurchases in total payout increases as executive stock option holdings and stock option deltas increase. Finally, our results show that executive share ownership and stock-based pay-performance sensitivity may mitigate agency conflicts by significantly increasing the level of total payout. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察企业支付政策如何受到高管激励（即股票和期权持有、股票期权德尔塔以及基于股票的薪酬-业绩敏感性）的影响，样本为2002年至2009年期间来自英国、德国、法国、意大利、荷兰和西班牙的1,650家公开上市企业。我们的结果表明，在我们的欧洲国家样本中，高管股票期权持有和股票期权德尔塔与更低的股利支付相关，而我们在这些样本中未观察到任何对高管股票期权的股利保护。我们发现，这一关系主要由可行权期权和实值期权驱动。此外，我们观察到高管股票期权持有和股票期权德尔塔对总支付具有负面影响，这表明高管不会用股份回购替代股利。而且，随着高管股票期权持有和股票期权德尔塔的增加，回购在总支付中所占的比例上升。最后，我们的结果表明，高管持股和基于股票的薪酬-业绩敏感性可能通过显著提高总支付水平来缓解代理冲突。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Subjective Cash Flow and Discount Rate Expectations (2021) Paper claim — Why do stock prices vary? Using survey forecasts, we find that cash flow growth expectations explain most movements in the S&P 500 price-dividend and price-earnings ratios, accounting for at least 93% and 63% of their variation. Raw markdown: delao-2021-subjective-cash-flow-and-discount-rate-expectations Bibliographic Record Authors: Delao, R, Myers, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13016 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Why do stock prices vary? Using survey forecasts, we find that cash flow growth expectations explain most movements in the S&P 500 price-dividend and price-earnings ratios, accounting for at least 93% and 63% of their variation. These expectations comove strongly with price ratios, even when price ratios do not predict future cash flow growth. In comparison, return expectations have low volatility and small comovement with price ratios. Short-term, rather than long-term, expectations account for most price ratio variation. We propose an asset pricing model with beliefs about earnings growth reversal that accurately replicates these cash flow growth expectations and dynamics. 摘要（中文） 股票价格为何变动？使用调查预测，我们发现现金流增长预期解释了标普500指数价格—股利比率和价格—盈余比率的大部分变动，分别占其变动的至少93%和63%。这些预期与价格比率强烈共同变动，即便在价格比率并不预测未来现金流增长时也是如此。相比之下，收益预期的波动性较低，与价格比率的共同变动也较小。是短期预期而非长期预期解释了价格比率的大部分变动。我们提出了一个资产定价模型，其中包含对盈余增长反转的信念，该模型准确地复现了这些现金流增长预期及其动态。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Share repurchases and institutional supply
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Consistent with the predictions of Brennan and Thakor's (1990) model of shareholder preferences, we find that, on average, institutional shareholders are net sellers during share repurchases. Raw markdown: delisle-2014-share-repurchases-and-institutional-supply…
pages.text: Share repurchases and institutional supply (2014) Paper claim — Consistent with the predictions of Brennan and Thakor's (1990) model of shareholder preferences, we find that, on average, institutional shareholders are net sellers during share repurchases. Raw markdown: delisle-2014-share-repurchases-and-institutional-supply Bibliographic Record Authors: DeLisle, RJ, Morscheck, JD, Nofsinger, JR Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.05.010 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, standard)；股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(information asymmetry, signal) Abstract Consistent with the predictions of Brennan and Thakor's (1990) model of shareholder preferences, we find that, on average, institutional shareholders are net sellers during share repurchases. After controlling for liquidity provision and characteristics investing, we find that a one standard deviation increase in share repurchases during a given quarter is associated with a 0.11 standard deviation decrease in institutional investor demand. We estimate that 37% of the inverse relation is attributed to institutional investors executing liquidity provision strategies, 8% is explained by institutions reacting to the investment characteristics signaled by a repurchasing firm. We attribute the majority, 55%, to the information asymmetry between institutions and individual investors. This work is one of the first to exploit the SEC mandate requiring firms to report the actual number of shares they repurchase each quarter, beginning in 2004. Using actual number of shares repurchased, we find evidence of institutional investors increasing their selling as firms increase their repurchasing. This finding is robust to models of endogeneity and autocorrelation in share repurchases and institutional investor trading. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 与Brennan和Thakor（1990）关于股东偏好的模型预测一致，我们发现平均而言机构股东在股份回购期间是净卖出者。在控制了流动性提供和特征投资之后，我们发现某一季度股份回购增加一个标准差与机构投资者需求下降0.11个标准差相关。我们估计这种反向关系中37%归因于机构投资者执行流动性提供策略，8%可由机构对回购企业所传递的投资特征作出反应来解释。我们将大多数（55%）归因于机构与个人投资者之间的信息不对称。这项工作是首批利用SEC自2004年起要求企业报告其每季度实际回购股份数量这一规定的研究之一。使用实际回购股份数量，我们发现证据表明机构投资者随着企业增加回购而增加其卖出。这一发现对股份回购和机构投资者交易中内生性和自相关的模型都稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Optimal security design and dynamic capital structure in a continuous-time agency model (2006) Paper claim — We derive the optimal dynamic contract in a continuous-time principal-agent setting, and implement it with a capital structure (credit line, long-term debt, and equity) over which the agent controls the payout policy. Raw markdown: demarzo-2006-optimal-security-design-and-dynamic-capital-structure-in Bibliographic Record Authors: DeMarzo, PM, Sannikov, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2006.01002.x Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(payout)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract We derive the optimal dynamic contract in a continuous-time principal-agent setting, and implement it with a capital structure (credit line, long-term debt, and equity) over which the agent controls the payout policy. While the project's volatility and liquidation cost have little impact on the firm's total debt capacity, they increase the use of credit versus debt. Leverage is nonstationary, and declines with past profitability. The firm may hold a compensating cash balance while borrowing (at a higher rate) through the credit line. Surprisingly, the usual conflicts between debt and equity (asset substitution, strategic default) need not arise. 摘要（中文） 我们在连续时间委托代理框架下推导出最优动态合约，并通过一种资本结构（信贷额度、长期债务和股权）加以实现，代理人对该资本结构下的支付政策拥有控制权。虽然项目的波动率和清算成本对企业的总债务容量影响不大，但它们会增加信贷相对于债务的使用。杠杆是非平稳的，且随过往盈利能力的提高而下降。企业可能在通过信贷额度借款（以更高利率）的同时持有补偿性现金余额。令人惊讶的是，债务与股权之间通常的冲突（资产替代、策略性违约）未必会出现。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Agency and optimal investment dynamics
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Agency problems limit firms' access to capital markets, curbing investment. Raw markdown: demarzo-2007-agency-and-optimal-investment-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: DeMarzo, PM, Fishman, MJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI:…
pages.text: Agency and optimal investment dynamics (2007) Paper claim — Agency problems limit firms' access to capital markets, curbing investment. Raw markdown: demarzo-2007-agency-and-optimal-investment-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: DeMarzo, PM, Fishman, MJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhl004 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow) Abstract Agency problems limit firms' access to capital markets, curbing investment. Firms and investors seek contractual ways to mitigate these problems. What are the implications for investment? We present a theory of a firm's investment dynamics in the presence of agency problems and optimal long-term financial contracts. We derive results relating firms' investment decisions, current and past cash flows, firm size, capital structure, and dividends. Among the results, optimal investment is increasing in current and past cash flow; and optimal investment is positively serially correlated over time (after controlling for investment opportunities). These results hold for a range of agency problems. (JEL G30, G31, G32, G35, D82, D86, D92) 摘要（中文） 代理问题限制了公司进入资本市场的能力，抑制了投资。公司和投资者寻求以合约方式来缓解这些问题。这对投资意味着什么？我们提出了一个关于公司在存在代理问题和最优长期财务合约情形下投资动态的理论。我们推导出将公司投资决策与当期和过去的现金流、公司规模、资本结构以及股利联系起来的结果。其中的结果包括：最优投资随当期和过去的现金流递增；且最优投资随时间正向序列相关（在控制了投资机会之后）。这些结果对一系列代理问题均成立。(JEL G30, G31, G32, G35, D82, D86, D92) Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop an agency model of financial contracting. Raw markdown: demarzo-2007-optimal-long-term-financial-contracting Bibliographic Record Authors: DeMarzo, PM, Fishman, MJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm031 Relevance score:…
pages.text: Optimal long-term financial contracting (2007) Paper claim — We develop an agency model of financial contracting. Raw markdown: demarzo-2007-optimal-long-term-financial-contracting Bibliographic Record Authors: DeMarzo, PM, Fishman, MJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm031 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow) Abstract We develop an agency model of financial contracting. We derive long-term debt, a line of credit, and equity as optimal securities, capturing the debt coupon and maturity; the interest rate and limits on the credit line; inside versus outside equity; dividend policy; and capital structure dynamics. The optimal debt-equity ratio is history dependent, but debt and credit line terms are independent of the amount financed and, in some cases, the severity of the agency problem. In our model, the agent can divert cash flows; we also consider settings in which the agent undertakes hidden effort, or can control cash flow risk. 摘要（中文） 我们建立了一个金融契约的代理模型。我们推导出长期债务、信贷额度和股权作为最优证券，涵盖了债务票息和期限；信贷额度的利率和上限；内部股权与外部股权；股利政策；以及资本结构动态。最优的债务股权比是路径依赖的，但债务和信贷额度的条款与融资金额无关，且在某些情况下与代理问题的严重程度无关。在我们的模型中，代理人可以转移现金流；我们还考虑了代理人从事隐性努力或能够控制现金流风险的情形。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Learning, Termination, and Payout Policy in Dynamic Incentive Contracts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study a principal-agent setting in which both sides learn about future profitability from output, and the project can be abandoned/terminated if profitability is too low. Raw markdown: demarzo-2017-learning-termination-and-payout-policy-in-dynamic-incentive…
pages.text: Learning, Termination, and Payout Policy in Dynamic Incentive Contracts (2017) Paper claim — We study a principal-agent setting in which both sides learn about future profitability from output, and the project can be abandoned/terminated if profitability is too low. Raw markdown: demarzo-2017-learning-termination-and-payout-policy-in-dynamic-incentive Bibliographic Record Authors: Demarzo, PM, Sannikov, Y Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/restud/rdw029 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We study a principal-agent setting in which both sides learn about future profitability from output, and the project can be abandoned/terminated if profitability is too low. With learning, shirking by the agent both reduces output and lowers the principal's estimate of future profitability. The agent can exploit this belief discrepancy and earn information rents, reducing his incentives to exert effort. The optimal contract controls information rents to improve incentives by distorting the termination decision. Our results capture the transition from a young, financially constrained firm to a mature firm that pays dividends. For young firms, poor performance permanently raises the termination threshold, as doing so lowers information rents. Mature firms pay smoothed dividends and have a fixed termination threshold. Dividend smoothing occurs because earnings surprises are used to adjust financial slack in line with profitability. When profitability only reflects the agent's private ability, a simple equity contract is optimal. 摘要（中文） 我们研究一个委托-代理情形，其中双方都从产出中学习未来的盈利能力，且当盈利能力过低时项目可被放弃/终止。在存在学习的情况下，代理人的偷懒既会降低产出，也会拉低委托人对未来盈利能力的估计。代理人可以利用这种信念差异并赚取信息租金，从而削弱其付出努力的激励。最优合约通过扭曲终止决策来控制信息租金以改善激励。我们的结果刻画了从年轻、受财务约束的公司向支付股利的成熟公司的转变。对于年轻公司，糟糕的业绩会永久性地提高终止阈值，因为这样做可降低信息租金。成熟公司支付平滑化的股利并拥有固定的终止阈值。股利平滑之所以出现，是因为盈余意外被用于根据盈利能力调整财务余裕。当盈利能力仅反映代理人的私人能力时，一份简单的股权合约便是最优的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Portfolio investment with the exact tax basis via nonlinear programming (2005) Paper claim — Computing the optimal portfolio policy of an investor facing capital gains tax is a challenging problem: because the tax to be paid depends on the price at which the security was purchased (the tax basis), the optimal policy is path dependent and the size of the problem grows exponentially with the number of time periods. Raw markdown: demiguel-2005-portfolio-investment-with-the-exact-tax-basis-via Bibliographic Record Authors: DeMiguel, V, Uppal, R Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1040.0315 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Computing the optimal portfolio policy of an investor facing capital gains tax is a challenging problem: because the tax to be paid depends on the price at which the security was purchased (the tax basis), the optimal policy is path dependent and the size of the problem grows exponentially with the number of time periods. Dammon et al. (2001, 2002, 2004), Garlappi et al. (2001), and Gallmeyer et al. (2001) address this problem by approximating the exact tax basis by the weighted average purchase price. Our contribution is threefold. First, we show that the structure of the problem has several attractive features that can be exploited to determine the optimal portfolio policy using the exact tax basis via nonlinear programming. Second, we characterize the optimal portfolio policy in the presence of capital gains tax when using the exact tax basis. Third, we show that the certainty equivalent loss from using the average tax basis instead of the exact basis is very small: it is typically less than 1% for problems with up to 10 periods, and this result is robust to the choice of parameter values and to the presence of transaction costs, dividends, intermediate consumption, labor income, tax reset provision at death, and wash-sale constraints. 摘要（中文） 计算面临资本利得税的投资者的最优组合政策是一个具有挑战性的问题：由于应缴税款取决于证券的购入价格（税基），最优政策是路径依赖的，且问题的规模随时间期数呈指数增长。Dammon等人（2001、2002、2004）、Garlappi等人（2001）和Gallmeyer等人（2001）通过用加权平均购入价格近似精确税基来处理这一问题。我们的贡献有三方面。首先，我们表明该问题的结构具有若干有吸引力的特征，可加以利用，从而通过非线性规划使用精确税基来确定最优组合政策。其次，我们刻画了在存在资本利得税且使用精确税基时的最优组合政策。第三，我们表明，使用平均税基而非精确税基所导致的确定性等价损失非常小：对于最多10个期数的问题，通常小于1%，并且这一结果对参数值的选择，以及对交易成本、股利、中期消费、劳动收入、死亡时的税收重置条款和洗售约束的存在都是稳健的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES AND THE MARKET REACTION TO EQUITY OFFERINGS (1994) Paper claim — This paper examines the relation between the market reaction to primary seasoned equity offerings and alternative measures of the profitability of the issuing firm's growth opportunities. Raw markdown: denis-1994-investment-opportunities-and-the-market-reaction-to-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: DENIS, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1994 DOI: 10.2307/2331220 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper examines the relation between the market reaction to primary seasoned equity offerings and alternative measures of the profitability of the issuing firm's growth opportunities. While the sample offerings display a positive relation between announcement period prediction errors and several ex ante measures of growth opportunities, this relation is not monotonic and appears to be driven by a small subset of younger, higher growth firms, whose announcement effects are insignificantly different from zero. For the remainder of the sample firms, there is no relation between the estimated profitability of new investment and the market reaction to announced equity offerings. Moreover, announcement effects are nonpositive regardless of how profitable investment opportunities are expected to be. These findings collectively suggest that investment opportunities play, at best, a minor role in explaining the cross-sectional distribution of equity offering announcement effects. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了市场对首次增发（seasoned equity offerings）的反应与发行公司增长机会盈利能力的替代度量之间的关系。虽然样本发行在公告期预测误差与若干增长机会的事前度量之间表现出正向关系，但这种关系并非单调，并且似乎是由一小部分较年轻、较高增长的公司所驱动，这些公司的公告效应与零无显著差异。对于其余的样本公司，新投资的估计盈利能力与市场对所宣布的股权发行的反应之间没有关系。此外，无论投资机会预期多么有利可图，公告效应都是非正的。这些发现共同表明，投资机会在解释股权发行公告效应的横截面分布方面至多发挥次要作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: THE INFORMATION-CONTENT OF DIVIDEND CHANGES - CASH FLOW SIGNALING, OVERINVESTMENT, AND DIVIDEND CLIENTELES (1994) Paper claim — We examine the cash flow signaling, overinvestment, and dividend clientele explanations for the information content of dividend change announcements. Raw markdown: denis-1994-the-information-content-of-dividend-changes-cash-flow Bibliographic Record Authors: DENIS, DJ, DENIS, DK, SARIN, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1994 DOI: 10.2307/2331110 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, overinvestment, signal) Abstract We examine the cash flow signaling, overinvestment, and dividend clientele explanations for the information content of dividend change announcements. After simultaneously controlling for the standardized dividend change, dividend yield, and Tobin's Q, we find that announcement period excess returns are positively related to the magnitude of the standardized dividend change and to the dividend yield, but unrelated to Tobin's Q. We provide further evidence on the cash flow signaling and overinvestment hypotheses by examing revisions in analysts' earnings forecasts and changes in capital expenditures following dividend change announcements. We find that analysts significantly revise their earnings forecasts following dividend changes and that Q < 1 firms actually increase their capital expenditures following dividend increases and decrease them following dividend decreases. Overall, our findings support the cash flow signaling and dividend clientele hypotheses for stock price reactions to dividend change announcements, but provide little support for the overinvestment hypothesis. 摘要（中文） 我们考察现金流信号、过度投资和股利客户群这三种对股利变化公告信息含量的解释。在同时控制了标准化股利变化、股利收益率和托宾Q之后，我们发现公告期超额收益与标准化股利变化的幅度以及股利收益率呈正相关，但与托宾Q无关。我们通过考察股利变化公告后分析师盈余预测的修正以及资本支出的变化，进一步提供了关于现金流信号和过度投资假说的证据。我们发现，分析师在股利变化后显著修正其盈余预测，且Q<1的企业实际上在股利增加后提高资本支出、在股利减少后降低资本支出。总体而言，我们的发现支持股价对股利变化公告反应的现金流信号假说和股利客户群假说，但几乎不支持过度投资假说。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Why do firms pay dividends? International evidence on the determinants of dividend policy (2008) Paper claim — In the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, and Japan, the propensity to pay dividends is higher among larger, more profitable firms, and those for which retained earnings comprise a large fraction of total equity. Raw markdown: denis-2008-why-do-firms-pay-dividends-international-evidence-on Bibliographic Record Authors: Denis, DJ, Osobov, I Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.06.006 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, catering, signal) Abstract In the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, and Japan, the propensity to pay dividends is higher among larger, more profitable firms, and those for which retained earnings comprise a large fraction of total equity. Although there are hints of reductions in the propensity to pay dividends in most of the sample countries over the 1994-2002 period, they are driven by a failure of newly listed firms to initiate dividends when expected to do so. Dividend abandonment and the failure to initiate by existing nonpayers are economically unimportant except in Japan. Moreover, in each country, aggregate dividends have not declined and are concentrated among the largest. most profitable firms. Finally, outside of the US there is little evidence of a systematic positive relation between relative prices of dividend paying and non-paying firms and the propensity to pay dividends. Overall, these findings cast doubt on signaling, clientele. and catering explanations for dividends, but support agency cost-based lifecycle theories. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在美国、加拿大、英国、德国、法国和日本，规模更大、盈利能力更强以及留存收益占总权益比例较大的企业派息倾向更高。尽管在大多数样本国家，1994—2002年期间派息倾向有下降的迹象，但这些迹象是由新上市企业在本应发起股利时未能发起所驱动的。除日本外，现有不派息企业放弃股利以及未能发起股利在经济意义上并不重要。此外，在每个国家，总股利并未下降，而是集中于最大、最盈利的企业。最后，在美国以外，几乎没有证据表明派息企业与不派息企业的相对价格与派息倾向之间存在系统性正相关。总体而言，这些发现使人对股利的信号、客户群和迎合解释产生怀疑，但支持基于代理成本的生命周期理论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Why do firms pay dividends? International evidence on the determinants of dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Across six developed markets, the propensity to pay dividends is driven by firm size, profitability, and the earned/contributed equity mix; any observed declines in dividend propensity are concentrated among newly listed firms that fail to initiate; and aggregate…
pages.text: Why do firms pay dividends? International evidence on the determinants of dividend policy (2008) Paper claim — Across six developed markets, the propensity to pay dividends is driven by firm size, profitability, and the earned/contributed equity mix; any observed declines in dividend propensity are concentrated among newly listed firms that fail to initiate; and aggregate dividends remain concentrated among the largest, most profitable firms — evidence that supports life-cycle theory while casting doubt on signaling, clientele, and catering explanations. Raw markdown: denis-osobov-why-do-rms-pay-dividends-international-evidence-on-the-determinants Bibliographic Record Authors: Denis, David J.; Osobov, Igor Journal: Journal of Financial Economics Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.06.006 Abstract In the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, and Japan, the propensity to pay dividends is higher among larger, more profitable firms, and those for which retained earnings comprise a large fraction of total equity. Although there are hints of reductions in the propensity to pay dividends in most of the sample countries over the 1994–2002 period, they are driven by a failure of newly listed firms to initiate dividends when expected to do so. Dividend abandonment and the failure to initiate by existing nonpayers are economically unimportant except in Japan. Moreover, in each country, aggregate dividends have not declined and are concentrated among the largest, most profitable firms. Finally, outside of the US there is little evidence of a systematic positive relation between relative prices of dividend-paying and non-paying firms and the propensity to pay dividends. Overall, these findings cast doubt on signaling, clientele, and catering explanations for dividends, but support agency cost-based lifecycle theories. Key Findings In logit regressions across all six countries (1989–2002), the probability of paying dividends is positively and significantly associated with firm size, profitability, and the ratio of retained earnings to total book equity (RE/BE) — with RE/BE showing a near-monotonic relationship from near-zero payer proportions when RE/BE < 0 to above 85% when RE/BE > 0.90. Any declines in dividend propensity are driven predominantly by the failure of newly listed firms (post-1993 entrants) to initiate dividends when expected to do so; this subcategory accounts for more than 80% of the shortfall in dividend payers in 2002 in each country except Japan. Abandonment by existing payers is economically trivial except in Japan, where financial distress explains the pattern. Aggregate real dividends did not decline over 1990–2002 in any country except Canada; they remain highly concentrated among the largest payers (top 20% of payers account for at least 73.3% of aggregate dividends in all periods and countries), consistent with the life-cycle theory's prediction that free cash flow distribution drives dividends. Outside the US, there is little evidence that the Baker–Wurgler dividend premium drives the propensity to pay dividends or time-series changes therein, providing weak international support for the catering theory. The pattern that dividends are paid by the largest, most profitable firms — precisely those least in need of signaling — casts doubt on signaling as a first-order determinant of dividends internationally. Linked Pages dividend-payout-policy international-evidence-on-dividends catering-theory-of-dividends

pages.title: Lazy dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Dividends are clustered in increments of 5, such as 25, 50, and 75. Firms gravitating towards these "prominent" amounts have lower operating performance and lower annual five-factor alphas of 77 b.p., consistent with agency frictions that lead to lazy payout…
pages.text: Lazy dividends (2025) Paper claim — Dividends are clustered in increments of 5, such as 25, 50, and 75. Firms gravitating towards these "prominent" amounts have lower operating performance and lower annual five-factor alphas of 77 b.p., consistent with agency frictions that lead to lazy payout decisions by entrenched managers. Raw markdown: dennis-2025-lazy-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Dennis, Patrick J.; Weston, James P. Journal: Journal of Corporate Finance Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2025.102858 Sample: CRSP quarterly dividends, ordinary U.S. common shares, 1Q1963–4Q2018 Abstract Dividends are clustered in increments of 5, such as 25, 50, and 75. Firms that gravitate towards these "prominent" amounts have lower operating performance and lower annual five-factor alphas of 77 b.p. Consistent with agency frictions that lead to lazy decisions, clustering effects are stronger for entrenched firms, with more market power, and less shareholder activism. Dividend increases also cluster more than cuts, consistent with saliency bias. In a counterfactual exercise, we find no similar patterns in a sample of ADRs. Our results complement a number of recent studies showing the economic importance of simple decision heuristics. Key Findings Non-prominent dividend payers earn 6.4 b.p. higher monthly 12-month alpha than prominent payers (significant at 10%); 24- and 36-month alphas are 6.7 and 6.4 b.p. higher (significant at 5%); matched-sample difference reaches 27 b.p. per month. Non-prominent dividend payers have significantly higher industry-adjusted Tobin's q (coefficient 0.03) and annual ROA approximately 0.7%–1.3% higher, indicating the effect extends to accounting-based performance measures. Prominent dividend clustering is stronger for industry-dominant firms (market power proxy for managerial quiet life), for firms with lower institutional ownership, and for firms with fewer outside directors—three proxies consistent with reduced managerial effort under weak monitoring. Dividend initiations are significantly more prominent than other dividends (+6 percentage points), while cuts are not, consistent with initiations being open numerical judgments that anchor on round numbers without a prior reference value. Special dividends (both explicitly flagged and algorithm-identified) are substantially less prominent (23%–35%) than regular dividends (39%), consistent with deliberate payout decisions being less lazy. Aggregate dividend prominence has declined from ~60% in 1963 to ~30% in 2018, coinciding with the secular rise in institutional ownership; time-series regressions confirm a significant negative association with aggregate institutional ownership. ADR placebo tests show no significant performance difference between prominent and non-prominent ADR dividends, isolating the effect to voluntary decimal-place choices by U.S. managers. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion). Linked Pages agency-costs-of-free-cash-flow dividend-payout-policy

pages.title: Institutional tax clienteles and payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper employs heterogeneity in institutional shareholder tax characteristics to identify the relation between firm payout policy and tax incentives. Raw markdown: desai-2011-institutional-tax-clienteles-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Desai,…
pages.text: Institutional tax clienteles and payout policy (2011) Paper claim — This paper employs heterogeneity in institutional shareholder tax characteristics to identify the relation between firm payout policy and tax incentives. Raw markdown: desai-2011-institutional-tax-clienteles-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Desai, MA, Jin, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2010.10.013 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper employs heterogeneity in institutional shareholder tax characteristics to identify the relation between firm payout policy and tax incentives. Analysis of a panel of firms matched with the tax characteristics of the clients of their institutional shareholders indicates that "dividend-averse" institutions are significantly less likely to hold shares in firms with larger dividend payouts. This relation between the tax preferences of institutional shareholders and firm payout policy may reflect dividend-averse institutions gravitating towards low dividend paying firms or managers adapting their payout policies to the interests of their institutional shareholders. Evidence is provided that both effects are operative. Plausibly exogenous changes in payout policy result in shifting institutional ownership patterns. Similarly, exogenous changes in the tax cost of institutional investors receiving dividends results in changes in firm dividend policy. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文利用机构股东税收特征的异质性来识别企业支付政策与税收激励之间的关系。对企业与其机构股东客户税收特征相匹配的面板数据进行的分析表明，"厌恶股利"的机构显著更不可能持有股利支付较高企业的股份。机构股东税收偏好与企业支付政策之间的这种关系，可能反映了厌恶股利的机构向低股利支付企业靠拢，或管理者根据其机构股东的利益调整其支付政策。本文提供的证据表明这两种效应都在起作用。支付政策看似外生的变化会导致机构持股模式的转变。同样，机构投资者收取股利的税收成本的外生变化会导致企业股利政策的变化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Repatriation Taxes and Foreign Cash Holdings: The Impact of Anticipated Tax Reform
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine whether an anticipated reduction in future repatriation taxes affects the amount of cash U.S. Raw markdown: desimone-2019-repatriation-taxes-and-foreign-cash-holdings-the-impact Bibliographic Record Authors: De Simone, L, Piotroski, JD, Tomy, RE Journal:…
pages.text: Repatriation Taxes and Foreign Cash Holdings: The Impact of Anticipated Tax Reform (2019) Paper claim — We examine whether an anticipated reduction in future repatriation taxes affects the amount of cash U.S. Raw markdown: desimone-2019-repatriation-taxes-and-foreign-cash-holdings-the-impact Bibliographic Record Authors: De Simone, L, Piotroski, JD, Tomy, RE Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhy124 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, reform)；股利政策(payout) Abstract We examine whether an anticipated reduction in future repatriation taxes affects the amount of cash U.S. multinationals hold overseas. We find that the expected benefits of a repatriation tax reduction are positively associated with accelerated accumulations of global cash holdings once Congress proposed legislation. Additional tests examining domestic and foreign corporations, voluntary disclosures of foreign cash, and corporate payout behavior support our conclusion that observed increases in excess global cash are driven by changes in foreign cash. We also document that U.S. multinationals accumulating excess cash engage in complementary organizational and financial reporting activities designed to maximize expected tax benefits. 摘要（中文） 我们考察对未来汇回税下调的预期是否会影响美国跨国公司在海外持有的现金数额。我们发现，一旦国会提出立法，汇回税下调的预期收益就与全球现金持有的加速积累正相关。对国内和外国公司、外国现金的自愿披露以及公司派现行为的额外检验支持了我们的结论，即观察到的超额全球现金增加是由外国现金的变化驱动的。我们还记录了，积累超额现金的美国跨国公司会从事旨在最大化预期税收收益的配套组织活动和财务报告活动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Signal on the Margin: Behavior of Levered Investors and Future Economic Conditions (2020) Paper claim — Margin capacity, defined as the aggregate excess debt capacity of investors buying securities on margin, strongly predicts (i) lower S&P 500 returns, (ii) lower growth in aggregate earnings, dividends, employment, and overall economic activity, (iii) higher macro, financial, and policy uncertainty, (iv) lower interest rates, (v) tighter lending standards by banks, and (vi) lower intermediary equity capital. Raw markdown: deuskar-2020-signal-on-the-margin-behavior-of-levered-investors Bibliographic Record Authors: Deuskar, P, Kumar, N, Poland, JA Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfaa006 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Margin capacity, defined as the aggregate excess debt capacity of investors buying securities on margin, strongly predicts (i) lower S&P 500 returns, (ii) lower growth in aggregate earnings, dividends, employment, and overall economic activity, (iii) higher macro, financial, and policy uncertainty, (iv) lower interest rates, (v) tighter lending standards by banks, and (vi) lower intermediary equity capital. High margin capacity is a precursor, not a response, to borrowing and intermediary constraints and higher volatility. It typically arises when levered investors with profitable past positions limit their leverage. We interpret that it reflects informed investors' conservatism ahead of bad times. 摘要（中文） 保证金容量（margin capacity）定义为以保证金买入证券的投资者的总体过剩债务容量，它强有力地预测了：（i）更低的标普500收益，（ii）总量盈余、股利、就业和整体经济活动的更低增长，（iii）更高的宏观、金融和政策不确定性，（iv）更低的利率，（v）银行更紧的贷款标准，以及（vi）更低的中介机构股权资本。高保证金容量是借款和中介约束以及更高波动率的前兆，而非对其的反应。它通常出现在具有盈利的过往头寸的杠杆投资者限制其杠杆之时。我们将其解读为反映了知情投资者在坏时期到来之前的保守态度。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends, asymmetric information, and agency conflicts: Evidence from a comparison of the dividend policies of Japanese and US firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We compare dividend policies of U.S. Raw markdown: dewenter-1998-dividends-asymmetric-information-and-agency-conflicts-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Dewenter, KL, Warther, VA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00038…
pages.text: Dividends, asymmetric information, and agency conflicts: Evidence from a comparison of the dividend policies of Japanese and US firms (1998) Paper claim — We compare dividend policies of U.S. Raw markdown: dewenter-1998-dividends-asymmetric-information-and-agency-conflicts-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Dewenter, KL, Warther, VA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00038 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, information asymmetry) Abstract We compare dividend policies of U.S. and Japanese firms, partitioning the Japanese data into keiretsu, independent, and hybrid firms. We examine the correlation between dividend changes and stock returns, and the reluctance to change dividends. Results are consistent with the joint hypotheses that Japanese firms, particularly keiretsu-member firms, face less information asymmetry and fewer agency conflicts than U.S. firms, and that information asymmetries and/or agency conflicts affect dividend policy. Japanese firms experience smaller stock price reactions to dividend omissions and initiations, they are less reluctant to omit and cut dividends, and their dividends are more responsive to earnings changes. 摘要（中文） 我们比较美国与日本企业的股利政策，并将日本数据划分为系列企业（keiretsu）、独立企业和混合型企业。我们考察股利变化与股票收益之间的相关性，以及改变股利的不情愿程度。结果与如下联合假设一致：日本企业、尤其是系列企业成员，相比美国企业面临更少的信息不对称和更少的代理冲突，且信息不对称和/或代理冲突会影响股利政策。日本企业在股利取消和首次发放时经历的股价反应更小，它们更少不愿意取消和削减股利，且它们的股利对盈利变化更为敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend taxes and implied cost of equity capital
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We estimate firm-level implied cost of equity capital based on recent advances in accounting and finance research and examine the effect of dividend taxes on the cost of equity capital. Raw markdown: dhaliwal-2005-dividend-taxes-and-implied-cost-of-equity-capital…
pages.text: Dividend taxes and implied cost of equity capital (2005) Paper claim — We estimate firm-level implied cost of equity capital based on recent advances in accounting and finance research and examine the effect of dividend taxes on the cost of equity capital. Raw markdown: dhaliwal-2005-dividend-taxes-and-implied-cost-of-equity-capital Bibliographic Record Authors: Dhaliwal, D, Krull, L, Li, OZ, Moser, W Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2005.00186.x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We estimate firm-level implied cost of equity capital based on recent advances in accounting and finance research and examine the effect of dividend taxes on the cost of equity capital. We investigate whether dividend taxes affect firms' cost of capital by testing the relation between the implied cost of equity capital and a measure of the tax-penalized portion of dividend yield, which we define as the product of dividend yield and the dividend tax penalty. The results generally support the dividend tax capitalization hypothesis. We find a positive relation between the implied cost of equity capital and the tax-penalized portion of dividend yield that is decreasing in aggregate institutional ownership, our proxy for tax-advantaged investors. The evidence in this study adds to the understanding of the effect of investor-level taxes on equity value. 摘要（中文） 我们基于会计和金融研究的近期进展估计企业层面的隐含股权资本成本，并考察股利税对股权资本成本的影响。我们通过检验隐含股权资本成本与股利收益率中受税收惩罚部分（我们将其定义为股利收益率与股利税惩罚的乘积）的度量之间的关系，来考察股利税是否影响企业的资本成本。结果总体上支持股利税资本化假说。我们发现隐含股权资本成本与股利收益率中受税收惩罚部分之间存在正相关关系，且这一关系随总体机构持股（我们对税收优惠投资者的代理变量）的增加而减弱。本研究的证据增进了对投资者层面税收对股权价值影响的理解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Shareholder income taxes and the relation between earnings and returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The purpose of this study is to investigate whether and how shareholder-level taxes affect earnings response coefficients (ERCs). Raw markdown: dhaliwal-2005-shareholder-income-taxes-and-the-relation-between-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Dhaliwal, DS,…
pages.text: Shareholder income taxes and the relation between earnings and returns (2005) Paper claim — The purpose of this study is to investigate whether and how shareholder-level taxes affect earnings response coefficients (ERCs). Raw markdown: dhaliwal-2005-shareholder-income-taxes-and-the-relation-between-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Dhaliwal, DS, Erickson, MM, Li, OZ Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1506/9QEL-CKDY-MJ40-0QDQ Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract The purpose of this study is to investigate whether and how shareholder-level taxes affect earnings response coefficients (ERCs). Our tests indicate that when the tax rate on dividends increases, ERCs decrease for firms with high levels of dividend yield and whose marginal investor is likely to be an individual. For firms with high levels of share repurchase yield and whose marginal investor is likely to be an individual, an increase in dividend tax rate has no discernible effect on ERCs. These results are consistent with the notion that the tax penalty on dividends, relative to capital gains, reduces the earnings-return relation. 摘要（中文） 本研究的目的是考察股东层面的税收是否以及如何影响盈余反应系数（ERCs）。我们的检验表明，当股利税率上升时，对于股利收益率高且其边际投资者很可能是个人的企业，盈余反应系数下降。对于股份回购收益率高且其边际投资者很可能是个人的企业，股利税率上升对盈余反应系数没有明显影响。这些结果与如下观点一致，即股利相对于资本利得的税收惩罚降低了盈余—收益关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Investor tax heterogeneity and ex-dividend day trading volume (2006) Paper claim — We propose that ex-dividend day excess volume is motivated by tax heterogeneity among investors, and thus is increasing in investor tax heterogeneity. Raw markdown: dhaliwal-2006-investor-tax-heterogeneity-and-ex-dividend-day-trading Bibliographic Record Authors: Dhaliwal, D, Li, OZ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2006.00842.x Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We propose that ex-dividend day excess volume is motivated by tax heterogeneity among investors, and thus is increasing in investor tax heterogeneity. Institutional ownership is our measure of heterogeneity. Since investor heterogeneity is a concave function of institutional ownership, we hypothesize that ex-day volume is a concave function of institutional ownership. Cross-sectional tests support the tax-motivated trading hypothesis. Additional tests, using trade size and pension ownership as proxies for institutional trades, yield similar results. We contribute to the literature by considering the interaction between payout policy and ownership structure in explaining the cross-sectional variation in ex-day volume. 摘要（中文） 我们提出，除息日的超额交易量源于投资者之间的税收异质性，因此随投资者税收异质性的增加而增加。机构持股是我们对异质性的度量。由于投资者异质性是机构持股的凹函数，我们假设除息日交易量是机构持股的凹函数。横截面检验支持税收驱动的交易假说。使用交易规模和养老金持股作为机构交易代理变量的额外检验得出了相似的结果。我们通过考察支付政策与所有权结构之间的相互作用来解释除息日交易量的横截面差异，从而对文献作出贡献。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines stock and bond price reactions to dividend changes. Raw markdown: dhillon-1994-the-effect-of-dividend-changes-on-stock-and Bibliographic Record Authors: DHILLON, US, JOHNSON, H Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: n/a Relevance score:…
pages.text: THE EFFECT OF DIVIDEND CHANGES ON STOCK AND BOND PRICES (1994) Paper claim — This study examines stock and bond price reactions to dividend changes. Raw markdown: dhillon-1994-the-effect-of-dividend-changes-on-stock-and Bibliographic Record Authors: DHILLON, US, JOHNSON, H Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract This study examines stock and bond price reactions to dividend changes. The positive stock market response to dividend increases has several potential explanations, two of the more commonly discussed being information content and wealth redistribution between stockholders and bondholders. The evidence presented supports the wealth redistribution hypothesis but does not rule out the information content hypothesis. Typically we find that the bond price reaction to announcements of large dividend changes is opposite to the stock price reaction. Our results differ from those of Handjinicolaou and Kalay. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察股票和债券价格对股利变动的反应。股票市场对股利增加的正面反应有若干潜在解释，其中较常被讨论的两种是信息含量以及股东与债券持有人之间的财富再分配。所呈现的证据支持财富再分配假说，但并不排除信息含量假说。通常，我们发现债券价格对大幅股利变动公告的反应与股价反应相反。我们的结果与Handjinicolaou和Kalay的结果不同。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock Market Returns and Consumption
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper employs Swedish data on households' stock holdings to investigate how consumption responds to changes in stock market returns. Raw markdown: dimaggio-2020-stock-market-returns-and-consumption Bibliographic Record Authors: Di Maggio, M, Kermani, A,…
pages.text: Stock Market Returns and Consumption (2020) Paper claim — This paper employs Swedish data on households' stock holdings to investigate how consumption responds to changes in stock market returns. Raw markdown: dimaggio-2020-stock-market-returns-and-consumption Bibliographic Record Authors: Di Maggio, M, Kermani, A, Majlesi, K Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12968 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout) Abstract This paper employs Swedish data on households' stock holdings to investigate how consumption responds to changes in stock market returns. We instrument the actual capital gains and dividend payments with past portfolio weights. Unrealized capital gains lead to a marginal propensity to consume of 23% for the bottom 50% of the wealth distribution and about 3% for the top 30% of the wealth distribution. Household consumption is significantly more responsive to dividend payouts across all parts of the wealth distribution. Our findings are consistent with households treating capital gains and dividends as separate sources of income. 摘要（中文） 本文利用瑞典家庭持股数据，考察消费如何对股市收益的变化作出反应。我们用过去的投资组合权重对实际的资本利得和股利支付进行工具变量处理。未实现的资本利得导致财富分布底部50%的边际消费倾向为23%，而财富分布顶部30%约为3%。在财富分布的所有部分，家庭消费对股利支付的反应都显著更强。我们的发现与家庭将资本利得和股利视为不同收入来源的观点相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The timing of financing decisions: An examination of the correlation in financing waves
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Why do corporate financing events occur in waves? We challenge recent evidence of the importance of valuation cycles in driving financing waves by documenting that the aggregate pattern of stock repurchases mirrors that of equity issuance and mergers, despite…
pages.text: The timing of financing decisions: An examination of the correlation in financing waves (2008) Paper claim — Why do corporate financing events occur in waves? We challenge recent evidence of the importance of valuation cycles in driving financing waves by documenting that the aggregate pattern of stock repurchases mirrors that of equity issuance and mergers, despite repurchases involving an opposite transaction. Raw markdown: dittmar-2008-the-timing-of-financing-decisions-an-examination-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Dittmar, AK, Dittmar, RF Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.11.007 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(stock repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Why do corporate financing events occur in waves? We challenge recent evidence of the importance of valuation cycles in driving financing waves by documenting that the aggregate pattern of stock repurchases mirrors that of equity issuance and mergers, despite repurchases involving an opposite transaction. We then show that trends in financing decisions result from differing responses to the same economic stimulus: growth in GDP. Specifically, economic expansion reduces the cost of equity relative to the cost of debt, inducing firms to issue equity, and increases cash flow and also causes varying degrees of uncertainty, increasing stock repurchases. We document similar trends and provide similar motivation for merger waves. (c) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 为什么公司融资事件会呈波浪式出现？我们对近期关于估值周期在驱动融资浪潮中重要性的证据提出质疑，记录到股份回购的总体模式与股权发行和并购的模式相互映照，尽管回购涉及的是相反方向的交易。随后我们表明，融资决策的趋势源于对同一经济刺激——GDP增长——的不同反应。具体而言，经济扩张降低了股权成本相对于债务成本的比例，促使企业发行股权；同时增加现金流，并造成不同程度的不确定性，从而增加股份回购。我们记录到并购浪潮存在类似趋势，并提供了类似的动因解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
