pages.title: To own or not to own: Stock loans around dividend payments
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In a standard stock loan, the borrower reimburses the lender any dividends paid while the loan is outstanding. Raw markdown: dixon-2021-to-own-or-not-to-own-stock-loans Bibliographic Record Authors: Dixon, PN, Fox, CA, Kelley, EK Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: To own or not to own: Stock loans around dividend payments (2021) Paper claim — In a standard stock loan, the borrower reimburses the lender any dividends paid while the loan is outstanding. Raw markdown: dixon-2021-to-own-or-not-to-own-stock-loans Bibliographic Record Authors: Dixon, PN, Fox, CA, Kelley, EK Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.12.010 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract In a standard stock loan, the borrower reimburses the lender any dividends paid while the loan is outstanding. Since these substitute dividends may be taxed differently than dividend payments themselves, some investors have incentives to either remove their shares from lendable supply-if they pay high taxes on substitute dividends-or lend out their shares to arbitrageurs-if they pay high taxes on dividends. Consistent with these incentives, we find a significant tightening of the equity lending market on dividend record days driven by both a contraction of supply and an expansion of demand-although the demand effect appears to dominate. We then exploit the plausibly exogenous nature of these shifts to causally link tightness in the lending market to wider effective spreads in the stock market. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在标准的股票借贷中，借入方需向出借方补偿在借贷未偿还期间所支付的任何股利。由于这些替代性股利（substitute dividends）可能与股利支付本身按不同方式征税，一些投资者有动机要么将其股份从可出借供给中撤出——如果他们对替代性股利缴纳高税——要么将其股份出借给套利者——如果他们对股利缴纳高税。与这些激励相一致，我们发现在股利登记日，股票借贷市场出现显著收紧，这既由供给的收缩驱动，也由需求的扩张驱动——不过需求效应似乎占主导。我们随后利用这些变动看似外生的性质，将借贷市场的紧张与股票市场中更宽的有效价差建立因果联系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE RATIONALITY OF EARLY EXERCISE DECISIONS - EVIDENCE FROM THE S-AND-P-100 INDEX OPTIONS MARKET
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of the early exercise history of S&P 100 put and call options. Raw markdown: diz-1993-the-rationality-of-early-exercise-decisions-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: DIZ, F, FINUCANE, TJ Journal: REVIEW…
pages.text: THE RATIONALITY OF EARLY EXERCISE DECISIONS - EVIDENCE FROM THE S-AND-P-100 INDEX OPTIONS MARKET (1993) Paper claim — This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of the early exercise history of S&P 100 put and call options. Raw markdown: diz-1993-the-rationality-of-early-exercise-decisions-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: DIZ, F, FINUCANE, TJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1993 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/6.4.765 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of the early exercise history of S&P 100 put and call options. Even though the S&P 100 index options market is generally considered to be the most efficient options market in the world, we show that many exercise decisions are inefficient because they occur when recorded bids are greater than exercise values. Due to market imperfections, some of the cases of inefficient exercise are still rational, but we show that a substantial number of these decisions are clearly irrational, since it would have been possible to realize a larger riskless net cash flow by selling. Unlike previous studies of early exercise, our tests of efficiency and the rational decisions that presumably lead to efficient markets are model independent. We also provide evidence concerning the relative significance of dividends and the wild card to index option pricing models, and introduce and document the importance of the option to exercise and avoid the indirect costs of the spread. We also find evidence of a significant day-of-the-week exercise effect, and present some likely explanations for that effect. 摘要（中文） 本研究对标准普尔100看跌期权和看涨期权的提前行权历史进行了全面的实证分析。尽管标准普尔100指数期权市场通常被认为是世界上最有效的期权市场，我们表明许多行权决策是低效的，因为它们发生在记录的买价大于行权价值之时。由于市场不完美，一些低效行权的情形仍然是理性的，但我们表明这些决策中有相当一部分显然是非理性的，因为通过卖出本可以实现更大的无风险净现金流。与此前关于提前行权的研究不同，我们对效率和据称导致有效市场的理性决策的检验是与模型无关的。我们还提供了关于股利和“通配符”对指数期权定价模型相对重要性的证据，并引入并记录了行权以避免价差间接成本这一选择的重要性。我们还发现存在显著的一周中不同日的行权效应，并对该效应给出了一些可能的解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Information and contagion effects of bank loan-loss reserve announcements
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Consistent with an information-signaling perspective, negative and statistically significant announcement effects are associated with bank loan-loss reserve (LLR) announcements over the 1985-90 period. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Information and contagion effects of bank loan-loss reserve announcements (1997) Paper claim — Consistent with an information-signaling perspective, negative and statistically significant announcement effects are associated with bank loan-loss reserve (LLR) announcements over the 1985-90 period. Raw markdown: docking-1997-information-and-contagion-effects-of-bank-loan-loss Bibliographic Record Authors: Docking, DS, Hirschey, M, Jones, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1997 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(96)00895-1 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Consistent with an information-signaling perspective, negative and statistically significant announcement effects are associated with bank loan-loss reserve (LLR) announcements over the 1985-90 period. Announcement effects differ between money-center and regional banks and also according to the nature of contemporaneous earnings and dividend disclosures, Moreover, information transfer or 'contagion' effects are present in that LLR announcements by regional banks decrease the value of both money-center banks and nonannouncing regional banks. These statistically significant contagion effects suggest a link between the asset quality characteristics of money-center and regional bank loan portfolios. 摘要（中文） 与信息信号传递的视角相一致，在1985-90年期间，银行贷款损失准备金（LLR）公告伴随着负向且统计上显著的公告效应。公告效应在货币中心银行（money-center banks）与区域性银行之间存在差异，也随同期盈余和股利披露的性质而不同。此外，还存在信息传递或"传染"（contagion）效应，即区域性银行的LLR公告会降低货币中心银行和未发布公告的区域性银行两者的价值。这些统计上显著的传染效应表明，货币中心银行与区域性银行贷款组合的资产质量特征之间存在联系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: A new dividend forecasting procedure that rejects bubbles in asset prices: The case of 1929's stock crash (1996) Paper claim — Ne develop a new procedure to forecast future cash flows from a financial asset and then use the present value of our cash flow forecasts to calculate the asset's fundamental price. Raw markdown: donaldson-1996-a-new-dividend-forecasting-procedure-that-rejects-bubbles Bibliographic Record Authors: Donaldson, RG, Kamstra, M Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/9.2.333 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Ne develop a new procedure to forecast future cash flows from a financial asset and then use the present value of our cash flow forecasts to calculate the asset's fundamental price. As an example, we construct a nonlinear ARMA-ARCH-Artificial Neural Network model to obtain out-of-sample dividend forecasts for 1920 and beyond using only in-sample dividend data. The present value of our forecasted dividends yield fundamental prices that reproduce the magnitude, timing, and time-series behavior of the boom and crash in 1929 stock prices. Ne therefore reject the popular claim that the 1920s stock market contained a bubble. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一种新程序来预测金融资产的未来现金流，然后用我们现金流预测的现值来计算该资产的基本面价格。作为一个例子，我们构建了一个非线性ARMA-ARCH-人工神经网络模型，仅使用样本内股利数据获得1920年及以后的样本外股利预测。我们所预测股利的现值产生了基本面价格，这些价格再现了1929年股价繁荣与崩盘的幅度、时机和时间序列行为。因此我们拒绝了1920年代股票市场包含泡沫这一流行说法。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Estimating the Equity Premium
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Existing empirical research investigating the size of the equity premium has largely consisted of a series of innovations around a common theme: producing a better estimate of the equity premium by using better data or a better estimation technique. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Estimating the Equity Premium (2010) Paper claim — Existing empirical research investigating the size of the equity premium has largely consisted of a series of innovations around a common theme: producing a better estimate of the equity premium by using better data or a better estimation technique. Raw markdown: donaldson-2010-estimating-the-equity-premium Bibliographic Record Authors: Donaldson, RG, Kamstra, MJ, Kramer, LA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109010000347 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Existing empirical research investigating the size of the equity premium has largely consisted of a series of innovations around a common theme: producing a better estimate of the equity premium by using better data or a better estimation technique. The equity premium estimate that emerges from most of this work matches one moment of the data alone: the mean difference between an estimate of the return to holding equity and a risk-free rate. We instead match multiple moments of U.S. market data, exploiting the joint distribution of the dividend yield, return volatility, and realized excess returns, and find that the equity premium lies within 50 basis points of 3.5%, a range much narrower than was achieved in previous studies. Additionally, statistical tests based on the joint distribution of these moments reveal that only those models of the conditional equity premium that embed time variation, breaks, and/or trends are supported by the data. In order to develop the joint distribution of the dividend yield, return volatility, and excess returns, we need a model of price and return fundamentals. We document that even recently developed analytically tractable models that permit autocorrelated dividend growth rates and discount rates impose restrictions that are rejected by the data. We therefore turn to a wider range of models, requiring numerical solution methods and parameter estimation by the simulated method of moments. 摘要（中文） 现有关于股权溢价大小的实证研究，很大程度上由围绕一个共同主题的一系列创新构成：通过使用更好的数据或更好的估计技术，得出对股权溢价更好的估计。这类工作中大多数得出的股权溢价估计仅匹配数据的一个矩：持有权益的收益估计与无风险利率之间的均值差。我们则匹配美国市场数据的多个矩，利用股利收益率、收益波动性和已实现超额收益的联合分布，发现股权溢价位于3.5%上下50个基点范围之内，这一区间比以往研究所达到的要窄得多。此外，基于这些矩的联合分布的统计检验揭示，只有那些嵌入了时变、断点和/或趋势的条件股权溢价模型才得到数据的支持。为了得出股利收益率、收益波动性和超额收益的联合分布，我们需要一个关于价格和收益基本面的模型。我们记录了，即便是近期发展出的、允许股利增长率和贴现率自相关的解析可处理模型，也施加了被数据拒绝的约束。因此，我们转向更广泛的模型，这需要数值求解方法以及通过模拟矩法进行参数估计。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Why individual investors want dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The question of why individual investors want dividends is investigated by submitting a questionnaire to a Dutch investor panel. Raw markdown: dong-2005-why-individual-investors-want-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Dong, M, Robinson, C, Veld, C Journal:…
pages.text: Why individual investors want dividends (2005) Paper claim — The question of why individual investors want dividends is investigated by submitting a questionnaire to a Dutch investor panel. Raw markdown: dong-2005-why-individual-investors-want-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Dong, M, Robinson, C, Veld, C Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2004.04.006 Relevance score: 11.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract The question of why individual investors want dividends is investigated by submitting a questionnaire to a Dutch investor panel. The respondents indicate that they want dividends partly because the cost of cashing in dividends is lower than the cost of selling shares. Their answers provide strong confirmation for the signaling theories of Bhattacharya (1979) [Bhattacharya, S., 1979. Imperfect information, dividend policy and the "bird in the hand" fallacy. Bell Journal of Economics 10, 259-270] and Miller and Rock (1985) [Miller, M., Modigliani, F., 1961. Dividend policy, growth and the valuation of shares. Journal of Business 34, 411-433]. They are inconsistent with the uncertainty resolution theory of Gordon (1961, 1962) [Gordon, M., 1961, The Investment, Financing, and Valuation of the Corporation, Richard D. Irwin, Homewood, IL Gordon, M., 1962. The savings, investment and valuation of a corporation. Review of Economics and Statistics 44, 37-51.]and the agency theories of Jensen (1986) [Jensen, M.C., 1986. Agency costs of free cash flow, corporate finance and takeovers. American Economic Review 76, 323-329] and Easterbrook (1984) [Easterbrook, F.H., 1984. Two agency-cost explanations of dividends. American Economic Review 74, 650-659]. The behavioral finance theory of Shefrin and Statman (1984) [Shefrin, H.M., Statman, M., 1984. Explaining investor preference for cash dividends. Journal of Financial Economics 13, 253-282] is not confirmed for cash dividends but is confirmed for stock dividends. Finally, Our results indicate that individual investors do not tend to consume a large part of their dividends. This raises some doubt as to whether a reduction or elimination of dividend taxes will stimulate the economy. (c) 2005 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文通过向一个荷兰投资者小组发放问卷，考察了个人投资者为何想要股利这一问题。受访者表示，他们想要股利部分是因为兑现股利的成本低于出售股份的成本。他们的回答为巴塔查里亚（Bhattacharya，1979）[Bhattacharya, S., 1979. 《不完全信息、股利政策与"落袋为安"谬误》，《贝尔经济学杂志》10, 259-270]以及米勒和罗克（Miller and Rock，1985）[Miller, M., Modigliani, F., 1961. 《股利政策、成长与股份估值》，《商业杂志》34, 411-433]的信号理论提供了有力印证。它们与戈登（Gordon，1961, 1962）[Gordon, M., 1961, 《公司的投资、融资与估值》，Richard D. Irwin, Homewood, IL；Gordon, M., 1962. 《公司的储蓄、投资与估值》，《经济学与统计学评论》44, 37-51]的不确定性消解理论以及詹森（Jensen，1986）[Jensen, M.C., 1986. 《自由现金流的代理成本、公司金融与接管》，《美国经济评论》76, 323-329]和伊斯特布鲁克（Easterbrook，1984）[Easterbrook, F.H., 1984. 《股利的两种代理成本解释》，《美国经济评论》74, 650-659]的代理理论不一致。谢弗林和斯塔特曼（Shefrin and Statman，1984）[Shefrin, H.M., Statman, M., 1984. 《解释投资者对现金股利的偏好》，《金融经济学杂志》13, 253-282]的行为金融理论在现金股利方面未获证实，但在股票股利方面获得证实。最后，我们的结果表明，个人投资者往往不会消费其股利中的很大一部分。这使人对削减或取消股利税是否会刺激经济产生某些怀疑。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Competitive Externalities of Tax Cuts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how tax cuts that benefit some firms are related to the economic performance of their direct competitors. Raw markdown: donohoe-2022-competitive-externalities-of-tax-cuts Bibliographic Record Authors: Donohoe, MP, Jang, H, Lisowsky, P Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Competitive Externalities of Tax Cuts (2022) Paper claim — We examine how tax cuts that benefit some firms are related to the economic performance of their direct competitors. Raw markdown: donohoe-2022-competitive-externalities-of-tax-cuts Bibliographic Record Authors: Donohoe, MP, Jang, H, Lisowsky, P Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12403 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract We examine how tax cuts that benefit some firms are related to the economic performance of their direct competitors. Consistent with tax cuts decreasing the cost of initiating competitive strategies, we find that a decrease in the tax burden for only a specific group of firms in the U.S. economy (i.e., "rivals") has a negative economic effect on the performance of its direct competitors not directly exposed to the same tax cut (i.e., "competitors"). This negative externality is stronger when the relatively higher taxed competitors (1) are financially constrained, (2) operate in more competitive markets, (3) have similar products to their lower taxed rivals, (4) face rivals that retain more of their cash tax savings due to lower dividends and share repurchases, and (5) face lower taxed, but financially constrained, rivals. We also find that shareholders and lenders price the negative externality manifested in these competitors' economic performance. 摘要（中文） 我们考察使某些企业受益的减税与其直接竞争对手经济表现之间的关系。与减税降低发起竞争策略成本相一致，我们发现，仅针对美国经济中某一特定企业群体（即“对手”，rivals）减轻税负，会对未直接受同一减税影响的其直接竞争对手（即“竞争者”，competitors）的表现产生负面经济效应。当相对税负较高的竞争者具有以下特征时，这种负外部性更强：（1）受融资约束；（2）经营于竞争程度更高的市场；（3）产品与其税负较低的对手相似；（4）面对的对手因较低的股利和股份回购而保留更多的省税现金；以及（5）面对税负较低但受融资约束的对手。我们还发现，股东和贷款人会对这些竞争者经济表现中体现出的负外部性进行定价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managerial replacement and corporate financial policy with endogenous manager-specific value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies financial policy, investment decisions and the threat of dismissal when managers value control and investments generate manager-specific value. Raw markdown: douglas-2001-managerial-replacement-and-corporate-financial-policy-with-endogenous…
pages.text: Managerial replacement and corporate financial policy with endogenous manager-specific value (2001) Paper claim — This paper studies financial policy, investment decisions and the threat of dismissal when managers value control and investments generate manager-specific value. Raw markdown: douglas-2001-managerial-replacement-and-corporate-financial-policy-with-endogenous Bibliographic Record Authors: Douglas, AVS Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1016/S0929-1199(00)00018-3 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(replace, signal) Abstract This paper studies financial policy, investment decisions and the threat of dismissal when managers value control and investments generate manager-specific value. A high probability of investigation focuses the manager on the profitability of replacement and therefore manager-specific value. The probability of an investigation increases when the firm enters bankruptcy. Thus, high debt levels focus the manager on investments that dissuade replacement during bankruptcy procedures. Dividends relax the manager's focus on manager-specific value since there is a lower probability of an investigation following a missed dividend. The ability to make dividend payments, however, is related to ex-post performance and can improve replacement decisions. When managerial quality is commonly known, the expected value of the firm is maximized with a combination of debt and dividend commitments. When managerial quality is hidden information, it is optimal for the combination of debt and dividend commitments to signal quality. (C) 2001 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文研究了当管理者看重控制权且投资产生特定于管理者的价值时的财务政策、投资决策以及解雇威胁。较高的调查概率使管理者聚焦于被替换的可能性，从而聚焦于特定于管理者的价值。当企业进入破产时，调查的概率会增加。因此，高债务水平使管理者聚焦于那些能在破产程序中阻止被替换的投资。股利放松了管理者对特定于管理者价值的关注，因为在漏发股利后被调查的概率较低。然而，支付股利的能力与事后业绩相关，能够改善替换决策。当管理者素质是公知信息时，通过债务和股利承诺的组合可以最大化企业的预期价值。当管理者素质是隐藏信息时，最优做法是让债务和股利承诺的组合传递素质信号。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate investment incentives and accounting-based debt covenants
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies the conditions under which accounting-based debt covenants increase firm value in a setting that incorporates the conflicting incentives of shareholders, bondholders, and managers. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Corporate investment incentives and accounting-based debt covenants (2003) Paper claim — This paper studies the conditions under which accounting-based debt covenants increase firm value in a setting that incorporates the conflicting incentives of shareholders, bondholders, and managers. Raw markdown: douglas-2003-corporate-investment-incentives-and-accounting-based-debt-covenants Bibliographic Record Authors: Douglas, AVS Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1506/R8NT-Q5U8-AMQF-NHC8 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract This paper studies the conditions under which accounting-based debt covenants increase firm value in a setting that incorporates the conflicting incentives of shareholders, bondholders, and managers. We construct a model in which debt is needed to discipline managerial investment decisions despite endogenous compensation contracts. We show that accounting covenants increase value when (1) debt serves as a credible commitment to penalize poor investment decisions; (2) the firm faces other (exogenous) sources of uncertainty that can make debt risky despite good investment decisions; and (3) accounting information serves as a contractible proxy for firm's economic performance. In these circumstances, accounting covenants ensure that shareholders do not offer compensation schemes that would encourage bondholder wealth expropriation when the debt becomes risky. A covenant specifying a required level of accounting performance provides additional bondholder power when performance is low. An accounting-based dividend covenant allows a disbursement to maintain investment incentives when performance is high without allowing dividend-based expropriation. The optimal covenants depend on the reliability of accounting information, and the interaction between accounting performance and the different incentive conflicts provides new insight into the empirical literature on accounting-based covenants. 摘要（中文） 本文研究了在一个纳入股东、债券持有人和管理者相互冲突激励的框架下，基于会计的债务契约在何种条件下会提升公司价值。我们构建了一个模型，其中尽管存在内生的薪酬契约，仍需要债务来约束管理者的投资决策。我们表明，会计契约在以下情况下会提升价值：（1）债务作为一种可信的承诺来惩罚糟糕的投资决策；（2）公司面临其他（外生的）不确定性来源，即使在良好投资决策下也可能使债务变得有风险；（3）会计信息作为公司经济表现的可缔约代理变量。在这些情形下，会计契约确保股东不会提供在债务变得有风险时会鼓励侵占债券持有人财富的薪酬方案。一个规定所需会计表现水平的契约在表现低下时为债券持有人提供了额外的权力。一个基于会计的股利契约允许在表现高企时进行分配以维持投资激励，同时不允许基于股利的侵占。最优契约取决于会计信息的可靠性，并且会计表现与不同激励冲突之间的相互作用为关于基于会计的契约的实证文献提供了新的洞见。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Spillovers Inside Conglomerates: Incentives and Capital
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using hand-collected data on divisional managers at conglomerates, we find that a change in industry pay in one division generates spillovers on managerial pay in other divisions of the same firm. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Spillovers Inside Conglomerates: Incentives and Capital (2017) Paper claim — Using hand-collected data on divisional managers at conglomerates, we find that a change in industry pay in one division generates spillovers on managerial pay in other divisions of the same firm. Raw markdown: duchin-2017-spillovers-inside-conglomerates-incentives-and-capital Bibliographic Record Authors: Duchin, R, Goldberg, A, Sosyura, D Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhw095 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(distribution) Abstract Using hand-collected data on divisional managers at conglomerates, we find that a change in industry pay in one division generates spillovers on managerial pay in other divisions of the same firm. These spillovers arise only within the boundaries of a conglomerate. The intra-firm spillovers increase when conglomerates have excess cash and when managers have more influence over its distribution, but decline in the presence of strong governance. These spillovers are associated with weaker performance and lower firm value. Our evidence is consistent with simultaneous cross-subsidization via managerial compensation and capital budgets and suggests that these practices arise in similar firms. 摘要（中文） 利用手工搜集的关于综合性企业集团中各分部管理者的数据，我们发现，某一分部所在行业薪酬的变化会对同一企业其他分部管理者的薪酬产生溢出效应。这些溢出效应仅存在于综合性企业集团的边界之内。当企业集团拥有过剩现金、且管理者对其分配拥有更大影响力时，企业内部溢出效应增强；但在治理强健的情况下则减弱。这些溢出效应与较弱的业绩和较低的企业价值相关。我们的证据与通过管理者薪酬和资本预算同时进行交叉补贴相一致，并表明这些做法出现在特征相似的企业中。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managerial conservatism and corporate policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates how conservative managers make corporate decisions. Raw markdown: duong-2021-managerial-conservatism-and-corporate-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Duong, KT, Banti, C, Instefjord, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021…
pages.text: Managerial conservatism and corporate policies (2021) Paper claim — This paper investigates how conservative managers make corporate decisions. Raw markdown: duong-2021-managerial-conservatism-and-corporate-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Duong, KT, Banti, C, Instefjord, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.101973 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, stock repurchase) Abstract This paper investigates how conservative managers make corporate decisions. Motivated by psychology research, we use handwritten signatures (i.e., emotionally restraint disclosure styles) as a proxy for CEO conservatism. We find that firms with conservative CEOs engage more with safer investments (capital expenditures), engage less with risky policies (Research & Development expenses and debt financing), hold more cash, are less likely to pay cash dividends, and more likely to use stock repurchase schemes. We use the same proxy for CFO conservatism. We find that CFO conservatism is a better determinant than CEO conservatism for cash holding and financing policies, but the reverse is true for investment policies. Conservative CFOs prefer long-term debt to short-term debt. 摘要（中文） 本文考察保守型经理人如何作出企业决策。受心理学研究启发，我们使用手写签名（即情绪克制的披露风格）作为CEO保守主义的代理变量。我们发现，拥有保守型CEO的企业更多地从事较安全的投资（资本支出），较少从事风险性政策（研发支出和债务融资），持有更多现金，更不可能支付现金股利，更可能采用股票回购计划。我们对CFO保守主义使用同样的代理变量。我们发现，就现金持有和融资政策而言，CFO保守主义是比CEO保守主义更好的决定因素，但就投资政策而言则相反。保守型CFO偏好长期债务而非短期债务。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Profit maximization and the market selection hypothesis
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the proposition that competitive firms must behave as if they were maximizing profits; otherwise they would go bankrupt, or even fail to be financed in a competitive capital market. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Profit maximization and the market selection hypothesis (1999) Paper claim — We examine the proposition that competitive firms must behave as if they were maximizing profits; otherwise they would go bankrupt, or even fail to be financed in a competitive capital market. Raw markdown: dutta-1999-profit-maximization-and-the-market-selection-hypothesis Bibliographic Record Authors: Dutta, PK, Radner, R Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1111/1467-937X.00108 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine the proposition that competitive firms must behave as if they were maximizing profits; otherwise they would go bankrupt, or even fail to be financed in a competitive capital market. We investigate a model in which an entrepreneur raises funds for a risky enterprise on a competitive capital market, by offering a "dividend policy" based on the realized (stochastic) flow of earnings. We show that an entrepreneur who maximizes the expected sum of discounted dividends is sure to fail in finite time. On the other hand, many other behaviours yield positive expected profits and are able to attract investment funds, and yet result in a positive probability of surviving forever. As a consequence, if new firms have sufficiently diverse behaviours, then even if there is a constant stream of new entrants, after a long time practically all of the surviving firms will not hare been maximizing profits. 摘要（中文） 我们考察这样一个命题，即竞争性企业必须表现得仿佛在最大化利润；否则它们会破产，甚至无法在竞争性资本市场上获得融资。我们研究一个模型，其中一位企业家通过基于已实现（随机）盈利流提供一种“股利政策”，在竞争性资本市场上为一项有风险的企业筹集资金。我们表明，最大化贴现股利期望之和的企业家必定在有限时间内破产。另一方面，许多其他行为会产生正的预期利润并能够吸引投资资金，同时结果是有正概率永远存续。因此，如果新企业具有足够多样化的行为，那么即使有源源不断的新进入者，在长时间之后几乎所有存续的企业都不会是在最大化利润的企业。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Optimal Corporate Taxation Under Financial Frictions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article studies the optimal design of corporate taxes when firms have private information about future investment opportunities and face financial constraints. Raw markdown: dvila-2023-optimal-corporate-taxation-under-financial-frictions Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Optimal Corporate Taxation Under Financial Frictions (2023) Paper claim — This article studies the optimal design of corporate taxes when firms have private information about future investment opportunities and face financial constraints. Raw markdown: dvila-2023-optimal-corporate-taxation-under-financial-frictions Bibliographic Record Authors: Dávila, E, Hébert, B Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1093/restud/rdac068 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract This article studies the optimal design of corporate taxes when firms have private information about future investment opportunities and face financial constraints. A government whose goal is to efficiently raise a given amount of revenue from its corporate sector should attempt to tax unconstrained firms, which value resources inside the firm less than financially constrained firms. We show that a corporate payout tax (a tax on dividends and share repurchases) can both separate constrained and unconstrained firms and raise revenue and is therefore optimal. Our quantitative analysis implies that a revenue-neutral switch from profit taxation to payout taxation would increase the overall value of existing firms and new entrants by 7%. This switch could be implemented in the current US tax system by making retained earnings fully deductible. 摘要（中文） 本文研究当企业对未来投资机会拥有私人信息且面临融资约束时公司税的最优设计。一个以从其公司部门高效筹集给定收入量为目标的政府，应设法对不受约束的企业征税，因为这类企业对企业内部资源的估值低于受融资约束的企业。我们表明，公司派现税（对股利和股份回购征税）既能区分受约束和不受约束的企业，又能筹集收入，因此是最优的。我们的定量分析意味着，从利润税转向派现税的收入中性转换将使现有企业和新进入者的整体价值提高7%。这一转换可以通过使留存收益完全可抵扣来在当前美国税制中实施。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Reload options, call options granting new options on exercise, are popularly used in compensation. Raw markdown: dybvig-2003-employee-reload-options-pricing-hedging-and-optimal-exercise Bibliographic Record Authors: Dybvig, PH, Loewenstein, M Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: Employee reload options: Pricing, hedging, and optimal exercise (2003) Paper claim — Reload options, call options granting new options on exercise, are popularly used in compensation. Raw markdown: dybvig-2003-employee-reload-options-pricing-hedging-and-optimal-exercise Bibliographic Record Authors: Dybvig, PH, Loewenstein, M Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/16.1.145 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Reload options, call options granting new options on exercise, are popularly used in compensation. Although the compound option feature may seem complicated, there is a distribution-free dominant policy of exercising reload options whenever they are in the money. The optimal policy implies general formulas for numerical valuation. Simpler formulas for valuation and hedging follow from Black-Scholes assumptions with or without continuous dividends. Time vesting affects the optimal policy, but numerical results indicate that it is nearly optimal to exercise in the money whenever feasible. The results suggest that reload options produce similar incentives as employee stock options and share grants. 摘要（中文） 重载期权（reload options），即在行权时授予新期权的看涨期权，在薪酬中被广泛使用。尽管复合期权特征看似复杂，但存在一种无分布依赖（distribution-free）的占优策略，即只要重载期权处于价内（in the money）就行权。该最优策略意味着可得出用于数值估值的一般公式。在有或没有连续股利的Black-Scholes假设下，可得出更简单的估值和对冲公式。时间归属（time vesting）会影响最优策略，但数值结果表明，只要可行，在价内行权几乎就是最优的。这些结果表明，重载期权产生的激励与员工股票期权和股份授予相似。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the interaction between firm uncertainty and corporate policies, emphasizing the role of skewness in the distribution of performance shocks reflected in stock returns. Raw markdown: easterwood-2021-firm-uncertainty-and-corporate-policies-the-role-of…
pages.text: Firm uncertainty and corporate policies: The role of stock return skewness (2021) Paper claim — We study the interaction between firm uncertainty and corporate policies, emphasizing the role of skewness in the distribution of performance shocks reflected in stock returns. Raw markdown: easterwood-2021-firm-uncertainty-and-corporate-policies-the-role-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Easterwood, JC, Paye, BS, Xie, YT Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.102032 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout) Abstract We study the interaction between firm uncertainty and corporate policies, emphasizing the role of skewness in the distribution of performance shocks reflected in stock returns. Conditional on volatility and other characteristics, firms with more negatively skewed performance shocks adopt more conservative policies, including greater cash holdings, a lower likelihood of dividend payments and increases in payout levels, and less financial leverage. These relationships are significant and robust for asymmetry proxies constructed from stock return innovations, in contrast to results for measures based on accounting performance shocks. This disparity highlights the importance of asymmetries in long-run performance shocks for corporate policy choices. 摘要（中文） 我们研究企业不确定性与公司政策之间的相互作用，强调反映在股票收益中的业绩冲击分布的偏度所起的作用。在给定波动率和其他特征的条件下，业绩冲击负偏度更大的企业采取更保守的政策，包括更多的现金持有、更低的股利支付可能性和派现水平上升，以及更低的财务杠杆。对于由股票收益创新构建的非对称性代理变量，这些关系是显著且稳健的，这与基于会计业绩冲击的度量所得结果形成对比。这一差异凸显了长期业绩冲击中的非对称性对公司政策选择的重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout Yields and Stock Return Predictability: How Important Is the Measure of Cash Flow?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We compare the stock return forecasting performance of alternative payout yields. Raw markdown: eaton-2017-payout-yields-and-stock-return-predictability-how-important Bibliographic Record Authors: Eaton, GW, Paye, BS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE…
pages.text: Payout Yields and Stock Return Predictability: How Important Is the Measure of Cash Flow? (2017) Paper claim — We compare the stock return forecasting performance of alternative payout yields. Raw markdown: eaton-2017-payout-yields-and-stock-return-predictability-how-important Bibliographic Record Authors: Eaton, GW, Paye, BS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109017000370 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract We compare the stock return forecasting performance of alternative payout yields. The net payout yield produces more accurate forecasts relative to alternatives, including the traditional dividend yield. This remains true even after excluding several years during the Great Depression when issuance was unusually high. The measure of cash flow used to form the yield matters economically. Long-term investors' hedging demand for stock is considerably reduced when net payout, rather than dividends, serves as the cash-flow measure. An agent relying on an incorrect payout measure is willing to pay an economically significant "management fee" to switch to the optimal policy. 摘要（中文） 我们比较各种替代性支付收益率的股票收益预测表现。相对于包括传统股利收益率在内的各种替代指标，净支付收益率产生了更为准确的预测。即便剔除大萧条期间股票发行异常高涨的若干年份，这一结论仍然成立。用于构造收益率的现金流指标在经济意义上很重要。当以净支付而非股利作为现金流指标时，长期投资者对股票的对冲需求会大大降低。一个依赖错误支付指标的主体愿意支付一笔具有经济意义的"管理费"以转向最优政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Short-term termination without deterring long-term investment: A theory of debt and buyouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The option to terminate a manager early minimizes investor losses if he is unskilled. Raw markdown: edmans-2011-short-term-termination-without-deterring-long-term-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Edmans, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011…
pages.text: Short-term termination without deterring long-term investment: A theory of debt and buyouts (2011) Paper claim — The option to terminate a manager early minimizes investor losses if he is unskilled. Raw markdown: edmans-2011-short-term-termination-without-deterring-long-term-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Edmans, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2010.11.005 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract The option to terminate a manager early minimizes investor losses if he is unskilled. However, it also deters a skilled manager from undertaking efficient long-term projects that risk low short-term earnings. This paper demonstrates how risky debt can overcome this tension. Leverage concentrates equityholders' stakes, inducing them to learn the cause of low earnings. If they result from investment (poor management), the firm is continued (liquidated). Therefore, unskilled managers are terminated and skilled managers invest without fear of termination. Unlike models of managerial discipline based on total payout, dividends are not a substitute for debt-they allow for termination upon non-payment, but at the expense of investment since they do not concentrate ownership and induce monitoring. Debt is dynamically consistent as the manager benefits from monitoring. In traditional theories, monitoring constrains the manager; here, it frees him to invest. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 提前解雇经理人的选择权，在经理人不具技能时可将投资者损失降至最低。然而，它也阻碍了有技能的经理人从事那些有低短期盈利风险的高效长期项目。本文展示了有风险的债务如何能够克服这一张力。杠杆使股权持有人的股份集中，促使他们去了解低盈利的原因。如果低盈利源于投资（管理不善），企业将得以持续经营（被清算）。因此，不具技能的经理人被解雇，而有技能的经理人在不惧被解雇的情况下进行投资。与基于总派现的管理者约束模型不同，股利并非债务的替代物——它们允许在不付款时进行解雇，但代价是牺牲投资，因为它们并不使所有权集中并诱导监督。债务是动态一致的，因为经理人从监督中受益。在传统理论中，监督约束经理人；而在这里，它使经理人得以自由投资。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The value of a flow-through entity in an integrated corporate tax system
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In an integrated corporate tax system, resident shareholders receive a tax credit for corporate tax paid that can be used to offset personal tax on dividend income. Raw markdown: edwards-2011-the-value-of-a-flow-through-entity-in Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: The value of a flow-through entity in an integrated corporate tax system (2011) Paper claim — In an integrated corporate tax system, resident shareholders receive a tax credit for corporate tax paid that can be used to offset personal tax on dividend income. Raw markdown: edwards-2011-the-value-of-a-flow-through-entity-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Edwards, A, Shevlin, T Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.03.003 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract In an integrated corporate tax system, resident shareholders receive a tax credit for corporate tax paid that can be used to offset personal tax on dividend income. Nonresident and tax-exempt (pension plan) investors cannot use the tax credit on corporate dividends and thus prefer to invest in flow-through entities. We estimate the value of the flow-through entity to nonresident and pension plan investors by examining the price change around the date of an unexpected announcement of a change in tax law related to Canadian publicly traded income trusts units creating an entity-level tax that makes them no longer tax-favored to these investors. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在综合公司税制下，居民股东可就企业已缴纳的公司税获得税收抵免，用以抵减股利收入的个人税。非居民和免税（养老金计划）投资者无法使用公司股利上的税收抵免，因而更倾向于投资于流通实体。我们通过考察加拿大公开交易的收入信托单位在一项意外的税法变更公告日前后的价格变化，估计了流通实体对非居民和养老金计划投资者的价值，该税法变更设立了一项实体层面的税，使得这些信托单位对这些投资者而言不再享有税收优惠。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Correlations
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Correlations of equity returns have varied substantially over time and remain a source of continuing policy debate. Raw markdown: ehling-2017-correlations Bibliographic Record Authors: Ehling, P, Heyerdahl-Larsen, C Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2017 DOI:…
pages.text: Correlations (2017) Paper claim — Correlations of equity returns have varied substantially over time and remain a source of continuing policy debate. Raw markdown: ehling-2017-correlations Bibliographic Record Authors: Ehling, P, Heyerdahl-Larsen, C Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2015.2413 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Correlations of equity returns have varied substantially over time and remain a source of continuing policy debate. This paper studies stock market correlations in an equilibrium model with heterogeneous risk aversion. In the model, preference heterogeneity causes variations in the volatility of aggregate risk aversion from good to bad states. At times of high volatility in aggregate risk aversion, which is a common factor in returns, we see high correlations. The model matches average industry return correlations and changes in correlations from business cycle peaks to troughs and replicates the dynamics of expected excess returns and standard deviations. Model-implied aggregate risk aversion explains average industry correlations, expected excess returns, standard deviations, and turnover volatility in the data. We find supportive evidence for the model's prediction that industries with low dividend-consumption correlation have low average return correlation but experience disproportional increases in return correlations in recessions. 摘要（中文） 股票收益的相关性随时间发生了显著变化，并且仍是持续的政策辩论之源。本文在一个具有异质风险规避的均衡模型中研究股票市场相关性。在该模型中，偏好异质性导致总量风险规避的波动性在好状态与坏状态之间发生变化。在总量风险规避波动性较高的时期（总量风险规避是收益中的一个共同因子），我们观察到较高的相关性。该模型匹配了行业平均收益相关性以及从经济周期波峰到波谷相关性的变化，并复现了预期超额收益和标准差的动态。模型隐含的总量风险规避解释了数据中行业平均相关性、预期超额收益、标准差以及换手率波动性。我们发现了支持模型预测的证据，即股利—消费相关性较低的行业具有较低的平均收益相关性，但在衰退期收益相关性会不成比例地上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do corporate managers skimp on shareholders' dividends to protect their own retirement funds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — What is the impact of long-term executive compensation, particularly large pension payouts, on the firm's current dividend policy? We argue that managers with high pension holdings are less likely to adopt a high dividend policy that can risk their future pension…
pages.text: Do corporate managers skimp on shareholders' dividends to protect their own retirement funds (2015) Paper claim — What is the impact of long-term executive compensation, particularly large pension payouts, on the firm's current dividend policy? We argue that managers with high pension holdings are less likely to adopt a high dividend policy that can risk their future pension payouts. Raw markdown: eisdorfer-2015-do-corporate-managers-skimp-on-shareholders-dividends-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Eisdorfer, A, Giaccotto, C, White, R Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.12.005 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, stock repurchase)；影响机制(agency) Abstract What is the impact of long-term executive compensation, particularly large pension payouts, on the firm's current dividend policy? We argue that managers with high pension holdings are less likely to adopt a high dividend policy that can risk their future pension payouts. Using a hand-collected actuarial pension dataset we show that (i) dividend payments are significantly lower when manager compensation relies more heavily on pension payouts; (ii) higher compensation leverage and inside debt have a significant negative effect on dividend payments net of stock repurchases; and (iii) the negative effect of pension on dividend is significantly weaker when pensions are protected in a pre-funding rabbi trust. We show further that this agency behavior reduces firm performance. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 长期高管薪酬，尤其是大额养老金支付，对企业当前股利政策有何影响？我们认为，养老金持有量高的管理者更不可能采用可能危及其未来养老金支付的高股利政策。使用手工收集的精算养老金数据集，我们表明：(i) 当管理者薪酬更多地依赖养老金支付时，股利支付显著更低；(ii) 更高的薪酬杠杆和内部债务对扣除股份回购后的净股利支付具有显著的负面影响；以及 (iii) 当养老金在预先注资的拉比信托（rabbi trust）中受到保护时，养老金对股利的负面影响显著减弱。我们进一步表明，这种代理行为降低了企业业绩。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Collaborating to Innovate: Balancing Strategy Dividend and Transactional Efficiencies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — When a firm collaborates with its suppliers, it expands its access to external know-how and thus can enhance its innovation performance. Raw markdown: elhelaly-2024-collaborating-to-innovate-balancing-strategy-dividend-and-transactional Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Collaborating to Innovate: Balancing Strategy Dividend and Transactional Efficiencies (2024) Paper claim — When a firm collaborates with its suppliers, it expands its access to external know-how and thus can enhance its innovation performance. Raw markdown: elhelaly-2024-collaborating-to-innovate-balancing-strategy-dividend-and-transactional Bibliographic Record Authors: Elhelaly, N, Ray, S Journal: JOURNAL OF MARKETING Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1177/00222429231222269 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract When a firm collaborates with its suppliers, it expands its access to external know-how and thus can enhance its innovation performance. Such collaborations are common and argued to have significant impact on the firm's market outcomes. However, such collaborations also expose the firm to various transactional hazards, including knowledge spillovers and opportunism. This trade-off looms over the firm's commitment to a market positioning strategy and the functional capabilities it draws on to generate its strategy dividend. Recent accounts suggest that the verdict on supplier collaborations is noisy and that partner perceptions of these collaborations do not align on key issues of governance, strategy, and value generation. To investigate this, the authors study 202 formal codevelopment contracts of high-tech original equipment manufacturers that collaborated with suppliers from 1985 to 2016. Drawing on the governance value analysis framework, the authors show how misalignment between the firm's codevelopment contracts, capabilities, and market positioning strategy significantly erodes its innovation performance. Thus, blanket prescriptions for one type of contract or the other are misdirected, their effectiveness being a contingent outcome dependent on the firm's market positioning strategy and functional capabilities. This research presents one of the most complete tests of the governance value analysis framework to date. 摘要（中文） 当一家企业与其供应商合作时，它扩大了对外部专业知识的获取，从而能够提升其创新绩效。此类合作很常见，并被认为对企业的市场结果有重大影响。然而，此类合作也使企业面临各种交易风险，包括知识溢出和机会主义。这种权衡笼罩着企业对市场定位战略的承诺以及它所依赖以产生“战略红利”（strategy dividend）的职能能力。近期的研究表明，关于供应商合作的结论是嘈杂的，且合作伙伴对这些合作的看法在治理、战略和价值创造等关键问题上并不一致。为研究这一点，作者研究了1985至2016年间与供应商合作的高科技原始设备制造商的202份正式共同开发合同。借助治理价值分析框架，作者展示了企业的共同开发合同、能力与市场定位战略之间的错配如何显著侵蚀其创新绩效。因此，一刀切地推崇某一类合同的做法是错误的，其有效性是一种取决于企业市场定位战略和职能能力的权变结果。这项研究呈现了迄今为止对治理价值分析框架最完整的检验之一。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Show Me the Money! Dividend Policy in Countries with Weak Institutions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We hypothesize that, in weak-institution countries, firms adjust the 'timing' of dividend payments by committing to distribute a percentage of current earnings as dividends, revealing the extent of firm-level agency conflicts to future investors and facilitating…
pages.text: Show Me the Money! Dividend Policy in Countries with Weak Institutions (2021) Paper claim — We hypothesize that, in weak-institution countries, firms adjust the 'timing' of dividend payments by committing to distribute a percentage of current earnings as dividends, revealing the extent of firm-level agency conflicts to future investors and facilitating the raising of external capital. Raw markdown: ellahie-2021-show-me-the-money-dividend-policy-in-countries Bibliographic Record Authors: Ellahie, A, Kaplan, Z Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12363 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We hypothesize that, in weak-institution countries, firms adjust the 'timing' of dividend payments by committing to distribute a percentage of current earnings as dividends, revealing the extent of firm-level agency conflicts to future investors and facilitating the raising of external capital. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that, on average, firms in weak-institution countries have a higher speed of adjustment (SOA) to their target payout ratio, pay dividends earlier in the life cycle, and are more likely to disclose a dividend policy committing to pay a minimum percentage of earnings. Within-country tests show that, in weak-institution countries, the firms with the highest SOA dividend policies have fewer agency problems and an increased ability to raise external capital. Finally, returns tests around earnings announcements show that high-SOA dividend policies are associated with larger market reactions to earnings in weak-institution countries. Collectively, our findings suggest that dividend policy helps to alleviate agency conflicts in weak-institution countries between firms and (future) investors. 摘要（中文） 我们假设，在制度薄弱的国家，企业通过承诺将当期收益的一定百分比分配为股利来调整股利支付的"时机"，向未来投资者披露企业层面代理冲突的程度，并便利外部资本的筹集。与这一假设一致，我们发现，平均而言，制度薄弱国家的企业向其目标支付率调整的速度（SOA）更高，在生命周期中更早派息，并且更可能披露一项承诺支付最低收益百分比的股利政策。国内检验表明，在制度薄弱的国家，拥有最高SOA股利政策的企业代理问题较少，且筹集外部资本的能力增强。最后，围绕盈余公告的收益检验表明，在制度薄弱的国家，高SOA股利政策与更大的市场对收益的反应相关联。总体而言，我们的发现表明，在制度薄弱的国家，股利政策有助于缓解企业与（未来）投资者之间的代理冲突。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Show Me the Money! Dividend Policy in Countries with Weak Institutions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In countries with weak institutions, firms with less severe agency conflicts commit to returning a proportion of current earnings as dividends (high speed of adjustment), using dividend timing rather than level as a credible signal that facilitates external equity…
pages.text: Show Me the Money! Dividend Policy in Countries with Weak Institutions (2021) Paper claim — In countries with weak institutions, firms with less severe agency conflicts commit to returning a proportion of current earnings as dividends (high speed of adjustment), using dividend timing rather than level as a credible signal that facilitates external equity capital raising — a mechanism absent in strong-institution countries. Raw markdown: ellahie-kaplan-2021-show-me-the-money-dividend-policy-in-countries-with-weak-ins Bibliographic Record Authors: Ellahie, Atif; Kaplan, Zachary Journal: Journal of Accounting Research Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12363 Abstract We hypothesize that, in weak-institution countries, firms adjust the "timing" of dividend payments by committing to distribute a percentage of current earnings as dividends, revealing the extent of firm-level agency conflicts to future investors and facilitating the raising of external capital. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that, on average, firms in weak-institution countries have a higher speed of adjustment (SOA) to their target payout ratio, pay dividends earlier in the lifecycle, and are more likely to disclose a dividend policy committing to pay a minimum percentage of earnings. Within-country tests show that, in weak-institution countries, the firms with the highest SOA dividend policies have fewer agency problems and an increased ability to raise external capital. Finally, returns tests around earnings announcements show that high-SOA dividend policies are associated with larger market reactions to earnings in weak-institution countries. Collectively, our findings suggest that dividend policy helps to alleviate agency conflicts in weak-institution countries between firms and (future) investors. Key Findings Country-level Institutional Quality (World Bank governance indicators, normalized 0–1) explains 48.2% of cross-country variation in average dividend speed of adjustment (SOA) across 85 countries, with a coefficient of −0.42 (t = −7.61): firms in the weakest-institution country adjust dividends 42% more strongly in response to earnings changes than firms in the strongest-institution country. Firm-level cross-sectional regressions confirm the association (Institutional Quality coefficient = −0.33, t = −4.79 after controls), and the result is robust to the inclusion of mandatory dividend rules, ownership structure, tax regimes, and per capita GDP. SOA is also higher for gross payout (dividends plus buybacks) in weak-institution countries, though with 26% attenuation. Within-country tests show the SOA–Institutional Quality association is stronger for firms with higher market valuations, stronger analyst following, higher audit fees, lower return volatility, and greater equity issuance activity — consistent with high-SOA policies being adopted by firms with lower agency conflicts in weak-institution environments. 18% of the 349 largest dividend payers globally commit to a minimum payout ratio (average = 37% of earnings); firms with such policies are located in weaker-institution countries, have higher SOA, and adhere to their stated payout commitments. Cross-listed firms (US ADRs) in weak-institution countries exhibit lower SOA-Institutional Quality associations, consistent with US cross-listing bonding substituting for the commitment function of high-SOA dividend policy. Firms in weak-institution countries deviate from the typical life-cycle dividend pattern by paying dividends earlier (when growth options are still strong) and are more successful at equity capital raising when they maintain high-SOA policies (larger issuance amounts, more positive announcement returns). pages.title: Pitfalls in VAR based return decompositions: A clarification
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze the pitfalls involved in VAR based return decompositions. Raw markdown: engsted-2012-pitfalls-in-var-based-return-decompositions-a-clarification Bibliographic Record Authors: Engsted, T, Pedersen, TQ, Tanggaard, C Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE…
pages.text: Pitfalls in VAR based return decompositions: A clarification (2012) Paper claim — We analyze the pitfalls involved in VAR based return decompositions. Raw markdown: engsted-2012-pitfalls-in-var-based-return-decompositions-a-clarification Bibliographic Record Authors: Engsted, T, Pedersen, TQ, Tanggaard, C Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2011.11.004 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We analyze the pitfalls involved in VAR based return decompositions. First, we show that recent criticism of such decompositions is misplaced and builds on invalid VAR models and erroneous interpretations. Second, we derive the requirements needed for VAR decompositions to be valid. A crucial - but often neglected - requirement is that the asset price needs to be included as a state variable in the VAR. In equity return decompositions this requirement is equivalent to including the dividend-price ratio in the VAR. Finally, we clarify the intriguing issue of the role of the residual component in return decompositions. In a properly specified first-order VAR, it makes no difference whether cash flow news or discount rate news is backed out residually, and it makes no difference whether both news components are computed directly or one of them is backed out residually. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们分析了基于VAR的收益分解所涉及的陷阱。首先，我们表明近期对此类分解的批评是错误的，并且建立在无效的VAR模型和错误的解释之上。其次，我们推导了VAR分解有效所需的条件。一个关键但常被忽视的要求是，资产价格需要作为一个状态变量被纳入VAR。在股权收益分解中，这一要求等价于将股利-价格比纳入VAR。最后，我们澄清了关于残差成分在收益分解中作用这一引人入胜的问题。在一个正确设定的一阶VAR中，无论是现金流消息还是贴现率消息被残差性地反推出来都没有区别，无论是两个消息成分都被直接计算还是其中一个被残差性地反推出来也都没有区别。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and expropriation

pages.text: Dividends and expropriation (2001) Paper claim — Whereas most U.S. Raw markdown: faccio-2001-dividends-and-expropriation Bibliographic Record Authors: Faccio, M, Lang, LHP, Young, L Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1257/aer.91.1.54 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, expropri) Abstract Whereas most U.S. corporations are widely held, the predominant form of ownership in East Asia is control by a family, which often supplies a top manager. These features of "crony capitalism" are actually more pronounced in Western Europe. In both regions, the salient agency problem is expropriation of outside shareholders by controlling shareholders. Dividends provide evidence on this. Group-affiliated corporations in Europe pay higher dividends than in Asia, dampening insider expropriation. Dividend rates are higher in Europe. but lower in Asia, when there are multiple large shareholders, suggesting that they dampen expropriation in Europe, bur exacerbate it in Asia. 摘要（中文） 尽管大多数美国公司股权分散，但东亚地区占主导地位的所有权形式是由家族控制，家族往往还提供一名高管。这些"裙带资本主义"（crony capitalism）的特征在西欧实际上更为明显。在这两个地区，突出的代理问题都是控股股东对外部股东的侵占（掏空）。股利为此提供了证据。集团附属公司在欧洲支付的股利高于亚洲，从而抑制了内部人的掏空。当存在多个大股东时，股利率在欧洲更高、而在亚洲更低，这表明多个大股东在欧洲抑制了掏空，但在亚洲却加剧了掏空。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use cross-sectional regressions to study how a firm's value is related to dividends and debt. Raw markdown: fama-1998-taxes-financing-decisions-and-firm-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Fama, EF, French, KR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI:…
pages.text: Taxes, financing decisions, and firm value (1998) Paper claim — We use cross-sectional regressions to study how a firm's value is related to dividends and debt. Raw markdown: fama-1998-taxes-financing-decisions-and-firm-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Fama, EF, French, KR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00036 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We use cross-sectional regressions to study how a firm's value is related to dividends and debt. With a good control for profitability, the regressions can measure how the taxation of dividends and debt affects firm value. Simple tax hypotheses say that value is negatively related to dividends and positively related to debt. We find the opposite. We infer that dividends and debt convey information about profitability (expected net cash flows) missed by a wide range of control variables. This information about profitability obscures any tax effects of financing decisions. 摘要（中文） 我们使用横截面回归来研究公司价值如何与股利和债务相关。在对盈利能力有良好控制的情况下，这些回归能够衡量股利和债务的税收如何影响公司价值。简单的税收假说认为，价值与股利负相关，与债务正相关。我们发现的却恰恰相反。我们推断，股利和债务传递了广泛的控制变量所遗漏的、关于盈利能力（预期净现金流）的信息。这一关于盈利能力的信息掩盖了融资决策的任何税收效应。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Disappearing dividends: changing firm characteristics or lower propensity to pay? (2001) Paper claim — The proportion of fir ms paying cash dividends falls from 66.5% in 1978 to 20.8% in 1999, due in part to the changing characteristics of publicly traded firms. Raw markdown: fama-2001-disappearing-dividends-changing-firm-characteristics-or-lower-propensity Bibliographic Record Authors: Fama, EF, French, KR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(01)00038-1 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract The proportion of fir ms paying cash dividends falls from 66.5% in 1978 to 20.8% in 1999, due in part to the changing characteristics of publicly traded firms. Fed by new listings, the population of publicly traded firms tilts increasingly toward small firms with low profitability and strong growth opportunities - characteristics typical of firms that have never paid dividends. More interesting, we also show that regardless of their characteristics, firms have become less likely to pay dividends. This lower propensity to pay is at least as important as changing characteristics in the declining incidence of dividend-paying firms. (C) 2001 Published by Elsevier Science S.A. 摘要（中文） 支付现金股利的公司比例从1978年的66.5%下降至1999年的20.8%，部分原因在于上市公司特征的变化。在新上市公司的推动下，上市公司群体日益向规模小、盈利能力低、成长机会强的公司倾斜——这些正是从未支付过股利的公司所具有的典型特征。更有意思的是，我们还表明，无论公司特征如何，公司支付股利的可能性都变低了。这种较低的支付倾向在支付股利公司数量下降中所起的作用，至少与公司特征的变化同等重要。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Confirming predictions shared by the trade-off and pecking order models, more profitable firms and firms with fewer investments have higher dividend payouts. Raw markdown: fama-2002-testing-trade-off-and-pecking-order-predictions-about Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Testing trade-off and pecking order predictions about dividends and debt (2002) Paper claim — Confirming predictions shared by the trade-off and pecking order models, more profitable firms and firms with fewer investments have higher dividend payouts. Raw markdown: fama-2002-testing-trade-off-and-pecking-order-predictions-about Bibliographic Record Authors: Fama, EF, French, KR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/15.1.1 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract Confirming predictions shared by the trade-off and pecking order models, more profitable firms and firms with fewer investments have higher dividend payouts. Confirming the pecking order model but contradicting the trade-off model, more profitable firms are less levered. Firms with more investments have less market leverage, which is consistent with the trade-off model and a complex pecking order model. Firms with more investments have lower long-term dividend payouts, but dividends do not vary to accommodate short-term variation in investment. As the pecking order model predicts, short-term variation in investment and earnings is mostly absorbed by debt. 摘要（中文） 与权衡模型和啄食顺序模型共有的预测相印证，盈利能力更强的企业以及投资较少的企业具有更高的股利支付。与啄食顺序模型相印证但与权衡模型相矛盾，盈利能力更强的企业杠杆更低。投资更多的企业市场杠杆更低，这与权衡模型和一个复杂的啄食顺序模型相一致。投资更多的企业长期股利支付更低，但股利并不会随投资的短期变化而变动以作出调节。正如啄食顺序模型所预测的，投资和盈余的短期变化大多由债务吸收。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The valuation of debt and equity, reorganization boundaries, and firm's optimal dividend policies are studied in a framework where we model strategic interactions between debt holders and equity holders in a game-theoretic setting which can accommodate varying…
pages.text: Debt valuation, renegotiation, and optimal dividend policy (2000) Paper claim — The valuation of debt and equity, reorganization boundaries, and firm's optimal dividend policies are studied in a framework where we model strategic interactions between debt holders and equity holders in a game-theoretic setting which can accommodate varying bargaining powers to the two claimants. Raw markdown: fan-2000-debt-valuation-renegotiation-and-optimal-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Fan, H, Sundaresan, SM Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/13.4.1057 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract The valuation of debt and equity, reorganization boundaries, and firm's optimal dividend policies are studied in a framework where we model strategic interactions between debt holders and equity holders in a game-theoretic setting which can accommodate varying bargaining powers to the two claimants. Two formulations of reorganization are presented: debt-equity swaps and strategic debt service resulting from negotiated debt service reductions. We study the effects of bond covenants on payout policies and distinguish liquidity-induced defaults from strategic defaults. We derive optimal equity issuance and payout policies. The debt capacity of the firm and the optimal capital structure are characterized. 摘要（中文） 本文在一个博弈论框架下研究债务和股权的估值、重组边界以及公司的最优股利政策，该框架对债权人与股权持有人之间的策略性互动进行建模，并可容纳两类求偿人不同的谈判能力。文中给出了两种重组的表述：债转股互换以及由协商减少偿债所产生的策略性偿债。我们研究债券契约条款对支付政策的影响，并区分流动性引致的违约与策略性违约。我们推导出最优的股权发行和支付政策，并刻画了公司的债务容量和最优资本结构。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of ownership transferability on family firm governance and performance: The case of family trusts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Ownership structure plays a critical role in the incentives and behaviors of business organizations. Raw markdown: fan-2020-the-impact-of-ownership-transferability-on-family-firm Bibliographic Record Authors: Fan, JPH, Leung, WSC Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE…
pages.text: The impact of ownership transferability on family firm governance and performance: The case of family trusts (2020) Paper claim — Ownership structure plays a critical role in the incentives and behaviors of business organizations. Raw markdown: fan-2020-the-impact-of-ownership-transferability-on-family-firm Bibliographic Record Authors: Fan, JPH, Leung, WSC Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2018.09.004 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Ownership structure plays a critical role in the incentives and behaviors of business organizations. The literature has focused on the effects of firm ownership dispersion across managers and investors. We extend the literature by examining the roles of ownership structure within a controlling family. Specifically, we focus on the family trust structure, which is a popular vehicle for holding family ownership around the world. The trust structure typically locks controlling ownership within a family for a very long period. Although it ensures family control, the share transfer restriction may induce family shirking problems, make family conflicts difficult to resolve, and distort firm decisions. Based on a sample of publicly traded family firms in Hong Kong, we report that trust-controlled firms that are more susceptible to these problems tend to pay higher dividends, invest less in the long term, and experience worse performance. The costs of using a trust structure are more significant when the family stakes have been locked inside the trust for a longer period and when a larger amount of family ownership is held by the trust. 摘要（中文） 所有权结构在商业组织的激励与行为中发挥着关键作用。既有文献聚焦于企业所有权在管理者与投资者之间分散的影响。我们通过考察控股家族内部所有权结构的作用来拓展这一文献。具体而言，我们聚焦于家族信托结构，这是全球范围内持有家族所有权的一种流行工具。信托结构通常将控股所有权在家族内部锁定极长的时间。尽管它确保了家族控制，但股份转让限制可能诱发家族偷懒问题，使家族冲突难以化解，并扭曲公司决策。基于香港上市家族企业的样本，我们报告称，更易受这些问题影响的信托控制企业往往支付更高的股利、进行更少的长期投资，并经历更差的业绩。当家族股份在信托内被锁定的时间越长、信托持有的家族所有权数量越大时，采用信托结构的成本就越显著。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Trading restrictions and firm dividends: The share lockup expiration experience in China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Chinese firms experienced a substantial reduction in nontradable shares following the Split-Share Structure Reform that began in 2005. Raw markdown: fang-2017-trading-restrictions-and-firm-dividends-the-share-lockup Bibliographic Record Authors: Fang, HY, Song, ZH,…
pages.text: Trading restrictions and firm dividends: The share lockup expiration experience in China (2017) Paper claim — Chinese firms experienced a substantial reduction in nontradable shares following the Split-Share Structure Reform that began in 2005. Raw markdown: fang-2017-trading-restrictions-and-firm-dividends-the-share-lockup Bibliographic Record Authors: Fang, HY, Song, ZH, Nofsinger, JR, Wang, YY Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2017.08.012 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, reform)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Chinese firms experienced a substantial reduction in nontradable shares following the Split-Share Structure Reform that began in 2005. The decrease in nontradable shares, or increase in share tradability, is associated with a decline in the firms' cash dividend payouts. The positive association is attenuated in firms with fewer financial constraints, only weakly affected by firm governance, and not affected by investment opportunities or controlling shareholder type. The results highlight the fact that firms disgorge cash to compensate shareholders for trading restrictions and conclude that dividends persist when firms have easier access to external financing. These findings are robust to alternative definitions of nontradable shares, after controlling for firm fixed effects and omitted changing firm characteristics. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 自2005年开始的股权分置改革之后，中国企业的非流通股大幅减少。非流通股的减少，或股份可交易性的增加，与企业现金股利支付的下降相关。这一正相关关系在财务约束较少的企业中被削弱，仅受企业治理的微弱影响，且不受投资机会或控股股东类型的影响。结果凸显了这样一个事实：企业吐出现金以补偿股东所受的交易限制，并得出结论认为，当企业更容易获得外部融资时股利依然存在。这些发现在非流通股的替代性定义下、以及在控制企业固定效应和被遗漏的变化中的企业特征之后，依然稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Partial vertical ownership in the presence of downstream competition
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms sometimes acquire partial ownership of their upstream suppliers. Raw markdown: fang-2023-partial-vertical-ownership-in-the-presence-of-downstream Bibliographic Record Authors: Fang, F, Jiang, BJ, Sun, J Journal: PRODUCTION AND OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT Year: 2023…
pages.text: Partial vertical ownership in the presence of downstream competition (2023) Paper claim — Firms sometimes acquire partial ownership of their upstream suppliers. Raw markdown: fang-2023-partial-vertical-ownership-in-the-presence-of-downstream Bibliographic Record Authors: Fang, F, Jiang, BJ, Sun, J Journal: PRODUCTION AND OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1111/poms.13933 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Firms sometimes acquire partial ownership of their upstream suppliers. Such ownership entails no direct control over the target firm's decision-making; however, both firms might change their pricing strategies after forming a partial ownership relationship. This paper studies the economic impacts of partial vertical ownership (PVO) in a market with downstream competition, where a manufacturer supplies two competing retailers. We find that dividend payments between firms can alter firms' incentives in their operational decisions and, hence, serve as an "invisible hand" to downstream competition and vertical interaction. We show that a higher PVO percentage can have both positive and negative effects because the acquiring retailer's gain from PVO depends on not only its own sales but also the competitor's sales. Thus, the PVO decision (i.e., the percentage of ownership to acquire) has an inverted U-shaped effect on the resulting profit for both the acquiring retailer and the manufacturer, which implies an intermediate PVO percentage in equilibrium. Second, the relative strength of the positive and negative effects depends on the acquiring retailer's competitive position. We show that the manufacturer prefers establishing PVO with the retailer with a valuation disadvantage because the disadvantaged retailer can obtain more benefits from PVO and is willing to pay higher than the competitor. Last, we find that consumers benefit from PVO when the acquiring retailer is the retailer with a valuation advantage but may become worse off when the disadvantaged retailer acquires PVO. Our research provides managers with guidance on the optimal PVO percentage and policymakers with insights on regulating PVOs for consumer protection. 摘要（中文） 企业有时会获得其上游供应商的部分所有权。此类所有权并不意味着对目标企业决策的直接控制；然而，两家企业在形成部分所有权关系后都可能改变其定价策略。本文研究在存在下游竞争的市场中部分垂直所有权（PVO）的经济影响，其中一家制造商向两家相互竞争的零售商供货。我们发现，企业之间的股利支付可以改变企业在其经营决策中的激励，从而充当下游竞争和垂直互动的“看不见的手”。我们表明，更高的PVO比例既可能有正面效应也可能有负面效应，因为收购方零售商从PVO中的收益不仅取决于其自身销售，还取决于竞争对手的销售。因此，PVO决策（即收购的所有权比例）对收购方零售商和制造商的最终利润都有倒U形效应，这意味着均衡时存在一个中间的PVO比例。第二，正面和负面效应的相对强度取决于收购方零售商的竞争地位。我们表明，制造商更偏好与处于估值劣势的零售商建立PVO，因为处于劣势的零售商能从PVO中获得更多好处，并愿意支付高于竞争对手的价格。最后，我们发现，当收购方零售商是具有估值优势的零售商时，消费者从PVO中受益，但当处于劣势的零售商收购PVO时消费者可能变得更糟。我们的研究为管理者提供了关于最优PVO比例的指导，并为政策制定者提供了关于为保护消费者而监管PVO的洞见。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Our paper provides evidence regarding the use of share repurchases as an earnings management mechanism in the presence of debt-financing constraints as well as the impact of these constraints on the use of accruals and other real earnings management techniques. Raw…
pages.text: Stock repurchases as an earnings management mechanism: The impact of financing constraints (2014) Paper claim — Our paper provides evidence regarding the use of share repurchases as an earnings management mechanism in the presence of debt-financing constraints as well as the impact of these constraints on the use of accruals and other real earnings management techniques. Raw markdown: farrell-2014-stock-repurchases-as-an-earnings-management-mechanism-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Farrell, K, Unlu, E, Yu, J Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.10.004 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase, stock repurchase) Abstract Our paper provides evidence regarding the use of share repurchases as an earnings management mechanism in the presence of debt-financing constraints as well as the impact of these constraints on the use of accruals and other real earnings management techniques. We document that share repurchases are prevalent as a mechanism to increase earnings per share. Next, we show that the presence of debt-financing constraints discourages the use of repurchase-based earnings management. We also find that for firms more likely to be engaged in earnings management, high financing constraints appear to increase the use of accruals based earnings management and decrease the use of other real earnings management techniques. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文提供了关于在存在债务融资约束情况下将股份回购用作盈余管理机制的证据，以及这些约束对应计项目和其他真实盈余管理手段使用的影响。我们记录了股份回购作为一种提高每股收益的机制普遍存在。接着，我们表明债务融资约束的存在会抑制基于回购的盈余管理的使用。我们还发现，对于更可能从事盈余管理的公司，较高的融资约束似乎会增加基于应计项目的盈余管理的使用，并减少其他真实盈余管理手段的使用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Financing Payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find that 43% of firms that make payouts also raise capital during the same year, resulting in 31% of aggregate payouts being externally financed, primarily with debt. Raw markdown: farremensa-2025-financing-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Farre-Mensa, J,…
pages.text: Financing Payouts (2025) Paper claim — We find that 43% of firms that make payouts also raise capital during the same year, resulting in 31% of aggregate payouts being externally financed, primarily with debt. Raw markdown: farremensa-2025-financing-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Farre-Mensa, J, Michaely, R, Schmalz, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109024000231 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract We find that 43% of firms that make payouts also raise capital during the same year, resulting in 31% of aggregate payouts being externally financed, primarily with debt. Most financed payouts cannot be explained by payout smoothing in response to volatile earnings or investment (rather, they are the result of firms persistently setting payouts above free cash flow). In fact, 25% of aggregate payouts could not have been paid without the firms simultaneously raising capital. Profitable firms with moderate growth use debt-financed payouts to jointly manage their leverage and cash, thus highlighting the close relationship between payout and capital structure decisions. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，进行派发的公司中有43%在同一年也筹集资本，导致总派发额的31%由外部融资，主要是通过债务。大多数经融资的派发无法用为应对波动的盈余或投资而进行的派发平滑来解释（相反，它们是公司持续将派发额设定在自由现金流之上的结果）。事实上，总派发额的25%若非公司同时筹集资本便无法支付。具有中等增长的盈利公司利用债务融资的派发来共同管理其杠杆和现金，从而凸显了派发与资本结构决策之间的密切关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Yes, dividends are disappearing: Worldwide evidence (2012) Paper claim — This study examines the patterns in payout policies worldwide. Raw markdown: fatemi-2012-yes-dividends-are-disappearing-worldwide-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Fatemi, A, Bildik, R Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2011.10.008 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This study examines the patterns in payout policies worldwide. Utilizing data from a sample of more than 17,000 companies from 33 different countries, we find evidence in support of a significant worldwide decline in the propensity to pay dividends. Most of the decline is due to the payout policies of smaller and less profitable firms with comparatively more investment opportunities. We find that larger firms, those with higher profitability, and firms with low growth opportunities have a greater propensity to pay dividends. The proportion of dividend payers varies substantially across industries as well. However, the proportion of firms paying dividends has declined over time, even after firms' characteristics have been controlled for. Moreover, aggregate dividends are highly concentrated in that they are paid only by a small group of firms. Our findings indicate that there has been a significant decline in the average dividend payout ratios over the years. The decline in the mean dividend payout ratios as well as the proportion of payers is much more pronounced in civil law countries. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了全球支付政策的模式。利用来自33个不同国家超过17000家公司样本的数据，我们发现证据支持派发股利倾向在全球范围内的显著下降。这一下降大多归因于规模较小、盈利能力较弱且投资机会相对较多的企业的支付政策。我们发现，规模较大的企业、盈利能力较高的企业以及增长机会较低的企业具有更大的派发股利倾向。派发股利企业的比例在不同行业间也有很大差异。然而，即使在控制了企业特征之后，派发股利企业的比例也随时间下降。此外，总量股利高度集中，仅由一小部分企业派发。我们的发现表明，多年来平均股利支付率出现了显著下降。平均股利支付率以及派发者比例的下降在民法系国家中更为显著。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
