pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the cross-sectional variation in the marginal value of corporate cash holdings that arises from differences in corporate financial policy. Raw markdown: faulkender-2006-corporate-financial-policy-and-the-value-of-cash Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Corporate financial policy and the value of cash (2006) Paper claim — We examine the cross-sectional variation in the marginal value of corporate cash holdings that arises from differences in corporate financial policy. Raw markdown: faulkender-2006-corporate-financial-policy-and-the-value-of-cash Bibliographic Record Authors: Faulkender, M, Wang, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2006.00894.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We examine the cross-sectional variation in the marginal value of corporate cash holdings that arises from differences in corporate financial policy. We begin by providing semi-quantitative predictions for the value of an extra dollar of cash depending upon the likely use of that dollar, and derive a set of intuitive hypotheses to test empirically. By examining the variation in excess stock returns over the fiscal year, we find that the marginal value of cash declines with larger cash holdings, higher leverage, better access to capital markets, and as firms choose greater cash distribution via dividends rather than repurchases. 摘要（中文） 我们考察公司现金持有边际价值的横截面差异，这种差异源于公司财务政策的不同。我们首先针对额外一美元现金的价值给出半定量的预测，这取决于该美元的可能用途，并推导出一组直观的假说以进行实证检验。通过考察财政年度内超额股票收益的变化，我们发现，现金的边际价值随现金持有量增大、杠杆升高、进入资本市场的渠道更好、以及公司选择更多地通过股利而非回购进行现金分配而下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Hot-Stove Effects: The Impact of CEO Past Corporate Experiences on Dividend Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The personal traits of chief executive officers (CEOs) have been found to influence corporate policy decisions. Raw markdown: faulkner-2022-hot-stove-effects-the-impact-of-ceo-past Bibliographic Record Authors: Faulkner, M, García-Feijóo, L Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Hot-Stove Effects: The Impact of CEO Past Corporate Experiences on Dividend Policy (2022) Paper claim — The personal traits of chief executive officers (CEOs) have been found to influence corporate policy decisions. Raw markdown: faulkner-2022-hot-stove-effects-the-impact-of-ceo-past Bibliographic Record Authors: Faulkner, M, García-Feijóo, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1017/S002210902100034X Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract The personal traits of chief executive officers (CEOs) have been found to influence corporate policy decisions. We examine the impact of CEO past corporate distress experiences on payout policy. CEOs who have experienced a distress event in their career, while working in a non-CEO position at a different firm, subsequently alter corporate payout policy once in the CEO position. They are less likely to pay dividends and repurchase shares, pay out lower levels of dividends, and are less likely to increase dividends. They further exhibit preference toward repurchases. Overall, we report that experience-driven conservatism affects payout policy, a novel finding in the literature. 摘要（中文） 已有研究发现，首席执行官（CEO）的个人特质会影响公司政策决策。我们考察CEO过去的公司困境经历对支付政策的影响。那些在职业生涯中曾在另一家公司担任非CEO职位时经历过困境事件的CEO，在担任CEO职位后随之改变了公司的支付政策。他们更不愿意支付股利和回购股票，派发的股利水平更低，也更不可能增加股利。他们进一步表现出对回购的偏好。总体而言，我们报告了经验驱动的保守主义会影响支付政策，这是文献中的一个新发现。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Hot-Stove Effects: The Impact of CEO Past Corporate Experiences on Dividend Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — CEOs who experienced corporate distress events (bond rating downgrade, OCF shock, stock price shock, or dividend cut) in a non-CEO role at a prior firm subsequently implement more conservative payout policies: lower dividend propensity and levels, reduced…
pages.text: Hot-Stove Effects: The Impact of CEO Past Corporate Experiences on Dividend Policy (2022) Paper claim — CEOs who experienced corporate distress events (bond rating downgrade, OCF shock, stock price shock, or dividend cut) in a non-CEO role at a prior firm subsequently implement more conservative payout policies: lower dividend propensity and levels, reduced repurchase activity, and a preference for repurchases over dividends — a behavioral "hot-stove effect" driving experience-driven conservatism in payout policy. Raw markdown: faulkner-garca-feijo-2022-hot-stove-effects-the-impact-of-ceo-past-corporate-exp Bibliographic Record Authors: Faulkner, Matthew; García-Feijóo, Luis Journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1017/S002210902100034X Abstract The personal traits of chief executive officers (CEOs) have been found to influence corporate policy decisions. We examine the impact of CEO past corporate distress experiences on payout policy. CEOs who have experienced a distress event in their career, while working in a non-CEO position at a different firm, subsequently alter corporate payout policy once in the CEO position. They are less likely to pay dividends and repurchase shares, pay out lower levels of dividends, and are less likely to increase dividends. They further exhibit preference toward repurchases. Overall, we report that experience-driven conservatism affects payout policy, a novel finding in the literature. Key Findings In a sample of ~4,228 US industrial firms (1983–2017, ~37,000 firm-year observations), CEOs with any prior corporate distress experience are 18.5% less likely to pay a dividend (DISTRESS_EXPERIENCES logit coefficient = −0.205, p < 0.01); the largest individual distress measure effect is OCF shocks (38.9% less likely). Conditional on paying dividends, distress-experienced CEOs pay lower levels: predicted dividend-to-assets ratio is approximately 12% below the mean for the composite distress measure and 42% below for OCF shocks, after controlling for standard determinants including size, profitability, growth, leverage, and lifecycle proxies. Distress-experienced CEOs are 7.5% less likely to repurchase shares and 12.8% less likely to use any form of payout; they are 11.7% less likely to increase dividends (p < 0.01), with weaker evidence of being more likely to cut dividends (p < 0.10). Conditional on making any payout, CEOs with distress experience are 12.1% more likely to prefer repurchases over dividends — substituting the flexible, non-committal repurchase for the sticky long-term cash outflow commitment of dividends. PSM and exogenous CEO turnover samples confirm main results (dividend propensity coefficients of −0.289 and −0.209, respectively). Effects are asymmetric: positive corporate experiences do not affect dividend policy, consistent with the pessimism bias that negative events have larger behavioral impact. Effects are stronger for more salient experiences: multiple distress events, top-5 executive roles, early-career experiences, and distress followed by bankruptcy all amplify the conservatism effect. pages.title: Wage Rigidity: A Quantitative Solution to Several Asset Pricing Puzzles
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In standard production models, wage volatility is far too high, and equity volatility is far too low. Raw markdown: favilukis-2016-wage-rigidity-a-quantitative-solution-to-several-asset Bibliographic Record Authors: Favilukis, J, Lin, XJ Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: Wage Rigidity: A Quantitative Solution to Several Asset Pricing Puzzles (2016) Paper claim — In standard production models, wage volatility is far too high, and equity volatility is far too low. Raw markdown: favilukis-2016-wage-rigidity-a-quantitative-solution-to-several-asset Bibliographic Record Authors: Favilukis, J, Lin, XJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhv041 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract In standard production models, wage volatility is far too high, and equity volatility is far too low. A simple modification-sticky wages because of infrequent resetting together with a constant elasticity of substitution (CES) production function leads to both smoother wages and higher equity volatility. Further, the model produces several other hard-to-explain features of financial data: high Sharpe ratios, low and smooth interest rates, time-varying equity volatility and premium, a value premium, and a downward-sloping equity term structure. Procyclical, volatile wages are a hedge for firms in standard models; smoother wages act like operating leverage, making profits and dividends riskier. 摘要（中文） 在标准的生产模型中，工资波动性过高，而股权波动性过低。一个简单的修正——因不频繁重定而产生的黏性工资，加上不变替代弹性（CES）生产函数——会同时带来更平滑的工资和更高的股权波动性。此外，该模型还产生了金融数据中若干其他难以解释的特征：高夏普比率、低而平滑的利率、随时间变化的股权波动性和溢价、价值溢价，以及向下倾斜的股权期限结构。在标准模型中，顺周期、波动的工资对公司而言是一种对冲；而更平滑的工资起到了经营杠杆的作用，使利润和股利风险更大。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Elective stock and scrip dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate firms' decisions to pay elective stock dividends, known in the UK as scrip dividends. Raw markdown: feitoruiz-2020-elective-stock-and-scrip-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Feito-Ruiz, I, Renneboog, L, Vansteenkiste, C Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Elective stock and scrip dividends (2020) Paper claim — We investigate firms' decisions to pay elective stock dividends, known in the UK as scrip dividends. Raw markdown: feitoruiz-2020-elective-stock-and-scrip-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Feito-Ruiz, I, Renneboog, L, Vansteenkiste, C Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101660 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract We investigate firms' decisions to pay elective stock dividends, known in the UK as scrip dividends. Scrip dividends give investors the choice between receiving new shares or the equivalent value as a cash dividend. UK firms paying scrip dividends are more likely to be financially constrained, and scrip dividends are used more when access to external financing is costly. Our results are robust to using the 2008 financial crisis as an exogenous shock to credit supply. Cash preservation is the most important corporate incentive to use scrip dividends as they tend to be distributed in combination with dividend cuts and with major corporate investments such as debt-financed mergers and acquisitions. Analysis of US dividend reinvestment plans by which investors purchase new shares confirms firms' cash-preservation motives. 摘要（中文） 我们考察公司支付可选股票股利的决策，这在英国被称为代股股利（scrip dividends）。代股股利让投资者在领取新股或等值现金股利之间进行选择。支付代股股利的英国公司更可能受到财务约束，且在外部融资代价高昂时，代股股利被更多地使用。我们的结果在使用2008年金融危机作为对信贷供给的外生冲击时依然稳健。现金保全是使用代股股利最重要的公司动机，因为它们往往与股利削减以及债务融资的并购等重大公司投资相结合派发。对美国股利再投资计划（投资者借此购买新股）的分析证实了公司的现金保全动机。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate payout policy and managerial stock incentives
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how corporate payout policy is affected by managerial stock incentives using data on more than 1,100 nonfinancial firms during 1993-97. Raw markdown: fenn-2001-corporate-payout-policy-and-managerial-stock-incentives Bibliographic Record Authors: Fenn,…
pages.text: Corporate payout policy and managerial stock incentives (2001) Paper claim — We examine how corporate payout policy is affected by managerial stock incentives using data on more than 1,100 nonfinancial firms during 1993-97. Raw markdown: fenn-2001-corporate-payout-policy-and-managerial-stock-incentives Bibliographic Record Authors: Fenn, GW, Liang, N Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(01)00039-3 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract We examine how corporate payout policy is affected by managerial stock incentives using data on more than 1,100 nonfinancial firms during 1993-97. We find that management stock ownership is associated with higher payouts by firms with potentially the greatest agency problems - those with low management stock ownership and few investment opportunities or high free cash flow. We also find that management stock options are related to the composition of payouts. We find a strong negative relationship between dividends and management stock options, as predicted by Lambert ct al (1989), acid a positive relationship between repurchases and management stock options. Our results suggest that the growth in stock options may help to explain the rise in repurchases at the expense of dividends. (C) 2001 Published by Elsevier Science S.A. 摘要（中文） 我们使用1993—1997年间1,100多家非金融企业的数据，考察企业支付政策如何受管理层股票激励的影响。我们发现，管理层持股与代理问题可能最严重的企业（即管理层持股低且投资机会少或自由现金流高的企业）的更高支付相关。我们还发现，管理层股票期权与支付的构成相关。正如兰伯特等（Lambert et al，1989）所预测的，我们发现股利与管理层股票期权之间存在强烈的负相关关系，而回购与管理层股票期权之间存在正相关关系。我们的结果表明，股票期权的增长可能有助于解释回购的兴起以及以牺牲股利为代价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does Option-Based Compensation Affect Payout Policy? Evidence from FAS 123R
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Does option-based compensation affect payout policy? To address this question, we examine the adoption of mandatory expensing of stock options. Raw markdown: ferri-2020-does-option-based-compensation-affect-payout-policy-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Does Option-Based Compensation Affect Payout Policy? Evidence from FAS 123R (2020) Paper claim — Does option-based compensation affect payout policy? To address this question, we examine the adoption of mandatory expensing of stock options. Raw markdown: ferri-2020-does-option-based-compensation-affect-payout-policy-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Ferri, F, Li, N Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109018001114 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Does option-based compensation affect payout policy? To address this question, we examine the adoption of mandatory expensing of stock options. Our identification strategy exploits the fact that the reduction in option-based compensation after the accounting change varies with the firm-specific expected accounting impact. Across a battery of tests, we do not find that (accounting-driven) reductions in option-based pay cause dividends to increase or repurchases to decrease. Our results contrast with the widely held belief that option-based pay has a significant causal influence on payout policy and cast doubts on its role in the shift from dividends to repurchases. 摘要（中文） 基于期权的薪酬是否影响支付政策？为解答这一问题，我们考察了强制性股票期权费用化的采用。我们的识别策略利用了这样一个事实：会计变更后基于期权的薪酬的减少随企业特定的预期会计影响而变化。在一系列检验中，我们没有发现（会计驱动的）基于期权薪酬的减少导致股利增加或回购减少。我们的结果与广泛持有的观点形成对比，即基于期权的薪酬对支付政策具有显著的因果影响，并对其在从股利向回购转变中的作用提出了质疑。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Catering effects in corporate dividend policy: The international evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study tests for the international presence of dividend catering across a sample of twenty-three countries. Raw markdown: ferris-2009-catering-effects-in-corporate-dividend-policy-the-international Bibliographic Record Authors: Ferris, SP, Jayaraman, N,…
pages.text: Catering effects in corporate dividend policy: The international evidence (2009) Paper claim — This study tests for the international presence of dividend catering across a sample of twenty-three countries. Raw markdown: ferris-2009-catering-effects-in-corporate-dividend-policy-the-international Bibliographic Record Authors: Ferris, SP, Jayaraman, N, Sabherwal, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2009.04.005 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection, law, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(catering) Abstract This study tests for the international presence of dividend catering across a sample of twenty-three countries. We find evidence of catering among firms incorporated in common law countries but not for those in civil law nations. Catering persists even after controlling for the effect of the firm's lifecycle. We conclude that when the legal regime and its accompanying set of investor protections permit, investors force dividends from managers, but they also attempt to extract such payouts indirectly by placing a high value on dividend paying firms. The relative failure of civil law firms to cater might be explained by idiosyncratic behaviors in the consumption of the private benefits of control or a lack of interest in responding to temporary market misevaluations of their equity. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究在涵盖二十三个国家的样本中检验股利迎合在国际上的存在。我们发现，在普通法国家注册的企业中存在迎合的证据，但在成文法国家的企业中则没有。即使在控制了企业生命周期的影响之后，迎合仍然存在。我们得出结论，当法律制度及其相应的一套投资者保护允许时，投资者会迫使管理者派发股利，但他们也试图通过对派息企业给予高估值来间接获取此类派现。成文法国家企业相对未能迎合，或许可以用其在控制权私人收益消费方面的特异行为、或缺乏对其股权暂时性市场错误估值作出回应的兴趣来解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The price of boardroom social capital: The effects of corporate demand for external connectivity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this study we examine the effect of boardroom social capital, defined as the aggregate benefits from the social networks of outside directors, on director compensation. Raw markdown: ferris-2020-the-price-of-boardroom-social-capital-the-effects Bibliographic…
pages.text: The price of boardroom social capital: The effects of corporate demand for external connectivity (2020) Paper claim — In this study we examine the effect of boardroom social capital, defined as the aggregate benefits from the social networks of outside directors, on director compensation. Raw markdown: ferris-2020-the-price-of-boardroom-social-capital-the-effects Bibliographic Record Authors: Ferris, SP, Javakhadze, D, Liu, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2019.105729 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract In this study we examine the effect of boardroom social capital, defined as the aggregate benefits from the social networks of outside directors, on director compensation. Using a large panel of nine thousand firm-year observations for the period 2007-2013, we find that boardroom social capital is positively priced. Further analysis shows that firms pay a premium for networked directors. Firms that have suffered adverse events such as a bad merger, performance declines, or dividend cuts, pay a higher connection premium. We determine that well-connected directors perform important board roles and hold multiple directorships. Overall, our results are consistent with an efficient contracting explanation for boardroom pay. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在本研究中，我们考察了董事会社会资本（定义为外部董事社会网络所带来的总体收益）对董事薪酬的影响。利用2007至2013年间包含九千个公司-年度观测值的大型面板，我们发现董事会社会资本被正向定价。进一步分析表明，企业为有网络关系的董事支付溢价。经历过诸如糟糕并购、业绩下滑或股利削减等不利事件的企业，会支付更高的关系溢价。我们确定，人脉广泛的董事发挥着重要的董事会作用，并持有多个董事职位。总体而言，我们的结果与董事会薪酬的有效契约解释相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend changes, abnormal returns, and intra-industry firm valuations
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Previous empirical research has established that dividend changes are associated with significant abnormal returns. Raw markdown: firth-1996-dividend-changes-abnormal-returns-and-intra-industry-firm Bibliographic Record Authors: Firth, M Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Dividend changes, abnormal returns, and intra-industry firm valuations (1996) Paper claim — Previous empirical research has established that dividend changes are associated with significant abnormal returns. Raw markdown: firth-1996-dividend-changes-abnormal-returns-and-intra-industry-firm Bibliographic Record Authors: Firth, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1996 DOI: 10.2307/2331179 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Previous empirical research has established that dividend changes are associated with significant abnormal returns. This association is rationalized on the basis that the dividend announcement acts as a signal of future earnings. Another body of research has documented the existence of intra-industry transfers of information where news about one firm is extrapolated to other companies in the same industry. Earnings information transfers have been found to be positive in nature, with good news about one company leading to stock price increases for rival firms. Linking dividend signaling and information transfer, tests were constructed to ascertain whether the dividend change of one firm is associated with the stock price performance of other companies in the same industry. The results indicate there is some small positive information transfer. The magnitude of information transfer is related to the degree of the dividend surprise, the recent dividend history of the other companies, and correlations in stock returns between the dividend announcer and the other companies. Information transfer is found to affect earnings and earnings growth estimates of the other firms and this leads to revisions in their stock prices. 摘要（中文） 此前的实证研究已确立股利变动与显著的异常收益相关。这种关联的合理化基础是股利公告充当了未来盈余的信号。另一批研究记录了行业内信息传递的存在，即关于一家公司的消息被外推到同一行业中的其他公司。盈余信息传递被发现本质上是正向的，关于一家公司的好消息导致竞争对手公司的股价上涨。将股利信号与信息传递相联系，本文构建了检验以确定一家公司的股利变动是否与同一行业中其他公司的股价表现相关。结果表明存在一些小的正向信息传递。信息传递的幅度与股利意外的程度、其他公司近期的股利历史以及股利宣告者与其他公司之间股票收益的相关性有关。信息传递被发现会影响其他公司的盈余和盈余增长估计，这进而导致其股价的修正。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Institutional stock ownership and firms' cash dividend policies: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Agency theory suggests that outside shareholders prefer higher dividend payouts in order to reduce the free cash flows of firms that are under the insiders' control. Raw markdown: firth-2016-institutional-stock-ownership-and-firms-cash-dividend-policies…
pages.text: Institutional stock ownership and firms' cash dividend policies: Evidence from China (2016) Paper claim — Agency theory suggests that outside shareholders prefer higher dividend payouts in order to reduce the free cash flows of firms that are under the insiders' control. Raw markdown: firth-2016-institutional-stock-ownership-and-firms-cash-dividend-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Firth, M, Gao, J, Shen, JH, Zhang, YY Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2016.01.009 Relevance score: 11.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract Agency theory suggests that outside shareholders prefer higher dividend payouts in order to reduce the free cash flows of firms that are under the insiders' control. Our study investigates the effects of mutual funds, typically the most important and influential type of outside shareholder, on firms' dividend payouts in China during the period from 2003 to 2011. We find that mutual funds influence firms to pay higher cash dividends. The results are consistent with the predictions from exit theory. The effects are more pronounced in firms controlled by state and regional governments and in firms with relatively higher free cash flows. We also find evidence that the mutual funds' effects are stronger when their investment horizon is longer and the ownership interest is larger. Other institutional investors, such as banks, insurance companies, and securities companies have a lower exit threat and do not have an influence on firms' cash dividend payments or financial performances. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 代理理论认为，外部股东偏好更高的股利支付，以减少受内部人控制的企业的自由现金流。我们的研究考察了共同基金（通常是最重要、最有影响力的外部股东类型）在2003年至2011年期间对中国企业股利支付的影响。我们发现，共同基金促使企业支付更高的现金股利。这些结果与退出理论的预测相一致。该效应在由国家和地方政府控制的企业以及自由现金流相对较高的企业中更为显著。我们还发现证据表明，当共同基金的投资期限较长、持股比例较大时，其影响更强。其他机构投资者，如银行、保险公司和证券公司，退出威胁较低，对企业的现金股利支付或财务业绩没有影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Rejected stock exchange applicants
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine listing applications by firms to the London Stock Exchange between 1891 and 1911. Raw markdown: fjesme-2021-rejected-stock-exchange-applicants Bibliographic Record Authors: Fjesme, SL, Galpin, NE, Moore, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year:…
pages.text: Rejected stock exchange applicants (2021) Paper claim — We examine listing applications by firms to the London Stock Exchange between 1891 and 1911. Raw markdown: fjesme-2021-rejected-stock-exchange-applicants Bibliographic Record Authors: Fjesme, SL, Galpin, NE, Moore, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.08.005 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine listing applications by firms to the London Stock Exchange between 1891 and 1911. The exchange rejected 82 (13.1%) of the 628 applicants to its main board. Accepted applicants were twice as likely to pay dividends (and to pay twice as much) and had longer firm lives than rejected applicants. Rejected applicants were more likely to file for liquidation than successful applicants. These results remain even after we control for the primary benefits of the listing itself: liquidity and future capital inflows. In this era, the London Stock Exchange could screen applicants for listing. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了1891至1911年间企业向伦敦证券交易所提交的上市申请。该交易所拒绝了向其主板提交申请的628家企业中的82家（13.1%）。相比被拒申请者，被接纳的申请者支付股利的可能性高出一倍（且支付金额高出一倍），公司存续期也更长。被拒申请者比成功申请者更有可能申请清算。即便在我们控制了上市本身的主要好处（即流动性和未来资本流入）之后，这些结果依然成立。在这一时代，伦敦证券交易所能够对上市申请者进行筛选。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout policy through the financial crisis: The growth of repurchases and the resilience of dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We compare the payout policies of US industrials and banks over the past 30 years to better understand dividends, especially for banks. Raw markdown: floyd-2015-payout-policy-through-the-financial-crisis-the-growth Bibliographic Record Authors: Floyd, E, Li, N,…
pages.text: Payout policy through the financial crisis: The growth of repurchases and the resilience of dividends (2015) Paper claim — We compare the payout policies of US industrials and banks over the past 30 years to better understand dividends, especially for banks. Raw markdown: floyd-2015-payout-policy-through-the-financial-crisis-the-growth Bibliographic Record Authors: Floyd, E, Li, N, Skinner, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2015.08.002 Relevance score: 11.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract We compare the payout policies of US industrials and banks over the past 30 years to better understand dividends, especially for banks. For industrials, dividends grow strongly after 2002, when the declining propensity to pay reverses. Banks have a higher and more stable propensity to pay dividends and resist cutting dividends as the 2007-2008 financial crisis begins. Before the crisis, increases in repurchases push payouts to historic levels. These findings are broadly consistent with the idea that banks use dividends to signal financial strength while agency costs of free cash flow better explain industrial payouts. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们比较了过去30年美国工业企业和银行的支付政策，以更好地理解股利，尤其是银行的股利。对于工业企业，股利在2002年之后强劲增长，此时支付倾向下降的趋势发生逆转。银行支付股利的倾向更高且更稳定，并在2007—2008年金融危机开始时抵制削减股利。在危机之前，回购的增加将支付推升至历史水平。这些发现大体上与以下观点相一致：银行使用股利来发出财务实力的信号，而自由现金流的代理成本能更好地解释工业企业的支付。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Bank dividends and signaling to information-sensitive depositors
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates whether banks use dividends to signal asset quality and liquidity to their debt-holders. Raw markdown: forti-2015-bank-dividends-and-signaling-to-information-sensitive-depositors Bibliographic Record Authors: Forti, C, Schiozer, RF Journal:…
pages.text: Bank dividends and signaling to information-sensitive depositors (2015) Paper claim — This study investigates whether banks use dividends to signal asset quality and liquidity to their debt-holders. Raw markdown: forti-2015-bank-dividends-and-signaling-to-information-sensitive-depositors Bibliographic Record Authors: Forti, C, Schiozer, RF Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2015.02.011 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This study investigates whether banks use dividends to signal asset quality and liquidity to their debt-holders. We exploit an exogenous shock to the asset opaqueness and perception of risks of Brazilian banks caused by the global financial turmoil of 2008. Our empirical identification takes advantage of the cross-sectional heterogeneity of types of depositors in Brazilian banks and the existence of several owner-managed banks (for which shareholder-targeted signaling is implausible) to identify that information-sensitive depositors (institutional investors) are targets of dividend signaling by banks. These costly signaling efforts are particularly strong during financial crises when asset opaqueness, informational asymmetry and depositors' concerns regarding bank liquidity are exacerbated. From a policy perspective, our results favor the imposition of limits on bank dividends during financial crises, because the banks' need to signal their financial health through dividends during crises intensifies the pro-cyclical effects of bank capital on lending. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察银行是否利用股利向其债权人传递资产质量和流动性的信号。我们利用2008年全球金融动荡对巴西银行资产不透明性和风险认知造成的外生冲击。我们的实证识别利用了巴西银行存款人类型的横截面异质性，以及若干由所有者自行管理的银行（对这些银行而言，针对股东的信号传递不太可信）的存在，从而识别出信息敏感型存款人（机构投资者）是银行股利信号传递的目标。这些代价高昂的信号传递努力在金融危机期间尤为强烈，此时资产不透明性、信息不对称以及存款人对银行流动性的担忧都被加剧。从政策角度看，我们的结果支持在金融危机期间对银行股利施加限制，因为危机期间银行需要通过股利传递其财务健康状况信号，这会加剧银行资本对信贷的顺周期效应。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Taxing the multinational enterprise: On the forced redesign of global value chains and other inefficiencies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The taxation of the multinational enterprise (MNE) has been a continuing concern for policymakers. Raw markdown: foss-2019-taxing-the-multinational-enterprise-on-the-forced-redesign Bibliographic Record Authors: Foss, NJ, Mudambi, R, Murtinu, S Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Taxing the multinational enterprise: On the forced redesign of global value chains and other inefficiencies (2019) Paper claim — The taxation of the multinational enterprise (MNE) has been a continuing concern for policymakers. Raw markdown: foss-2019-taxing-the-multinational-enterprise-on-the-forced-redesign Bibliographic Record Authors: Foss, NJ, Mudambi, R, Murtinu, S Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1057/s41267-018-0159-3 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The taxation of the multinational enterprise (MNE) has been a continuing concern for policymakers. We argue that the changing nature of the mobile MNE (e.g., its improved ability to fine-slice the value chain and disperse it geographically) makes it increasingly important to rethink current tax policies. First, there should be more focus on the inefficiencies that arise when taxation leads to the inefficient location of MNE activities. Thus, MNEs may shift activities to low-tax jurisdictions that offer lucrative pecuniary and non-pecuniary incentives, but do not enable their investments to maximize their contribution to global value creation. Second, international tax regimes should ensure that MNEs pay for their consumption of local public goods, and public finance scholars have long known that the taxation-based distortions are minimized when the tax objects are immobile. However, the bulk of current tax policies are aimed at corporate profits that are both poor proxies for the consumption of local public goods as well as extremely mobile. Integrating theory from international business, public finance and economic geography, our analysis demonstrates that moving the incidence of taxation from corporate profits to dividends and consumption would unambiguously improve both wealth creation and efficiency. 摘要（中文） 跨国企业（MNE）的税收问题一直是政策制定者持续关注的问题。我们认为，流动性跨国企业不断变化的特性（例如其精细切分价值链并在地理上分散的能力提高），使得重新思考现行税收政策变得日益重要。首先，应更多关注当税收导致跨国企业活动低效布局时所产生的低效率。因此，跨国企业可能将活动转移到提供丰厚货币性和非货币性激励的低税收辖区，但这些辖区并不能使其投资对全球价值创造的贡献最大化。其次，国际税收制度应确保跨国企业为其对当地公共品的消费付费，而公共财政学者早已知道，当税收对象不可流动时，基于税收的扭曲最小。然而，当前大部分税收政策针对的是企业利润，而企业利润既不是当地公共品消费的良好代理变量，又极具流动性。通过整合国际商务、公共财政和经济地理学的理论，我们的分析表明，将税收归宿从企业利润转移到股利和消费上，将明确无误地同时改善财富创造和效率。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Gender Differences in Financial Reporting Decision Making: Evidence from Accounting Conservatism
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates the effect of CFO gender on corporate financial reporting decision making. Raw markdown: francis-2015-gender-differences-in-financial-reporting-decision-making-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Francis, B, Hasan, I, Park, JC, Wu, Q…
pages.text: Gender Differences in Financial Reporting Decision Making: Evidence from Accounting Conservatism (2015) Paper claim — This paper investigates the effect of CFO gender on corporate financial reporting decision making. Raw markdown: francis-2015-gender-differences-in-financial-reporting-decision-making-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Francis, B, Hasan, I, Park, JC, Wu, Q Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12098 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper investigates the effect of CFO gender on corporate financial reporting decision making. Focusing on firms that experience changes of CFO from male to female, the paper compares the firms' degree of accounting conservatism between pre- and post-transition periods. We find that female CFOs are more conservative in their financial reporting. In addition, we find that the relation between CFO gender and conservatism varies with the level of various firm risks, including litigation risk, default risk, systematic risk, and CFO-specific risk such as job security risk. We further find that the risk aversion of female CFOs is associated with less equity-based compensation, lower firm risk, a higher tangibility level, and a lower dividend payout level. Overall, the study provides strong support for the notion that female CFOs are more risk averse than male CFOs, which leads female CFOs to adopt more conservative financial reporting policies. 摘要（中文） 本文考察CFO性别对公司财务报告决策的影响。本文聚焦于经历了CFO由男性变为女性变更的公司，比较了这些公司在变更前和变更后期间的会计稳健性程度。我们发现，女性CFO在财务报告方面更为稳健。此外，我们发现CFO性别与稳健性之间的关系随各类公司风险水平而变化，这些风险包括诉讼风险、违约风险、系统性风险以及诸如工作保障风险等CFO特有的风险。我们进一步发现，女性CFO的风险规避与更少的股权型薪酬、更低的公司风险、更高的有形资产比例以及更低的股利派现水平相关。总体而言，本研究为女性CFO比男性CFO更为风险规避这一观点提供了有力支持，正是这种风险规避导致女性CFO采取更为稳健的财务报告政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Too few dividends? Groups' tunneling through chair and board compensation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Group affiliation increases boards' compensation in countries as different as Korea, India, Hong Kong and Italy. Raw markdown: francisco-2009-too-few-dividends-groups-tunneling-through-chair-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Francisco, UI Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Too few dividends? Groups' tunneling through chair and board compensation (2009) Paper claim — Group affiliation increases boards' compensation in countries as different as Korea, India, Hong Kong and Italy. Raw markdown: francisco-2009-too-few-dividends-groups-tunneling-through-chair-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Francisco, UI Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2008.11.002 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(tunneling) Abstract Group affiliation increases boards' compensation in countries as different as Korea, India, Hong Kong and Italy. In this paper, I examine a 6-year sample of controller-dominated, concentrated-ownership firms in Chile in search of a rationale for these results. I show that, for group-affiliated companies, controllers' presence on the board of directors is associated with a strong negative relation between chair and board compensation and controllers' cash-flow rights. Furthermore, I show that controllers of group-affiliated companies prefer to increase chair and board compensation rather than dividends as their cash-flow rights decrease. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在韩国、印度、香港和意大利等差异迥异的国家，集团附属都会提高董事会的薪酬。在本文中，我考察智利一个为期6年的、由控制人主导的、股权集中的公司样本，以探寻这些结果的一种理据。我表明，对于集团附属公司而言，控制人在董事会中的存在与董事长及董事会薪酬与控制人现金流权之间的强烈负向关系相关联。此外，我表明，随着现金流权下降，集团附属公司的控制人更愿意提高董事长及董事会薪酬，而非增加股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Effect of Unsuccessful Past Repurchases on Future Decisions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find that managers are less likely to repurchase stocks when they lose money on past stock repurchases but find no robust evidence that past gains on repurchases influence future repurchasing activity. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The Effect of Unsuccessful Past Repurchases on Future Decisions (2022) Paper claim — We find that managers are less likely to repurchase stocks when they lose money on past stock repurchases but find no robust evidence that past gains on repurchases influence future repurchasing activity. Raw markdown: friesen-2022-the-effect-of-unsuccessful-past-repurchases-on-future Bibliographic Record Authors: Friesen, GC, Jeutang, NP, Unlu, E Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2020.3875 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, stock repurchase) Abstract We find that managers are less likely to repurchase stocks when they lose money on past stock repurchases but find no robust evidence that past gains on repurchases influence future repurchasing activity. This asymmetric sensitivity is strongest for young CEOs and those with the shortest tenure. Also, future repurchases are more sensitive to past repurchase losses for CEOs whose previous lifetime experience with the stock market is unfavorable. The sensitivity of future repurchases to past losses costs firms, on average, about 3.7% per year. When this cost is decomposed into systematic and idiosyncratic components, we find that nearly half (1.8%) comes from mistiming idiosyncratic shocks. Past losses on repurchases have a significant and negative impact on the CEO's future bonus and increase the likelihood that future CEO termination is involuntary. We also find that negative outcomes from past repurchases encourage the subsequent use of dividends. Our findings suggest that outcomes of past repurchases have economically significant consequences through both nonbehavioral (career concerns) and behavioral (snakebite effect) factors. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，当管理者在过去的股票回购中亏损时，他们进行股票回购的可能性较低，但没有稳健证据表明过去回购的收益会影响未来的回购活动。这种非对称敏感性在年轻的CEO以及任期最短的CEO身上最为明显。此外，对于此前一生中股市经历不利的CEO，未来回购对过去回购损失更为敏感。未来回购对过去损失的敏感性平均每年给公司造成约3.7%的成本。当将这一成本分解为系统性成分和特质性成分时，我们发现近一半（1.8%）来自对特质性冲击的择时错误。过去回购的损失对CEO未来的奖金有显著的负面影响，并增加了未来CEO被非自愿终止任职的可能性。我们还发现，过去回购的负面结果会促使随后转向使用股利。我们的研究结果表明，过去回购的结果通过非行为性因素（职业顾虑）和行为性因素（蛇咬效应）两方面产生了具有经济意义的后果。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How are stock prices affected by the location of trade?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine pairs of large, 'Siamese twin' companies whose stocks are traded around the world but have different trading and ownership habitats. Raw markdown: froot-1999-how-are-stock-prices-affected-by-the-location Bibliographic Record Authors: Froot, KA, Dabora,…
pages.text: How are stock prices affected by the location of trade? (1999) Paper claim — We examine pairs of large, 'Siamese twin' companies whose stocks are traded around the world but have different trading and ownership habitats. Raw markdown: froot-1999-how-are-stock-prices-affected-by-the-location Bibliographic Record Authors: Froot, KA, Dabora, EM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(99)00020-3 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow) Abstract We examine pairs of large, 'Siamese twin' companies whose stocks are traded around the world but have different trading and ownership habitats. Twins pool their cash flows, so, with integrated markets, twin stocks should move together. However, the difference between the prices of twin stocks appears to be correlated with the markets on which they are traded most, i.e., a twin's relative price rises when the market on which it is traded relatively intensively rises. We examine several explanations of this phenomenon including: the discretionary use of dividend income by parent companies: differences in parent expenditures; voting rights; currency fluctuations; ex-dividend date timing issues; and tax-induced investor heterogeneity. Only the last hypothesis can explain some, but not all, of the empirical facts. We conjecture that: (a) country-specific sentiment shocks might affect share intensity, (b) investors are rational, but markets are segmented by frictions other than international transactions costs, such as agency problems. (C) 1999 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察一对对大型的"连体双胞胎"（Siamese twin）公司，其股票在全球范围内交易，但拥有不同的交易和所有权栖息地（habitats）。双胞胎公司汇集其现金流，因此在市场一体化的情况下，双胞胎股票的走势应当一致。然而，双胞胎股票价格之间的差异似乎与它们交易最多的市场相关，即当一只双胞胎股票被相对密集交易的市场上涨时，其相对价格上升。我们考察了这一现象的若干解释，包括：母公司对股利收入的自由裁量使用；母公司支出的差异；投票权；汇率波动；除息日时点问题；以及税收引致的投资者异质性。只有最后一个假说能够解释部分（但并非全部）经验事实。我们推测：(a) 特定国家的情绪冲击可能影响交易份额（share intensity）；(b) 投资者是理性的，但市场被国际交易成本之外的其他摩擦所分割，例如代理问题。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Persistence of Long-Run Abnormal Returns Following Stock Repurchases and Offerings
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The long-run abnormal returns following both stock repurchases and seasoned equity offerings disappear for the events in 2003-2012. Raw markdown: fu-2016-the-persistence-of-long-run-abnormal-returns-following Bibliographic Record Authors: Fu, FJ, Huang, S Journal:…
pages.text: The Persistence of Long-Run Abnormal Returns Following Stock Repurchases and Offerings (2016) Paper claim — The long-run abnormal returns following both stock repurchases and seasoned equity offerings disappear for the events in 2003-2012. Raw markdown: fu-2016-the-persistence-of-long-run-abnormal-returns-following Bibliographic Record Authors: Fu, FJ, Huang, S Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2015.2150 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, governance, institution, regulat)；股利政策(stock repurchase) Abstract The long-run abnormal returns following both stock repurchases and seasoned equity offerings disappear for the events in 2003-2012. The disappearance is associated with the changing market environment: increased institutional investment, decreased trading costs, improved liquidity, and enhanced regulations on corporate governance and information disclosure. In response to the more efficient pricing of stocks, firms become less opportunistic in stock repurchases and offerings. Recent events of stock repurchases and offerings are motivated more by business-operating reasons than to exploit mispricing. Both external market factors and internal firm factors contribute to the disappearance of the postevent abnormal returns. Our findings on the recent events contrast with those of earlier studies and shed light on how the changing market environment affects both asset pricing and corporate behavior. 摘要（中文） 对于2003至2012年间的事件，股份回购和增发新股（seasoned equity offerings）之后的长期异常收益消失了。这一消失与市场环境的变化相关联：机构投资增加、交易成本下降、流动性改善以及公司治理和信息披露方面监管的加强。为应对更有效率的股票定价，企业在股份回购和增发中变得不那么机会主义。近期的股份回购和增发事件更多是出于经营业务的原因，而非利用错误定价。外部市场因素和内部企业因素都促成了事件后异常收益的消失。我们关于近期事件的发现与早期研究的发现形成对比，并揭示了不断变化的市场环境如何影响资产定价和公司行为。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of informed trading on dividend signaling: a theoretical and empirical examination
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines how the trading behavior of various investors impacts the market reaction to a dividend signal. Raw markdown: fuller-2003-the-impact-of-informed-trading-on-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Fuller, KP Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE…
pages.text: The impact of informed trading on dividend signaling: a theoretical and empirical examination (2003) Paper claim — This paper examines how the trading behavior of various investors impacts the market reaction to a dividend signal. Raw markdown: fuller-2003-the-impact-of-informed-trading-on-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Fuller, KP Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1016/S0929-1199(02)00052-4 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper examines how the trading behavior of various investors impacts the market reaction to a dividend signal. The dividend signaling model incorporates asymmetric information among traders, firm insiders, and the market. This interaction among market participants explains why not all dividend increases are viewed by the market as good news. The model predicts that the announcement day returns for a dividend increase are inversely related to measures of informed trading and decreasing in the level of buy demand relative to sell demand. Further, the model hypothesizes that more informed trading results in larger dividend increases. Empirical tests confirm these predictions. (C) 2002 Published by Elsevier Science B.V. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了各类投资者的交易行为如何影响市场对股利信号的反应。该股利信号模型纳入了交易者、公司内部人和市场之间的信息不对称。市场参与者之间的这种相互作用解释了为何并非所有股利增加都被市场视为好消息。该模型预测，股利增加的公告日收益与知情交易的度量呈反向关系，并随买入需求相对于卖出需求水平的上升而下降。此外，该模型假设更多的知情交易导致更大的股利增加。实证检验证实了这些预测。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do dividends matter more in declining markets?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find dividends do matter to shareholders, but more in declining markets than advancing ones. Raw markdown: fuller-2011-do-dividends-matter-more-in-declining-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Fuller, KP, Goldstein, MA Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: Do dividends matter more in declining markets? (2011) Paper claim — We find dividends do matter to shareholders, but more in declining markets than advancing ones. Raw markdown: fuller-2011-do-dividends-matter-more-in-declining-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Fuller, KP, Goldstein, MA Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.01.001 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract We find dividends do matter to shareholders, but more in declining markets than advancing ones. Dividend-paying stocks outperform non-dividend-paying stocks by 1 to 2% more per month in declining markets than in advancing markets. These results are economically and statistically significant and robust to many risk adjustments and across industries. In addition, we find an asymmetric response to dividend changes based on market conditions: dividend increases matter more in declining markets than advancing ones. Tests indicate that results are not due to more profitable firms and appear not to be caused either by free cash flow or signaling explanations. We also find that it is the existence of dividends, and not the dividend yield, that drives returns' asymmetric behavior relative to market movements. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们发现股利对股东确实重要，但在下跌市场中比在上涨市场中更为重要。在下跌市场中，派息股票每月跑赢不派息股票的幅度比在上涨市场中多1至2个百分点。这些结果在经济上和统计上都显著，并且对许多风险调整以及跨行业都稳健。此外，我们发现基于市场状况对股利变化存在不对称的反应：股利增长在下跌市场中比在上涨市场中更为重要。检验表明结果并非源于更盈利的企业，且似乎既不是由自由现金流也不是由信号传递解释所引起的。我们还发现，是股利的存在与否、而非股利收益率，驱动了收益相对于市场变动的不对称行为。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Unintended Consequences of Granting Small Firms Exemptions from Securities Regulation: Evidence from the Sarbanes-Oxley Act
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper provides evidence about the unintended consequences arising when small companies are exempted from costly regulations-these firms have incentives to stay small. Raw markdown: gao-2009-unintended-consequences-of-granting-small-firms-exemptions-from…
pages.text: Unintended Consequences of Granting Small Firms Exemptions from Securities Regulation: Evidence from the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (2009) Paper claim — This paper provides evidence about the unintended consequences arising when small companies are exempted from costly regulations-these firms have incentives to stay small. Raw markdown: gao-2009-unintended-consequences-of-granting-small-firms-exemptions-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Gao, F, Wu, JS, Zimmerman, J Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2009.00319.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(compliance, disclosure, regulat)；股利政策(payout) Abstract This paper provides evidence about the unintended consequences arising when small companies are exempted from costly regulations-these firms have incentives to stay small. Between 2003 and 2008, the SEC postponed compliance with Section 404 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 (SOX) for "non-accelerated filers" (firms with public float less than $75 million). We hypothesize and find that some of these firms had an incentive to remain below this bright line threshold. Moreover, we document that these firms remained small by undertaking less investment, making more cash payouts to shareholders, reducing the number of shares held by non-affiliates, making more bad news disclosures, and reporting lower earnings than control firms. Finally, there is no evidence that firms remaining small are doing so to maintain insiders' private control benefits. These findings have implications beyond SOX because numerous federal and state regulations exempt small firms via bright line size thresholds. 摘要（中文） 本文提供了证据，说明当小公司被豁免于代价高昂的监管时所产生的意外后果——这些公司有保持规模较小的激励。在2003年至2008年间，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）推迟了"非加速申报者"（public float低于7500万美元的公司）遵守《2002年萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》（SOX）第404条的时间。我们假设并发现，其中一些公司有动机保持在这一明确界线阈值之下。此外，我们记录了这些公司通过以下方式保持规模较小：进行更少的投资，向股东进行更多的现金派发，减少非关联方持有的股份数量，进行更多坏消息披露，并报告低于对照组公司的盈余。最后，没有证据表明保持规模较小的公司这样做是为了维持内部人的私人控制收益。这些发现具有超越SOX的意义，因为众多联邦和州法规通过明确界线的规模阈值豁免小公司。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Optimal compensation contracts when managers can hedge
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines optimal compensation contracts when executives can hedge their personal portfolios. Raw markdown: gao-2010-optimal-compensation-contracts-when-managers-can-hedge Bibliographic Record Authors: Gao, HS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year:…
pages.text: Optimal compensation contracts when managers can hedge (2010) Paper claim — This paper examines optimal compensation contracts when executives can hedge their personal portfolios. Raw markdown: gao-2010-optimal-compensation-contracts-when-managers-can-hedge Bibliographic Record Authors: Gao, HS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2010.03.015 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines optimal compensation contracts when executives can hedge their personal portfolios. In a simple principal-agent framework, I predict that the Chief Executive Officer's (CEO's) pay-performance sensitivity decreases with the executive-hedging cost. Empirically, I find evidence supporting the model's prediction. Providing further support for the theory, I show that shareholders also impose a high sensitivity of CEO wealth to stock volatility and increase financial leverage to resolve the executive-hedging problem. Moreover, executives with lower hedging costs hold more exercisable in-the-money options, have weaker incentives to cut dividends, and pursue fewer corporate diversification initiatives. Overall, the manager's ability to hedge the firm's risk affects governance mechanisms and managerial actions. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了当高管能够对其个人投资组合进行对冲时的最优薪酬契约。在一个简单的委托-代理框架中，我预测首席执行官（CEO）的薪酬-业绩敏感性随高管对冲成本的下降而下降。实证上，我发现证据支持该模型的预测。为进一步支持该理论，我表明股东还会强加CEO财富对股票波动率的高敏感性，并提高财务杠杆以解决高管对冲问题。此外，对冲成本较低的高管持有更多实值可行权期权、削减股利的动机较弱，且发起更少的企业多元化举措。总体而言，管理者对冲企业风险的能力会影响治理机制和管理层行动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managerial social capital and dividend smoothing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate the influence of a previously unexamined managerial personal attribute, social capital, on a firm?s propensity to smooth dividends. Raw markdown: garcafeijo-2021-managerial-social-capital-and-dividend-smoothing Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Managerial social capital and dividend smoothing (2021) Paper claim — We investigate the influence of a previously unexamined managerial personal attribute, social capital, on a firm?s propensity to smooth dividends. Raw markdown: garcafeijo-2021-managerial-social-capital-and-dividend-smoothing Bibliographic Record Authors: García-Feijóo, L, Hossain, MM, Javakhadze, D Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101811 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, alternative) Abstract We investigate the influence of a previously unexamined managerial personal attribute, social capital, on a firm?s propensity to smooth dividends. We document that greater managerial social capital is associated with a statistically and economically significant increase in dividend smoothing. The effect of social capital on dividend smoothing is stronger for financially constrained firms. We also find that social connections are positively associated with passive institutional ownership. Our results are robust to alternative model specifications, different variable measurement, and endogeneity tests. Overall, the findings are consistent with agency-based explanations for corporate dividend smoothing. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了一个此前未被研究的管理者个人特质——社会资本——对企业平滑股利倾向的影响。我们记录到，更高的管理者社会资本与股利平滑在统计上和经济上的显著增加相关联。社会资本对股利平滑的影响对财务受约束的企业更强。我们还发现，社会关系与被动机构持股正相关。我们的结果对替代性模型设定、不同的变量度量以及内生性检验都是稳健的。总体而言，这些发现与企业股利平滑基于代理的解释相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend behavior and dividend signaling
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze the dividend behavior of the aggregate stock market. Raw markdown: garrett-2000-dividend-behavior-and-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Garrett, I, Priestley, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2000 DOI:…
pages.text: Dividend behavior and dividend signaling (2000) Paper claim — We analyze the dividend behavior of the aggregate stock market. Raw markdown: garrett-2000-dividend-behavior-and-dividend-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Garrett, I, Priestley, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2000 DOI: 10.2307/2676189 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative, signal) Abstract We analyze the dividend behavior of the aggregate stock market. We propose a model that assumes managers minimize the costs of adjustment associated with being away from their target dividend payout. The target is expressed as a function of lagged stock prices and permanent earnings, generalizing previous models of dividend behavior. We present a new method for measuring unobserved permanent earnings based on the Kalman filter. Our specification of dividend behavior is strongly supported by the data relative to both alternative models and over time. We find significant evidence of dividend smoothing and dividends conveying information regarding unexpected positive changes in current permanent earnings. We also find that both the speed of adjustment of dividends to target dividends and tests of signaling are sensitive to the specification of the model. 摘要（中文） 我们分析总体股票市场的股利行为。我们提出一个模型，假设经理人使偏离其目标股利支付所带来的调整成本最小化。目标被表述为滞后股价和永久性收益的函数，从而推广了以往的股利行为模型。我们提出了一种基于卡尔曼滤波来度量不可观测的永久性收益的新方法。相对于各种替代模型并随时间推移来看，我们对股利行为的设定得到了数据的有力支持。我们发现显著证据表明存在股利平滑，且股利传递了关于当期永久性收益意外正向变化的信息。我们还发现，股利向目标股利的调整速度以及信号传递的检验都对模型的设定敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a new variable based on a model of dividend smoothing, we find that dividend growth is highly predictable and that cash flow news contributes importantly to return variability. Raw markdown: garrett-2012-dividend-growth-cash-flow-and-discount-rate-news…
pages.text: Dividend Growth, Cash Flow, and Discount Rate News (2012) Paper claim — Using a new variable based on a model of dividend smoothing, we find that dividend growth is highly predictable and that cash flow news contributes importantly to return variability. Raw markdown: garrett-2012-dividend-growth-cash-flow-and-discount-rate-news Bibliographic Record Authors: Garrett, I, Priestley, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109012000427 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Using a new variable based on a model of dividend smoothing, we find that dividend growth is highly predictable and that cash flow news contributes importantly to return variability. Cash flow betas derived from this predictability are central to explaining the size effect in the cross section of returns. However, they do not explain the value effect; this is explained by noise betas. We also find that the relative importance of cash flow news in explaining recent stock price run-ups and subsequent declines increases when cash flow news is estimated directly. 摘要（中文） 我们使用一个基于股利平滑模型的新变量，发现股利增长具有高度可预测性，并且现金流消息对收益变异性有重要贡献。由这种可预测性所推导出的现金流贝塔对于解释收益横截面中的规模效应至关重要。然而，它们无法解释价值效应；价值效应由噪声贝塔来解释。我们还发现，当直接估计现金流消息时，现金流消息在解释近期股价上涨及随后下跌方面的相对重要性会增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout Policy Choices and Shareholder Investment Horizons
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines how shareholder investment horizons influence payout policy choices. Raw markdown: gaspar-2013-payout-policy-choices-and-shareholder-investment-horizons Bibliographic Record Authors: Gaspar, JM, Massa, M, Matos, P, Patgiri, R, Rehman, Z Journal:…
pages.text: Payout Policy Choices and Shareholder Investment Horizons (2013) Paper claim — This paper examines how shareholder investment horizons influence payout policy choices. Raw markdown: gaspar-2013-payout-policy-choices-and-shareholder-investment-horizons Bibliographic Record Authors: Gaspar, JM, Massa, M, Matos, P, Patgiri, R, Rehman, Z Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfr040 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(buyback, dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper examines how shareholder investment horizons influence payout policy choices. The authors infer institutional shareholders' investment horizons using the churn rate of their overall stock portfolios prior to the payout decision. The authors find that the frequency and amount of repurchases increases with ownership by short-term investors to the detriment of dividends. They also find that the market reacts less positively to repurchase announcements made by firms held by short-term institutions. These findings are consistent with a model in which undervalued firms signal their value through repurchases, but firms held by short-term investors make repurchases more often because those investors care mostly about the short-term price reaction. Hence, the market rationally discounts the signal provided by such repurchases. Our findings suggest that shorter shareholder investment horizons might be one contributing factor to the increasing popularity of buybacks. 摘要（中文） 本文考察股东投资期限如何影响支付政策选择。作者利用机构股东在支付决策之前整体股票投资组合的换手率，来推断其投资期限。作者发现，回购的频率和金额随短期投资者持股的增加而上升，以牺牲股利为代价。他们还发现，对于由短期机构持有的企业，市场对其回购公告的反应不那么积极。这些发现与这样一个模型相一致：被低估的企业通过回购发出其价值的信号，但由短期投资者持有的企业更频繁地进行回购，因为这些投资者主要关心短期价格反应。因此，市场理性地对此类回购所提供的信号打了折扣。我们的发现表明，较短的股东投资期限可能是回购日益流行的一个促成因素。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend taxes and share prices: Evidence from real estate investment trusts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Prior empirical evidence regarding the impact of dividend taxes on firm valuation is mixed. Raw markdown: gentry-2003-dividend-taxes-and-share-prices-evidence-from-real Bibliographic Record Authors: Gentry, WM, Kemsley, D, Mayer, CJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE…
pages.text: Dividend taxes and share prices: Evidence from real estate investment trusts (2003) Paper claim — Prior empirical evidence regarding the impact of dividend taxes on firm valuation is mixed. Raw markdown: gentry-2003-dividend-taxes-and-share-prices-evidence-from-real Bibliographic Record Authors: Gentry, WM, Kemsley, D, Mayer, CJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00524 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy, transparency)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Prior empirical evidence regarding the impact of dividend taxes on firm valuation is mixed. This study avoids some of the complications encountered in previous empirical work by exploiting institutional characteristics of REITs, such as their limited discretion over dividend policy and the relative transparency of REIT assets. We regress the market value of equity on the market value of assets and tax basis, which creates tax deductions that lower future dividend taxes without affecting future pretax cash flow. We find that firm value is positively related to tax basis, suggesting that future dividend taxes are capitalized into share prices. 摘要（中文） 以往关于股利税对企业估值影响的实证证据参差不齐。本研究通过利用房地产投资信托（REITs）的制度特征——例如它们对股利政策有限的自由裁量权以及REIT资产的相对透明性——避免了以往实证工作中遇到的一些复杂问题。我们将权益的市场价值对资产的市场价值和计税基础进行回归，计税基础会产生税收抵扣，从而在不影响未来税前现金流的情况下降低未来股利税。我们发现企业价值与计税基础呈正相关，这表明未来股利税被资本化进了股价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The dark side of CEO inside debt: Evidence from stock price crash risk
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Despite being thought of as a governance mechanism, CEO inside debt seems to distort firms' information environment. Raw markdown: gholami-2025-the-dark-side-of-ceo-inside-debt-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Gholami, A, Elnahas, A Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: The dark side of CEO inside debt: Evidence from stock price crash risk (2025) Paper claim — Despite being thought of as a governance mechanism, CEO inside debt seems to distort firms' information environment. Raw markdown: gholami-2025-the-dark-side-of-ceo-inside-debt-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Gholami, A, Elnahas, A Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2025.102860 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution, regulat)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(information asymmetry) Abstract Despite being thought of as a governance mechanism, CEO inside debt seems to distort firms' information environment. Our results indicate that CEO inside debt alters managerial orientation and incentives in a way that increases stock price crash risk. Our results are robust after addressing endogeneity using the instrumental variable (IV) approach, a difference-in-differences test based on the implementation of Internal Revenue Code Section 409 A Final Regulations, and Oster's omitted variable diagnostic test, and selection bias using the propensity score matching (PSM) and Entropy balancing (EB) approaches. The results are stronger for firms that are poorly governed, operate in less competitive industries, have lower institutional ownership, have higher information asymmetry, and pay less dividends. Further, the results are robust to controlling for CSR, local religiosity, tax avoidance, financial opacity, CEO power, and CEO as well as local political ideology. 摘要（中文） 尽管CEO的内部债务（inside debt）被视为一种治理机制，但它似乎扭曲了企业的信息环境。我们的结果表明，CEO内部债务以一种增加股价崩盘风险的方式改变了管理者的取向和激励。在采用工具变量（IV）方法、基于《国内税收法典》第409A节最终条例实施的双重差分检验、Oster遗漏变量诊断检验来处理内生性，以及采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）和熵平衡（EB）方法来处理选择偏差之后，我们的结果依然稳健。对于治理较差、经营于竞争程度较低行业、机构持股较低、信息不对称较高以及派发股利较少的企业，这一结果更强。此外，在控制了企业社会责任（CSR）、当地宗教虔诚度、避税、财务不透明度、CEO权力以及CEO和当地政治意识形态之后，结果依然稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Employee ownership, board representation, and corporate financial policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — French law mandates that employees of publicly listed companies can elect two types of directors to represent employees. Raw markdown: ginglinger-2011-employee-ownership-board-representation-and-corporate-financial-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Ginglinger,…
pages.text: Employee ownership, board representation, and corporate financial policies (2011) Paper claim — French law mandates that employees of publicly listed companies can elect two types of directors to represent employees. Raw markdown: ginglinger-2011-employee-ownership-board-representation-and-corporate-financial-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Ginglinger, E, Megginson, W, Waxin, T Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.03.005 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, law, policy)；股利政策(payout) Abstract French law mandates that employees of publicly listed companies can elect two types of directors to represent employees. Privatized companies must reserve board seats for directors elected by employees by right of employment, while employee-shareholders can elect a director whenever they hold at least 3% of outstanding shares. Using a comprehensive sample of firms in the Societe des Bourses Francaises (SBF) 120 Index from 1998 to 2008, we examine the impact of employee-directors on corporate valuation, payout policy, and internal board organization and performance. We find that directors elected by employee shareholders increase firm valuation and profitability, but do not significantly impact corporate payout policy. Directors elected by employees by right significantly reduce payout ratios, but do not impact firm value or profitability. Employee representation on corporate boards thus appears to be at least value-neutral, and perhaps value-enhancing in the case of directors elected by employee shareholders. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 法国法律规定，上市公司的员工可以选举两类董事来代表员工。被私有化的公司必须为凭雇佣权利由员工选举产生的董事保留董事会席位，而员工股东只要持有至少3%的流通股，便可选举一名董事。利用法国证券交易所（SBF）120指数中1998年至2008年公司的一个全面样本，我们考察员工董事对公司估值、支付政策以及董事会内部组织和绩效的影响。我们发现，由员工股东选举产生的董事提升了公司估值和盈利能力，但对公司支付政策没有显著影响。凭权利由员工选举产生的董事显著降低了支付比率，但对公司价值或盈利能力没有影响。因此，员工在公司董事会中的代表权至少似乎是价值中性的，而在由员工股东选举产生董事的情况下或许还能提升价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Valuing the Treasury's Capital Assistance Program
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — T he Capital Assistance Program (CAP) was created by the U. Raw markdown: glasserman-2011-valuing-the-treasury-s-capital-assistance-program Bibliographic Record Authors: Glasserman, P, Wang, ZY Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1110.1351…
pages.text: Valuing the Treasury's Capital Assistance Program (2011) Paper claim — T he Capital Assistance Program (CAP) was created by the U. Raw markdown: glasserman-2011-valuing-the-treasury-s-capital-assistance-program Bibliographic Record Authors: Glasserman, P, Wang, ZY Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1110.1351 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, supervis)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract T he Capital Assistance Program (CAP) was created by the U. S. government in February 2009 to provide backup capital to large financial institutions unable to raise sufficient capital from private investors. Under the terms of the CAP, a participating bank receives contingent capital by issuing preferred shares to the Treasury combined with embedded options for both parties: The bank gets the option to redeem the shares or convert them to common equity, with conversion mandatory after seven years; the Treasury earns dividends on the preferred shares and gets warrants on the bank's common equity. We develop a contingent claims framework in which to estimate market values of these CAP securities. The interaction between the competing options held by the buyer and issuer of these securities creates a game between the two parties, and our approach captures this strategic element of the joint valuation problem and clarifies the incentives it creates. We apply our method to the 18 publicly held bank holding companies that participated in the Supervisory Capital Assessment Program (the stress test) launched together with the CAP. On average, we estimate that compared to a market transaction, the CAP securities carry a net value of approximately 30% of the capital invested for a bank participating to the maximum extent allowed under the terms of the program. We also find that the net value varies widely across banks. We compare our estimates with abnormal stock price returns for the stress test banks at the time the terms of the CAP were announced; we find correlations between 0.78 and 0.85, depending on the precise choice of period and set of banks included. These results suggest that our valuation aligns with shareholder perception of the value of the program, prompting questions about industry reactions and the overall impact of the program. 摘要（中文） 资本援助计划（CAP）由美国政府于2009年2月设立，旨在为无法从私人投资者处筹集充足资本的大型金融机构提供后备资本。根据CAP的条款，参与银行通过向财政部发行优先股获得或有资本，同时为双方嵌入期权：银行获得赎回股份或将其转换为普通股的期权，且七年后强制转换；财政部就优先股赚取股利，并获得对该银行普通股的认股权证。我们发展了一个或有权益（contingent claims）框架，用以估计这些CAP证券的市场价值。这些证券的买方和发行方所持有的相互竞争期权之间的相互作用，在双方之间创造了一场博弈，我们的方法捕捉了联合估值问题的这一策略性要素，并厘清了它所创造的激励。我们将我们的方法应用于参与了与CAP同时启动的监管资本评估计划（即压力测试）的18家公开持有的银行控股公司。平均而言，我们估计，对于在该计划条款下参与到最大允许程度的银行，与市场交易相比，CAP证券所带来的净价值约为所投入资本的30%。我们还发现，净价值在各银行之间差异很大。我们将我们的估计与压力测试银行在CAP条款公布时的异常股价收益进行比较；我们发现两者的相关性介于0.78和0.85之间，具体取决于期间的确切选择以及所纳入的银行集合。这些结果表明，我们的估值与股东对该计划价值的认知相一致，从而引发了对行业反应以及该计划整体影响的疑问。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The market for corporate control and dividend policies: Cross-country evidence from M&A laws
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article examines the association between the market for corporate control and firm dividend policies. Raw markdown: glendening-2016-the-market-for-corporate-control-and-dividend-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Glendening, M, Khurana, LK, Wang, W…
pages.text: The market for corporate control and dividend policies: Cross-country evidence from M&A laws (2016) Paper claim — This article examines the association between the market for corporate control and firm dividend policies. Raw markdown: glendening-2016-the-market-for-corporate-control-and-dividend-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Glendening, M, Khurana, LK, Wang, W Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1057/s41267-016-0028-x Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, law, monitor)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This article examines the association between the market for corporate control and firm dividend policies. Specifically, we examine changes in firms' dividend payouts following a plausibly exogenous shock to the threat of takeover with the staggered initiation of country-level merger and acquisition (M&A) laws. Using a global sample of firms across 34 countries, we find that both the likelihood and the amount of dividends decrease significantly after the initiation of an M&A law in a country. Our cross-sectional analyses indicate that the negative effect of M&A laws on dividend payouts is amplified in countries where the institutional environment enables M&A laws to improve the takeover market and for firms that could readily use Interpol capital to finance growth opportunities. Moreover, this negative effect is attenuated for firms with already sufficient monitoring of managers. These findings suggest that the enactment of M&A laws, by strengthening the market for corporate control, lowered the need for firms to convey their commitment to shareholders' interests through costly dividend payments, especially when the threat of takeover prompted by M&A laws is likely to serve as an effective disciplinary mechanism. 摘要（中文） 本文考察公司控制权市场与企业股利政策之间的关联。具体而言，我们考察随着国家层面并购（M&A）法律的分阶段出台、企业股利支付在收购威胁受到看似外生冲击后的变化。使用涵盖34个国家企业的全球样本，我们发现，在一国出台并购法律后，派息的可能性和金额均显著下降。我们的横截面分析表明，并购法律对股利支付的负向效应在制度环境使并购法律能够改善收购市场的国家、以及能够便利地使用内部资本为增长机会提供资金的企业中被放大。此外，对于已经对经理人有充分监督的企业，这一负向效应有所减弱。这些发现表明，并购法律的颁布通过强化公司控制权市场，降低了企业通过代价高昂的股利支付来传达其对股东利益承诺的需要，尤其是当并购法律所引发的收购威胁很可能成为一种有效的约束机制时。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: TESTING THE PREDICTIVE POWER OF DIVIDEND YIELDS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper reexamines the ability of dividend yields to predict long-horizon stock returns. Raw markdown: goetzmann-1993-testing-the-predictive-power-of-dividend-yields Bibliographic Record Authors: GOETZMANN, WN, JORION, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1993…
pages.text: TESTING THE PREDICTIVE POWER OF DIVIDEND YIELDS (1993) Paper claim — This paper reexamines the ability of dividend yields to predict long-horizon stock returns. Raw markdown: goetzmann-1993-testing-the-predictive-power-of-dividend-yields Bibliographic Record Authors: GOETZMANN, WN, JORION, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1993 DOI: 10.2307/2328917 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract This paper reexamines the ability of dividend yields to predict long-horizon stock returns. We use the bootstrap methodology, as well as simulations, to examine the distribution of test statistics under the null hypothesis of no forecasting ability. These experiments are constructed so as to maintain the dynamics of regressions with lagged dependent variables over long horizons. We find that the empirically observed statistics are well within the 95% bounds of their simulated distributions. Overall there is no strong statistical evidence indicating that dividend yields can be used to forecast stock returns. 摘要（中文） 本文重新考察股利收益率预测长期跨度股票收益的能力。我们使用自助法（bootstrap）以及模拟，来考察在无预测能力这一原假设下检验统计量的分布。这些实验的构建方式使其在长期跨度上保持了带滞后因变量回归的动态特性。我们发现，实证观察到的统计量完全处于其模拟分布95%边界之内。总体而言，没有强有力的统计证据表明股利收益率可用于预测股票收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: How do share repurchases affect ownership concentration? (2013) Paper claim — We study how share repurchases affect the ownership stake of outside blockholders in 950 publicly-traded US corporations from 1996 through 2001, using a control function approach to address the possible endogeneity of repurchases. Raw markdown: golbe-2013-how-do-share-repurchases-affect-ownership-concentration Bibliographic Record Authors: Golbe, DL, Nyman, I Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2012.11.002 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract We study how share repurchases affect the ownership stake of outside blockholders in 950 publicly-traded US corporations from 1996 through 2001, using a control function approach to address the possible endogeneity of repurchases. We find that share repurchases tend to make outside ownership less concentrated: repurchasing 1% of outstanding common equity decreases the fraction owned by large shareholders by around one and a half percentage points. This may decrease outside shareholders' influence over firm decision-making. Our results are confirmed when we restrict the sample to institutional owners, but not to individual owners. (c) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们使用控制函数方法来解决回购可能的内生性问题，研究了1996年至2001年间950家美国上市公司中股份回购如何影响外部大股东的持股比例。我们发现股份回购往往使外部所有权更不集中：回购流通普通股的1%会使大股东所持份额下降约1.5个百分点。这可能会削弱外部股东对企业决策的影响力。当我们将样本限制为机构所有者时，结果得到确认，但对个人所有者则不然。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The dividend-price ratio is a noisy proxy for expected returns when expected dividend growth is time-varying. Raw markdown: golez-2014-expected-returns-and-dividend-growth-rates-implied-by Bibliographic Record Authors: Golez, B Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES…
pages.text: Expected Returns and Dividend Growth Rates Implied by Derivative Markets (2014) Paper claim — The dividend-price ratio is a noisy proxy for expected returns when expected dividend growth is time-varying. Raw markdown: golez-2014-expected-returns-and-dividend-growth-rates-implied-by Bibliographic Record Authors: Golez, B Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hht131 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The dividend-price ratio is a noisy proxy for expected returns when expected dividend growth is time-varying. This paper uses a new and forward-looking measure of dividend growth extracted from S&P 500 futures and options to correct the dividend-price ratio for changes in expected dividend growth. Over January 1994 through June 2011, dividend growth implied by derivative markets reliably forecasts future dividend growth, and the corrected dividend-price ratio predicts S&P 500 returns substantially better than the standard dividend-price ratio, in-sample and out-of-sample. Time-varying expected dividend growth is important to explain price movements, especially because it is highly correlated with expected returns. 摘要（中文） 当预期股利增长时变时，股利-价格比是预期收益的一个含噪代理变量。本文使用一种从标准普尔500期货和期权中提取的、前瞻性的新股利增长度量，来对股利-价格比进行修正以反映预期股利增长的变化。在1994年1月至2011年6月期间，衍生品市场所隐含的股利增长可靠地预测了未来股利增长，而经修正的股利-价格比在样本内和样本外都显著优于标准股利-价格比地预测标准普尔500的收益。时变的预期股利增长对于解释价格变动很重要，尤其是因为它与预期收益高度相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
