pages.title: Equity duration and predictability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — After 1945, expected returns have started to dominate the variation in equity price movements, leaving little room for expected dividend growth. Raw markdown: golez-2025-equity-duration-and-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Golez, B, Koudijs, P Journal:…
pages.text: Equity duration and predictability (2025) Paper claim — After 1945, expected returns have started to dominate the variation in equity price movements, leaving little room for expected dividend growth. Raw markdown: golez-2025-equity-duration-and-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Golez, B, Koudijs, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2025.104114 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract After 1945, expected returns have started to dominate the variation in equity price movements, leaving little room for expected dividend growth. An increase in equity duration can help explain this change. Expected returns vary more for payouts further into the future. Furthermore, because expected returns are more persistent than growth rates, they are more important for longer-duration assets. We provide empirical support for this explanation across three datasets: dividend strips, the long time series for the aggregate market, and the crosssection of stocks. A simple present value model with time-varying duration can largely explain the post-1945 dominance of expected returns. 摘要（中文） 1945年之后，预期收益开始主导股价变动的波动，几乎没有给预期股利增长留下空间。股票久期（equity duration）的增加有助于解释这一变化。对于更远期的派现，预期收益的变动更大。此外，由于预期收益比增长率更具持久性，它们对于久期更长的资产更为重要。我们在三个数据集上为这一解释提供了经验支持：股利条带、总体市场的长时间序列以及股票截面。一个具有时变久期的简单现值模型在很大程度上可以解释1945年后预期收益的主导地位。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Fed information effects: Evidence from the equity term structure (2025) Paper claim — Do investors interpret central bank target rate decisions as signals about the current state of the economy? We study this question using a short-term equity asset that entitles the owner to the near-term dividends of the aggregate stock market. Raw markdown: golez-2025-fed-information-effects-evidence-from-the-equity-term Bibliographic Record Authors: Golez, B, Matthies, B Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2024.103988 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Do investors interpret central bank target rate decisions as signals about the current state of the economy? We study this question using a short-term equity asset that entitles the owner to the near-term dividends of the aggregate stock market. We develop a stylized model of monetary policy and the equity term structure and derive tests of Fed information effects using the short-term asset announcement return. Consistent with the existence of information effects, we find that the short-term asset return in a 30-minute window around FOMC announcements loads positively on monetary policy surprises. Furthermore, the announcement return predicts near-term macroeconomic growth. 摘要（中文） 投资者是否将央行目标利率决策解读为关于当前经济状态的信号？我们使用一种短期股票资产来研究这一问题，该资产赋予其所有者获取总体股票市场近期股利的权利。我们建立了一个关于货币政策和股票期限结构的程式化模型，并利用短期资产的公告收益推导出对美联储信息效应（Fed information effects）的检验。与信息效应的存在相一致，我们发现在FOMC公告前后30分钟窗口内，短期资产收益正向加载于货币政策意外冲击。此外，公告收益可以预测近期的宏观经济增长。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Active catering to dividend clienteles: Evidence from takeovers
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use merger-induced changes to shareholder structure to test for active catering to dividend clienteles. Raw markdown: golubov-2020-active-catering-to-dividend-clienteles-evidence-from-takeovers Bibliographic Record Authors: Golubov, A, Lasfer, M, Vitkova, V…
pages.text: Active catering to dividend clienteles: Evidence from takeovers (2020) Paper claim — We use merger-induced changes to shareholder structure to test for active catering to dividend clienteles. Raw markdown: golubov-2020-active-catering-to-dividend-clienteles-evidence-from-takeovers Bibliographic Record Authors: Golubov, A, Lasfer, M, Vitkova, V Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.04.002 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We use merger-induced changes to shareholder structure to test for active catering to dividend clienteles. Following mergers, acquirers adjust their dividend payout toward that of the target, but only when they inherit target shareholders through stock swaps. This adjustment is stronger when legacy shareholders are more influential and reveal a greater preference for dividends through portfolio holdings and trading behavior. Country-level differences in dividend taxes, governance quality, and population age further shape the extent of adjustment in ways consistent with dividend preferences. Pre-closing, differences in dividend payout discourage the use of stock as a payment method. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用并购引发的股东结构变化来检验对股利客户群的主动迎合。在并购后，收购方将其股利支付向目标公司调整，但仅当它们通过换股继承了目标公司股东时如此。当这些既有股东更具影响力、并通过持仓组合和交易行为显示出对股利更强的偏好时，这种调整更强。国家层面在股利税、治理质量和人口年龄方面的差异，进一步以与股利偏好相一致的方式塑造了调整的程度。在并购完成前，股利支付的差异会抑制以股票作为支付方式的使用。 Key Findings In a global sample of 5,366 public-to-public M&A deals (1990–2015), acquirers in stock-swap deals where the target paid higher dividends increase their DPS by 14.23 percentage points more (of pre-merger BPS) in year 1 than in otherwise comparable pure cash deals — with the difference-in-differences (Panel B minus Panel C) significant at p < 0.01 across all three post-merger years. Multivariate regressions confirm that Dividend Gap alone has no significant effect, but the interaction Dividend Gap × Pct. Stock is positive and highly significant (0.276–0.453 across years 1–3, all p < 0.01), with zero effect in cash deals — isolating the catering mechanism to cases where target shareholders are actually inherited. The clientele effect is stronger when inherited shareholders are more influential (larger relative deal size, more illiquid acquirer stock) and when they reveal stronger dividend preferences through portfolio holdings (dedicated institutional investors, high portfolio dividend yield, tax-insensitive institutions). Country-level cross-sectional tests show adjustment is stronger when acquirer governance quality is weaker (relative to target), when dividends are tax-advantaged for acquirer investors, and when target domicile countries have a higher proportion of senior citizens — consistent with agency-based, tax-based, and age-based dividend demand mechanisms. Pre-merger, the probability of an all-stock offer is strongly negatively associated with the pre-deal Dividend Gap, showing that acquirers avoid stock payment when target shareholders prefer higher dividends — an ex-ante effect of clientele considerations on deal structure. pages.title: The signaling power of specially designated dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We distinguish among the signaling, free cash flow, and wealth transfer hypotheses in explaining the stock price reaction to specially designated dividend (SDD) announcements. Raw markdown: gombola-1999-the-signaling-power-of-specially-designated-dividends…
pages.text: The signaling power of specially designated dividends (1999) Paper claim — We distinguish among the signaling, free cash flow, and wealth transfer hypotheses in explaining the stock price reaction to specially designated dividend (SDD) announcements. Raw markdown: gombola-1999-the-signaling-power-of-specially-designated-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Gombola, MJ, Liu, FY Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.2307/2676266 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract We distinguish among the signaling, free cash flow, and wealth transfer hypotheses in explaining the stock price reaction to specially designated dividend (SDD) announcements. In a direct test of the signaling power of SDDs, we find both a larger stock price reaction and a significant upward revision of earnings forecasts for firms with Tobin's q less than one, but not for other firms. Our results support the conditional signaling hypothesis, which predicts greater effects of favorable information for low q firms. Taken together, our results for stock price effects and earnings forecast revisions do not support either the free cash flow or wealth transfer hypotheses. 摘要（中文） 我们在解释特别指定股利（SDD）公告引起的股价反应时，区分了信号传递假说、自由现金流假说与财富转移假说。在对SDD信号传递能力的直接检验中，我们发现托宾q小于1的企业既有更大的股价反应，也有对盈余预测的显著向上修正，而其他企业则没有。我们的结果支持条件信号传递假说，该假说预测有利信息对低q企业有更大的影响。综合来看，我们关于股价效应和盈余预测修正的结果既不支持自由现金流假说，也不支持财富转移假说。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Reinvestment Risk and the Equity Term Structure
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The equity term structure is downward sloping at long maturities. Raw markdown: gonalves-2021-reinvestment-risk-and-the-equity-term-structure Bibliographic Record Authors: Gonçalves, AS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13035 Relevance score:…
pages.text: Reinvestment Risk and the Equity Term Structure (2021) Paper claim — The equity term structure is downward sloping at long maturities. Raw markdown: gonalves-2021-reinvestment-risk-and-the-equity-term-structure Bibliographic Record Authors: Gonçalves, AS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13035 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract The equity term structure is downward sloping at long maturities. I estimate an Intertemporal Capital Asset Pricing Model (ICAPM) to show that the trade-off between market and reinvestment risk explains this pattern. Intuitively, while long-term dividend claims are highly exposed to market risk, they are good hedges for reinvestment risk because dividend prices rise as expected returns decline, and longer-term claims are more sensitive to discount rates. In the estimated ICAPM, reinvestment risk dominates at long maturities, inducing relatively low risk premia on long-term dividend claims. The model is also consistent with the equity term structure cyclicality and the upward-sloping bond term structure. 摘要（中文） 权益期限结构在长期限端向下倾斜。我估计了一个跨期资本资产定价模型（ICAPM），以表明市场风险与再投资风险之间的权衡解释了这一模式。直观地说，虽然长期股利索取权对市场风险的暴露很高，但它们是再投资风险的良好对冲工具，因为股利价格随着预期收益的下降而上升，而更长期的索取权对贴现率更为敏感。在估计的ICAPM中，再投资风险在长期限处占主导地位，从而使长期股利索取权的风险溢价相对较低。该模型还与权益期限结构的周期性以及向上倾斜的债券期限结构相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Risk-sensitive Basel regulations and firms' access to credit: Direct and indirect effects☆
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the impact of risk-sensitive Basel regulations on debt financing of firms around the world. Raw markdown: gopalakrishnan-2021-risk-sensitive-basel-regulations-and-firms-access-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Gopalakrishnan, B, Jacob, J,…
pages.text: Risk-sensitive Basel regulations and firms' access to credit: Direct and indirect effects☆ (2021) Paper claim — This paper examines the impact of risk-sensitive Basel regulations on debt financing of firms around the world. Raw markdown: gopalakrishnan-2021-risk-sensitive-basel-regulations-and-firms-access-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Gopalakrishnan, B, Jacob, J, Mohapatra, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2021.106101 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(payout) Abstract This paper examines the impact of risk-sensitive Basel regulations on debt financing of firms around the world. It investigates how firms cope with the impact through adjustments to their financing sources and capital investments. We find that the implementation of Basel II regulations is associated with reduced credit availability for lower-rated firms. Such firms mitigate the shortage in bank credit through increased reliance on accounts payable, lower payouts to shareholders, and reduced capital investments. The impact of the capital regulation is lower in countries that rely on the internal ratings-based approach. The key results are robust to controls for banking crises, bank-specific controls, and the inclusion of loan-level information. The findings of this paper substantially contribute to the understanding of the real effects of risk-sensitive bank capital regulations. (c) 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了风险敏感型巴塞尔监管规则对全球企业债务融资的影响。文章探究了企业如何通过调整其融资来源和资本投资来应对这一影响。我们发现，巴塞尔II监管规则的实施与评级较低企业的信贷可得性下降相关。这类企业通过增加对应付账款的依赖、减少对股东的派现以及削减资本投资来缓解银行信贷的短缺。在采用内部评级法的国家，资本监管的影响较小。这些主要结果在控制了银行业危机、银行特定控制变量以及纳入贷款层面信息后依然稳健。本文的发现对理解风险敏感型银行资本监管的实际效应做出了重要贡献。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Internal Capital Market and Dividend Policies: Evidence From Business Groups
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We argue that internal capital market imperatives of business groups i.e., reallocation of capital across group firms, influences an affiliated firms dividend policy. Raw markdown: gopalan-2014-internal-capital-market-and-dividend-policies-evidence-from…
pages.text: Internal Capital Market and Dividend Policies: Evidence From Business Groups (2014) Paper claim — We argue that internal capital market imperatives of business groups i.e., reallocation of capital across group firms, influences an affiliated firms dividend policy. Raw markdown: gopalan-2014-internal-capital-market-and-dividend-policies-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Gopalan, R, Nanda, V, Seru, A Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhu004 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We argue that internal capital market imperatives of business groups i.e., reallocation of capital across group firms, influences an affiliated firms dividend policy. Intuition is developed in a model in which business group insiders distribute dividends from cash-rich firms and use their share of payout to invest in other affiliated firms. Employing multi-country panel-data, we find support for this channel: Dividends by a group firm are positively related with equity-financed investments by its affiliated firms. Results are corroborated by exploiting variation in a firms investment opportunity generated by changes in import tariff policy: a shock to investment opportunity of an affiliated firm is propagated to dividend policies of other firms in its group. 摘要（中文） 我们认为，企业集团内部资本市场的必然要求（即跨集团企业的资本再配置）会影响成员企业的股利政策。我们在一个模型中形成了直觉，在该模型中，企业集团内部人从现金充裕的企业中分配股利，并利用其分得的派现份额去投资于其他成员企业。运用多国面板数据，我们发现支持这一渠道的证据：某一集团企业的股利与其成员企业的股权融资投资正相关。通过利用进口关税政策变化所产生的企业投资机会变异，结果得到进一步印证：某一成员企业投资机会的冲击会传导至集团中其他企业的股利政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Flexibility in cash-flow classification under IFRS: determinants and consequences
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) allow managers flexibility in classifying interest paid, interest received, and dividends received within operating, investing, or financing activities within the statement of cash flows. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Flexibility in cash-flow classification under IFRS: determinants and consequences (2017) Paper claim — International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) allow managers flexibility in classifying interest paid, interest received, and dividends received within operating, investing, or financing activities within the statement of cash flows. Raw markdown: gordon-2017-flexibility-in-cash-flow-classification-under-ifrs-determinants Bibliographic Record Authors: Gordon, EA, Henry, E, Jorgensen, BN, Linthicum, CL Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-017-9387-1 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) allow managers flexibility in classifying interest paid, interest received, and dividends received within operating, investing, or financing activities within the statement of cash flows. In contrast, U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) requires these items to be classified as operating cash flows (OCF). Studying IFRS-reporting firms in 13 European countries, we document firms' cash-flow classification choices vary, with about 76, 60, and 57% of our sample classifying interest paid, interest received, and dividends received, respectively, in OCF. Reported OCF under IFRS tends to exceed what would be reported under U.S. GAAP. We find the main determinants of OCF-enhancing classification choices are capital market incentives and other firm characteristics, including greater likelihood of financial distress, higher leverage, and accessing equity markets more frequently. In analyzing the consequences of reporting flexibility, we find some evidence that the market's assessment of the persistence of operating cash flows and accruals varies with the firm's classification choices and the results of certain OCF prediction models are sensitive to classification choices. 摘要（中文） 《国际财务报告准则》（IFRS）允许管理者在现金流量表中将已付利息、已收利息和已收股利灵活地归类于经营、投资或融资活动之内。相比之下，美国公认会计原则（GAAP）要求将这些项目归类为经营现金流（OCF）。通过研究13个欧洲国家中采用IFRS报告的公司，我们记录了公司的现金流分类选择存在差异，样本中分别约有76%、60%和57%的公司将已付利息、已收利息和已收股利归类于OCF。IFRS下报告的OCF往往超过在美国GAAP下将报告的金额。我们发现，增强OCF的分类选择的主要决定因素是资本市场激励和其他公司特征，包括财务困境可能性更大、杠杆更高以及更频繁地进入股权市场。在分析报告灵活性的后果时，我们发现一些证据表明，市场对经营现金流和应计项目持续性的评估随公司的分类选择而变化，且某些OCF预测模型的结果对分类选择敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Duration-Driven Returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a duration-based explanation for the premia on major equity factors, including value, profitability, investment, low-risk, and payout factors. Raw markdown: gormsen-2023-duration-driven-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Gormsen, NJ, Lazarus, E…
pages.text: Duration-Driven Returns (2023) Paper claim — We propose a duration-based explanation for the premia on major equity factors, including value, profitability, investment, low-risk, and payout factors. Raw markdown: gormsen-2023-duration-driven-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Gormsen, NJ, Lazarus, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13216 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We propose a duration-based explanation for the premia on major equity factors, including value, profitability, investment, low-risk, and payout factors. These factors invest in firms that earn most of their cash flows in the near future and could therefore be driven by a premium on near-future cash flows. We test this hypothesis using a novel data set of single-stock dividend futures, which are claims on dividends of individual firms. Consistent with our hypothesis, the expected Capital Asset Pricing Model alpha on individual cash flows decreases in maturity within a firm, and the alpha is not related to the above characteristics when controlling for maturity. 摘要（中文） 我们对主要股票因子（包括价值、盈利能力、投资、低风险和派现因子）的溢价提出了一种基于久期（duration）的解释。这些因子投资于那些大部分现金流在近期获得的企业，因此可能由近期现金流的溢价驱动。我们使用一个由单只股票股利期货（即对单个企业股利的求偿权）构成的新颖数据集来检验这一假设。与我们的假设一致，在一家企业内部，单个现金流的预期资本资产定价模型阿尔法随到期期限的增加而下降，且在控制到期期限后，阿尔法与上述特征无关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The intraday speed of stock price adjustment to major dividend changes: Bid-ask bounce and order flow imbalances
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the intraday stock price reaction to substantial shifts in dividend policy, The results indicate the price reaction to be slower than that previously found by Patell and Wolfson (1984) and closer to that found with earnings announcements by…
pages.text: The intraday speed of stock price adjustment to major dividend changes: Bid-ask bounce and order flow imbalances (1996) Paper claim — This paper examines the intraday stock price reaction to substantial shifts in dividend policy, The results indicate the price reaction to be slower than that previously found by Patell and Wolfson (1984) and closer to that found with earnings announcements by Woodruff and Senchack (1988). Raw markdown: gosnell-1996-the-intraday-speed-of-stock-price-adjustment-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Gosnell, TF, Keown, AJ, Pinkerton, JM Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00106-5 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines the intraday stock price reaction to substantial shifts in dividend policy, The results indicate the price reaction to be slower than that previously found by Patell and Wolfson (1984) and closer to that found with earnings announcements by Woodruff and Senchack (1988). Possible order flow imbalances are examined by looking at the proximity of transaction prices to contemporaneous bid and ask quotes. While order flow imbalances are evident for bad news announcements, this is not the case for the dividend increase sample. This is interpreted as evidence that the price reaction to major dividend increases are in general anticipated. Fifteen minute holding period returns are computed to measure the movement of equilibrium prices during the announcement period. Results show a rapid adjustment of prices to positive announcements with adjustment to negative announcements taking up to 75 minutes. Finally, fifteen minute lagged bid-ask returns are calculated to determine whether an investor could respond to the announcement and earn positive returns. These results are found to be dependent on the transaction cost assumptions being made. 摘要（中文） 本文考察对股利政策实质性转变的日内股价反应。结果表明，价格反应比Patell和Wolfson（1984）此前发现的要慢，而更接近Woodruff和Senchack（1988）在盈利公告中发现的情形。通过考察交易价格与同期买入价和卖出报价的接近程度，我们检验了可能的订单流失衡。虽然坏消息公告存在明显的订单流失衡，但股利增长样本则不然。这被解读为一种证据，表明对重大股利增长的价格反应通常是被预期到的。我们计算了15分钟的持有期收益，以度量公告期内均衡价格的变动。结果显示价格对正面公告快速调整，而对负面公告的调整则最多需要75分钟。最后，我们计算了15分钟滞后的买卖价差收益，以确定投资者能否对公告作出反应并赚取正收益。这些结果被发现取决于所做出的交易成本假设。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: DEBT FINANCING UNDER ASYMMETRIC INFORMATION
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze the optimal design of debt maturity, coupon payments, and dividend payout restrictions under asymmetric information. Raw markdown: goswami-1995-debt-financing-under-asymmetric-information Bibliographic Record Authors: GOSWAMI, G, NOE, T, REBELLO, M…
pages.text: DEBT FINANCING UNDER ASYMMETRIC INFORMATION (1995) Paper claim — We analyze the optimal design of debt maturity, coupon payments, and dividend payout restrictions under asymmetric information. Raw markdown: goswami-1995-debt-financing-under-asymmetric-information Bibliographic Record Authors: GOSWAMI, G, NOE, T, REBELLO, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1995 DOI: 10.2307/2329422 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We analyze the optimal design of debt maturity, coupon payments, and dividend payout restrictions under asymmetric information. We show that, if the asymmetry of information is concentrated around long-term cash flows, firms finance with coupon-bearing long-term debt that partially restricts dividend payments. If the asymmetry of information is concentrated around near-term cash flows and there exists considerable refinancing risk, firms finance with coupon-bearing long-term debt that does not restrict dividend payments. Finally, if the asymmetry of information is uniformly distributed across dates, firms finance with short-term debt. 摘要（中文） 我们分析了非对称信息下债务期限、票息支付和股利支付限制的最优设计。我们表明，如果信息不对称集中于长期现金流，企业会以附息长期债务融资，且该债务部分限制股利支付。如果信息不对称集中于近期现金流且存在相当大的再融资风险，企业会以附息长期债务融资，且该债务不限制股利支付。最后，如果信息不对称在各时点上均匀分布，企业会以短期债务融资。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Payout policy, taxes, and the relation between returns and the bid-ask spread
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent evidence demonstrates that corporate payout policy has shifted from the nearly exclusive use of dividend payout to the inclusion of stock repurchase, primarily through open markets. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Payout policy, taxes, and the relation between returns and the bid-ask spread (2006) Paper claim — Recent evidence demonstrates that corporate payout policy has shifted from the nearly exclusive use of dividend payout to the inclusion of stock repurchase, primarily through open markets. Raw markdown: gottesman-2006-payout-policy-taxes-and-the-relation-between-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Gottesman, AA, Jacoby, G Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2004.12.003 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, stock repurchase) Abstract Recent evidence demonstrates that corporate payout policy has shifted from the nearly exclusive use of dividend payout to the inclusion of stock repurchase, primarily through open markets. This trend has been attributed to the tax advantages associated with repurchase relative to dividends. In this paper, we introduce personal taxation and stock repurchase to reexamine the relation between returns and the bid-ask spread. Our model provides insight into the nature of this relation. Tests performed using NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ data provide empirical support of our theoretical conclusions. We conclude that the firm's choice of payout policy influences the relation between returns and spreads. (c) 2005 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 近期证据表明，企业支付政策已经从几乎完全使用股利支付转变为纳入股票回购，主要通过公开市场进行。这一趋势被归因于回购相对于股利的税收优势。本文引入个人税收和股票回购，重新考察收益与买卖价差之间的关系。我们的模型为这一关系的本质提供了洞见。使用纽交所、美交所和纳斯达克数据进行的检验为我们的理论结论提供了实证支持。我们的结论是，企业对支付政策的选择影响收益与价差之间的关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Activist directors: determinants and consequences
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Hedge fund activism campaigns that result in activist directors being appointed to target firm boards are associated with increased payouts, higher CEO turnover, greater divestiture, and lower investment; affiliated activist directors are particularly effective at…
pages.text: Activist directors: determinants and consequences (2024) Paper claim — Hedge fund activism campaigns that result in activist directors being appointed to target firm boards are associated with increased payouts, higher CEO turnover, greater divestiture, and lower investment; affiliated activist directors are particularly effective at raising payout by nearly 15% of EBITDA and improving ROA over five subsequent years. Raw markdown: gow-2024-activist-directors-determinants-and-consequences Bibliographic Record Authors: Gow, Ian D.; Shin, Sa-Pyung Sean; Srinivasan, Suraj Journal: Review of Accounting Studies Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-023-09767-8 Abstract This paper examines determinants and consequences of hedge fund activism, focusing on activist directors, i.e., directors appointed in response to activist demands. Using a sample of 3,259 activism events from 2004 to 2016, we identify 1,623 activist directors. Compared to other newly appointed directors, these activist directors tend to be younger, more likely to have finance and accounting skills, and less likely to be female. We find that the likelihood of acquiring board representation is associated with weaker market performance or lower payout ratios. Following the appointment of an activist director, we find evidence of increased divestiture, decreased acquisition activity, higher CEO turnover, increased leverage, higher payouts, and reduced investment. Our analysis of data on activists' stated demands also shows that activist directors are effective in helping activists achieve their goals, consistent with the notion that board representation is an important mechanism for activists to bring about desired changes. Finally, we find positive abnormal returns of 1% when an activist director is appointed and a 3.2%-point increase in return on assets over the subsequent five years with an activist-affiliated director. Key Findings Activists are more likely to target firms with lower dividend payout ratios and poorer stock market performance, and affiliated activist directors are more likely at firms with lower payout specifically. Following activist director appointment, payout (dividends + repurchases) increases by an economically significant amount — nearly 15% of EBITDA for affiliated director events — alongside reduced capex and R&D, higher leverage, and greater divestiture. Activist directors tend to have finance and accounting skills (48% versus 34% for other directors) and are younger; affiliated directors are most distinctive, averaging 51 years old and only 1% female. Activists with board representation hold the target stock for a median of 3.2 years (affiliated) versus 2.2 years for other activism, contradicting the short-termism critique. Operational performance improves after activism: ROA increases by 1.8+ percentage points over five years, with an additional 1.5–3.2 percentage-point gain for affiliated director appointments. pages.title: Why do privatized firms pay higher dividends?

pages.text: Why do privatized firms pay higher dividends? (2020) Paper claim — We examine state income and reputation incentives to account for the high dividends of privatized firms. Raw markdown: goyal-2020-why-do-privatized-firms-pay-higher-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Goyal, A, Jategaonkar, SP, Muckley, CB Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.101493 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, rule)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We examine state income and reputation incentives to account for the high dividends of privatized firms. Consistent with these agency-cost based incentives, we show strong and robust evidence that the extent of state ownership is positively related to corporate dividends. We distinguish between the empirical importance of these incentives using variation in the rule of law to protect minority shareholders, the fiscal deficit and the political orientation of the state. Our findings show that an incentive to enhance the state's reputation with minority shareholders can account for the high dividends of privatized firms. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了国家收入和声誉激励，以解释私有化企业的高股利。与这些基于代理成本的激励相一致，我们展示了强有力且稳健的证据表明，国家所有权的程度与公司股利正相关。我们利用保护中小股东的法治程度、财政赤字以及国家的政治取向的差异，来区分这些激励的实证重要性。我们的发现表明，提升国家在中小股东中声誉的激励，能够解释私有化企业的高股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Taxes and corporate finance: A review
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article reviews tax research related to domestic and multinational capital structure, payout policy, compensation policy, risk management, and organizational form. Raw markdown: graham-2003-taxes-and-corporate-finance-a-review Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Taxes and corporate finance: A review (2003) Paper claim — This article reviews tax research related to domestic and multinational capital structure, payout policy, compensation policy, risk management, and organizational form. Raw markdown: graham-2003-taxes-and-corporate-finance-a-review Bibliographic Record Authors: Graham, JR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhg033 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(payout) Abstract This article reviews tax research related to domestic and multinational capital structure, payout policy, compensation policy, risk management, and organizational form. For each topic, the theoretical arguments explaining how taxes can affect corporate decision making and firm value are reviewed, followed by a summary of the related empirical evidence and a discussion of unresolved issues. Tax research generally supports the hypothesis that high tax rate firms pursue policies that provide tax benefits. Many issues remain unresolved, however, including understanding whether tax effects are of first-order importance, why firms do not pursue tax benefits more aggressively, and whether corporate actions are affected by investor-level taxes. 摘要（中文） 本文回顾了与国内和跨国资本结构、支付政策、薪酬政策、风险管理和组织形式相关的税收研究。对于每个主题，本文回顾了解释税收如何影响公司决策和公司价值的理论论点，随后总结了相关的实证证据并讨论了未决问题。税收研究总体上支持以下假设：高税率公司追求提供税收收益的政策。然而，许多问题仍未解决，包括理解税收效应是否具有一阶重要性、为何公司不更积极地追求税收收益，以及公司行为是否受投资者层面税收的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Presidential Address: Corporate Finance and Reality
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper uses surveys to document CFO perspectives on corporate planning, investment, capital structure, payout, and shareholder versus stakeholder focus. Raw markdown: graham-2022-presidential-address-corporate-finance-and-reality Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Presidential Address: Corporate Finance and Reality (2022) Paper claim — This paper uses surveys to document CFO perspectives on corporate planning, investment, capital structure, payout, and shareholder versus stakeholder focus. Raw markdown: graham-2022-presidential-address-corporate-finance-and-reality Bibliographic Record Authors: Graham, JR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.13161 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, rule)；股利政策(payout) Abstract This paper uses surveys to document CFO perspectives on corporate planning, investment, capital structure, payout, and shareholder versus stakeholder focus. Comparing policy decisions today to those 20 years ago, I find that companies employ decision rules that are conservative, sticky, and geared to time the market; rely on internal forecasts that are miscalibrated and considered reliable only two years ahead; and emphasize corporate objectives that focus increasingly on stakeholders and revenues. These practice of corporate finance themes can discipline academic models toward better explaining outcomes. Models of satisficing decision-making or costly managerial biases align with many of the themes. 摘要（中文） 本文利用调查记录了CFO对公司规划、投资、资本结构、派现以及股东导向与利益相关者导向的看法。将当今的政策决策与20年前进行比较，我发现公司采用的决策规则是保守的、黏性的且倾向于择时市场；依赖内部预测，而这些预测校准不佳且仅在提前两年时被认为可靠；并且日益强调聚焦于利益相关者和收入的公司目标。这些公司金融实践主题可以约束学术模型，使其更好地解释实际结果。满意化决策模型或代价高昂的管理层偏差模型与许多此类主题相吻合。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Ex-day behavior with dividend preference and limitations to short-term arbitrage: the case of Swedish lottery bonds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Swedish lottery bonds offer a unique opportunity to study ex-day effects in an environment where cash distributions are tax-advantaged relative to capital gains. Raw markdown: green-1999-ex-day-behavior-with-dividend-preference-and-limitations Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Ex-day behavior with dividend preference and limitations to short-term arbitrage: the case of Swedish lottery bonds (1999) Paper claim — Swedish lottery bonds offer a unique opportunity to study ex-day effects in an environment where cash distributions are tax-advantaged relative to capital gains. Raw markdown: green-1999-ex-day-behavior-with-dividend-preference-and-limitations Bibliographic Record Authors: Green, RC, Rydqvist, K Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(99)00019-7 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Swedish lottery bonds offer a unique opportunity to study ex-day effects in an environment where cash distributions are tax-advantaged relative to capital gains. Thus, in the lottery bond market, we observe a reversal of the preference for capital gains that researchers have cited as an explanation for the ex-day behavior of U.S. equities. Further, in this market there are barriers to short-term arbitrage when prices do reflect the tax preferences of individual investors. We find the bonds are priced around the ex-day to reflect differential tax rates on income and capital gains consistent with the prevailing tax regimes. The bonds consistently experience negative returns over the coupon payment period, and in fact often sell at negative yields prior to the cash distribution, as one would expect given tax-motivated trading between high-tax investors, who buy prior to the distribution, and low-tax investors, who buy after the distribution. (C) 1999 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 瑞典彩票债券提供了一个独特的机会，可以在一个现金分配相对于资本利得享有税收优势的环境中研究除息日效应。因此，在彩票债券市场中，我们观察到对资本利得偏好的逆转，而研究者曾将这种对资本利得的偏好引作对美国股票除息日行为的一种解释。此外，在这个市场中，当价格确实反映个人投资者的税收偏好时，存在对短期套利的障碍。我们发现，除息日前后债券的定价反映了收入和资本利得的差别税率，这与当时的税收制度相一致。债券在票息支付期内一贯经历负收益，事实上在现金分配之前常常以负收益率出售，考虑到高税投资者（在分配前买入）与低税投资者（在分配后买入）之间由税收驱动的交易，这正是人们所预期的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The personal-tax advantages of equity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We value a firm that pays its cash flows to equity through share repurchases in a dynamic environment where personal taxes are paid on capital gains upon realization. Raw markdown: green-2003-the-personal-tax-advantages-of-equity Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: The personal-tax advantages of equity (2003) Paper claim — We value a firm that pays its cash flows to equity through share repurchases in a dynamic environment where personal taxes are paid on capital gains upon realization. Raw markdown: green-2003-the-personal-tax-advantages-of-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Green, RC, Hollifield, B Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(02)00246-5 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow, tradeoff) Abstract We value a firm that pays its cash flows to equity through share repurchases in a dynamic environment where personal taxes are paid on capital gains upon realization. The cost of capital is reduced by approximately 0.8% through the use of repurchases relative to dividends. We use the empirical distribution of pre-tax free cash flows in Fama and French (1999) to evaluate the tradeoffs between the costs of financial distress, the personal-tax advantages of equity, and the corporate-tax advantage to debt. The optimal capital structure is interior with a 3% bankruptcy cost. (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们对一家通过股份回购向股权支付其现金流的企业进行估值，其所处的动态环境中，个人在资本利得实现时缴纳个人税。相对于股利，使用回购可使资本成本降低约0.8%。我们使用法玛和弗伦奇（Fama and French，1999）中税前自由现金流的经验分布，来评估财务困境成本、股权的个人税收优势与债务的公司税收优势之间的权衡。在3%的破产成本下，最优资本结构是内点解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Share Issuance and Factor Timing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that characteristics of stock issuers can be used to forecast important common factors in stocks' returns such as those associated with book-to-market, size, and industry. Raw markdown: greenwood-2012-share-issuance-and-factor-timing Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Share Issuance and Factor Timing (2012) Paper claim — We show that characteristics of stock issuers can be used to forecast important common factors in stocks' returns such as those associated with book-to-market, size, and industry. Raw markdown: greenwood-2012-share-issuance-and-factor-timing Bibliographic Record Authors: Greenwood, R, Hanson, SG Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2012.01730.x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(payout) Abstract We show that characteristics of stock issuers can be used to forecast important common factors in stocks' returns such as those associated with book-to-market, size, and industry. Specifically, we use differences between the attributes of stock issuers and repurchasers to forecast characteristic-related factor returns. For example, we show that large firms underperform after years when issuing firms are large relative to repurchasing firms. While our strongest results are for portfolios based on book-to-market (i.e., HML), size (i.e., SMB), and industry, our approach is also useful for forecasting factor returns associated with distress, payout policy, and profitability. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，股票发行者的特征可用于预测股票收益中重要的共同因子，例如与账面市值比、规模和行业相关的因子。具体而言，我们使用股票发行者与回购者属性之间的差异来预测与特征相关的因子收益。例如，我们表明当发行公司相对于回购公司规模较大的年份之后，大公司表现不佳。虽然我们最强的结果是针对基于账面市值比（即HML）、规模（即SMB）和行业的组合，但我们的方法对于预测与财务困境、支付政策和盈利能力相关的因子收益也很有用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Institutional holdings and payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the relation between institutional holdings and payout policy in U.S. Raw markdown: grinstein-2005-institutional-holdings-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Grinstein, Y, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI:…
pages.text: Institutional holdings and payout policy (2005) Paper claim — We examine the relation between institutional holdings and payout policy in U.S. Raw markdown: grinstein-2005-institutional-holdings-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Grinstein, Y, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2005.00765.x Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine the relation between institutional holdings and payout policy in U.S. public firms. We find that payout policy affects institutional holdings. Institutions avoid firms that do not pay dividends. However, among dividend-paying firms they prefer firms that pay fewer dividends. Our evidence indicates that institutions prefer firms that repurchase shares, and regular repurchasers over nonregular repurchasers. Higher institutional holdings or a concentration of holdings do not cause firms to increase their dividends, their repurchases, or their total payout. Our results do not support models that predict that high dividends attract institutional clientele, or models that predict that institutions cause firms to increase payout. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了美国上市公司机构持股与支付政策之间的关系。我们发现支付政策会影响机构持股。机构回避不派发股利的企业。然而，在派发股利的企业中，它们更偏好派发较少股利的企业。我们的证据表明，机构偏好回购股份的企业，且相较于非经常性回购者更偏好经常性回购者。较高的机构持股或持股集中度并不会促使企业增加其股利、回购或总支付。我们的结果不支持那些预测高股利会吸引机构客户群的模型，也不支持那些预测机构会促使企业增加支付的模型。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: What to expect when everyone is expecting: Self-fulfilling expectations and asset-pricing puzzles
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study an economy without bubbles in which expectations about future discount rates can become self-fulfilling because asset valuations redistribute wealth across different investor cohorts. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: What to expect when everyone is expecting: Self-fulfilling expectations and asset-pricing puzzles (2021) Paper claim — We study an economy without bubbles in which expectations about future discount rates can become self-fulfilling because asset valuations redistribute wealth across different investor cohorts. Raw markdown: grleanu-2021-what-to-expect-when-everyone-is-expecting-self Bibliographic Record Authors: Gârleanu, N, Panageas, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.10.007 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We study an economy without bubbles in which expectations about future discount rates can become self-fulfilling because asset valuations redistribute wealth across different investor cohorts. For such redistribution to take place, the wealth of arriving and existing cohorts must react differently to discount rates, and in addition only the existing agents are marginal in financial markets. The self-fulfilling nature of discount rate expectations means that the economy can address several well-documented empirical asset-pricing facts (excessive volatility, return predictability, low interest rate level and volatility), while all real quantities (aggregate consumption and dividend growth) are smooth. (C) 2020 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们研究一个不存在泡沫的经济体，在其中关于未来贴现率的预期能够自我实现，因为资产估值会在不同投资者世代之间重新分配财富。要发生这种再分配，新到来世代和现存世代的财富必须对贴现率做出不同反应，此外只有现存的行为主体才是金融市场上的边际参与者。贴现率预期的自我实现性质意味着，该经济体能够解释若干已被充分记录的实证资产定价事实（过度波动性、收益可预测性、低利率水平和波动性），而所有实际数量（总量消费和股利增长）都是平滑的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends, share repurchases, and the substitution hypothesis
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that repurchases have not only became an important form of payout for U.S. Raw markdown: grullon-2002-dividends-share-repurchases-and-the-substitution-hypothesis Bibliographic Record Authors: Grullon, G, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2002…
pages.text: Dividends, share repurchases, and the substitution hypothesis (2002) Paper claim — We show that repurchases have not only became an important form of payout for U.S. Raw markdown: grullon-2002-dividends-share-repurchases-and-the-substitution-hypothesis Bibliographic Record Authors: Grullon, G, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00474 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We show that repurchases have not only became an important form of payout for U.S. corporations, but also that firms finance their share repurchases with funds that otherwise would have been used to increase dividends. We find that young firms have a higher propensity to pay cash through repurchases than they did in the past and that repurchases have become the preferred form of initiating a cash payout. Although large, established firms have generally not cut their dividends, they also show a higher propensity to pay out cash through repurchases. These findings indicate that firms have gradually substituted repurchases for dividends. Our results also suggest that before 1983, regulatory constraints inhibited firms from aggressively repurchasing shares. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，回购不仅已成为美国企业一种重要的支付形式，而且企业以本可用于增加股利的资金为其股份回购提供资金。我们发现，与过去相比，年轻企业通过回购支付现金的倾向更高，且回购已成为启动现金支付的首选形式。虽然规模大、成立已久的企业通常没有削减其股利，但它们也表现出更高的通过回购支付现金的倾向。这些发现表明，企业已逐渐用回购替代股利。我们的结果还表明，在1983年之前，监管约束抑制了企业积极回购股份。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The information content of share repurchase programs
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Contrary to the implications of many payout theories, we find that announcements of open-market share repurchase programs are not followed by an increase in operating performance. Raw markdown: grullon-2004-the-information-content-of-share-repurchase-programs…
pages.text: The information content of share repurchase programs (2004) Paper claim — Contrary to the implications of many payout theories, we find that announcements of open-market share repurchase programs are not followed by an increase in operating performance. Raw markdown: grullon-2004-the-information-content-of-share-repurchase-programs Bibliographic Record Authors: Grullon, G, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2004.00645.x Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout, share repurchase) Abstract Contrary to the implications of many payout theories, we find that announcements of open-market share repurchase programs are not followed by an increase in operating performance. However, we find that repurchasing firms experience a significant reduction in systematic risk and cost of capital relative to non-repurchasing firms. Further, consistent with the free cash-flow hypothesis, we find that the market reaction to share repurchase announcements is more positive among those firms that are more likely to overinvest. Finally, we find evidence to indicate that investors under-react to repurchase announcements because they initially underestimate the decline in cost of capital. 摘要（中文） 与许多派现理论的含义相反，我们发现公开市场股份回购计划的公告之后并未伴随经营绩效的提升。然而，我们发现相对于不回购的公司，回购公司经历了系统性风险和资本成本的显著降低。此外，与自由现金流假说相一致，我们发现，在那些更可能过度投资的公司中，市场对股份回购公告的反应更为正面。最后，我们发现证据表明，投资者对回购公告反应不足，因为他们最初低估了资本成本的下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Has the Propensity to Pay Out Declined?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent studies document both a significant decline in firms' propensity to pay dividends and a significant increase in firms' propensity to repurchase shares and issue equity over the past 30 years. Raw markdown: grullon-2011-has-the-propensity-to-pay-out-declined…
pages.text: Has the Propensity to Pay Out Declined? (2011) Paper claim — Recent studies document both a significant decline in firms' propensity to pay dividends and a significant increase in firms' propensity to repurchase shares and issue equity over the past 30 years. Raw markdown: grullon-2011-has-the-propensity-to-pay-out-declined Bibliographic Record Authors: Grullon, G, Paye, B, Underwood, S, Weston, JP Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109010000633 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Recent studies document both a significant decline in firms' propensity to pay dividends and a significant increase in firms' propensity to repurchase shares and issue equity over the past 30 years. In this paper we test whether firms' net cash disbursements to equity holders have declined in a pattern similar to firms' propensity to pay dividends. Contrary to the evidence using dividends, we find no evidence that the conditional propensity to distribute net cash to equity holders has declined over the past 3 decades. Surprisingly, we find that, conditional on firm characteristics, net payout yields have been increasing over time. 摘要（中文） 近期研究记录了在过去30年中公司支付股利的倾向显著下降，同时公司回购股份和发行权益的倾向显著上升。本文检验公司向权益持有人支付的净现金是否以类似于其支付股利倾向的方式下降。与使用股利得出的证据相反，我们没有发现证据表明在过去三十年中向权益持有人分配净现金的条件倾向有所下降。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在给定公司特征的条件下，净派现收益率随时间推移一直在上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Stock market volatility in a heterogeneous information economy (2002) Paper claim — The informational role of prices contributes positively to their variability. Raw markdown: grundy-2002-stock-market-volatility-in-a-heterogeneous-information-economy Bibliographic Record Authors: Grundy, BD, Kim, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2002 DOI: 10.2307/3594993 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract The informational role of prices contributes positively to their variability. In a noisy rational expectations equilibrium, traders rationally respond to price changes by revising their estimates of other traders' private signals and hence their own expectations of future dividends. The resultant shifts in traders' demands amplify any supply shock-induced price changes, We develop an infinite horizon noisy rational expectations model and calibrate, simulate, and test it using U.S. stock market data. The price variability in a heterogeneous information economy is shown to be 20% to 46% higher than in an otherwise equivalent economy in which all signals are publicly announced. 摘要（中文） 价格的信息作用对其变异性有正向贡献。在一个噪声理性预期均衡中，交易者理性地对价格变动作出反应，修正其对其他交易者私有信号的估计，从而修正自身对未来股利的预期。由此产生的交易者需求的变动放大了任何由供给冲击引起的价格变动。我们建立了一个无限视野噪声理性预期模型，并使用美国股票市场数据对其进行校准、模拟和检验。结果表明，异质信息经济中的价格变异性比一个所有信号都公开宣布的其他方面等价的经济高出20%到46%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Why are conversion-forcing call announcements associated with negative wealth effects? (2014) Paper claim — We analyze call announcement returns taking into account two recent developments in the convertible bond market: the inclusion of dividend protection clauses in convertibles' terms, and the high fraction of convertible issues purchased by hedge funds. Raw markdown: grundy-2014-why-are-conversion-forcing-call-announcements-associated-with Bibliographic Record Authors: Grundy, BD, Veld, C, Verwijmeren, P, Zabolotnyuk, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.10.003 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We analyze call announcement returns taking into account two recent developments in the convertible bond market: the inclusion of dividend protection clauses in convertibles' terms, and the high fraction of convertible issues purchased by hedge funds. Calls of dividend-protected convertible bonds are predictable, yet we still observe a negative stock price reaction that cannot be explained by signaling. Greater hedge fund involvement prior to a call means less short selling in response to the call and we document a reduced price reaction. We conclude that price pressure and not signaling underlies the negative announcement effect of convertible bond calls. Crown Copyright (C) 2013 Published by Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们在分析赎回公告收益时，考虑了可转换债券市场中最近的两个发展：在可转债条款中纳入股利保护条款，以及对冲基金购买了很大比例的可转债发行。对具有股利保护的可转换债券的赎回是可预测的，然而我们仍然观察到一种无法用信号理论解释的负向股价反应。赎回前更多的对冲基金参与意味着对赎回响应的卖空更少，我们记录了一种减弱的价格反应。我们得出结论认为，价格压力而非信号是可转换债券赎回负向公告效应的基础。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A theory of corporate financial decisions with liquidity and solvency concerns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies the impact of both liquidity and solvency concerns on corporate finance. Raw markdown: gryglewicz-2011-a-theory-of-corporate-financial-decisions-with-liquidity Bibliographic Record Authors: Gryglewicz, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS…
pages.text: A theory of corporate financial decisions with liquidity and solvency concerns (2011) Paper claim — This paper studies the impact of both liquidity and solvency concerns on corporate finance. Raw markdown: gryglewicz-2011-a-theory-of-corporate-financial-decisions-with-liquidity Bibliographic Record Authors: Gryglewicz, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2010.09.010 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper studies the impact of both liquidity and solvency concerns on corporate finance. I present a tractable model of a firm that optimally chooses capital structure, cash holdings, dividends, and default while facing cash flows with long-term uncertainty and short-term liquidity shocks. The model explains how changes in solvency affect liquidity and also how liquidity concerns affect solvency via capital structure choice. These interactions result in a dynamic cash policy in which cash reserves increase in profitability and are positively correlated with cash flows. The optimal dividend distributions implied by the model are smoothed relative to cash flows. I also find that liquidity concerns lead to a decrease of dispersion of credit spreads. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文研究流动性和偿付能力两方面担忧对公司财务的影响。我提出了一个可处理的企业模型，该企业在面临具有长期不确定性和短期流动性冲击的现金流的同时，最优地选择资本结构、现金持有、股利和违约。该模型解释了偿付能力的变化如何影响流动性，以及流动性担忧如何通过资本结构选择影响偿付能力。这些相互作用导致一种动态现金政策，其中现金储备随盈利能力上升，并与现金流正相关。该模型隐含的最优股利分配相对于现金流是平滑的。我还发现流动性担忧会导致信用利差离散度的下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Cultural Origin and Minority Shareholder Expropriation: Historical Evidence (2024) Paper claim — Can culture explain regional differences in minority shareholder expropriation? Examining regional variation in China, we document that the influence of historical Confucian values persists, despite decades of political movements clamping down on these values, and that these values reduce minority shareholder expropriation in local public firms. Raw markdown: gu-2024-cultural-origin-and-minority-shareholder-expropriation-historical-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Gu, ZH, Sun, W, Zhou, FS Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12517 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(oversight)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract Can culture explain regional differences in minority shareholder expropriation? Examining regional variation in China, we document that the influence of historical Confucian values persists, despite decades of political movements clamping down on these values, and that these values reduce minority shareholder expropriation in local public firms. The effect on minority shareholder expropriation, in part, operates through the establishment of oversight mechanisms (i.e., greater financial reporting quality and dividend payouts) that constrain expropriation. The findings have important implications for understanding the origins of enduring regional differences in minority shareholder expropriation and capital market development. 摘要（中文） 文化能否解释小股东侵占的地区差异？考察中国的地区差异，我们记录到，尽管数十年的政治运动打压了这些价值观，历史上的儒家价值观影响依然持续存在，且这些价值观减少了当地上市公司中的小股东侵占。这种对小股东侵占的效应部分是通过建立约束侵占的监督机制（即更高的财务报告质量和股利支付）来发挥作用的。这些发现对理解小股东侵占持久地区差异的根源以及资本市场发展具有重要意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Curbing stock price crash: The bright side of regulatory fragmentation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Complementing existing research on the inefficiencies of regulatory fragmentation, this study identifies a potential benefit: firms facing greater regulatory fragmentation experience lower stock price crash risk. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Curbing stock price crash: The bright side of regulatory fragmentation (2026) Paper claim — Complementing existing research on the inefficiencies of regulatory fragmentation, this study identifies a potential benefit: firms facing greater regulatory fragmentation experience lower stock price crash risk. Raw markdown: gu-2026-curbing-stock-price-crash-the-bright-side-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Gu, M, Li, DX, Xiong, ZT Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.102950 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, oversight, regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Complementing existing research on the inefficiencies of regulatory fragmentation, this study identifies a potential benefit: firms facing greater regulatory fragmentation experience lower stock price crash risk. Mechanism analyses suggest that such fragmentation enhances financial reporting quality, mitigates stock overpricing, and improves the accuracy of analyst forecasts. Firms subject to regulatory fragmentation also hold more cash and are less likely to pay dividends or repurchase shares. These findings indicate that the reduction in crash risk is associated with improved information disclosure and more conservative financial policies. Consistent with this notion, the effect is more pronounced among firms with high information uncertainty and tight financial constraints. Overall, this study sheds light on the ongoing discussion regarding optimal regulatory oversight schemes. 摘要（中文） 作为对现有关于监管碎片化（regulatory fragmentation）低效性研究的补充，本研究识别出一项潜在益处：面临更大监管碎片化的企业经历更低的股价崩盘风险。机制分析表明，这种碎片化提高了财务报告质量、缓解了股票高估，并改善了分析师预测的准确性。受监管碎片化影响的企业还持有更多现金，且更不可能派发股利或回购股份。这些发现表明，崩盘风险的降低与信息披露的改善和更为保守的财务政策相关。与这一观念一致，该效应在信息不确定性高和融资约束紧的企业中更为显著。总体而言，本研究为关于最优监管监督方案的持续讨论提供了启示。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Managerial Ability and the Shareholder Tax Sensitivity of Dividends (2018) Paper claim — We examine the impact of managerial ability on the shareholder tax sensitivity of dividends. Raw markdown: guan-2018-managerial-ability-and-the-shareholder-tax-sensitivity-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Guan, JXJ, Li, OZ, Ma, JM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109017001004 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, reform)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We examine the impact of managerial ability on the shareholder tax sensitivity of dividends. We find that managerial ability increases the sensitivity of dividends to the dividend tax penalty. In addition, the positive association between managerial ability and the shareholder tax sensitivity of dividends decreases in institutional ownership. Further, managerial ability increases the shareholder tax sensitivity of the substitution of dividends with share repurchases. Finally, evidence from tax reforms reveals that high ability managers are more responsive to a reduction in dividend tax penalty than to an increase. We conclude that managerial ability influences the formation of tax-efficient dividend policies. 摘要（中文） 我们考察经理人能力对股利的股东税收敏感性的影响。我们发现，经理人能力会提高股利对股利税收惩罚的敏感性。此外，经理人能力与股利的股东税收敏感性之间的正向关联随机构持股增加而减弱。进一步地，经理人能力会提高用股份回购替代股利的股东税收敏感性。最后，来自税制改革的证据表明，高能力经理人对股利税收惩罚的下降比对其上升更为敏感。我们的结论是，经理人能力影响税收高效股利政策的形成。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The cash-flow permanence and information content of dividend increases versus repurchases (2000) Paper claim — We hypothesize that firms choose dividend increases to distribute relatively permanent cash-flow shocks and repurchases to distribute more transient shocks. Raw markdown: guay-2000-the-cash-flow-permanence-and-information-content-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Guay, W, Harford, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(00)00062-3 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We hypothesize that firms choose dividend increases to distribute relatively permanent cash-flow shocks and repurchases to distribute more transient shocks. As predicted, we find that post-shock cash flows of dividend increasing firms exhibit less reversion to pre-shock levels compared with repurchasing firms. We also examine whether the stock market uses the announcement of the payout method to update its beliefs about the permanence of cash-flow shocks. Controlling for payout size and the market's expectation about the permanence of the cash-flow shock, the stock price reaction to dividend increases is more positive than the reaction to repurchases. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G35; G32. 摘要（中文） 我们假设，企业选择增加股利来分配相对永久性的现金流冲击，而选择回购来分配更为短暂的冲击。正如预测的那样，我们发现，与回购企业相比，增加股利企业的冲击后现金流对冲击前水平的回复较少。我们还考察了股票市场是否利用支付方式的公告来更新其对现金流冲击永久性的信念。在控制了支付规模以及市场对现金流冲击永久性的预期之后，股价对股利增加的反应比对回购的反应更为正向。JEL分类号：G35；G32。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Political freedom and corporate payouts (2017) Paper claim — We study the effect of a country's political freedom status on corporate payouts around the world. Raw markdown: guedhami-2017-political-freedom-and-corporate-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Guedhami, O, Kwok, CCY, Shao, L Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.02.002 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We study the effect of a country's political freedom status on corporate payouts around the world. In both OLS and two-stage regressions, we find that firms in less free countries pay out more cash, suggesting that low political freedom is associated with a less friendly investment environment. Consistent with this view, we further find that firms reduce payouts when a country's political freedom status improves, while they tend to pay out past excess cash and cut future investment in the face of a deterioration in political freedom. In additional analysis, we also find that firms in less free countries do not pay out cash mainly to ease agency concerns: cash payouts in these countries are more volatile and hence less valuable. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究一个国家的政治自由状况对世界范围内公司派现的影响。在OLS回归和两阶段回归中，我们都发现，较不自由国家的公司支付更多现金，这表明较低的政治自由与一个不太友好的投资环境相关联。与这一观点相一致，我们进一步发现，当一个国家的政治自由状况改善时，公司会减少派现，而当面临政治自由恶化时，它们往往会派出过去的超额现金并削减未来投资。在额外分析中，我们还发现，较不自由国家的公司派出现金主要并非为了缓解代理担忧：这些国家的现金派现更为波动，因而价值更低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Dynamic Adverse Selection: A Theory of Illiquidity, Fire Sales, and Flight to Quality (2014) Paper claim — We develop a dynamic equilibrium model of asset markets with adverse selection. Raw markdown: guerrieri-2014-dynamic-adverse-selection-a-theory-of-illiquidity-fire Bibliographic Record Authors: Guerrieri, V, Shimer, R Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1257/aer.104.7.1875 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We develop a dynamic equilibrium model of asset markets with adverse selection. There exists a unique equilibrium in which better quality assets trade at higher prices but with a lower price-dividend ratio in less liquid markets. Sellers of high-quality assets signal quality by accepting a lower trading probability. We show how the distribution of sellers' private information affects an asset's price and liquidity, how a change in that distribution can cause a fire sale and a flight to quality, and how asset purchase and subsidy programs may raise prices and liquidity and reverse the flight to quality. 摘要（中文） 我们建立了一个具有逆向选择的资产市场动态均衡模型。存在唯一的均衡，其中质量更好的资产以更高的价格交易，但在流动性较差的市场中价格股利比更低。高质量资产的卖方通过接受更低的交易概率来传递质量信号。我们展示了卖方私人信息的分布如何影响资产的价格和流动性，该分布的变化如何导致抛售（fire sale）和向质量的逃逸（flight to quality），以及资产购买和补贴计划如何可能提高价格和流动性并逆转向质量的逃逸。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We exploit institutional features of the U.S. Raw markdown: guerrieri-2024-the-information-content-of-stress-test-announcements Bibliographic Record Authors: Guerrieri, L, Modugno, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI:…
pages.text: The information content of stress test announcements (2024) Paper claim — We exploit institutional features of the U.S. Raw markdown: guerrieri-2024-the-information-content-of-stress-test-announcements Bibliographic Record Authors: Guerrieri, L, Modugno, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107087 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(distribution)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We exploit institutional features of the U.S. bank stress tests to disentangle different types of information garnered by market participants when the stress test results are released. By examining the reaction of different asset prices, we find evidence that market participants value the stress test announcements not only for the information on possible future capital distributions but also for the signals about bank resilience. These results back the use of stress tests by central banks to inform the broader public about the soundness of the banking system. 摘要（中文） 我们利用美国银行压力测试的制度特征，来厘清市场参与者在压力测试结果公布时所获取的不同类型信息。通过考察不同资产价格的反应，我们发现证据表明，市场参与者重视压力测试公告，不仅是因为其中关于未来可能的资本分配的信息，还因为关于银行韧性的信号。这些结果支持了中央银行使用压力测试来向更广泛的公众告知银行体系稳健性的做法。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Corporate governance, dividend payout policy, and the interrelation between dividends, R&D, and capital investment (2003) Paper claim — This paper investigates the relationship between dividends and the ownership and control structure of the firm. Raw markdown: gugler-2003-corporate-governance-dividend-payout-policy-and-the-interrelation Bibliographic Record Authors: Gugler, K Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(02)00258-3 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This paper investigates the relationship between dividends and the ownership and control structure of the firm. For a panel of Austrian firms over the 1991/99 period, we find that state-controlled firms engage in dividend smoothing, while family-controlled firms do not. The latter choose significantly lower target payout levels. Consistently, state-controlled firms are most reluctant and family-controlled firms are least reluctant to cut dividends when cuts are warranted. The dividend behavior of bank- and foreign-controlled firms lies in between state-and family-controlled firms. This is consistent with the expected "ranking" of information asymmetries and managerial agency costs. The above results hold for firms with good investment opportunities. We find that firms with low growth opportunities optimally disgorge cash irrespective of who controls the firm. (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察股利与企业所有权和控制结构之间的关系。对于1991/99年期间的一组奥地利企业面板，我们发现，国家控制的企业进行股利平滑，而家族控制的企业则不然。后者选择显著更低的目标支付水平。与此一致的是，在有理由削减股利时，国家控制的企业最不愿意削减，而家族控制的企业最愿意削减。银行控制和外资控制企业的股利行为介于国家控制和家族控制企业之间。这与信息不对称和经理人代理成本预期的"排序"相一致。上述结果对具有良好投资机会的企业成立。我们发现，增长机会较低的企业无论由谁控制，都会最优地吐出现金。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Ethical Issues Around Share Repurchase Announcements: The Role of Social Capital (2024) Paper claim — We examine whether social capital mitigates managerial opportunism around share repurchase announcements. Raw markdown: gupta-2024-ethical-issues-around-share-repurchase-announcements-the-role Bibliographic Record Authors: Gupta, A, Nemani, A, Raman, K Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-023-05552-4 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract We examine whether social capital mitigates managerial opportunism around share repurchase announcements. We find that firms headquartered in high social capital states are associated with: (i) higher repurchase completion rates, and more so in environments where governance is weak and the potential for misleading investors is high, (ii) a smaller likelihood of information manipulation such as revealing bad news before repurchases, and (iii) lower completion rates when shares are less undervalued. By documenting that firms' external social environments help curb managerial opportunism, our study suggests that the location of headquarters facilitates trustworthiness and affects ethical considerations in corporate announcements. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了社会资本是否缓解围绕股份回购公告的管理者机会主义。我们发现总部位于高社会资本州的公司与以下方面相关：（i）更高的回购完成率，并且在治理薄弱且误导投资者的可能性较高的环境中更为如此；（ii）信息操纵（例如在回购前透露坏消息）的可能性更小；以及（iii）当股份被低估程度较低时更低的完成率。通过记录公司的外部社会环境有助于遏制管理者机会主义，我们的研究表明总部所在地促进了可信度，并影响了公司公告中的伦理考量。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Stickiness and Strategic Pooling
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We argue that dividend stickiness, the tendency of managers to keep dividends unchanged, implies that managers use a partially pooling dividend policy. Raw markdown: guttman-2010-dividend-stickiness-and-strategic-pooling Bibliographic Record Authors: Guttman, I,…
pages.text: Dividend Stickiness and Strategic Pooling (2010) Paper claim — We argue that dividend stickiness, the tendency of managers to keep dividends unchanged, implies that managers use a partially pooling dividend policy. Raw markdown: guttman-2010-dividend-stickiness-and-strategic-pooling Bibliographic Record Authors: Guttman, I, Kadan, O, Kandel, E Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhq096 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We argue that dividend stickiness, the tendency of managers to keep dividends unchanged, implies that managers use a partially pooling dividend policy. We offer a model that demonstrates how such a policy can evolve endogenously in equilibrium. An informed manager who cares about the firm's intrinsic value as well as short-term stock price allocates earnings between investments and dividends. We show that there is a continuum of equilibria in which the dividend is constant for a range of realized earnings. Compared with the standard separating equilibrium, this partial pooling behavior induces higher firm value and lower underinvestment. We offer new empirical implications relating the pooling nature of dividend stickiness to the information environment of the firm, dividend prediction models, managerial incentives, and investment. 摘要（中文） 我们认为，股利粘性（即管理者倾向于保持股利不变）意味着管理者使用一种部分混同的股利政策。我们提供了一个模型，展示这样一种政策如何能在均衡中内生地演化出来。一位既关心企业内在价值又关心短期股价的知情管理者，在投资和股利之间分配盈利。我们表明，存在一个连续的均衡区间，在其中股利对于某一区间的实现盈利保持不变。与标准的分离均衡相比，这种部分混同行为诱导出更高的企业价值和更低的投资不足。我们提出了将股利粘性的混同性质与企业信息环境、股利预测模型、管理者激励和投资相联系的新经验含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Payouts and Information Shocks
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine changes in firms' dividend payouts following an exogenous shock to the information asymmetry problem between managers and investors. Raw markdown: hail-2014-dividend-payouts-and-information-shocks Bibliographic Record Authors: Hail, L, Tahoun, A, Wang, C…
pages.text: Dividend Payouts and Information Shocks (2014) Paper claim — We examine changes in firms' dividend payouts following an exogenous shock to the information asymmetry problem between managers and investors. Raw markdown: hail-2014-dividend-payouts-and-information-shocks Bibliographic Record Authors: Hail, L, Tahoun, A, Wang, C Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12040 Relevance score: 17.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, governance, law, regulat)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow, information asymmetry, overinvestment) Abstract We examine changes in firms' dividend payouts following an exogenous shock to the information asymmetry problem between managers and investors. Agency theories predict a decrease in dividend payments to the extent that improved public information lowers managers' need to convey their commitment to avoid overinvestment via costly dividend payouts. Conversely, dividends could increase if minority investors are in a better position to extract cash dividends. We test these predictions by analyzing the dividend payment behavior of a global sample of firms around the mandatory adoption of IFRS and the initial enforcement of new insider trading laws. Both events serve as proxies for a general improvement of the information environment and, hence, the corporate governance structure in the economy. We find that, following the two events, firms are less likely to pay (increase) dividends, but more likely to cut (stop) such payments. The changes occur around the time of the informational shock, and only in countries and for firms subject to the regulatory change. They are more pronounced when the inherent agency issues or the informational shocks are stronger. We further find that the information content of dividends decreases after the events. The results highlight the importance of the agency costs of free cash flows (and changes therein) for shaping firms' payout policies. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了在管理者与投资者之间信息不对称问题遭遇一次外生冲击之后，企业股利支付的变化。代理理论预测，股利支付会下降，因为公共信息的改善降低了管理者通过成本高昂的股利支付来传达其避免过度投资的承诺的必要性。相反，如果中小投资者处于更有利的地位以攫取现金股利，则股利可能会上升。我们通过分析全球样本企业在强制采用国际财务报告准则（IFRS）以及新内幕交易法初次执行前后的股利支付行为来检验这些预测。这两个事件都可作为经济体中信息环境总体改善、进而公司治理结构改善的代理变量。我们发现，在这两个事件之后，企业支付（增加）股利的可能性降低，但削减（停止）此类支付的可能性上升。这些变化发生在信息冲击前后，且仅出现在受监管变化影响的国家和企业中。当内在代理问题或信息冲击更强时，这些变化更为显著。我们进一步发现，事件之后股利的信息含量下降。研究结果凸显了自由现金流的代理成本（及其变化）在塑造企业支付政策中的重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do dividends convey information about future earnings?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Yes. Raw markdown: ham-2020-do-dividends-convey-information-about-future-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Ham, CG, Kaplan, ZR, Leary, MT Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2019.10.006 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched…
pages.text: Do dividends convey information about future earnings? (2020) Paper claim — Yes. Raw markdown: ham-2020-do-dividends-convey-information-about-future-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Ham, CG, Kaplan, ZR, Leary, MT Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2019.10.006 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, signal) Abstract Yes. We show that dividend changes contain information about highly persistent changes in future economic income. Three methodological differences lead us to different conclusions from the extant literature: (i) we use an "event window approach" to cleanly delineate earnings after dividend changes from those before, (ii) we use alternative earnings measures to control for endogenous investment and asset write-downs surrounding dividend changes, and (iii) we control for the nonlinear relation between dividend changes and market reactions. Our results suggest dividend announcement returns reflect information about the level of permanent earnings, though the timing of the information content is difficult to reconcile with traditional signaling models. (C) 2019 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 会的。我们表明，股利变动包含关于未来经济收益高度持续性变化的信息。三点方法上的差异使我们得出了不同于现有文献的结论：(i) 我们采用一种"事件窗口方法"来清晰地划分股利变动之后与之前的盈余；(ii) 我们使用替代性盈余度量指标来控制股利变动前后的内生性投资和资产减记；(iii) 我们控制了股利变动与市场反应之间的非线性关系。我们的结果表明，股利公告回报反映了关于永久性盈余水平的信息，不过其信息含量的时点难以与传统信号模型相调和。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Attention to dividends, inattention to earnings?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine whether dividends serve as substitutes or complements to accounting information in firm valuation. Raw markdown: ham-2023-attention-to-dividends-inattention-to-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Ham, CG, Kaplan, ZR, Utke, S Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: Attention to dividends, inattention to earnings? (2023) Paper claim — We examine whether dividends serve as substitutes or complements to accounting information in firm valuation. Raw markdown: ham-2023-attention-to-dividends-inattention-to-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Ham, CG, Kaplan, ZR, Utke, S Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-021-09642-4 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal, substitut) Abstract We examine whether dividends serve as substitutes or complements to accounting information in firm valuation. Consistent with dividends substituting for earnings information, we find that dividend paying firms have 11%-15% lower earnings response coefficients (ERCs) than non-payers. We find more substitution when the dividend provides a stronger signal of permanent earnings: when the firm is less likely to cut the dividend, when the firm is likely to fund the dividend out of earnings rather than cash reserves, or when the dividend is larger. We then show that dividend payers have lower absolute returns, less trading volume, and fewer analyst forecasts at the earnings announcement (EA), suggesting that dividend payers attract less attention to their less informative EAs. Finally, we show that the lower EA attention translates into less earnings management and fewer earnings-related disclosures for dividend payers relative to non-payers. Collectively, this evidence suggests that dividends supply information about permanent earnings and, although costly, could be an efficient way for some firms to satisfy investors' demand for earnings information. 摘要（中文） 我们考察股利在企业估值中是充当会计信息的替代品还是补充。与股利替代盈利信息相一致，我们发现派息企业的盈利反应系数（ERCs）比不派息企业低11%—15%。当股利提供关于永久性盈利的更强信号时，我们发现更多的替代作用：即当企业削减股利的可能性较低时、当企业可能以盈利而非现金储备来支付股利时，或当股利较大时。随后我们表明，派息企业在盈余公告（EA）时的绝对收益较低、成交量较少、分析师预测较少，这表明派息企业对其信息含量较低的盈余公告吸引了较少的关注。最后，我们表明，相对于不派息企业，较低的盈余公告关注度转化为派息企业更少的盈余管理和更少的盈利相关披露。综合来看，这一证据表明股利提供了关于永久性盈利的信息，尽管代价高昂，但对某些企业而言，这可能是满足投资者对盈利信息需求的一种有效方式。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
