pages.title: Do dividends convey information about future earnings?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using an event-window approach rather than fiscal-year aggregation, dividend changes do convey highly persistent information about future economic income for at least three years, reversing the prior consensus; the key methodological driver is cleanly separating…
pages.text: Do dividends convey information about future earnings? (2020) Paper claim — Using an event-window approach rather than fiscal-year aggregation, dividend changes do convey highly persistent information about future economic income for at least three years, reversing the prior consensus; the key methodological driver is cleanly separating post-dividend earnings from pre-dividend earnings. Raw markdown: ham-do-dividends-convey-information-about-future-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Ham, Charles G.; Kaplan, Zachary R.; Leary, Mark T. Journal: Journal of Financial Economics Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2019.10.006 Abstract Yes. We show that dividend changes contain information about highly persistent changes in future economic income. Three methodological differences lead us to different conclusions from the extant literature: (i) we use an "event window approach" to cleanly delineate earnings after dividend changes from those before, (ii) we use alternative earnings measures to control for endogenous investment and asset write-downs surrounding dividend changes, and (iii) we control for the nonlinear relation between dividend changes and market reactions. Our results suggest dividend announcement returns reflect information about the level of permanent earnings, though the timing of the information content is difficult to reconcile with traditional signaling models. Key Findings Event window vs. fiscal year methodology is decisive: the fiscal year approach produces no evidence of earnings information content; the event window approach reveals highly significant positive information content (β = 0.025 at year 1, 0.018 at years 2–3). Dividend changes predict persistent shifts in the level of earnings for at least three years — consistent with a move to a new permanent earnings level — not merely transitory earnings changes. Apparent attenuation of information content in prior literature arises from endogenous investment and asset write-downs being embedded in net income; gross profit, which excludes these accelerated expenses, shows growing information content across the horizon. Very large dividend increases have lower persistence than moderate increases, as firms making outsized increases have more volatile dividend histories and are nearly four times more likely to subsequently cut the dividend; using percentile-ranked or market-implied dividend news restores estimated persistence. The earnings information in dividend announcements is large enough to explain market reactions: a 1% increase in announcement returns corresponds to an earnings increase of ~0.1% of market value, consistent with the average price-to-earnings ratio of ~10×. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Stocks that initiate dividends tend to comove more with other dividend-paying stocks and comove less with non-dividend payers. Raw markdown: hameed-2019-preference-for-dividends-and-return-comovement Bibliographic Record Authors: Hameed, A, Xie, J Journal: JOURNAL…
pages.text: Preference for dividends and return comovement (2019) Paper claim — Stocks that initiate dividends tend to comove more with other dividend-paying stocks and comove less with non-dividend payers. Raw markdown: hameed-2019-preference-for-dividends-and-return-comovement Bibliographic Record Authors: Hameed, A, Xie, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2018.09.012 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract Stocks that initiate dividends tend to comove more with other dividend-paying stocks and comove less with non-dividend payers. This is also true for: (a) dividend initiations that are motivated by the exogenous 2003 dividend tax cut; and (b) the cash dividend share class of Citizens Utilities (relative to its stock dividend class). We find that flows to dividend prone (averse) mutual funds increase the comovement among dividend-paying (non dividend paying) stocks. Overall, the evidence supports the proposition that the trading of pro-dividend (dividend-averse) clienteles induces an extra factor in dividend payers (non payers), beyond those associated with changes in common factors. (C) 2018 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 开始派发股利的股票往往与其他派发股利的股票共同变动更多，而与不派发股利的股票共同变动更少。以下情形同样如此：（a）由外生的2003年股利减税所驱动的股利发起；以及（b）Citizens Utilities的现金股利股票类别（相对于其股票股利类别）。我们发现，流入偏好股利（厌恶股利）共同基金的资金增加了派发股利（不派发股利）股票之间的共同变动。总体而言，证据支持这样一个命题：偏好股利（厌恶股利）投资者群体的交易在股利派发者（不派发者）中引入了一个额外因子，超出了与共同因子变化相关的部分。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates whether investor-level taxes affect corporate payout policy decisions. Raw markdown: hanlon-2014-what-do-firms-do-when-dividend-tax-rates Bibliographic Record Authors: Hanlon, M, Hoopes, JL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2014…
pages.text: What do firms do when dividend tax rates change? An examination of alternative payout responses (2014) Paper claim — This paper investigates whether investor-level taxes affect corporate payout policy decisions. Raw markdown: hanlon-2014-what-do-firms-do-when-dividend-tax-rates Bibliographic Record Authors: Hanlon, M, Hoopes, JL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2014.06.004 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper investigates whether investor-level taxes affect corporate payout policy decisions. We predict and find a surge of special dividends in the final months of 2010 and 2012, immediately before individual-level dividend tax rates were expected to increase. We also find evidence that immediately before the expected tax increases, firms altered the timing of their regular dividend payments by shifting what would normally be January regular dividend payments into the preceding December. To our knowledge this is the first evidence in the literature about changes in the timing of regular dividend payments in response to tax law changes. For both actions (specials and shifting), we find that it was more likely for a firm to respond to individual-level tax rates if insiders owned a relatively large amount of the firm. Overall, our paper provides evidence that managers consider individual-level taxes in making corporate payout decisions. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察投资者层面的税收是否影响企业支付政策决策。我们预测并发现，在2010年和2012年最后几个月里，即个人层面股利税率预期上调之前，特别股利出现激增。我们还发现证据表明，在预期税率上调之前，企业改变了其常规股利支付的时机，把原本通常在1月支付的常规股利提前到前一年的12月。据我们所知，这是文献中首次出现关于常规股利支付时机为应对税法变化而改变的证据。对于这两种行为（特别股利和提前支付），我们发现，如果内部人拥有企业相当大比例的股份，企业更可能对个人层面的税率作出反应。总体而言，我们的论文提供了证据表明，经理人在作出企业支付决策时会考虑个人层面的税收。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the behavior of call options surrounding the underlying stock's ex-dividend date. Raw markdown: hao-2010-ex-dividend-arbitrage-in-option-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Hao, J, Kalay, A, Mayhew, S Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2010…
pages.text: Ex-dividend Arbitrage in Option Markets (2010) Paper claim — We examine the behavior of call options surrounding the underlying stock's ex-dividend date. Raw markdown: hao-2010-ex-dividend-arbitrage-in-option-markets Bibliographic Record Authors: Hao, J, Kalay, A, Mayhew, S Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhp038 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine the behavior of call options surrounding the underlying stock's ex-dividend date. The evidence is inconsistent with the predictions of a rational exercise policy; a significant fraction of the open interest remains unexercised, resulting in a windfall gain to option writers. This triggers a sophisticated trading scheme that enables short-term traders to receive a significant fraction of the gains. The trading scheme inflates reported volume and distorts its traditional relations to liquidity. The dramatic increases in the volume of trade on the last cum-dividend day are facilitated by limitations on transaction costs passed by the various option exchanges. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了看涨期权在标的股票除息日前后的行为。证据与理性行权政策的预测不一致；相当大一部分未平仓合约仍未被行权，从而给期权卖方带来意外收益。这触发了一种精巧的交易方案，使短期交易者能够获得这些收益的相当一部分。该交易方案抬高了报告的成交量，并扭曲了其与流动性之间的传统关系。在最后一个含息日成交量的急剧增加，是由各期权交易所通过的对交易成本的限制所促成的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate the impact of dividend policy on earnings quality and opportunistic earnings management for individual banks across 45 developed and developing countries between 1996 and 2019. Raw markdown: haq-2024-do-banks-engage-in-earnings-management-the-role…
pages.text: Do banks engage in earnings management? The role of dividends and institutional factors (2024) Paper claim — We investigate the impact of dividend policy on earnings quality and opportunistic earnings management for individual banks across 45 developed and developing countries between 1996 and 2019. Raw markdown: haq-2024-do-banks-engage-in-earnings-management-the-role Bibliographic Record Authors: Haq, M, Ongena, S, Pu, JY, Tan, EKM Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107287 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, investor protection, policy, regulat)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We investigate the impact of dividend policy on earnings quality and opportunistic earnings management for individual banks across 45 developed and developing countries between 1996 and 2019. Our estimates show that high dividend payments reduce earnings management, hence mitigate agency problems. This mitigation is especially prevalent among well-capitalised and non-listed banks. Greater investor protection and government regulation appear to strengthen the negative association between dividend policy and earnings management. Our results hold robustly across many different specifications. 摘要（中文） 我们考察1996年至2019年间45个发达国家和发展中国家单个银行的股利政策对盈余质量和机会主义盈余管理的影响。我们的估计表明，高股利支付会减少盈余管理，从而缓解代理问题。这种缓解在资本充足和非上市银行中尤为普遍。更强的投资者保护和政府监管似乎会强化股利政策与盈余管理之间的负向关联。我们的结果在许多不同设定下都稳健成立。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate governance and firm cash holdings in the US
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using governance metrics based on antitakeover provisions and inside ownership, we find that firms with weaker corporate governance structures actually have smaller cash reserves. Raw markdown: harford-2008-corporate-governance-and-firm-cash-holdings-in-the…
pages.text: Corporate governance and firm cash holdings in the US (2008) Paper claim — Using governance metrics based on antitakeover provisions and inside ownership, we find that firms with weaker corporate governance structures actually have smaller cash reserves. Raw markdown: harford-2008-corporate-governance-and-firm-cash-holdings-in-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Harford, J, Mansi, SA, Maxwell, WF Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.04.002 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Using governance metrics based on antitakeover provisions and inside ownership, we find that firms with weaker corporate governance structures actually have smaller cash reserves. When distributing cash to shareholders, firms with weaker governance structures choose to repurchase instead of increasing dividends, avoiding future payout commitments. The combination of excess cash and weak shareholder rights leads to increases in capital expenditures and acquisitions. Firms with low shareholder rights and excess cash have lower profitability and valuations. However, there is only limited evidence that the presence of excess cash alters the overall relation between governance and profitability. In the US, weakly controlled managers choose to spend cash quickly on acquisitions and capital expenditures, rather than hoard it. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 利用基于反收购条款和内部人持股的公司治理指标，我们发现，公司治理结构较弱的公司实际上拥有较小的现金储备。在向股东分配现金时，治理结构较弱的公司选择回购而非增加股利，从而避免未来的支付承诺。过剩现金与较弱股东权利的结合会导致资本支出和收购的增加。股东权利较低且拥有过剩现金的公司盈利能力和估值较低。然而，只有有限的证据表明过剩现金的存在会改变治理与盈利能力之间的总体关系。在美国，受到弱控制的管理者选择迅速将现金花在收购和资本支出上，而非将其囤积起来。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Do long-term investors improve corporate decision making? (2018) Paper claim — We study the effect of investor horizons on a comprehensive set of corporate decisions. Raw markdown: harford-2018-do-long-term-investors-improve-corporate-decision-making Bibliographic Record Authors: Harford, J, Kecskés, A, Mansi, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.09.022 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, monitor)；股利政策(payout) Abstract We study the effect of investor horizons on a comprehensive set of corporate decisions. We argue that monitoring by long-term investors generates decision making that maximizes shareholder value. We find that long-term investors strengthen governance and restrain managerial misbehaviors such as earnings management and financial fraud. They discourage a range of investment and financing activities but encourage payouts. Innovation increases, in quantity and quality. Shareholders benefit through higher profitability that the stock market does not fully anticipate, and lower risk. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究投资者持有期限对一整套全面公司决策的影响。我们认为长期投资者的监督会产生使股东价值最大化的决策。我们发现长期投资者强化了治理，并抑制了诸如盈余管理和财务舞弊等管理者不当行为。他们抑制了一系列投资和融资活动，但鼓励派现。创新在数量和质量上都有所增加。股东通过股票市场未能完全预期的更高盈利能力以及更低的风险而获益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Juicing the dividend yield: Mutual funds and the demand for dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Some mutual funds purchase stocks before dividend payments to artificially increase their dividends, which we call "juicing." Funds paid more than twice the dividends implied by their holdings in 7.4% of fund-years examined. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Juicing the dividend yield: Mutual funds and the demand for dividends (2015) Paper claim — Some mutual funds purchase stocks before dividend payments to artificially increase their dividends, which we call "juicing." Funds paid more than twice the dividends implied by their holdings in 7.4% of fund-years examined. Raw markdown: harris-2015-juicing-the-dividend-yield-mutual-funds-and-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Harris, LE, Hartzmark, SM, Solomon, DH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2015.04.001 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Some mutual funds purchase stocks before dividend payments to artificially increase their dividends, which we call "juicing." Funds paid more than twice the dividends implied by their holdings in 7.4% of fund-years examined. Juicing is associated with larger inflows, and is more common among funds with unsophisticated investors. This behavior is consistent with an underlying investor demand for dividends, but is hard to explain by taxes or need for income, as funds can generate equivalent tax-free distributions by returning capital. Juicing is costly to investors through higher turnover and increased taxes of 0.57% to 1.52% of fund assets per year. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 一些共同基金在股利支付之前购买股票，以人为地增加其股利，我们称之为"催汁"（juicing）。在所考察的基金—年度中，有7.4%的基金支付的股利超过了其持股所隐含股利的两倍以上。催汁与更大的资金流入相关，并且在拥有非老练投资者的基金中更为常见。这种行为与投资者对股利的潜在需求相一致，但很难用税收或对收入的需求来解释，因为基金本可以通过返还资本产生等值的免税分配。催汁通过更高的换手率以及每年增加相当于基金资产0.57%至1.52%的税负而给投资者带来成本。 Key Findings 7.4% of fund-years show extreme juicing (dividends > 2× holdings-implied), and 28.5% show juicing beyond the 1% significance cutoff of the bootstrap distribution; juicing is persistent year-over-year, consistent with deliberate fund policy. Juicing funds attract 6.8–12.2% more annual inflows than comparable non-juicing funds, demonstrating investors reward the behavior and confirming an underlying psychological demand for dividend income rather than equivalent capital returns. Juicing is significantly less likely in institutional share classes and more common in high-expense funds, consistent with the catering explanation (unsophisticated investors) rather than a tax clientele (which predicts the opposite). Juicing funds hold shares that are on average 4.1 days closer to the next dividend payment, and new holdings are 5.0 days closer, providing direct portfolio-level evidence of deliberate dividend-capturing trading. The strategy is costly to investors: higher portfolio turnover (11–17% per year) and annual tax costs of 0.57–1.52% of fund assets, while juicing funds do not generate higher returns and by some measures perform worse. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.title: The Dividend Disconnect
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Many individual investors, mutual funds, and institutions trade as if dividends and capital gains are disconnected attributes, not fully appreciating that dividends result in price decreases. Raw markdown: hartzmark-2019-the-dividend-disconnect Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: The Dividend Disconnect (2019) Paper claim — Many individual investors, mutual funds, and institutions trade as if dividends and capital gains are disconnected attributes, not fully appreciating that dividends result in price decreases. Raw markdown: hartzmark-2019-the-dividend-disconnect Bibliographic Record Authors: Hartzmark, SM, Solomon, DH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12785 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Many individual investors, mutual funds, and institutions trade as if dividends and capital gains are disconnected attributes, not fully appreciating that dividends result in price decreases. Behavioral trading patterns (e.g., the disposition effect) are driven by price changes instead of total returns. Investors rarely reinvest dividends, and trade as if dividends are a separate, stable income stream. Analysts fail to account for the effect of dividends on price, leading to optimistic price forecasts for dividend-paying stocks. Demand for dividends is systematically higher in periods of low interest rates and poor market performance, leading to lower returns for dividend-paying stocks. 摘要（中文） 许多个人投资者、共同基金和机构在交易时，仿佛股利和资本利得是彼此脱节的属性，而未能充分认识到股利会导致价格下跌。行为交易模式（例如处置效应）由价格变动而非总收益驱动。投资者很少将股利再投资，且交易时仿佛股利是一个独立、稳定的收入流。分析师未能考虑股利对价格的影响，从而对派息股票做出乐观的价格预测。在低利率和市场表现不佳的时期，对股利的需求会系统性地升高，从而导致派息股票的收益率下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We demonstrate that predictable uninformed cash flows forecast aggregate market stock returns. Raw markdown: hartzmark-2025-market-wide-predictable-price-pressure Bibliographic Record Authors: Hartzmark, SM, Solomon, DH Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2025…
pages.text: Market-Wide Predictable Price Pressure (2025) Paper claim — We demonstrate that predictable uninformed cash flows forecast aggregate market stock returns. Raw markdown: hartzmark-2025-market-wide-predictable-price-pressure Bibliographic Record Authors: Hartzmark, SM, Solomon, DH Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1257/aer.20231725 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We demonstrate that predictable uninformed cash flows forecast aggregate market stock returns. Buying pressure from dividend payments (announced weeks prior) predicts higher value-weighted market returns, with returns for the top quintile of payment days four times higher than the lowest. This holds internationally and increases when reinvestment is high and market liquidity is low. We estimate a market-level price multiplier of 1.9. These results suggest price pressure is a widespread result of flows, not an anomaly. G12, G14, 摘要（中文） 我们证明，可预测的、非信息驱动的现金流可以预测总体市场股票收益。来自股利支付（数周前已宣布）的买入压力可预测更高的价值加权市场收益，支付日排在最高五分位的收益是最低五分位的四倍。这一现象在国际上同样成立，并且在再投资较高且市场流动性较低时增强。我们估计的市场层面价格乘数为1.9。这些结果表明，价格压力是资金流普遍存在的结果，而非一种异象。G12, G14。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do intangibles matter for corporate policies? Evidence from organization capital and corporate payout choices
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A B S T R A C T Organization capital represents the stock of knowledge, capabilities, culture, and business processes, and systems that integrate human skills with physical capital to enhance organizational efficiency. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Do intangibles matter for corporate policies? Evidence from organization capital and corporate payout choices (2022) Paper claim — A B S T R A C T Organization capital represents the stock of knowledge, capabilities, culture, and business processes, and systems that integrate human skills with physical capital to enhance organizational efficiency. Raw markdown: hasan-2022-do-intangibles-matter-for-corporate-policies-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Hasan, MM, Uddin, MR Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2021.106395 Relevance score: 13.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, distribution, dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, signal) Abstract A B S T R A C T Organization capital represents the stock of knowledge, capabilities, culture, and business processes, and systems that integrate human skills with physical capital to enhance organizational efficiency. We investigate whether and how a firm's payout choices are related to its level of organization capital. Using a large sample of U.S. firms during the period 1980-2017, we find that both the likelihood and the levels of cash dividend distribution and share repurchases are significantly higher for firms with more organization capital. Our findings hold up to a battery of robustness checks and endogeneity tests. We further explore related channels and find strong evidence that the positive association between organization capital and dividend payments (share repurchases) is largely attributable to agency problems (executive compensation incentives). We find weak evidence for the signaling argument for corporate payouts. Overall, we document that organization capital plays a central role in shaping corporate payout choices. (c) 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 组织资本代表着知识、能力、文化、业务流程和系统的存量，它将人力技能与实物资本整合，以提升组织效率。我们考察企业的支付选择是否以及如何与其组织资本水平相关。使用1980—2017年间美国企业的大样本，我们发现，组织资本更多的企业，其现金股利分配和股份回购的可能性和水平都显著更高。我们的发现经受住了一系列稳健性检验和内生性检验。我们进一步探究相关渠道，发现有力证据表明，组织资本与股利支付（股份回购）之间的正相关关系在很大程度上可归因于代理问题（高管薪酬激励）。我们发现支持公司支付信号论点的证据较弱。总体而言，我们记录了组织资本在塑造公司支付选择中发挥着核心作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: SIGNALING WITH DIVIDENDS AND SHARE REPURCHASES - A CHOICE BETWEEN DETERMINISTIC AND STOCHASTIC CASH DISBURSEMENTS (1993) Paper claim — We study firms signaling with cash disbursements and show that the choice of a deterministic or a stochastic disbursement depends on a property of the firm's production function that is analogous to absolute risk aversion for a utility function. Raw markdown: hausch-1993-signaling-with-dividends-and-share-repurchases-a-choice Bibliographic Record Authors: HAUSCH, DB, SEWARD, JK Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1993 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/6.1.121 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We study firms signaling with cash disbursements and show that the choice of a deterministic or a stochastic disbursement depends on a property of the firm's production function that is analogous to absolute risk aversion for a utility function. With decreasing (increasing) absolute risk aversion, the high-quality firm prefers to distinguish itself from the low-quality firm with a stochastic (deterministic) outlay. We then study in detail two common forms of corporate cash distributions. dividends, a deterministic disbursement, and share repurchases, a stochastic disbursement. 摘要（中文） 我们研究企业通过现金分配进行信号传递，并表明，选择确定性还是随机性的分配取决于企业生产函数的一个性质，该性质类似于效用函数的绝对风险厌恶。在绝对风险厌恶递减（递增）的情况下，高质量企业偏好用随机性（确定性）支出把自己与低质量企业区分开来。随后我们详细研究了两种常见的企业现金分配形式：股利，一种确定性支出；以及股份回购，一种随机性支出。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The contribution of stock repurchases to the value of the firm and cash holdings around the world
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using corporate payout data from 33 economies, this study investigates the contribution of stock repurchases to the value of the firm and cash holdings in different country-level investor protection environments. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The contribution of stock repurchases to the value of the firm and cash holdings around the world (2011) Paper claim — Using corporate payout data from 33 economies, this study investigates the contribution of stock repurchases to the value of the firm and cash holdings in different country-level investor protection environments. Raw markdown: haw-2011-the-contribution-of-stock-repurchases-to-the-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Haw, IM, Ho, SSM, Hu, BB, Zhang, X Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2010.10.001 Relevance score: 11.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection)；股利政策(dividend, payout, stock repurchase)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract Using corporate payout data from 33 economies, this study investigates the contribution of stock repurchases to the value of the firm and cash holdings in different country-level investor protection environments. We find that stock repurchases contribute more to firm value in countries with strong investor protection than in countries with weak investor protection. We also report that dividends contribute approximately 60% more to firm value than repurchases in countries with weak investor protection. Furthermore, as the proportion of repurchases in total payouts increases, the marginal value of cash increases in countries with strong investor protection, whereas it declines in countries with weak investor protection. In a poor investor protection environment, the marginal value of cash for a firm that makes 100% of its payouts via repurchases is 12 cents lower than that for a firm that distributes 100% of its payouts via dividends. Overall, our findings highlight that stock repurchases are less effective than dividends in mitigating agency problems associated with free cash flow in countries with poor investor protection. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 使用来自33个经济体的企业支付数据，本研究考察了在不同的国家层面投资者保护环境下，股份回购对企业价值和现金持有的贡献。我们发现，在投资者保护强的国家，股份回购对企业价值的贡献比投资者保护弱的国家更大。我们还报告，在投资者保护弱的国家，股利对企业价值的贡献比回购高出约60%。此外，随着回购在总支付中所占比例的上升，在投资者保护强的国家现金的边际价值上升，而在投资者保护弱的国家则下降。在投资者保护差的环境中，一家100%通过回购进行支付的企业，其现金边际价值比一家100%通过股利进行分配的企业低12美分。总体而言，我们的发现凸显出，在投资者保护差的国家，股份回购在缓解与自由现金流相关的代理问题方面不如股利有效。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Dividends Behavior in State- Versus Family-Controlled Firms: Evidence from Hong Kong (2012) Paper claim — This study comparatively examines the dividends behavior in state-controlled firms versus family-controlled firms. Raw markdown: he-2012-dividends-behavior-in-state-versus-family-controlled-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: He, TT, Li, WXB, Tang, GYN Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-011-1150-0 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This study comparatively examines the dividends behavior in state-controlled firms versus family-controlled firms. With the sample of large industrial firms listed on the Main Board of Hong Kong Stock Exchange, we investigate the dividends payment rates, stability of dividends payment, the effects of firm size, profitability and growth opportunity on likelihood to pay dividends, as well as the concentration of dividend in state-controlled versus family-controlled firms. Based on the findings, we derive some ethical implications of dividends policy regarding the differences in business ethical behavior, corporate social responsibility, corporate governance, business sustainability, and shareholder activism in state-controlled versus family-controlled firms, as well as the improvement in these respects through cross-listing in Hong Kong. 摘要（中文） 本研究对国有控股公司与家族控股公司的股利行为进行了比较考察。以在香港联合交易所主板上市的大型工业公司为样本，我们考察了国有控股与家族控股公司在股利支付率、股利支付的稳定性，公司规模、盈利能力和成长机会对派发股利可能性的影响，以及股利集中度方面的情况。基于研究发现，我们推导出股利政策的一些伦理含义，涉及国有控股与家族控股公司在商业伦理行为、企业社会责任、公司治理、企业可持续性和股东维权方面的差异，以及通过在香港交叉上市在这些方面的改善。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend policy and earnings management across countries
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines whether dividend policy is associated with earnings management and whether the relationship varies across countries with wide-ranging degrees of institutional strength and transparency. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Dividend policy and earnings management across countries (2017) Paper claim — This paper examines whether dividend policy is associated with earnings management and whether the relationship varies across countries with wide-ranging degrees of institutional strength and transparency. Raw markdown: he-2017-dividend-policy-and-earnings-management-across-countries Bibliographic Record Authors: He, W, Ng, LL, Zaiats, N, Zhang, BH Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.11.014 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, investor protection, policy, transparency)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This paper examines whether dividend policy is associated with earnings management and whether the relationship varies across countries with wide-ranging degrees of institutional strength and transparency. Based on a sample of 23,429 corporations from 29 countries, we show that dividend payers manage earnings less than dividend non-payers, and that this evidence is stronger in countries with weak investor protection and high opacity. Further, we find that dividend payers manage earnings less when they issue equity following dividend payments, and that this result is more pronounced in countries with weak institutions and low transparency. Overall, our evidence suggests that firms may employ dividend policies associated with less earnings manipulation to mitigate agency concerns and to establish credible reputation, thereby facilitating access to external funds. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察股利政策是否与盈余管理相关联，以及这种关系是否因国家制度强度和透明度的广泛差异而不同。基于来自29个国家的23429家企业样本，我们表明，派息企业比不派息企业的盈余管理更少，且这一证据在投资者保护薄弱、不透明度高的国家更强。此外，我们发现，当派息企业在派息后发行股票时其盈余管理更少，且这一结果在制度薄弱、透明度低的国家更为显著。总体而言，我们的证据表明，企业可能采用与更少盈余操纵相关联的股利政策，以缓解代理担忧并建立可信声誉，从而便利获取外部资金。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The effects of a comply-or-explain dividend regulation in China (2018) Paper claim — We examine the effects of the world's first comply-or-explain dividend regulation in China's Shanghai Stock Exchange, which requires firms to either pay at least 30% of profits as dividends or explain the use of funds. Raw markdown: he-2018-the-effects-of-a-comply-or-explain-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: He, W, Li, CK Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2018.07.002 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We examine the effects of the world's first comply-or-explain dividend regulation in China's Shanghai Stock Exchange, which requires firms to either pay at least 30% of profits as dividends or explain the use of funds. We find that many firms increased their payout ratio to comply, by increasing dividends or decreasing earnings. Firms with high profitability, state ownership, and fewer agency conflicts were more likely to comply. However, complying firms subsequently issued more debt and had a decline in accounting performance and firm valuation. The evidence China suggests that the comply-or-explain regulation increased firms' dividends at substantial costs. 摘要（中文） 我们考察世界上首个"遵守或解释"股利监管在中国上海证券交易所所产生的影响，该监管要求企业要么将至少30%的利润作为股利支付，要么解释资金用途。我们发现，许多企业通过增加股利或减少收益来提高其支付率以求遵守。盈利能力高、国有所有权以及代理冲突较少的企业更可能遵守。然而，遵守的企业随后发行了更多债务，并出现会计业绩和企业估值的下降。来自中国的证据表明，"遵守或解释"监管以巨大的代价提高了企业的股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Asymmetric Cost Behavior and Dividend Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Costs are sticky on average, that is, they fall less for sales decreases than they rise for equivalent sales increases. Raw markdown: he-2020-asymmetric-cost-behavior-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: He, J, Tian, X, Yang, H, Zuo, L Journal: JOURNAL…
pages.text: Asymmetric Cost Behavior and Dividend Policy (2020) Paper claim — Costs are sticky on average, that is, they fall less for sales decreases than they rise for equivalent sales increases. Raw markdown: he-2020-asymmetric-cost-behavior-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: He, J, Tian, X, Yang, H, Zuo, L Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12328 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Costs are sticky on average, that is, they fall less for sales decreases than they rise for equivalent sales increases. We examine the effect of this asymmetric cost behavior on a firm's dividend policy. Given investors' aversion to dividend cuts, we predict that firms with higher resource adjustment costs and stickier costs pay lower dividends than their peers because they are less able to sustain any higher level of dividend payouts in the future. We find evidence consistent with this prediction. Further, using a regression discontinuity design that exploits variation in labor adjustment costs generated by close-call union elections, we provide evidence suggesting that the negative relation between cost stickiness and dividend payouts is driven by resource adjustment costs. Our paper sheds new light on the determinants of dividend policy and demonstrates the role of cost behavior in corporate decisions. 摘要（中文） 成本平均而言是粘性的，也就是说，成本在销售下降时的减少幅度小于其在等量销售增加时的上升幅度。我们考察了这种非对称成本行为对企业股利政策的影响。鉴于投资者对削减股利的厌恶，我们预测，具有更高资源调整成本和更粘性成本的企业比其同侪派发更低的股利，因为它们在未来更不能维持任何更高水平的股利支付。我们发现的证据与这一预测相一致。此外，利用一个利用由势均力敌的工会选举所产生的劳动调整成本差异的断点回归设计，我们提供的证据表明，成本粘性与股利支付之间的负相关关系是由资源调整成本所驱动的。我们的论文为股利政策的决定因素提供了新的启示，并展示了成本行为在公司决策中的作用。 Key Findings Firms with stickier costs exhibit 3.3% lower dividend payouts per one-standard-deviation increase in cost stickiness in OLS regressions controlling for firm size, leverage, Tobin's Q, earnings quality and volatility, and industry-by-year fixed effects (N = 87,807 firm-years, 1978–2016). Results are robust to three alternative cost stickiness measures (industry-level, operating cost-based, total cost-based) and five alternative dividend payout measures, all showing a consistent negative relation of 2.2–5.0% economic magnitude. Regression discontinuity using close-call union elections provides causal evidence: firms where union elections barely passed pay 44.3% lower annual dividends per share over the subsequent four years than firms where elections barely failed, mediated by higher post-election cost stickiness. Two-step mediation analysis shows that the negative effect of unionization on dividends operates specifically through the cost stickiness channel (predicted DPS coefficient −0.337, p < 5%; residual DPS coefficient insignificant), not through other mechanisms. The negative cost-stickiness/payout relation is concentrated in financially constrained firms (below-median cash or retained earnings), consistent with the resource adjustment cost mechanism rather than empire-building or managerial expectations. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.title: Institutional investors' horizon and equity-financed payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Farre-Mensa, Michaely and Schmalz (2018) document that many firms issue new equity to finance their payouts to shareholders, despite the substantial cost of equity issuance. Raw markdown: he-2022-institutional-investors-horizon-and-equity-financed-payouts…
pages.text: Institutional investors' horizon and equity-financed payouts (2022) Paper claim — Farre-Mensa, Michaely and Schmalz (2018) document that many firms issue new equity to finance their payouts to shareholders, despite the substantial cost of equity issuance. Raw markdown: he-2022-institutional-investors-horizon-and-equity-financed-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: He, W, Mi, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2021.106324 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(payout) Abstract Farre-Mensa, Michaely and Schmalz (2018) document that many firms issue new equity to finance their payouts to shareholders, despite the substantial cost of equity issuance. We find that equity-financed payouts are related to institutional investors' horizon. Specifically, firms with a larger ownership by short horizon institutions are more likely to have equity-financed discretionary payouts, and firms with equity financed discretionary payouts tend to cut down their investments in the following years. Our results suggest that investor short-termism has significant effects on firms' payout, financing and investment policies. (c) 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） Farre-Mensa、Michaely和Schmalz（2018）记录到，尽管股权发行成本高昂，许多公司仍发行新股权来为其对股东的支付融资。我们发现，股权融资的支付与机构投资者的持有期限相关。具体而言，短期限机构持股比例较大的公司更可能进行股权融资的酌情支付，而进行股权融资酌情支付的公司往往在随后的年份削减其投资。我们的结果表明，投资者的短期主义对公司的支付、融资和投资政策具有显著影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The effects of a comply-or-explain dividend regulation in China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The world's first comply-or-explain dividend regulation (Shanghai Stock Exchange 2013) successfully increased dividend payout ratios among Shanghai-listed firms, primarily through dividend increases rather than earnings manipulation, but complying firms…
pages.text: The effects of a comply-or-explain dividend regulation in China (2018) Paper claim — The world's first comply-or-explain dividend regulation (Shanghai Stock Exchange 2013) successfully increased dividend payout ratios among Shanghai-listed firms, primarily through dividend increases rather than earnings manipulation, but complying firms subsequently issued more debt and experienced declining operating performance and firm valuation. Raw markdown: he-li-2018-the-effects-of-a-comply-or-explain-dividend-regulation-in-china Bibliographic Record Authors: He, Wen; Li, Chao Kevin Journal: Journal of Corporate Finance Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2018.07.002 Abstract We examine the effects of the world's first comply-or-explain dividend regulation in China's Shanghai Stock Exchange, which requires firms to either pay at least 30% of profits as dividends or explain the use of funds. We find that many firms increased their payout ratio to comply, by increasing dividends or decreasing earnings. Firms with high profitability, state ownership, and fewer agency conflicts were more likely to comply. However, complying firms subsequently issued more debt and had a decline in accounting performance and firm valuation. The evidence suggests that the comply-or-explain regulation increased firms' dividends at substantial costs. Key Findings The 2013 Shanghai regulation was effective: the percentage of Shanghai firms with payout ratios ≥30% nearly doubled from 25.2% in 2011 to 54.6% in 2012, with no comparable change in Shenzhen (the control group), confirmed in difference-in-differences regressions. Complying firms primarily increased actual cash dividends rather than manipulating earnings downward, though some earnings management also contributed; dividend increase is roughly four times larger in magnitude in the treatment regressions. State ownership and high profitability are the strongest predictors of compliance; firms with higher management ownership or mutual fund ownership (lower agency costs) are also more likely to comply, while high insider-minority shareholder disparities discourage compliance. Complying firms are more likely to issue debt in the year following the regulation, consistent with the finding that US dividend payers often fund payouts with external debt (Farre-Mensa et al., 2018). Despite the payout increase, complying firms experienced declining Tobin's Q and operating profitability post-regulation, suggesting investors perceived the costs of forced compliance as outweighing the benefits, particularly because capital that might otherwise have been tunneled was replaced by expensive debt. pages.title: Languages and dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms in markets where a weak future-time-reference (FTR) language is spoken pay lower dividends than firms in strong-FTR markets, because weak-FTR speakers perceive future payoffs as nearer and more ambiguous in timing, resulting in a lower discount rate and…
pages.text: Languages and dividends (2022) Paper claim — Firms in markets where a weak future-time-reference (FTR) language is spoken pay lower dividends than firms in strong-FTR markets, because weak-FTR speakers perceive future payoffs as nearer and more ambiguous in timing, resulting in a lower discount rate and higher present value of future dividends, which diminishes today's demand for cash dividends. Raw markdown: he-zhang-2022-languages-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: He, Wen; Zhang, Feida Journal: The British Accounting Review Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.bar.2022.101132 Abstract We study whether languages are related to corporate dividend policies around the world. Users of languages with a weak future time reference (FTR), such as Japanese and Finnish, do not need to grammatically distinguish future and current events, while users of strong-FTR languages such as French and Italian do. Chen (2013) shows that people who use weak-FTR languages may perceive the future to be nearer and have less precise perceptions of the timing of future events than users of strong-FTR languages. We argue that these perceptions may result in a lower discount rate and a higher valuation of future dividends, leading to a weaker preference and demand for a dividend today. Using a large sample of firms from 19 markets, we find supporting evidence that firms in weak-FTR language markets pay lower dividends than firms in strong-FTR language markets. The results remain robust after a battery of robustness tests, including using a single market with multiple languages and using a difference-in-differences approach in a market with a change of official languages. Further evidence shows that weak-FTR languages are related to a lower implied cost of equity capital and stronger market reactions to dividend changes. Our results offer a new explanation for cross-country differences in dividend policies and add to the research on culture and financial markets. Key Findings In a sample of 220,464 firm-year observations from 19 markets (1988–2017), weak-FTR language firms pay significantly lower dividends across five dividend ratio measures; the dividends-to-equity ratio is about 10% lower in weak-FTR markets after controlling for legal origin, investor protection, national culture, and other country characteristics. Hong Kong difference-in-differences provides causal evidence: after the 1997 handover increased use of Chinese (a weak-FTR language), Hong Kong firms paid lower dividends relative to Singapore and Malaysia benchmarks (coefficient −0.011 to −0.018, p < 0.01), while legal institutions remained unchanged. Within-Switzerland evidence shows that firms headquartered in German-speaking cantons (weak-FTR) pay lower dividends than firms in French- and Italian-speaking cantons (strong-FTR), isolating the language effect from country-level institutions. Implied cost of equity capital is approximately 90 basis points lower for firms in weak-FTR markets (RAVG coefficient −0.009, p < 0.001), providing direct evidence for the discount rate channel. Market reactions to dividend changes are stronger in weak-FTR markets (interaction term coefficient 0.007, significant at 1%), consistent with dividend changes signaling more valuable future earnings in lower-discount-rate environments. Linked Pages international-evidence-on-dividends dividend-clienteles

pages.title: THE CHALLENGES OF INVESTOR COMMUNICATION - THE CASE OF CUC INTERNATIONAL, INC
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine investor communication issues using the experience of CUC International. Raw markdown: healy-1995-the-challenges-of-investor-communication-the-case-of Bibliographic Record Authors: HEALY, PM, PALEPU, KG Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1995…
pages.text: THE CHALLENGES OF INVESTOR COMMUNICATION - THE CASE OF CUC INTERNATIONAL, INC (1995) Paper claim — We examine investor communication issues using the experience of CUC International. Raw markdown: healy-1995-the-challenges-of-investor-communication-the-case-of Bibliographic Record Authors: HEALY, PM, PALEPU, KG Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1995 DOI: 10.1016/0304-405X(94)00814-H Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We examine investor communication issues using the experience of CUC International. CUC had difficulty convincing investors that its marketing outlays were profitable investments, leading to stock misvaluation over an extended period. To resolve this problem, CUC adopted an accounting change and then underwent a leveraged recapitalization. Subsequently, it accelerated recap debt repayments and initiated a stock repurchase. CUC's experience suggests that accounting reports are not always effective in investor communication. While financial signals are more effective, their impact is not as immediate as predicted by prior research. The CUC case suggests that investor communications is a rich area for future research. 摘要（中文） 我们利用CUC International的经历来考察投资者沟通问题。CUC难以让投资者相信其营销支出是有利可图的投资，导致股票在相当长的一段时期内被错误估值。为解决这一问题，CUC采取了一项会计变更，然后进行了杠杆资本重组。随后，它加速偿还重组债务并启动了股票回购。CUC的经历表明，会计报告在投资者沟通中并不总是有效的。虽然财务信号更为有效，但其影响并不像此前研究所预测的那样即时。CUC案例表明，投资者沟通是未来研究的一个丰富领域。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Extended Dividend, Cash Flow, and Residual Income Valuation Models: Accounting for Deviations from Ideal Conditions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Previous empirical studies derive the standard equity valuation models (i.e., DDM, RIM, and DCF model) while assuming that ideal conditions, such as infinite payoffs and clean surplus accounting, exist. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Extended Dividend, Cash Flow, and Residual Income Valuation Models: Accounting for Deviations from Ideal Conditions (2013) Paper claim — Previous empirical studies derive the standard equity valuation models (i.e., DDM, RIM, and DCF model) while assuming that ideal conditions, such as infinite payoffs and clean surplus accounting, exist. Raw markdown: heinrichs-2013-extended-dividend-cash-flow-and-residual-income-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Heinrichs, N, Hess, D, Homburg, C, Lorenz, M, Sievers, S Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1111/j.1911-3846.2011.01148.x Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Previous empirical studies derive the standard equity valuation models (i.e., DDM, RIM, and DCF model) while assuming that ideal conditions, such as infinite payoffs and clean surplus accounting, exist. Because these conditions are rarely met, we extend the standard models by following the fundamental principle of financial statement articulation. We then empirically test the extended models by employing two sets of forecasts: (1) the analyst forecasts provided by Value Line, and (2) the forecasts generated by cross-sectional regression models. The main result is that our extended models yield considerably smaller valuation errors. Moreover, by constructing these models, we obtain identical value estimates across the extended models. By reestablishing empirical equivalence under nonideal conditions, our approach provides a benchmark that enables us to quantify the errors caused by individual deviations from ideal conditions and thus to analyze the robustness of the standard models. Finally, by providing a level playing field for the different valuation models, our findings have implications for other empirical approaches, for example, estimating the implied cost of capital. 摘要（中文） 先前的实证研究在推导标准股权估值模型（即股利折现模型DDM、剩余收益模型RIM和现金流折现DCF模型）时，假设存在诸如无限期收益和干净盈余会计（clean surplus accounting）等理想条件。由于这些条件很少被满足，我们遵循财务报表勾稽（articulation）的基本原则来扩展标准模型。随后，我们采用两组预测对扩展后的模型进行实证检验：(1) Value Line提供的分析师预测，以及 (2) 由横截面回归模型生成的预测。主要结果是，我们扩展后的模型产生的估值误差要小得多。此外，通过构建这些模型，我们在各扩展模型之间获得了完全相同的价值估计。通过在非理想条件下重新确立实证等价性，我们的方法提供了一个基准，使我们能够量化由个别偏离理想条件所引起的误差，从而分析标准模型的稳健性。最后，通过为不同的估值模型提供一个公平的竞争环境，我们的发现对其他实证方法（例如估计隐含资本成本）具有启示意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How costly is external financing? Evidence from a structural estimation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We apply simulated method of moments to a dynamic model to infer the magnitude of financing costs. Raw markdown: hennessy-2007-how-costly-is-external-financing-evidence-from-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Hennessy, CA, Whited, TM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: How costly is external financing? Evidence from a structural estimation (2007) Paper claim — We apply simulated method of moments to a dynamic model to infer the magnitude of financing costs. Raw markdown: hennessy-2007-how-costly-is-external-financing-evidence-from-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Hennessy, CA, Whited, TM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2007.01255.x Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We apply simulated method of moments to a dynamic model to infer the magnitude of financing costs. The model features endogenous investment, distributions, leverage, and default. The corporation faces taxation, costly bankruptcy, and linear-quadratic equity flotation costs. For large (small) firms, estimated marginal equity flotation costs start at 5.0% (10.7%) and bankruptcy costs equal to 8.4% (15.1%) of capital. Estimated financing frictions are higher for low-dividend firms and those identified as constrained by the Cleary and Whited-Wu indexes. In simulated data, many common proxies for financing constraints actually decrease when we increase financing cost parameters. 摘要（中文） 我们将模拟矩法应用于一个动态模型，以推断融资成本的大小。该模型包含内生的投资、派现、杠杆和违约。公司面临税收、代价高昂的破产以及线性—二次型的权益发行（flotation）成本。对于大（小）公司，估计的边际权益发行成本起始于5.0%（10.7%），破产成本等于资本的8.4%（15.1%）。对于低股利公司以及被Cleary指数和Whited-Wu指数识别为受约束的公司，估计的融资摩擦更高。在模拟数据中，当我们提高融资成本参数时，许多常用的融资约束代理变量实际上反而下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Repeated Signaling and Firm Dynamics
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — As an alternative to the pecking order, we develop a dynamic calibratable model where the firm avoids mispricing via signaling. Raw markdown: hennessy-2010-repeated-signaling-and-firm-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: Hennessy, CA, Livdan, D, Miranda, B…
pages.text: Repeated Signaling and Firm Dynamics (2010) Paper claim — As an alternative to the pecking order, we develop a dynamic calibratable model where the firm avoids mispricing via signaling. Raw markdown: hennessy-2010-repeated-signaling-and-firm-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: Hennessy, CA, Livdan, D, Miranda, B Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhq004 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(alternative, signal, substitut) Abstract As an alternative to the pecking order, we develop a dynamic calibratable model where the firm avoids mispricing via signaling. The model is rich, featuring endogenous investment, debt, default, dividends, equity flotations, and share repurchases. In equilibrium, firms with negative private information have negative leverage, issue equity, and overinvest. Firms signal positive information by substituting debt for equity. Default costs induce such firms to underinvest. Model simulations reveal that repeated signaling can account for countercyclical leverage, leverage persistence, volatile procylical investment, and correlation between size and leverage. The model generates other novel predictions. Investment rates are the key predictor of abnormal announcement returns in simulated data, with leverage only predicting returns unconditionally. Firms facing asymmetric information actually exhibit higher mean Q ratios and investment rates. 摘要（中文） 作为啄食顺序的一种替代，我们建立了一个可校准的动态模型，其中企业通过发出信号来避免错误定价。该模型内容丰富，包含内生的投资、债务、违约、股利、股权发行和股份回购。在均衡中，拥有负面私人信息的企业采取负杠杆、发行股权并过度投资。企业通过用债务替代股权来发出正面信息的信号。违约成本促使这类企业投资不足。模型模拟显示，重复信号发送能够解释逆周期杠杆、杠杆持续性、波动的顺周期投资以及规模与杠杆之间的相关性。该模型还产生了其他新颖的预测。在模拟数据中，投资率是异常公告回报的关键预测因素，而杠杆仅无条件地预测回报。面临信息不对称的企业实际上表现出更高的平均q比率和投资率。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Ownership structure and tax-friendly dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The paper examines the existence of tax-based dividend clienteles using the novel environment of Australia. Raw markdown: henry-2011-ownership-structure-and-tax-friendly-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Henry, D Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: Ownership structure and tax-friendly dividends (2011) Paper claim — The paper examines the existence of tax-based dividend clienteles using the novel environment of Australia. Raw markdown: henry-2011-ownership-structure-and-tax-friendly-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Henry, D Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2011.03.003 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract The paper examines the existence of tax-based dividend clienteles using the novel environment of Australia. which has operated a full dividend imputation system since 1987. The analysis jointly focuses on the tax-based preferences of five categories of shareholders, including both domestic and foreign-domiciled shareholder classes. Incorporating the dividend franking percentage as a direct measure of the degree of tax benefit associated with dividends, strong evidence supporting the existence of tax-based dividend clienteles is present for both domestic and foreign shareholder categories. This includes domestic corporate blockholders and company directors, and local institutional investors following tax reforms in 2000. and foreign institutional shareholders which, alternatively, demand lower dividends and dividend franking. These findings persist after considering the effect of share repurchases. and under various model specifications controlling for unobserved firm heterogeneity and potential endogeneity between ownership structure and dividend payout policy. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文利用澳大利亚这一新颖环境考察基于税收的股利群体是否存在，澳大利亚自1987年以来一直实行完全的股利抵免制度。分析同时聚焦于五类股东（包括本国和外国注册的股东类别）基于税收的偏好。将股利税收抵免比例作为衡量与股利相关税收优惠程度的直接指标，我们发现有力证据支持本国和外国两类股东中基于税收的股利群体的存在。这包括本国公司大股东和公司董事、2000年税收改革后的本地机构投资者，以及相反地要求较低股利和股利税收抵免的外国机构股东。这些发现在考虑了股份回购的影响之后，以及在控制不可观测的企业异质性和所有权结构与股利支付政策之间潜在内生性的各种模型设定下，依然成立。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Ex-Dividend Profitability and Institutional Trading Skill
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use institutional trading data to examine whether skilled institutions exploit positive abnormal ex-dividend returns. Raw markdown: henry-2017-ex-dividend-profitability-and-institutional-trading-skill Bibliographic Record Authors: Henry, TR, Koski, JL Journal:…
pages.text: Ex-Dividend Profitability and Institutional Trading Skill (2017) Paper claim — We use institutional trading data to examine whether skilled institutions exploit positive abnormal ex-dividend returns. Raw markdown: henry-2017-ex-dividend-profitability-and-institutional-trading-skill Bibliographic Record Authors: Henry, TR, Koski, JL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12472 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We use institutional trading data to examine whether skilled institutions exploit positive abnormal ex-dividend returns. Results show that institutions concentrate trading around certain ex-dates, and earn higher profits around these events. Dividend capture trades represent 6% of all institutional buy trades but contribute 15% of overall abnormal returns. Institutional dividend capture trading is persistent. Institutional ex-day profitability is also strongly cross-sectionally related to trade execution skill. The relation between execution skill and profits disappears around placebo non-ex-days. Results suggest that skilled institutions target certain opportunities rather than benefiting uniformly over time. Furthermore, only skilled institutions can profit from dividend capture. 摘要（中文） 我们利用机构交易数据，考察熟练的机构投资者是否利用了正的除息日异常收益。结果表明，机构投资者将交易集中在某些除息日附近，并在这些事件周围赚取更高的利润。股利捕获交易占所有机构买入交易的6%，却贡献了整体异常收益的15%。机构的股利捕获交易具有持续性。机构在除息日的盈利能力还与其交易执行技能存在强烈的横截面相关性。而在安慰剂式的非除息日周围，执行技能与利润之间的关系消失。结果表明，熟练的机构瞄准特定机会，而非在时间上均匀受益。此外，只有熟练的机构才能从股利捕获中获利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Singapore Airlines' Balancing Act
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Singapore Airlines is widely regarded as an exemplar of excellence in an industry whose service standards are tumbling. Raw markdown: heracleous-2010-singapore-airlines-balancing-act Bibliographic Record Authors: Heracleous, L, Wirtz, J Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS…
pages.text: Singapore Airlines' Balancing Act (2010) Paper claim — Singapore Airlines is widely regarded as an exemplar of excellence in an industry whose service standards are tumbling. Raw markdown: heracleous-2010-singapore-airlines-balancing-act Bibliographic Record Authors: Heracleous, L, Wirtz, J Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 2010 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Singapore Airlines is widely regarded as an exemplar of excellence in an industry whose service standards are tumbling. What's not so well known is that the company is also one of the civil aviation industry's cost leaders. SIA's success in executing a dual strategy of differentiation and cost leadership is unusual. Indeed, management experts, such as Michael Porter, argue that it's impossible to do so for a sustained period since dual strategies entail contradictory investments and organizational processes. Yet SIA, and a few other emerging-economy companies, view the dualities as opposites that form part of a whole. SIA executes its dual strategy by managing four paradoxes: Achieving service excellence cost-effectively, fostering centralized and decentralized innovation, being a technology leader and follower, and using standardization to achieve personalization. The results speak for themselves: SIA has delivered healthy financial returns; it has never had an annual loss; and except for the initial capitalization, the Asian airline has funded its growth itself while paying dividends every year. 摘要（中文） 在一个服务标准不断滑落的行业中，新加坡航空被广泛视为卓越的典范。而鲜为人知的是，该公司还是民航业的成本领先者之一。新航成功执行差异化与成本领先的双重战略，这是不同寻常的。事实上，诸如迈克尔·波特等管理专家认为，长期做到这一点是不可能的，因为双重战略需要相互矛盾的投资和组织流程。然而，新航以及其他少数新兴经济体公司，将这些二元性视为构成一个整体的对立面。新航通过管理四对悖论来执行其双重战略：以成本效益方式实现卓越服务、培育集中式与分散式创新、既做技术领导者又做技术追随者，以及利用标准化实现个性化。结果不言自明：新航实现了健康的财务回报；它从未出现过年度亏损；除最初的资本注入外，这家亚洲航空公司在每年支付股利的同时依靠自身为增长提供资金。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock repurchases and liquidity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We analyze the impact of share repurchases on liquidity based on a new comprehensive data set of realized share repurchases in the US, which covers 50,204 repurchase months between 2004 and 2010. Raw markdown: hillert-2016-stock-repurchases-and-liquidity…
pages.text: Stock repurchases and liquidity (2016) Paper claim — We analyze the impact of share repurchases on liquidity based on a new comprehensive data set of realized share repurchases in the US, which covers 50,204 repurchase months between 2004 and 2010. Raw markdown: hillert-2016-stock-repurchases-and-liquidity Bibliographic Record Authors: Hillert, A, Maug, E, Obernberger, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2015.08.009 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase, stock repurchase) Abstract We analyze the impact of share repurchases on liquidity based on a new comprehensive data set of realized share repurchases in the US, which covers 50,204 repurchase months between 2004 and 2010. Using instrumental variable analysis, we show that repurchases unequivocally improve liquidity and suggest that endogenous controls have confounded results in earlier studies. Liquidity also influences how firms execute repurchase programs. Repurchases provide liquidity when other investors sell the firm's stock or in times of crisis. No evidence exists that firms reduce liquidity when they trade on private information. (C) 2015 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们基于一个关于美国已实现股份回购的全新综合数据集分析股份回购对流动性的影响，该数据集涵盖了2004年至2010年间的50,204个回购月份。使用工具变量分析，我们表明回购毫无疑问地改善了流动性，并提示内生性控制变量混淆了早期研究的结果。流动性也影响公司执行回购计划的方式。当其他投资者出售公司股票时或在危机时期，回购提供了流动性。没有证据表明公司在依据私有信息交易时会降低流动性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend taxation and the ownership structure of private firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the effect of dividend taxation on the ownership structure of private firms. Raw markdown: hillmann-2023-dividend-taxation-and-the-ownership-structure-of-private Bibliographic Record Authors: Hillmann, L Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: Dividend taxation and the ownership structure of private firms (2023) Paper claim — This paper examines the effect of dividend taxation on the ownership structure of private firms. Raw markdown: hillmann-2023-dividend-taxation-and-the-ownership-structure-of-private Bibliographic Record Authors: Hillmann, L Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2023.102380 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper examines the effect of dividend taxation on the ownership structure of private firms. I exploit a German dividend tax increase that only affects corporate shareholders owning a mi-nority stake. Using data on private German firms and their shareholders, I find that corporate shareholders reduce their minority stakes in firms after the dividend tax reform. This result is in line with the notion that, because minority shareholders do not have sufficient decision-making power to influence the payout policy, they can only react to a dividend tax increase by selling their shares. This effect is larger when the affected minority shareholders face high dividend tax costs. However, I find a smaller effect when the benefits of the minority stakes are highly relevant for the firm and the affected shareholders, suggesting that non-tax factors mute the response to dividend taxes. In addition, I find that the largest shareholder of the firm buys the minority stake, resulting in greater ownership concentration. These findings extend the prior literature that finds no effect of dividend taxes on the ownership structure of private firms. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了股利税收对民营企业所有权结构的影响。我利用德国一项仅影响持有少数股权的公司股东的股利税上调。使用德国民营企业及其股东的数据，我发现在股利税改革后，公司股东减少了其在企业中的少数股权。这一结果与以下观点相符：由于少数股东没有足够的决策权来影响支付政策，他们只能通过出售其股份来应对股利税上调。当受影响的少数股东面临较高的股利税成本时，这一效应更大。然而，当少数股权的收益对企业和受影响的股东高度重要时，我发现的效应较小，这表明非税收因素抑制了对股利税的反应。此外，我发现企业的最大股东会买入这些少数股权，导致所有权集中度提高。这些发现拓展了先前认为股利税对民营企业所有权结构没有影响的文献。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and profits: Same unsubtle foreign influences
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — American corporations earn a significant share of their profits from foreign sources, out of which they appear to pay dividends at rates that are three times higher than their payout rates from domestic profits. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Dividends and profits: Same unsubtle foreign influences (1996) Paper claim — American corporations earn a significant share of their profits from foreign sources, out of which they appear to pay dividends at rates that are three times higher than their payout rates from domestic profits. Raw markdown: hines-1996-dividends-and-profits-same-unsubtle-foreign-influences Bibliographic Record Authors: Hines, JR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.1996.tb02698.x Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract American corporations earn a significant share of their profits from foreign sources, out of which they appear to pay dividends at rates that are three times higher than their payout rates from domestic profits. Why firms do so is unclear, although this behavior is consistent with the use of dividends to signal profitability. This payout behavior implies that a significant part of the U.S. tax revenue generated by the foreign profits of U.S. corporations arises through the taxation of dividends received by individuals, and that the cost of capital may be higher for foreign than for domestic operations. 摘要（中文） 美国企业从外国来源赚取了其利润中相当大的份额，而它们从中派发股利的比率似乎是其从国内利润派现比率的三倍。企业为何如此做尚不清楚，尽管这种行为与使用股利来传递盈利能力信号的做法相一致。这种支付行为意味着，美国企业外国利润所产生的美国税收收入中有相当一部分来自对个人所获股利的征税，并且外国经营的资本成本可能高于国内经营。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE IMPACT OF CALLS OF PREFERRED STOCK ON COMMON SHAREHOLDERS WEALTH
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the behavior of common stock prices around the announcement dates of calls of straight and convertible preferred stock. Raw markdown: hingorani-1994-the-impact-of-calls-of-preferred-stock-on Bibliographic Record Authors: HINGORANI, A, MAKHIJA,…
pages.text: THE IMPACT OF CALLS OF PREFERRED STOCK ON COMMON SHAREHOLDERS WEALTH (1994) Paper claim — This paper examines the behavior of common stock prices around the announcement dates of calls of straight and convertible preferred stock. Raw markdown: hingorani-1994-the-impact-of-calls-of-preferred-stock-on Bibliographic Record Authors: HINGORANI, A, MAKHIJA, AK, SHASTRI, K Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00062-X Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout) Abstract This paper examines the behavior of common stock prices around the announcement dates of calls of straight and convertible preferred stock. Our results indicate that calls of in-the-money convertibles result in a decrease in stock price. On the other hand, we find that calls of out-of-the-money convertibles are associated with stock price increases. In addition, our results indicate that the negative price impact of in-the-money calls is related to the reduction in cash dividend payout induced by the conversion of preferred stock to common stock, and not related to whether the call is underwritten or not, and the ''moneyness'' of the convertible preferred. Finally, we find that calls of straight preferred that are financed with debt result in an increase in stock price, while all other straight preferred calls have no impact on stock price. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了在直接优先股和可转换优先股赎回公告日前后普通股价格的表现。我们的结果表明，价内可转换优先股的赎回导致股价下降。另一方面，我们发现价外可转换优先股的赎回与股价上升相关联。此外，我们的结果表明，价内赎回的负向价格影响与优先股转换为普通股所引起的现金股利支付的减少相关，而与赎回是否被承销以及可转换优先股的价内价外程度无关。最后，我们发现以债务融资的直接优先股赎回导致股价上升，而所有其他直接优先股赎回对股价没有影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Computing the Nondominated Surface in Tri-Criterion Portfolio Selection
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Computing the nondominated set of a multiple objective mathematical program has long been a topic in multiple criteria decision making. Raw markdown: hirschberger-2013-computing-the-nondominated-surface-in-tri-criterion-portfolio Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Computing the Nondominated Surface in Tri-Criterion Portfolio Selection (2013) Paper claim — Computing the nondominated set of a multiple objective mathematical program has long been a topic in multiple criteria decision making. Raw markdown: hirschberger-2013-computing-the-nondominated-surface-in-tri-criterion-portfolio Bibliographic Record Authors: Hirschberger, M, Steuer, RE, Utz, S, Wimmer, M, Qi, Y Journal: OPERATIONS RESEARCH Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1287/opre.1120.1140 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Computing the nondominated set of a multiple objective mathematical program has long been a topic in multiple criteria decision making. In this paper, motivated by the desire to extend Markowitz portfolio selection to an additional linear criterion (dividends, liquidity, sustainability, etc.), we demonstrate an exact method for computing the nondominated set of a tri-criterion program that is all linear except for the fact that one of its objectives is to minimize a convex quadratic function. With the nondominated set of the resulting quad-lin-lin program being a surface composed of curved platelets, a multiparametric algorithm is devised for computing the platelets so that they can be graphed precisely. In this way, graphs of the tri-criterion nondominated surface can be displayed so that, as in traditional portfolio selection, a most preferred portfolio can be selected while in full view of all other contenders for optimality. Finally, by giving an example for socially responsible investors, we demonstrate that our algorithm can outperform standard portfolio strategies for multicriterial decision makers. 摘要（中文） 计算多目标数学规划的非支配集，长期以来一直是多准则决策中的一个课题。在本文中，出于将马科维茨证券组合选择扩展到额外一个线性准则（股利、流动性、可持续性等）的意愿，我们展示了一种精确方法，用于计算一个三准则规划的非支配集，该规划除其目标之一为最小化一个凸二次函数外，其余全部为线性。由于所得的二次-线性-线性规划的非支配集是一个由弯曲小片组成的曲面，我们设计了一种多参数算法来计算这些小片，以便能够精确绘制它们。通过这种方式，可以展示三准则非支配曲面的图形，从而如同传统证券组合选择那样，在全面审视所有其他最优候选者的同时选出最偏好的组合。最后，通过给出一个针对社会责任投资者的算例，我们证明我们的算法在多准则决策情形下能够胜过标准的组合策略。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Predicting Global Stock Returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — I test for stock return predictability in the largest and most comprehensive data set analyzed so far, using four common forecasting variables: the dividend-price (DP) and earnings-price (EP) ratios, the short interest rate, and the term spread. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Predicting Global Stock Returns (2010) Paper claim — I test for stock return predictability in the largest and most comprehensive data set analyzed so far, using four common forecasting variables: the dividend-price (DP) and earnings-price (EP) ratios, the short interest rate, and the term spread. Raw markdown: hjalmarsson-2010-predicting-global-stock-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Hjalmarsson, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109009990469 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract I test for stock return predictability in the largest and most comprehensive data set analyzed so far, using four common forecasting variables: the dividend-price (DP) and earnings-price (EP) ratios, the short interest rate, and the term spread. The data contain over 20,000 monthly observations from 40 international markets, including 24 developed and 16 emerging economies. In addition, I develop new. methods for predictive regressions with panel data. Inference based on the standard fixed effects estimator is shown to suffer from severe size distortions in the typical stock return regression, and an alternative robust estimator is proposed. The empirical results indicate that the short interest rate and the term spread are fairly robust predictors of stock returns in developed markets. In contrast, no strong or consistent evidence of predictability is found when considering the EP and DP ratios as predictors. 摘要（中文） 我在迄今为止所分析的最大、最全面的数据集中检验股票收益的可预测性，使用四个常见的预测变量：股利-价格比（DP）、盈余-价格比（EP）、短期利率和期限利差。数据包含来自40个国际市场（包括24个发达经济体和16个新兴经济体）的两万多个月度观测值。此外，我为面板数据的预测回归开发了新方法。研究表明，基于标准固定效应估计量的推断在典型的股票收益回归中存在严重的规模扭曲（size distortions），并提出了一个替代性的稳健估计量。实证结果表明，短期利率和期限利差是发达市场股票收益相当稳健的预测变量。相比之下，将EP和DP比率作为预测变量时，未发现可预测性的强有力或一致的证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The investment opportunity set, director ownership, and corporate policies: evidence from an emerging market
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper provides evidence of the association between a firm's investment opportunity set (IOS), director ownership, and corporate policy choices. Raw markdown: ho-2004-the-investment-opportunity-set-director-ownership-and-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: The investment opportunity set, director ownership, and corporate policies: evidence from an emerging market (2004) Paper claim — This paper provides evidence of the association between a firm's investment opportunity set (IOS), director ownership, and corporate policy choices. Raw markdown: ho-2004-the-investment-opportunity-set-director-ownership-and-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: Ho, SSM, Lam, KCK, Sami, H Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1016/S0929-1199(02)00024-X Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper provides evidence of the association between a firm's investment opportunity set (IOS), director ownership, and corporate policy choices. Using a sample of growth and non-growth firms in an emerging Asian market, we find that the IOS theory has significant explanatory power in the financing, dividend, executive compensation, and leasing aspects of corporate policies. Growth firms have lower debt-to-equity ratios and dividend yields, pay higher cash compensation and bonus amounts to their top executives, and finance a higher proportion of their asset acquisitions through operating leases. We also find that director ownership moderates and counteracts the association between IOS and corporate policies. Our results are consistent with contracting theory predictions that high director ownership mitigates the need for incentive or bonus compensation plans in growth firms. (C) 2002 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文提供了企业投资机会集（IOS）、董事持股与公司政策选择之间关联的证据。使用一个新兴亚洲市场中成长型和非成长型企业的样本，我们发现IOS理论在公司政策的融资、股利、高管薪酬和租赁等方面具有显著的解释力。成长型企业具有较低的债务-股权比率和股利收益率，向其高管支付更高的现金薪酬和奖金金额，并通过经营租赁为更高比例的资产收购提供融资。我们还发现，董事持股会调节并抵消IOS与公司政策之间的关联。我们的结果与契约理论的预测相一致，即高董事持股会缓解成长型企业对激励或奖金薪酬计划的需求。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Disappearing Dividends, Catering, and Risk
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Fama and French (2001a) show that the propensity to pay dividends declines significantly between 1978 and 1999. Raw markdown: hoberg-2009-disappearing-dividends-catering-and-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Hoberg, G, Prabhala, NR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: Disappearing Dividends, Catering, and Risk (2009) Paper claim — Fama and French (2001a) show that the propensity to pay dividends declines significantly between 1978 and 1999. Raw markdown: hoberg-2009-disappearing-dividends-catering-and-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Hoberg, G, Prabhala, NR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhn073 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(catering) Abstract Fama and French (2001a) show that the propensity to pay dividends declines significantly between 1978 and 1999. We examine this "disappearing dividends" puzzle through the lens of risk and report two main findings: (i) Risk is a significant determinant of the propensity to pay dividends, and it explains roughly 40% of disappearing dividends; (ii) We find little support for the view that disappearing dividends reflects firms' catering to transient fads for dividends. Absent risk controls, proxies for fads matter, but these proxies are insignificant once we control for risk. Our results are robust to an extensive battery of robustness tests that vary samples, time periods, proxies for fads, the types of empirical tests, and the nature of payout decisions made by firms. 摘要（中文） Fama和French（2001a）表明，派发股利的倾向在1978至1999年间显著下降。我们通过风险的视角考察这一"股利消失"之谜，并报告两个主要发现：（i）风险是派发股利倾向的显著决定因素，它解释了股利消失的大约40%；（ii）我们几乎没有发现证据支持股利消失反映了企业迎合对股利短暂风尚的观点。在没有风险控制的情况下，风尚的代理变量是重要的，但一旦我们控制了风险，这些代理变量就不显著了。我们的结果对一系列广泛的稳健性检验都是稳健的，这些检验改变了样本、时间段、风尚代理变量、实证检验类型以及企业所作支付决策的性质。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Product Market Threats, Payouts, and Financial Flexibility
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how product market threats influence firm payout policy and cash holdings. Raw markdown: hoberg-2014-product-market-threats-payouts-and-financial-flexibility Bibliographic Record Authors: Hoberg, G, Phillips, G, Prabhala, N Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE…
pages.text: Product Market Threats, Payouts, and Financial Flexibility (2014) Paper claim — We examine how product market threats influence firm payout policy and cash holdings. Raw markdown: hoberg-2014-product-market-threats-payouts-and-financial-flexibility Bibliographic Record Authors: Hoberg, G, Phillips, G, Prabhala, N Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12050 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine how product market threats influence firm payout policy and cash holdings. Using firms' product text descriptions, we develop new measures of competitive threats. Our primary measure, product market fluidity, captures changes in rival firms' products relative to the firm's products. We show that fluidity decreases firm propensity to make payouts via dividends or repurchases and increases the cash held by firms, especially for firms with less access to financial markets. These results are consistent with the hypothesis that firms' financial policies are significantly shaped by product market threats and dynamics. 摘要（中文） 我们考察产品市场威胁如何影响公司的支付政策和现金持有。利用公司的产品文本描述，我们开发了衡量竞争威胁的新指标。我们的主要指标——产品市场流动性（product market fluidity）——刻画了竞争对手公司产品相对于本公司产品的变化。我们表明，流动性会降低公司通过股利或回购进行派发的意愿，并增加公司持有的现金，对于较难进入金融市场的公司尤其如此。这些结果与以下假说相一致：公司的财务政策在很大程度上受到产品市场威胁和动态变化的塑造。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
