pages.title: DIVIDEND YIELDS AND EXPECTED STOCK RETURNS - ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURES FOR INFERENCE AND MEASUREMENT
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Alternative ways of conducting inference and measurement for long-horizon forecasting are explored with an application to dividend yields as predictors of stock returns. Raw markdown: hodrick-1992-dividend-yields-and-expected-stock-returns-alternative-procedures…
pages.text: DIVIDEND YIELDS AND EXPECTED STOCK RETURNS - ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURES FOR INFERENCE AND MEASUREMENT (1992) Paper claim — Alternative ways of conducting inference and measurement for long-horizon forecasting are explored with an application to dividend yields as predictors of stock returns. Raw markdown: hodrick-1992-dividend-yields-and-expected-stock-returns-alternative-procedures Bibliographic Record Authors: HODRICK, RJ Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1992 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/5.3.357 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Alternative ways of conducting inference and measurement for long-horizon forecasting are explored with an application to dividend yields as predictors of stock returns. Monte Carlo analysis indicates that the Hansen and Hodrick (1980)procedure is biased at long horizons, but the alternatives perform better. These include an estimator derived under the null hypothesis as in Richardson and Smith (1991), a reformulation of the regression as in Jegadeesh (1990), and a vector autoregression (VAR) as in Campbell and Shiller (1988), Kandel and Stambaugh (1988), and Campbell (1991). The statistical properties of long-horizon statistics generated from the VAR indicate interesting patterns in expected stock returns. 摘要（中文） 本文探讨了进行长期视野预测的推断和测量的替代方法，并将其应用于以股利收益率作为股票收益预测变量的情形。蒙特卡洛分析表明，Hansen和Hodrick（1980）的程序在长期视野上存在偏误，但其替代方法表现更好。这些替代方法包括：如Richardson和Smith（1991）那样在原假设下推导出的估计量、如Jegadeesh（1990）那样对回归进行的重新表述，以及如Campbell和Shiller（1988）、Kandel和Stambaugh（1988）以及Campbell（1991）那样的向量自回归（VAR）。由VAR生成的长期视野统计量的统计性质揭示了预期股票收益中有趣的模式。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using information collected from the Swedish tax authorities, we calculate insiders' actual effective tax rates on dividends. Raw markdown: holmen-2008-inside-shareholders-effective-tax-rates-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Holmen, M, Knopf, JD,…
pages.text: Inside shareholders' effective tax rates and dividends (2008) Paper claim — Using information collected from the Swedish tax authorities, we calculate insiders' actual effective tax rates on dividends. Raw markdown: holmen-2008-inside-shareholders-effective-tax-rates-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Holmen, M, Knopf, JD, Peterson, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2007.12.048 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Using information collected from the Swedish tax authorities, we calculate insiders' actual effective tax rates on dividends. With this unique dataset, we find a significant negative cross-sectional relationship between insiders' effective tax rates and dividend payout. This result is consistent with a tax-induced clientele effect for dividends. We also look at the impact of large block trades on dividends. We find that when insiders with zero effective taxes sell blocks. subsequent dividend payments are significantly more likely to decrease. This provides evidence that large shareholders are adjusting dividends for their individual tax Situations. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用从瑞典税务机关收集的信息，计算了内部人在股利上的实际有效税率。借助这一独特的数据集，我们发现内部人有效税率与股利派现之间存在显著的负向横截面关系。这一结果与由税收诱发的股利投资者群体效应相一致。我们还考察了大宗股权交易对股利的影响。我们发现，当有效税率为零的内部人出售大宗股权时，随后的股利支付显著更有可能减少。这提供了证据表明，大股东会根据其个人的税收状况来调整股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How Important are Dividend Signals in Assessing Earnings Persistence?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We build and test a Bayesian model that shows how investors revise their earnings persistence expectations after dividend announcements. Raw markdown: homburg-2018-how-important-are-dividend-signals-in-assessing-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Homburg, C,…
pages.text: How Important are Dividend Signals in Assessing Earnings Persistence? (2018) Paper claim — We build and test a Bayesian model that shows how investors revise their earnings persistence expectations after dividend announcements. Raw markdown: homburg-2018-how-important-are-dividend-signals-in-assessing-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Homburg, C, Müller, C, Nasev, J Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12443 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We build and test a Bayesian model that shows how investors revise their earnings persistence expectations after dividend announcements. When dividend changes confirm preceding earnings changes, our model predicts inverse u-shaped investor revisions conditional on the prior expectations for noisy dividend signals. As the dividend signal becomes more informative, our model predicts that investor revisions will become more skewed converging to a monotonically decreasing relation for perfectly informative dividend signals. When dividend changes contradict preceding earnings changes, our model predicts u-shaped investor revisions. In empirical tests, we find results generally consistent with our model predictions. 摘要（中文） 我们构建并检验了一个贝叶斯模型，该模型展示了投资者在股利公告后如何修正其对盈余持久性的预期。当股利变动证实了先前的盈余变动时，我们的模型预测：在噪声性股利信号的先验预期条件下，投资者修正呈倒U形。随着股利信号变得更具信息量，我们的模型预测投资者修正将变得更为偏斜，对于完全信息性的股利信号则趋于一种单调递减的关系。当股利变动与先前盈余变动相矛盾时，我们的模型预测投资者修正呈U形。在实证检验中，我们发现结果总体上与我们的模型预测相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Political corruption and corporate payouts (2021) Paper claim — Firms headquartered in more corrupt US environments (states) provide higher payouts to their shareholders. Raw markdown: hossain-2021-political-corruption-and-corporate-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Hossain, AT, Hossain, T, Kryzanowski, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2020.106016 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Firms headquartered in more corrupt US environments (states) provide higher payouts to their shareholders. Our results are robust to, for example propensity score matching, instrumental variable approach, headquarters relocations, quasi natural experiments using exogenous shocks, use of alternative measures of corruption and payouts, use of additional (possibly omitted) variables, and various alternative explanations based on additional channels and moderating factors. Our study finds that the use and marginal value of dividend payout as a shielding channel is affected by state-level corruption. Our study also adds geographic-based shielding as another important motivation for firms to make corporate payouts. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 总部位于美国腐败程度更高环境（州）的企业，向其股东提供更高的支付。我们的结果对以下方法都是稳健的：例如倾向得分匹配、工具变量方法、总部迁址、利用外生冲击的准自然实验、使用腐败和支付的替代度量、使用额外的（可能被遗漏的）变量，以及基于额外渠道和调节因素的各种替代解释。我们的研究发现，股利支付作为一种庇护渠道的使用及其边际价值受到州级腐败的影响。我们的研究还将基于地理的庇护作为企业进行公司支付的另一个重要动机。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: CEO marital status and dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate whether and how CEO marital status is related to dividend policy. Raw markdown: hossain-2023-ceo-marital-status-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Hossain, MN, Rabarison, MK, Ater, B, Sobngwi, CK Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: CEO marital status and dividend policy (2023) Paper claim — We investigate whether and how CEO marital status is related to dividend policy. Raw markdown: hossain-2023-ceo-marital-status-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Hossain, MN, Rabarison, MK, Ater, B, Sobngwi, CK Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102342 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We investigate whether and how CEO marital status is related to dividend policy. We find that firms run by single CEOs are less likely to pay dividends. Further analyses reveal that the aforementioned relation is stronger for single CEOs who are more risk-seeking, have compensation packages with lower pay-performance sensitivity, are less conservative, or are less engaged in corporate social responsibility activities. Our results hold in multiple robustness and endogeneity tests, including propensity score matching, difference-in-differences estimation, and an instrumental variable regression. Overall, our findings contribute to the literature highlighting the importance of CEOs' personal attributes for corporate decisions. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了CEO婚姻状况是否以及如何与股利政策相关。我们发现由单身CEO管理的公司支付股利的可能性更低。进一步的分析揭示，上述关系对于以下单身CEO更强：更追求风险、拥有薪酬-绩效敏感性较低的薪酬方案、较不保守或较少参与企业社会责任活动的CEO。我们的结果在多项稳健性和内生性检验中成立，包括倾向得分匹配、双重差分估计和工具变量回归。总体而言，我们的发现为强调CEO个人特质对公司决策重要性的文献做出了贡献。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: ONE-TIME CASH FLOW ANNOUNCEMENTS AND FREE CASH-FLOW THEORY - SHARE REPURCHASES AND SPECIAL DIVIDENDS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The leading explanation for the positive price response surrounding tender offer share repurchase and specially designated dividend (SDD) announcements is the information signaling hypothesis. Raw markdown: howe-1992-one-time-cash-flow-announcements-and-free-cash…
pages.text: ONE-TIME CASH FLOW ANNOUNCEMENTS AND FREE CASH-FLOW THEORY - SHARE REPURCHASES AND SPECIAL DIVIDENDS (1992) Paper claim — The leading explanation for the positive price response surrounding tender offer share repurchase and specially designated dividend (SDD) announcements is the information signaling hypothesis. Raw markdown: howe-1992-one-time-cash-flow-announcements-and-free-cash Bibliographic Record Authors: HOWE, KM, HE, J, KAO, GW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2329004 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow, signal) Abstract The leading explanation for the positive price response surrounding tender offer share repurchase and specially designated dividend (SDD) announcements is the information signaling hypothesis. This paper reexamines these announcements to determine if Jensen's free cash-flow theory also has explanatory power. Lang and Litzenberger's (1989) findings suggest an important role for the free cash-flow theory in explaining the market's reaction to dividend changes. In contrast, we find the market's reaction to share repurchases and SDDs is approximately the same for both high-Q and low-Q firms. We thus have an empirical puzzle: If Jensen's free cash-flow theory applies to dividend changes, it is difficult to see why it does not also apply to the analogous events examined here. 摘要（中文） 对要约收购式股份回购和特别指定股利（SDD）公告前后正向价格反应的主流解释是信息信号假说。本文重新考察这些公告，以确定Jensen的自由现金流理论是否也具有解释力。Lang和Litzenberger（1989）的发现表明自由现金流理论在解释市场对股利变化反应方面具有重要作用。相比之下，我们发现市场对股份回购和SDD的反应对高Q和低Q企业大致相同。因此我们面临一个实证难题：如果Jensen的自由现金流理论适用于股利变化，那么很难理解它为何不同样适用于此处考察的类似事件。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Insiders' tax preferences and firms' choices between dividends and share repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates whether corporate payout policy is associated with insiders' share holdings and their tax preferences. Raw markdown: hsieh-2008-insiders-tax-preferences-and-firms-choices-between-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Hsieh, J, Wang, QH…
pages.text: Insiders' tax preferences and firms' choices between dividends and share repurchases (2008) Paper claim — This paper investigates whether corporate payout policy is associated with insiders' share holdings and their tax preferences. Raw markdown: hsieh-2008-insiders-tax-preferences-and-firms-choices-between-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Hsieh, J, Wang, QH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000002805 Relevance score: 13.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase, stock repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper investigates whether corporate payout policy is associated with insiders' share holdings and their tax preferences. We find that insider ownership and the implied tax liabilities are positively related to a firm's propensity to employ share repurchases. Firms with higher levels of or greater increases in insider ownership prefer stock repurchases to cash dividends. This relation is more significant in years when dividends were more tax disadvantaged relative to capital gains. Our findings are robust to the endogeneity of insider ownership and the inclusion of various control variables such as firm size, permanence of cash flows, growth opportunities, institutional ownership, and executive stock options. Overall, our results suggest that personal tax considerations from insiders affect corporate payout decisions. 摘要（中文） 本文考察公司支付政策是否与内部人的持股及其税收偏好相关。我们发现，内部人持股及其隐含的税负与企业采用股份回购的倾向正相关。内部人持股水平较高或增幅较大的企业，更偏好股份回购而非现金股利。这一关系在股利相对于资本利得税收劣势更明显的年份更为显著。我们的发现对内部人持股的内生性以及纳入各种控制变量（如企业规模、现金流的持久性、成长机会、机构持股和高管股票期权）都是稳健的。总体而言，我们的结果表明，内部人的个人税收考量影响了公司的支付决策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The role of earnings information in corporate dividend decisions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the role of earnings information in the determination of dividend policy. Raw markdown: hsu-1998-the-role-of-earnings-information-in-corporate-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Hsu, JM, Wang, XM, Wu, CC Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year:…
pages.text: The role of earnings information in corporate dividend decisions (1998) Paper claim — This paper examines the role of earnings information in the determination of dividend policy. Raw markdown: hsu-1998-the-role-of-earnings-information-in-corporate-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Hsu, JM, Wang, XM, Wu, CC Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.44.12.S173 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines the role of earnings information in the determination of dividend policy. I We decompose accounting earnings into permanent and transitory components and postulate that dividend policy is driven by sustainable permanent earnings. Two measures of permanent earnings are proposed. The first is a permanent earnings variable extracted from accounting earnings by a random-level shift ARMA model. The second measure is stock price times cost of capital. These two permanent earnings measures are employed in the Marsh-Merton (1987) model to explain corporate dividend behavior and their performance is compared. A generalized friction method is adopted for empirical estimation to account for stepwise dividend movements over time. Results show that the permanent earnings measure extracted from accounting earnings data explains dividend dynamic behavior better than stock price. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了盈余信息在股利政策决定中的作用。我们将会计盈余分解为持久性成分和暂时性成分，并假设股利政策由可持续的持久性盈余所驱动。本文提出了两种持久性盈余的度量。第一种是通过一个随机水平移动ARMA模型从会计盈余中提取的持久性盈余变量。第二种度量是股价乘以资本成本。这两种持久性盈余度量被用于Marsh-Merton（1987）模型来解释公司股利行为，并比较其表现。实证估计采用广义摩擦法以考虑股利随时间的逐步变动。结果表明，从会计盈余数据中提取的持久性盈余度量比股价更好地解释了股利的动态行为。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managerial entrenchment and payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Building on the managerial entrenchment literature, we develop and test a novel perspective on payout policy that integrates the influence of internal governance mechanisms, investment opportunities, management compensation, and monitoring by large shareholders.…
pages.text: Managerial entrenchment and payout policy (2004) Paper claim — Building on the managerial entrenchment literature, we develop and test a novel perspective on payout policy that integrates the influence of internal governance mechanisms, investment opportunities, management compensation, and monitoring by large shareholders. Raw markdown: hu-2004-managerial-entrenchment-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Hu, AD, Kumar, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000003203 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract Building on the managerial entrenchment literature, we develop and test a novel perspective on payout policy that integrates the influence of internal governance mechanisms, investment opportunities, management compensation, and monitoring by large shareholders. Our study incorporates both dividend payments and share repurchases, and examines the determinants of the likelihood and the level of payouts. Our model performs well in both in-sample and out-of-sample predictions on a sample of 2,081 firms during 1992-2000. We find that both the likelihood and the level of payouts are significantly and positively (negatively) related to factors that increase (decrease) executive entrenchment levels, even when controlling for size, leverage, and the proportion of tangible to total assets. We identify factors that significantly affect the likelihood but not the level of payouts (or vice versa), and show that entrenchment has an asymmetric influence on dividend vs. shares repurchase policy. 摘要（中文） 在管理层壕沟自守文献的基础上，我们提出并检验了一种关于支付政策的新视角，该视角整合了内部治理机制、投资机会、管理层薪酬以及大股东监督的影响。我们的研究同时纳入了股利支付和股份回购，并考察了支付的可能性和水平的决定因素。我们的模型在1992—2000年间2,081家企业样本的样本内和样本外预测中均表现良好。我们发现，即使在控制规模、杠杆以及有形资产占总资产比例之后，支付的可能性和水平都与增加（减少）高管壕沟自守水平的因素显著正（负）相关。我们识别出显著影响支付可能性但不影响支付水平（或反之）的因素，并表明壕沟自守对股利与股份回购政策具有不对称的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Inventory Management and Debt Maturity Structure (2017) Paper claim — The current literature on the coordination of operations and finance does not differentiate long- and short-term debts and therefore is silent on how firms' debt maturity structure affects their short-run financial and operational decisions. Raw markdown: hu-2017-inventory-management-and-debt-maturity-structure Bibliographic Record Authors: Hu, QH Journal: PRODUCTION AND OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1111/poms.12720 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract The current literature on the coordination of operations and finance does not differentiate long- and short-term debts and therefore is silent on how firms' debt maturity structure affects their short-run financial and operational decisions. Through a dynamic inventory model that explicitly captures a firm's periodic decisions on inventory replenishment quantity, the amount of dividends net of capital subscriptions, and the amount of short-term debt, we demonstrate that under coordinated short-term operational and financial decisions, the firm's optimal inventory level increases initially as its long-term debt rises; after the firm depletes its short-term borrowing capacity, as the long-term debt rises further, the inventory level decreases and then remains constant. In addition, we find that optimal coordinated decisions, in comparison with decentralized ones, yield lower inventories, require less cash, take larger short-term loans, incur a lower probability of financial distress, and yield higher expected dividends net of capital subscriptions. Moreover, long- and short-term debts are substitutes; an optimally leveraged firm needs less long-term debt if it coordinates its short-term decisions than if it decentralizes them. 摘要（中文） 当前关于运营与财务协调的文献没有区分长期与短期债务，因此对企业的债务期限结构如何影响其短期财务与运营决策保持沉默。通过一个动态存货模型，该模型明确刻画了企业关于存货补充数量、扣除资本认购后的股利净额以及短期债务数量的周期性决策，我们证明：在协调的短期运营与财务决策下，随着长期债务上升，企业最优存货水平最初上升；在企业耗尽其短期借款能力之后，随着长期债务进一步上升，存货水平下降然后保持恒定。此外，我们发现与分散化决策相比，最优协调决策产生更低的存货、需要更少的现金、借入更多的短期贷款、发生更低的财务困境概率，并产生更高的预期扣除资本认购后的股利净额。而且，长期与短期债务是替代品；如果企业协调其短期决策，相比于分散化决策，最优杠杆企业所需的长期债务更少。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Nonnegotiable shares, controlling shareholders, and dividend payments in China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — China has some unique institutional features. Raw markdown: huang-2011-nonnegotiable-shares-controlling-shareholders-and-dividend-payments-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, JJ, Shen, YF, Sun, Q Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI:…
pages.text: Nonnegotiable shares, controlling shareholders, and dividend payments in China (2011) Paper claim — China has some unique institutional features. Raw markdown: huang-2011-nonnegotiable-shares-controlling-shareholders-and-dividend-payments-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, JJ, Shen, YF, Sun, Q Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2010.09.007 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy, regulat)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout) Abstract China has some unique institutional features. For example, the shares of listed firms are segmented into negotiable and nonnegotiable ones. The controlling shareholders, usually connected to the government, hold nonnegotiable shares. We examine how these institutional features affected cash dividend payments in China during the period 1994-2006. We find that dividend payments are positively associated with the proportion of nonnegotiable shares in a firm and the proportion of nonnegotiable shares held by the controlling shareholder; moreover, the 2001 China Securities Regulatory Commission stipulation requiring cash dividend payments does not benefit negotiable shareholders. However, we also find that dividend payments are downside flexible, and controlling shareholders cannot force firms to pay or to pay more dividends when firms' earnings decline significantly. The conventional factors, especially profitability or the capability to pay, still play an important role in determining the dividend policy. The propensity to pay and the payout ratio in China are not high compared to those of other countries. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 中国具有一些独特的制度特征。例如，上市企业的股份被分割为流通股和非流通股。控股股东（通常与政府有关联）持有非流通股。我们考察了这些制度特征在1994—2006年期间如何影响中国的现金股利支付。我们发现，股利支付与企业中非流通股的比例以及控股股东所持非流通股的比例正相关；此外，2001年中国证监会要求支付现金股利的规定并未使流通股股东受益。然而，我们还发现，股利支付具有向下的灵活性，当企业盈利显著下降时，控股股东无法迫使企业支付或支付更多股利。传统因素，尤其是盈利能力或支付能力，在决定股利政策中仍发挥重要作用。与其他国家相比，中国的支付倾向和支付率都不高。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Investor Heterogeneity, Investor-Management Disagreement and Share Repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops and tests a new theoretical explanation for stock repurchases. Raw markdown: huang-2013-investor-heterogeneity-investor-management-disagreement-and-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, S, Thakor, AV Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: Investor Heterogeneity, Investor-Management Disagreement and Share Repurchases (2013) Paper claim — This paper develops and tests a new theoretical explanation for stock repurchases. Raw markdown: huang-2013-investor-heterogeneity-investor-management-disagreement-and-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, S, Thakor, AV Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hht043 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase, stock repurchase) Abstract This paper develops and tests a new theoretical explanation for stock repurchases. Investors may disagree with the manager about the firm's investment projects. Arepurchase causes a change in the investor base as investors who are most likely to disagree with the manager tender their shares. Therefore, a firm is more likely to buy back shares when the level of investor-management agreement is lower, and agreement improves as a consequence. Moreover, dispersion of opinion among investors cannot explain repurchase activity once the stock price and investor-management agreement are controlled for. Overall, the evidence is consistent with firms strategically using repurchases to improve alignment between management and shareholders. 摘要（中文） 本文提出并检验了一个关于股票回购的新理论解释。投资者可能在企业的投资项目上与管理者意见相左。回购会引起投资者基础的变化，因为那些最可能与管理者意见相左的投资者会卖出其股份。因此，当投资者与管理层的一致程度较低时，企业更有可能回购股份，并且一致程度会因此而改善。此外，一旦控制了股价和投资者与管理层的一致程度，投资者之间的意见分歧就无法解释回购活动。总体而言，证据与企业策略性地利用回购来改善管理层与股东之间一致性的观点相符。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Political risk and dividend policy: Evidence from international political crises
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the impact of political risk on firms' payout policy. Raw markdown: huang-2015-political-risk-and-dividend-policy-evidence-from-international Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, T, Wu, F, Yu, J, Zhang, BH Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS…
pages.text: Political risk and dividend policy: Evidence from international political crises (2015) Paper claim — We examine the impact of political risk on firms' payout policy. Raw markdown: huang-2015-political-risk-and-dividend-policy-evidence-from-international Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, T, Wu, F, Yu, J, Zhang, BH Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1057/jibs.2015.2 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, legal protection, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine the impact of political risk on firms' payout policy. Using a large international sample across 35 countries over the period from 1990 to 2008, we find that global political crises raise the market perceived uncertainty and cost of external financing. Using crisis events as a proxy for political risk, we document that past dividend payers are more likely to terminate dividends and that non-payers are less likely to initiate dividends during periods of high political risk. These findings suggest a precautionary incentive of managers in response to political shocks. Further analysis shows that the effect of political risk on payout policy is stronger for multinational corporations, but can be attenuated by country-specific institutional settings, such as more stable political systems and stronger investor legal protection. 摘要（中文） 我们考察政治风险对企业支付政策的影响。使用1990年至2008年期间涵盖35个国家的大型国际样本，我们发现，全球政治危机提高了市场感知的不确定性和外部融资成本。以危机事件作为政治风险的代理变量，我们记录到，在政治风险高的时期，过去的派息企业更可能终止股利，而不派息企业更不可能发起股利。这些发现表明经理人对政治冲击存在预防性动机。进一步分析表明，政治风险对支付政策的影响对跨国公司更强，但可以被国家特定的制度环境所减弱，如更稳定的政治体制和更强的投资者法律保护。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Private Equity Firms' Reputational Concerns and the Costs of Debt Financing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A popular view is that private equity (PE) firms tend to expropriate other stakeholders of their portfolio companies. Raw markdown: huang-2016-private-equity-firms-reputational-concerns-and-the-costs Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, RB, Ritter, JR, Zhang, DH…
pages.text: Private Equity Firms' Reputational Concerns and the Costs of Debt Financing (2016) Paper claim — A popular view is that private equity (PE) firms tend to expropriate other stakeholders of their portfolio companies. Raw markdown: huang-2016-private-equity-firms-reputational-concerns-and-the-costs Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, RB, Ritter, JR, Zhang, DH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109016000053 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract A popular view is that private equity (PE) firms tend to expropriate other stakeholders of their portfolio companies. Bonds offered during 1992-2011 by companies after their initial public offerings (IPOs) do not reflect this view. We find that yield spreads on bonds offered by PE-backed companies are, on average, 70 basis points lower, holding other things constant. We also find that PE-backed companies have more conservative investment and dividend policies after bond offerings compared with non-PE-backed companies. These results suggest that PE firms' reputational concerns dominate their wealth expropriation incentives and help their portfolio companies reduce the costs of debt. 摘要（中文） 一种流行的观点认为，私募股权（PE）公司倾向于侵占其投资组合公司的其他利益相关者。1992-2011年间由公司在首次公开发行（IPO）之后发行的债券并不反映这一观点。我们发现，在控制其他因素的情况下，PE支持公司发行的债券的收益率利差平均而言低70个基点。我们还发现，与非PE支持公司相比，PE支持公司在债券发行后拥有更为保守的投资和股利政策。这些结果表明，PE公司的声誉考量主导了其财富侵占动机，并帮助其投资组合公司降低债务成本。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of climate risk on firm performance and financing choices: An international comparison
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Increasingly adverse climatic conditions have created greater systematic risk for companies throughout the global economy. Raw markdown: huang-2018-the-impact-of-climate-risk-on-firm-performance Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, HH, Kerstein, J, Wang, C Journal:…
pages.text: The impact of climate risk on firm performance and financing choices: An international comparison (2018) Paper claim — Increasingly adverse climatic conditions have created greater systematic risk for companies throughout the global economy. Raw markdown: huang-2018-the-impact-of-climate-risk-on-firm-performance Bibliographic Record Authors: Huang, HH, Kerstein, J, Wang, C Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1057/s41267-017-0125-5 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract Increasingly adverse climatic conditions have created greater systematic risk for companies throughout the global economy. Few studies have directly examined the consequences of climate-related risk on financing choices by publicly listed firms across the globe. We attempt to do so using the Global Climate Risk Index compiled and published by Germanwatch (Kreft & Eckstein, 2014), which captures at the country level the extent of losses from extreme weather events. As expected, we find the likelihood of loss from major storms, flooding, heat waves, etc. to be associated with lower and more volatile earnings and cash flows. Consistent with policies that attempt to moderate such effects, we show that firms located in countries characterized by more severe weather are likelier to hold more cash so as to build financial slack and thereby organizational resilience to climatic threats. Those firms also tend to have less short-term debt but more long-term debt, and to be less likely to distribute cash dividends. In addition, we find that certain industries are less vulnerable to extreme weather and so face less climate-related risk. Our results are robust to using an instrumental variable approach, a propensity-score-matched sample, and path analysis, and remain unchanged when we consider an alternative measure of climate risk. Finally, our conclusions are invariant to the timing of financial crises that can affect different countries at different times. 摘要（中文） 日益不利的气候条件为整个全球经济中的公司带来了更大的系统性风险。很少有研究直接考察气候相关风险对全球公开上市企业融资选择的影响。我们尝试利用由德国观察（Germanwatch）（Kreft和Eckstein, 2014）编制并发布的全球气候风险指数来这样做，该指数在国家层面刻画了极端天气事件造成的损失程度。正如预期，我们发现，因大风暴、洪水、热浪等造成损失的可能性与更低且更为波动的收益和现金流相关联。与试图缓和此类影响的政策相一致，我们表明，位于天气更为恶劣国家的企业更可能持有更多现金，以建立财务缓冲，从而增强组织对气候威胁的韧性。这些企业还倾向于拥有更少的短期债务但更多的长期债务，并且更不可能派发现金股利。此外，我们发现某些行业对极端天气不那么脆弱，因而面临的气候相关风险更少。我们的结果在使用工具变量方法、倾向得分匹配样本和路径分析后依然稳健，并且在我们考虑另一种气候风险度量时保持不变。最后，我们的结论对可能在不同时间影响不同国家的金融危机的时机是不变的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Do investors ignore dividend taxation? A reexamination of the citizens utilities case (1997) Paper claim — Citizens Utilities Company (CU), Stamford, CT, has two classes of common stock, one paying cash dividends and one paying stock dividends, Unless CU shareholders ignore dividend taxation, the price of the cash dividend shares should increase relative to the stock dividend shares after the 1986 tax change, Contrary to this hypothesis, we find that the relative valuation of these two classes of shares was not permanently affected by the tax change. Raw markdown: hubbard-1997-do-investors-ignore-dividend-taxation-a-reexamination-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Hubbard, J, Michaely, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1997 DOI: 10.2307/2331319 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract Citizens Utilities Company (CU), Stamford, CT, has two classes of common stock, one paying cash dividends and one paying stock dividends, Unless CU shareholders ignore dividend taxation, the price of the cash dividend shares should increase relative to the stock dividend shares after the 1986 tax change, Contrary to this hypothesis, we find that the relative valuation of these two classes of shares was not permanently affected by the tax change. We do observe a pricing change around the time of the tax reform, but the effect is only temporary-the relative valuation before the tax change (1982-1984) and after (1987-1989) is almost equal. Two possible explanations for the observed valuation of the two stocks are clientele effects and differences in liquidity. We find that neither of these explanations can account for the relative pricing of the shares. 摘要（中文） Citizens Utilities公司（CU，位于康涅狄格州Stamford）有两类普通股，一类派发现金股利，一类派发股票股利。除非CU股东忽视股利税收，否则在1986年税制变化之后，现金股利股份的价格相对于股票股利股份应当上升。与这一假说相反，我们发现这两类股份的相对估值并未受到税制变化的永久性影响。我们确实观察到在税制改革前后出现了一次定价变化，但该效应只是暂时的——税制变化之前（1982-1984）和之后（1987-1989）的相对估值几乎相等。对观察到的这两只股票估值的两个可能解释是客户效应和流动性差异。我们发现，这两种解释都无法说明这两类股份的相对定价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a dynamic model of investment, financing, and cash management decisions in which investment is lumpy and firms face capital supply uncertainty. Raw markdown: hugonnier-2015-capital-supply-uncertainty-cash-holdings-and-investment Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Capital Supply Uncertainty, Cash Holdings, and Investment (2015) Paper claim — We develop a dynamic model of investment, financing, and cash management decisions in which investment is lumpy and firms face capital supply uncertainty. Raw markdown: hugonnier-2015-capital-supply-uncertainty-cash-holdings-and-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Hugonnier, J, Malamud, S, Morellec, E Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhu081 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We develop a dynamic model of investment, financing, and cash management decisions in which investment is lumpy and firms face capital supply uncertainty. We characterize optimal policies explicitly, demonstrate that smooth-pasting conditions may not guarantee optimality, and show that firms may not follow standard single barrier policies. In the model, firms with high investment costs differ in their behaviors from firms with low investment costs, financing policy does not follow a strict pecking order, and the optimal payout policy may feature several regions with both incremental and lumpy dividend payments. 摘要（中文） 我们构建了一个投资、融资和现金管理决策的动态模型，其中投资是块状的，且企业面临资本供给的不确定性。我们明确刻画了最优政策，证明了平滑粘贴条件可能无法保证最优性，并表明企业可能不会遵循标准的单一障碍政策。在该模型中，高投资成本的企业与低投资成本的企业在行为上有所不同，融资政策不遵循严格的啄食顺序，且最优支付政策可能呈现出多个区域，既有增量式股利支付也有块状股利支付。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Asset Pricing with Costly Short Sales
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study a dynamic general equilibrium model with costly-to-short stocks and heterogeneous beliefs. Raw markdown: hugonnier-2025-asset-pricing-with-costly-short-sales Bibliographic Record Authors: Hugonnier, J, Prieto, R Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2025 DOI:…
pages.text: Asset Pricing with Costly Short Sales (2025) Paper claim — We study a dynamic general equilibrium model with costly-to-short stocks and heterogeneous beliefs. Raw markdown: hugonnier-2025-asset-pricing-with-costly-short-sales Bibliographic Record Authors: Hugonnier, J, Prieto, R Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2023.01887 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, trade-off) Abstract We study a dynamic general equilibrium model with costly-to-short stocks and heterogeneous beliefs. Costly short sales drive a wedge between the valuation of assets that promise identical cash flows but that are subject to different trading arrangements. In particular, we show that the price of an asset is given by the risk-adjusted present value of its future cash flows, which include both dividends and an endogenous lending yield that we characterize explicitly. This valuation formula implies that stocks with low and high shorting costs should offer similar risk-return trade-off once returns are appropriately adjusted for lending revenues and thus, sheds light on recent empirical findings about the explanatory power of shorting costs in the cross-section of returns. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了一个具有做空成本高昂的股票和异质信念的动态一般均衡模型。高昂的做空成本在承诺相同现金流但受制于不同交易安排的资产估值之间打入了一个楔子。具体而言，我们表明资产价格等于其未来现金流的风险调整现值，这些现金流既包括股利，也包括我们明确刻画的一种内生借券收益（lending yield）。这一估值公式意味着，一旦收益对借券收入进行适当调整后，做空成本低和做空成本高的股票应提供相似的风险-收益权衡，从而为近期关于做空成本在收益截面中的解释力的经验发现提供了启示。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Analysts' Book Value Forecasts: Initial Evidence from the Perspective of Real-Options-Based Valuation
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the usefulness of analysts' book value forecasts and the economic factors driving analysts' issuance of these forecasts. Raw markdown: hui-2022-analysts-book-value-forecasts-initial-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Hui, KW, Liu,…
pages.text: Analysts' Book Value Forecasts: Initial Evidence from the Perspective of Real-Options-Based Valuation (2022) Paper claim — This study examines the usefulness of analysts' book value forecasts and the economic factors driving analysts' issuance of these forecasts. Raw markdown: hui-2022-analysts-book-value-forecasts-initial-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Hui, KW, Liu, AZ, Schneible, RA, Zhang, GC Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12787 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This study examines the usefulness of analysts' book value forecasts and the economic factors driving analysts' issuance of these forecasts. Guided by the real-options-based valuation model (ROM) of Zhang (2000), we explicitly link book value forecasts to the need for such information in valuation. We first establish that analysts' book value forecasts are superior to forecasts that are mechanically imputed from analysts' own earnings forecasts and those from random walk models and are incrementally informative beyond analysts' earnings, cash flow, and dividend forecasts. We then employ the ROM to explore the distinct information embedded in book value forecasts and analysts' decisions to issue these forecasts. Consistent with our expectations, we find that (i) book value forecasts convey growth information that is significantly correlated with ex ante indicators of real options, while analysts' earnings forecasts do not display this property; and (ii) analysts issue more book value forecasts when either growth options or, to a lesser extent, abandonment options are an important part of firm value. Our study sheds light on how analysts' book value forecasts are useful and under what circumstances analysts provide such information to meet investors' needs. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察分析师账面价值预测的有用性以及驱动分析师发布这些预测的经济因素。在Zhang（2000）基于实物期权的估值模型（ROM）指导下，我们明确地将账面价值预测与估值中对此类信息的需求联系起来。我们首先确认，分析师的账面价值预测优于从分析师自身盈利预测中机械推算的预测以及随机游走模型的预测，并且在分析师的盈利、现金流和股利预测之外具有增量信息含量。随后我们运用ROM来探究账面价值预测中蕴含的独特信息以及分析师发布这些预测的决策。与我们的预期一致，我们发现：（i）账面价值预测传递了增长信息，该信息与实物期权的事前指标显著相关，而分析师的盈利预测则不具有这一特性；（ii）当增长期权，或在较小程度上放弃期权（abandonment options）是企业价值的重要组成部分时，分析师会发布更多的账面价值预测。我们的研究阐明了分析师账面价值预测如何有用，以及分析师在何种情况下提供此类信息以满足投资者需求。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Capital structure and international debt shifting
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper presents a model of a multinational firm's optimal debt policy that incorporates international taxation factors. Raw markdown: huizinga-2008-capital-structure-and-international-debt-shifting Bibliographic Record Authors: Huizinga, H, Laeven, L, Nicodeme,…
pages.text: Capital structure and international debt shifting (2008) Paper claim — This paper presents a model of a multinational firm's optimal debt policy that incorporates international taxation factors. Raw markdown: huizinga-2008-capital-structure-and-international-debt-shifting Bibliographic Record Authors: Huizinga, H, Laeven, L, Nicodeme, G Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.05.006 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper presents a model of a multinational firm's optimal debt policy that incorporates international taxation factors. The model yields the prediction that a multinational firm's indebtedness in a country depends on a weighted average of national tax rates and differences between national and foreign tax rates. These differences matter as multinationals have an incentive to shift debt to high-tax countries. The predictions of the model are tested using a novel firm-level dataset for European multinationals and their subsidiaries, combined with newly collected data on the international tax treatment of dividend and interest streams. Our empirical results show that a foreign subsidiary's capital structure reflects local corporate tax rates as well as tax rate differences vis-A-vis the parent firm and other foreign subsidiaries, although the overall economic effect of taxes on leverage appears to be small. Ignoring the international debt shifting arising from differences in national tax rates would understate the impact of national taxes on debt policies by about 25%. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文提出了一个纳入国际税收因素的跨国企业最优债务政策模型。该模型得出如下预测：一家跨国企业在某国的负债水平取决于各国税率的加权平均，以及本国与外国税率之间的差异。这些差异之所以重要，是因为跨国企业有激励将债务转移到高税率国家。我们利用一个关于欧洲跨国企业及其子公司的新颖企业层面数据集，结合新搜集的关于股利流和利息流国际税收待遇的数据，对该模型的预测进行了检验。我们的实证结果表明，外国子公司的资本结构既反映了当地公司税率，也反映了相对于母公司和其他外国子公司的税率差异，尽管税收对杠杆的总体经济影响似乎较小。忽略因各国税率差异而产生的国际债务转移，会将各国税收对债务政策的影响低估约25%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does the timing of dividend reductions signal value? Empirical evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines a firm's dividend reduction timing relative to other dividend reductions in the same industry. Raw markdown: hull-2013-does-the-timing-of-dividend-reductions-signal-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Hull, TJ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE…
pages.text: Does the timing of dividend reductions signal value? Empirical evidence (2013) Paper claim — This paper examines a firm's dividend reduction timing relative to other dividend reductions in the same industry. Raw markdown: hull-2013-does-the-timing-of-dividend-reductions-signal-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Hull, TJ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.05.002 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper examines a firm's dividend reduction timing relative to other dividend reductions in the same industry. It tests if the timing of dividend cuts is informative in firm valuation. The findings suggest that during periods of less accessible external financing, such as recessions, firms with greater investment opportunities are among the first firms to make necessary dividend reductions to take advantage of such opportunities. When external financing is more accessible, firms with superior investment opportunities are able to access capital markets in lieu of dividend-reducing internal financing, indicating higher firm values for earlier dividend reductions during periods of costly external financing and significantly lower firm values for early reductions when financing is more easily obtained. A series of empirical tests show that, in periods of less accessible external financing or during a recession, early dividend-reducing firms significantly outperform late reducers in announcement day and contraction cycle cumulative abnormal returns. The results also show that, outside of a recession, early dividend-reducing firms have significantly lower industry contraction cycle returns than late dividend reducers. Additionally, this study compares early dividend reductions that occur during periods of costly external financing (or during a recession) against early reductions that occur when external financing is more available (or outside of a recession) and finds the former to have significantly higher announcement day and contraction cycle cumulative abnormal returns. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了一家公司相对于同一行业中其他股利削减的股利削减时机。它检验了股利削减的时机在公司估值中是否具有信息量。研究发现表明，在外部融资较难获得的时期（如衰退期），拥有更多投资机会的公司是最早进行必要股利削减以利用这些机会的公司之一。当外部融资更易获得时，拥有卓越投资机会的公司能够进入资本市场，以替代削减股利的内部融资，这表明在外部融资代价高昂的时期较早削减股利意味着更高的公司价值，而在融资较易获得时较早削减则意味着显著较低的公司价值。一系列实证检验表明，在外部融资较难获得或衰退期内，较早削减股利的公司在公告日和收缩周期累积异常收益方面显著优于较晚削减者。结果还表明，在衰退期之外，较早削减股利的公司的行业收缩周期收益显著低于较晚削减股利者。此外，本研究将发生在融资代价高昂时期（或衰退期）的早期股利削减与发生在外部融资更易获得时（或衰退期之外）的早期削减进行了比较，发现前者具有显著更高的公告日和收缩周期累积异常收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines a firm's dividend reduction timing relative to other dividend reductions in the same industry. Raw markdown: hull-2015-how-the-timing-of-dividend-reductions-can-signal Bibliographic Record Authors: Hull, TJ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: How the timing of dividend reductions can signal value (2015) Paper claim — This paper examines a firm's dividend reduction timing relative to other dividend reductions in the same industry. Raw markdown: hull-2015-how-the-timing-of-dividend-reductions-can-signal Bibliographic Record Authors: Hull, TJ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.12.011 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper examines a firm's dividend reduction timing relative to other dividend reductions in the same industry. A model is proposed where the timing of dividend cuts signals true firm value. It is suggested that during periods of lower availability of external financing, firms with greater investment opportunities are among the first to make necessary dividend reductions to take advantage of such opportunities. When external financing is more available, firms with superior investment opportunities are able to access capital markets in lieu of dividend-reducing internal financing, indicating relatively higher firm values for earlier dividend reductions during periods of costly external financing, and significantly lower relative firm values for early reductions when financing is more easily obtained. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All sights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察一家企业相对于同行业其他企业削减股利的时机。文中提出一个模型，其中股利削减的时机传递企业真实价值的信号。文章认为，在外部融资可得性较低的时期，具有更大投资机会的企业会率先做出必要的股利削减，以把握此类机会。当外部融资更易获得时，投资机会更优的企业能够转向资本市场，而非依靠削减股利的内部融资，这表明在外部融资成本高昂的时期较早削减股利的企业相对企业价值较高，而在融资更易获得时较早削减的企业相对企业价值显著较低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Nonregular Employment and Payout Policy: Evidence from the Massachusetts Independent Contractor Law
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Compared with regular employees, independent contractors (ICs) offer labor flexibility and cost savings to their employers. Raw markdown: hwang-2024-nonregular-employment-and-payout-policy-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Hwang, J, Kahle, KM Journal:…
pages.text: Nonregular Employment and Payout Policy: Evidence from the Massachusetts Independent Contractor Law (2024) Paper claim — Compared with regular employees, independent contractors (ICs) offer labor flexibility and cost savings to their employers. Raw markdown: hwang-2024-nonregular-employment-and-payout-policy-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Hwang, J, Kahle, KM Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2022.00103 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(payout, share repurchase) Abstract Compared with regular employees, independent contractors (ICs) offer labor flexibility and cost savings to their employers. Using a difference-in-differences design around the 2004 Massachusetts law that discourages IC usage, we find that this exogenous decrease in IC usage makes treated firms' earnings more sensitive to changes in sales, increases labor-related expenses, and reduces profitability. Firms subsequently reduce share repurchases. The decrease is more pronounced for firms with high operating leverage and financial constraints. Our results are robust to entropy balancing. We conclude that IC usage affects firms' operating leverage and profitability, which in turn, influence payout policy. 摘要（中文） 与正式员工相比，独立承包商（IC）为其雇主提供了劳动力灵活性和成本节约。利用围绕2004年马萨诸塞州抑制IC使用的法律构建的双重差分设计，我们发现IC使用的这一外生下降使处理组企业的盈余对销售变动更为敏感，增加了与劳动相关的费用，并降低了盈利能力。企业随后减少了股份回购。这一下降在具有高经营杠杆和财务约束的企业中更为显著。我们的结果对熵平衡是稳健的。我们得出结论，IC的使用影响企业的经营杠杆和盈利能力，进而影响支付政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article analyses founding family influence on pay-out policies for Swiss listed firms over the period 2003-2010. Raw markdown: isakov-2015-pay-out-policies-in-founding-family-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Isakov, D, Weisskopf, JP Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Pay-out policies in founding family firms (2015) Paper claim — This article analyses founding family influence on pay-out policies for Swiss listed firms over the period 2003-2010. Raw markdown: isakov-2015-pay-out-policies-in-founding-family-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Isakov, D, Weisskopf, JP Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2015.01.003 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This article analyses founding family influence on pay-out policies for Swiss listed firms over the period 2003-2010. We hypothesise that family firms have different incentives and characteristics that affect pay-out decisions and propose three possible explanations: agency theory, reputation building and family income needs. Our results show that founding family firms display significantly higher dividend pay-outs relative to companies with other ownership structures. We also examine specific family characteristics and document that a family's stake, active involvement and generation play an important role in determining pay-out policies. Our findings appear to be consistent with the family income hypothesis and to some extent with reputational concerns. (C) 2015 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文分析了2003至2010年期间创始家族对瑞士上市公司派现政策的影响。我们假设家族企业具有不同的激励和特征，这些会影响派现决策，并提出三种可能的解释：代理理论、声誉建立和家族收入需求。我们的结果表明，创始家族企业相比其他所有权结构的公司显示出显著更高的股利派发。我们还考察了具体的家族特征，并记录到家族的持股份额、积极参与和代际在决定派现政策方面发挥了重要作用。我们的发现似乎与家族收入假说一致，并在一定程度上与声誉考量一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: What If Dividends Were Tax-Exempt? Evidence from a Natural Experiment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the effect of dividend taxes on the payout and investment policies of publicly listed firms. Raw markdown: isakov-2021-what-if-dividends-were-tax-exempt-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Isakov, D, Pérignon, C, Weisskopf, JP Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: What If Dividends Were Tax-Exempt? Evidence from a Natural Experiment (2021) Paper claim — We study the effect of dividend taxes on the payout and investment policies of publicly listed firms. Raw markdown: isakov-2021-what-if-dividends-were-tax-exempt-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Isakov, D, Pérignon, C, Weisskopf, JP Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhab010 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We study the effect of dividend taxes on the payout and investment policies of publicly listed firms. We exploit a unique setting in Switzerland where, following the corporate tax reform of 2011, some but not all firms were suddenly able to pay tax-exempt dividends. We show that treated firms increase their dividend payout by around 30% after the tax cut. The effect on payout is less pronounced for firms prone to agency conflicts. We find a significant positive abnormal stock return after the announcement of the payment of a tax-exempt dividend. However, reducing dividend taxes does not boost investment. 摘要（中文） 我们研究股利税对公开上市企业支付和投资政策的影响。我们利用了瑞士一个独特的情境：在2011年公司税改革之后，部分而非全部企业突然能够派发免税股利。我们表明，处理组企业在减税后将其股利支付提高了约30%。这一支付效应对易受代理冲突影响的企业较不显著。我们发现，在派发免税股利的公告之后存在显著的正向异常股票收益。然而，降低股利税并未提振投资。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We compile a comprehensive international dividend and capital gains tax data set to study tax-based explanations of corporate payout for a panel of 6,035 firms from 25 countries for the period 1990-2008. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Taxation, Dividends, and Share Repurchases: Taking Evidence Global (2013) Paper claim — We compile a comprehensive international dividend and capital gains tax data set to study tax-based explanations of corporate payout for a panel of 6,035 firms from 25 countries for the period 1990-2008. Raw markdown: jacob-2013-taxation-dividends-and-share-repurchases-taking-evidence-global Bibliographic Record Authors: Jacob, M, Jacob, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109013000367 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We compile a comprehensive international dividend and capital gains tax data set to study tax-based explanations of corporate payout for a panel of 6,035 firms from 25 countries for the period 1990-2008. We find robust evidence that the tax penalty on dividends versus capital gains corresponds closely with firms' propensity to pay dividends and repurchase shares, and with the amount of dividends and shares repurchased. Our coefficient estimates suggest a smaller tax effect than is reported in recent single-country, single-event studies. Instead, our results correspond more closely with historic long-term estimates of the elasticity of dividends. 摘要（中文） 我们编制了一个全面的国际股利与资本利得税数据集，以研究1990至2008年间来自25个国家的6035家企业面板中企业支付的基于税收的解释。我们发现有力证据表明，股利相对于资本利得的税收惩罚与企业派发股利和回购股份的倾向、以及股利和回购的金额密切对应。我们的系数估计表明，税收效应小于近期单一国家、单一事件研究所报告的水平。相反，我们的结果与股利弹性的历史长期估计更为吻合。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Taxation and Dividend Policy: The Muting Effect of Agency Issues and Shareholder Conflicts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using proprietary data on the entire spectrum of ownership structure and exact tax status of investors and firms, we examine how dividend taxation affects payout. Raw markdown: jacob-2017-taxation-and-dividend-policy-the-muting-effect-of Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Taxation and Dividend Policy: The Muting Effect of Agency Issues and Shareholder Conflicts (2017) Paper claim — Using proprietary data on the entire spectrum of ownership structure and exact tax status of investors and firms, we examine how dividend taxation affects payout. Raw markdown: jacob-2017-taxation-and-dividend-policy-the-muting-effect-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Jacob, M, Michaely, R Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhx041 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Using proprietary data on the entire spectrum of ownership structure and exact tax status of investors and firms, we examine how dividend taxation affects payout. Utilizing an exogenous shock to dividend taxation, we show that absent any frictions, dividend taxation has a large impact on payout. As agency issues and shareholder conflicts increase, owners' tax preferences have significantly smaller impact on payout. Three mechanisms reduce the dividend-tax sensitivity: Coordination among owners, heterogeneity in tax preferences, and diverging objectives between managers and owners. Altogether, taxation has a first-order impact on payout, but agency issues and shareholder conflicts mute its impact substantially. (JEL G30, G35, H24, H25) 摘要（中文） 利用涵盖所有权结构全谱以及投资者和企业确切税收状况的专有数据，我们考察股利税如何影响支付。利用一个对股利征税的外生冲击，我们表明，在没有任何摩擦的情况下，股利税对支付有很大影响。随着代理问题和股东冲突的增加，所有者的税收偏好对支付的影响显著减小。三种机制降低了股利—税收敏感性：所有者之间的协调、税收偏好的异质性，以及经理人与所有者之间目标的分歧。总体而言，税收对支付有一阶影响，但代理问题和股东冲突大幅削弱了其影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Taxation and Dividend Policy: The Muting Effect of Agency Issues and Shareholder Conflicts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using proprietary data on the entire spectrum of ownership structure and exact tax status of investors and firms in Sweden, Jacob and Michaely show that dividend taxation has a large first-order impact on payout in frictionless settings, but agency issues and…
pages.text: Taxation and Dividend Policy: The Muting Effect of Agency Issues and Shareholder Conflicts (2017) Paper claim — Using proprietary data on the entire spectrum of ownership structure and exact tax status of investors and firms in Sweden, Jacob and Michaely show that dividend taxation has a large first-order impact on payout in frictionless settings, but agency issues and shareholder conflicts substantially mute this effect through three mechanisms: coordination costs, tax preference heterogeneity, and manager-owner divergence. Raw markdown: jacob-michaely-2017-taxation-and-dividend-policy-the-muting-effect-of-agency-iss Bibliographic Record Authors: Jacob, Martin; Michaely, Roni Journal: Review of Financial Studies Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhx041 Abstract Using proprietary data on the entire spectrum of ownership structure and exact tax status of investors and firms, we examine how dividend taxation affects payout. Utilizing an exogenous shock to dividend taxation, we show that absent any frictions, dividend taxation has a large impact on payout. As agency issues and shareholder conflicts increase, owners' tax preferences have significantly smaller impact on payout. Three mechanisms reduce the dividend-tax sensitivity: Coordination among owners, heterogeneity in tax preferences, and diverging objectives between managers and owners. Altogether, taxation has a first-order impact on payout, but agency issues and shareholder conflicts mute its impact substantially. (JEL G30, G35, H24, H25) Key Findings In the absence of frictions (wholly owned Swedish closely held corporations), owners with tax preferences for dividends increased their dividend compensation ratio by approximately 7.3 percentage points (69% relative to pre-reform average) following Sweden's 2006 dividend tax cut. Tax sensitivity gradually declines as the number of owners (and thus agency issues and coordination costs) increases: the response falls by 40% when moving from one to three owners, and is statistically indistinguishable from zero in firms with five owners. Three mechanisms driving the muting effect are identified: (i) coordination costs among owners reducing substitution between dividends and wages; (ii) heterogeneity in tax preferences across owners making it harder to reach a consensus on payout policy; (iii) agency conflicts between managers and owners (separation of ownership and control) reducing dividend compensation responsiveness to taxation. Owners of closely held firms trade off dividend taxes and labor income taxes: they substitute dividends for wages when the dividend tax rate falls below the wage tax rate, but this substitution is impeded by ownership dispersion. The magnitude of effects is consistent across owner-level and firm-level analyses, and is robust to matched subsamples and fully interacted specifications. pages.title: Financial flexibility and the choice between dividends and stock repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper measures the growth in open market stock repurchases and the manner in which stock repurchases and dividends are used by U.S. Raw markdown: jagannathan-2000-financial-flexibility-and-the-choice-between-dividends-and Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Financial flexibility and the choice between dividends and stock repurchases (2000) Paper claim — This paper measures the growth in open market stock repurchases and the manner in which stock repurchases and dividends are used by U.S. Raw markdown: jagannathan-2000-financial-flexibility-and-the-choice-between-dividends-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Jagannathan, M, Stephens, CP, Weisbach, MS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(00)00061-1 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend, stock repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper measures the growth in open market stock repurchases and the manner in which stock repurchases and dividends are used by U.S. corporations. Stock repurchases and dividends are used at different times from one another, by different kinds of firms. Stock repurchases are very pro-cyclical, while dividends increase steadily over time. Dividends are paid by firms with higher "permanent" operating cash flows, while repurchases are used by firms with higher "temporary", non-operating cash hows. Repurchasing firms also have much more volatile cash flows and distributions. Finally, firms repurchase stock following poor stock market performance and increase dividends following good performance. These results are consistent with the view that the flexibility inherent in repurchase programs is one reason why they are sometimes used instead of dividends. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G32; G35. 摘要（中文） 本文测度了公开市场股票回购的增长，以及美国公司使用股票回购和股利的方式。股票回购和股利在不同的时间、由不同类型的企业使用。股票回购具有很强的顺周期性，而股利则随时间稳步增长。股利由“永久性”经营现金流较高的企业派发，而回购则由“暂时性”非经营现金流较高的企业使用。回购企业的现金流和派现也更为波动。最后，企业在股市表现不佳后回购股票，并在表现良好后提高股利。这些结果与如下观点一致，即回购计划固有的灵活性是它们有时被用来替代股利的原因之一。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We characterize legality and incidence of short selling in a worldwide, multimarket framework. Raw markdown: jain-2013-worldwide-reach-of-short-selling-regulations Bibliographic Record Authors: Jain, A, Jain, PK, McInish, TH, McKenzie, M Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Worldwide reach of short selling regulations (2013) Paper claim — We characterize legality and incidence of short selling in a worldwide, multimarket framework. Raw markdown: jain-2013-worldwide-reach-of-short-selling-regulations Bibliographic Record Authors: Jain, A, Jain, PK, McInish, TH, McKenzie, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2013.02.012 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, regulat, standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We characterize legality and incidence of short selling in a worldwide, multimarket framework. Home country short selling restrictions curtail home market stock borrowing by 45% and reduce short selling of the country's American Depository Receipts (ADRs) by 68% due to regulatory reach. Also, the 2008 US ban on short selling of financial firms reduced borrowing in foreign locations. These findings are robust to controls for option availability, enforcement, returns, firm size, trading volume, dividends, ADR level, volatility, days-to-cover, and industry sector. Further, we show that investor conduct resulting from adherence to professional standards is a more powerful mechanism of regulatory reach than intergovernment cooperation. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们在一个全球性、多市场的框架下刻画卖空的合法性和发生情况。母国的卖空限制使母国市场的股票借入减少了45%，并由于监管触及效应（regulatory reach）使该国美国存托凭证（ADR）的卖空减少了68%。此外，2008年美国对金融公司的卖空禁令减少了境外场所的借入。这些发现在控制了期权可得性、执法、收益、公司规模、交易量、股利、ADR层级、波动性、补仓天数（days-to-cover）和行业板块后依然稳健。此外，我们表明，因遵守职业标准而产生的投资者行为，是比政府间合作更为强大的监管触及机制。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Bali and Hite (1998) and Dubofsky (1992) propose models in which market microstructure effects play a role in the ex-dividend day price drop anomaly. Raw markdown: jakob-2004-tick-size-nyse-rule-118-and-ex-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Jakob, K, Ma, TS…
pages.text: Tick size, NYSE rule 118, and ex-dividend day stock price behavior (2004) Paper claim — Bali and Hite (1998) and Dubofsky (1992) propose models in which market microstructure effects play a role in the ex-dividend day price drop anomaly. Raw markdown: jakob-2004-tick-size-nyse-rule-118-and-ex-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Jakob, K, Ma, TS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(03)00189-2 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Bali and Hite (1998) and Dubofsky (1992) propose models in which market microstructure effects play a role in the ex-dividend day price drop anomaly. Bali and Hite suggest that the anomaly is caused solely by price discreteness, while Dubofsky suggests that NYSE Rule 118 is also involved. We test these models by examining cum- to ex-day price drops during the one-eighth, one-sixteenth, and decimal tick size regimes. While the evidence is qualitatively consistent with Dubofsky's predictions, neither model is satisfactory in a quantitative sense. One of our main empirical findings is that no significant decline was evident in the magnitude of the ex-day anomaly after the tick size reduction. (C) 2003 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） Bali和Hite（1998）以及Dubofsky（1992）提出了市场微观结构效应在除息日价格下跌异象中发挥作用的模型。Bali和Hite认为该异象完全由价格离散性所致，而Dubofsky则认为纽约证券交易所第118号规则也参与其中。我们通过考察八分之一、十六分之一和十进制最小报价单位（tick size）制度下含息日至除息日的价格下跌来检验这些模型。虽然证据在定性上与Dubofsky的预测一致，但从定量意义上讲，两个模型都不令人满意。我们的主要实证发现之一是，在最小报价单位缩减之后，除息日异象的量级并未出现显著下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: What do market participants learn from share repurchases? Evidence from a return decomposition (2023) Paper claim — This paper analyzes cash flow and cost of capital dynamics around share repurchase announcements of publicly traded US firms by decomposing stock returns into news related to cash flows and discount rates. Raw markdown: jakob-2023-what-do-market-participants-learn-from-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Jakob, S, Valta, P Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2023.102451 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper analyzes cash flow and cost of capital dynamics around share repurchase announcements of publicly traded US firms by decomposing stock returns into news related to cash flows and discount rates. After repurchase announcements, the cost of capital decreases significantly, while cash flows do not change. The decrease in the cost of capital is largest for firms that appear underpriced. These firms also experience the highest long-term returns after repurchase announcements. The findings suggest that market participants learn about a temporary overestimation of the cost of capital when firms announce share repurchases. 摘要（中文） 本文通过将股票收益分解为与现金流和贴现率相关的新闻，分析美国上市公司股份回购公告前后的现金流和资本成本动态。在回购公告后，资本成本显著下降，而现金流没有变化。资本成本的下降对于那些看似被低估的公司最大。这些公司在回购公告后也经历最高的长期收益。这些发现表明，当企业宣布股份回购时，市场参与者了解到资本成本被暂时高估。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Raw markdown: jalan-1995-equity-financing-and-corporate-convertible-bond-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: JALAN, P, BARONEADESI, G Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1995 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00058-B Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract A co-operative game playing model is used to examine ex ante the decision parameters which are involved in the selection of callable convertible bonds as a means of delayed equity financing. The differential tax treatment of coupon interest and dividend payments, coupled with market friction and incompleteness, provides sufficient reason for convertible debt issuance. Though there is a myopic incentive to expropriate wealth from convertible bondholders by inducing early conversion, value-maximizing managers choose to delay calling in order to maintain access to capital markets on favorable terms. 摘要（中文） 本文使用一个合作博弈模型，事前考察在选择可赎回可转换债券作为延迟股权融资手段时所涉及的决策参数。息票利息与股利支付的差异化税收待遇，加上市场摩擦和不完全性，为可转换债务的发行提供了充分理由。尽管存在通过诱使提前转换从可转换债券持有人处侵占财富的短视激励，但追求价值最大化的管理者选择延迟赎回，以维持在有利条件下进入资本市场的渠道。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: An international analysis of dividend smoothing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the extent to which agency-based models and asymmetric information theories explain dividend smoothing around the world. Raw markdown: javakhadze-2014-an-international-analysis-of-dividend-smoothing Bibliographic Record Authors: Javakhadze, D,…
pages.text: An international analysis of dividend smoothing (2014) Paper claim — This study examines the extent to which agency-based models and asymmetric information theories explain dividend smoothing around the world. Raw markdown: javakhadze-2014-an-international-analysis-of-dividend-smoothing Bibliographic Record Authors: Javakhadze, D, Ferris, SP, Sen, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.09.007 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, legal protection)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, information asymmetry) Abstract This study examines the extent to which agency-based models and asymmetric information theories explain dividend smoothing around the world. Tests on a cross-section of more than two thousand firms from twenty-four countries show that managers of firms with low market-to-book ratios and less cash engage in greater dividend smoothing. Further, firms with highly-concentrated ownership structure and strong corporate governance smooth dividends less. In addition, managers of firms in industries facing high levels of competition smooth dividends more. We also determine that the extent of legal protections provided to shareholders and the culture of the country in which the firm is incorporated, as well as tax regime, have additional explanatory power for dividend smoothing. Our results are most consistent with the simultaneous presence of agency and information asymmetry effects in the decision to smooth dividends. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察基于代理的模型和信息不对称理论在多大程度上能够解释世界各地的股利平滑。对来自24个国家两千多家企业的横截面进行的检验表明，市值账面比低且现金较少的企业的经理人进行更多的股利平滑。此外，所有权结构高度集中、公司治理强的企业股利平滑较少。另外，处于竞争激烈行业的企业的经理人股利平滑更多。我们还确定，为股东提供的法律保护程度、企业注册所在国的文化以及税收制度对股利平滑具有额外的解释力。我们的结果与代理效应和信息不对称效应在股利平滑决策中同时存在最为一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the determinants of cross-sectional differences in insider ownership, debt, and dividend policies. Raw markdown: jensen-1992-simultaneous-determination-of-insider-ownership-debt-and-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: JENSEN, GR, SOLBERG, DP, ZORN, TS…
pages.text: SIMULTANEOUS DETERMINATION OF INSIDER OWNERSHIP, DEBT, AND DIVIDEND POLICIES (1992) Paper claim — We examine the determinants of cross-sectional differences in insider ownership, debt, and dividend policies. Raw markdown: jensen-1992-simultaneous-determination-of-insider-ownership-debt-and-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: JENSEN, GR, SOLBERG, DP, ZORN, TS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2331370 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine the determinants of cross-sectional differences in insider ownership, debt, and dividend policies. These policies are related not only directly, but also indirectly, through their relationship with operating characteristics of firms. To distinguish these effects, we examine the determinants of the three policy choices within a system of equations. Our empirical results support the hypothesis that levels of insider ownership differ systematically across firms. Further, high insider ownership firms choose lower levels of both debt and dividends. Finally, the effects of profitability, growth, and investment spending on debt and dividend policy support a modified "pecking order" hypothesis. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了内部人持股、债务和股利政策横截面差异的决定因素。这些政策不仅直接相关，还通过它们与公司经营特征的关系间接相关。为了区分这些效应，我们在一个方程组内考察这三种政策选择的决定因素。我们的实证结果支持了这样一个假设：内部人持股水平在公司之间存在系统性差异。此外，内部人持股较高的公司会选择较低的债务和股利水平。最后，盈利能力、成长性和投资支出对债务与股利政策的影响支持了一个修正的"啄食顺序"假说。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Business conditions, monetary policy, and expected security returns (1996) Paper claim — We examine the evidence that expected security returns can be forecasted by the term premium, default premium, and dividend yield, in light of recent findings that similar security return patterns are associated with Federal Reserve monetary policy developments. Raw markdown: jensen-1996-business-conditions-monetary-policy-and-expected-security-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Jensen, GR, Mercer, JM, Johnson, RR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1016/0304-405X(96)89537-7 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine the evidence that expected security returns can be forecasted by the term premium, default premium, and dividend yield, in light of recent findings that similar security return patterns are associated with Federal Reserve monetary policy developments. We extend Fama and French's (1989) analysis by suggesting that the monetary environment influences investors' required returns, and hence the robustness of the models they propose. Our findings indicate that Fama and French's results vary dramatically across monetary environments; that is, the behavior of the business-conditions proxies and their influence on expected security returns is significantly affected by the monetary sector. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了预期证券收益可由期限溢价、违约溢价和股利收益率预测的证据，并结合近期发现——即类似的证券收益模式与美联储货币政策发展相关。我们扩展了Fama和French（1989）的分析，提出货币环境会影响投资者的必要收益，进而影响他们所提出模型的稳健性。我们的发现表明，Fama和French的结果在不同货币环境中差异巨大；也就是说，商业状况代理变量的行为及其对预期证券收益的影响，受货币部门的显著影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: What do dividend reductions signal?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Dividend reductions have long been considered a "last resort" action for firm managers. Raw markdown: jensen-2010-what-do-dividend-reductions-signal Bibliographic Record Authors: Jensen, GR, Lundstrum, LL, Miller, RE Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010…
pages.text: What do dividend reductions signal? (2010) Paper claim — Dividend reductions have long been considered a "last resort" action for firm managers. Raw markdown: jensen-2010-what-do-dividend-reductions-signal Bibliographic Record Authors: Jensen, GR, Lundstrum, LL, Miller, RE Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2010.06.009 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Dividend reductions have long been considered a "last resort" action for firm managers. Managerial reluctance to reduce dividends emanates from the view that dividend drops signal managerial pessimism regarding future earnings. Contrary to expectations, studies show that earnings rebound significantly following a dividend reduction; yet investors react negatively to the dividend-drop announcement. We present an explanation for the anomalous behavior of earnings and returns around the time of a dividend drop. Our evidence suggests that a reduction in a firm's established dividend coincides with a decrease in the value of the firm's real options. Earnings rebound following the dividend reduction due to the savings that result as the firm allows growth options to expire; however, announcement period returns suggest that investors recognize the lost value associated with the forthcoming expiration of growth options. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 长期以来，股利削减一直被视为公司管理者的“最后手段”行动。管理者不愿削减股利源于这样一种观点：股利下降会发出管理者对未来盈余持悲观态度的信号。与预期相反，研究表明盈余在股利削减后会显著反弹；然而投资者对股利下降公告作出负向反应。我们为股利下降前后盈余和收益的这种反常行为提出了一个解释。我们的证据表明，公司既定股利的削减与该公司实物期权价值的下降相吻合。盈余在股利削减后反弹，这是由于公司允许增长期权到期而产生的节约；然而，公告期收益表明投资者认识到与即将到来的增长期权到期相关的价值损失。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock returns, dividend yield, and book-to-market ratio
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A dividend yield model has been widely used in previous research that relates stock market valuations to cash flow fundamentals. Raw markdown: jiang-2007-stock-returns-dividend-yield-and-book-to-market Bibliographic Record Authors: Jiang, XQ, Lee, BS Journal:…
pages.text: Stock returns, dividend yield, and book-to-market ratio (2007) Paper claim — A dividend yield model has been widely used in previous research that relates stock market valuations to cash flow fundamentals. Raw markdown: jiang-2007-stock-returns-dividend-yield-and-book-to-market Bibliographic Record Authors: Jiang, XQ, Lee, BS Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2006.07.012 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract A dividend yield model has been widely used in previous research that relates stock market valuations to cash flow fundamentals. Given controversies about using dividends as a proxy for cash flows, a loglinear book-to-market model has recently been proposed. However, these models rely on the assumption that dividend yield and book-to-market ratio are both stationary, and empirical evidence for this is, at best, mixed. We develop a new model, the loglinear cointegration model, that explains future profitability and excess stock returns in terms of a linear combination of log book-to-market ratio and log dividend yield. The loglinear cointegration model performs better than the log dividend yield model and the log book-to-market model in terms of cross-equation restriction tests and forecasting performance comparisons. The superior performance of the loglinear cointegration model suggests that the linear combination may be a better indicator of intrinsic fundamentals than the dividend yield or the book-to-market ratio separately. Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 在此前将股票市场估值与现金流基本面相联系的研究中，股利收益率模型被广泛使用。鉴于关于使用股利作为现金流代理变量的争议，最近有人提出了一个对数线性账面市值比模型。然而，这些模型依赖于股利收益率和账面市值比都是平稳的假设，而对此的实证证据充其量是混合的。我们开发了一个新模型，即对数线性协整模型，它用对数账面市值比和对数股利收益率的线性组合来解释未来盈利能力和超额股票收益。在跨方程约束检验和预测表现比较方面，对数线性协整模型的表现优于对数股利收益率模型和对数账面市值比模型。对数线性协整模型的优越表现表明，该线性组合可能是比单独的股利收益率或账面市值比更好的内在基本面指标。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
