pages.title: Share repurchases, catering, and dividend substitution
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We first extend Baker and Wurgler's (2004a) catering theory of dividends to share repurchases. Raw markdown: jiang-2013-share-repurchases-catering-and-dividend-substitution Bibliographic Record Authors: Jiang, Z, Kim, KA, Lie, E, Yang, S Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Share repurchases, catering, and dividend substitution (2013) Paper claim — We first extend Baker and Wurgler's (2004a) catering theory of dividends to share repurchases. Raw markdown: jiang-2013-share-repurchases-catering-and-dividend-substitution Bibliographic Record Authors: Jiang, Z, Kim, KA, Lie, E, Yang, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.01.004 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(catering, substitut) Abstract We first extend Baker and Wurgler's (2004a) catering theory of dividends to share repurchases. Consistent with the notion that firms cater to investor demand for share repurchases, we report evidence that the market's time-varying repurchase premium positively affects firms' choice to repurchase shares. Next, we use the catering behavior as a novel framework for testing the dividend substitution hypothesis. Consistent with the notion that managers consider dividends and share repurchases to be substitute payout mechanisms, we find that the dividend premium negatively affects the repurchase choice, whereas the repurchase premium negatively affects the choice to pay dividends. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们首先将贝克和沃格勒（Baker and Wurgler，2004a）的股利迎合理论扩展到股份回购。与企业迎合投资者对股份回购的需求这一观念相一致，我们报告的证据表明，市场随时间变化的回购溢价正向影响企业回购股份的选择。接着，我们将迎合行为用作检验股利替代假说的新框架。与管理者将股利和股份回购视为替代性支付机制这一观念相一致，我们发现股利溢价负向影响回购选择，而回购溢价负向影响支付股利的选择。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Stock liquidity and dividend payouts (2017) Paper claim — This study investigates the informational effect of stock liquidity on dividend payouts. Raw markdown: jiang-2017-stock-liquidity-and-dividend-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Jiang, FX, Ma, YB, Shi, BB Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.12.005 Relevance score: 11.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, regulat, rule)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative, substitut) Abstract This study investigates the informational effect of stock liquidity on dividend payouts. Using a sample of Chinese listed firms during 2000-2014, we find a positive relation between stock liquidity and dividend payouts. This result is robust to the use of alternative measures of liquidity, and holds after we control for endogeneity concerns. In accord with our hypothesis that stock liquidity provides information and increases insiders' incentive to pay out dividends, we find that the positive relation between stock liquidity and dividend payouts is more pronounced when the information environment is opaque, and when conflict between controlling shareholders and minority investors is severe. Further, market reactions to regulatory stipulations requiring dividend payouts are more favorable for firms with low stock liquidity, suggesting that legal provisions and regulations are substitutes for stock liquidity. Finally, we rule out several alternative explanations concerning the governance of non-controlling blockholders and the alleviation of manager-shareholder agency conflict. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察股票流动性对股利支付的信息效应。使用2000—2014年间中国上市企业的样本，我们发现股票流动性与股利支付之间存在正相关关系。这一结果在使用替代性流动性度量时是稳健的，并在控制内生性顾虑后依然成立。与我们的假设（即股票流动性提供信息并增强内部人支付股利的动机）相一致，我们发现，当信息环境不透明、以及当控股股东与中小投资者之间的冲突严重时，股票流动性与股利支付之间的正相关关系更为显著。此外，对于股票流动性低的企业，市场对要求支付股利的监管规定的反应更为积极，这表明法律条款和监管是股票流动性的替代品。最后，我们排除了若干关于非控股大股东治理以及缓解经理人-股东代理冲突的替代性解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Multiple Large Shareholders and Dividends: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Jiang et al. show that in the Chinese institutional context, multiple large shareholders cooperate to force firms to pay and increase cash dividends — rather than colluding to withhold them as in Faccio et al. (2001) — because after the mid-2000s crackdown on…
pages.text: Multiple Large Shareholders and Dividends: Evidence from China (2019) Paper claim — Jiang et al. show that in the Chinese institutional context, multiple large shareholders cooperate to force firms to pay and increase cash dividends — rather than colluding to withhold them as in Faccio et al. (2001) — because after the mid-2000s crackdown on tunneling via related-party transactions, blockholders shifted to using dividends as the primary channel for extracting cash returns from their equity holdings. Raw markdown: jiang-2019-multiple-large-shareholders-and-dividends-evidence-from-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Jiang, Fuxiu; Cai, Xinni; Jiang, Zhan; Nofsinger, John R. Journal: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2019.101201 Abstract Faccio et al. (2001) find that when East Asian firms have multiple large shareholders, they will collude to expropriate wealth and withhold dividend payouts. However, when it becomes difficult for large shareholders to expropriate wealth through activities like tunneling, large shareholders may then need dividends to fund personal cash flow needs. Thus, they may cooperate to make firms pay dividends and pay large dividends. To test this hypothesis, we study Chinese-listed firms. Consistent with our contention, we find that firms with multiple large shareholders are more likely to pay dividends and pay large dividends. These activities are especially prevalent after restrictions were placed on tunneling. We also find that dividend payouts and large payouts are more likely when the largest shareholder needs the cooperation of other blockholders to exert control over dividend payout policy, and when multiple blockholders are of the same identity. Key Findings Using a sample of 20,516 firm-years for 2,428 non-financial Chinese listed firms from 2000 to 2014, firms with multiple blockholders (Multi=1) show a 2.8% higher propensity to pay dividends and about 12% higher dividend-to-earnings ratios than single-blockholder firms. Multiple blockholders are positively associated with tunneling via related-party transactions in the first sub-period (2000–2007), but this association disappears in the second sub-period (2008–2014) after the crackdown. Correspondingly, the positive effect of multiple blockholders on dividends is significantly stronger in the post-tunneling era. Cooperation among blockholders to pay dividends is more likely when the largest shareholder needs the cooperation of other blockholders (i.e., when no single shareholder holds majority control), and when multiple blockholders share the same identity (private-to-private or state-to-state). Despite the negative coalition to force higher dividends, capital markets do not discount multiple-blockholder firms for these payouts, and the excess dividends are not associated with minority shareholder expropriation — firms with multiple blockholders pay more dividends especially when faced with fewer investment opportunities. Results are robust to 2SLS (using province-level average ownership structure as instrument), difference-in-differences around transitions in ownership structure, and propensity score matching. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper characterizes U.S. Raw markdown: johannes-2016-learning-about-consumption-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: Johannes, M, Lochstoer, LA, Mou, YQ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12246 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes:…
pages.text: Learning about Consumption Dynamics (2016) Paper claim — This paper characterizes U.S. Raw markdown: johannes-2016-learning-about-consumption-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: Johannes, M, Lochstoer, LA, Mou, YQ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12246 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper characterizes U.S. consumption dynamics from the perspective of a Bayesian agent who does not know the underlying model structure but learns over time from macroeconomic data. Realistic, high-dimensional macroeconomic learning problems, which entail parameter, model, and state learning, generate substantially different subjective beliefs about consumption dynamics compared to the standard, full-information rational expectations benchmark. Beliefs about long-run dynamics are volatile, with counter-cyclical conditional volatility, and drift over time. Embedding these beliefs in a standard asset pricing model significantly improves the model's ability to match the stylized facts, as well as the sample path of the market price-dividend ratio. 摘要（中文） 本文从一位贝叶斯主体的视角刻画了美国的消费动态，该主体并不知晓底层的模型结构，而是随时间从宏观经济数据中学习。现实的、高维的宏观经济学习问题涉及参数学习、模型学习和状态学习，与标准的完全信息理性预期基准相比，会生成关于消费动态的显著不同的主观信念。关于长期动态的信念是波动的，具有逆周期的条件波动率，并随时间漂移。将这些信念嵌入一个标准资产定价模型，显著提高了该模型匹配典型事实以及市场价格-股利比样本路径的能力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does geography matter? Firm location and corporate payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate the impact of geography on agency costs and firm dividend policies. Raw markdown: john-2011-does-geography-matter-firm-location-and-corporate-payout Bibliographic Record Authors: John, K, Knyazeva, A, Knyazeva, D Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: Does geography matter? Firm location and corporate payout policy (2011) Paper claim — We investigate the impact of geography on agency costs and firm dividend policies. Raw markdown: john-2011-does-geography-matter-firm-location-and-corporate-payout Bibliographic Record Authors: John, K, Knyazeva, A, Knyazeva, D Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.03.014 Relevance score: 12.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(oversight, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract We investigate the impact of geography on agency costs and firm dividend policies. We argue that remote firm location increases the cost of shareholder oversight of managerial investment decisions. We hypothesize that remotely located firms facing free cash flow problems precommit to higher dividends to mitigate agency conflicts. We find that remotely located firms pay higher dividends. As expected, the effect of geography on dividends is most pronounced for firms with severe free cash flow problems. Further, remotely located firms rely more on regular dividends instead of special dividends or share repurchases and decrease dividends less often. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察地理因素对代理成本和企业股利政策的影响。我们认为，企业地理位置偏远会增加股东监督管理层投资决策的成本。我们假设，面临自由现金流问题的偏远企业会预先承诺更高的股利，以缓解代理冲突。我们发现，位置偏远的企业支付更高的股利。正如预期，地理因素对股利的影响在存在严重自由现金流问题的企业中最为显著。此外，位置偏远的企业更多地依赖常规股利而非特别股利或股份回购，且减少股利的频率更低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Governance and Payout Precommitment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine how firms structure payout and debt commitments to address governance weaknesses. Raw markdown: john-2015-governance-and-payout-precommitment Bibliographic Record Authors: John, K, Knyazeva, A, Knyazeva, D Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015…
pages.text: Governance and Payout Precommitment (2015) Paper claim — We examine how firms structure payout and debt commitments to address governance weaknesses. Raw markdown: john-2015-governance-and-payout-precommitment Bibliographic Record Authors: John, K, Knyazeva, A, Knyazeva, D Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2015.05.004 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, replace) Abstract We examine how firms structure payout and debt commitments to address governance weaknesses. Firms with severe agency conflicts precommit through a combination of dividends and debt or through dividends rather than debt alone. Such firms also shift their shareholder payouts towards regular quarterly dividends a stronger commitment than special dividends or repurchases. Although dividend commitments are implicit, event study evidence supports their credibility and value relevance for firms with weak governance. Despite harsher penalties, debt alone cannot replace shareholder payouts as a means of addressing managerial agency conflicts. Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们考察企业如何构建支付和债务承诺以应对治理弱点。存在严重代理冲突的企业会通过股利与债务的组合，或通过股利而非单独的债务来进行预先承诺。此类企业还会将其股东支付转向常规季度股利——这比特别股利或回购是更强的承诺。尽管股利承诺是隐性的，但事件研究的证据支持其对治理薄弱企业的可信度和价值相关性。尽管惩罚更为严厉，但仅靠债务无法取代股东支付作为应对经理人代理冲突的手段。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: DIVIDEND PAYOUT AND THE VALUATION EFFECTS OF BOND ANNOUNCEMENTS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent theoretical models suggest debt and dividends can serve as substitute free cash how control or signaling devices. Raw markdown: johnson-1995-dividend-payout-and-the-valuation-effects-of-bond Bibliographic Record Authors: JOHNSON, SA Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: DIVIDEND PAYOUT AND THE VALUATION EFFECTS OF BOND ANNOUNCEMENTS (1995) Paper claim — Recent theoretical models suggest debt and dividends can serve as substitute free cash how control or signaling devices. Raw markdown: johnson-1995-dividend-payout-and-the-valuation-effects-of-bond Bibliographic Record Authors: JOHNSON, SA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1995 DOI: 10.2307/2331348 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow, signal, substitut) Abstract Recent theoretical models suggest debt and dividends can serve as substitute free cash how control or signaling devices. I examine share price responses to announcements of straight debt issues and test whether there are systematic differences between low and high dividend payout firms. Share price response is significantly positive for low growth-low dividend payout firms, and is negatively related to cross-sectional dividend payout. The results support arguments that debt and dividends are substitutes. The results also support arguments that debt provides free cash flow or signaling benefits, but suggest the benefits are significant only for firms with low levels of substitutes. I also document that low growth-low dividend payout firms enter capital markets less frequently, but find no relation between share price response and this frequency. 摘要（中文） 近来的理论模型表明，债务和股利可以充当替代性的自由现金流控制或信号工具。我考察了股价对普通债务发行公告的反应，并检验低股利支付企业与高股利支付企业之间是否存在系统性差异。对于低成长-低股利支付企业，股价反应显著为正，且与横截面股利支付负相关。这些结果支持了债务与股利互为替代品的论点。结果还支持了债务提供自由现金流或信号收益的论点，但表明这些收益只对替代品水平较低的企业才显著。我还记录到，低成长-低股利支付企业进入资本市场的频率较低，但未发现股价反应与这一频率之间存在关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Rational momentum effects (2002) Paper claim — Momentum effects in stock returns need not imply investor irrationality, heterogeneous information, or market frictions. Raw markdown: johnson-2002-rational-momentum-effects Bibliographic Record Authors: Johnson, TC Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00435 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Momentum effects in stock returns need not imply investor irrationality, heterogeneous information, or market frictions. A simple, single-firm model with a standard pricing kernel can produce such effects when expected dividend growth rates vary over time. An enhanced model, under which persistent growth rate shocks occur episodically, can match many of the features documented by the empirical research. The same basic mechanism could potentially account for underreaction anomalies in general. 摘要（中文） 股票收益中的动量效应不必然意味着投资者非理性、信息异质或市场摩擦。当预期股利增长率随时间变化时，一个简单的、带标准定价核的单一企业模型即可产生此类效应。一个增强模型（在该模型下，持续性增长率冲击间歇性地发生）能够匹配实证研究所记录的许多特征。同一基本机制或许还能解释一般意义上的反应不足异象。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend policy, signaling, and discounts on closed-end funds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We test the predictions of dividend signaling models using closed-end equity funds that adopt explicit policies committing them to pay minimum dividend yields. Raw markdown: johnson-2006-dividend-policy-signaling-and-discounts-on-closed-end Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Dividend policy, signaling, and discounts on closed-end funds (2006) Paper claim — We test the predictions of dividend signaling models using closed-end equity funds that adopt explicit policies committing them to pay minimum dividend yields. Raw markdown: johnson-2006-dividend-policy-signaling-and-discounts-on-closed-end Bibliographic Record Authors: Johnson, SA, Lin, JC, Song, KR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.08.001 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We test the predictions of dividend signaling models using closed-end equity funds that adopt explicit policies committing them to pay minimum dividend yields. These policies represent deliberate attempts to reduce share price undervaluation relative to NAV. Funds that adopt minimum dividend policies experience reductions in their share price discounts, trade at smaller discounts than other funds, earn greater excess returns following policy adoption, and their managers survive longer than other managers do. The results are broadly consistent with the predictions of dividend signaling models, and suggest that high quality closed-end funds can reduce undervaluation via dividend policy. (c) 2006 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用采取明确政策、承诺支付最低股利收益率的封闭式股票基金，检验股利信号传递模型的预测。这些政策代表了刻意尝试降低股价相对于净资产价值（NAV）被低估的程度。采取最低股利政策的基金经历了股价折价的缩小，其折价小于其他基金，在采取该政策后获得更大的超额收益，且其管理者比其他管理者存续更久。这些结果与股利信号传递模型的预测大体一致，并表明高质量的封闭式基金可通过股利政策降低被低估的程度。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managing stock option expense: The manipulation of option-pricing model assumptions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines whether firms that voluntarily recognize stock option expense in their financial statements manage that expense downward more than firms that do not recognize the expense by adjusting option-pricing model assumptions. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Managing stock option expense: The manipulation of option-pricing model assumptions (2006) Paper claim — This paper examines whether firms that voluntarily recognize stock option expense in their financial statements manage that expense downward more than firms that do not recognize the expense by adjusting option-pricing model assumptions. Raw markdown: johnston-2006-managing-stock-option-expense-the-manipulation-of-option Bibliographic Record Authors: Johnston, D Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1506/6YVX-9KDJ-08UC-P0Q6 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines whether firms that voluntarily recognize stock option expense in their financial statements manage that expense downward more than firms that do not recognize the expense by adjusting option-pricing model assumptions. To examine this issue, I collect option-pricing model assumptions from fiscal year 2002 for both a sample of firms that voluntarily recognize stock option expense ("recognizing firms") and a sample of control firms that do not ("disclosing firms"). The empirical results suggest that recognizing firms manage the recognized stock-based compensation expense reported in their financial statements downward more than do firms that only disclose the expense. Additional analyses reveal that recognizing firms assume a lower level of volatility than disclosing firms in the option-pricing model calculations; however, I find no evidence that recognizing firms manage the dividend yield and risk-free interest rate assumptions more than disclosing firms. The Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) recently issued Statement of Financial Accounting Standards No. 123(R), which requires the expensing of the fair value of stock options, so these results may be of interest to capital-market participants and the FASB as they assess the reliability of stock option expense as determined by option-pricing models. 摘要（中文） 本文考察在财务报表中自愿确认股票期权费用的公司，是否比不确认该费用的公司通过调整期权定价模型假设而更多地向下管理该费用。为考察这一问题，我收集了2002财年一个自愿确认股票期权费用的公司样本（"确认公司"）以及一个不确认该费用的对照公司样本（"披露公司"）的期权定价模型假设。实证结果表明，确认公司比仅披露费用的公司更多地向下管理其财务报表中所报告的、已确认的股权型薪酬费用。额外分析揭示，确认公司在期权定价模型计算中假设的波动性水平低于披露公司；然而，我没有发现证据表明确认公司比披露公司更多地管理股利收益率和无风险利率假设。财务会计准则委员会（FASB）近期发布了第123(R)号财务会计准则公告，要求将股票期权的公允价值费用化，因此这些结果在FASB和资本市场参与者评估由期权定价模型确定的股票期权费用的可靠性时可能会引起他们的兴趣。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate payout policy in dual-class firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine corporate payout policy in dual-class firms. Raw markdown: jordan-2014-corporate-payout-policy-in-dual-class-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Jordan, BD, Liu, MH, Wu, Q Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI:…
pages.text: Corporate payout policy in dual-class firms (2014) Paper claim — We examine corporate payout policy in dual-class firms. Raw markdown: jordan-2014-corporate-payout-policy-in-dual-class-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Jordan, BD, Liu, MH, Wu, Q Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.02.004 Relevance score: 15.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, rule)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative, cash flow, expropri, free cash flow) Abstract We examine corporate payout policy in dual-class firms. The expropriation hypothesis predicts that dual-class firms pay out less to shareholders because entrenched managers want to maximize the value of assets under control and the associated private benefits. The pre-commitment hypothesis predicts that dual-class firms pay out more to shareholders because firms use corporate payouts as a pre-commitment device to mitigate agency costs. Our results support the pre-commitment hypothesis. Dual-class firms have higher cash dividend payments and total payouts, and they use more regular cash dividends rather than special dividends or repurchases, compared to their propensity-matched single-class firms. Dual-class firms with severe free cash flow-related agency problems and few growth opportunities rely even more on corporate payouts as a pre-commitment mechanism. We also rule out the alternative explanation that dual-class firms pay out more because super-voting shareholders lack the ability to generate home-made dividends by selling shares since super-voting shares are often non-tradable or very illiquid. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了双重股权结构企业的公司支付政策。侵占假说预测，双重股权结构企业向股东支付较少，因为壕沟自守的管理者希望最大化其所控制资产的价值以及相关的私人收益。预先承诺假说则预测，双重股权结构企业向股东支付更多，因为企业将公司支付用作缓解代理成本的预先承诺工具。我们的结果支持预先承诺假说。与倾向得分匹配的单一股权结构企业相比，双重股权结构企业的现金股利支付和总支付更高，且更多地使用常规现金股利而非特别股利或回购。存在严重的自由现金流相关代理问题且成长机会较少的双重股权结构企业，更加依赖公司支付作为预先承诺机制。我们还排除了另一种解释，即双重股权结构企业支付更多是因为超级投票权股东缺乏通过出售股份来自制股利的能力，因为超级投票权股份往往不可交易或流动性极差。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Organizational Form and Corporate Payout Policy (2018) Paper claim — We examine how organizational form affects corporate payouts. Raw markdown: jordan-2018-organizational-form-and-corporate-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Jordan, BD, Liu, MH, Wu, Q Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109017001211 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We examine how organizational form affects corporate payouts. Conglomerates pay out more than pure plays in both cash dividends and total payouts (cash dividends plus share repurchases). Furthermore, their payouts are more sensitive to cash flows compared to pure-play firms. The sensitivity of payouts to cash flow increases as the cross-segment correlation in a conglomerate decreases. Corporate payouts increase after mergers and acquisitions (M&As), especially among M&As in which acquirers and targets are less correlated. These results suggest that the coinsurance among different divisions of a conglomerate allows them to pay out more cash flow to their shareholders than pure-play firms. 摘要（中文） 我们考察组织形式如何影响企业支付。在现金股利和总支付（现金股利加股份回购）两方面，集团企业的支付都高于纯业务企业。此外，与纯业务企业相比，集团企业的支付对现金流更为敏感。随着集团内跨部门相关性的下降，支付对现金流的敏感性上升。在并购（M&A）之后，企业支付增加，尤其是在收购方与目标方相关性较低的并购中。这些结果表明，集团企业各部门之间的共同保险，使其能够比纯业务企业向股东支付更多的现金流。 Key Findings Conglomerates pay out more than pure plays in both cash dividends and total payouts across all sample years (1981–2011): average cash payout of 1.40% vs. 0.87% for pure plays (p < 0.0001), and average total payout of 2.53% vs. 1.96% (p < 0.0001). The difference in cash-dividend-to-cash-flow sensitivity between a conglomerate with CORR_CF = 0 and a pure play (CORR_CF = 1) implies $0.834 more in cash dividends per $100 of extra cash flow. Panel regressions with firm and year fixed effects show negative and significant coefficients on CF×CORR_CF and CF×CORR_INV for both CASH_PAYOUT and TOTAL_PAYOUT, confirming that payout-to-cash-flow sensitivity is negatively related to cross-segment correlation within a firm. Falsification tests using pseudo conglomerates (portfolios of single-segment firms matched to each conglomerate segment by industry and size) show actual conglomerates have significantly higher cash-dividend-to-cash-flow sensitivities than pseudo conglomerates, ruling out industry and size explanations. Corporate payouts increase after stock swap M&As (dividend-to-cash-flow sensitivity rises by 0.47 percentage points); the increase is more pronounced when the cash-flow or investment correlation between acquirer and target before the M&A is lower, consistent with the coinsurance hypothesis. Conglomerates with more efficient internal capital markets (less diverse Tobin's Q across segments, per Rajan et al. 2000) have greater payout-to-cash-flow sensitivities than those with less efficient internal capital markets. pages.title: Ambiguity, Learning, and Asset Returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a novel generalized recursive smooth ambiguity model which permits a three-way separation among risk aversion, ambiguity aversion, and intertemporal substitution. Raw markdown: ju-2012-ambiguity-learning-and-asset-returns Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Ambiguity, Learning, and Asset Returns (2012) Paper claim — We propose a novel generalized recursive smooth ambiguity model which permits a three-way separation among risk aversion, ambiguity aversion, and intertemporal substitution. Raw markdown: ju-2012-ambiguity-learning-and-asset-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Ju, NJ, Miao, JJ Journal: ECONOMETRICA Year: 2012 DOI: 10.3982/ECTA7618 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We propose a novel generalized recursive smooth ambiguity model which permits a three-way separation among risk aversion, ambiguity aversion, and intertemporal substitution. We apply this utility model to a consumption-based asset-pricing model in which consumption and dividends follow hidden Markov regime-switching processes. Our calibrated model can match the mean equity premium, the mean risk-free rate, and the volatility of the equity premium observed in the data. In addition, our model can generate a variety of dynamic asset-pricing phenomena, including the procyclical variation of pricedividend ratios, the countercyclical variation of equity premia and equity volatility, the leverage effect, and the mean reversion of excess returns. The key intuition is that an ambiguity-averse agent behaves pessimistically by attaching more weight to the pricing kernel in bad times when his continuation values are low. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一个新颖的广义递归平滑模糊模型，它允许在风险厌恶、模糊厌恶和跨期替代之间进行三方分离。我们将此效用模型应用于一个基于消费的资产定价模型，其中消费和股利遵循隐马尔可夫状态转换过程。我们校准后的模型能够匹配数据中观察到的平均股权溢价、平均无风险利率以及股权溢价的波动率。此外，我们的模型能够生成各种动态资产定价现象，包括价格-股利比的顺周期变动、股权溢价和股权波动率的逆周期变动、杠杆效应以及超额收益的均值回归。关键直觉在于，厌恶模糊性的主体在其延续价值较低的坏时期通过对定价核赋予更大权重而表现出悲观行为。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Payouts and Rollover Crises
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study dividend payouts when banks face coordination-based rollover crises. Raw markdown: juelsrud-2020-dividend-payouts-and-rollover-crises Bibliographic Record Authors: Juelsrud, RE, Nenov, PT Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2020 DOI:…
pages.text: Dividend Payouts and Rollover Crises (2020) Paper claim — We study dividend payouts when banks face coordination-based rollover crises. Raw markdown: juelsrud-2020-dividend-payouts-and-rollover-crises Bibliographic Record Authors: Juelsrud, RE, Nenov, PT Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhz130 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We study dividend payouts when banks face coordination-based rollover crises. Banks in the model can use dividends to both risk shift and signal their available liquidity to shortterm lenders, thus, influencing the lenders' actions. In the unique equilibrium both channels induce banks to pay higher dividends than in the absence of a rollover crisis. In our model banks exert an informational externality on other banks via the inferences and actions of lenders. Optimal dividend regulation that corrects this externality and promote financial stability includes a binding cap on dividends. We also discuss testable implications of our theory. 摘要（中文） 我们研究当银行面临基于协调的展期危机时的股利支付。模型中的银行可以利用股利来同时进行风险转移以及向短期贷款人传递其可用流动性的信号，从而影响贷款人的行动。在唯一的均衡中，这两种渠道都促使银行支付比不存在展期危机时更高的股利。在我们的模型中，银行通过贷款人的推断和行动对其他银行施加信息外部性。纠正这一外部性并促进金融稳定的最优股利监管包括一个具约束力的股利上限。我们还讨论了我们理论的可检验含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Share repurchase, executive options and wealth changes to stockholders and bondholders
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We test the signaling and wealth transfer hypotheses around the announcement of share repurchases using a recent and larger sample of data than previously examined while employing a methodology designed to enhance the power of our tests. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Share repurchase, executive options and wealth changes to stockholders and bondholders (2009) Paper claim — We test the signaling and wealth transfer hypotheses around the announcement of share repurchases using a recent and larger sample of data than previously examined while employing a methodology designed to enhance the power of our tests. Raw markdown: jun-2009-share-repurchase-executive-options-and-wealth-changes-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Jun, SG, Jung, M, Walkling, RA Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2008.11.003 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase, stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We test the signaling and wealth transfer hypotheses around the announcement of share repurchases using a recent and larger sample of data than previously examined while employing a methodology designed to enhance the power of our tests. Disentangling the wealth transfer and signaling hypotheses is difficult; they are not mutually exclusive and can have opposite effects for bondholders. Wealth transfers decrease bondholder wealth while positive signals increase it; the combined result obscures tests of each hypothesis. By focusing on sub-samples where signaling is more and less likely to be present we increase our ability to isolate the separate effects. In addition to traditional tests of wealth effects, we feature information inherent in the correlation of wealth changes to equity and debt. Our results are generally consistent with the positive signaling effect of stock repurchases, but also provide some support for wealth transfer. Our work also emphasizes the importance of trying to disentangle the various hypotheses. In the subset of option funding repurchases. where signaling effects are less likely, the positive correlation of wealth changes between stockholders and bondholders is completely eliminated. Bond ratings are much more likely to be upgraded in samples without executive options which is precisely where the signaling effects are expected to be concentrated. Firms with weaker shareholder rights experience greater bondholder wealth losses at the announcement of stock repurchases. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们围绕股份回购公告，使用比先前考察的更近期和更大规模的数据样本，并采用一种旨在增强检验效力的方法，检验了信号传递假说和财富转移假说。将财富转移假说和信号传递假说区分开来是困难的；它们并不相互排斥，且对债券持有人可能产生相反的影响。财富转移减少债券持有人财富，而正向信号增加债券持有人财富；两者的综合结果模糊了对每个假说的检验。通过聚焦于信号传递更可能和更不可能存在的子样本，我们提高了分离各自效应的能力。除了传统的财富效应检验外，我们还突出了股权与债务财富变化相关性中所蕴含的信息。我们的结果总体上与股票回购的正向信号传递效应相一致，但也为财富转移提供了一些支持。我们的工作还强调了试图区分各种假说的重要性。在期权融资回购这一子集中（那里信号传递效应更不可能存在），股东与债券持有人财富变化之间的正相关被完全消除。在没有高管期权的样本中，债券评级被上调的可能性大得多，而这恰恰是预期信号传递效应集中的地方。股东权利较弱的企业在股票回购公告时经历更大的债券持有人财富损失。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Stock reaction to dividend savings of convertible preferred calls: Free cash flow or price pressure effects? (1996) Paper claim — Calls of in-the-money convertible preferred stock typically induce dividend savings for the firm, since preferred dividends exceed common stock dividends, Prior research finds that these savings are negatively related to stock returns at call announcement and argues that the market expects managers to abuse the increased free cash flow. Raw markdown: kadapakkam-1996-stock-reaction-to-dividend-savings-of-convertible-preferred Bibliographic Record Authors: Kadapakkam, PR, Tang, AP Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(96)00022-2 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract Calls of in-the-money convertible preferred stock typically induce dividend savings for the firm, since preferred dividends exceed common stock dividends, Prior research finds that these savings are negatively related to stock returns at call announcement and argues that the market expects managers to abuse the increased free cash flow. This paper finds that dividend savings are closely related to call size, suggesting other explanations, Larger calls experience a more negative announcement reaction. Consistent with temporary liquidity effects, there is a price reversal during the conversion period, which is greater for larger calls. 摘要（中文） 对处于价内的可转换优先股进行赎回，通常会为公司带来股利节省，因为优先股股利超过普通股股利。先前研究发现，这些节省与赎回公告时的股票收益负相关，并认为市场预期管理者会滥用增加的自由现金流。本文发现，股利节省与赎回规模密切相关，这暗示了其他解释。规模较大的赎回经历更为负面的公告反应。与暂时性流动性效应相一致，在转换期内存在价格反转，且对于规模较大的赎回而言反转更大。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Reduction of constraints on arbitrage trading and market efficiency: An examination of ex-day returns in Hong Kong after introduction of electronic settlement (2000) Paper claim — Previous research documents positive ex-dividend day returns in excess of one percent in the unique institutional setting of Hong Kong, where neither dividends nor capital gains are taxed. Raw markdown: kadapakkam-2000-reduction-of-constraints-on-arbitrage-trading-and-market Bibliographic Record Authors: Kadapakkam, PR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00309 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Previous research documents positive ex-dividend day returns in excess of one percent in the unique institutional setting of Hong Kong, where neither dividends nor capital gains are taxed. Short-term arbitrage trades around the ex-day were hampered by physical settlement procedures. After the recent switch to an electronic settlement system, which enables such trades, ex-day abnormal returns have declined to an insignificant 0.17 percent. This drop is more pronounced fbr high-yield stocks, which are more likely to attract dividend capture trading. The evidence points to the crucial role of short-term traders in ensuring the pricing efficiency of financial markets. 摘要（中文） 以往研究记录了在香港这一独特的制度环境中除息日正收益超过1%的现象，在香港股利和资本利得均不征税。围绕除息日的短期套利交易此前受到实物结算程序的阻碍。在近期切换到电子结算系统（该系统使此类交易成为可能）之后，除息日异常收益已下降至不显著的0.17%。这一下降对高收益率股票更为明显，这类股票更有可能吸引股利捕获交易。证据表明短期交易者在确保金融市场定价效率方面发挥着关键作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Lost in translation: Delayed ex-dividend price adjustments of Hong Kong ADRs
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Previous research documents that Hong Kong stocks have a full ex-dividend price adjustment consistent with dividends and capital gains being tax free. Raw markdown: kadapakkam-2010-lost-in-translation-delayed-ex-dividend-price-adjustments Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Lost in translation: Delayed ex-dividend price adjustments of Hong Kong ADRs (2010) Paper claim — Previous research documents that Hong Kong stocks have a full ex-dividend price adjustment consistent with dividends and capital gains being tax free. Raw markdown: kadapakkam-2010-lost-in-translation-delayed-ex-dividend-price-adjustments Bibliographic Record Authors: Kadapakkam, PR, Meisami, A, Shi, YL Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2009.09.001 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Previous research documents that Hong Kong stocks have a full ex-dividend price adjustment consistent with dividends and capital gains being tax free. We examine ex-dividend price behavior of Hong Kong ADRs to assess the impact of differing tax environments in US and Hong Kong. These ADRs typically go ex-dividend before their underlying stock. They experience significant abnormal returns of 1.16% on their ex-day: the average ex-day price drop is only 30% of the dividend. However, ADR prices drop when the underlying stock goes ex-dividend subsequently. The cumulative ADR price drop is equal to the dividend. Thus, the ADR ex-dividend adjustment resembles that of the underlying stock, consistent with home country tax laws governing ADR price behavior. Neither liquidity nor transaction costs can explain the anomalous delayed ex-dividend adjustment of ADRs. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 以往研究记录，香港股票具有与股利和资本利得均免税相一致的完全除息价格调整。我们考察香港ADR（美国存托凭证）的除息价格行为，以评估美国和香港不同税收环境的影响。这些ADR通常在其标的股票之前除息。它们在除息日经历了1.16%的显著异常收益：平均除息日价格下跌仅为股利的30%。然而，当标的股票随后除息时，ADR价格会下跌。ADR的累计价格下跌等于股利。因此，ADR的除息调整与其标的股票的调整相似，这与由母国税法主导ADR价格行为相一致。流动性和交易成本都无法解释ADR这种反常的延迟除息调整。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Superreplication of Financial Derivatives via Convex Programming
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We give a method based on convex programming to calculate the optimal super-replicating and subreplicating prices and corresponding hedging portfolios of a financial derivative in terms of other financial derivatives in a discrete-time setting. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Superreplication of Financial Derivatives via Convex Programming (2017) Paper claim — We give a method based on convex programming to calculate the optimal super-replicating and subreplicating prices and corresponding hedging portfolios of a financial derivative in terms of other financial derivatives in a discrete-time setting. Raw markdown: kahal-2017-superreplication-of-financial-derivatives-via-convex-programming Bibliographic Record Authors: Kahalé, N Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2017.2786 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We give a method based on convex programming to calculate the optimal super-replicating and subreplicating prices and corresponding hedging portfolios of a financial derivative in terms of other financial derivatives in a discrete-time setting. Our method produces a model that matches the superreplicating (or subreplicating) price within an arbitrary precision and is consistent with the other financial derivatives prices. Applications include robust replication in terms of call prices with various strikes and maturities of forward start options, volatility and variance swaps and derivatives, cliquet calls, barrier options, and lookback and Asian options. Numerical examples show that, in some cases, the best superreplicating and/or subreplicating prices are within 10% of the price obtained by a standard model but considerably differ from it in other cases. Our method can incorporate bid-ask spreads, interest rates and dividends, and various limitations to the diffusion model. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一种基于凸规划的方法，在离散时间框架下，以其他金融衍生品为参照，计算某一金融衍生品的最优超复制价格和次复制价格及其相应的对冲组合。我们的方法产生的模型能在任意精度内匹配超复制（或次复制）价格，并与其他金融衍生品价格保持一致。应用范围包括：以各种执行价和到期日的看涨期权价格对远期开始期权、波动率与方差互换及衍生品、棘轮式看涨期权、障碍期权以及回望期权和亚式期权进行稳健复制。数值算例表明，在某些情形下，最优超复制和/或次复制价格与标准模型所得价格相差在10%以内，但在其他情形下则与之相差甚远。我们的方法可纳入买卖价差、利率和股利，以及扩散模型的各种局限。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Why are corporate payouts so high in the 20 0 0s?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The average annual inflation-adjusted amount paid out through dividends and repurchases by public industrial firms is more than three times larger from 20 0 0 to 2019 than from 1971 to 1999. Raw markdown: kahle-2021-why-are-corporate-payouts-so-high-in-the…
pages.text: Why are corporate payouts so high in the 20 0 0s? (2021) Paper claim — The average annual inflation-adjusted amount paid out through dividends and repurchases by public industrial firms is more than three times larger from 20 0 0 to 2019 than from 1971 to 1999. Raw markdown: kahle-2021-why-are-corporate-payouts-so-high-in-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Kahle, K, Stulz, RM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.06.020 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract The average annual inflation-adjusted amount paid out through dividends and repurchases by public industrial firms is more than three times larger from 20 0 0 to 2019 than from 1971 to 1999. We find that an increase in aggregate corporate income accounts for 37% of the increase in aggregate annual payouts, and an increase in the payout rate accounts for 63%. Firms have higher payout rates in the 20 0 0s not only because they are older, larger, and have more free cash flow, but also because they pay out more of their free cash flow. Though firms spend less on capital expenditures in the 20 0 0s than before, capital expenditures decrease similarly for firms with payouts and for firms without. (c) 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 由公众工业企业通过股利和回购派发的年度平均通胀调整金额，在2000至2019年间比1971至1999年间大三倍以上。我们发现，公司总收入的增加解释了年度总派现增加的37%，而派现率的上升解释了63%。企业在2000年代拥有更高的派现率，不仅因为它们更老、更大、拥有更多自由现金流，还因为它们派发出更大比例的自由现金流。虽然企业在2000年代的资本支出低于此前，但对于有派现和无派现的企业，资本支出的下降幅度相似。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article uses managerial control rights data for over 5000 firms from 31 countries to examine the net costs and benefits of cash holdings. Raw markdown: kalcheva-2007-international-evidence-on-cash-holdings-and-expected-managerial Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: International evidence on cash holdings and expected managerial agency problems (2007) Paper claim — This article uses managerial control rights data for over 5000 firms from 31 countries to examine the net costs and benefits of cash holdings. Raw markdown: kalcheva-2007-international-evidence-on-cash-holdings-and-expected-managerial Bibliographic Record Authors: Kalcheva, I, Lins, KV Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhm023 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This article uses managerial control rights data for over 5000 firms from 31 countries to examine the net costs and benefits of cash holdings. We find that when external country-level shareholder protection is weak, firm values are lower when controlling managers hold more cash. Further, when external shareholder protection is weak we find that firm values are higher when controlling managers pay dividends. Only when external shareholder protection is strong do we find that cash held by controlling managers is unrelated to firm value, consistent with generally prevailing U.S. and international evidence. 摘要（中文） 本文使用来自31个国家5000多家公司的管理层控制权数据，考察现金持有的净成本与收益。我们发现，当外部国家层面的股东保护较弱时，控股管理者持有更多现金时公司价值较低。此外，当外部股东保护较弱时，我们发现控股管理者支付股利时公司价值较高。只有当外部股东保护较强时，我们才发现控股管理者持有的现金与公司价值无关，这与普遍流行的美国和国际证据相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: (Un)intended consequences? The impact of the 2017 tax cuts and jobs act on shareholder wealth
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the stock market reactions to the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA), the most significant structural U.S. Raw markdown: kalcheva-2020-un-intended-consequences-the-impact-of-the-2017 Bibliographic Record Authors: Kalcheva, I, Plecnik, JM, Tran, H, Turkiela, J…
pages.text: (Un)intended consequences? The impact of the 2017 tax cuts and jobs act on shareholder wealth (2020) Paper claim — We study the stock market reactions to the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA), the most significant structural U.S. Raw markdown: kalcheva-2020-un-intended-consequences-the-impact-of-the-2017 Bibliographic Record Authors: Kalcheva, I, Plecnik, JM, Tran, H, Turkiela, J Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2020.105860 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(payout) Abstract We study the stock market reactions to the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA), the most significant structural U.S. tax reform in over 30 years. In line with the stated intent of TCJA proponents, we find that the Act benefited highly taxed firms. However, the Act hindered firms with international operations as well as firms with high interest expense and tax losses. Counter to claims that the TCJA would quickly spur economic growth, we find that financially constrained and high growth opportunity firms did not benefit. Rather, market participants anticipate that most of the TCJA's benefits will be passed on to shareholders via higher corporate payouts. We confirm these market expectations by documenting that firms did increase payouts via repurchases after the TCJA, but did not increase their corporate investments. (c) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究股票市场对《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）的反应，这是美国30多年来最重大的结构性税收改革。与TCJA支持者所声明的意图一致，我们发现该法案使高税负企业受益。然而，该法案损害了具有国际业务的企业以及利息费用高和有税务亏损的企业。与“TCJA将迅速刺激经济增长”的主张相反，我们发现受融资约束的企业和高成长机会企业并未受益。相反，市场参与者预期TCJA的大部分益处将通过更高的公司派现传递给股东。我们通过记录企业在TCJA之后确实通过回购增加了派现、但并未增加其公司投资，证实了这些市场预期。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Dividend Initiation Decision of Newly Public Firms: Some Evidence on Signaling with Dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We track the dividend initiation (DI) decisions from a sample of 6,588 firms that went public during the period 1979-2005 and find that 873 of them initiated dividends. Raw markdown: kale-2012-the-dividend-initiation-decision-of-newly-public-firms Bibliographic…
pages.text: The Dividend Initiation Decision of Newly Public Firms: Some Evidence on Signaling with Dividends (2012) Paper claim — We track the dividend initiation (DI) decisions from a sample of 6,588 firms that went public during the period 1979-2005 and find that 873 of them initiated dividends. Raw markdown: kale-2012-the-dividend-initiation-decision-of-newly-public-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Kale, JR, Kini, O, Payne, JD Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109012000063 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, catering, signal) Abstract We track the dividend initiation (DI) decisions from a sample of 6,588 firms that went public during the period 1979-2005 and find that 873 of them initiated dividends. Our primary objective is to determine whether information signaling can explain the DI decision. We find that variables suggested by the dividend-signaling models of John and Williams (1985) and Allen, Bernardo, and Welch (2000) are significant determinants of the DI decision and the associated announcement-period stock price effect. We also find support for the residual, agency, tax, clientele, transaction costs, catering, and life-cycle explanations of dividend policy. 摘要（中文） 我们追踪了1979至2005年间上市的6588家企业样本的股利首次发放（DI）决策，发现其中873家发起了股利发放。我们的主要目标是确定信息信号传递能否解释股利首次发放决策。我们发现，John和Williams（1985）以及Allen、Bernardo和Welch（2000）的股利信号模型所提出的变量，是股利首次发放决策及相关公告期股价效应的显著决定因素。我们还发现支持股利政策的剩余理论、代理理论、税收理论、追随者理论、交易成本理论、迎合理论和生命周期解释的证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Using Tucker's theorem of the alternative to simplify, review and expand discrete arbitrage theory
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — For valuing derivatives and other assets in securities and commodities markets, arbitrage pricing theory has been a major approach for decades. Raw markdown: kallio-2007-using-tucker-s-theorem-of-the-alternative-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Kallio, M, Ziemba,…
pages.text: Using Tucker's theorem of the alternative to simplify, review and expand discrete arbitrage theory (2007) Paper claim — For valuing derivatives and other assets in securities and commodities markets, arbitrage pricing theory has been a major approach for decades. Raw markdown: kallio-2007-using-tucker-s-theorem-of-the-alternative-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Kallio, M, Ziemba, WT Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2007.02.004 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract For valuing derivatives and other assets in securities and commodities markets, arbitrage pricing theory has been a major approach for decades. This paper derives fundamental arbitrage pricing results in finite dimensions in a simple unified framework using Tucker's theorem of the alternative. Frictionless results, that is perfect market results, plus imperfect market results such as those with dividends, periodic interest payments, transaction costs, different interest rates for lending and borrowing, shorting costs and constrained short selling are presented. While the results are mostly known and appear in various places, our contribution is to present them in a coherent and comprehensive fashion with very simple proofs. The analysis yields a simple procedure to prove new results and some are presented for cases with imperfect market frictions. (C) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 对于证券和商品市场中衍生品及其他资产的估值，套利定价理论数十年来一直是一种主要方法。本文使用Tucker择一定理，在一个简单统一的框架中推导了有限维中的基本套利定价结果。文中给出了无摩擦结果（即完美市场结果）以及不完美市场结果，例如具有股利、周期性利息支付、交易成本、借贷不同利率、卖空成本和受约束卖空的结果。虽然这些结果大多是已知的并出现在各个地方，但我们的贡献在于以一种连贯而全面的方式并用非常简单的证明呈现它们。该分析产生了一个证明新结果的简单程序，并针对具有不完美市场摩擦的情形给出了一些新结果。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managerial innovation incentives, management buyouts, and shareholders' intolerance of failure
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study demonstrates that, apart from managerial agency problem, shareholders' intolerance of failure also deteriorates managerial innovation incentives in public firms. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Managerial innovation incentives, management buyouts, and shareholders' intolerance of failure (2017) Paper claim — This study demonstrates that, apart from managerial agency problem, shareholders' intolerance of failure also deteriorates managerial innovation incentives in public firms. Raw markdown: kamoto-2017-managerial-innovation-incentives-management-buyouts-and-shareholders-intoleran Bibliographic Record Authors: Kamoto, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.11.002 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This study demonstrates that, apart from managerial agency problem, shareholders' intolerance of failure also deteriorates managerial innovation incentives in public firms. Furthermore, management buyouts improve the innovation intensity, even if managers gain no excess value from the buyouts in collaboration with private equity firms. The study provides insights into the interrelation between firms' innovation, corporate governance, and dividend policy. It presents a rationale behind empirical evidence of a positive relationship between management buyouts and innovation intensity. It provides empirical implications on firms' characteristics that facilitate management buyouts and the return and risk structure of private equity firms. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究表明，除了管理者代理问题之外，股东对失败的不容忍也会恶化上市公司中管理者的创新激励。此外，管理层收购提高了创新强度，即使管理者在与私募股权公司合作的收购中并未获得超额价值。本研究为企业创新、公司治理和股利政策之间的相互关系提供了见解。它为管理层收购与创新强度之间正向关系的经验证据提供了理论依据。它为便于管理层收购的企业特征以及私募股权公司的收益与风险结构提供了经验含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Bank dividends, risk, and regulatory regimes
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates the relation between bank dividends and bank risk over the period 1984-2011, and assesses the existence of risk-taking and risk-shifting in the US commercial banking sector subject to regulatory regime changes. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Bank dividends, risk, and regulatory regimes (2013) Paper claim — This paper investigates the relation between bank dividends and bank risk over the period 1984-2011, and assesses the existence of risk-taking and risk-shifting in the US commercial banking sector subject to regulatory regime changes. Raw markdown: kanas-2013-bank-dividends-risk-and-regulatory-regimes Bibliographic Record Authors: Kanas, A Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2012.05.018 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat, supervis)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper investigates the relation between bank dividends and bank risk over the period 1984-2011, and assesses the existence of risk-taking and risk-shifting in the US commercial banking sector subject to regulatory regime changes. The introduction of PCA in 1992 and TARP in 2008 constitute significant regulatory regime changes, and provide the necessary framework to explore whether regime-dependent risk-shifting or risk-taking is present. We find strong evidence of risk-shifting and risk-taking over the post-PCA regime spanning the period 1992-2008. We interpret this evidence as indication of ineffectiveness of PCA in controlling risk-taking and risk-shifting. The finding of risk-taking just prior to the recent financial crisis suggests that risk-taking may be a factor contributing to this crisis. As risk-taking and risk-shifting are important aspects of bank behavior (Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, 2009), these results are of interest to bank regulators and important to Basel III. (C) 2012 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 本文考察1984—2011年期间银行股利与银行风险之间的关系，并评估在受监管制度变化影响下的美国商业银行业中是否存在风险承担和风险转移。1992年引入的及时纠正措施（PCA）以及2008年引入的问题资产救助计划（TARP）构成了重大的监管制度变化，并提供了探究是否存在依赖于制度的风险转移或风险承担的必要框架。我们在涵盖1992—2008年期间的PCA后制度中发现了风险转移和风险承担的有力证据。我们将这一证据解读为PCA在控制风险承担和风险转移方面无效的迹象。在近期金融危机之前恰好发现风险承担，这表明风险承担可能是导致这场危机的一个因素。由于风险承担和风险转移是银行行为的重要方面（巴塞尔银行监管委员会，2009），这些结果对银行监管者具有意义，并对巴塞尔协议III具有重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A well-known view in the literature is that if management is more concerned with the firm's survival than with profitability, it is efficient to use a levered capital structure and thereby transfer the liquidation decision to lenders. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Dividends and debt with managerial agency and lender holdup (2004) Paper claim — A well-known view in the literature is that if management is more concerned with the firm's survival than with profitability, it is efficient to use a levered capital structure and thereby transfer the liquidation decision to lenders. Raw markdown: kanatas-2004-dividends-and-debt-with-managerial-agency-and-lender Bibliographic Record Authors: Kanatas, G, Qi, JP Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1030.0183 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract A well-known view in the literature is that if management is more concerned with the firm's survival than with profitability, it is efficient to use a levered capital structure and thereby transfer the liquidation decision to lenders. Our paper extends this idea to a setting where lenders behave opportunistically when they control the liquidation decision. We show that in this situation, an optimal mix of debt and dividends, can mitigate the twin moral hazard problems of the manager and the lender. Given an otherwise optimal capital structure, initiating a dividend policy increases firm value, lowers debt payments, but raises total cash disbursements-interest and dividends-to investors. Numerous other empirical implications of the model are also discussed. 摘要（中文） 文献中一个广为人知的观点是，如果管理层更关心企业的存续而非盈利能力，那么采用杠杆化的资本结构、从而将清算决策转移给贷款人是有效率的。我们的论文将这一思想扩展到贷款人在控制清算决策时表现出机会主义行为的情境。我们表明，在这种情况下，债务与股利的最优组合可以缓解管理者和贷款人的双重道德风险问题。在其他方面已是最优的资本结构下，发起一项股利政策会提高企业价值、降低债务支付，但会提高向投资者的现金支付总额——利息加股利。文中还讨论了该模型的众多其他经验含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend and corporate income taxation with present-biased consumers
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Debates on the double taxation of dividends and corporate income have been long-standing. Raw markdown: kang-2023-dividend-and-corporate-income-taxation-with-present-biased Bibliographic Record Authors: Kang, M, Ye, LS Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: Dividend and corporate income taxation with present-biased consumers (2023) Paper claim — Debates on the double taxation of dividends and corporate income have been long-standing. Raw markdown: kang-2023-dividend-and-corporate-income-taxation-with-present-biased Bibliographic Record Authors: Kang, M, Ye, LS Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2023.106835 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Debates on the double taxation of dividends and corporate income have been long-standing. If double taxation were to be avoided, which type of tax policy would be more ideal? Conventional corporate the-ory based on microeconomic approaches does not yield a definitive answer, as either policy would distort firm investment and decrease firm value. Distinct from previous models, this paper addresses the dou-ble taxation issue in a macroeconomic context under a Laibson-type hyperbolic discounting model. In particular, this paper shows that in the hyperbolic economy, dividend taxes can improve consumer wel-fare, even though they decrease firm value. On the other hand, corporate income taxes negatively impact both consumers and firms. We also extend this result in an infinite-period steady-state model and show quantitative implications. (c) 2023 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 关于股利和公司所得税双重征税的争论由来已久。如果要避免双重征税，哪种税收政策更为理想？基于微观经济方法的传统企业理论无法给出确定的答案，因为任一政策都会扭曲企业投资并降低企业价值。与以往模型不同，本文在Laibson型双曲贴现模型下的宏观经济背景中探讨双重征税问题。特别地，本文表明，在双曲经济中，股利税可以改善消费者福利，尽管它降低了企业价值。另一方面，公司所得税同时对消费者和企业产生负面影响。我们还在一个无限期稳态模型中扩展了这一结果，并展示了定量含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends, trust, and firm value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find evidence that investors value dividends differently depending on their level of trust. Raw markdown: kapons-2023-dividends-trust-and-firm-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Kapons, M, Kelly, P, Stoumbos, R, Zambrana, R Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES…
pages.text: Dividends, trust, and firm value (2023) Paper claim — We find evidence that investors value dividends differently depending on their level of trust. Raw markdown: kapons-2023-dividends-trust-and-firm-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Kapons, M, Kelly, P, Stoumbos, R, Zambrana, R Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-023-09795-4 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We find evidence that investors value dividends differently depending on their level of trust. Our tests indicate that investor demand for dividend-paying stocks increases as trust decreases, and that this relationship affects market values. We begin with survey evidence showing that people think accounting fraud is less likely among dividend payers and that people with low trust are more likely to hold dividend-paying stocks. We then empirically exploit accounting fraud discoveries within a mutual fund's portfolio as a shock to trust. In response to these shocks, we show that mutual funds tilt their portfolios toward dividend-paying stocks. This result is not explained by a shift in risk preferences, indicating that these institutional investors are seeking dividends in particular rather than stable firms that just happen to pay dividends. Finally, we provide evidence that dividend payers experience a premium in their market values relative to non-payers when their investor base becomes less trusting. 摘要（中文） 我们发现证据表明，投资者根据其信任水平的不同而对股利有不同的估值。我们的检验表明，投资者对派息股票的需求随信任度下降而增加，且这一关系影响市场价值。我们首先呈现调查证据，表明人们认为派息公司发生会计舞弊的可能性较低，且信任度低的人更可能持有派息股票。随后我们在经验上利用某共同基金投资组合内部发现的会计舞弊作为对信任的冲击。在应对这些冲击时，我们表明共同基金会将其投资组合向派息股票倾斜。这一结果无法由风险偏好的转变来解释，表明这些机构投资者特别追求的是股利，而非恰好派息的稳定企业。最后，我们提供证据表明，当投资者基础变得信任度更低时，派息公司相对于不派息公司在市场价值上享有溢价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends: Relevance, rigidity, and signaling
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper uses a dynamic partial equilibrium model to explain a puzzle of dividend smoothing. Raw markdown: karpavicius-2014-dividends-relevance-rigidity-and-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Karpavicius, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014…
pages.text: Dividends: Relevance, rigidity, and signaling (2014) Paper claim — This paper uses a dynamic partial equilibrium model to explain a puzzle of dividend smoothing. Raw markdown: karpavicius-2014-dividends-relevance-rigidity-and-signaling Bibliographic Record Authors: Karpavicius, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.12.014 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper uses a dynamic partial equilibrium model to explain a puzzle of dividend smoothing. In contrast to the Modigliani-Miller theory, I show that firm value depends on payout policy. The analysis implies that firms with more stable dividend stream are more valuable. This explains why dividends are rigid over time. A volatile component of dividends is introduced to reduce the likelihood of dividend omission in bad times while keeping the same historical average dividends. I show that the empirically observed positive relation between dividends and future firm performance is a statistical artifact driven by dividend smoothing. Thus, the empirical tests of dividend signaling theory might be misspecified. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文使用一个动态局部均衡模型来解释股利平滑之谜。与Modigliani-Miller理论相反，我表明企业价值取决于支付政策。分析表明，拥有更稳定股利流的企业更有价值。这解释了为何股利随时间推移是刚性的。引入股利的波动性成分是为了降低在困难时期取消股利的可能性，同时保持相同的历史平均股利。我表明，实证观察到的股利与未来企业业绩之间的正向关系是由股利平滑所驱动的一种统计假象。因此，对股利信号理论的实证检验可能是设定错误的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In May 1997, the Japanese Commercial Code was amended to allow firms to begin granting stock options as compensation to top management and employees. Raw markdown: kato-2005-an-empirical-examination-of-the-costs-and-benefits Bibliographic Record Authors: Kato, HK,…
pages.text: An empirical examination of the costs and benefits of executive stock options: Evidence from Japan (2005) Paper claim — In May 1997, the Japanese Commercial Code was amended to allow firms to begin granting stock options as compensation to top management and employees. Raw markdown: kato-2005-an-empirical-examination-of-the-costs-and-benefits Bibliographic Record Authors: Kato, HK, Lemmon, M, Luo, M, Schallheim, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2004.09.001 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract In May 1997, the Japanese Commercial Code was amended to allow firms to begin granting stock options as compensation to top management and employees. Nearly 350 firms adopted option-based compensation plans between 1997 and 2001. These options typically have five year lives and are out-of-the-money by about 5% at the grant date. Firms exhibit abnormal stock returns of about 2%, around the announcements of plan adoptions. We find improvements in operating performance and observe that dividend policy and volatility remain unchanged post-adoption. Our evidence suggests that well-designed incentive compensation plans are consistent with the creation of shareholder Value. (c) 2005 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 1997年5月，日本《商法》修订，允许企业开始将股票期权作为对高层管理者和员工的薪酬进行授予。1997年至2001年间有近350家企业采纳了基于期权的薪酬计划。这些期权通常有五年期限，并在授予日约低于价内5%（即价外5%）。企业在计划采纳公告前后表现出约2%的异常股票收益。我们发现经营业绩有所改善，并观察到采纳后股利政策和波动性保持不变。我们的证据表明，设计良好的激励薪酬计划与股东价值的创造相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Rational and behavioral motives to trade: Evidence from reinvestment of dividends and tender offer proceeds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We provide evidence of households' stock market trading in response to clearly identifiable positive cash flow shocks: dividend payments and tender offer proceeds. Raw markdown: kaustia-2012-rational-and-behavioral-motives-to-trade-evidence-from Bibliographic…
pages.text: Rational and behavioral motives to trade: Evidence from reinvestment of dividends and tender offer proceeds (2012) Paper claim — We provide evidence of households' stock market trading in response to clearly identifiable positive cash flow shocks: dividend payments and tender offer proceeds. Raw markdown: kaustia-2012-rational-and-behavioral-motives-to-trade-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Kaustia, M, Rantapuska, E Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2012.04.015 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We provide evidence of households' stock market trading in response to clearly identifiable positive cash flow shocks: dividend payments and tender offer proceeds. Transaction cost motives appear important, and there is some support for rational portfolio rebalancing and life cycle considerations as well. Households' tendency to reinvest is low, even for large and unexpected dividend payments. This is consistent with a default choice bias, and is not due to dividend clientele effects. Reinvestment of tender offer proceeds is significantly higher, controlling for other important factors. This is consistent with mental accounting, i.e., cash flows from different sources are treated differently. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们提供了家庭对清晰可辨的正向现金流冲击——即股利支付和要约收购收益——作出股票市场交易反应的证据。交易成本动机似乎很重要，并且也有一些证据支持理性的投资组合再平衡和生命周期考量。家庭的再投资倾向很低，即使对于大额且意外的股利支付也是如此。这与一种默认选择偏差相一致，而不是由于股利客户群效应。在控制其他重要因素后，要约收购收益的再投资显著更高。这与心理账户相一致，即来自不同来源的现金流被区别对待。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Distracted Shareholders and Corporate Actions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Investor attention matters for corporate actions. Raw markdown: kempf-2017-distracted-shareholders-and-corporate-actions Bibliographic Record Authors: Kempf, E, Manconi, A, Spalt, O Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhw082 Relevance…
pages.text: Distracted Shareholders and Corporate Actions (2017) Paper claim — Investor attention matters for corporate actions. Raw markdown: kempf-2017-distracted-shareholders-and-corporate-actions Bibliographic Record Authors: Kempf, E, Manconi, A, Spalt, O Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhw082 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, monitor)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Investor attention matters for corporate actions. Our new identification approach constructs firm-level shareholder "distraction" measures, by exploiting exogenous shocks to unrelated parts of institutional shareholders' portfolios. Firms with "distracted" shareholders are more likely to announce diversifying, value-destroying, acquisitions. They are also more likely to grant opportunistically timed CEO stock options, more likely to cut dividends, and less likely to fire their CEO for bad performance. Firms with distracted shareholders have abnormally low stock returns. Combined, these patterns are consistent with a model in which the unrelated shock shifts investor attention, leading to a temporary loosening of monitoring constraints. 摘要（中文） 投资者关注对公司行为很重要。我们全新的识别方法通过利用机构股东组合中不相关部分所受的外生冲击，构建了公司层面的股东"分心"度量。拥有"分心"股东的公司更可能宣布多元化的、破坏价值的收购。它们还更可能授予择机时点的CEO股票期权，更可能削减股利，且更不可能因业绩不佳而解雇其CEO。拥有分心股东的公司具有异常低的股票收益。综合来看，这些模式与一个模型相一致，在该模型中，不相关的冲击转移了投资者的关注，从而导致监督约束暂时松弛。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Value of outside blockholder activism: Evidence from the switchers
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper measures the value of shareholder activism focusing on outside blockholders who switch their investment purpose from passive to active but are not likely to engage in control-related activities. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Value of outside blockholder activism: Evidence from the switchers (2009) Paper claim — This paper measures the value of shareholder activism focusing on outside blockholders who switch their investment purpose from passive to active but are not likely to engage in control-related activities. Raw markdown: kim-2009-value-of-outside-blockholder-activism-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Kim, W, Kim, W, Kwon, KS Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2009.04.002 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, rule)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract This paper measures the value of shareholder activism focusing on outside blockholders who switch their investment purpose from passive to active but are not likely to engage in control-related activities. Unlike the usual 5% ownership disclosure, a switch does not necessarily involve additional share purchase, and thus provides a cleaner test in effectively ruling out alternative theories such as those related to stock picking skills, private information. or herding. We apply the test to outside blockholders in the Korean market, which experienced a concentrated number of switchers in the first half of 2005 when the government adopted a new disclosure rule. We find that target price reaction is significantly positive around the time of the switch disclosure and this effect is more pronounced when the switcher declares to use a wider scope of activist measures. Following the switch, we also find evidence of increases in dividend payouts for firms targeted by switchers with a wider scope of activism, and those with high free cash flows. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文衡量股东积极主义的价值，聚焦于将其投资目的从被动转为主动、但不太可能参与控制权相关活动的外部大股东。与通常的5%持股披露不同，这种转变不一定涉及额外的股份购买，因此提供了更为干净的检验，能够有效排除诸如选股技巧、私人信息或羊群行为等替代性理论。我们将该检验应用于韩国市场的外部大股东，该市场在2005年上半年政府采用新披露规则时经历了转变者的集中出现。我们发现，在转变披露前后，目标企业的股价反应显著为正，且当转变者声明将使用更广泛的积极主义措施时，这一效应更为显著。在转变之后，我们还发现证据表明，对于被采用更广泛积极主义的转变者所瞄准的企业，以及自由现金流高的企业，股利支付有所增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A J-shaped cross-sectional relation between dividends and firm value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study identifies a J-shaped relation between dividends and firm value. Raw markdown: kim-2018-a-j-shaped-cross-sectional-relation-between-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Kim, S, Park, SH, Suh, J Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI:…
pages.text: A J-shaped cross-sectional relation between dividends and firm value (2018) Paper claim — This study identifies a J-shaped relation between dividends and firm value. Raw markdown: kim-2018-a-j-shaped-cross-sectional-relation-between-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Kim, S, Park, SH, Suh, J Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.09.010 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(catering) Abstract This study identifies a J-shaped relation between dividends and firm value. On average, top dividend-payers are valued higher than all other firms, while non-dividend-payers are valued higher than low-dividend-payers. This J-shaped relation is highly stable over time as it is observed in nearly every year over the period 1962-2010, and it remains significant after controlling for firm characteristics such as profitability, growth and firm size. We also find similar J-shaped relations in stock markets outside the U.S. Our evidence suggests that dividend theories, such as the dividend catering, free-cash-flow and dividend clientele hypotheses, are inadequate to explain the J-shaped relation. It does not appear that the J-shaped pattern reflects mispricing. There is mixed evidence as to whether the J-shaped relation is driven by dividends or unobservable firm characteristics. (C) 2016 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 本研究识别出股利与公司价值之间存在J形关系。平均而言，最高股利支付者的估值高于所有其他公司，而不派息公司的估值高于低股利支付者。这种J形关系在时间上高度稳定，因为在1962-2010年期间几乎每一年都能观察到，并且在控制了盈利能力、增长和公司规模等公司特征之后仍然显著。我们还在美国以外的股票市场中发现了类似的J形关系。我们的证据表明，诸如股利迎合、自由现金流和股利客户群假说等股利理论不足以解释这种J形关系。这种J形模式似乎并非反映错误定价。关于该J形关系是由股利还是由不可观测的公司特征驱动，证据是混合的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stop the presses! Or wait, we might need them: Firm responses to local newspaper closures and layoffs
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Media as a whole has been shown to play an important role as an information source, information intermediary, and monitor of public firms, but much less is known about whether local news-papers play a similar role. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Stop the presses! Or wait, we might need them: Firm responses to local newspaper closures and layoffs (2021) Paper claim — Media as a whole has been shown to play an important role as an information source, information intermediary, and monitor of public firms, but much less is known about whether local news-papers play a similar role. Raw markdown: kim-2021-stop-the-presses-or-wait-we-might-need Bibliographic Record Authors: Kim, M, Stice, D, Stice, H, White, RM Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.102035 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Media as a whole has been shown to play an important role as an information source, information intermediary, and monitor of public firms, but much less is known about whether local news-papers play a similar role. We attempt to shed light on this issue, and we investigate if and how firms respond to changes in the local newspaper industry, where closures and layoffs have become the norm. Compared to a sample of matched control firms, we find that following newspaper closures and large industry layoffs, nearby public companies boost dividend payouts. This result follows from prior research suggesting that investors pressure managers to increase dividends in response to growing agency problems. Cross-sectional analyses confirm that our results are driven by geographically-concentrated firms that rely more heavily on local newspa-pers as a monitor and information source. Our findings suggest that local newspapers play an important role as an information intermediary and monitor of public firms, and that the disap-pearance of local newspapers exacerbates agency problems in nearby firms that tend to be remedied by higher dividends. 摘要（中文） 媒体作为一个整体已被证明作为信息来源、信息中介以及上市公司监督者发挥着重要作用，但关于地方报纸是否发挥类似作用则知之甚少。我们试图对这一问题加以阐明，并考察企业是否以及如何应对地方报业的变化——在该行业，倒闭和裁员已成为常态。与匹配的控制组企业样本相比，我们发现，在报纸倒闭和大规模行业裁员之后，附近的上市公司会提高股利支付。这一结果与先前研究相符，后者表明投资者会向经理人施压，要求其为应对不断增长的代理问题而提高股利。横截面分析证实，我们的结果是由那些地理上更集中、更依赖地方报纸作为监督者和信息来源的企业所驱动的。我们的发现表明，地方报纸作为上市公司的信息中介和监督者发挥着重要作用，且地方报纸的消失加剧了附近企业的代理问题，而这些问题往往通过更高的股利来加以补救。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Tunneling through trademarks
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study documents how trademarks can be used to benefit controlling families at the expense of outside minority shareholders. Raw markdown: kim-2022-tunneling-through-trademarks Bibliographic Record Authors: Kim, S, Kim, W Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE…
pages.text: Tunneling through trademarks (2022) Paper claim — This study documents how trademarks can be used to benefit controlling families at the expense of outside minority shareholders. Raw markdown: kim-2022-tunneling-through-trademarks Bibliographic Record Authors: Kim, S, Kim, W Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102274 Relevance score: 13.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout, stock repurchase)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow, tunneling) Abstract This study documents how trademarks can be used to benefit controlling families at the expense of outside minority shareholders. Using a sample of Korean business group firms from 2017 to 2020, we find evidence to support this. First, firms are more likely to be licensor firms if the family holds higher cash flow rights. Second, we find that the association between a firm's sales and the likelihood of it being a licensee firm (or the amount of trademark royalty payments) gets stronger when the family's cash flow rights in the firm fall further below those in the licensor firm (i.e., higher cash flow rights differentials). Third, we find that the negative association between a firm's trademark royalty payments and shareholder distribution (i.e., dividend payouts and stock repurchases) gets stronger when family's cash flow rights differentials widen. Fourth, we find that the share prices of licensee firms react negatively on the day when the full disclosure of trademark royalty payments became mandatory, and that this tendency is stronger in firms with higher trademark royalty payments and higher cash flow rights differentials. Finally, these results manifest more significantly in pure holding company groups, where alternative tunneling channels are limited. 摘要（中文） 本研究记录了商标如何被用来使控股家族受益，而以外部中小股东为代价。使用2017年至2020年韩国企业集团的样本，我们发现了支持这一点的证据。第一，若家族持有更高的现金流权，企业更可能成为许可方企业。第二，我们发现，当家族在某企业的现金流权进一步低于其在许可方企业的现金流权时（即更高的现金流权差异），该企业的销售额与其成为被许可方企业的可能性（或商标特许权使用费金额）之间的关联会增强。第三，我们发现，当家族的现金流权差异扩大时，企业的商标特许权使用费与股东分配（即股利支付和股份回购）之间的负相关关系会增强。第四，我们发现，在商标特许权使用费的全面披露成为强制性要求的当天，被许可方企业的股价出现负面反应，且这一倾向在商标特许权使用费更高、现金流权差异更大的企业中更强。最后，这些结果在纯控股公司集团中表现得更为显著，因为在这类集团中其他掏空渠道受到限制。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
