pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper proposes and tests a new method to extract the value of corporate voting rights from market prices of American-style single-stock options. Raw markdown: kind-2013-the-value-of-corporate-voting-rights-embedded-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Kind, A,…
pages.text: The value of corporate voting rights embedded in option prices (2013) Paper claim — This paper proposes and tests a new method to extract the value of corporate voting rights from market prices of American-style single-stock options. Raw markdown: kind-2013-the-value-of-corporate-voting-rights-embedded-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Kind, A, Poltera, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.03.004 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract This paper proposes and tests a new method to extract the value of corporate voting rights from market prices of American-style single-stock options. The method models voting-right values as non-cash dividends and backs them out via numerical optimization from prices of equity options. Simulation experiments show that the method is accurate and outperforms existing option-based approaches by reducing their measurement error from 17.2% to 1.57% in terms of root mean squared errors and almost eliminates their bias. The paper also contributes an empirical analysis of corporate voting-right values in European companies in the time period between 2003 and 2010. Voting rights have an annualized average value of 0.37% of the share price and are significantly worth more in months in which either ordinary or extraordinary general meetings take place but no single shareholder holds a majority stake in the company. Finally, voting values are higher in companies incorporated in French-civil-law countries (France and the Netherlands) than in German-civil-law countries (Germany and Switzerland). (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文提出并检验了一种从美式单一股票期权的市场价格中提取公司投票权价值的新方法。该方法将投票权价值建模为非现金股利，并通过数值优化从股票期权价格中反推出来。模拟实验表明，该方法准确，并优于现有基于期权的方法：以均方根误差衡量，它将现有方法的测量误差从17.2%降至1.57%，并几乎消除了其偏误。本文还对2003年至2010年间欧洲公司的投票权价值进行了实证分析。投票权的年化平均价值为股价的0.37%，并且在召开普通或特别股东大会但公司无单一股东持有多数股权的月份中显著更高。最后，在法国民法法系国家（法国和荷兰）注册的公司中，投票权价值高于德国民法法系国家（德国和瑞士）的公司。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE RISK-RETURN ATTRIBUTES OF PUBLICLY TRADED VENTURE CAPITAL - IMPLICATIONS FOR INVESTORS AND PUBLIC-POLICY
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Despite having provided original seed money to extremely successful start-ups such as Federal Express, Cray Research, and Apple Computer, the Small Business Administration (SBA) with encouragement from the U.S. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: THE RISK-RETURN ATTRIBUTES OF PUBLICLY TRADED VENTURE CAPITAL - IMPLICATIONS FOR INVESTORS AND PUBLIC-POLICY (1992) Paper claim — Despite having provided original seed money to extremely successful start-ups such as Federal Express, Cray Research, and Apple Computer, the Small Business Administration (SBA) with encouragement from the U.S. Raw markdown: kleiman-1992-the-risk-return-attributes-of-publicly-traded-venture Bibliographic Record Authors: KLEIMAN, RT, SHULMAN, JM Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS VENTURING Year: 1992 DOI: 10.1016/0883-9026(92)90026-N Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(audit, institution, monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Despite having provided original seed money to extremely successful start-ups such as Federal Express, Cray Research, and Apple Computer, the Small Business Administration (SBA) with encouragement from the U.S. Senate, has recently placed a moratorium on granting new small business investment company (SBIC) licenses. And, due to perceived fund mismanagement, at least some senators have suggested that the misguided SBICs could lead to "a mini S & L bailout." Consequently, the SBA has threatened the existence of the SBIC government-assisted program. Two public policy issues arise. First, should the government sponsor SBICs given their past risk-return characteristics? Second, if SBA support does re-emerge, should changes be made to the organizational structure of SBICs? With respect to the first issue, our study examines the risk/return attributes of two categories of venture capital funds: publicly traded business development corporations (BDCs) and SBICs. Popular folklore, as well as a recent study in this journal, suggest that a well-diversified fund of venture capital containing both SBICs and BDCs outperforms the general market. While previous research assumes that SBICs are similar to BDCs, we find striking dissimilarities between these groups. During 1980-1986, SBICs demonstrate significantly greater total and unsystematic risk, but significantly less systematic risk than BDCs. In addition, SBICs experience much higher returns, on a risk adjusted basis, than either the market proxy or BDCs. Financial theory suggests a number of reasons for the differential performance among the two groups. Moreover, given the strong investment success of publicly traded SBICs during the early to middle 1980s, and the ability of the public to monitor SBIC investment in lieu of the SBA, we conclude that continued SBA financing of SBICs benefits the investment community. However, the investment performance of SBICs in the late 1980s contrasts with the successes achieved earlier in the decade. Since 1986 many publicly traded SBICs have performed poorly, liquidated, or changed their organizational status. We conclude that many of these problems originate with the Investment Company Act of 1940. This Act limits operating flexibility of SBICs, discourages public trading and related monitoring by public investors, and reduces the equity capital cushion. Accordingly, we propose guidelines, including audit and equity capital considerations, that may mitigate difficulties stemming from the organizational structure of SBICs. Public policy issues related to SBA sponsorship of SBICs are relevant to individual and institutional investors-particularly as they relate to dividends, liquidity, investment allocation, and port-folio risk of venture capital related funds. For example, our study indicates that publicly traded SBICs, on average, appear to have greater corporate financial leverage and a large percentage of their portfolio invested in fixed income securities, compared with private SBICs (which invest more heavily in equity funds). To the extent that the SBA relaxes dividend payout restrictions on SBIC operating income, we might expect lower financial leverage and a greater portfolio allocation to equity instruments. This change would tend to reduce the financial risk related to SBIC ownership and encourage the provision of equity capital to emerging enterprises. 摘要（中文） 尽管小企业管理局（SBA）曾为诸如联邦快递、克雷研究公司和苹果电脑等极为成功的初创企业提供了最初的种子资金，但在美国参议院的敦促下，它近期暂停了发放新的小企业投资公司（SBIC）牌照。而且，由于被认为存在基金管理不善，至少一些参议员暗示这些误入歧途的SBIC可能引发"一场小型储贷危机式的救助"。因此，SBA威胁到了SBIC政府援助计划的存续。由此产生了两个公共政策问题。第一，鉴于SBIC过去的风险—收益特征，政府是否应当资助SBIC？第二，如果SBA的支持确实重新出现，是否应对SBIC的组织结构作出改变？就第一个问题而言，我们的研究考察了两类风险投资基金的风险/收益属性：公开交易的商业发展公司（BDC）和SBIC。流行的说法以及本刊近期的一项研究认为，一个同时包含SBIC和BDC的充分分散化的风险投资基金组合表现优于大盘。以往研究假定SBIC与BDC相似，而我们却发现这两组之间存在显著差异。在1980—1986年期间，SBIC表现出显著更高的总风险和非系统性风险，但其系统性风险显著低于BDC。此外，在风险调整的基础上，SBIC的收益远高于市场基准或BDC。金融理论提出了若干解释这两组之间业绩差异的原因。而且，鉴于公开交易的SBIC在20世纪80年代初至中期强劲的投资业绩，以及公众能够代替SBA监督SBIC投资的能力，我们得出结论：SBA继续为SBIC提供资金有利于投资界。然而，SBIC在80年代末的投资业绩与该十年早期取得的成功形成鲜明对比。自1986年以来，许多公开交易的SBIC表现不佳、被清算或改变了其组织形式。我们的结论是，这些问题中的许多都源于1940年的《投资公司法》。该法限制了SBIC的经营灵活性，抑制了公开交易及相关的公众投资者监督，并削减了权益资本缓冲。据此，我们提出了一些准则，包括审计和权益资本方面的考量，或可缓解源自SBIC组织结构的困难。与SBA资助SBIC有关的公共政策问题对个人和机构投资者都具有意义，尤其是就风险投资相关基金的股利、流动性、投资配置和组合风险而言。例如，我们的研究表明，与私人SBIC（其权益基金投资更为集中）相比，公开交易的SBIC平均而言似乎具有更高的公司财务杠杆，并且其组合中有很大比例投资于固定收益证券。如果SBA放宽对SBIC经营收入的股利派发限制，我们可以预期会出现更低的财务杠杆以及更高的股权工具组合配置。这一变化将倾向于降低与SBIC所有权相关的财务风险，并鼓励为新兴企业提供权益资本。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. This is especially true in papers we receive to review for journals. The purpose of this note is to clarify understanding of the no premature exercise condition. 摘要（中文） 本文表明，Merton关于股利派发未受保护的美式看涨期权不进行理性提前行权的充分条件，在金融文献中应用于多重股利情形时经常被误解和错误使用。在我们收到的供期刊评审的论文中尤其如此。本文的目的是澄清对不提前行权条件的理解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend changes and the persistence of past earnings changes
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine whether the market interprets changes in dividends as a signal about the persistence of past earnings changes. Raw markdown: koch-2004-dividend-changes-and-the-persistence-of-past-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Koch, AS, Sun, AX Journal: JOURNAL…
pages.text: Dividend changes and the persistence of past earnings changes (2004) Paper claim — We examine whether the market interprets changes in dividends as a signal about the persistence of past earnings changes. Raw markdown: koch-2004-dividend-changes-and-the-persistence-of-past-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Koch, AS, Sun, AX Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2004.00693.x Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We examine whether the market interprets changes in dividends as a signal about the persistence of past earnings changes. Prior to observing this signal, investors may believe that past earnings changes are not necessarily indicative of future earnings levels. We empirically investigate whether a change in dividends alters investors' assessments about the valuation implications of past earnings. Results confirm the hypothesis that changes in dividends cause investors to revise their expectations about the persistence of past earnings changes. This effect varies predictably with the magnitude of the dividend change and the sign of the past earnings change. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了市场是否将股利变动解读为关于过去盈余变动持久性的一个信号。在观察到这一信号之前，投资者可能认为过去的盈余变动不一定预示未来的盈余水平。我们从实证角度考察股利变动是否改变了投资者对过去盈余估值含义的评估。结果证实了以下假设：股利变动促使投资者修正其对过去盈余变动持久性的预期。这种效应随股利变动的幅度和过去盈余变动的符号而可预测地变化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The effect of financial reporting quality on corporate dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines how financial reporting quality affects corporate dividend policy. Raw markdown: koo-2017-the-effect-of-financial-reporting-quality-on-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: Koo, DS, Ramalingegowda, S, Yu, Y Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING…
pages.text: The effect of financial reporting quality on corporate dividend policy (2017) Paper claim — This study examines how financial reporting quality affects corporate dividend policy. Raw markdown: koo-2017-the-effect-of-financial-reporting-quality-on-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: Koo, DS, Ramalingegowda, S, Yu, Y Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-017-9393-3 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution, monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract This study examines how financial reporting quality affects corporate dividend policy. We find that higher quality reporting is associated with higher dividends. This positive association is more pronounced among firms with more severe free cash flow problems and among firms with higher ownership by monitoring-type institutional investors. Further analysis of the relation between reporting quality and under-/over-payment of dividends suggests that reporting quality largely mitigates underpayment of dividends. Additionally, both a granger causality test and a difference-in-difference analysis of dividend changes around a quasi-exogenous reporting event yield evidence consistent with the direction of causality going from financial reporting to dividends. Overall, these findings are consistent with financial reporting quality acting as a governance mechanism that induces managers to pay dividends by disciplining free cash flow problems. Our findings support the view that dividends are the result of enhanced monitoring (Jensen 1986; La Porta, Lopez-de-Silanes, Shleifer, and Vishny 2000). 摘要（中文） 本研究考察财务报告质量如何影响企业股利政策。我们发现，更高的报告质量与更高的股利相关。这一正相关关系在自由现金流问题更严重的企业中以及监督型机构投资者持股更高的企业中更为显著。对报告质量与股利支付不足/过度之间关系的进一步分析表明，报告质量在很大程度上缓解了股利支付不足。此外，格兰杰因果检验以及围绕一次准外生报告事件的股利变化双重差分分析，都得出了与因果方向从财务报告指向股利相一致的证据。总体而言，这些发现与财务报告质量充当一种治理机制、通过约束自由现金流问题促使管理者支付股利的观点相一致。我们的发现支持这样一种观点：股利是监督增强的结果（Jensen 1986；La Porta, Lopez-de-Silanes, Shleifer, and Vishny 2000）。 Key Findings In Tobit regressions on 19,031 U.S. firm-year observations (1994–2011), a one standard deviation increase in reporting quality (Dechow-Dichev measure) is associated with a 4.8 basis point increase in dividend yield — approximately a 5% increase from the sample average — and with both a higher probability of paying dividends and a larger magnitude conditional on paying. The positive relation between reporting quality and dividends is significantly stronger for firms with more severe free cash flow problems (above-median operating cash flows and below-median Tobin's Q) and for firms with higher ownership by monitoring-type institutional investors, supporting the outcome view of the free cash flow problem channel. The positive relation does not vary with financial constraints (Hadlock-Pierce index), providing no support for the financial constraint channel. Reporting quality is associated with lower underpayment of dividends (consistent with the outcome view) and also with lower overpayment of dividends (consistent with the substitute view or quiet life channel), based on tests using Richardson (2006) dividend residuals. Granger causality tests (PVAR) show that reporting quality Granger-causes dividends but not vice versa; a difference-in-difference analysis of firms subject to the SEC's 1955/1970 mandatory reporting frequency increases finds that these firms exhibit increases in dividends relative to control firms, consistent with a causal flow from reporting quality to dividends. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops a formal model of the effect of time-varying asymmetric information on the timing and pricing of equity issues when managers are better informed than outside investors. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: EQUITY ISSUES WITH TIME-VARYING ASYMMETRIC INFORMATION (1992) Paper claim — This paper develops a formal model of the effect of time-varying asymmetric information on the timing and pricing of equity issues when managers are better informed than outside investors. Raw markdown: korajczyk-1992-equity-issues-with-time-varying-asymmetric-information Bibliographic Record Authors: KORAJCZYK, RA, LUCAS, DJ, MCDONALD, RL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2331327 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper develops a formal model of the effect of time-varying asymmetric information on the timing and pricing of equity issues when managers are better informed than outside investors. We assume that as time passes, the adverse selection problem becomes more severe as more managers receive a private signal. Under this assumption, the model predicts temporal variation in the quantity of issues, with a bunching of issues after information releases. It also predicts that the price drop at issue announcement increases with the time since the last information release. These predictions are consistent with several recent empirical studies relating equity issues to earnings and dividend announcements. 摘要（中文） 本文建立了一个正式模型，考察当管理者比外部投资者更知情时，时变的信息不对称对股权发行的时机和定价的影响。我们假设随着时间的推移，逆向选择问题会随着更多管理者收到私有信号而变得更加严重。在这一假设下，模型预测发行数量存在时间上的变动，在信息发布后发行会出现聚集。它还预测发行公告时的价格下降随距上次信息发布的时间而增加。这些预测与若干将股权发行与盈余和股利公告相联系的近期实证研究相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Tax reform and payout policy: Do shareholder clienteles or payout policy adjust?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Changes in taxation of corporate dividends offer excellent opportunities to study dividend clientele effects. Raw markdown: korkeamaki-2010-tax-reform-and-payout-policy-do-shareholder-clienteles Bibliographic Record Authors: Korkeamaki, T, Liljeblom, E, Pasternack,…
pages.text: Tax reform and payout policy: Do shareholder clienteles or payout policy adjust? (2010) Paper claim — Changes in taxation of corporate dividends offer excellent opportunities to study dividend clientele effects. Raw markdown: korkeamaki-2010-tax-reform-and-payout-policy-do-shareholder-clienteles Bibliographic Record Authors: Korkeamaki, T, Liljeblom, E, Pasternack, D Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2009.12.003 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Changes in taxation of corporate dividends offer excellent opportunities to study dividend clientele effects. We explore payout policies and ownership structures around a major tax reform that took place in Finland in 2004. Consistent with dividend clienteles affecting firms' dividend policy decisions, we find that Finnish firms altered their dividend policies based on the changed tax incentives of their largest shareholders. While firms adjust their payout policies, our results also indicate that ownership structures of Finnish firms also changed around the 2004 reform, consistent with shareholder clienteles adjusting to the new tax system. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 公司股利税收的变化为研究股利客户效应提供了极佳的机会。我们考察了2004年芬兰一项重大税制改革前后的支付政策与所有权结构。与股利客户效应影响企业股利政策决策相一致，我们发现芬兰企业根据其最大股东所改变的税收激励调整了其股利政策。虽然企业调整了其支付政策，但我们的结果也表明，芬兰企业的所有权结构在2004年改革前后也发生了变化，这与股东客户群适应新税制相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Measurement effects and the variance of returns after stock splits and stock dividends (1998) Paper claim — This article examines the relation between two factors affecting stock returns, the bid-ask spread and price discreteness, and the increase in return variance after ex-dates of stock splits and stock dividends. Raw markdown: koski-1998-measurement-effects-and-the-variance-of-returns-after Bibliographic Record Authors: Koski, JL Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/11.1.143 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract This article examines the relation between two factors affecting stock returns, the bid-ask spread and price discreteness, and the increase in return variance after ex-dates of stock splits and stock dividends. Controlling for these effects, the variance of daily returns still increases significantly, The variance of weekly returns also increases significantly, and the variance of returns for a control sample of nonsplitting firms shows no significant increase Variance ratio tests show that bid-ask, errors are small for these stocks and therefore cannot explain the large increase in variance. Spreads and price discreteness do not explain increased variance after stock distributions. 摘要（中文） 本文考察影响股票收益的两个因素——买卖价差和价格离散性——与拆股和股票股利除权日之后收益方差增加之间的关系。在控制了这些效应之后，日收益的方差仍然显著增加。周收益的方差也显著增加，而一个由不拆股公司构成的对照样本的收益方差没有显著增加。方差比检验表明，对于这些股票而言买卖价差误差很小，因此无法解释方差的大幅增加。价差和价格离散性无法解释股票分配之后方差的增加。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate liquidity and dividend policy under uncertainty
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine optimal liquidity (retained earnings) and dividend choice incorporating debt financing with risk of default and bankruptcy costs as well as growth options under revenue uncertainty. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Corporate liquidity and dividend policy under uncertainty (2017) Paper claim — We examine optimal liquidity (retained earnings) and dividend choice incorporating debt financing with risk of default and bankruptcy costs as well as growth options under revenue uncertainty. Raw markdown: koussis-2017-corporate-liquidity-and-dividend-policy-under-uncertainty Bibliographic Record Authors: Koussis, N, Martzoukos, SH, Trigeorgis, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2016.11.015 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine optimal liquidity (retained earnings) and dividend choice incorporating debt financing with risk of default and bankruptcy costs as well as growth options under revenue uncertainty. We revisit the conditions for dividend policy irrelevancy and the broader role of retained earnings and dividends. Retained earnings have a net positive impact on firm value in the presence of growth options, high external financing costs and low default risk. High levels of retained earnings enhance debt capacity but have a negative effect on equity value due to the likelihood of losing accumulated cash balances in case of default, unless offset by high external financing costs. Opposite directional effects of retained earnings on equity and debt create a U-shaped relation with firm value. The framework is extended to analyze management-shareholder conflicts, demonstrating that managers accumulate higher than optimal cash. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了最优流动性（留存收益）和股利选择，纳入了具有违约风险和破产成本的债务融资，以及收入不确定性下的增长期权。我们重新审视了股利政策无关性的条件以及留存收益和股利更广泛的作用。在存在增长期权、高外部融资成本和低违约风险的情况下，留存收益对公司价值有净正向影响。高水平的留存收益增强了债务能力，但由于在违约情况下可能失去累积的现金余额而对股权价值有负向影响，除非被高外部融资成本所抵消。留存收益对股权和债务的相反方向效应造就了与公司价值之间的U形关系。该框架被扩展以分析管理层-股东冲突，证明管理者会累积高于最优水平的现金。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: FOUR WAYS TO FIX BANKS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Big banks have become too complex for boards to govern them effectively, writes a former top executive at Bank of America and Citigroup. Raw markdown: krawcheck-2012-four-ways-to-fix-banks Bibliographic Record Authors: Krawcheck, S Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW…
pages.text: FOUR WAYS TO FIX BANKS (2012) Paper claim — Big banks have become too complex for boards to govern them effectively, writes a former top executive at Bank of America and Citigroup. Raw markdown: krawcheck-2012-four-ways-to-fix-banks Bibliographic Record Authors: Krawcheck, S Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 2012 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Big banks have become too complex for boards to govern them effectively, writes a former top executive at Bank of America and Citigroup. Directors need simple tools to cut through that complexity, and Krawchek suggests four: Pay top executives with bank debt instead of just stock and stock options, to give them more incentive to worry about risk. Pay dividends as a percentage of earnings instead of as a set amount, to preserve capital in downturns. Ignore net interest income in judging bank performance, and pay much more attention to customer satisfaction metrics. Focus board attention not on the most troubled business segments, as is customary now, but on those that are using the most capital. 146 Harvard Business Review June 2012 HBR Reprint R12060 摘要（中文） 大型银行已变得过于复杂，董事会无法有效治理它们，一位曾任美国银行和花旗集团高层的前高管如是写道。董事需要简单的工具来穿透这种复杂性，Krawchek提出了四点建议：以银行债务而非仅用股票和股票期权向高管支付薪酬，以使他们更有动力关注风险。将股利按盈利的百分比而非固定金额支付，以在经济下行时保存资本。在评判银行业绩时忽略净利息收入，而更多关注客户满意度指标。将董事会的注意力不放在最陷入困境的业务板块（如当前惯常做法），而放在那些占用资本最多的板块上。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do senior citizens prefer dividends? Local clienteles vs. firm characteristics
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the payout policy of U.S. Raw markdown: krieger-2013-do-senior-citizens-prefer-dividends-local-clienteles-vs Bibliographic Record Authors: Krieger, K, Lee, BS, Mauck, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.08.002…
pages.text: Do senior citizens prefer dividends? Local clienteles vs. firm characteristics (2013) Paper claim — We examine the payout policy of U.S. Raw markdown: krieger-2013-do-senior-citizens-prefer-dividends-local-clienteles-vs Bibliographic Record Authors: Krieger, K, Lee, BS, Mauck, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.08.002 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We examine the payout policy of U.S. firms over the period 1980-2008. Prior research indicates that firm characteristics, managerial preferences, and investor clienteles are all important factors in setting payout policy. Counter to the oft-reported positive relation between senior citizens and the use of dividends, we find no such significant relation. Our results indicate that either senior citizens are indifferent between dividends and repurchases, or that if seniors do demand dividends, they have no influence over firm payout policy. The evolution of firm characteristics, including the average firm size, age, and volatility of earnings over time, best explains payout policy. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察1980-2008年期间美国公司的支付政策。已有研究表明，公司特征、管理层偏好和投资者客户群体都是设定支付政策的重要因素。与经常被报道的老年人与股利使用之间的正向关系相反，我们并未发现此类显著关系。我们的结果表明，要么老年人在股利与回购之间无所偏好，要么即便老年人确实需要股利，他们对公司的支付政策也没有影响力。公司特征的演变，包括平均公司规模、成立年限以及盈余波动性随时间的变化，最能解释支付政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The second wave of hedge fund activism: The importance of reputation, clout, and expertise
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a large dataset of hand-collected information on activist interventions from 2008 to 2014, we examine why certain hedge funds succeed in the face of competition. Raw markdown: krishnan-2016-the-second-wave-of-hedge-fund-activism-the Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: The second wave of hedge fund activism: The importance of reputation, clout, and expertise (2016) Paper claim — Using a large dataset of hand-collected information on activist interventions from 2008 to 2014, we examine why certain hedge funds succeed in the face of competition. Raw markdown: krishnan-2016-the-second-wave-of-hedge-fund-activism-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Krishnan, CNV, Partnoy, F, Thomas, RS Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.08.009 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, law, monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Using a large dataset of hand-collected information on activist interventions from 2008 to 2014, we examine why certain hedge funds succeed in the face of competition. We document that the top hedge funds succeed, not merely because of how they select targets, but because they acquire a reputation for what we label "clout and expertise." These hedge funds do not intervene more frequently; to the contrary, activists with more interventions are associated with lower returns. Instead, top activists have a demonstrated ability to succeed in difficult interventions by targeting large firms, launching successful proxy fights, filing and winning lawsuits, pressuring target boards through the media, overcoming anti-takeover defenses, and replacing board members. These activists' successes appear to result more from board representation, improved performance, and monitoring management than from capital structure or dividend policy changes. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 使用一个关于2008至2014年维权干预（activist interventions）的手工收集信息的大型数据集，我们考察为何某些对冲基金在竞争中取得成功。我们记录到，顶级对冲基金取得成功，不仅仅是因为它们如何选择目标，还因为它们获得了我们所称的“影响力和专长”（clout and expertise）的声誉。这些对冲基金并非更频繁地干预；恰恰相反，干预次数更多的维权者与更低的收益相关。相反，顶级维权者展现出在困难干预中取得成功的能力，其方式是瞄准大型企业、发起成功的代理权争夺、提起并赢得诉讼、通过媒体向目标董事会施压、克服反收购防御以及更换董事会成员。这些维权者的成功似乎更多地源于董事会代表席位、业绩改善和对管理层的监督，而非资本结构或股利政策的变化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Regulatory incentives and the thrift crisis: Dividends, mutual-to-stock conversions, and financial distress
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — During the 1980s, insolvency of individual thrifts and the thrift deposit insurer created severe incentive problems. Raw markdown: kroszner-1996-regulatory-incentives-and-the-thrift-crisis-dividends-mutual Bibliographic Record Authors: Kroszner, RS, Strahan, PE…
pages.text: Regulatory incentives and the thrift crisis: Dividends, mutual-to-stock conversions, and financial distress (1996) Paper claim — During the 1980s, insolvency of individual thrifts and the thrift deposit insurer created severe incentive problems. Raw markdown: kroszner-1996-regulatory-incentives-and-the-thrift-crisis-dividends-mutual Bibliographic Record Authors: Kroszner, RS, Strahan, PE Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.2307/2329395 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy, regulat)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract During the 1980s, insolvency of individual thrifts and the thrift deposit insurer created severe incentive problems. Lacking cash to close insolvent thrifts, regulators induced nearly $10 billion of private capital to flow into the industry through mutual-to-stock conversions. We test a theory of how regulators encouraged capital-impaired mutual thrifts to convert by permitting them to pay dividends rather than rebuild capital. We estimate the costs of this policy and interpret the 1991 Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Improvement Act as requiring regulators to impose restraints on depository institutions parallel to debt covenants that pc-event capital distributions by nonfinancial firms experiencing distress. 摘要（中文） 在20世纪80年代，单个储贷机构以及储贷存款保险机构的资不抵债造成了严重的激励问题。由于缺乏现金关闭资不抵债的储贷机构，监管者通过共有制转股份制（mutual-to-stock）转制诱使近100亿美元的私人资本流入该行业。我们检验了一个理论，即监管者如何通过允许资本受损的共有制储贷机构派发股利而非重建资本，来鼓励它们转制。我们估计了这一政策的成本，并将1991年《联邦存款保险公司改进法》解读为要求监管者对存款机构施加与债务契约条款相平行的约束，以阻止陷入困境的非金融企业进行资本分配。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Aggregate risk and efficiency of mutual funds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies the welfare properties of mutual funds in a Diamond-Dybvig economy with two sources of aggregate risk: (i) shocks to long-term investment returns; and (ii) shocks to aggregate liquidity demand. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Aggregate risk and efficiency of mutual funds (2019) Paper claim — This paper studies the welfare properties of mutual funds in a Diamond-Dybvig economy with two sources of aggregate risk: (i) shocks to long-term investment returns; and (ii) shocks to aggregate liquidity demand. Raw markdown: kucinskas-2019-aggregate-risk-and-efficiency-of-mutual-funds Bibliographic Record Authors: Kucinskas, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2019.01.001 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper studies the welfare properties of mutual funds in a Diamond-Dybvig economy with two sources of aggregate risk: (i) shocks to long-term investment returns; and (ii) shocks to aggregate liquidity demand. Mutual funds are inefficient when the long-term investment is risky. Mutual funds improve upon autarky by introducing a wedge between the market and technological rates of return. However, the wedge distorts the decisions of consumers not facing liquidity shocks, and the resulting equilibrium is inefficient. If only aggregate liquidity demand is subject to shocks, mutual funds can implement the social optimum (even when liquidity demand is not directly observable) by means of a price-contingent dividend policy. (C) 2019 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文研究在具有两种总量风险来源的Diamond-Dybvig经济中共同基金的福利性质：(i) 对长期投资回报的冲击；以及 (ii) 对总量流动性需求的冲击。当长期投资有风险时，共同基金是无效率的。共同基金通过在市场回报率与技术回报率之间引入一个楔子而改进了自给自足（autarky）状态。然而，该楔子扭曲了不面临流动性冲击的消费者的决策，由此产生的均衡是无效率的。如果只有总量流动性需求受到冲击，那么共同基金可以通过一种依赖于价格的股利政策来实现社会最优（即使流动性需求不可直接观察）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Catering driven substitution in corporate payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates catering as a motivation for substitution between share repurchases and dividend payments. Raw markdown: kulchania-2013-catering-driven-substitution-in-corporate-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Kulchania, M Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Catering driven substitution in corporate payouts (2013) Paper claim — This paper investigates catering as a motivation for substitution between share repurchases and dividend payments. Raw markdown: kulchania-2013-catering-driven-substitution-in-corporate-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Kulchania, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.02.003 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(catering, substitut) Abstract This paper investigates catering as a motivation for substitution between share repurchases and dividend payments. I hypothesize that firms cater to investor demand by repurchasing shares when investors place a premium on the stock price of firms that repurchase shares, and by paying dividends when investors place a higher value on dividend-paying firms. I propose a proxy to measure the relative preference for repurchases over dividends the difference premium. Results show that the decision to repurchase shares or to pay dividends depends on this premium. Firms channel higher fractions of the additional payout dollars toward share repurchases when this premium is high. The market reaction to dividend changes is more favorable when firms act in accordance with the catering hypothesis. Overall, I find that catering plays a role in the substitution between repurchases and dividends. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文研究迎合作为股份回购与股利派发之间替代的一种动机。我假设企业通过在投资者对回购股份企业的股价给予溢价时回购股份、以及在投资者对派发股利企业给予更高估值时派发股利，来迎合投资者需求。我提出一个代理变量来度量回购相对于股利的相对偏好——差异溢价（difference premium）。结果表明，回购股份还是派发股利的决策取决于这一溢价。当该溢价较高时，企业将更高比例的额外派现资金投向股份回购。当企业按照迎合假说行事时，市场对股利变化的反应更为有利。总体而言，我发现迎合在回购与股利之间的替代中发挥了作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Shareholder-Manager Conflict and the Information Content of Dividends (1988) Paper claim — In a model of the firm in which insiders are privately Informed of the firm's prospects and investment is endogenous, this article shows the existence of coarse dividend-signaling equilibria: Dividends partition the space of possible prospects of the firm, and changes in dividends reflect "broad," or nonincremental, changes in these prospects. Raw markdown: kumar-1988-shareholder-manager-conflict-and-the-information-content-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Kumar, P Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1988 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/1.2.111 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract In a model of the firm in which insiders are privately Informed of the firm's prospects and investment is endogenous, this article shows the existence of coarse dividend-signaling equilibria: Dividends partition the space of possible prospects of the firm, and changes in dividends reflect "broad," or nonincremental, changes in these prospects. These equilibria are shown to exist under general preference and technology structures, and it is argued that they closely match the following "anomalous" empirical features of corporate dividend payouts: Dividend changes have nontrivial information effects, yet dividends are smoothed (in a world with cyclic prospects), and dividends are poor predictors of future earnings. Furthermore, in performing comparative statics, this article derives cross-sectional and time-series restrictions on the relation of dividend smoothing to observable firm attributes. 摘要（中文） 在一个内部人私下获知企业前景且投资内生的企业模型中，本文表明存在粗粒度的股利信号传递均衡：股利将企业可能前景的空间加以划分，而股利的变化反映了这些前景中"宽泛"的、非增量式的变化。这些均衡被证明在一般的偏好和技术结构下都存在，且文章认为它们与企业股利支付以下"异常"的实证特征密切吻合：股利变化具有不平凡的信息效应，但股利却被平滑（在一个具有周期性前景的世界里），且股利是未来盈余的糟糕预测因子。此外，在进行比较静态分析时，本文推导出关于股利平滑与可观测企业属性之间关系的横截面和时间序列限制。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Estimation risk, information, and the conditional CAPM: Theory and evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We theoretically and empirically investigate the role of information on the cross section of stock returns and firms' cost of capital when investors face estimation risk and learn from noisy signals of uncertain quality. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Estimation risk, information, and the conditional CAPM: Theory and evidence (2008) Paper claim — We theoretically and empirically investigate the role of information on the cross section of stock returns and firms' cost of capital when investors face estimation risk and learn from noisy signals of uncertain quality. Raw markdown: kumar-2008-estimation-risk-information-and-the-conditional-capm-theory Bibliographic Record Authors: Kumar, P, Sorescu, SM, Boehme, RD, Danielsen, BR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhn016 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We theoretically and empirically investigate the role of information on the cross section of stock returns and firms' cost of capital when investors face estimation risk and learn from noisy signals of uncertain quality. The resultant equilibrium is an information-dependent conditional CAPM. We find strong empirical support for the model. Innovations in market volatility, oil prices, exchange rates, and dispersion of analysts' forecasts not only help explain the cross section of stock returns, but their influence depends on the stock's systematic estimation risk. Moreover, dividend and share repurchase initiations have significant downward announcement effects on estimated betas and their standard errors. 摘要（中文） 我们从理论与实证两方面考察了在投资者面临估计风险并从质量不确定的噪声信号中学习时，信息对股票收益横截面及企业资本成本的作用。由此得出的均衡是一个依赖于信息的条件CAPM。我们发现该模型得到了强有力的实证支持。市场波动率、油价、汇率以及分析师预测分歧的创新不仅有助于解释股票收益的横截面，而且其影响取决于股票的系统性估计风险。此外，股利和股份回购的启动对估计的贝塔及其标准误具有显著的向下公告效应。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The Effect of Financial Flexibility on Payout Policy (2020) Paper claim — We use variation in real estate prices as exogenous shocks to firms' debt capacity to study the causal effect of financial flexibility on payout policy. Raw markdown: kumar-2020-the-effect-of-financial-flexibility-on-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Kumar, A, Vergara-Alert, C Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1017/S002210901800114X Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We use variation in real estate prices as exogenous shocks to firms' debt capacity to study the causal effect of financial flexibility on payout policy. We show that an increase in financial flexibility results in higher dividends, share repurchases, and payout flexibility. We find that a 1-standard-deviation increase in a firms' collateral value results in 0.26- and 0.55-percentage-point increases in nondiscretionary and discretionary payouts, respectively. This effect is stronger for firms with few investment opportunities. Moreover, highly leveraged firms are more likely to cut dividends in response to a sharp decrease in their financial flexibility. 摘要（中文） 我们利用房地产价格的变动作为企业债务容量的外生冲击，研究财务灵活性对支付政策的因果影响。我们表明，财务灵活性的提高会带来更高的股利、股份回购以及支付灵活性。我们发现，企业抵押品价值每提高1个标准差，会使非自主性支付和自主性支付分别提高0.26和0.55个百分点。这一效应对投资机会较少的企业更强。此外，高杠杆企业在其财务灵活性急剧下降时更可能削减股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Dividend sentiment, catering incentives, and return predictability (2022) Paper claim — Using Internet search volume of dividend-related keywords to measure investor preference for dividends that varies over time and across states, we show that dividend sentiment affects corporate policies and asset prices. Raw markdown: kumar-2022-dividend-sentiment-catering-incentives-and-return-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Kumar, A, Lei, ZC, Zhang, CD Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.102128 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(catering) Abstract Using Internet search volume of dividend-related keywords to measure investor preference for dividends that varies over time and across states, we show that dividend sentiment affects corporate policies and asset prices. Investors search more for dividends when economic conditions are poor, with the peak volume reached during the recent COVID-19 pandemic. Firms initiate or increase dividends when dividend sentiment is stronger, especially in regions with strong dividend sentiment. Shifts in dividend sentiment predict higher investor demand for dividends and higher returns for high dividend stocks. Further, mutual funds that pay high dividends receive more inflows when dividend sentiment is stronger. 摘要（中文） 使用股利相关关键词的互联网搜索量来衡量随时间和跨州变化的投资者对股利的偏好，我们表明股利情绪影响公司政策和资产价格。当经济状况不佳时投资者更多地搜索股利，其峰值搜索量在近期的COVID-19大流行期间达到。当股利情绪更强时，企业会首次派发或增加股利，尤其是在股利情绪强烈的地区。股利情绪的变化预示着投资者对股利的更高需求以及高股利股票的更高收益。此外，当股利情绪更强时，派发高股利的共同基金会获得更多资金流入。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Effect of Financial Flexibility on Payout Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Kumar and Vergara-Alert use variation in real estate prices as exogenous shocks to firms' debt capacity and show that an increase in financial flexibility causally leads to higher dividends, more share repurchases, and greater payout flexibility, with effects…
pages.text: The Effect of Financial Flexibility on Payout Policy (2020) Paper claim — Kumar and Vergara-Alert use variation in real estate prices as exogenous shocks to firms' debt capacity and show that an increase in financial flexibility causally leads to higher dividends, more share repurchases, and greater payout flexibility, with effects concentrated in firms with few investment opportunities and stronger for discretionary than nondiscretionary payouts. Raw markdown: kumar-vergara-alert-2020-the-effect-of-financial-flexibility-on-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Kumar, Anil; Vergara-Alert, Carles Journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1017/S002210901800114X Abstract We use variation in real estate prices as exogenous shocks to firms' debt capacity to study the causal effect of financial flexibility on payout policy. We show that an increase in financial flexibility results in higher dividends, share repurchases, and payout flexibility. We find that a 1-standard-deviation increase in a firms' collateral value results in 0.26- and 0.55-percentage-point increases in nondiscretionary and discretionary payouts, respectively. This effect is stronger for firms with few investment opportunities. Moreover, highly leveraged firms are more likely to cut dividends in response to a sharp decrease in their financial flexibility. Key Findings A $1 increase in real estate collateral value is associated with a 0.30-cent increase in cash dividends (OLS); a 1-standard-deviation increase in pledgeable collateral translates to a 0.26-percentage-point increase in nondiscretionary payout (7.0% of a standard deviation) and a 0.55-percentage-point increase in discretionary payout (9.5% of a standard deviation), consistent across OLS and IV specifications using land supply elasticity × interest rates as instrument. An increase in financial flexibility leads to higher share repurchases in addition to higher dividends; payout flexibility (ratio of share repurchases to total payout) also increases with collateral value, consistent with firms allocating more of the temporary increases in financial flexibility to share repurchases than to dividends. During the 2008–2011 real estate bust, highly leveraged firms are significantly more likely to cut dividends in response to declining financial flexibility (coefficient on BUST_DUMMY × HIGH_LEVERAGE_DUMMY × RE_VALUE is positive and significant), while low-leverage firms maintain dividend payments. The effect of financial flexibility on dividends and share repurchases is concentrated in firms with few investment opportunities (low Tobin's Q); among these, financially constrained firms make even greater use of the collateral channel to increase payouts. Transmission operates via two channels: (i) the collateral channel — increases in CRE value relax borrowing constraints and allow firms to raise debt to fund payouts; (ii) the substitution channel — firms substitute future real estate services with current payouts. pages.text: What drives the disappearing dividends phenomenon? (2013) Paper claim — We study the determinants of dividend payout policy and examine the role of liquidity, risk and catering in explaining the changes in propensity to pay. Raw markdown: kuo-2013-what-drives-the-disappearing-dividends-phenomenon Bibliographic Record Authors: Kuo, JM, Philip, D, Zhang, QJ Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2013.05.003 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We study the determinants of dividend payout policy and examine the role of liquidity, risk and catering in explaining the changes in propensity to pay. Our results indicate that risk plays a major role in firms' dividend policy. The evidence substantiates from a large sample of firms representing 18 countries over the sample period from 1989 to 2011. For firms in the US, France, UK and Other European markets, liquidity is additionally an important determinant of dividend policy. We find that, although catering incentives persist only among firms in common law countries and not in civil law countries, after adjusting for risk there is little support for catering theory even among firms incorporated in common law countries. Our results indicate that catering incentives reflect the risk-reward relationship in the changing propensity to pay dividends. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究股利支付政策的决定因素，并考察流动性、风险和迎合在解释派息倾向变化中的作用。我们的结果表明，风险在企业股利政策中发挥了主要作用。这一证据得到了代表18个国家、样本期为1989年至2011年的大样本企业的证实。对于美国、法国、英国和其他欧洲市场的企业，流动性还是股利政策的一个重要决定因素。我们发现，尽管迎合动机仅在普通法国家的企业中持续存在而在成文法国家中不存在，但在对风险进行调整后，即便在普通法国家注册的企业中，迎合理论也几乎得不到支持。我们的结果表明，迎合动机反映了派息倾向变化中的风险—回报关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Signalling to Experts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study competitive equilibria in a signalling economy with heterogeneously informed buyers. Raw markdown: kurlat-2021-signalling-to-experts Bibliographic Record Authors: Kurlat, P, Scheuer, F Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 2021 DOI:…
pages.text: Signalling to Experts (2021) Paper claim — We study competitive equilibria in a signalling economy with heterogeneously informed buyers. Raw markdown: kurlat-2021-signalling-to-experts Bibliographic Record Authors: Kurlat, P, Scheuer, F Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1093/restud/rdaa068 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We study competitive equilibria in a signalling economy with heterogeneously informed buyers. In terms of the classic Spence (1973, The Quarterly Journal of Economics, 87, 355-374) model of job market signalling, firms have access to direct but imperfect information about worker types, in addition to observing their education. Firms can be ranked according to the quality of their information, i.e., their expertise. In equilibrium, some high-type workers forgo signalling and are hired by better informed firms, which make positive profits. Workers' education decisions and firms' use of their expertise are strategic complements, allowing for multiple equilibria that can be Pareto ranked. We characterize wage dispersion and the extent of signalling as a function of the distribution of expertise among firms. Our model can also be applied to a variety of other signalling problems, including securitization, corporate financial structure, insurance markets, or dividend policy. 摘要（中文） 我们研究一个具有异质知情买家的信号传递经济中的竞争性均衡。就Spence（1973，《经济学季刊》87卷，355-374页）关于劳动力市场信号传递的经典模型而言，除了观察工人的教育之外，企业还能获得关于工人类型的直接但不完美的信息。企业可以根据其信息质量（即其专长）进行排序。在均衡中，一些高类型工人放弃信号传递，被信息更充分的企业雇用，这些企业获得正利润。工人的教育决策与企业对其专长的运用是策略互补的，从而允许存在多重可帕累托排序的均衡。我们将工资离散度和信号传递程度刻画为企业间专长分布的函数。我们的模型还可应用于多种其他信号传递问题，包括证券化、公司财务结构、保险市场或股利政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: A Lintner Model of Payout and Managerial Rents
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a dynamic agency model in which payout, investment, and financing decisions are made by managers who attempt to maximize the rents they take from the firm, subject to a capital market constraint. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: A Lintner Model of Payout and Managerial Rents (2012) Paper claim — We develop a dynamic agency model in which payout, investment, and financing decisions are made by managers who attempt to maximize the rents they take from the firm, subject to a capital market constraint. Raw markdown: lambrecht-2012-a-lintner-model-of-payout-and-managerial-rents Bibliographic Record Authors: Lambrecht, BM, Myers, SC Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2012.01772.x Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We develop a dynamic agency model in which payout, investment, and financing decisions are made by managers who attempt to maximize the rents they take from the firm, subject to a capital market constraint. Managers smooth payout to smooth their flow of rents. Total payout (dividends plus net repurchases) follows Lintners (1956) target adjustment model. Payout smooths out transitory shocks to current income and adjusts gradually to changes in permanent income. Smoothing is accomplished by borrowing or lending. Payout is not cut back to finance capital investment. Risk aversion causes managers to underinvest, but habit formation mitigates the degree of underinvestment. 摘要（中文） 我们建立了一个动态代理模型，其中支付、投资和融资决策由管理者作出，管理者试图在资本市场约束下最大化其从企业攫取的租金。管理者平滑支付以平滑其租金流。总支付（股利加净回购）遵循Lintner（1956）的目标调整模型。支付平滑掉当期收入的暂时性冲击，并逐渐适应永久性收入的变化。平滑是通过借款或放贷实现的。支付不会被削减以为资本投资融资。风险厌恶导致管理者投资不足，但习惯形成缓解了投资不足的程度。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: The Dynamics of Investment, Payout and Debt
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a dynamic agency model of a public corporation. Raw markdown: lambrecht-2017-the-dynamics-of-investment-payout-and-debt Bibliographic Record Authors: Lambrecht, BM, Myers, SC Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhx081…
pages.text: The Dynamics of Investment, Payout and Debt (2017) Paper claim — We develop a dynamic agency model of a public corporation. Raw markdown: lambrecht-2017-the-dynamics-of-investment-payout-and-debt Bibliographic Record Authors: Lambrecht, BM, Myers, SC Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhx081 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We develop a dynamic agency model of a public corporation. Managers underinvest because of risk aversion. They smooth rents and payout. They do not exploit interest tax shields fully. The interactions of investment, debt, and payout decisions can change drastically depending on managers' preferences. Managers with power utility set investment, debt, and payout proportional to the firm's net worth, generating a constant (possibly negative) net debt ratio. With exponential utility, investment decisions are separated from decisions about debt and payout. More profitable firms become cash cows, and less profitable firms accumulate debt, as in a pecking-order model. 摘要（中文） 我们建立了一个上市公司的动态代理模型。管理者由于风险厌恶而投资不足。他们平滑租金和支付。他们没有充分利用利息税盾。投资、债务和支付决策之间的相互作用会根据管理者的偏好而发生剧烈变化。具有幂效用的管理者将投资、债务和支付设定为与公司净值成比例，从而产生一个恒定（可能为负）的净负债比率。在指数效用下，投资决策与关于债务和支付的决策相分离。更具盈利能力的公司成为“现金牛”，而盈利能力较弱的公司积累债务，正如优序融资模型中所描述的那样。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Liquidation, Bailout, and Bail-In: Insolvency Resolution Mechanisms and Bank Lending
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We present a dynamic, continuous-time model in which risk averse inside equityholders set a bank's lending, payout, and financing policies, and the exposure of bank assets to crashes. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Liquidation, Bailout, and Bail-In: Insolvency Resolution Mechanisms and Bank Lending (2023) Paper claim — We present a dynamic, continuous-time model in which risk averse inside equityholders set a bank's lending, payout, and financing policies, and the exposure of bank assets to crashes. Raw markdown: lambrecht-2023-liquidation-bailout-and-bail-in-insolvency-resolution-mechanisms Bibliographic Record Authors: Lambrecht, BM, Tse, ASL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109022000813 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We present a dynamic, continuous-time model in which risk averse inside equityholders set a bank's lending, payout, and financing policies, and the exposure of bank assets to crashes. We examine whether bailouts encourage excessive lending and risk taking compared to liquidation or bail-ins with debt-to-equity conversion or debt write-downs. The effects of the prevailing insolvency resolution mechanism (IRM) on the probability of insolvency, loss in default, and the bank's value suggest no single IRM is a panacea. We show how a bailout fund financed through a tax on bank dividends resolves bailouts without public money and without distorting insiders' incentives. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一个动态的连续时间模型，其中风险厌恶的内部股权持有人设定银行的放贷、派现和融资政策，以及银行资产对崩溃的敞口。我们考察相比清算或采用债转股或债务减记的自救（bail-in），救助（bailout）是否会鼓励过度放贷和冒险。现行破产处置机制（IRM）对破产概率、违约损失和银行价值的影响表明，没有任何单一的IRM是万灵药。我们展示了一个通过对银行股利征税来筹资的救助基金如何在不动用公共资金且不扭曲内部人激励的情况下解决救助问题。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Earnings and expected returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The aggregate dividend payout ratio forecasts excess returns on both stocks and corporate bonds in postwar U.S. Raw markdown: lamont-1998-earnings-and-expected-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Lamont, O Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI:…
pages.text: Earnings and expected returns (1998) Paper claim — The aggregate dividend payout ratio forecasts excess returns on both stocks and corporate bonds in postwar U.S. Raw markdown: lamont-1998-earnings-and-expected-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Lamont, O Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00065 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract The aggregate dividend payout ratio forecasts excess returns on both stocks and corporate bonds in postwar U.S. data. High dividends forecast high returns. High earnings forecast low returns. The correlation of earnings with business conditions gives them predictive power for returns; they contain information about future returns that is not captured by other variables. Dividends and earnings contribute substantial explanatory power at short horizons. For forecasting long-horizon returns, however, only (scaled) stock prices matter. Forecasts of low long-horizon stock returns in the mid-1990s are caused not by earnings or dividends, but by high stock prices. 摘要（中文） 在战后美国数据中，总量股利支付率能够预测股票和公司债券的超额收益。高股利预示着高收益。高盈余预示着低收益。盈余与经济景气状况的相关性赋予了它们对收益的预测能力；它们包含了其他变量未能捕捉的关于未来收益的信息。在短期跨度上，股利和盈余提供了可观的解释力。然而，对于预测长期跨度的收益，只有（经过缩放的）股票价格才起作用。20世纪90年代中期对长期跨度股票收益偏低的预测，并非由盈余或股利造成，而是由高股价造成的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: CDS Trading Initiation, Information Asymmetry, and Dividend Payout
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study uses an information-asymmetry framework to examine the effect of initiation of credit default swaps (CDS) trading on firm dividend payout policy. Raw markdown: landsman-2023-cds-trading-initiation-information-asymmetry-and-dividend-payout Bibliographic…
pages.text: CDS Trading Initiation, Information Asymmetry, and Dividend Payout (2023) Paper claim — This study uses an information-asymmetry framework to examine the effect of initiation of credit default swaps (CDS) trading on firm dividend payout policy. Raw markdown: landsman-2023-cds-trading-initiation-information-asymmetry-and-dividend-payout Bibliographic Record Authors: Landsman, WR, Li, CK, Zhao, JD Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2022.4337 Relevance score: 12.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow, information asymmetry) Abstract This study uses an information-asymmetry framework to examine the effect of initiation of credit default swaps (CDS) trading on firm dividend payout policy. We find evidence that CDS initiation is associated with increasing dividends, which is consistent with firms distributing excess free cash flow to mitigate exacerbated manager-equityholder agency conflicts resulting from reduced monitoring by banks following CDS initiation. Additional findings support this explanation by showing that the dividend increases are concentrated among borrowing firms with higher agency cost before CDS initiation, among firms whose lead arranger banks have a relatively less strong reputation in the loan-syndication market, and among firms whose loans are subject to less intense monitoring features???that is, less restrictive loan covenants???following CDS initiation. Additional analyses also suggest that inferences are robust to controlling for the potential effects of CDS initiation on capital structure. 摘要（中文） 本研究运用信息不对称框架，考察信用违约互换（CDS）交易启动对企业股利支付政策的影响。我们发现证据表明，CDS启动与股利增加相关，这与企业分配多余的自由现金流以缓解经理人与股东之间加剧的代理冲突相一致——这种加剧源于CDS启动后银行监督的减弱。其他发现支持了这一解释：股利增加集中于在CDS启动前代理成本较高的借款企业中，集中于牵头安排行在贷款银团市场中声誉相对较弱的企业中，以及集中于CDS启动后贷款受较不严密监督特征（即较不严格的贷款契约）约束的企业中。补充分析还表明，在控制了CDS启动对资本结构的潜在影响后，上述推断依然稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Expectations and the cross-section of stock returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Previous research has shown that stocks with low prices relative to book value, cash flow, earnings, or dividends (that is, value stocks) earn high returns. Raw markdown: laporta-1996-expectations-and-the-cross-section-of-stock-returns Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Expectations and the cross-section of stock returns (1996) Paper claim — Previous research has shown that stocks with low prices relative to book value, cash flow, earnings, or dividends (that is, value stocks) earn high returns. Raw markdown: laporta-1996-expectations-and-the-cross-section-of-stock-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: LaPorta, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.1996.tb05223.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, cash flow) Abstract Previous research has shown that stocks with low prices relative to book value, cash flow, earnings, or dividends (that is, value stocks) earn high returns. Value stocks may earn high returns because they are more risky. Alternatively, systematic errors in expectations may explain the high returns earned by value stocks. I test for the existence of systematic errors using survey data on forecasts by stock market analysts. I show that investment strategies that seek to exploit errors in analysts' forecasts earn superior returns because expectations about future growth in earnings are too extreme. 摘要（中文） 先前研究表明，相对于账面价值、现金流、盈余或股利而言价格较低的股票（即价值股）能获得高收益。价值股可能因为风险更大而获得高收益。或者，预期中的系统性错误也可能解释价值股所获得的高收益。我利用关于股市分析师预测的调查数据来检验系统性错误的存在。我表明，旨在利用分析师预测错误的投资策略之所以能获得超额收益，是因为对未来盈余增长的预期过于极端。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Agency problems and dividend policies around the world
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper outlines and tests two agency models of dividends. Raw markdown: laporta-2000-agency-problems-and-dividend-policies-around-the-world Bibliographic Record Authors: La Porta, R, Lopez-de-Silanes, F, Shleifer, A, Vishny, RW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: Agency problems and dividend policies around the world (2000) Paper claim — This paper outlines and tests two agency models of dividends. Raw markdown: laporta-2000-agency-problems-and-dividend-policies-around-the-world Bibliographic Record Authors: La Porta, R, Lopez-de-Silanes, F, Shleifer, A, Vishny, RW Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00199 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, outcome model, substitut) Abstract This paper outlines and tests two agency models of dividends. According to the "outcome model," dividends are paid because minority shareholders pressure corporate insiders to disgorge cash. According to the "substitute model," insiders interested in issuing equity in the future pay dividends to establish a reputation for decent treatment of minority shareholders. The first model predicts that stronger minority shareholder rights should be associated with higher dividend payouts; the second model predicts the opposite. Tests on a cross section of 4,000 companies from 33 countries with different levels of minority shareholder rights support the outcome agency model of dividends. 摘要（中文） 本文概述并检验了两个股利代理模型。根据"结果模型"，支付股利是因为中小股东向公司内部人施压要求其吐出现金。根据"替代模型"，有意在未来发行股权的内部人支付股利，以建立善待中小股东的声誉。第一个模型预测，更强的中小股东权利应与更高的股利支付相关；第二个模型的预测则相反。对来自33个国家、具有不同中小股东权利水平的4,000家公司的横截面检验，支持了股利的结果代理模型。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Investor protection and corporate governance
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent research has documented large differences among countries in ownership concentration in publicly traded firms, in the breadth and depth of capital markets, in dividend policies, and in the access of firms to external finance. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Investor protection and corporate governance (2000) Paper claim — Recent research has documented large differences among countries in ownership concentration in publicly traded firms, in the breadth and depth of capital markets, in dividend policies, and in the access of firms to external finance. Raw markdown: laporta-2000-investor-protection-and-corporate-governance Bibliographic Record Authors: La Porta, R, Lopez-De-Silanes, F, Shleifer, A, Vishny, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(00)00065-9 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, governance, investor protection, law, reform)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract Recent research has documented large differences among countries in ownership concentration in publicly traded firms, in the breadth and depth of capital markets, in dividend policies, and in the access of firms to external finance. A common element to the explanations of these differences is how well investors, both shareholders and creditors, are protected by law from expropriation by the managers and controlling shareholders of firms. We describe the differences in laws and the effectiveness of their enforcement across countries, discuss the possible origins of these differences, summarize their consequences, and assess potential strategies of corporate governance reform. We argue that the legal approach is a more fruitful way to understand corporate governance and its reform than the conventional distinction between bank-centered and market-centered financial systems. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G21; G28; G32. 摘要（中文） 近来的研究记录了各国在公开交易企业的所有权集中度、资本市场的广度和深度、股利政策以及企业获得外部融资的渠道等方面存在巨大差异。对这些差异的各种解释有一个共同要素，即投资者（包括股东和债权人）在多大程度上受到法律保护，免遭企业管理者和控股股东的侵占。我们描述了各国法律及其执行有效性方面的差异，讨论了这些差异的可能起源，总结了它们的后果，并评估了公司治理改革的潜在策略。我们认为，相比银行主导型与市场主导型金融体系之间的传统区分，法律途径是理解公司治理及其改革的一种更富成效的方式。JEL分类：G21; G28; G32。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Shareholder Protection and Agency Costs: An Experimental Analysis
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Two competing principal-agent models explain why firms pay dividends. Raw markdown: lariviere-2018-shareholder-protection-and-agency-costs-an-experimental-analysis Bibliographic Record Authors: LaRiviere, J, McMahon, M, Neilson, W Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year:…
pages.text: Shareholder Protection and Agency Costs: An Experimental Analysis (2018) Paper claim — Two competing principal-agent models explain why firms pay dividends. Raw markdown: lariviere-2018-shareholder-protection-and-agency-costs-an-experimental-analysis Bibliographic Record Authors: LaRiviere, J, McMahon, M, Neilson, W Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2017.2770 Relevance score: 13.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection, legal protection)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, expropri, outcome model, signal, substitut) Abstract Two competing principal-agent models explain why firms pay dividends. The substitute model proposes that corporate insiders pay dividends to signal and build trust with outside shareholders who lack legal protection. The outcome model, in contrast, surmises that when shareholders have legal protection, they demand dividends from insiders to prevent them from expropriating corporate funds. Either way, dividends represent an agency cost paid to align the interests of shareholders and insiders. Expropriations by insiders and reduced investment by shareholders are also agency costs, but they are difficult to identify with archival data. Using a laboratory experiment, we identify the impact of strengthened shareholder protection on all three types of agency costs. Dividend payout ratios are five times larger with stronger investor protection, insider expropriation ratios are twice as high, and outsider investment falls by 45%. Thus, we find evidence that strengthening shareholder protection introduces previously unidentified agency costs into the insider-investor relationship. 摘要（中文） 两个相互竞争的委托代理模型解释了企业为何支付股利。替代模型认为，公司内部人支付股利是为了向缺乏法律保护的外部股东发出信号并建立信任。相比之下，结果模型推断，当股东拥有法律保护时，他们会要求内部人支付股利，以防止内部人侵占公司资金。无论哪种情况，股利都代表了一种为使股东与内部人利益一致而付出的代理成本。内部人的侵占和股东的投资减少也是代理成本，但很难用档案数据来识别。我们使用实验室实验，识别了强化股东保护对这三类代理成本的影响。在投资者保护更强的情况下，股利支付率高出五倍，内部人侵占率高出一倍，而外部人投资下降了45%。因此，我们发现证据表明，强化股东保护会将此前未被识别的代理成本引入内部人与投资者的关系中。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do Investors Value Dividend-Smoothing Stocks Differently?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — It is widely documented that managers strive to maintain smooth dividends. Raw markdown: larkin-2017-do-investors-value-dividend-smoothing-stocks-differently Bibliographic Record Authors: Larkin, Y, Leary, MT, Michaely, R Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2017 DOI:…
pages.text: Do Investors Value Dividend-Smoothing Stocks Differently? (2017) Paper claim — It is widely documented that managers strive to maintain smooth dividends. Raw markdown: larkin-2017-do-investors-value-dividend-smoothing-stocks-differently Bibliographic Record Authors: Larkin, Y, Leary, MT, Michaely, R Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2016.2551 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract It is widely documented that managers strive to maintain smooth dividends. Yet, it is not clear if this behavior reflects investors' preferences. In this paper, we study whether investors indeed value dividend-smoothing stocks differently by exploring the implications of dividend smoothing for firms' investor clientele, stock prices, and cost of capital. We find that retail investors are less likely to hold dividend-smoothing stocks, while institutional investors, and especially mutual funds, are more likely. However, this preference does not result in any detectable relation between the smoothness of a firm's dividends and the expected return, or market value, of its stock. Together, the evidence suggests that firms adjust the supply of smoothed dividends to match investors' demand. Dividend smoothing affects the composition of a firm's shareholders but has little impact on its stock price. 摘要（中文） 人们广泛记录到管理者努力维持平滑的股利。然而，尚不清楚这种行为是否反映了投资者的偏好。在本文中，我们通过探究股利平滑对公司投资者客户群、股价和资本成本的含义，来研究投资者是否确实对股利平滑股票给予不同的估值。我们发现散户投资者不太可能持有股利平滑股票，而机构投资者、尤其是共同基金，则更可能持有。然而，这种偏好并未导致公司股利平滑度与其股票预期收益或市场价值之间存在任何可检测的关系。综合起来，证据表明公司会调整平滑股利的供给以匹配投资者的需求。股利平滑影响公司股东的构成，但对其股价影响甚微。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Does firm value move too much to be justified by subsequent changes in cash flow?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The appropriate measure of cash flow for valuing corporate assets is net payout, which is the sum of dividends, interest, and net repurchases of equity and debt. Raw markdown: larrain-2008-does-firm-value-move-too-much-to-be Bibliographic Record Authors: Larrain,…
pages.text: Does firm value move too much to be justified by subsequent changes in cash flow? (2008) Paper claim — The appropriate measure of cash flow for valuing corporate assets is net payout, which is the sum of dividends, interest, and net repurchases of equity and debt. Raw markdown: larrain-2008-does-firm-value-move-too-much-to-be Bibliographic Record Authors: Larrain, B, Yogo, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.01.002 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract The appropriate measure of cash flow for valuing corporate assets is net payout, which is the sum of dividends, interest, and net repurchases of equity and debt. Variation in net payout yield, the ratio of net payout to asset value, is mostly driven by movements in expected cash flow growth, instead of movements in discount rates. Net payout yield is less persistent than dividend yield and implies much smaller variation in long-horizon discount rates. Therefore, movements in the value of corporate assets can be justified by changes in expected future cash flow. (c) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 为企业资产估值的适当现金流度量是净支付（net payout），即股利、利息以及股权和债务净回购之和。净支付收益率（净支付与资产价值之比）的变化主要由预期现金流增长的变动所驱动，而非由贴现率的变动所驱动。净支付收益率比股利收益率的持续性更低，并意味着长视界贴现率的变化要小得多。因此，企业资产价值的变动可以由预期未来现金流的变化来解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: EX-DAY BEHAVIOR - TAX OR SHORT-TERM TRADING EFFECTS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the behavior of share prices around the ex-dividend dates before and after the introduction of the 1988 Income and Corporation Taxes Act that reduced substantially the tax differential between dividends and capital gains in the United Kingdom.…
pages.text: EX-DAY BEHAVIOR - TAX OR SHORT-TERM TRADING EFFECTS (1995) Paper claim — This study examines the behavior of share prices around the ex-dividend dates before and after the introduction of the 1988 Income and Corporation Taxes Act that reduced substantially the tax differential between dividends and capital gains in the United Kingdom. Raw markdown: lasfer-1995-ex-day-behavior-tax-or-short-term-trading Bibliographic Record Authors: LASFER, MA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1995 DOI: 10.2307/2329291 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, distribution, dividend) Abstract This study examines the behavior of share prices around the ex-dividend dates before and after the introduction of the 1988 Income and Corporation Taxes Act that reduced substantially the tax differential between dividends and capital gains in the United Kingdom. We find that, in the pre-1988 period when the differential taxation of dividends and capital gains is high, ex-day returns are positive and significant. In contrast, in the post-1988 period, ex-day returns are, in most cases, negative and insignificant. Further analysis reveals that, while ex-day returns are significantly related to dividend yield and to the length of the settlement period, they are not affected by the commonly used measures of transaction costs, such as the bid-ask spread and trading volume, or by the day of week, month of the year, type of dividend distribution, or number of days to the actual receipt of the cash dividend. We conclude that taxation affects significantly ex-day share prices in the United Kingdom. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了1988年《所得税与公司税法》引入前后除息日前后股价的表现，该法案大幅缩小了英国股利与资本利得之间的税收差异。我们发现，在1988年之前的时期，即股利与资本利得的差别课税较高时，除息日收益为正且显著。相反，在1988年之后的时期，除息日收益在大多数情况下为负且不显著。进一步分析表明，虽然除息日收益与股利收益率及结算周期长度显著相关，但它们不受常用的交易成本度量（如买卖价差和交易量）的影响，也不受星期几、一年中的月份、股利分配类型或到实际收到现金股利的天数的影响。我们得出结论，税收显著影响英国的除息日股价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Earnings Quality Information Content of Dividend Policies and Audit Pricing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent studies indicate dividends are associated with higher-quality earnings. Raw markdown: lawson-2016-the-earnings-quality-information-content-of-dividend-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Lawson, BP, Wang, DC Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year:…
pages.text: The Earnings Quality Information Content of Dividend Policies and Audit Pricing (2016) Paper claim — Recent studies indicate dividends are associated with higher-quality earnings. Raw markdown: lawson-2016-the-earnings-quality-information-content-of-dividend-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Lawson, BP, Wang, DC Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12179 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(audit)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Recent studies indicate dividends are associated with higher-quality earnings. Our study extends the literature by examining whether dividends' information is associated with auditors' assessment of their clients' earnings quality. Our results show that auditors charge lower fees to dividend-paying clients than to nondividend-paying clients and the average fee discount ranges from 6.0 to 10.6 percent. More importantly, we find dividends have an interactive effect with respect to earnings persistence and earnings manipulation: the negative association between audit fees and earnings persistence is more pronounced for dividend firms; and dividend payouts mitigate the positive relation between earnings manipulation risk and audit fees. Our results imply dividends reduce audit risk by enhancing clients' earnings quality information. We contribute to the literature by showing that auditors reflect the earnings quality information content of firms' dividend policies in their pricing decisions. 摘要（中文） 近期研究表明，股利与更高质量的盈余相关联。我们的研究通过考察股利所含信息是否与审计师对其客户盈余质量的评估相关，拓展了这一文献。我们的结果显示，审计师向支付股利的客户收取的费用低于不支付股利的客户，平均费用折扣介于6.0%至10.6%之间。更重要的是，我们发现股利在盈余持续性和盈余操纵方面具有交互效应：审计费用与盈余持续性之间的负向关系在支付股利的公司中更为显著；而股利派现缓解了盈余操纵风险与审计费用之间的正向关系。我们的结果意味着，股利通过增强客户的盈余质量信息来降低审计风险。我们的贡献在于表明，审计师在其定价决策中反映了公司股利政策所蕴含的盈余质量信息。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: US biopharmaceutical finance and the sustainability of the biotech business model
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In the decade before the 2008 economic crisis, the US biotechnology industry was booming. Raw markdown: lazonick-2011-us-biopharmaceutical-finance-and-the-sustainability-of-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Lazonick, W, Tulum, Ö Journal: RESEARCH POLICY Year: 2011…
pages.text: US biopharmaceutical finance and the sustainability of the biotech business model (2011) Paper claim — In the decade before the 2008 economic crisis, the US biotechnology industry was booming. Raw markdown: lazonick-2011-us-biopharmaceutical-finance-and-the-sustainability-of-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Lazonick, W, Tulum, Ö Journal: RESEARCH POLICY Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.respol.2011.05.021 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(buyback, dividend) Abstract In the decade before the 2008 economic crisis, the US biotechnology industry was booming. In a 2006 book, Science Business: The Promise, the Reality, and the Future of Biotech, Gary Pisano implies that, given the 10-20 year time-frame for developing biotech products and the lack of profitability of the industry as a whole, the US biotech boom should not have happened. Yet the biotech industry has received substantial funding from venture-capital firms as well as from established companies through R&D alliances. Why would money from venture capitalists and big pharma flow into an industry in which profits are so hard to come by? The purpose of this article is to work toward a solution of what might be called the "Pisano puzzle", and in the process to provide a basis for analyzing the industrial and institutional conditions under which the growth of the US biopharmaceutical (BP) industry is sustainable. One part of the answer has been the willingness of stock-market investors to absorb the initial public offerings (IPOs) of a BP venture that has not yet generated a commercial product, and indeed may never do so. The other part of the answer is that the knowledge base that BP companies can tap to develop products comes much more from government investments and spending than from business finance. Indeed, we show that, through stock buybacks and dividends, established corporations in the BP industry have been distributing substantial sums of cash to shareholders that may be at the expense of R&D. We use the framework that we have developed for analyzing the sustainability of the US BP business model to pose a number of key areas for future research and policy, with an emphasis on the implications of the financialization of this business model for the generation of safe and affordable BP drugs as well as the need for a theory of innovative enterprise. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在2008年经济危机之前的十年里，美国生物技术产业蓬勃发展。在2006年的一本著作《科学商业：生物技术的承诺、现实与未来》中，Gary Pisano暗示，鉴于生物技术产品10至20年的开发周期以及整个产业整体缺乏盈利能力，美国的生物技术热潮本不应发生。然而，生物技术产业已从风险投资公司以及通过研发联盟从成熟企业那里获得了大量资金。为什么风险投资家和大型制药公司的资金会流入一个利润如此难以获得的产业？本文的目的是致力于解决所谓的"Pisano悖论"，并在此过程中为分析美国生物制药（BP）产业增长可持续的产业和制度条件提供基础。答案的一部分在于股市投资者愿意吸收尚未产生商业化产品——事实上可能永远不会产生——的BP企业的首次公开募股（IPO）。答案的另一部分在于，BP企业可用来开发产品的知识基础，更多来自政府投资和支出，而非商业融资。事实上，我们表明，通过股票回购和股利，BP产业中的成熟企业一直在向股东分配大量现金，而这可能以牺牲研发为代价。我们运用为分析美国BP商业模式可持续性而开发的框架，提出了未来研究和政策的若干关键领域，重点关注这一商业模式的金融化对生产安全且价格可负担的BP药物的影响，以及对创新型企业理论的需求。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
