pages.title: Determinants of Dividend Smoothing: Empirical Evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We document the cross-sectional properties of corporate dividend-smoothing policies and relate them to extant theories. Raw markdown: leary-2011-determinants-of-dividend-smoothing-empirical-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Leary, MT, Michaely, R Journal:…
pages.text: Determinants of Dividend Smoothing: Empirical Evidence (2011) Paper claim — We document the cross-sectional properties of corporate dividend-smoothing policies and relate them to extant theories. Raw markdown: leary-2011-determinants-of-dividend-smoothing-empirical-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Leary, MT, Michaely, R Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhr072 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We document the cross-sectional properties of corporate dividend-smoothing policies and relate them to extant theories. We find that younger, smaller firms, firms with low dividend yields and more volatile earnings and returns, and firms with fewer and more disperse analyst forecasts smooth less. Firms that are cash cows, with low growth prospects, weaker governance, and greater institutional holdings, smooth more. We also document that dividend smoothing has steadily increased over the past 80 years, even before firms began using share repurchases in the mid-1980s. Taken together, our results suggest that dividend smoothing is most common among firms that are not financially constrained, face low levels of asymmetric information, and are most susceptible to agency conflicts. These findings provide challenges and guidance for the developing theoretical literature. 摘要（中文） 我们记录了企业股利平滑政策的横截面特征，并将其与现有理论相联系。我们发现，更年轻、规模更小的企业，股利收益率低、收益和收益率更为波动的企业，以及分析师预测数量更少且更为分散的企业，平滑程度更低。作为现金牛、增长前景低、治理更弱以及机构持股更多的企业，平滑程度更高。我们还记录了在过去80年里股利平滑稳步增加，甚至在企业于20世纪80年代中期开始使用股份回购之前就已如此。综合来看，我们的结果表明，股利平滑在那些不受财务约束、面临的信息不对称程度低、且最易受代理冲突影响的企业中最为常见。这些发现为发展中的理论文献提供了挑战和指引。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The present value relation over six centuries: The case of the Bazacle company
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study asset pricing over the longue duree using share prices and net dividends from the Bazacle company of Toulouse, the earliest documented shareholding corporation. Raw markdown: lebris-2019-the-present-value-relation-over-six-centuries-the Bibliographic…
pages.text: The present value relation over six centuries: The case of the Bazacle company (2019) Paper claim — We study asset pricing over the longue duree using share prices and net dividends from the Bazacle company of Toulouse, the earliest documented shareholding corporation. Raw markdown: lebris-2019-the-present-value-relation-over-six-centuries-the Bibliographic Record Authors: le Bris, D, Goetzmann, WN, Pouget, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2017.03.011 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We study asset pricing over the longue duree using share prices and net dividends from the Bazacle company of Toulouse, the earliest documented shareholding corporation. The data extend from the firm's foundation in 1372 to its nationalization in 1946. We find an average dividend yield of 5% per annum and near-zero long-term, real capital appreciation. Stationary dividends and stock prices enable us to directly study how prices relate to expected cash flows, without relying on a rate of return transformation. A reduced-form asset pricing model with persistent dividends and a time-varying risk correction is not rejected by the data. (C) 2018 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用巴扎克勒（Bazacle）公司的股价和净股利，从长时段视角研究资产定价，该公司是有文献记载的最早的股份制公司。数据跨越从公司1372年成立到1946年被国有化的时期。我们发现平均股利收益率为每年5%，长期实际资本增值接近于零。平稳的股利和股价使我们能够直接研究价格如何与预期现金流相关联，而无需依赖收益率变换。一个具有持久性股利和时变风险修正的简约式资产定价模型未被数据所拒绝。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Time-series behavior of share repurchases and dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Given the growth in the importance and popularity of share repurchases, we use an alternative time-series approach to test two hypotheses on the motives for share repurchases and dividends: the flexibility hypothesis and the substitution hypothesis. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Time-series behavior of share repurchases and dividends (2007) Paper claim — Given the growth in the importance and popularity of share repurchases, we use an alternative time-series approach to test two hypotheses on the motives for share repurchases and dividends: the flexibility hypothesis and the substitution hypothesis. Raw markdown: lee-2007-time-series-behavior-of-share-repurchases-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, BS, Rui, OM Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000002210 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(alternative, substitut) Abstract Given the growth in the importance and popularity of share repurchases, we use an alternative time-series approach to test two hypotheses on the motives for share repurchases and dividends: the flexibility hypothesis and the substitution hypothesis. By investigating both share repurchase and dividend payout policies in the context of a time-series vector autoregression, we account for the dynamic and multi-dimensional nature of the two payout policies. We find that share repurchases are associated with temporary components of earnings, whereas dividends are not, and that share repurchases and dividends are imperfect substitutes. 摘要（中文） 鉴于股份回购在重要性和流行度上的增长，我们使用一种替代性的时间序列方法来检验关于股份回购和股利动机的两个假说：灵活性假说和替代假说。通过在时间序列向量自回归的框架下同时考察股份回购和股利支付政策，我们考虑了这两种支付政策的动态和多维性质。我们发现，股份回购与盈利的暂时性成分相关，而股利则不然，且股份回购和股利是不完全替代品。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Cash holdings and share repurchases: International evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this study, we examine the patterns and determinants of share repurchases using firm-level data from seven major countries-Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, the U.K., and the U.S.-over the period 1998-2006. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Cash holdings and share repurchases: International evidence (2011) Paper claim — In this study, we examine the patterns and determinants of share repurchases using firm-level data from seven major countries-Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, the U.K., and the U.S.-over the period 1998-2006. Raw markdown: lee-2011-cash-holdings-and-share-repurchases-international-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, BS, Suh, J Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.06.006 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, cash flow) Abstract In this study, we examine the patterns and determinants of share repurchases using firm-level data from seven major countries-Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, the U.K., and the U.S.-over the period 1998-2006. We find that while non-U.S. firms do not repurchase shares as much as U.S. firms do, both U.S. and non-U.S. firms display a common set of share repurchase behaviors. For example, across countries, firms use share repurchases as a flexible means of distributing cash. More importantly, large cash holdings are significantly associated with the amount of share repurchases in all countries. There is evidence that large cash holdings held by repurchasing firms represent excess cash. Firms tend to experience substantial increases in cash holdings prior to share repurchase as a result of reductions in capital expenditures. Overall, our evidence lends support to two hypotheses: (i) firms discharge excess capital to reduce agency conflicts and (ii) firms use repurchases to distribute temporary cash flows. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在本研究中，我们使用来自七个主要国家——澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、日本、英国和美国——1998至2006年期间的企业层面数据，考察股份回购的模式和决定因素。我们发现，虽然非美国企业不像美国企业那样进行大量股份回购，但美国和非美国企业都表现出一套共同的股份回购行为。例如，在各国，企业将股份回购用作分配现金的一种灵活手段。更重要的是，在所有国家，大量现金持有都与股份回购金额显著相关。有证据表明，回购企业持有的大量现金代表过量现金。企业往往在股份回购之前由于资本支出的削减而经历现金持有的大幅增加。总体而言，我们的证据支持两个假说：(i) 企业释放过量资本以减少代理冲突，以及 (ii) 企业使用回购来分配暂时性现金流。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Optimal payout ratio under uncertainty and the flexibility hypothesis: Theory and empirical evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Following the dividend flexibility hypothesis used by DeAngelo and DeAngelo (2006), Blau and Fuller (2008), and others, we theoretically extend the proposition of DeAngelo and DeAngelo (2006) optimal payout policy in terms of the flexibility dividend hypothesis.…
pages.text: Optimal payout ratio under uncertainty and the flexibility hypothesis: Theory and empirical evidence (2011) Paper claim — Following the dividend flexibility hypothesis used by DeAngelo and DeAngelo (2006), Blau and Fuller (2008), and others, we theoretically extend the proposition of DeAngelo and DeAngelo (2006) optimal payout policy in terms of the flexibility dividend hypothesis. Raw markdown: lee-2011-optimal-payout-ratio-under-uncertainty-and-the-flexibility Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, CF, Gupta, MC, Chen, HY, Lee, AC Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.02.004 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract Following the dividend flexibility hypothesis used by DeAngelo and DeAngelo (2006), Blau and Fuller (2008), and others, we theoretically extend the proposition of DeAngelo and DeAngelo (2006) optimal payout policy in terms of the flexibility dividend hypothesis. In addition, we also introduce growth rate, systematic risk, and total risk variables into the theoretical model. To test the theoretical results derived in this paper, we use the data collected in the US from 1969 to 2009 to investigate the impact of the growth rate, systematic risk, and total risk on the optimal payout ratio in terms of the fixed-effect model. We find that based on flexibility considerations, a company will reduce its payout when the growth rate increases. In addition, we find that a nonlinear relationship exists between the payout ratio and the risk. In other words, the relationship between the payout ratio and the risk is negative (or positive) when the growth rate is higher (or lower) than the rate of return on total assets. Our theoretical model and empirical results can therefore be used to identify whether flexibility or the free cash flow hypothesis should be used to determine the dividend policy. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 遵循迪安杰洛和迪安杰洛（DeAngelo and DeAngelo，2006）、布劳和富勒（Blau and Fuller，2008）等人使用的股利灵活性假说，我们从灵活性股利假说的角度，从理论上扩展了迪安杰洛和迪安杰洛（2006）的最优支付政策命题。此外，我们还将成长率、系统性风险和总风险变量引入理论模型。为检验本文推导的理论结果，我们使用1969年至2009年间在美国收集的数据，采用固定效应模型考察成长率、系统性风险和总风险对最优支付率的影响。我们发现，基于灵活性考量，当成长率上升时，公司会减少其支付。此外，我们发现支付率与风险之间存在非线性关系。换言之，当成长率高于（或低于）总资产回报率时，支付率与风险之间的关系为负（或正）。因此，我们的理论模型和实证结果可用于识别应使用灵活性假说还是自由现金流假说来决定股利政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine three aspects of the relation between dividend initiation and increase announcements and idiosyncratic volatility. Raw markdown: lee-2016-dividend-initiations-increases-and-idiosyncratic-volatility Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, BS, Mauck, N Journal:…
pages.text: Dividend initiations, increases and idiosyncratic volatility (2016) Paper claim — We examine three aspects of the relation between dividend initiation and increase announcements and idiosyncratic volatility. Raw markdown: lee-2016-dividend-initiations-increases-and-idiosyncratic-volatility Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, BS, Mauck, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.07.005 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We examine three aspects of the relation between dividend initiation and increase announcements and idiosyncratic volatility. First, consistent with dividend signaling, we find that firms with higher levels of idiosyncratic volatility are associated with higher announcement abnormal returns when initiating or increasing dividends. Second, firms on average experience an ex post reduction in idiosyncratic volatility following dividend initiations that is associated with announcement and long-term abnormal returns. Finally, high idiosyncratic volatility firms are associated with stronger positive post event return drift. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了股利首次发放与增加公告与特质波动率之间关系的三个方面。首先，与股利信号理论相一致，我们发现特质波动率水平较高的公司在首次发放或增加股利时伴随着更高的公告异常收益。其次，公司平均而言在首次发放股利后经历特质波动率的事后下降，这种下降与公告异常收益和长期异常收益相关。最后，高特质波动率公司伴随着更强的正向事件后收益漂移。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Repurchases after being well known as good news
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using recent U.S. Raw markdown: lee-2020-repurchases-after-being-well-known-as-good-news Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, I, Park, YJ, Pearson, ND Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.101552 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched…
pages.text: Repurchases after being well known as good news (2020) Paper claim — Using recent U.S. Raw markdown: lee-2020-repurchases-after-being-well-known-as-good-news Bibliographic Record Authors: Lee, I, Park, YJ, Pearson, ND Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.101552 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(buyback) Abstract Using recent U.S. data, we find that long-horizon abnormal returns following repurchase announcements made after 2001 are much lower than those following earlier announcements. The equity-linked compensation of senior management of buyback firms exceeds that of matching firms, especially for repurchases announced after 2001. Transient institutional investors equity holdings of buyback firms are smaller than their holdings of matching firms following buyback announcements by repeat repurchasers during 2002-2006. The results suggest that many recent buybacks have not been motivated by fundamentals-based factors such as undervaluation, and that non-fundamentals-based factors such as managerial self-interest have become more important. 摘要（中文） 使用近期的美国数据，我们发现2001年之后发布的回购公告所带来的长期异常收益，远低于更早期公告所带来的收益。回购企业高级管理层的股权挂钩薪酬超过配对企业，尤其是对于2001年之后宣布的回购而言。在2002至2006年间，对于重复回购者发布回购公告之后，暂时性机构投资者对回购企业的股权持有量小于其对配对企业的持有量。研究结果表明，近期许多回购并非由估值偏低等基本面因素所驱动，而诸如管理者自利等非基本面因素已变得更加重要。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Leveraged buybacks
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Debt-financed share buybacks generate positive short-term and long-run abnormal stock returns. Raw markdown: lei-2016-leveraged-buybacks Bibliographic Record Authors: Lei, ZC, Zhang, CD Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI:…
pages.text: Leveraged buybacks (2016) Paper claim — Debt-financed share buybacks generate positive short-term and long-run abnormal stock returns. Raw markdown: lei-2016-leveraged-buybacks Bibliographic Record Authors: Lei, ZC, Zhang, CD Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.04.004 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(buyback) Abstract Debt-financed share buybacks generate positive short-term and long-run abnormal stock returns. Leveraged buyback firms have more debt capacity, higher marginal tax rate, lower excess cash and lower growth prospects ex ante, increase leverage and reduce investments more sharply ex post than cash-financed buyback firms. Firms that are over-levered ex-ante are associated with lower returns and real investments following leveraged buybacks. The lower announcement returns of over-levered firms are concentrated on firms with weaker corporate governance. The evidence is consistent with leveraged buybacks enabling firms to optimize their leverage, on average benefiting shareholders. The benefits decrease with a firm's leverage ex ante. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 债务融资的股票回购能产生正的短期和长期异常股票收益。相比现金融资的回购企业，杠杆回购企业事前拥有更大的债务容量、更高的边际税率、更低的过剩现金和更低的成长前景，事后则更大幅度地增加杠杆并削减投资。事前杠杆过高的企业在杠杆回购后与较低的收益和实际投资相关。杠杆过高企业较低的公告收益集中于公司治理较弱的企业。这些证据与如下观点相一致：杠杆回购使企业能够优化其杠杆，平均而言使股东受益。但随着企业事前杠杆的升高，这些收益递减。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Consumption, aggregate wealth, and expected stock returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies the role of fluctuations in the aggregate consumption-wealth ratio for predicting stock returns. Raw markdown: lettau-2001-consumption-aggregate-wealth-and-expected-stock-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Lettau, M, Ludvigson, S Journal:…
pages.text: Consumption, aggregate wealth, and expected stock returns (2001) Paper claim — This paper studies the role of fluctuations in the aggregate consumption-wealth ratio for predicting stock returns. Raw markdown: lettau-2001-consumption-aggregate-wealth-and-expected-stock-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Lettau, M, Ludvigson, S Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00347 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper studies the role of fluctuations in the aggregate consumption-wealth ratio for predicting stock returns. Using U.S, quarterly stock market data, we find that these fluctuations in the consumption-wealth ratio are strong predictors of both real stock returns and excess returns over a Treasury bill rate. We also find that this variable is a better forecaster of future returns at short and intermediate horizons than is the dividend yield, the dividend payout ratio, and several other popular forecasting variables. Why should the consumption-wealth ratio forecast asset returns? We show that a wide class of optimal models of consumer behavior imply that the log consumption-aggregate wealth (human capital plus asset holdings) ratio summarizes expected returns on aggregate wealth, or the market portfolio. Although this ratio is not observable, we provide assumptions under which its important predictive components for future asset returns may be expressed in terms of observable variables, namely in terms of consumption, asset holdings and labor income. The framework implies that these variables are cointegrated, and that deviations from this shared trend summarize agents' expectations of future returns on the market portfolio. 摘要（中文） 本文研究总量消费—财富比率的波动在预测股票收益中的作用。使用美国季度股票市场数据，我们发现消费—财富比率的这些波动是实际股票收益以及相对于国库券利率的超额收益的强预测变量。我们还发现，在短期和中期时间跨度上，该变量比股利收益率、股利支付率以及其他几个常用的预测变量能更好地预测未来收益。为什么消费—财富比率能够预测资产收益？我们表明，一大类关于消费者行为的最优模型意味着，对数消费—总量财富（人力资本加资产持有）比率概括了总量财富（即市场组合）的预期收益。尽管该比率不可观测，但我们给出了一些假设，在这些假设下，它对未来资产收益的重要预测成分可以用可观测变量来表达，即用消费、资产持有和劳动收入来表达。该框架意味着这些变量是协整的，并且对这一共同趋势的偏离概括了行为主体对市场组合未来收益的预期。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a dynamic risk-based model that captures the value premium. Raw markdown: lettau-2007-why-is-long-horizon-equity-less-risky-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Lettau, M, Wachter, JA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI:…
pages.text: Why is long-horizon equity less risky? A duration-based explanation of the value premium (2007) Paper claim — We propose a dynamic risk-based model that captures the value premium. Raw markdown: lettau-2007-why-is-long-horizon-equity-less-risky-a Bibliographic Record Authors: Lettau, M, Wachter, JA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2007.01201.x Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We propose a dynamic risk-based model that captures the value premium. Firms are modeled as long-lived assets distinguished by the timing of cash flows. The stochastic discount factor is specified so that shocks to aggregate dividends are priced, but shocks to the discount rate are not. The model implies that growth firms covary more with the discount rate than do value firms, which covary more with cash flows. When calibrated to explain aggregate stock market behavior, the model accounts for the observed value premium, the high Sharpe ratios on value firms, and the poor performance of the CAPM. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一个动态的基于风险的模型来刻画价值溢价。公司被建模为由现金流时机所区分的长期资产。随机贴现因子被设定为使得对总体股利的冲击被定价，但对贴现率的冲击不被定价。该模型意味着成长型公司比价值型公司与贴现率的协变更大，而价值型公司与现金流的协变更大。当校准以解释总体股票市场行为时，该模型解释了观察到的价值溢价、价值型公司的高夏普比率以及CAPM的糟糕表现。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The term structures of equity and interest rates
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper proposes a dynamic risk-based model capable of jointly explaining the term structure of interest rates, returns on the aggregate market, and the risk and return characteristics of value and growth stocks. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The term structures of equity and interest rates (2011) Paper claim — This paper proposes a dynamic risk-based model capable of jointly explaining the term structure of interest rates, returns on the aggregate market, and the risk and return characteristics of value and growth stocks. Raw markdown: lettau-2011-the-term-structures-of-equity-and-interest-rates Bibliographic Record Authors: Lettau, M, Wachter, JA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.02.014 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper proposes a dynamic risk-based model capable of jointly explaining the term structure of interest rates, returns on the aggregate market, and the risk and return characteristics of value and growth stocks. Both the term structure of interest rates and returns on value and growth stocks convey information about how the representative investor values cash flows of different maturities. We model how the representative investor perceives risks of these cash flows by specifying a parsimonious stochastic discount factor for the economy. Shocks to dividend growth, the real interest rate, and expected inflation are priced, but shocks to the price of risk are not. Given reasonable assumptions for dividends and inflation, we show that the model can simultaneously account for the behavior of aggregate stock returns, an upward-sloping yield curve, the failure of the expectations hypothesis, and the poor performance of the capital asset pricing model. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文提出了一个动态的基于风险的模型，能够联合解释利率的期限结构、总体市场收益以及价值股和成长股的风险与收益特征。利率的期限结构和价值股与成长股的收益都传递了代表性投资者如何对不同期限现金流估值的信息。我们通过为该经济设定一个简约的随机贴现因子来建模代表性投资者如何感知这些现金流的风险。对股利增长、实际利率和预期通胀的冲击被定价，但对风险价格的冲击未被定价。在对股利和通胀作出合理假设的前提下，我们表明该模型能够同时解释总体股票收益的行为、向上倾斜的收益率曲线、预期假说的失败以及资本资产定价模型的糟糕表现。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Dividend changes and catering incentives (2006) Paper claim — We extend Baker and Wurgler's [2004a. Raw markdown: li-2006-dividend-changes-and-catering-incentives Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, W, Lie, E Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.03.005 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We extend Baker and Wurgler's [2004a. Journal of Finance 59 1125-1165] catering theory to include decreases and increases in existing dividends. Consistent with our extended model, we find that the decision to change the dividend and the magnitude of the change depend on the premium that the capital market places on dividends. We also find that the stock market reaction to dividend changes depends on the dividend premium. Thus, the capital market rewards managers for considering investor demand for dividends when making decisions about the level of dividends. (c) 2005 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们扩展了Baker和Wurgler（2004a，《金融学杂志》59: 1125-1165）的迎合理论，将现有股利的减少和增加纳入其中。与我们扩展的模型相一致，我们发现改变股利的决策以及改变的幅度取决于资本市场对股利所赋予的溢价。我们还发现，股票市场对股利变化的反应取决于股利溢价。因此，资本市场会因管理者在做出关于股利水平的决策时考虑投资者对股利的需求而给予其奖励。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Control of Dividends, Capital Subscriptions, and Physical Inventories
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Manufacturers manage interrelated flows of material and cash. Raw markdown: li-2013-control-of-dividends-capital-subscriptions-and-physical-inventories Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, L, Shubik, M, Sobel, MJ Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2013 DOI:…
pages.text: Control of Dividends, Capital Subscriptions, and Physical Inventories (2013) Paper claim — Manufacturers manage interrelated flows of material and cash. Raw markdown: li-2013-control-of-dividends-capital-subscriptions-and-physical-inventories Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, L, Shubik, M, Sobel, MJ Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1120.1629 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Manufacturers manage interrelated flows of material and cash. Material needs capital, and sales contribute cash. Therefore, it may be beneficial to coordinate operational and financial decisions. We study a dynamic model of coordination in an equity-financed firm in which inventory and financial decisions interact in the presence of demand uncertainty, financial constraints, and a risk of default. The criterion is to maximize the expected present value of dividends net of capital subscriptions. The optimal target inventory level and financial decision variables are nondecreasing functions of the levels of inventory and retained earnings. Some important attributes of an optimal policy remain the same regardless of whether default precipitates Chapter 7 or Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The optimal policy is myopic, and if pertinent cost functions are piecewise linear, it is characterized with simple formulas. We show that the methods of inventory theory are useful in analyzing models of operational and financial coordination. 摘要（中文） 制造商管理着彼此关联的物料流和现金流。物料需要资本，销售贡献现金。因此，协调运营决策与财务决策可能是有益的。我们研究了一个股权融资企业中协调的动态模型，其中在需求不确定性、财务约束和违约风险存在的情况下，存货决策与财务决策相互作用。其准则是使股利净额（扣除资本认购后）的预期现值最大化。最优目标存货水平和财务决策变量是存货水平与留存收益水平的非递减函数。无论违约触发的是第7章还是第11章破产，最优政策的一些重要属性保持不变。最优政策是近视的，并且如果相关成本函数是分段线性的，则该政策可用简单公式加以刻画。我们表明，存货理论的方法在分析运营与财务协调模型时是有用的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Heterogeneity in beliefs and time preferences among investors make stock volatility stochastic, even though the volatility of the underlying dividend is constant. Raw markdown: li-2013-investors-heterogeneity-and-implied-volatility-smiles Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Investors' Heterogeneity and Implied Volatility Smiles (2013) Paper claim — Heterogeneity in beliefs and time preferences among investors make stock volatility stochastic, even though the volatility of the underlying dividend is constant. Raw markdown: li-2013-investors-heterogeneity-and-implied-volatility-smiles Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, T Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2013.1712 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Heterogeneity in beliefs and time preferences among investors make stock volatility stochastic, even though the volatility of the underlying dividend is constant. Prices of the European options written on this stock admit closed-form solutions, hence their hedging deltas. The Black-Scholes implied volatility surface, which depends on wealth distribution, investors' beliefs, and time preferences, exhibits observed patterns that are widely documented in various options markets. Along with benchmark models, the model is calibrated weekly to the S&P 500 index options from January 1996 to April 2006. It shows comparable performance to the stochastic volatility and jump model and outperforms the traders' rules and two no-arbitrage models (stochastic volatility, and stochastic volatility and stochastic interest rate) in terms of out-of-sample pricing errors. 摘要（中文） 投资者之间在信念和时间偏好上的异质性使股票波动性变得随机，尽管标的股利的波动性是恒定的。以该股票为标的的欧式期权价格存在闭式解，因而其对冲delta也存在闭式解。Black-Scholes隐含波动率曲面取决于财富分布、投资者信念和时间偏好，它表现出在各类期权市场中被广泛记录的、可观察到的模式。连同基准模型一起，该模型在1996年1月至2006年4月期间每周对标普500指数期权进行校准。它表现出与随机波动率加跳跃模型相当的表现，并在样本外定价误差方面优于交易员经验法则和两个无套利模型（随机波动率模型，以及随机波动率加随机利率模型）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Individual Investors' Dividend Taxes and Corporate Payout Policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The 2012 Dividend Tax Reform in China ties individual investors' dividend tax rates to the length of their shareholding period. Raw markdown: li-2017-individual-investors-dividend-taxes-and-corporate-payout-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, OZ, Liu, H, Ni,…
pages.text: Individual Investors' Dividend Taxes and Corporate Payout Policies (2017) Paper claim — The 2012 Dividend Tax Reform in China ties individual investors' dividend tax rates to the length of their shareholding period. Raw markdown: li-2017-individual-investors-dividend-taxes-and-corporate-payout-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, OZ, Liu, H, Ni, CK, Ye, KT Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109017000199 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract The 2012 Dividend Tax Reform in China ties individual investors' dividend tax rates to the length of their shareholding period. We find that firms facing a reduction (increase) in their individual investors' dividend tax rates are more (less) likely to increase dividend payout. Such an effect is concentrated in firms where incentives of controlling shareholders and minority shareholders are aligned. Furthermore, investors respond to this tax law change by reducing trading activities before the cum-dividend day and successfully lower their dividend tax penalty. Overall, our evidence enhances the notion that individual investors' tax profiles shape firms' payout policies. 摘要（中文） 中国2012年的股利税改革将个人投资者的股利税率与其持股期限的长短挂钩。我们发现，其个人投资者股利税率面临下降（上升）的企业，更（更不）可能提高股利支付。这种效应集中于控股股东与中小股东利益一致的企业。此外，投资者对这一税法变化的反应是在除息日前减少交易活动，并成功降低其股利税负。总体而言，我们的证据强化了这样一种观点：个人投资者的税收状况塑造了企业的支付政策。 Key Findings Using a difference-in-differences design around China's 2012 Dividend Tax Reform (which tied individual investors' dividend tax rates to holding period length), the coefficient on EVENT×HP (holding period proxy based on inverse share turnover) is positive and significant (0.045, t=2.48 in the full model); for two firms at the first and third share turnover quartiles, the difference in their dividend yield changes around the reform is 10.5% of the sample median yield. The tax-driven increase in dividends is concentrated in firms without divergence between controlling shareholders' voting and cash-flow rights; using related-party transactions (RPT) as a direct expropriation measure, the EVENT×HP coefficient is insignificant (−0.009) in high-RPT firms but positive and highly significant (0.089) in low-RPT firms, with a statistically significant Chow-test difference. Consistent with tax incentives mattering to investors, investors in high-dividend-yield firms significantly reduce their trading activities during the month before the cum-dividend day following the reform (coefficient on EVENT×YIELD_ANN is −0.048 for TURNOVER and −0.150 for ABTURNOVER, both significant). Ex-dividend day stock return analysis shows the coefficient on EVENT×TURNOVER×YIELD_CUM is positive and significant (15.747, t=3.18), indicating that after the reform investors who trade more before the cum-dividend day face higher dividend tax penalties — confirming they successfully manage their tax rates through trading behavior. Results are robust to a change-analysis specification, an alternative holding-period proxy based on changes in top-10 individual investors' ownership, and alternative payout measures. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine the implications of short-run and long-run consumption risks on the momentum and long-term contrarian profits and the value premium in a unified economic framework. Raw markdown: li-2017-short-run-and-long-run-consumption-risks-dividend Bibliographic…
pages.text: Short-Run and Long-Run Consumption Risks, Dividend Processes, and Asset Returns (2017) Paper claim — We examine the implications of short-run and long-run consumption risks on the momentum and long-term contrarian profits and the value premium in a unified economic framework. Raw markdown: li-2017-short-run-and-long-run-consumption-risks-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, J, Zhang, HH Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhw073 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We examine the implications of short-run and long-run consumption risks on the momentum and long-term contrarian profits and the value premium in a unified economic framework. By introducing time-varying firm cash flow exposures to the short-run and long-run shocks in consumption growth, we find the otherwise standard intertemporal asset pricing model goes a long way toward generating the momentum and long-term contrarian profits and the value premium. The model also reproduces the size effect, the pairwise correlations between the profitabilities of these investment strategies, and the performance of the standard CAPM and the consumption CAPM in explaining these well-documented return behaviors. 摘要（中文） 我们在一个统一的经济框架下考察短期和长期消费风险对动量利润、长期反转利润以及价值溢价的含义。通过在消费增长的短期和长期冲击中引入随时间变化的公司现金流暴露，我们发现，一个在其他方面标准的跨期资产定价模型在生成动量利润、长期反转利润以及价值溢价方面走得相当远。该模型还再现了规模效应、这些投资策略盈利性之间的两两相关性，以及标准CAPM和消费CAPM在解释这些有充分记录的收益行为方面的表现。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Innovation externalities and the customer/supplier link
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper proposes a novel channel through which innovation externalities can affect firm performance. Raw markdown: li-2018-innovation-externalities-and-the-customer-supplier-link Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, KM Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: Innovation externalities and the customer/supplier link (2018) Paper claim — This paper proposes a novel channel through which innovation externalities can affect firm performance. Raw markdown: li-2018-innovation-externalities-and-the-customer-supplier-link Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, KM Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2017.09.003 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper proposes a novel channel through which innovation externalities can affect firm performance. I find cross-sectional evidence that the positive innovation outputs of customer firms increase their supplier profitability as measured by firm ROE. This result is robust to the inclusion of industry fixed effect, a control for both supplier and customer characteristics, such as ROE, advertisement expenditure, capital expenditure, firm age, industry concentration, institutional ownership, dividend yield, and a control for industry spillover or geographical spillover. To identify the causal effect of customer innovation outputs on supplier performance, I study an exogenous shock-State Street Bank and Trust Company v. Signature Financial Group, Inc.-and find that an increase in granted customer patents causes an improvement in future supplier performance. This effect is mainly driven by the demand channel and the knowledge diffusion channel from customers to suppliers. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文提出了一条创新外部性可影响企业业绩的新颖渠道。我发现横截面证据表明，客户企业的正向创新产出会提升其供应商的盈利能力（以企业净资产收益率ROE衡量）。这一结果在纳入行业固定效应、控制供应商与客户特征（如ROE、广告支出、资本支出、企业年龄、行业集中度、机构持股、股利收益率）以及控制行业溢出或地理溢出后依然稳健。为识别客户创新产出对供应商业绩的因果效应，我研究了一次外生冲击——State Street Bank and Trust Company诉Signature Financial Group, Inc.案——并发现获批客户专利的增加会导致未来供应商业绩的改善。这一效应主要由从客户到供应商的需求渠道和知识扩散渠道所驱动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Gauging the effects of stock liquidity on earnings management: Evidence from the SEC tick size pilot test
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies whether stock market liquidity has a causal effect on real earnings management. Raw markdown: li-2021-gauging-the-effects-of-stock-liquidity-on-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, D, Xia, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021…
pages.text: Gauging the effects of stock liquidity on earnings management: Evidence from the SEC tick size pilot test (2021) Paper claim — This paper studies whether stock market liquidity has a causal effect on real earnings management. Raw markdown: li-2021-gauging-the-effects-of-stock-liquidity-on-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, D, Xia, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2021.101904 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper studies whether stock market liquidity has a causal effect on real earnings management. We introduce a new and cleaner identification of liquidity shock - the 2016 Tick Size Pilot Program - to show that firms with less liquid stocks are more likely to engage in real earnings management. We provide direct evidence that stock liquidity helps to deter real earnings management via enhancing governance by long-term institutional investors through trading and direct intervention, and via facilitating short selling to discipline managers. The effect is stronger in firms that do not pay dividends. 摘要（中文） 本文研究股票市场流动性是否对真实盈余管理具有因果效应。我们引入了一个关于流动性冲击的全新且更为纯净的识别——2016年最小报价单位试点计划（Tick Size Pilot Program）——以表明股票流动性较低的公司更可能从事真实盈余管理。我们提供了直接证据表明，股票流动性通过以下途径帮助遏制真实盈余管理：一是通过长期机构投资者的交易和直接干预来强化公司治理，二是通过便利卖空来约束管理者。这一效应在不支付股利的公司中更强。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Price ceilings, market structure, and payout policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — To prevent issuers from inflating their share prices, SEC Rule 10b-18 sets price ceilings on share repurchases through open markets. Raw markdown: li-2024-price-ceilings-market-structure-and-payout-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, XS, Ye, M, Zheng, M…
pages.text: Price ceilings, market structure, and payout policies (2024) Paper claim — To prevent issuers from inflating their share prices, SEC Rule 10b-18 sets price ceilings on share repurchases through open markets. Raw markdown: li-2024-price-ceilings-market-structure-and-payout-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Li, XS, Ye, M, Zheng, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2024.103818 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform, rule)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract To prevent issuers from inflating their share prices, SEC Rule 10b-18 sets price ceilings on share repurchases through open markets. We find that market-structure reforms in the 1990s and 2000s dramatically increased share repurchases because they relaxed constraints on issuers competing with other buyers under price ceilings. The Tick Size Pilot Program, a controlled experiment that partially reversed previous reforms, significantly reduced share repurchases. We estimate that price ceilings and reduced market-structure frictions explain 18% of the secular increase in share repurchases. Meanwhile, these two frictions still exist, which explains why share repurchases have not crowded out dividends entirely. 摘要（中文） 为防止发行方抬高其股价，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）规则10b-18对通过公开市场进行的股份回购设定了价格上限。我们发现，20世纪90年代和2000年代的市场结构改革显著增加了股份回购，因为这些改革放松了对发行方在价格上限下与其他买方竞争的约束。作为一项部分逆转先前改革的受控实验，报价单位试点计划（Tick Size Pilot Program）显著减少了股份回购。我们估计，价格上限和市场结构摩擦的降低解释了股份回购长期增长的18%。与此同时，这两种摩擦仍然存在，这解释了为何股份回购尚未完全挤出股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Outside Blockholders' Monitoring of Management and Debt Financing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Corporate governance mechanisms designed to alleviate manager-shareholder agency conflicts can worsen shareholder-bondholder conflicts. Raw markdown: liao-2015-outside-blockholders-monitoring-of-management-and-debt-financing Bibliographic Record Authors: Liao, S…
pages.text: Outside Blockholders' Monitoring of Management and Debt Financing (2015) Paper claim — Corporate governance mechanisms designed to alleviate manager-shareholder agency conflicts can worsen shareholder-bondholder conflicts. Raw markdown: liao-2015-outside-blockholders-monitoring-of-management-and-debt-financing Bibliographic Record Authors: Liao, S Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12138 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, monitor)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Corporate governance mechanisms designed to alleviate manager-shareholder agency conflicts can worsen shareholder-bondholder conflicts. This study examines how one such corporate governance mechanism, monitoring by large outside shareholders, influences the choice between public and private debt. I conjecture and find that firms with higher outside blockholdings are inclined to choose bank loans over public debt when they borrow, consistent with the notion that banks are better monitors than public debt markets. I also find that bank loans carry less price protection than corporate bonds against increased agency risk associated with outside blocks. Corroborating the monitoring story, I document that bank loans contain more accounting-based covenants and dividend restriction provisions for firms with higher outside blockholdings than for those with lower blockholdings. I find no such relation for public debt covenants. This supports that banks' monitoring of their loans counters the agency risk caused by blockholders. This study extends prior research that associates governance mechanisms with agency costs of debt, by incorporating lenders' differential monitoring mechanisms in the overall corporate governance system. 摘要（中文） 旨在缓解管理者-股东代理冲突的公司治理机制可能恶化股东-债券持有人冲突。本研究考察了这样一种公司治理机制——大额外部股东的监督——如何影响公开债务与私人债务之间的选择。我推测并发现，外部区块持股较高的企业在借款时倾向于选择银行贷款而非公开债务，这与银行比公开债务市场是更好的监督者这一观点相一致。我还发现，与公司债券相比，银行贷款针对与外部区块相关的代理风险增加所提供的价格保护更少。为佐证监督的观点，我记录到，对于外部区块持股较高的企业，银行贷款比外部区块持股较低的企业包含更多基于会计的契约条款和股利限制条款。对于公开债务契约，我没有发现这样的关系。这支持了银行对其贷款的监督抵消了区块持股人所引起的代理风险。本研究通过将贷款人差异化的监督机制纳入整体公司治理体系，拓展了将治理机制与债务代理成本相联系的先前研究。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The role of personal taxes in corporate decisions: An empirical analysis of share repurchases and dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates the impact of personal taxation on corporate managers' choices between share repurchases and dividends as a means of disbursing cash. Raw markdown: lie-1999-the-role-of-personal-taxes-in-corporate-decisions Bibliographic Record Authors: Lie,…
pages.text: The role of personal taxes in corporate decisions: An empirical analysis of share repurchases and dividends (1999) Paper claim — This study investigates the impact of personal taxation on corporate managers' choices between share repurchases and dividends as a means of disbursing cash. Raw markdown: lie-1999-the-role-of-personal-taxes-in-corporate-decisions Bibliographic Record Authors: Lie, E, Lie, HJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.2307/2676233 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, reform)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract This study investigates the impact of personal taxation on corporate managers' choices between share repurchases and dividends as a means of disbursing cash. Consistent with the notion that personal taxation influences the choice of disbursement method, we find that managers are more likely to choose a share repurchase if the firm has a low dividend yield, if the firm's stock has experienced losses or small recent capital gains, and if the payout occured before the Tax Reform Act of 1986. Further, managers are more sensitive to the shareholders' tax situations if institutional investors hold a large fraction of the shares. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察个人税收对企业经理人在股份回购与股利之间进行现金分配方式选择的影响。与个人税收影响分配方式选择这一观点相一致，我们发现，如果企业股利收益率低、如果企业股票近期经历了亏损或较小的资本利得、以及如果支付发生在1986年《税制改革法》之前，经理人更可能选择股份回购。此外，当机构投资者持有很大比例的股份时，经理人对股东税收状况更为敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Excess funds and agency problems: An empirical study of incremental cash disbursements
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates the excess funds hypothesis using samples of special dividends, regular dividend increases, and self-tender offers. Raw markdown: lie-2000-excess-funds-and-agency-problems-an-empirical-study Bibliographic Record Authors: Lie, E Journal:…
pages.text: Excess funds and agency problems: An empirical study of incremental cash disbursements (2000) Paper claim — This study investigates the excess funds hypothesis using samples of special dividends, regular dividend increases, and self-tender offers. Raw markdown: lie-2000-excess-funds-and-agency-problems-an-empirical-study Bibliographic Record Authors: Lie, E Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/13.1.219 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This study investigates the excess funds hypothesis using samples of special dividends, regular dividend increases, and self-tender offers. All three types of firms tend to have funds in excess of industry norms before the events. The excess funds are largely nonrecurring for special dividend and self-tender offer firms and recurring for regular dividend increase firms. The analysis of the stock price reaction suggests that large incremental disbursements mitigate the agency problem associated with excess funds. In particular, the stock price reaction is positively related to excess funds for self-tender offers and large special dividends, but not for regular dividend increases (which tend to be smaller) or small special dividends. 摘要（中文） 本研究使用特别股利、常规股利增加和自我要约收购的样本，考察了超额资金假说。所有这三类公司在事件发生之前往往拥有超过行业常态的资金。对于特别股利和自我要约收购公司，超额资金在很大程度上是非经常性的，而对于常规股利增加公司则是经常性的。对股价反应的分析表明，大额增量分配缓解了与超额资金相关的代理问题。特别地，对于自我要约收购和大额特别股利，股价反应与超额资金正相关，但对于常规股利增加（往往较小）或小额特别股利则不然。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Operating performance following dividend decreases and omissions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using quarterly data and benchmarks based on past performance characteristics, I find little evidence that earnings change following 661 dividend decreases and 484 dividend omissions between 1980 and 1998. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Operating performance following dividend decreases and omissions (2005) Paper claim — Using quarterly data and benchmarks based on past performance characteristics, I find little evidence that earnings change following 661 dividend decreases and 484 dividend omissions between 1980 and 1998. Raw markdown: lie-2005-operating-performance-following-dividend-decreases-and-omissions Bibliographic Record Authors: Lie, E Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2004.04.004 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract Using quarterly data and benchmarks based on past performance characteristics, I find little evidence that earnings change following 661 dividend decreases and 484 dividend omissions between 1980 and 1998. The exception is that earnings deteriorate during the quarter of dividend omissions, but they recover within a couple of quarters. My results further suggest that the lack of a more pronounced earnings decline is neither attributable to a contemporaneous and confounding increase in share repurchases, to earnings management, nor to improving investment opportunities, and the results are similar for firms that are not predicted to cut dividend payouts based on their financial flexibility. Instead, I find some evidence that the negative stock price reaction reflects the dismal performance during the quarter of the announcement, especially for firms that omit dividends, and that the market interprets the dividend announcements too pessimistically. (c) 2004 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 利用季度数据以及基于过往业绩特征的基准，我发现几乎没有证据表明1980年至1998年间661次股利减少和484次股利取消之后盈余会发生变化。例外情况是，盈余在股利取消当季恶化，但在几个季度内即可恢复。我的结果进一步表明，盈余下滑不甚显著既不能归因于同期且具有混淆效应的股份回购增加，也不能归因于盈余管理或投资机会的改善，且对于那些根据其财务灵活性预测不会削减股利支付的企业，结果也是相似的。相反，我发现一些证据表明，负向的股价反应反映了公告当季糟糕的业绩，尤其对于取消股利的企业而言，且市场对股利公告的解读过于悲观。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do personal taxes affect capital structure? Evidence from the 2003 tax cut
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Because the personal tax treatments of interest and dividend income likely affect the relative cost of debt and equity financing, a sharp change in tax treatment could affect firms' optimal leverage. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Do personal taxes affect capital structure? Evidence from the 2003 tax cut (2013) Paper claim — Because the personal tax treatments of interest and dividend income likely affect the relative cost of debt and equity financing, a sharp change in tax treatment could affect firms' optimal leverage. Raw markdown: lin-2013-do-personal-taxes-affect-capital-structure-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, LM, Flannery, MJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2013.03.010 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Because the personal tax treatments of interest and dividend income likely affect the relative cost of debt and equity financing, a sharp change in tax treatment could affect firms' optimal leverage. This paper examines the effect of the 2003 equity income tax cut on firms' debt usage. Because this tax cut affected only individual investors, we can use a difference-in-differences method to identify the effect of personal tax on firms' leverage. Previous research has found that the 2003 tax cut encouraged dividend payouts and reduced the cost of equity, but it provides no link to equilibrium leverage ratios. We estimate that the tax cut causes the affected firms' leverage to decrease by about 5 percentage points. Furthermore, we show that the effects of the tax cut are stronger for firms with lower marginal corporate tax rates and for firms that are not financially constrained, consistent with our theoretical predictions. Overall, we find strong evidence that personal tax is an important determinant of firms' optimal leverage. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 由于利息和股利收入的个人税收待遇很可能会影响债务融资和权益融资的相对成本，税收待遇的急剧变化可能会影响公司的最优杠杆。本文考察2003年权益收入减税对公司债务使用的影响。由于这次减税仅影响个人投资者，我们可以使用双重差分方法来识别个人税对公司杠杆的影响。以往研究发现2003年减税鼓励了股利派现并降低了权益成本，但并未提供其与均衡杠杆比率的关联。我们估计，减税导致受影响公司的杠杆下降约5个百分点。此外，我们表明，对于边际公司税率较低的公司以及不受融资约束的公司，减税的效应更强，这与我们的理论预测相一致。总体而言，我们发现有力证据表明个人税是公司最优杠杆的一个重要决定因素。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Effect of Financing Constraints on Risk
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We provide evidence on the causal link between financing constraints and the risk of corporate cash flows and returns. Raw markdown: lin-2013-the-effect-of-financing-constraints-on-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, HD, Paravisini, D Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE…
pages.text: The Effect of Financing Constraints on Risk (2013) Paper claim — We provide evidence on the causal link between financing constraints and the risk of corporate cash flows and returns. Raw markdown: lin-2013-the-effect-of-financing-constraints-on-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, HD, Paravisini, D Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfr038 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We provide evidence on the causal link between financing constraints and the risk of corporate cash flows and returns. For identification, we compare public US firms in the same industry, location, and size quintile, but whose access to bank credit was differentially affected by WorldCom's demise in 2002. A credit shortage induces a permanent increase in the volatility and skewness of operating cash flows and an increase in the correlation between firm stock and market returns. We document how firms' cash, payout, and investment policies respond endogenously to mitigate the impact of constraints on risk. 摘要（中文） 我们提供了关于融资约束与公司现金流和收益风险之间因果联系的证据。为进行识别，我们比较了处于同一行业、同一地区、同一规模五分位、但其获得银行信贷的渠道因2002年WorldCom倒闭而受到差别影响的美国上市公司。信贷短缺诱发了经营现金流波动性和偏度的永久性上升，以及公司股票收益与市场收益之间相关性的上升。我们记录了公司的现金、派现和投资政策如何内生地做出反应，以缓解约束对风险的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Price inversion and post lock-up period returns on private investments in public equity in China: An interest transfer perspective
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper documents an anomaly in privately-placed stock returns in China and provides an explanation based on deliberate interest transfers. Raw markdown: lin-2019-price-inversion-and-post-lock-up-period-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, J, An, YB, Yang,…
pages.text: Price inversion and post lock-up period returns on private investments in public equity in China: An interest transfer perspective (2019) Paper claim — This paper documents an anomaly in privately-placed stock returns in China and provides an explanation based on deliberate interest transfers. Raw markdown: lin-2019-price-inversion-and-post-lock-up-period-returns Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, J, An, YB, Yang, J, Liang, YH Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2018.11.005 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper documents an anomaly in privately-placed stock returns in China and provides an explanation based on deliberate interest transfers. Using a sample of private investments in public equity (PIPEs) with lock-up periods ending between 2007 and 2015, we find that stocks with price inversion (unlock-date price lower than the issuing price) generate higher short-term returns post lock-up period than other stocks, and the greater the degree of price inversion, the better the short-term returns. This anomaly cannot be explained by the effects of price reversal, investors' under-reaction to companies' prospects, or improved governance after PIPEs. Rather, it reflects the interests transferred by issuing firms to participating investors via means including aggressive earnings management and dividend increase, given the unique regulations on PIPEs in China. Interest transfer is particularly pronounced if local investors participate in a PIPE, but sound corporate governance can restrain it. 摘要（中文） 本文记录了中国定向增发股票收益中的一个异象，并基于蓄意的利益输送提供了一种解释。使用锁定期在2007年至2015年间结束的定向增发（PIPEs）样本，我们发现，出现价格倒挂（解禁日价格低于发行价）的股票在锁定期后产生的短期收益高于其他股票，且价格倒挂程度越大，短期收益越好。这一异象无法用价格反转效应、投资者对公司前景的反应不足或PIPE之后治理改善来解释。相反，它反映了在中国关于PIPE的独特监管背景下，发行公司通过激进的盈余管理和股利增加等手段向参与投资者输送的利益。如果本地投资者参与PIPE，利益输送尤为明显，但健全的公司治理能够对其加以约束。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Minority shareholder voting and dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find that minority shareholders' voting opposition to dividend proposals is associated with signifi-cantly higher cash dividend payout in the following year for stocks listed in Shanghai Stock Exchange. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Minority shareholder voting and dividend policy (2023) Paper claim — We find that minority shareholders' voting opposition to dividend proposals is associated with signifi-cantly higher cash dividend payout in the following year for stocks listed in Shanghai Stock Exchange. Raw markdown: lin-2023-minority-shareholder-voting-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, J, Li, F, Zheng, SX, Zhou, MS Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2022.106748 Relevance score: 11.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, independent director, policy, regulat)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract We find that minority shareholders' voting opposition to dividend proposals is associated with signifi-cantly higher cash dividend payout in the following year for stocks listed in Shanghai Stock Exchange. When minority shareholders' voting opposition increases, the likelihood and frequency of regulatory penalties increase. The reverse happens after firms increase dividend payout. Minority shareholders' vot-ing opposition has a stronger positive effect on cash dividend payout when they post more messages in stock forums and when independent directors express dissenting opinions. The effect is weaker if the board chair or CEO has political connections. Minority shareholders' voting opposition does not have sig-nificant effects on the growth rate of earnings and the level of earnings management. But we do find evidence that minority shareholder voting opposition reduces expropriation by major shareholders. The evidence supports a hypothesis that regulators use the minority shareholder voting results to screen out possible cases of shareholder oppression.(c) 2022 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，对于在上海证券交易所上市的股票，中小股东在股利提案上的投票反对与次年显著更高的现金股利支付相关。当中小股东的投票反对增加时，监管处罚的可能性和频率上升。企业在增加股利支付后则出现相反情况。当中小股东在股票论坛上发布更多信息、以及当独立董事表达异议时，其投票反对对现金股利支付的正向影响更强。若董事长或首席执行官具有政治关联，则该影响较弱。中小股东的投票反对对盈利增长率和盈余管理水平没有显著影响。但我们确实发现证据表明，中小股东投票反对减少了大股东的侵占。这一证据支持了这样一个假说：监管者利用中小股东的投票结果来筛查可能存在的股东压迫案例。 Key Findings Minority shareholders' voting opposition to dividend proposals is associated with significantly higher cash dividend payout in the following year; for each one standard deviation increase in Dissent, Dividend2A_After increases by 7.4% relative to the mean. Higher minority voting opposition increases the likelihood and frequency of regulatory penalties by 33% per one SD increase in Dissent; conversely, if firms subsequently increase dividend payout, regulatory penalties decrease by 43.3%. The effect of voting opposition on dividends is stronger when minority shareholders post more messages in stock forums (SMCover) and when independent directors express dissenting opinions (IndDissent), and is weaker when the board chair or CEO has political connections. The primary mechanism through which dividend increases are generated is a reduction in expropriation by major shareholders (intercorporate tunneling via other receivables), not changes in earnings management or perk consumption. The evidence supports the vote disclosure screening hypothesis: regulators use minority shareholder voting results to screen for firms with potential governance problems, inducing preemptive dividend increases to avoid scrutiny. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.title: State Controlling Shareholders and Payout Policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the role of state controlling shareholders in corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: lin-2023-state-controlling-shareholders-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, C, Liu, H, Ni, CK, Zhang, BH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE…
pages.text: State Controlling Shareholders and Payout Policy (2023) Paper claim — We study the role of state controlling shareholders in corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: lin-2023-state-controlling-shareholders-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, C, Liu, H, Ni, CK, Zhang, BH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109022001132 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We study the role of state controlling shareholders in corporate payout policy. The State Capital Operation Program in China requires parent central state-owned enterprises (CSOEs) to contribute part of their consolidated income to a new fiscal fund. We find that listed CSOEs, partially controlled by parent CSOEs, experience significant reductions in dividend payouts as the income-contribution ratio increases. The dividend reductions are concurrent with increases in intragroup resource transfers-listed CSOEs' loans to, and commercial trades with, group peers. The program yields adverse consequences for listed CSOEs' investment and employment, yet being mitigated by group-level dividend reductions. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了国家控股股东在公司支付政策中的作用。中国的国有资本运营计划要求母公司中央国有企业（CSOE）将其合并收入的一部分贡献给一个新的财政基金。我们发现，由母公司CSOE部分控股的上市CSOE，随着收入贡献比率的提高，股利支付出现显著减少。股利减少与集团内部资源转移的增加同时发生——即上市CSOE向集团同侪提供贷款以及与之进行商业交易。该计划对上市CSOE的投资和就业产生了不利后果，但被集团层面的股利减少所缓解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Government debt, government ownership, and corporate cash dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates the joint effect of government debt and government ownership on corporate dividends, using data on local government debt and A-share listed companies in China. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Government debt, government ownership, and corporate cash dividends (2026) Paper claim — This paper investigates the joint effect of government debt and government ownership on corporate dividends, using data on local government debt and A-share listed companies in China. Raw markdown: lin-2026-government-debt-government-ownership-and-corporate-cash-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Lin, J, Lu, YT, Zhou, MS, An, YB Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2026.102994 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, rule)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract This paper investigates the joint effect of government debt and government ownership on corporate dividends, using data on local government debt and A-share listed companies in China. We find that excessive local government debt leads to higher cash dividends among local stateowned enterprises (SOEs), indicating that under significant debt pressure, local governments rely on SOE cash dividends to address pressing fiscal challenges. The effect is more pronounced in regions where local governments have stronger control over SOEs and local debt ratios exceed the 100% risk warning threshold. Moreover, heavily indebted local governments prioritize alleviating urgent debt burdens to meet the central government's debt risk mitigation requirements and lower financing costs. We further show that SOEs accommodate these demands by cutting R&D expenditures and operating expenses while increasing bank debt. In fact, government debt is largely converted into SOE bank loans. Finally, we find that high SOE cash dividends enable local governments to scale back bond issuance for refinancing maturing implicit government debt and narrow the interest spread of newly issued government debt. Our findings have important implications for jurisdictions globally where the rule of law fails to protect minority shareholders against expropriation and dividend tunnelling. 摘要（中文） 本文利用中国地方政府债务和A股上市公司的数据，考察政府债务与政府所有权对企业股利的联合影响。我们发现，过度的地方政府债务导致地方国有企业（国企）派发更高的现金股利，这表明在巨大的债务压力下，地方政府依赖国企的现金股利来应对紧迫的财政挑战。在地方政府对国企控制力更强、且地方债务率超过100%风险警戒阈值的地区，这一效应更为显著。此外，负债沉重的地方政府优先缓解紧迫的债务负担，以满足中央政府降低债务风险的要求并降低融资成本。我们进一步表明，国企通过削减研发支出和运营费用、同时增加银行债务来迎合这些需求。事实上，政府债务在很大程度上被转化为国企的银行贷款。最后，我们发现，高额的国企现金股利使地方政府能够缩减为到期隐性政府债务再融资而进行的债券发行，并收窄新发行政府债务的利差。我们的发现对全球那些法治未能保护小股东免遭侵占和股利掏空的司法辖区具有重要意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Underreaction to dividend reductions and omissions? (2008) Paper claim — Using a sample of 2,337 cash dividend reduction or omission announcements over the 1927 to 1999 period, this study reports significant negative post-announcement long-term abnormal returns, which last 1 year only. Raw markdown: liu-2008-underreaction-to-dividend-reductions-and-omissions Bibliographic Record Authors: Liu, Y, Szewczyk, SH, Zantout, Z Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2008.01337.x Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract Using a sample of 2,337 cash dividend reduction or omission announcements over the 1927 to 1999 period, this study reports significant negative post-announcement long-term abnormal returns, which last 1 year only. However, this long-term abnormal performance is driven by the post-earnings-announcement drift. After controlling for the earnings performance and the skewness of buy-and-hold abnormal returns, there is no compelling evidence of a post-dividend-reduction or post-dividend-omission price drift. 摘要（中文） 本文使用1927年至1999年期间2,337个现金股利削减或取消公告的样本，报告了公告后显著为负的长期异常收益，但该现象仅持续1年。然而，这一长期异常表现是由盈余公告后漂移驱动的。在控制了盈余表现以及买入并持有异常收益的偏度之后，并没有令人信服的证据表明存在股利削减后或股利取消后的价格漂移。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: CORPORATE DIVIDENDS AND SEASONED EQUITY ISSUES - AN EMPIRICAL-INVESTIGATION (1992) Paper claim — This paper investigates whether managers rely on dividends to obtain a higher price in a stock offering and whether the stock price reaction to dividend and offering announcements justifies such a coordination. Raw markdown: loderer-1992-corporate-dividends-and-seasoned-equity-issues-an-empirical Bibliographic Record Authors: LODERER, CF, MAUER, DC Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2329095 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper investigates whether managers rely on dividends to obtain a higher price in a stock offering and whether the stock price reaction to dividend and offering announcements justifies such a coordination. The evidence does not support either conjecture. Issuing firms are not more likely to pay or increase dividends than nonissuing forms. Moreover, there is little evidence that firms time stock offering announcements right after dividend declarations to benefit from the attendant information disclosure. The analysis of dividend and stock offering announcement effects suggests few if any benefits from linking dividend and stock offering announcements. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了管理者是否依赖股利在股票发行中获得更高的价格，以及股价对股利和发行公告的反应是否证明此种协调的合理性。证据不支持这两种推测。发行企业并不比非发行企业更有可能支付或增加股利。此外，几乎没有证据表明企业会在股利宣告后立即安排股票发行公告的时间，以从随之而来的信息披露中受益。对股利和股票发行公告效应的分析表明，将股利与股票发行公告联系起来即便有好处也微乎其微。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The vector autoregressive approach for testing present value models is applied to a heterogeneous-agent asset pricing model using historical observations of the S&P 500 index. Raw markdown: lof-2015-rational-speculators-contrarians-and-excess-volatility…
pages.text: Rational Speculators, Contrarians, and Excess Volatility (2015) Paper claim — The vector autoregressive approach for testing present value models is applied to a heterogeneous-agent asset pricing model using historical observations of the S&P 500 index. Raw markdown: lof-2015-rational-speculators-contrarians-and-excess-volatility Bibliographic Record Authors: Lof, M Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2014.1937 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The vector autoregressive approach for testing present value models is applied to a heterogeneous-agent asset pricing model using historical observations of the S&P 500 index. Besides fundamentalists, who value assets according to expected dividends, the model features rational and contrarian speculators. Agents choose their strategy based on evolutionary considerations. Supplementing the standard present value model with speculative agents dramatically improves the model's ability to replicate observed market dynamics. In particular, the existence of contrarians can explain some of the most volatile episodes including the 1990s bubble, suggesting this was not a rational bubble. 摘要（中文） 本文将检验现值模型的向量自回归方法应用于一个异质主体资产定价模型，使用标准普尔500指数的历史观测数据。除了根据预期股利对资产估值的基本面派之外，该模型还包含理性投机者和反向投机者。主体基于演化考量选择其策略。在标准现值模型中补充投机性主体，极大地提高了该模型复现观测到的市场动态的能力。特别是，反向投机者的存在可以解释一些波动性最强的时期，包括20世纪90年代的泡沫，这表明该泡沫并非理性泡沫。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Discount rates and cash flows: A local projection approach (2024) Paper claim — We develop flexible local projections to quantify the relative contributions of expected discount rates and cash flows to the variation of dividend yields. Raw markdown: lof-2024-discount-rates-and-cash-flows-a-local-projection Bibliographic Record Authors: Lof, M, Nyberg, H Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107127 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We develop flexible local projections to quantify the relative contributions of expected discount rates and cash flows to the variation of dividend yields. Local projections enable the incorporation of large information sets, the use of monthly data along with annual data, and the consideration of time variation in the dividend yield decomposition. By expanding the set of state variables and allowing for time -varying parameters, our results show that the variation of expected discount rates remains the primary contributor to market volatility, whereas the contribution of expected cash flows is considerably smaller. 摘要（中文） 我们发展了灵活的局部投影方法，以量化预期贴现率和现金流对股利收益率变动的相对贡献。局部投影能够纳入大型信息集，同时使用月度数据和年度数据，并考虑股利收益率分解中的时间变动。通过扩展状态变量集合并允许时变参数，我们的结果表明，预期贴现率的变动仍然是市场波动的主要贡献者，而预期现金流的贡献则要小得多。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: AN EMPIRICAL-EXAMINATION OF DIVIDEND POLICY FOLLOWING DEBT ISSUES
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper empirically examines the underinvestment problem and the use of dividends to expropriate lenders' wealth. Raw markdown: long-1994-an-empirical-examination-of-dividend-policy-following-debt Bibliographic Record Authors: LONG, MS, MALITZ, IB, SEFCIK, SE…
pages.text: AN EMPIRICAL-EXAMINATION OF DIVIDEND POLICY FOLLOWING DEBT ISSUES (1994) Paper claim — This paper empirically examines the underinvestment problem and the use of dividends to expropriate lenders' wealth. Raw markdown: long-1994-an-empirical-examination-of-dividend-policy-following-debt Bibliographic Record Authors: LONG, MS, MALITZ, IB, SEFCIK, SE Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1994 DOI: 10.2307/2331195 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract This paper empirically examines the underinvestment problem and the use of dividends to expropriate lenders' wealth. Rather than analyzing the market's reaction to potential wealth-expropriating events, a different aspect of potential conflicts of interest is addressed: do managers who control dividends act in a manner consistent with wealth expropriation? If so, then debt issues should be followed by increases in dividends. Two samples of firms are used: those issuing straight debt and those issuing convertible debt. The study finds no evidence that firms manipulate dividend policy to transfer wealth from the bondholders to stockholders. Two possible explanations are suggested. First, wealth expropriation may be a potential problem, but existing bond covenants restricting a firm's ability to pay dividends are effective. Second, firms may believe that reputation has greater value than what can be transferred from creditors in a one-time expropriation of wealth. Since the paper fails to find support for the covenant argument, it concludes that reputation is the most plausible explanation. 摘要（中文） 本文实证考察投资不足问题以及利用股利来侵占债权人财富的行为。本文并非分析市场对潜在财富侵占事件的反应，而是探讨利益冲突的另一个方面：控制股利的管理者是否以与财富侵占相一致的方式行事？如果是，那么债务发行之后应当伴随股利的增加。本文使用两个公司样本：发行普通债务的公司和发行可转换债务的公司。研究发现，没有证据表明公司会操纵股利政策以将财富从债券持有人转移至股东。文中提出了两种可能的解释。第一，财富侵占可能是一个潜在问题，但现有的限制公司支付股利能力的债券契约条款是有效的。第二，公司可能认为声誉的价值大于在一次性财富侵占中可从债权人处转移的价值。由于本文未能找到支持契约条款论点的证据，因此得出结论认为声誉是最合理的解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Corporate earnings and the equity premium
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Corporate cash flows are highly volatile and strongly procyclical. Raw markdown: longstaff-2004-corporate-earnings-and-the-equity-premium Bibliographic Record Authors: Longstaff, FA, Piazzesi, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2004 DOI:…
pages.text: Corporate earnings and the equity premium (2004) Paper claim — Corporate cash flows are highly volatile and strongly procyclical. Raw markdown: longstaff-2004-corporate-earnings-and-the-equity-premium Bibliographic Record Authors: Longstaff, FA, Piazzesi, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2003.12.001 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Corporate cash flows are highly volatile and strongly procyclical. We examine the asset-pricing implications of the sensitivity of corporate cash flows to economic shocks within a continuous-time model in which dividends are a stochastic fraction of aggregate consumption. We provide closed-form solutions for stock values and show that the equity premium can be represented as the sum of three components which we call the consumption-risk, event-risk, and corporate-risk premia. Calibrated to historical data, the model implies a total equity premium many times larger than in the standard model. The model also generates levels of equity volatility consistent with those experienced in the stock market. (C) 2004 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 公司现金流高度波动且强烈顺周期。我们在一个连续时间模型中考察公司现金流对经济冲击的敏感性的资产定价含义，在该模型中股利是总消费的一个随机比例。我们为股票价值提供了封闭形式解，并表明股权溢价可以表示为三个组成部分之和，我们称之为消费风险溢价、事件风险溢价和企业风险溢价。校准到历史数据后，该模型隐含的总股权溢价比标准模型大许多倍。该模型还生成了与股票市场实际经历相一致的股权波动水平。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Valuing Thinly Traded Assets
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We model illiquidity as a restriction on the stopping rules investors can follow in selling assets, and apply this framework to the valuation of thinly traded investments. Raw markdown: longstaff-2018-valuing-thinly-traded-assets Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Valuing Thinly Traded Assets (2018) Paper claim — We model illiquidity as a restriction on the stopping rules investors can follow in selling assets, and apply this framework to the valuation of thinly traded investments. Raw markdown: longstaff-2018-valuing-thinly-traded-assets Bibliographic Record Authors: Longstaff, FA Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2016.2718 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We model illiquidity as a restriction on the stopping rules investors can follow in selling assets, and apply this framework to the valuation of thinly traded investments. We find that discounts for illiquidity can be surprisingly large, approaching 30%-50% in some cases. Immediacy plays a unique role and is valued much more than ongoing liquidity. We show that investors in illiquid enterprises have strong incentives to increase dividends and other cash payouts, thereby introducing potential agency conflicts. We also find that illiquidity and volatility are fundamentally entangled in their effects on asset prices. This aspect may help explain why some assets are viewed as inherently more liquid than others and why liquidity concerns are heightened during financial crises. 摘要（中文） 我们将非流动性建模为对投资者出售资产时可遵循的停时规则的一种限制，并将这一框架应用于稀薄交易投资的估值。我们发现非流动性折价可能出奇地大，某些情况下接近30%—50%。即时性发挥着独特的作用，其价值远高于持续的流动性。我们表明，非流动性企业的投资者有强烈动机提高股利和其他现金支付，从而引入潜在的代理冲突。我们还发现，非流动性和波动性在其对资产价格的影响上从根本上相互交织。这一方面或许有助于解释为何某些资产被视为本质上比其他资产更具流动性，以及为何在金融危机期间对流动性的担忧会加剧。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Agency Conflicts, Dividend Payout, and the Direct Benefits of Conservative Financial Reporting to Equity-Holders
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Dividend payments are generally costly to shareholders. Raw markdown: louis-2015-agency-conflicts-dividend-payout-and-the-direct-benefits Bibliographic Record Authors: Louis, H, Urcan, O Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2015 DOI:…
pages.text: Agency Conflicts, Dividend Payout, and the Direct Benefits of Conservative Financial Reporting to Equity-Holders (2015) Paper claim — Dividend payments are generally costly to shareholders. Raw markdown: louis-2015-agency-conflicts-dividend-payout-and-the-direct-benefits Bibliographic Record Authors: Louis, H, Urcan, O Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1111/1911-3846.12085 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Dividend payments are generally costly to shareholders. One principal reason for such payments is that they force managers to raise funds in the external capital markets to finance new projects, which presumably reduces their incentives to engage in empire-building activities. We posit that, because accounting conservatism can also mitigate managers' incentives to engage in value-destroying projects, it could reduce the need for dividend payments and the associated costs. Accordingly, we find that dividend payments decrease with accounting conservatism. This effect holds even after we control for the underlying accounting factors that directly affect dividends, or limit the sample to firms that have no debt covenants pertaining to dividend payouts, indicating that the reason for the conservatism effect transcends the standard debt covenant restriction argument. More importantly, consistent with the agency cost explanation, the evidence also indicates that the conservatism effect increases with potential agency conflicts between managers and shareholders. 摘要（中文） 股利支付对股东而言通常是有代价的。此类支付的一个主要原因是，它们迫使经理人在外部资本市场筹集资金以为新项目融资，这大概会削弱其从事帝国建造活动的动机。我们提出，由于会计稳健性也能够缓解经理人从事价值破坏性项目的动机，它可以减少对股利支付及相关成本的需要。据此，我们发现股利支付随会计稳健性的提高而减少。这一效应即便在我们控制了直接影响股利的基础会计因素之后，或将样本限定于没有与股利支付相关债务契约条款的企业之后，依然成立，这表明稳健性效应的原因超越了标准的债务契约约束论点。更重要的是，与代理成本解释相一致，证据还表明稳健性效应随经理人与股东之间潜在代理冲突的增加而增强。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
