pages.title: The link between bank monitoring and corporate dividend policy: The case of dividend omissions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates whether bank monitoring influences investor response to a borrowing firm's decision to omit its dividend payments. Raw markdown: low-2001-the-link-between-bank-monitoring-and-corporate-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Low, SW,…
pages.text: The link between bank monitoring and corporate dividend policy: The case of dividend omissions (2001) Paper claim — This study investigates whether bank monitoring influences investor response to a borrowing firm's decision to omit its dividend payments. Raw markdown: low-2001-the-link-between-bank-monitoring-and-corporate-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Low, SW, Glorfeld, L, Hearth, D, Rimbey, JN Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(00)00170-9 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This study investigates whether bank monitoring influences investor response to a borrowing firm's decision to omit its dividend payments. We establish a new link between the theories of banking and dividend policy in an examination of how bank monitoring and firm dividend signals complement one another to resolve information asymmetries. Results indicate that, for small firms, investors interpret the dividend decision as a function of bank monitoring and the dividend signals taken together. Also reported are the results of tests examining the differences between the monitoring effects of banks versus public and private non-bank lenders. (C) 2001 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察银行监督是否影响投资者对借款企业取消其股利支付这一决定的反应。我们在考察银行监督与企业股利信号如何相互补充以解决信息不对称的过程中，在银行理论与股利政策理论之间建立了一个新的联系。结果表明，对于小企业，投资者将股利决定解读为银行监督与股利信号共同作用的函数。本文还报告了考察银行监督效应与公共及私人非银行贷款人监督效应之间差异的检验结果。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Shareholder heterogeneity, adverse selection, and payout policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — When shareholders have different plans to sell their shares, they will, in general, have different preferences concerning the firm's decision to pay out cash using dividends or share repurchase. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Shareholder heterogeneity, adverse selection, and payout policy (1998) Paper claim — When shareholders have different plans to sell their shares, they will, in general, have different preferences concerning the firm's decision to pay out cash using dividends or share repurchase. Raw markdown: lucas-1998-shareholder-heterogeneity-adverse-selection-and-payout-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Lucas, DJ, McDonald, RL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1998 DOI: 10.2307/2331309 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract When shareholders have different plans to sell their shares, they will, in general, have different preferences concerning the firm's decision to pay out cash using dividends or share repurchase. We illustrate these different preferences and explore a model of payout policy that highlights the adverse selection costs of repurchases when managers have superior information about the value of the firm. We show that, in the absence of fixed costs to repurchasing shares, there is a separating equilibrium in which managers use taxable dividends to signal the quality of the firm, with better firms paying lower dividends, using repurchases for the remainder of the payout. With fixed costs to repurchasing, small payouts are made via dividend and large payouts are divided between repurchases and dividends, as in the no-fixed cost case. In both cases, the percentage of shares repurchased increases with the size of the payout and larger repurchases are better news. 摘要（中文） 当股东有不同的售股计划时，他们对企业以股利还是股份回购分配现金的决策一般会有不同的偏好。我们阐明了这些不同的偏好，并探讨了一个支付政策模型，该模型凸显了当管理者拥有关于企业价值的优势信息时回购的逆向选择成本。我们表明，在不存在回购股份固定成本的情况下，存在一个分离均衡，其中管理者使用应税股利来发出企业质量的信号，质量更好的企业支付更低的股利，用回购完成其余的支付。在存在回购固定成本时，小额支付通过股利进行，而大额支付则在回购与股利之间分配，与无固定成本情形相同。在这两种情况下，回购股份的比例都随支付规模的增大而上升，且较大的回购是更好的消息。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Friend or foe? Bilateral political relations and the portfolio allocation of foreign institutional investors
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study the role of bilateral political relations in explaining variations in the equity portfolio allocation of foreign institutional investors. Raw markdown: lugo-2026-friend-or-foe-bilateral-political-relations-and-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Lugo, S,…
pages.text: Friend or foe? Bilateral political relations and the portfolio allocation of foreign institutional investors (2026) Paper claim — We study the role of bilateral political relations in explaining variations in the equity portfolio allocation of foreign institutional investors. Raw markdown: lugo-2026-friend-or-foe-bilateral-political-relations-and-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Lugo, S, Montone, M Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2025.102937 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We study the role of bilateral political relations in explaining variations in the equity portfolio allocation of foreign institutional investors. Using a large sample at the fund-firm-year level, we find that political distance between countries leads to significant retrenchment of foreign institutional investors from local firms. Consistent with our theorized mechanisms, we find that the effect is stronger for stocks that are more exposed to geopolitical risk, dividend-paying, and less liquid, as foreign investors sell off local securities perceived to become riskier to hold. Overall, our findings identify a novel financial channel through which geopolitical risk affects international equity markets. 摘要（中文） 我们研究双边政治关系在解释外国机构投资者股权组合配置变异中的作用。使用基金—企业—年度层面的大型样本，我们发现国家间的政治距离导致外国机构投资者从当地企业大幅撤离。与我们所理论化的机制一致，我们发现这一效应对于更多暴露于地缘政治风险、派发股利以及流动性较差的股票更强，因为外国投资者抛售那些被认为持有起来变得更有风险的当地证券。总体而言，我们的发现识别出地缘政治风险影响国际股票市场的一条新颖的金融渠道。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Reconciling Value Estimates from the Discounted Cash Flow Model and the Residual Income Model
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines why practitioners and researchers get different estimates of equity value when they use a discounted cash flow (CF) model versus a residual income (RI) model. Raw markdown: lundholm-2001-reconciling-value-estimates-from-the-discounted-cash-flow…
pages.text: Reconciling Value Estimates from the Discounted Cash Flow Model and the Residual Income Model (2001) Paper claim — This paper examines why practitioners and researchers get different estimates of equity value when they use a discounted cash flow (CF) model versus a residual income (RI) model. Raw markdown: lundholm-2001-reconciling-value-estimates-from-the-discounted-cash-flow Bibliographic Record Authors: Lundholm, R, O'Keefe, T Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1506/W13B-K4BT-455N-TTR2 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper examines why practitioners and researchers get different estimates of equity value when they use a discounted cash flow (CF) model versus a residual income (RI) model. Both models are derived from the same underlying assumption - that price is the present value of expected future net dividends discounted at the cost of equity capital - but in practice and in research they frequently yield different estimates. We argue that the research literature devoted to comparing the accuracy of these two models is misguided; properly implemented, both models yield identical valuations for all firms in all years. We identify how prior research has applied inconsistent assumptions to the two models and show how these seemingly small errors cause surprisingly large differences in the value estimates. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了为何从业者和研究者在使用贴现现金流（CF）模型与剩余收益（RI）模型时会得到不同的股权价值估计。两个模型都源于同一个基础假设——即价格是预期未来净股利按股权资本成本贴现的现值——但在实践和研究中它们经常产生不同的估计。我们认为，致力于比较这两个模型准确性的研究文献是被误导的；如果正确实施，两个模型对所有公司在所有年份都产生完全相同的估值。我们指出此前研究如何对这两个模型应用了不一致的假设，并表明这些看似微小的错误如何导致价值估计中出人意料的巨大差异。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Investment, payout, and cash management under risk and ambiguity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study extends the theoretical model of dynamic investment, dividend payout, costly external financing, and liquidation for financially constrained firms by incorporating ambiguity. Raw markdown: luo-2022-investment-payout-and-cash-management-under-risk-and…
pages.text: Investment, payout, and cash management under risk and ambiguity (2022) Paper claim — This study extends the theoretical model of dynamic investment, dividend payout, costly external financing, and liquidation for financially constrained firms by incorporating ambiguity. Raw markdown: luo-2022-investment-payout-and-cash-management-under-risk-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Luo, PF, Tian, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2022.106551 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract This study extends the theoretical model of dynamic investment, dividend payout, costly external financing, and liquidation for financially constrained firms by incorporating ambiguity. We demonstrate that ambiguity aversion induces a trade-off between the "bird-in-hand" effect and an amplified precautionary motive in determining firms' cash management, which consequently affects firms' investment, dividend payout, costly external financing, and liquidation decisions. Unlike the models considering risk only, we identify a non-monotonic relationship between the endogenous payout boundary and ambiguity aversion. Our model generates several new implications, including providing an explanation for the high cash holdings and speed-up of asset sales during the recent COVID-19 crisis. (c) 2022 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究通过纳入模糊性（ambiguity），扩展了财务受约束企业的动态投资、股利支付、代价高昂的外部融资和清算的理论模型。我们证明，模糊性厌恶在决定企业现金管理时诱发了"落袋为安"（bird-in-hand）效应与被放大的预防性动机之间的权衡，进而影响企业的投资、股利支付、代价高昂的外部融资和清算决策。与仅考虑风险的模型不同，我们识别出内生支付边界与模糊性厌恶之间的非单调关系。我们的模型产生了若干新的启示，包括为近期COVID-19危机期间的高现金持有和资产出售加速提供了一种解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: 股利迎合行为：综述及研究展望 (Dividend Catering Behavior: A Review and Research Prospects)
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A systematic review of dividend catering theory from a behavioral finance perspective, organizing findings around determinants (investor preference heterogeneity, firm size, information asymmetry, share repurchases) and economic consequences (market reactions,…
pages.text: 股利迎合行为：综述及研究展望 (2024) Paper claim — A systematic review of dividend catering theory from a behavioral finance perspective, organizing findings around determinants (investor preference heterogeneity, firm size, information asymmetry, share repurchases) and economic consequences (market reactions, future earnings, firm value), and identifying future research directions. Raw markdown: luo-qi-2024-dividend-catering-review Bibliographic Record Authors: Luo Qi (罗琦); Shi Lei (石磊); Wu Xiyue (吴喜悦) Journal: 中南财经政法大学学报 (Journal of Zhongnan University of Economics and Law) Year: 2024 DOI: (not specified in available text) Institutions: Wuhan University; Central South University of Economics and Law Abstract 本文从行为金融学视角系统综述了股利迎合行为的主要研究成果和核心研究问题。梳理了投资者偏好异质性、公司规模和信息不对称对股利迎合行为的影响，以及回购政策和迎合行为确定的研究进展。从市场反应角度、未来公司收益及投资者对公司价值的影响等角度探讨了股利迎合行为对公司经营和利益相关者的经济后果。最后指出现有研究存在的不足，为将来研究者的后续研究提供了指导和启示。 English summary: This paper systematically reviews research on dividend catering behavior from a behavioral finance perspective. It organizes findings around: (1) determinants of catering — investor preference heterogeneity, firm size, information asymmetry, and share repurchases as a substitute; (2) economic consequences — market reactions to catering decisions, effects on future corporate earnings, and impacts on different investor groups including controlling vs. minority shareholders. The review identifies gaps and calls for future research on dynamic investor preference shifts, cross-country institutional comparisons, and AI/big data effects on preference identification. Key Findings Investor preference heterogeneity is the core driver of catering behavior; institutional and individual investors differ systematically in dividend demand, and firms adjust payout policy to match their dominant investor type. Larger firms face more external monitoring pressure, constraining their catering latitude; smaller firms exhibit stronger information asymmetry and thus greater managerial incentive and ability to cater to perceived investor preferences. Share repurchases serve as a flexible substitute for dividends in catering; managers choose between dividends and repurchases to maximize catering benefit, and repurchase timing and scale also reflect catering to investor preferences. Dividend initiations are associated with market premiums; cessation of dividends triggers significant stock price declines, confirming market sensitivity to catering-motivated payout changes. The effect of catering on future earnings is contested: maintaining high stock prices through catering can reduce financing costs and facilitate investment, but excessive short-term price focus may sacrifice long-term value creation. Catering that primarily serves controlling shareholders may harm outside investors; conversely, catering to minority shareholders can improve governance signals, stabilize stock prices, and protect investor rights. Future research priorities include: dynamic investor preference shifts and their effect on catering over market cycles; cross-institutional comparisons of catering mechanisms; AI/big data tools for real-time investor preference identification; and ESG-catering complementarity under sustainable development objectives. Linked Pages catering-theory-of-dividends dividend-clienteles overview

pages.title: Dynamic risk, accounting-based valuation and firm fundamentals
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study extends the accounting-based valuation framework of Ohlson (Contemp Acc Res 11(2):661-687, 1995) and Feltham and Ohlson (Acc Rev 74(2):165-183, 1999) to incorporate dynamic expectations about the level of systematic risk in the economy. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Dynamic risk, accounting-based valuation and firm fundamentals (2013) Paper claim — This study extends the accounting-based valuation framework of Ohlson (Contemp Acc Res 11(2):661-687, 1995) and Feltham and Ohlson (Acc Rev 74(2):165-183, 1999) to incorporate dynamic expectations about the level of systematic risk in the economy. Raw markdown: lyle-2013-dynamic-risk-accounting-based-valuation-and-firm-fundamentals Bibliographic Record Authors: Lyle, MR, Callen, JL, Elliott, RJ Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-013-9227-x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This study extends the accounting-based valuation framework of Ohlson (Contemp Acc Res 11(2):661-687, 1995) and Feltham and Ohlson (Acc Rev 74(2):165-183, 1999) to incorporate dynamic expectations about the level of systematic risk in the economy. Our model explains recent empirical findings documenting a strong negative association between changes in economy-wide risk and future stock returns. Importantly, the model also generates costs of capital that are solely a linear function of accounting variables and other firm fundamentals, including the book-to-market ratio, the earnings-to-price ratio, the forward earnings-to-price ratio, size and the dividend yield. This result provides a theoretical rationale for the inclusion of these popular variables in cost of capital (expected return) computations by the accounting and finance literatures and obviates the need to estimate costs of capital from unobservable (future) covariances. The model also generates an accounting return decomposition in the spirit of Vuolteenaho (J Finance 57(1):233-264, 2002). Empirically, we find that costs of capital generated by our model are significantly associated with future returns both in and out of sample in contrast to standard benchmark models. We further obtain significantly lower valuation errors in out-of-sample tests than traditional models that ignore dynamic risk expectations. 摘要（中文） 本研究将Ohlson（1995）以及Feltham和Ohlson（1999）的基于会计的估值框架加以扩展，纳入了关于经济中系统性风险水平的动态预期。我们的模型解释了近期记录经济范围内风险变化与未来股票收益之间存在强负相关的实证发现。重要的是，该模型还生成了完全为会计变量和其他企业基本面（包括账市比、盈利-价格比、前瞻盈利-价格比、规模和股利收益率）的线性函数的资本成本。这一结果为会计和金融文献将这些流行变量纳入资本成本（预期收益）计算提供了理论依据，并免除了从不可观测的（未来）协方差中估计资本成本的需要。该模型还生成了一种秉承Vuolteenaho（2002）精神的会计收益分解。实证上，我们发现，与标准基准模型形成对比的是，由我们模型生成的资本成本在样本内和样本外都与未来收益显著相关。我们还在样本外检验中获得了比忽略动态风险预期的传统模型显著更低的估值误差。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Intertemporal CAPM with Conditioning Variables
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper derives and tests an intertemporal capital asset pricing model (ICAPM) based on a conditional version of the Campbell-Vuolteenaho two-beta ICAPM (bad beta, good beta (BBGB)). Raw markdown: maio-2013-intertemporal-capm-with-conditioning-variables…
pages.text: Intertemporal CAPM with Conditioning Variables (2013) Paper claim — This paper derives and tests an intertemporal capital asset pricing model (ICAPM) based on a conditional version of the Campbell-Vuolteenaho two-beta ICAPM (bad beta, good beta (BBGB)). Raw markdown: maio-2013-intertemporal-capm-with-conditioning-variables Bibliographic Record Authors: Maio, P Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1120.1557 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper derives and tests an intertemporal capital asset pricing model (ICAPM) based on a conditional version of the Campbell-Vuolteenaho two-beta ICAPM (bad beta, good beta (BBGB)). The novel factor is a scaled cash-flow factor that results from the interaction between cash-flow news and a lagged state variable (market dividend yield or consumer price index inflation). The cross-sectional tests over 10 portfolios sorted on size, 10 portfolios sorted on book-to-market, and 10 portfolios sorted on momentum show that the scaled ICAPM explains relatively well the dispersion in excess returns on the 30 portfolios. The results for an alternative set of equity portfolios (25 portfolios sorted on size and momentum) show that the scaled ICAPM prices particularly well the momentum portfolios. Moreover, the scaled ICAPM compares favorably with alternative asset pricing models in pricing both sets of equity portfolios. The scaled factor is decisive to account for the dispersion in average excess returns between past winner and past loser stocks. More specifically, past winners are riskier than past losers in times of high price of risk. Therefore, a time-varying cash-flow beta/price of risk provides a rational explanation for momentum. 摘要（中文） 本文推导并检验了一个跨期资本资产定价模型（ICAPM），它基于Campbell-Vuolteenaho双贝塔ICAPM（坏贝塔、好贝塔，即BBGB）的一个条件版本。这个新颖的因子是一个经缩放的现金流因子，它源于现金流消息与一个滞后状态变量（市场股利收益率或消费者价格指数通胀率）之间的相互作用。在按规模排序的10个组合、按账面市值比排序的10个组合和按动量排序的10个组合上的横截面检验表明，缩放的ICAPM相对较好地解释了这30个组合超额收益的离散度。对另一组股权组合（按规模和动量排序的25个组合）的结果表明，缩放的ICAPM对动量组合定价特别好。此外，在对这两组股权组合定价方面，缩放的ICAPM相较于替代资产定价模型表现更优。这个缩放因子对于解释过去赢家和过去输家股票平均超额收益的离散度起到了决定性作用。更具体地说，在风险价格高企的时期，过去赢家比过去输家风险更大。因此，时变的现金流贝塔/风险价格为动量提供了一个理性的解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The 'Fed Model' and the Predictability of Stock Returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The focus of this article is on the predictive role of the stock-bond yield gap-the difference between the stock market earnings (dividend) yield and the 10-year Treasury bond yield-also known as the "Fed model". Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The "Fed Model" and the Predictability of Stock Returns (2013) Paper claim — The focus of this article is on the predictive role of the stock-bond yield gap-the difference between the stock market earnings (dividend) yield and the 10-year Treasury bond yield-also known as the "Fed model". Raw markdown: maio-2013-the-fed-model-and-the-predictability-of-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Maio, P Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfs025 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract The focus of this article is on the predictive role of the stock-bond yield gap-the difference between the stock market earnings (dividend) yield and the 10-year Treasury bond yield-also known as the "Fed model". The results show that the yield gap forecasts positive excess market returns, both at short and long forecasting horizons, and for both value- and equal-weighted stock indexes, and it also outperforms competing predictors commonly used in the literature. These findings go in line with the predictions from a present-value decomposition. The absence of predictive power for dividend growth, dividend payout ratios, earnings growth, and future one-period interest rates, actually strengthens the return predictability associated with the yield gap at very long horizons. By performing an out-of-sample analysis, the results show that the yield gap has reasonable out-of-sample predictability for the equity premium when the comparison is made against a simple historical average, especially when one imposes a restriction of positive equity premia. Furthermore, the yield gap proxies generally show greater out-of-sample forecasting power than the alternative state variables. An investment strategy based on the forecasting ability of the yield gap produces significant gains in Sharpe ratios. 摘要（中文） 本文的重点在于股债收益率缺口——即股市盈余（股利）收益率与10年期国债收益率之差，也称为"美联储模型"——的预测作用。结果表明，收益率缺口能够预测正的超额市场收益，无论在短期还是长期预测视界，也无论对市值加权还是等权重股票指数，且其表现优于文献中常用的竞争性预测变量。这些发现与现值分解的预测相一致。股利增长、股利支付率、盈余增长以及未来单期利率缺乏预测能力，实际上强化了收益率缺口在非常长视界下所关联的收益预测能力。通过进行样本外分析，结果表明，当与简单的历史平均值相比较时，收益率缺口对股权溢价具有合理的样本外预测能力，尤其是在施加正股权溢价约束时。此外，收益率缺口代理变量通常比其他状态变量表现出更强的样本外预测能力。基于收益率缺口预测能力的投资策略在夏普比率上产生了显著的收益。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend Yields, Dividend Growth, and Return Predictability in the Cross Section of Stocks
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — There is a generalized conviction that variation in dividend yields is exclusively related to expected returns and not to expected dividend growth, for example, Cochrane's (2011) presidential address. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Dividend Yields, Dividend Growth, and Return Predictability in the Cross Section of Stocks (2015) Paper claim — There is a generalized conviction that variation in dividend yields is exclusively related to expected returns and not to expected dividend growth, for example, Cochrane's (2011) presidential address. Raw markdown: maio-2015-dividend-yields-dividend-growth-and-return-predictability-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Maio, P, Santa-Clara, P Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109015000058 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract There is a generalized conviction that variation in dividend yields is exclusively related to expected returns and not to expected dividend growth, for example, Cochrane's (2011) presidential address. We show that this pattern, although valid for the aggregate stock market, is not true for portfolios of small and value stocks, where dividend yields are related mainly to future dividend changes. Thus, the variance decomposition associated with the aggregate dividend yield has important heterogeneity in the cross section of equities. Our results are robust to different forecasting horizons, econometric methodology (long-horizon regressions or first-order vector autoregression), and alternative decomposition based on excess returns. 摘要（中文） 存在一种普遍的信念，认为股利收益率的变动完全与预期收益相关，而与预期股利增长无关，例如Cochrane（2011）的主席演讲。我们表明，这种模式虽然对总体股票市场有效，但对小型股和价值股组合并不成立，在这些组合中股利收益率主要与未来股利变动相关。因此，与总体股利收益率相关的方差分解在股票横截面中存在重要的异质性。我们的结果对不同的预测视野、计量方法（长视野回归或一阶向量自回归）以及基于超额收益的替代分解都是稳健的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A Servant to Many Masters: Competing Shareholder Preferences and Limits to Catering
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study what determines catering through the payout policy and how catering affects firm value. Raw markdown: manconi-2013-a-servant-to-many-masters-competing-shareholder-preferences Bibliographic Record Authors: Manconi, A, Massa, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL…
pages.text: A Servant to Many Masters: Competing Shareholder Preferences and Limits to Catering (2013) Paper claim — We study what determines catering through the payout policy and how catering affects firm value. Raw markdown: manconi-2013-a-servant-to-many-masters-competing-shareholder-preferences Bibliographic Record Authors: Manconi, A, Massa, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109014000052 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(catering) Abstract We study what determines catering through the payout policy and how catering affects firm value. We create a catering index, measuring how the firm caters to its investors' payout preferences. The index is based on the revealed payout preferences of mutual funds holding the firm's stocks. Catering is constrained by market segmentation and dispersion in investor payout preferences. It is also associated with positive value effects: Firms increasing their catering index also experience an increase in value. Furthermore, greater catering ability is associated with a more positive market reaction to corporate announcements of equity issues and dividend payouts. 摘要（中文） 我们研究是什么决定了通过支付政策进行的迎合以及迎合如何影响企业价值。我们创建了一个迎合指数，度量企业如何迎合其投资者的支付偏好。该指数基于持有企业股票的共同基金所显示出的支付偏好。迎合受到市场分割和投资者支付偏好离散程度的约束。它还与正向的价值效应相关联：提高其迎合指数的企业也会经历价值提升。此外，更强的迎合能力与市场对企业股权发行和股利支付公告更为正面的反应相关联。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Broker incentives and timing manipulation in mutual fund flows
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines how financial intermediaries, particularly brokers, influence the timing of retail investor flows into mutual funds at the turn of the calendar year. Raw markdown: mangipudi-2026-broker-incentives-and-timing-manipulation-in-mutual-fund…
pages.text: Broker incentives and timing manipulation in mutual fund flows (2026) Paper claim — This paper examines how financial intermediaries, particularly brokers, influence the timing of retail investor flows into mutual funds at the turn of the calendar year. Raw markdown: mangipudi-2026-broker-incentives-and-timing-manipulation-in-mutual-fund Bibliographic Record Authors: Mangipudi, CS, Wang, C Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2026 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2026.107744 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(distribution, dividend)；影响机制(agency, alternative) Abstract This paper examines how financial intermediaries, particularly brokers, influence the timing of retail investor flows into mutual funds at the turn of the calendar year. Using mutual fund purchase (inflows) and redemption (outflows) data, we document a systematic shift in inflows from January to December in broker-sold funds, consistent with brokers accelerating purchases to meet year-end sales quotas under non-linear compensation structures. This timing distortion is absent in direct-sold funds and weakens following the implementation of Regulation Best Interest, which reduces brokers' incentives to manipulate investment timing. Our findings are robust to alternative explanations based on capital gains or dividend distributions, fund marketing efforts, or investor behaviors such as year-end liquidity planning and procrastination. These findings extend theories of sales-driven behavior to financial intermediation and highlight a new dimension of agency conflict. 摘要（中文） 本文考察金融中介、尤其是经纪商，如何在日历年之交影响散户投资者流入共同基金的时机。使用共同基金申购（流入）和赎回（流出）数据，我们记录到经纪商销售基金的流入从1月到12月出现系统性转移，这与经纪商在非线性薪酬结构下为达成年终销售配额而加速申购相一致。这种时机扭曲在直销基金中不存在，并在实施《最佳利益监管条例》（Regulation Best Interest）之后减弱，该条例降低了经纪商操纵投资时机的动机。我们的发现对基于资本利得或股利分配、基金营销努力，或诸如年终流动性规划和拖延等投资者行为的替代解释都稳健。这些发现将销售驱动行为的理论拓展到金融中介领域，并凸显了代理冲突的一个新维度。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Income Insurance and the Equilibrium Term Structure of Equity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Output, wages, and dividends feature term structures of variance ratios that are respectively flat, increasing, and decreasing. Raw markdown: marf-2017-income-insurance-and-the-equilibrium-term-structure-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Marfè, R Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Income Insurance and the Equilibrium Term Structure of Equity (2017) Paper claim — Output, wages, and dividends feature term structures of variance ratios that are respectively flat, increasing, and decreasing. Raw markdown: marf-2017-income-insurance-and-the-equilibrium-term-structure-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Marfè, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12508 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Output, wages, and dividends feature term structures of variance ratios that are respectively flat, increasing, and decreasing. Income insurance from shareholders to workers explains these term structures. Risk-sharing smooths wages but only concerns transitory risk and hence enhances short-run dividend risk. As a result, actual labor-share variation largely forecasts the risk, premium, and slope of dividend strips. A simple general equilibrium model in which labor rigidity affects dividend dynamics and the price of short-run risk reconciles standard asset pricing facts with the term structures of the equity premium, volatility, and macroeconomic variables, which are at odds in leading models. 摘要（中文） 产出、工资和股利呈现出不同的方差比率期限结构，分别为平坦、递增和递减。从股东向工人提供的收入保险解释了这些期限结构。风险分担平滑了工资，但只涉及暂时性风险，因而加剧了短期股利风险。因此，实际的劳动份额变动在很大程度上能够预测股利分档的风险、溢价和斜率。一个简单的一般均衡模型——其中劳动刚性影响股利动态和短期风险的价格——将标准资产定价事实与股权溢价、波动率及宏观经济变量的期限结构相调和，而这些在主流模型中是相互矛盾的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Supervisory stringency, payout restrictions, and bank equity prices
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — I study investor responses to the 2020 bank stress tests that included restrictions on shareholder payouts. Raw markdown: marsh-2023-supervisory-stringency-payout-restrictions-and-bank-equity-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Marsh, WB Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Supervisory stringency, payout restrictions, and bank equity prices (2023) Paper claim — I study investor responses to the 2020 bank stress tests that included restrictions on shareholder payouts. Raw markdown: marsh-2023-supervisory-stringency-payout-restrictions-and-bank-equity-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Marsh, WB Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2023.106936 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat, supervis)；股利政策(payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract I study investor responses to the 2020 bank stress tests that included restrictions on shareholder payouts. I find that banks subject to the stress tests and payout restrictions experienced both immediate and persistently lower excess stock price returns. In the cross-section, I find that excess stock returns declined with bank size but cannot otherwise be explained by pre-pandemic bank or payout characteristics, suggesting that investors penalized banks likely to experience greater regulatory scrutiny. However, the excess stock return penalties are smaller than those previously estimated in the literature examining voluntary payout reductions that signal bank distress. The results show that using supervisory discretion to take preventative actions in a crisis can be less costly than actions taken once banks are distressed. 摘要（中文） 我研究了投资者对2020年银行压力测试的反应，该测试包含对股东支付的限制。我发现，接受压力测试和支付限制的银行经历了既即时又持续的更低超额股价收益。在横截面上，我发现超额股票收益随银行规模的增大而下降，但除此之外无法用疫情前的银行或支付特征来解释，这表明投资者惩罚了那些可能经历更严格监管审查的银行。然而，这些超额股票收益的惩罚小于此前文献中考察自愿削减支付（作为银行困境信号）所估计的水平。结果表明，在危机中运用监管自由裁量权采取预防性行动，可能比在银行陷入困境后采取行动的代价更小。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: No-Arbitrage pricing of GDP-Linked bonds
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a novel term-structure model for pricing GDP-linked bonds, hypothetical securities with cash flows indexed to the level of U.S. Raw markdown: martin-2021-no-arbitrage-pricing-of-gdp-linked-bonds Bibliographic Record Authors: Martin, FE, Meldrum, A, Yan,…
pages.text: No-Arbitrage pricing of GDP-Linked bonds (2021) Paper claim — We develop a novel term-structure model for pricing GDP-linked bonds, hypothetical securities with cash flows indexed to the level of U.S. Raw markdown: martin-2021-no-arbitrage-pricing-of-gdp-linked-bonds Bibliographic Record Authors: Martin, FE, Meldrum, A, Yan, W Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2021.106075 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We develop a novel term-structure model for pricing GDP-linked bonds, hypothetical securities with cash flows indexed to the level of U.S. GDP. For this purpose, we rely on a term-structure model of equity yields estimated using the prices of dividend swaps, which we assume span GDP growth. Our approach provides a novel way of estimating the relative cost of conventional and GDP-linked bonds, as well as measuring more general market-based expectations of (and risks around) GDP growth. Our model predicts that U.S. GDP-linked bonds would typically have yields lower than those on conventional Treasury bonds with the same maturity in our sample from 2010 to 2017. Positive expected future GDP growth lowers the yield on GDP-linked bonds relative to conventional bonds, which typically more than offsets the estimated GDP risk premium demanded by investors for holding GDP risk. (c) 2021 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们构建了一个新颖的期限结构模型，用于为GDP挂钩债券定价——这是一种假设性证券，其现金流与美国GDP水平挂钩。为此，我们依赖一个利用股利互换价格估计的股票收益率期限结构模型，并假设该模型能够跨度GDP增长。我们的方法为估计常规债券与GDP挂钩债券的相对成本，以及测度更一般的、基于市场的GDP增长预期（及其相关风险）提供了新颖的途径。在我们2010至2017年的样本中，我们的模型预测，美国GDP挂钩债券的收益率通常低于同期限常规国债的收益率。预期未来GDP正增长会压低GDP挂钩债券相对于常规债券的收益率，这通常足以抵消并超过投资者因持有GDP风险而要求的、估计出的GDP风险溢价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Are Algorithmic Decisions Legitimate? The Effect of Process and Outcomes on Perceptions of Legitimacy of AI Decisions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms use algorithms to make important business decisions. Raw markdown: martin-2023-are-algorithmic-decisions-legitimate-the-effect-of-process Bibliographic Record Authors: Martin, K, Waldman, A Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2023 DOI:…
pages.text: Are Algorithmic Decisions Legitimate? The Effect of Process and Outcomes on Perceptions of Legitimacy of AI Decisions (2023) Paper claim — Firms use algorithms to make important business decisions. Raw markdown: martin-2023-are-algorithmic-decisions-legitimate-the-effect-of-process Bibliographic Record Authors: Martin, K, Waldman, A Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-021-05032-7 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Firms use algorithms to make important business decisions. To date, the algorithmic accountability literature has elided a fundamentally empirical question important to business ethics and management: Under what circumstances, if any, are algorithmic decision-making systems considered legitimate? The present study begins to answer this question. Using factorial vignette survey methodology, we explore the impact of decision importance, governance, outcomes, and data inputs on perceptions of the legitimacy of algorithmic decisions made by firms. We find that many of the procedural governance mechanisms in practice today, such as notices and impact statements, do not lead to algorithmic decisions being perceived as more legitimate in general, and, consistent with legitimacy theory, that algorithmic decisions with good outcomes are perceived as more legitimate than bad outcomes. Yet, robust governance, such as offering an appeal process, can create a legitimacy dividend for decisions with bad outcomes. However, when arbitrary or morally dubious factors are used to make decisions, most legitimacy dividends are erased. In other words, companies cannot overcome the legitimacy penalty of using arbitrary or morally dubious factors, such as race or the day of the week, with a good outcome or an appeal process for individuals. These findings add new perspectives to both the literature on legitimacy and policy discussions on algorithmic decision-making in firms. 摘要（中文） 企业使用算法来做出重要的商业决策。迄今为止，算法问责文献回避了一个对商业伦理和管理都很重要的根本性经验问题：在何种情况下（如果有的话）算法决策系统被认为是合法的？本研究开始回答这一问题。使用因子情景调查方法（factorial vignette survey methodology），我们探究决策重要性、治理、结果和数据输入对企业所做算法决策合法性感知的影响。我们发现，当今实践中许多程序性治理机制（如告知和影响声明）总体上并不会使算法决策被感知为更合法，并且与合法性理论一致，结果良好的算法决策比结果糟糕的决策被感知为更合法。然而，稳健的治理（如提供申诉程序）可以为结果糟糕的决策创造合法性红利（legitimacy dividend）。但是，当使用任意或道德上可疑的因素来做决策时，大多数合法性红利都会被抹去。换言之，企业无法通过良好的结果或为个人提供申诉程序来克服使用任意或道德上可疑因素（如种族或星期几）所带来的合法性惩罚。这些发现为合法性文献以及关于企业算法决策的政策讨论增添了新的视角。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Mandatory dividend rules: Do they make it harder for firms to invest?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — What are the costs and benefits of mandatory dividend rules? On the one hand, they make it harder for controlling shareholders to divert corporate assets. Raw markdown: martins-2012-mandatory-dividend-rules-do-they-make-it-harder Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Mandatory dividend rules: Do they make it harder for firms to invest? (2012) Paper claim — What are the costs and benefits of mandatory dividend rules? On the one hand, they make it harder for controlling shareholders to divert corporate assets. Raw markdown: martins-2012-mandatory-dividend-rules-do-they-make-it-harder Bibliographic Record Authors: Martins, TC, Novaes, W Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2012.05.002 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract What are the costs and benefits of mandatory dividend rules? On the one hand, they make it harder for controlling shareholders to divert corporate assets. On the other hand, they reduce the internal funds available for firms to invest, possibly leading to the loss of valuable projects. To assess this trade-off, we look at investment and dividend decisions in a sample of public firms in Brazil. We show that a significant fraction of these firms use loopholes of Brazil's mandatory dividend rules to avoid paying dividends. And yet, the dividend rules are effective. They help explain why the average dividend yield in Brazil is higher than in the U.S., without making it harder for firms to invest. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 强制股利规则的成本和收益是什么？一方面，它们使控股股东更难挪用公司资产。另一方面，它们减少了公司可用于投资的内部资金，可能导致有价值项目的损失。为评估这一权衡，我们考察巴西上市公司样本中的投资和股利决策。我们表明，其中相当一部分公司利用巴西强制股利规则的漏洞来规避支付股利。然而，股利规则是有效的。它们有助于解释为何巴西的平均股利收益率高于美国，同时又不会使公司更难进行投资。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Agency Problems of Corporate Philanthropy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Evaluating agency theory and optimal contracting theory views of corporate philanthropy, we find that as corporate giving increases, shareholders reduce their valuation of firm cash holdings. Raw markdown: masulis-2015-agency-problems-of-corporate-philanthropy…
pages.text: Agency Problems of Corporate Philanthropy (2015) Paper claim — Evaluating agency theory and optimal contracting theory views of corporate philanthropy, we find that as corporate giving increases, shareholders reduce their valuation of firm cash holdings. Raw markdown: masulis-2015-agency-problems-of-corporate-philanthropy Bibliographic Record Authors: Masulis, RW, Reza, SW Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhu082 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, reform)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Evaluating agency theory and optimal contracting theory views of corporate philanthropy, we find that as corporate giving increases, shareholders reduce their valuation of firm cash holdings. Dividend increases following the 2003 Tax Reform Act are associated with reduced corporate giving. Using a natural experiment, we find that corporate giving is positively (negatively) associated with CEO charity preferences (CEO shareholdings and corporate governance quality). Evidence from CEO-affiliated charity donations, market reactions to insider-affiliated donations, its relation to CEO compensation, and firm contributions to director-affiliated charities indicates that corporate donations advance CEO interests and suggests misuses of corporate resources that reduce firm value. 摘要（中文） 在评估公司慈善的代理理论观点和最优契约理论观点时，我们发现，随着公司捐赠的增加，股东会下调其对企业现金持有的估值。2003年《税收改革法案》后的股利增加与公司捐赠的减少相关联。利用一个自然实验，我们发现公司捐赠与CEO慈善偏好正相关（与CEO持股和公司治理质量负相关）。来自CEO关联慈善捐赠、市场对内部人关联捐赠的反应、其与CEO薪酬的关系以及企业对董事关联慈善机构的捐款的证据表明，公司捐赠推进了CEO的利益，并暗示了对公司资源的滥用，从而降低了企业价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The wealth effects of repurchases on bondholders
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Prior research has documented positive abnormal stock returns around the announcements of repurchase programs; several explanations of these returns have been suggested, including signaling, free cash flow, and wealth redistributions. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The wealth effects of repurchases on bondholders (2003) Paper claim — Prior research has documented positive abnormal stock returns around the announcements of repurchase programs; several explanations of these returns have been suggested, including signaling, free cash flow, and wealth redistributions. Raw markdown: maxwell-2003-the-wealth-effects-of-repurchases-on-bondholders Bibliographic Record Authors: Maxwell, WF, Stephens, CP Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1111/1540-6261.00550 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract Prior research has documented positive abnormal stock returns around the announcements of repurchase programs; several explanations of these returns have been suggested, including signaling, free cash flow, and wealth redistributions. This study analyzes abnormal stock, bond, and firm returns,around repurchase announcements to examine these hypotheses. We find evidence consistent with both signaling and wealth redistribution. The loss to bondholders is a function of the size of the repurchase, and the risk of the firm's debt. We also find that bond ratings are twice as likely to be downgraded as upgraded after the announcement of the repurchase program. 摘要（中文） 先前的研究记录了在回购计划公告前后股票出现正向异常收益；对这些收益已提出若干解释，包括信号传递、自由现金流以及财富再分配。本研究分析了回购公告前后股票、债券及企业整体的异常收益，以检验这些假说。我们发现的证据同时支持信号传递与财富再分配。债券持有人的损失是回购规模及企业债务风险的函数。我们还发现，在回购计划公告后，债券评级被下调的可能性是被上调的两倍。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of dividend imputation on corporate tax avoidance: The case of shareholder value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The objective of this paper is to evaluate whether dividend imputation, whereby tax credits may be passed on to shareholders for corporate tax paid, impacts corporate tax avoidance. Raw markdown: mcclure-2018-the-impact-of-dividend-imputation-on-corporate-tax…
pages.text: The impact of dividend imputation on corporate tax avoidance: The case of shareholder value (2018) Paper claim — The objective of this paper is to evaluate whether dividend imputation, whereby tax credits may be passed on to shareholders for corporate tax paid, impacts corporate tax avoidance. Raw markdown: mcclure-2018-the-impact-of-dividend-imputation-on-corporate-tax Bibliographic Record Authors: McClure, R, Lanis, R, Wells, P, Govendir, B Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.10.007 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract The objective of this paper is to evaluate whether dividend imputation, whereby tax credits may be passed on to shareholders for corporate tax paid, impacts corporate tax avoidance. This is undertaken with a pooled cross-sectional research design evaluating differences in tax avoidance across firms where there are significant differences in corporate tax avoidance incentives. Specifically, potential differences arise between firms paying dividends with tax credits, paying dividends without tax credits, and not paying dividends. Results suggest that firms paying dividends with tax credits attached are less likely to engage in tax avoidance with an average cash effective tax rate up to 16.9 percentage points higher than firms that pay dividends without tax credits, and up to 14.7 percentage points higher than firms that do not pay dividends at all. Accordingly, this provides insights into the effectiveness of dividend imputation in mitigating corporate tax avoidance, as well as providing support for the continuance of dividend imputation in Australia. Additionally, a positive association is found to exist between outside directors and corporate tax avoidance, extending to firms paying dividends with tax credits where dividend imputation is expected to mitigate such a relation. In combination, these results suggest heterogeneity of costs and benefits of tax avoidance and this is a challenge in evaluating corporate tax aggressiveness generally, and the impact of corporate governance on corporate tax avoidance in particular. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文的目的是评估股利抵免制度（据此可将企业已缴纳的公司税以税收抵免形式传递给股东）是否会影响企业避税。这一研究采用混合横截面研究设计，评估在企业避税激励存在显著差异的公司之间避税行为的差异。具体而言，潜在差异存在于以下三类公司之间：支付附带税收抵免股利的公司、支付不附带税收抵免股利的公司，以及不支付股利的公司。结果表明，支付附带税收抵免股利的公司更不太可能从事避税，其平均现金实际税率比支付不附带税收抵免股利的公司最多高出16.9个百分点，比完全不支付股利的公司最多高出14.7个百分点。据此，这为股利抵免制度在抑制企业避税方面的有效性提供了洞见，同时也为澳大利亚继续实施股利抵免制度提供了支持。此外，研究发现外部董事与企业避税之间存在正相关关系，这种关系延伸至那些支付附带税收抵免股利的公司，而股利抵免制度本应缓解此种关系。综合来看，这些结果表明避税的成本与收益具有异质性，这对于总体上评估企业税收激进程度，尤其是评估公司治理对企业避税的影响，构成了一项挑战。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Cross-border investing with tax arbitrage: The case of German dividend tax credits
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — German dividends typically carry a tax credit which makes the dividend worth 42.86% more to a taxable German shareholder than to a tax-exempt or foreign shareholder. Raw markdown: mcdonald-2001-cross-border-investing-with-tax-arbitrage-the-case Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Cross-border investing with tax arbitrage: The case of German dividend tax credits (2001) Paper claim — German dividends typically carry a tax credit which makes the dividend worth 42.86% more to a taxable German shareholder than to a tax-exempt or foreign shareholder. Raw markdown: mcdonald-2001-cross-border-investing-with-tax-arbitrage-the-case Bibliographic Record Authors: McDonald, RL Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/14.3.617 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract German dividends typically carry a tax credit which makes the dividend worth 42.86% more to a taxable German shareholder than to a tax-exempt or foreign shareholder. This results in a penalty for foreign investors who buy and hold German dividend-paying stocks. I document that, as a result of the credit, the ex-day drop exceeds the dividend by more than one-half of the tax credit, and show that futures and option prices embed more than one-half of the tax credit. The existence of the credit creates opportunities for cross-border tax arbitrage-in which foreign holders of German stock transfer the dividend to German shareholders-and implies that it is tax efficient for foreign investors to hold derivatives rather than investing directly in German stocks. The empirical findings are consistent with costly tax arbitrage activity by German investors, who face tax risk due to antiarbitrage rules. Since dividend tax credits exist in many other countries, the findings are potentially of broad interest. 摘要（中文） 德国股利通常带有一项税收抵免，使得该股利对一位应纳税的德国股东而言，比对一位免税或外国股东价值高出42.86%。这给买入并持有德国派息股票的外国投资者带来了惩罚。我记录到，由于该抵免，除息日的价格下跌超过股利额，其超出部分超过税收抵免的一半，并表明期货和期权价格中嵌入了超过一半的税收抵免。该抵免的存在创造了跨境税收套利的机会——外国持有德国股票者将股利转让给德国股东——并意味着对外国投资者而言，持有衍生品比直接投资德国股票更具税收效率。实证发现与德国投资者代价高昂的税收套利活动相一致，这些投资者因反套利规则而面临税收风险。由于许多其他国家也存在股利税收抵免，这些发现可能具有广泛的意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How fidelity invests in service professionals
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — If you're in the business of service delivery, investment in the training and development of your staff is one of the keys to your company's success. Raw markdown: mcgolgan-1997-how-fidelity-invests-in-service-professionals Bibliographic Record Authors: McGolgan,…
pages.text: How fidelity invests in service professionals (1997) Paper claim — If you're in the business of service delivery, investment in the training and development of your staff is one of the keys to your company's success. Raw markdown: mcgolgan-1997-how-fidelity-invests-in-service-professionals Bibliographic Record Authors: McGolgan, EA Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 1997 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract If you're in the business of service delivery, investment in the training and development of your staff is one of the keys to your company's success. But what's the best way to design and implement your investment? In 1994, Fidelity Institutional Retirement Services Company (FIRSCo) needed to ensure that its rapidly expanding staff maintained the company's high levels of customer satisfaction. The solution, according to Ellyn McColgan, formerly an executive vice president of FIRSCo and now the president of Fidelity Investments Tax-Exempt Services Company, was to reach out to its service associates with a powerful new model for training and development called Service Delivery University. SDU is a virtual university with a content-based core curriculum and five colleges that focus on business concepts and skills. It is driven by three principles. First, all training must be directly aligned with the company's strategic and financial objectives and focused on customer needs. Second, service delivery is a profession and should be taught as such. And finally, professional development should be the primacy responsibility of line managers rather than the human resources department. McColgan explains how FIRSCo overcame resistance to this sweeping change in employee education. (Time was one obstacle: each associate receives 80 hours of training per year.) In addition, the author discusses the fine art of measuring the success of a program like SDU. She finds that the company's investment has paid dividends to the staff, to the organization as a whole, and to FIRSCo's customers. 摘要（中文） 如果你从事服务交付行业，对员工培训与发展的投资是公司成功的关键之一。但设计和实施这种投资的最佳方式是什么呢？1994年，富达机构退休服务公司（FIRSCo）需要确保其迅速扩张的员工队伍保持公司高水平的客户满意度。据Ellyn McColgan（曾任FIRSCo执行副总裁，现任富达投资免税服务公司总裁）所言，解决方案是通过一种名为"服务交付大学"的强大新型培训与发展模式来触及其服务人员。SDU是一所虚拟大学，拥有以内容为基础的核心课程和五个专注于商业概念与技能的学院。它由三条原则驱动。第一，所有培训必须与公司的战略和财务目标直接对齐，并聚焦于客户需求。第二，服务交付是一门专业，应作为专业来教授。最后，专业发展应主要是一线经理而非人力资源部门的责任。McColgan解释了FIRSCo如何克服对这一员工教育重大变革的抵触。（时间是障碍之一：每位员工每年接受80小时培训。）此外，作者讨论了衡量像SDU这样的项目成败的精妙艺术。她发现，公司的这项投资已经向员工、向整个组织以及向FIRSCo的客户带来了回报。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Investigating the cost performance of UK credit unions using radial and non-radial efficiency measures
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the relative efficiency of UK credit unions. Raw markdown: mckillop-2002-investigating-the-cost-performance-of-uk-credit-unions Bibliographic Record Authors: McKillop, DG, Glass, JC, Ferguson, C Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2002…
pages.text: Investigating the cost performance of UK credit unions using radial and non-radial efficiency measures (2002) Paper claim — This paper examines the relative efficiency of UK credit unions. Raw markdown: mckillop-2002-investigating-the-cost-performance-of-uk-credit-unions Bibliographic Record Authors: McKillop, DG, Glass, JC, Ferguson, C Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(01)00164-9 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines the relative efficiency of UK credit unions. Radial and non-radial measures of input cost efficiency plus associated scale efficiency measures are computed for a selection of input output specifications. Both measures highlighted that UK credit unions have considerable scope for efficiency gains. It was mooted that the documented high levels of inefficiency may be indicative of the fact that credit unions, based on clearly defined and non-overlapping common bonds, are not in competition with each other for market share. Credit unions were also highlighted as suffering from a considerable degree of scale inefficiency with the majority of scale inefficient credit unions subject to decreasing returns to scale. The latter aspect highlights that the UK Government's goal of larger credit unions must be accompanied by greater regulatory freedom if inefficiency is to be avoided. One of the advantages of computing non-radial measures is that an insight into potential over- or under-expenditure on specific inputs can be obtained through a comparison of the non-radial measure of efficiency with the associated radial measure. Two interesting findings emerged, the first that UK credit unions over-spend on dividend payments and the second that they under-spend on labour costs. (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了英国信用合作社的相对效率。针对若干投入产出规格，计算了投入成本效率的径向和非径向度量以及相关的规模效率度量。两种度量都凸显出，英国信用合作社在效率提升方面有相当大的空间。有人提出，所记录的高水平低效率可能表明，基于清晰界定且互不重叠的共同纽带的信用合作社彼此之间并不为市场份额而竞争。研究还凸显出信用合作社遭受相当程度的规模低效率，大多数规模低效率的信用合作社处于规模报酬递减状态。后一方面凸显出，英国政府关于扩大信用合作社规模的目标，若要避免低效率，就必须伴随更大的监管自由。计算非径向度量的优势之一是，通过将非径向效率度量与相关的径向度量进行比较，可以洞察在特定投入上可能存在的超支或不足支出。出现了两个有趣的发现，其一是英国信用合作社在股利支付上超支，其二是它们在劳动成本上支出不足。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE FINANCIAL AND OPERATING PERFORMANCE OF NEWLY PRIVATIZED FIRMS - AN INTERNATIONAL EMPIRICAL-ANALYSIS
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study compares the pre- and postprivatization financial and operating performance of 61 companies from 18 countries and 32 industries that experience full or partial privatization through public share offerings during the period 1961 to 1990. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: THE FINANCIAL AND OPERATING PERFORMANCE OF NEWLY PRIVATIZED FIRMS - AN INTERNATIONAL EMPIRICAL-ANALYSIS (1994) Paper claim — This study compares the pre- and postprivatization financial and operating performance of 61 companies from 18 countries and 32 industries that experience full or partial privatization through public share offerings during the period 1961 to 1990. Raw markdown: megginson-1994-the-financial-and-operating-performance-of-newly-privatized Bibliographic Record Authors: MEGGINSON, WL, NASH, RC, VANRANDENBORGH, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.1994.tb05147.x Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This study compares the pre- and postprivatization financial and operating performance of 61 companies from 18 countries and 32 industries that experience full or partial privatization through public share offerings during the period 1961 to 1990. Our results document strong performance improvements, achieved surprisingly without sacrificing employment security. Specifically, after being privatized, firms increase real sales, become more profitable, increase their capital investment spending, improve their operating efficiency, and increase their work forces. Furthermore, these companies significantly lower their debt levels and increase dividend payout. Finally, we document significant changes in the size and composition of corporate boards of directors after privatization. 摘要（中文） 本研究比较了61家公司私有化前后的财务与经营绩效，这些公司来自18个国家、32个行业，在1961年至1990年期间通过公开发售股份实现全部或部分私有化。我们的结果记录了强劲的绩效改善，而且出人意料地在不牺牲就业保障的情况下实现。具体而言，被私有化后，公司增加了实际销售额，盈利能力增强，增加了资本投资支出，改善了经营效率，并扩充了劳动力。此外，这些公司显著降低了负债水平并提高了股利支付。最后，我们记录了私有化后公司董事会规模和构成的显著变化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Subordinate executives? horizon and firm policies (2022) Paper claim — Motivated by the internal governance theory, we investigate the links between subordinate executives' horizon and firm policies. Raw markdown: mekhaimer-2022-subordinate-executives-horizon-and-firm-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Mekhaimer, M, Abakah, AA, Ibrahim, A, Hussainey, K Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102220 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Motivated by the internal governance theory, we investigate the links between subordinate executives' horizon and firm policies. Using the number of years to retirement to capture subordinate executives' horizon inside the firm, we find that subordinates' horizon is positively associated with firm's risk-taking, long-term investments growth, and research and development productivity, but negatively related to the dividend decision and the payout ratio. We also find a positive relationship between subordinates' horizon and firm value. Our results are robust to controlling for alternative explanations including the pay gap between CEO and subordinate executives, executives' overconfidence, CEO's decision horizon, and other governance mechanisms. The results are also robust to alternative measures of subordinates' horizon, and after addressing potential endogeneity concerns. 摘要（中文） 受内部治理理论的启发，我们考察下属高管的任职期限（horizon）与公司政策之间的联系。使用距退休的年数来捕捉下属高管在企业内部的任职期限，我们发现下属的任职期限与企业的冒险、长期投资增长以及研发生产率正相关，但与股利决策和派现比率负相关。我们还发现下属任职期限与企业价值之间存在正相关关系。在控制包括CEO与下属高管之间的薪酬差距、高管过度自信、CEO决策期限以及其他治理机制在内的替代解释后，我们的结果依然稳健。在使用下属任职期限的替代度量以及处理潜在内生性问题之后，结果也依然稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Asymmetric stock market volatility and the cyclical behavior of expected returns
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Recent explanations of aggregate stock market fluctuations suggest that countercyclical stock market volatility is consistent with rational asset evaluations. Raw markdown: mele-2007-asymmetric-stock-market-volatility-and-the-cyclical-behavior Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Asymmetric stock market volatility and the cyclical behavior of expected returns (2007) Paper claim — Recent explanations of aggregate stock market fluctuations suggest that countercyclical stock market volatility is consistent with rational asset evaluations. Raw markdown: mele-2007-asymmetric-stock-market-volatility-and-the-cyclical-behavior Bibliographic Record Authors: Mele, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2006.10.002 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Recent explanations of aggregate stock market fluctuations suggest that countercyclical stock market volatility is consistent with rational asset evaluations. In this paper, I develop a framework to study the causes of countercyclical stock market volatility. I find that countercyclical risk premia do not imply countercyclical return volatility. Instead, countercyclical stock volatility occurs if risk premia increase more in bad times than they decrease in good times, thereby inducing price-dividend ratios to fluctuate more in bad times than in good. The business cycle asymmetry in the investors' attitude toward discounting future cash flows plays a novel and critical role in many rational explanations of asset price fluctuations. (c) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 近期对总体股票市场波动的解释表明，逆周期的股票市场波动率与理性的资产评估相一致。在本文中，我建立了一个框架来研究逆周期股票市场波动率的成因。我发现逆周期的风险溢价并不意味着逆周期的收益波动率。相反，逆周期的股票波动率发生的条件是：风险溢价在坏时期上升的幅度大于其在好时期下降的幅度，从而促使价格-股利比在坏时期比在好时期波动更大。投资者对贴现未来现金流态度的经济周期不对称性，在许多对资产价格波动的理性解释中发挥了新颖而关键的作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Understanding predictability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a general equilibrium model with multiple securities in which investors' risk preferences and expectations of dividend growth are time-varying. Raw markdown: menzly-2004-understanding-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Menzly, L, Santos, T,…
pages.text: Understanding predictability (2004) Paper claim — We propose a general equilibrium model with multiple securities in which investors' risk preferences and expectations of dividend growth are time-varying. Raw markdown: menzly-2004-understanding-predictability Bibliographic Record Authors: Menzly, L, Santos, T, Veronesi, P Journal: JOURNAL OF POLITICAL ECONOMY Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1086/379934 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We propose a general equilibrium model with multiple securities in which investors' risk preferences and expectations of dividend growth are time-varying. While time-varying risk preferences induce the standard positive relation between the dividend yield and expected returns, time-varying expected dividend growth induces a negative relation between them. These offsetting effects reduce the ability of the dividend yield to forecast returns and eliminate its ability to forecast dividend growth, as observed in the data. The model links the predictability of returns to that of dividend growth, suggesting specific changes to standard linear predictive regressions for both. The model's predictions are confirmed empirically. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一个包含多种证券的一般均衡模型，其中投资者的风险偏好和对股利增长的预期都是时变的。时变的风险偏好诱发了股利收益率与预期收益之间标准的正相关关系，而时变的预期股利增长则诱发了两者之间的负相关关系。这些相互抵消的效应降低了股利收益率预测收益的能力，并消除了其预测股利增长的能力，正如数据中所观测到的。该模型将收益的可预测性与股利增长的可预测性联系起来，为两者的标准线性预测回归提出了具体的修改建议。该模型的预测得到了实证证实。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: ROBUST CONTRACTS IN CONTINUOUS TIME
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study a continuous-time contracting problem under hidden action, where the principal has ambiguous beliefs about the project cash flows. Raw markdown: miao-2016-robust-contracts-in-continuous-time Bibliographic Record Authors: Miao, JJ, Rivera, A Journal:…
pages.text: ROBUST CONTRACTS IN CONTINUOUS TIME (2016) Paper claim — We study a continuous-time contracting problem under hidden action, where the principal has ambiguous beliefs about the project cash flows. Raw markdown: miao-2016-robust-contracts-in-continuous-time Bibliographic Record Authors: Miao, JJ, Rivera, A Journal: ECONOMETRICA Year: 2016 DOI: 10.3982/ECTA13127 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, tradeoff) Abstract We study a continuous-time contracting problem under hidden action, where the principal has ambiguous beliefs about the project cash flows. The principal designs a robust contract that maximizes his utility under the worst-case scenario subject to the agent's incentive and participation constraints. Robustness generates endogenous belief heterogeneity and induces a tradeoff between incentives and ambiguity sharing so that the incentive constraint does not always bind. We implement the optimal contract by cash reserves, debt, and equity. In addition to receiving ordinary dividends when cash reserves reach a threshold, outside equity holders also receive special dividends or inject cash in the cash reserves to hedge against model uncertainty and smooth dividends. The equity premium and the credit yield spread generated by ambiguity aversion are state dependent and high for distressed firms with low cash reserves. 摘要（中文） 我们研究一个隐藏行动下的连续时间合约问题，其中委托人对项目现金流持有模糊（ambiguous）信念。委托人设计一份稳健合约，在最坏情形下、且满足代理人激励约束和参与约束的前提下，使其效用最大化。稳健性内生地产生了信念异质性，并诱发了激励与模糊分担之间的权衡，从而使激励约束并不总是紧约束。我们通过现金储备、债务和股权来实现最优合约。除了在现金储备达到某一阈值时获得普通股利外，外部股权持有人还会获得特别股利，或向现金储备注入现金，以对冲模型不确定性并平滑股利。由模糊厌恶所产生的股权溢价和信用收益率利差是依状态而定的，对于现金储备较低的陷入困境的公司而言更高。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE PRICING OF INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERINGS - TESTS OF ADVERSE-SELECTION AND SIGNALING THEORIES
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We test the empirical implications of several models of IPO underpricing. Raw markdown: michaely-1994-the-pricing-of-initial-public-offerings-tests-of Bibliographic Record Authors: MICHAELY, R, SHAW, WH Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1994 DOI:…
pages.text: THE PRICING OF INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERINGS - TESTS OF ADVERSE-SELECTION AND SIGNALING THEORIES (1994) Paper claim — We test the empirical implications of several models of IPO underpricing. Raw markdown: michaely-1994-the-pricing-of-initial-public-offerings-tests-of Bibliographic Record Authors: MICHAELY, R, SHAW, WH Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/7.2.279 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We test the empirical implications of several models of IPO underpricing. Consistent with the winner's-curse hypothesis, we show that in markets where investors know a priori that they do not have to compete with informed investors, IPOs are not underpriced. We also show that IPOs under-written by reputable investment banks experience significantly less underpricing and perform significantly better in the long run. We do not find empirical support for the signaling models that try to explain why firms underprice. In fact, we find that (1) firms that underprice more return to the reissue market less frequently, and for lesser amounts, than firms that underprice less, and (2) firms that underprice less experience higher earnings and pay higher dividends, contrary to the models' predictions. 摘要（中文） 我们检验了若干IPO抑价模型的实证含义。与赢家诅咒假说相一致，我们表明在投资者事先知道他们不必与知情投资者竞争的市场中，IPO不存在抑价。我们还表明，由声誉良好的投资银行承销的IPO抑价显著更少，并在长期内表现显著更好。我们没有找到支持那些试图解释公司为何抑价的信号模型的实证证据。事实上，我们发现（1）抑价更多的公司返回再发行市场的频率更低、金额更小，相比抑价较少的公司；以及（2）抑价较少的公司经历更高的盈余并支付更高的股利，这与这些模型的预测相反。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: PRICE REACTIONS TO DIVIDEND INITIATIONS AND OMISSIONS - OVERREACTION OR DRIFT
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article investigates market reactions to initiations and omissions of cash dividend payments. Raw markdown: michaely-1995-price-reactions-to-dividend-initiations-and-omissions-overreaction Bibliographic Record Authors: MICHAELY, R, THALER, RH, WOMACK, KL…
pages.text: PRICE REACTIONS TO DIVIDEND INITIATIONS AND OMISSIONS - OVERREACTION OR DRIFT (1995) Paper claim — This article investigates market reactions to initiations and omissions of cash dividend payments. Raw markdown: michaely-1995-price-reactions-to-dividend-initiations-and-omissions-overreaction Bibliographic Record Authors: MICHAELY, R, THALER, RH, WOMACK, KL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1995 DOI: 10.2307/2329420 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract This article investigates market reactions to initiations and omissions of cash dividend payments. Consistent with prior literature we find that the magnitude of short-run price reactions to omissions are greater than for initiations. In the year following the announcements, prices continue to drift in the same direction, though the drift following omissions is stronger and more robust. This post-dividend initiation/omission price drift is distinct from and more pronounced than that following earnings surprises. A trading rule employing both samples earns positive returns in 22 out of 25 years. We find little evidence for clientele shifts in either sample. 摘要（中文） 本文考察市场对现金股利派发的开始与省略（omission）的反应。与已有文献一致，我们发现市场对省略股利的短期价格反应幅度大于对开始派发股利的反应幅度。在公告后的一年内，价格继续沿同一方向漂移，不过省略股利之后的漂移更强、更稳健。这种股利开始/省略后的价格漂移不同于盈余意外之后的漂移，且更为显著。一项同时利用两个样本的交易规则在25年中有22年获得正收益。我们几乎没有发现任何一个样本存在客户群体转移（clientele shifts）的证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: THE EFFECT OF TAX HETEROGENEITY ON PRICES AND VOLUME AROUND THE EX-DIVIDEND DAY - EVIDENCE FROM THE MILAN STOCK-EXCHANGE (1995) Paper claim — To investigate the effect of taxation on stock price and trading volume around the ex-dividend day, we use the Italian stock market, where dividends on two classes of stock are taxed differently. Raw markdown: michaely-1995-the-effect-of-tax-heterogeneity-on-prices-and Bibliographic Record Authors: MICHAELY, R, MURGIA, M Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1995 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/8.2.369 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract To investigate the effect of taxation on stock price and trading volume around the ex-dividend day, we use the Italian stock market, where dividends on two classes of stock are taxed differently. We find that the weighted average of investors' tax rates is reflected in the ex-day prices and the variance of the relative tax rate across investors is reflected in the volume of trades. We also show that higher transaction costs result in higher ex-dividend day excess returns and lower abnormal volume. This finding is consistent with ''profit elimination'' activity by institutions and corporations. 摘要（中文） 为考察税收对除息日前后股价和交易量的影响，我们使用意大利股票市场，在该市场中两类股票的股利征税不同。我们发现，投资者税率的加权平均反映在除息日价格中，而投资者间相对税率的方差反映在交易量中。我们还表明，较高的交易成本导致较高的除息日超额收益和较低的异常交易量。这一发现与机构和企业的"利润消除"活动相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Trading volume with private valuation: Evidence from the ex-dividend day (1996) Paper claim — We test a theory of the interaction between investors' heterogeneity, risk, transaction costs, and trading volume We take advantage of the specific nature of trading motives around the distribution of cash dividends, namely the costly trading of tax shields, Consistent with the theory, we show that when trades occur because of differential valuation of cash flows, an increase in risk or transaction costs reduces volume We also show that the nonsystematic risk plays a significant role in determining the volume of trade. Raw markdown: michaely-1996-trading-volume-with-private-valuation-evidence-from-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, R, Vila, JL Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/9.2.471 Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, distribution, dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We test a theory of the interaction between investors' heterogeneity, risk, transaction costs, and trading volume We take advantage of the specific nature of trading motives around the distribution of cash dividends, namely the costly trading of tax shields, Consistent with the theory, we show that when trades occur because of differential valuation of cash flows, an increase in risk or transaction costs reduces volume We also show that the nonsystematic risk plays a significant role in determining the volume of trade. Finally, we demonstrate that trading volume is positively related to the degree of heterogeneity and the incentives of the various groups to engage in trading. 摘要（中文） 我们检验一个关于投资者异质性、风险、交易成本与交易量之间相互作用的理论。我们利用了现金股利分配前后交易动机的特殊性质，即税盾的有成本交易。与该理论一致，我们表明，当交易因对现金流的差异化估值而发生时，风险或交易成本的增加会减少交易量。我们还表明，非系统性风险在决定交易量方面发挥了重要作用。最后，我们证明，交易量与异质性程度以及各群体参与交易的动机呈正相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Are Friday announcements special? Overcoming selection bias
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We report reduced market response to Friday announcements of dividend changes, seasoned equity offerings, share repurchases, earnings, and mergers, which is seemingly consistent with the notion of investor inattention on Fridays. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Are Friday announcements special? Overcoming selection bias (2016) Paper claim — We report reduced market response to Friday announcements of dividend changes, seasoned equity offerings, share repurchases, earnings, and mergers, which is seemingly consistent with the notion of investor inattention on Fridays. Raw markdown: michaely-2016-are-friday-announcements-special-overcoming-selection-bias Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, R, Rubin, A, Vedrashko, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2016.05.006 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase) Abstract We report reduced market response to Friday announcements of dividend changes, seasoned equity offerings, share repurchases, earnings, and mergers, which is seemingly consistent with the notion of investor inattention on Fridays. However, we show that these findings are an outcome of selection bias. Firms that make announcements on Fridays experience reduced market response on any weekday and have common unobserved characteristics across announcement types. After correcting for selection bias, there is no evidence that investors pay less attention to announcements made on Fridays. The method introduced here is applicable to other studies in which an exogenous factor influencing firm performance can actually be associated with firm characteristics. (C) 2016 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们报告了市场对周五公布的股利变化、增发权益发行、股份回购、盈余和并购的反应有所减弱，这看似与投资者在周五注意力不集中的观点相一致。然而，我们表明这些发现是选择性偏差的结果。在周五发布公告的公司在任何工作日都会经历减弱的市场反应，并且在各类公告类型之间具有共同的不可观测特征。在校正选择性偏差之后，没有证据表明投资者对周五发布的公告关注更少。本文引入的方法适用于其他研究，只要其中一个影响公司绩效的外生因素实际上可能与公司特征相关联。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Signaling safety
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Contrary to signaling models' central predictions, changes in the level of cash flows do not empirically follow changes in dividends. Raw markdown: michaely-2021-signaling-safety Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, R, Rossi, S, Weber, M Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Signaling safety (2021) Paper claim — Contrary to signaling models' central predictions, changes in the level of cash flows do not empirically follow changes in dividends. Raw markdown: michaely-2021-signaling-safety Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, R, Rossi, S, Weber, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.08.013 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow, signal) Abstract Contrary to signaling models' central predictions, changes in the level of cash flows do not empirically follow changes in dividends. We use the Campbell (1991) decomposition to construct cash-flow and discount-rate news from returns and find the following: (1) both dividend changes and repurchase announcements signal changes in cash-flow volatility (in opposite directions); (2) larger cash-flow volatility changes come with larger announcement returns; and (3) neither discount-rate news, nor the level of cash-flow news, nor total stock return volatility change following dividend changes. We conclude cash-flow news-and not discount-rate news-drive payout policy, and payout policy conveys information about future cash-flow volatility. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 与信号模型的核心预测相反，现金流水平的变化在实证上并不跟随股利的变化。我们使用坎贝尔（Campbell，1991）的分解方法，从回报中构建现金流消息和贴现率消息，并发现如下结论：(1) 股利变化和回购公告都发出现金流波动性变化的信号（方向相反）；(2) 现金流波动性变化越大，公告回报越大；以及 (3) 在股利变化之后，贴现率消息、现金流消息的水平以及股票总回报波动性都没有变化。我们的结论是，驱动支付政策的是现金流消息，而非贴现率消息，且支付政策传递了关于未来现金流波动性的信息。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Disappearing and reappearing dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We decompose the decrease (1970s-20 0 0) and subsequent recovery (20 0 0-2018) in the fraction of dividend-paying firms. Raw markdown: michaely-2022-disappearing-and-reappearing-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, R, Moin, A Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Disappearing and reappearing dividends (2022) Paper claim — We decompose the decrease (1970s-20 0 0) and subsequent recovery (20 0 0-2018) in the fraction of dividend-paying firms. Raw markdown: michaely-2022-disappearing-and-reappearing-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, R, Moin, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.06.029 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We decompose the decrease (1970s-20 0 0) and subsequent recovery (20 0 0-2018) in the fraction of dividend-paying firms. Changes in firm characteristics and proclivity to pay (probability of paying dividends conditional on characteristics) each drive half of the dividend disappearance. A higher proclivity drives 82% of the dividend reappearance. The remaining 18% is driven by a single characteristic: reduced earnings volatility. Changing characteristics are associated with low-profitability, high-earnings-volatility firms. Changing proclivity is associated with stable, profitable firms. Rather than dividend initiations or omissions, newly listed and delisted firms drive trends. Finally, the magnitude and duration of disappearing total payout is substantially smaller than that of dividends, indicating some substitution between dividends and repurchases. (c) 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们分解了派发股利企业比例的下降（1970年代至2000年）及随后的回升（2000至2018年）。企业特征的变化以及支付倾向（在给定特征条件下派发股利的概率）各自驱动了股利消失的一半。更高的支付倾向驱动了股利重现的82%。剩余的18%由单一特征驱动：盈余波动性的降低。变化的特征与低盈利能力、高盈余波动性的企业相关联。变化的支付倾向与稳定、盈利的企业相关联。驱动趋势的并非股利启动或取消，而是新上市和退市的企业。最后，消失的总支付在量级和持续时间上都大大小于股利，这表明股利与回购之间存在某种替代。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
