pages.title: Disappearing and Reappearing Dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Changes in firm characteristics and proclivity to pay each drive half of the dividend disappearance (1970s–2000); a higher proclivity drives 82% of the subsequent dividend reappearance (2000–2018), with reduced earnings volatility driving the remaining 18%. Raw…
pages.text: Disappearing and Reappearing Dividends (2022) Paper claim — Changes in firm characteristics and proclivity to pay each drive half of the dividend disappearance (1970s–2000); a higher proclivity drives 82% of the subsequent dividend reappearance (2000–2018), with reduced earnings volatility driving the remaining 18%. Raw markdown: michaely-moin-2022-disappearing-and-reappearing-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, Roni; Moin, Amani Journal: Journal of Financial Economics Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.06.029 Abstract We decompose the decrease (1970s–2000) and subsequent recovery (2000–2018) in the fraction of dividend-paying firms. Changes in firm characteristics and proclivity to pay (probability of paying dividends conditional on characteristics) each drive half of the dividend disappearance. A higher proclivity drives 82% of the dividend reappearance. The remaining 18% is driven by a single characteristic: reduced earnings volatility. Changing characteristics are associated with low-profitability, high-earnings-volatility firms. Changing proclivity is associated with stable, profitable firms. Rather than dividend initiations or omissions, newly listed and delisted firms drive trends. Finally, the magnitude and duration of disappearing total payout is substantially smaller than that of dividends, indicating some substitution between dividends and repurchases. Key Findings The fraction of U.S. firms paying dividends fell from 73% in 1978 to 23% in 2000, then recovered to 36% by 2018; both the disappearance and reappearance are driven by newly listed and delisted firms, not by within-firm changes in dividend policy (consistent with Lintner dividend persistence). Disappearing dividends are attributable roughly equally to changing firm characteristics (52.6% — an influx of low-profitability, high-earnings-volatility firms) and changing proclivity to pay (47.4% — profitable, stable firms increasingly choosing not to pay). Reappearing dividends are driven overwhelmingly by changing proclivity (81.7%), with the remaining 18.3% attributable entirely to reduced earnings volatility — the only characteristic that moved in the direction of reappearance. The reappearance is mechanically driven by non-dividend-paying firms delisting (primarily via mergers/acquisitions); if M&A delistings did not occur post-2000, dividends would have reappeared only one-third as much. Total payout (dividends + repurchases) showed a smaller and shorter-lived gap (trough −9.1 pp, gap closes by 1998) than dividends alone (trough −21.7 pp), indicating substantial substitution of repurchases for dividends; repurchases continue growing even as dividends reappear, consistent with the passage of SEC rule 10b-18 in 1982. Linked Pages dividend-payout-policy financial-flexibility-and-payout overview

pages.title: Corporate Dividend Policies: Lessons from Private Firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Private firms smooth dividends significantly less than their public counterparts, suggesting that the scrutiny of public capital markets plays a central role in the propensity of firms to smooth dividends; ownership structure and incentives play key roles in…
pages.text: Corporate Dividend Policies: Lessons from Private Firms (2012) Paper claim — Private firms smooth dividends significantly less than their public counterparts, suggesting that the scrutiny of public capital markets plays a central role in the propensity of firms to smooth dividends; ownership structure and incentives play key roles in shaping dividend policies. Raw markdown: michaely-roberts-2012-corporate-dividend-policies-lessons-from-private-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Michaely, Roni; Roberts, Michael R. Journal: Review of Financial Studies Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhr108 Abstract We compare the dividend policies of publicly and privately held firms in order to help identify the forces shaping corporate dividends, and shed light on the behavior of privately held companies. We show that private firms smooth dividends significantly less than their public counterparts, suggesting that the scrutiny of public capital markets plays a central role in the propensity of firms to smooth dividends over time. Public firms pay relatively higher dividends that tend to be more sensitive to changes in investment opportunities than otherwise similar private firms. Ultimately, ownership structure and incentives play key roles in shaping dividend policies. (JEL G35, G32, G15) Key Findings Public firms smooth dividends significantly more than private firms: the Lintner speed-of-adjustment parameter is 0.41 for public firms, 0.63 for private dispersed firms, and 0.83 for wholly owned firms; when firms transition from private to public, the rate of dividend omission decreases by 56% and dividend cuts decrease by 40%. Public firms pay relatively higher dividends than comparable private firms (27% of profits vs. 17.8% for private dispersed and 13.4% for wholly owned), and this holds both in matched samples and for the same firms before and after going public. Wholly owned firms' dividends are most sensitive to investment opportunities (sales growth), consistent with dividends acting as a residual payout when agency and information frictions are minimal; the same sensitivity is absent for private dispersed firms and weaker for public firms. A 1997 U.K. tax reform that reduced dividend value to pension fund investors by 20% did not change cross-group patterns, suggesting the observed differences are driven by ownership structure and capital market scrutiny rather than tax clienteles. Results are identified via both propensity-score matched samples and a transition sample (firms that underwent IPO or going-private), with both approaches yielding consistent conclusions about the role of public market listing in shaping smoothing behavior. Linked Pages dividend-smoothing ownership-structure-and-expropriation international-evidence-on-dividends

pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study analyzes bid-ask spreads surrounding announcements of open-market share repurchase programs for a sample of 248 announcements of repurchase programs by NYSE firms over the period January 1984 through June 1988. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: OPEN-MARKET SHARE REPURCHASE PROGRAMS AND BID-ASK SPREADS ON THE NYSE - IMPLICATIONS FOR CORPORATE PAYOUT POLICY (1995) Paper claim — This study analyzes bid-ask spreads surrounding announcements of open-market share repurchase programs for a sample of 248 announcements of repurchase programs by NYSE firms over the period January 1984 through June 1988. Raw markdown: miller-1995-open-market-share-repurchase-programs-and-bid-ask Bibliographic Record Authors: MILLER, JM, MCCONNELL, JJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1995 DOI: 10.2307/2331346 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(payout, share repurchase) Abstract This study analyzes bid-ask spreads surrounding announcements of open-market share repurchase programs for a sample of 248 announcements of repurchase programs by NYSE firms over the period January 1984 through June 1988. The sample includes 158 announcements of new programs and 90 announcements regarding continuations of already existing programs. Contrary to the theory that spreads increase surrounding the announcement of open-market share repurchase programs, with both univariate and multivariate tests that control for changes in volume, changes in stock price volatility, and changes in the level of stock price, we find no evidence of an increase in spreads surrounding announcements of open-market share repurchase programs. 摘要（中文） 本研究分析了公开市场股票回购计划公告前后的买卖价差，样本为纽约证券交易所（NYSE）公司在1984年1月至1988年6月期间发布的248项回购计划公告。样本包括158项新计划公告和90项关于已有计划延续的公告。与"买卖价差会在公开市场股票回购计划公告前后上升"这一理论相反，通过控制成交量变化、股价波动性变化和股价水平变化的单变量和多变量检验，我们没有发现价差在公开市场股票回购计划公告前后上升的任何证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stealth compensation: Do CEOs increase their pay by influencing dividend policy?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Companies can increase executive compensation by allowing dividends to be paid on unvested restricted stocks grants, also known as stealth compensation. Raw markdown: minnick-2014-stealth-compensation-do-ceos-increase-their-pay-by Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Stealth compensation: Do CEOs increase their pay by influencing dividend policy? (2014) Paper claim — Companies can increase executive compensation by allowing dividends to be paid on unvested restricted stocks grants, also known as stealth compensation. Raw markdown: minnick-2014-stealth-compensation-do-ceos-increase-their-pay-by Bibliographic Record Authors: Minnick, K, Rosenthal, L Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.01.005 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Companies can increase executive compensation by allowing dividends to be paid on unvested restricted stocks grants, also known as stealth compensation. Examining all S&P 500 firms over the period 2003-2007, we find that more than half of the dividend paying firms allow this practice. We look at whether this form of compensation reduces agency costs or decreases value for shareholders. We find that CEOs' stealth compensation amounts to an average of $180,000 in additional income, which increases the CEOs' cash compensation and total compensation by 9% and 2% respectively. Firms engaging in stealth compensation have higher dividend payout ratios than those not allowing stealth compensation. For all firms using stealth compensation, there is a reduction in average ROA and Tobin's Q over the long run. However, stealth compensation companies with potential agency issues see a meaningful improvement in their long run performance. For weakly governed companies, stealth compensation may act as a bonding mechanism which may serve to reduce agency costs and therefore increase shareholder value. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 公司可以通过允许对未归属的限制性股票授予支付股利来增加高管薪酬，这也被称为隐性薪酬。考察2003—2007年期间所有标普500企业，我们发现半数以上的派息企业允许这种做法。我们研究这种薪酬形式是减少了代理成本还是减损了股东价值。我们发现，CEO的隐性薪酬平均相当于18万美元的额外收入，使CEO的现金薪酬和总薪酬分别增加9%和2%。从事隐性薪酬的企业其股利支付率高于不允许隐性薪酬的企业。对于所有使用隐性薪酬的企业，从长期来看平均ROA和托宾Q有所下降。然而，存在潜在代理问题的隐性薪酬企业在长期业绩上有明显改善。对于治理薄弱的公司，隐性薪酬可能起到一种绑定机制的作用，从而有助于减少代理成本并因此提升股东价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Reinvesting or Consuming Dividends: Account Structure Matters
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — It is a long-standing fact that households mostly consume and rarely reinvest dividends. Raw markdown: mllerdethard-2025-reinvesting-or-consuming-dividends-account-structure-matters Bibliographic Record Authors: Müller-Dethard, J, Reinhardt, N, Weber, M Journal:…
pages.text: Reinvesting or Consuming Dividends: Account Structure Matters (2025) Paper claim — It is a long-standing fact that households mostly consume and rarely reinvest dividends. Raw markdown: mllerdethard-2025-reinvesting-or-consuming-dividends-account-structure-matters Bibliographic Record Authors: Müller-Dethard, J, Reinhardt, N, Weber, M Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfaf031 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract It is a long-standing fact that households mostly consume and rarely reinvest dividends. Among representative brokerage clients of one of Germany's largest banks, we find the opposite: 80 percent reinvestments and 12 percent consumption. Of these reinvestments, the majority occurs with a delay after dividends are initially parked as brokerage cash. Motivated by this finding, we study payout modalities (deposits into brokerage accounts, checking accounts, or checks) as a novel mechanism that nudges investors toward reinvesting or consuming dividends. Consistent with a transition from checks to brokerage deposits, we find that the dividend consumption rate in the Consumer Expenditure Survey has decreased substantially over time. 摘要（中文） 家庭大多消费而很少再投资股利，这是一个长期存在的事实。而在德国最大银行之一的具有代表性的经纪客户中，我们发现了相反的情况：80%再投资，12%消费。在这些再投资中，大多数是在股利最初作为经纪账户现金停放之后延迟发生的。受这一发现的启发，我们研究了派现方式（存入经纪账户、存入支票账户或以支票形式发放）作为一种促使投资者再投资或消费股利的新颖机制。与从支票向经纪账户存款的转变相一致，我们发现《消费者支出调查》中的股利消费率随时间已大幅下降。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Discussion of 'Using earnings forecasts to simultaneously estimate firm-specific cost of equity and long-term growth'
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Accounting-based valuation models allow us to develop rigorous estimates of either value or the expected rate of return on equity capital (i.e., ERR) without making steady-state forecasts that rely on ad hoc assumptions about dividend policy. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Discussion of "Using earnings forecasts to simultaneously estimate firm-specific cost of equity and long-term growth" (2011) Paper claim — Accounting-based valuation models allow us to develop rigorous estimates of either value or the expected rate of return on equity capital (i.e., ERR) without making steady-state forecasts that rely on ad hoc assumptions about dividend policy. Raw markdown: monahan-2011-discussion-of-using-earnings-forecasts-to-simultaneously-estimate Bibliographic Record Authors: Monahan, SJ Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-011-9146-7 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Accounting-based valuation models allow us to develop rigorous estimates of either value or the expected rate of return on equity capital (i.e., ERR) without making steady-state forecasts that rely on ad hoc assumptions about dividend policy. Hence, these models have great potential. Their ultimate usefulness, however, depends on the extent to which users of them make assumptions about future residual income that are consistent with the underlying accounting. Nekrasov and Ogneva contribute by developing a methodology that allows us to integrate information about accounting attributes such as conservatism into our estimates of the growth rate in residual income. Hence, their methodology can be used to improve our understanding of the role that conservatism plays in determining growth. This, in turn, improves our ability to estimate key parameters such as value and the expected rate of return on equity capital. 摘要（中文） 基于会计的估值模型使我们能够为价值或股权资本的预期收益率（即ERR）建立严格的估计，而无需作出依赖于关于股利政策的临时性假设的稳态预测。因此，这些模型具有巨大潜力。然而，它们的最终有用性取决于其使用者在多大程度上对未来剩余收益作出与基础会计相一致的假设。Nekrasov和Ogneva的贡献在于开发了一种方法，使我们能够将关于诸如稳健性之类的会计属性的信息整合到我们对剩余收益增长率的估计中。因此，他们的方法可用于改进我们对稳健性在决定增长中所起作用的理解。这进而提高了我们估计诸如价值和股权资本预期收益率等关键参数的能力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Capital Gains Taxes and Real Corporate Investment: Evidence from Korea
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper assesses the effects of capital gains taxes on investment in the Republic of Korea (hereafter, Korea), where capital gains tax rates vary at the firm level by firm size. Raw markdown: moon-2022-capital-gains-taxes-and-real-corporate-investment-evidence…
pages.text: Capital Gains Taxes and Real Corporate Investment: Evidence from Korea (2022) Paper claim — This paper assesses the effects of capital gains taxes on investment in the Republic of Korea (hereafter, Korea), where capital gains tax rates vary at the firm level by firm size. Raw markdown: moon-2022-capital-gains-taxes-and-real-corporate-investment-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Moon, TS Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1257/aer.20201272 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(payout) Abstract This paper assesses the effects of capital gains taxes on investment in the Republic of Korea (hereafter, Korea), where capital gains tax rates vary at the firm level by firm size. Following a reform in 2014, firms with a tax cut increased investment by 34 log points and issued more equity by 9 cents per dollar of lagged revenue, relative to unaffected firms. Additionally, the effects were larger for firms that appeared more cash constrained or went public after the reform. Taken together, these findings are consistent with the "traditional view" predicting that lower payout taxes spur equity-financed investment by increasing marginal returns on investment. 摘要（中文） 本文评估资本利得税对韩国（大韩民国，下称韩国）投资的影响，在韩国，资本利得税率在企业层面因企业规模而异。在2014年的一项改革之后，相对于未受影响的企业，获得减税的企业将投资增加了34个对数点，并且每一美元滞后收入多发行了9美分的股权。此外，对于看起来更受现金约束或在改革后上市的企业，这些效应更大。综合来看，这些发现与预测较低派现税会通过提高投资边际回报来刺激股权融资投资的“传统观点”相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Strategic repurchases and equity sales: Evidence from equity vesting schedules
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies the strategic use and timing of share repurchases by insiders for personal gain. Raw markdown: moore-2023-strategic-repurchases-and-equity-sales-evidence-from-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Moore, D Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE…
pages.text: Strategic repurchases and equity sales: Evidence from equity vesting schedules (2023) Paper claim — This paper studies the strategic use and timing of share repurchases by insiders for personal gain. Raw markdown: moore-2023-strategic-repurchases-and-equity-sales-evidence-from-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Moore, D Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2022.106717 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(share repurchase) Abstract This paper studies the strategic use and timing of share repurchases by insiders for personal gain. Us-ing grant-level compensation data and a hand-collected sample of monthly repurchases, I find a positive causal relation between executive equity sales and share repurchases. I identify the relation using the vesting schedule of equity grants as an instrument for equity sales. This behavior is persistent across firm, executive, and governance characteristics. Both CFO and CEO vesting schedules impact repurchases, sug-gesting the CFO may also have influence over the execution of the repurchase program. There is minimal evidence of long-term value destruction. The results indicate executive contracts impact the execution of share repurchase programs.(c) 2022 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文研究了内部人为个人利益而对股份回购的策略性使用和时机把握。使用授予层面的薪酬数据和手工收集的月度回购样本，我发现高管股权出售与股份回购之间存在正向因果关系。我使用股权授予的归属时间表作为股权出售的工具变量来识别这一关系。这种行为在公司、高管和治理特征之间是持续存在的。CFO和CEO的归属时间表都影响回购，这表明CFO可能也对回购计划的执行具有影响力。几乎没有长期价值销毁的证据。结果表明高管合约影响股份回购计划的执行。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate whether investor protection and taxation legislation affect dividend policy, using a unique sample of all Belgian firms listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange between 1838 and 2012. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Investor protection, taxation and dividend policy: Long-run evidence, 1838-2012 (2017) Paper claim — We investigate whether investor protection and taxation legislation affect dividend policy, using a unique sample of all Belgian firms listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange between 1838 and 2012. Raw markdown: moortgat-2017-investor-protection-taxation-and-dividend-policy-long-run Bibliographic Record Authors: Moortgat, L, Annaert, J, Deloof, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2017.08.013 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection, policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We investigate whether investor protection and taxation legislation affect dividend policy, using a unique sample of all Belgian firms listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange between 1838 and 2012. Investor protection was very weak in Belgium before World War 1, but gradually improved over time. Dividend taxation was introduced only in 1920. While it is generally believed that investor protection and taxation affect dividend policy, we find that dividend policy has been remarkably stable over time, even after controlling for firm characteristics. Changes in investor protection and taxation legislation seem to have had little impact on dividend policy. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用1838年至2012年间在布鲁塞尔证券交易所上市的所有比利时公司这一独特样本，考察投资者保护和税收立法是否影响股利政策。第一次世界大战之前，比利时的投资者保护非常薄弱，但随着时间推移逐渐改善。股利税直到1920年才被引入。尽管人们普遍认为投资者保护和税收会影响股利政策，但我们发现，即便在控制了公司特征之后，股利政策随时间推移也保持了显著的稳定性。投资者保护和税收立法的变化似乎对股利政策影响甚微。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — As an alternative version of the side-payment model, this paper presents a demonstration of how the necessity of winning majority support of shareholders influences the relation between a blockholder's monitoring incentive and a firm's dividend policy. Raw…
pages.text: Majority support of shareholders, monitoring incentive, and dividend policy (2015) Paper claim — As an alternative version of the side-payment model, this paper presents a demonstration of how the necessity of winning majority support of shareholders influences the relation between a blockholder's monitoring incentive and a firm's dividend policy. Raw markdown: mori-2015-majority-support-of-shareholders-monitoring-incentive-and-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Mori, N, Ikeda, N Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.10.015 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract As an alternative version of the side-payment model, this paper presents a demonstration of how the necessity of winning majority support of shareholders influences the relation between a blockholder's monitoring incentive and a firm's dividend policy. When dividend-averse individuals collectively hold a majority stake in a dispersed ownership structure, a dividend-seeking blockholder might be compelled to propose lower dividends than the tax-optimum to dominate the zero-dividend proposal. Under such circumstances, the blockholder has an incentive to provide unprofitable monitoring activity as long as the private benefits of tax-saving are greater than the pecuniary loss from the monitoring activity. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 作为附带支付（side-payment）模型的另一种版本，本文论证了赢得股东多数支持的必要性如何影响区块持股人的监督激励与企业股利政策之间的关系。当厌恶股利的个人在分散的所有权结构中共同持有多数股权时，一个追逐股利的区块持股人可能被迫提出低于税收最优水平的股利，以压倒零股利提案。在这种情况下，只要节税的私人收益大于监督活动带来的金钱损失，区块持股人就有动机提供无利可图的监督活动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Speculative investor behavior and learning (1996) Paper claim — As traders learn about the true distribution of some asset's dividends, a speculative premium occurs as each trader anticipates the possibility of reselling the asset to another trader before complete learning has occurred. Raw markdown: morris-1996-speculative-investor-behavior-and-learning Bibliographic Record Authors: Morris, S Journal: QUARTERLY JOURNAL OF ECONOMICS Year: 1996 DOI: 10.2307/2946709 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract As traders learn about the true distribution of some asset's dividends, a speculative premium occurs as each trader anticipates the possibility of reselling the asset to another trader before complete learning has occurred. Small differences in prior beliefs lead to large speculative premiums during the learning process. This phenomenon helps explain a paradox concerning the pricing of initial public offerings. The result casts light on the significance of the common prior assumption in economic models. 摘要（中文） 随着交易者了解某资产股利的真实分布，会出现一种投机溢价，因为每个交易者都预期到在完全学习发生之前将该资产转售给另一交易者的可能性。先验信念上的微小差异会在学习过程中导致巨大的投机溢价。这一现象有助于解释一个关于首次公开发行定价的悖论。这一结果阐明了共同先验假设在经济模型中的重要意义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The effect of shareholder taxes on corporate payout choice
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates whether the difference in individual shareholder tax rates between dividend income and capital gain (the dividend tax penalty) affects a firm's choice between distributing funds to shareholders through dividends or share repurchases. Raw…
pages.text: The effect of shareholder taxes on corporate payout choice (2007) Paper claim — This study investigates whether the difference in individual shareholder tax rates between dividend income and capital gain (the dividend tax penalty) affects a firm's choice between distributing funds to shareholders through dividends or share repurchases. Raw markdown: moser-2007-the-effect-of-shareholder-taxes-on-corporate-payout Bibliographic Record Authors: Moser, WJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000003471 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract This study investigates whether the difference in individual shareholder tax rates between dividend income and capital gain (the dividend tax penalty) affects a firm's choice between distributing funds to shareholders through dividends or share repurchases. The results of this study suggest that, in periods in which the dividend tax penalty increases, firms are more likely to distribute funds to shareholders through share repurchases as opposed to dividends. The results also indicate that the relation between the dividend tax penalty and corporate payout choice is affected by the types of shareholders who own stock in the firm. As tax-disfavored institutional ownership increases and the dividend tax penalty increases, firms are more likely to repurchase shares as opposed to distributing dividends. In contrast, as tax-favored institutional ownership increases and the dividend tax penalty increases, firms are less likely to repurchase shares as opposed to distributing dividends. As senior managerial share ownership increases and the dividend tax penalty increases, firms are more likely to make distributions to shareholders in the form of share repurchases. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察股利收入与资本利得之间个人股东税率的差异（股利税收惩罚）是否影响企业在通过股利还是股份回购向股东分配资金之间的选择。本研究结果表明，在股利税收惩罚增加的时期，企业更可能通过股份回购而非股利向股东分配资金。结果还表明，股利税收惩罚与企业支付选择之间的关系受持有企业股票的股东类型的影响。随着税收上不受青睐的机构持股增加以及股利税收惩罚增加，企业更可能回购股份而非分配股利。相反，随着税收上受青睐的机构持股增加以及股利税收惩罚增加，企业则更不可能回购股份而非分配股利。随着高层管理者持股增加以及股利税收惩罚增加，企业更可能以股份回购的形式向股东进行分配。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — From the existing literature, it is not clear what effect financing constraints have on the sensitivities of firms' investment to their cash flow. Raw markdown: moyen-2004-investment-cash-flow-sensitivities-constrained-versus-unconstrained-firms Bibliographic…
pages.text: Investment-cash flow sensitivities: Constrained versus unconstrained firms (2004) Paper claim — From the existing literature, it is not clear what effect financing constraints have on the sensitivities of firms' investment to their cash flow. Raw markdown: moyen-2004-investment-cash-flow-sensitivities-constrained-versus-unconstrained-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Moyen, N Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2004 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2004.00692.x Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract From the existing literature, it is not clear what effect financing constraints have on the sensitivities of firms' investment to their cash flow. I propose an explanation that reconciles the conflicting empirical evidence. I present two models: the unconstrained model, in which firms can raise external funds, and the constrained model, in which firms cannot do so. Using low dividends to identify financing constraints in my generated panel of data produces results consistent with those of Fazzari, Hubbard, and Petersen; using the constrained model produces results consistent with those of Kaplan and Zingales. 摘要（中文） 从现有文献来看，融资约束对企业投资对其现金流敏感性的影响并不清楚。我提出了一个解释来调和相互冲突的实证证据。我提出了两个模型：无约束模型（企业可以筹集外部资金）和约束模型（企业无法这样做）。在我生成的面板数据中，使用低股利来识别融资约束所产生的结果与Fazzari、Hubbard和Petersen的结果相一致；使用约束模型所产生的结果与Kaplan和Zingales的结果相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Outside equity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Equity financing is modeled when cash flows and asset values are not verifiable. Raw markdown: myers-2000-outside-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Myers, SC Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00239 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched…
pages.text: Outside equity (2000) Paper claim — Equity financing is modeled when cash flows and asset values are not verifiable. Raw markdown: myers-2000-outside-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Myers, SC Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.00239 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow) Abstract Equity financing is modeled when cash flows and asset values are not verifiable. Investors have enforceable property rights to the firm's assets, but cannot prevent insiders (managers or entrepreneurs) from capturing cash flow Insiders must co-invest and pay in each period a dividend sufficient to ensure outside investors' participation for at least one more period. Intervention by the investors must be limited by an agreement with insiders or by costs of collective action. Basic models are extended to show why firms go public and why agency costs necessarily arise when the act of investment is not immediately verifiable. 摘要（中文） 本文对现金流和资产价值不可验证时的股权融资进行了建模。投资者对企业资产拥有可执行的财产权，但无法阻止内部人（管理者或企业家）攫取现金流。内部人必须共同投资，并在每一期支付足以确保外部投资者至少再参与一期的股利。投资者的干预必须受到与内部人的协议或集体行动成本的限制。基本模型被加以扩展，以说明为什么企业会上市，以及为什么当投资行为无法立即被验证时，代理成本必然会产生。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Disentangling the dividend information in splits: A decomposition using conditional event-study methods (2001) Paper claim — While folklore in finance holds that split valuation effects are due to dividend increases associated with splits, little is known about magnitudes of dividend and nondividend components of split announcement effects. Raw markdown: nayak-2001-disentangling-the-dividend-information-in-splits-a-decomposition Bibliographic Record Authors: Nayak, S, Prabhala, NR Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/14.4.1083 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract While folklore in finance holds that split valuation effects are due to dividend increases associated with splits, little is known about magnitudes of dividend and nondividend components of split announcement effects. We find that splits and dividends are indeed informational substitutes, a notion we characterize more precisely, but a significant portion of split valuation effects, 46% according to our estimates, cannot be attributed to dividend information in splits. Our techniques extend the literature on conditional event-study methods and we illustrate their practical value in testing hypotheses and analyzing data not amenable to analysis by standard procedures. 摘要（中文） 尽管金融领域的民间说法认为，拆分的估值效应源于与拆分相关联的股利增加，但对于拆分公告效应中股利成分与非股利成分的大小，人们所知甚少。我们发现，拆分与股利确实是信息替代品——我们对这一概念作了更精确的刻画——但拆分估值效应中有相当一部分（据我们估计为46%）无法归因于拆分中的股利信息。我们的技术扩展了关于条件事件研究方法的文献，并展示了它们在检验假设以及分析不适于用标准程序分析的数据方面的实用价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: ARE FAMILY FIRMS GOOD EMPLOYERS?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Family firms employ about 60% of the global workforce. Raw markdown: neckebrouck-2018-are-family-firms-good-employers Bibliographic Record Authors: Neckebrouck, J, Schulze, W, Zellweger, T Journal: ACADEMY OF MANAGEMENT JOURNAL Year: 2018 DOI: 10.5465/amj.2016.0765…
pages.text: ARE FAMILY FIRMS GOOD EMPLOYERS? (2018) Paper claim — Family firms employ about 60% of the global workforce. Raw markdown: neckebrouck-2018-are-family-firms-good-employers Bibliographic Record Authors: Neckebrouck, J, Schulze, W, Zellweger, T Journal: ACADEMY OF MANAGEMENT JOURNAL Year: 2018 DOI: 10.5465/amj.2016.0765 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Family firms employ about 60% of the global workforce. While it is widely assumed that they are good employers, data about their conduct are mixed. In this study, we extend stewardship and agency theories to test competing propositions about the impact of family on employment practices using data from 14,961 private Belgian firms over a 19-year period. Higher investments, lower dividend payout, and higher risk tolerance indicate that family firms are better financial stewards of their companies than nonfamily firms. However, family firms are worse organizational stewards than nonfamily firms: they offer lower compensation, invest less in employee training, and exhibit higher voluntary turnover and lower labor productivity. Further, and contrary to earlier research, we find that financial practices in private family firms do not change over time, and that the deleterious influence of family on employment practices rises with both firm age and with heightened family involvement. Together, our findings suggest that a more nuanced understanding of stewardship and agency theory is needed to understand the impact of family on the governance of private firms. 摘要（中文） 家族企业雇用了全球约60%的劳动力。虽然人们普遍认为它们是好雇主，但关于其行为的数据却参差不齐。在本研究中，我们扩展了管家理论和代理理论，利用14961家比利时私人企业19年间的数据来检验关于家族对雇佣实践影响的相互竞争的命题。更高的投资、更低的股利支付以及更高的风险容忍度表明，家族企业比非家族企业是其公司更好的财务管家。然而，家族企业是比非家族企业更差的组织管家：它们提供更低的薪酬、在员工培训上投资更少，并表现出更高的自愿离职率和更低的劳动生产率。此外，与早先研究相反，我们发现私人家族企业的财务实践不随时间改变，且家族对雇佣实践的有害影响随企业年龄和家族参与程度的加深而上升。综合来看，我们的发现表明，要理解家族对私人企业治理的影响，需要对管家理论和代理理论有更细致的理解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The value of corporate voting rights and control: A cross-country analysis
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper measures the value of corporate voting rights, specifically of the control block of votes, in a sample of 661 dual-class firms in 18 countries, in 1997. Raw markdown: nenova-2003-the-value-of-corporate-voting-rights-and-control Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: The value of corporate voting rights and control: A cross-country analysis (2003) Paper claim — This paper measures the value of corporate voting rights, specifically of the control block of votes, in a sample of 661 dual-class firms in 18 countries, in 1997. Raw markdown: nenova-2003-the-value-of-corporate-voting-rights-and-control Bibliographic Record Authors: Nenova, T Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(03)00069-2 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, investor protection, law, regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper measures the value of corporate voting rights, specifically of the control block of votes, in a sample of 661 dual-class firms in 18 countries, in 1997. A consistent measure across countries is proposed. The measure is adjusted for takeover probability, block-holding costs, and dividend and liquidity differences between the share classes. The value of controlblock votes varies widely across countries. It is close to half of firm market value in South Korea, and close to zero in Finland. The value of control-block votes is interpreted as a lower bound for actual private benefits of the controlling shareholder. The legal environment, law enforcement, investor protection, takeover regulations, and power-concentrating corporate charter provisions explain 68% of the cross-country variation in the value of control-block votes. (C) 2003 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文测度了公司投票权的价值，特别是控制权投票权区块的价值，样本为1997年18个国家的661家双层股权结构企业。本文提出了一种跨国一致的度量方法。该度量对收购概率、区块持有成本以及不同股份类别之间的股利和流动性差异进行了调整。控制权区块投票权的价值在各国之间差异很大。在韩国，它接近企业市场价值的一半，而在芬兰则接近于零。控制权区块投票权的价值被解释为控股股东实际私人收益的下限。法律环境、法律执行、投资者保护、收购监管以及权力集中的公司章程条款，解释了控制权区块投票权价值跨国差异的68%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A test of the Modigliani-Miller theorem, dividend policy and in asset markets
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Modigliani and Miller showed the market value of the company is independent of its capital structure, and suggested that dividend policy makes no difference to this law of one price. Raw markdown: neugebauer-2023-a-test-of-the-modigliani-miller-theorem-dividend…
pages.text: A test of the Modigliani-Miller theorem, dividend policy and in asset markets (2023) Paper claim — Modigliani and Miller showed the market value of the company is independent of its capital structure, and suggested that dividend policy makes no difference to this law of one price. Raw markdown: neugebauer-2023-a-test-of-the-modigliani-miller-theorem-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Neugebauer, T, Shachat, J, Szymczak, W Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2023.106814 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Modigliani and Miller showed the market value of the company is independent of its capital structure, and suggested that dividend policy makes no difference to this law of one price. We experimentally test the Modigliani-Miller theorem in a complete market with two simultaneously traded assets, employing two experimental treatment variations. The first variation involves the dividend stream. According to this variation the dividend payment order is either identical or independent. The second variation involves the market participation, or not, of an algorithmic arbitrageur. We find that Modigliani-Miller's law of one price can be supported on average with or without an arbitrageur when dividends are identical. The law of one price breaks down when dividend payment order is independent unless there is arbitrageur participation.(c) 2023 The Authors. Published by Elsevier B.V. This is an open access article under the CC BY license ( http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ) 摘要（中文） Modigliani和Miller表明公司的市场价值独立于其资本结构，并提出股利政策对这一一价定律没有影响。我们在一个同时交易两种资产的完全市场中，对Modigliani-Miller定理进行了实验检验，采用了两种实验处理变式。第一种变式涉及股利流。根据这一变式，股利支付顺序要么相同，要么相互独立。第二种变式涉及算法套利者是否参与市场。我们发现，当股利相同时，无论有无套利者，Modigliani-Miller的一价定律平均而言都能得到支持。当股利支付顺序相互独立时，一价定律会失效，除非有套利者参与。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stakeholder orientation and corporate payout policy: Insights from state legal shocks
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We employ a difference-in-differences estimation approach to examine the impact of stakeholder orienta-tion on corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: ni-2020-stakeholder-orientation-and-corporate-payout-policy-insights-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Ni, XR,…
pages.text: Stakeholder orientation and corporate payout policy: Insights from state legal shocks (2020) Paper claim — We employ a difference-in-differences estimation approach to examine the impact of stakeholder orienta-tion on corporate payout policy. Raw markdown: ni-2020-stakeholder-orientation-and-corporate-payout-policy-insights-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Ni, XR, Song, W, Yao, JQ Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2020.105970 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We employ a difference-in-differences estimation approach to examine the impact of stakeholder orienta-tion on corporate payout policy. The empirical test exploits the enactment of US state-level constituency statutes, which allow directors to consider stakeholders and long-term interests in corporate decision making. We find that firms incorporated in states that have adopted constituency statutes significantly reduce share repurchases, whereas the effects of statute enactment on total payout and dividend payments are marginal and insignificant, respectively. We further show that the negative statute effect on share repurchases is more pronounced for firms that are in financial distress or are close to default, and firms in consumer-focused and high-polluting industries. Overall, our findings indicate that promoting stakeholder orientation can have a significant impact on corporate payout decisions. (c) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们采用双重差分估计方法来考察利益相关者导向对企业支付政策的影响。实证检验利用了美国州层面利益相关者法规的颁布，这些法规允许董事在企业决策中考虑利益相关者和长期利益。我们发现，在采纳了利益相关者法规的州注册的企业显著减少股份回购，而法规颁布对总支付和股利支付的影响分别是微弱的和不显著的。我们进一步表明，法规对股份回购的负向效应对陷入财务困境或接近违约的企业、以及消费者导向和高污染行业的企业更为显著。总体而言，我们的发现表明，促进利益相关者导向能够对企业支付决策产生显著影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A trade-off theory of ownership and capital structure
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper determines the optimal ownership share held by a unit into a second unit when both face a tax-bankruptcy trade-off. Raw markdown: nicodano-2019-a-trade-off-theory-of-ownership-and-capital Bibliographic Record Authors: Nicodano, G, Regis, L Journal:…
pages.text: A trade-off theory of ownership and capital structure (2019) Paper claim — This paper determines the optimal ownership share held by a unit into a second unit when both face a tax-bankruptcy trade-off. Raw markdown: nicodano-2019-a-trade-off-theory-of-ownership-and-capital Bibliographic Record Authors: Nicodano, G, Regis, L Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2018.09.001 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract This paper determines the optimal ownership share held by a unit into a second unit when both face a tax-bankruptcy trade-off. Full ownership is optimal when the first unit has positive debt, because dividends help avoid its default. Positive debt is, in turn, optimal when its corporate tax rate exceeds a threshold, and/or thin capitalization rules place an upper limit on the debt level in the second unit, and/or the Volcker Rule bans bailout transfers to the second unit. Full ownership is no longer optimal only if there is a tax on intercorporate dividend. This theory rationalizes observations on multinationals, financial conglomerates, and family groups. (C) 2018 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文确定了当一个单位对第二个单位持股、且两者都面临税收-破产权衡时，该单位所持的最优所有权份额。当第一个单位有正债务时，完全所有权是最优的，因为股利有助于避免其违约。而当其企业所得税率超过某一阈值、和/或资本弱化规则（thin capitalization rules）对第二个单位的债务水平设定上限、和/或沃尔克规则（Volcker Rule）禁止向第二个单位进行救助性转移时，正债务反过来又是最优的。只有当对公司间股利征税时，完全所有权才不再是最优的。这一理论使关于跨国公司、金融集团和家族集团的观察结果合理化。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Demographics of dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using seventeen observable demographic characteristics, we investigate the impact of six CEO profiles on dividend policy. Raw markdown: nicolosi-2013-demographics-of-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Nicolosi, G Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year:…
pages.text: Demographics of dividends (2013) Paper claim — Using seventeen observable demographic characteristics, we investigate the impact of six CEO profiles on dividend policy. Raw markdown: nicolosi-2013-demographics-of-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Nicolosi, G Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.07.003 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Using seventeen observable demographic characteristics, we investigate the impact of six CEO profiles on dividend policy. Firms headed by married, Republican, Christian CEOs with children maintain higher dividend yields and are more likely to considerably increase their dividend payout. Following substantial dividend hikes, firms led by CEOs with these more traditional personal lives exhibit deteriorating performance. Potential explanations include managerial optimism coupled with dividend signaling and the possibility that CEO profiles proxy for an unobserved firm effect such as firm maturity. However, the associations above continue to persist in both mature firm and turnover sub-samples. Overall, this suggests that these relationships are related to characteristics of the CEOs themselves. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 使用十七种可观测的人口统计学特征，我们考察六种CEO类型对股利政策的影响。由已婚、共和党、有子女的基督徒CEO领导的企业维持更高的股利收益率，并更可能大幅提高其股利支付。在大幅提高股利之后，由拥有这些较为传统个人生活的CEO领导的企业表现出业绩恶化。可能的解释包括经理人乐观情绪与股利信号传递相结合，以及CEO类型代表了某种不可观测的企业效应（如企业成熟度）的可能性。然而，上述关联在成熟企业和CEO更替子样本中都持续存在。总体而言，这表明这些关系与CEO本身的特征相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article shows how to extract future real activity information from optimally combined size-sorted portfolios. Raw markdown: nieto-2014-volatility-bounds-size-and-real-activity-prediction Bibliographic Record Authors: Nieto, B, Rubio, G Journal: REVIEW OF…
pages.text: Volatility Bounds, Size, and Real Activity Prediction (2014) Paper claim — This article shows how to extract future real activity information from optimally combined size-sorted portfolios. Raw markdown: nieto-2014-volatility-bounds-size-and-real-activity-prediction Bibliographic Record Authors: Nieto, B, Rubio, G Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rft003 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This article shows how to extract future real activity information from optimally combined size-sorted portfolios. In particular, we analyze the capacity of the size-based model-free Hansen-Jagannathan volatility bound to predict future economic growth. We find that the volatility bound is a powerful in-sample and out-of-sample predictor of future industrial production growth. The asymmetric sensitivities of small and large companies through the business cycle explain our findings. Alternative volatility bounds estimated with sorting procedures based on book-to-market, momentum, or dividend yield do not show these asymmetric sensitivities or forecasting capacity of output growth. 摘要（中文） 本文展示了如何从最优组合的按规模排序的投资组合中提取未来实际经济活动信息。特别地，我们分析了基于规模的、无模型的Hansen-Jagannathan波动率界预测未来经济增长的能力。我们发现该波动率界是未来工业生产增长的强有力的样本内和样本外预测变量。小公司和大公司在整个经济周期中的不对称敏感性解释了我们的发现。基于账面市值比、动量或股利收益率的排序程序所估计的替代波动率界并未表现出这些不对称敏感性或对产出增长的预测能力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Asymmetric information, managerial opportunism, financing, and payout policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine corporate issuance and payout policies in the presence. Raw markdown: noe-1996-asymmetric-information-managerial-opportunism-financing-and-payout-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Noe, TH, Rebello, MJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI:…
pages.text: Asymmetric information, managerial opportunism, financing, and payout policies (1996) Paper claim — We examine corporate issuance and payout policies in the presence. Raw markdown: noe-1996-asymmetric-information-managerial-opportunism-financing-and-payout-policies Bibliographic Record Authors: Noe, TH, Rebello, MJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.2307/2329374 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We examine corporate issuance and payout policies in the presence. of both adverse selection (in capital markets) and managerial opportunism. Our results establish the importance of the locus of decision control in the firm. When shareholders determine policies, debt financing is always optimal in the presence of either adverse selection or managerial opportunism. However, when both of these problems are simultaneously present, equity issuance can become an optimal signaling mechanism. Shareholders' most preferred signaling mechanism is restricting dividends, followed by equity financing, and finally underpricing securities. When managers determine policies, a reversed hierarchy may be obtained. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了同时存在（资本市场中的）逆向选择和管理者机会主义时的公司发行和支付政策。我们的结果确立了企业内部决策控制权归属的重要性。当股东决定政策时，在存在逆向选择或管理者机会主义任一情形下，债务融资始终是最优的。然而，当这两个问题同时存在时，股权发行可能成为一种最优的信号传递机制。股东最偏好的信号传递机制是限制股利，其次是股权融资，最后是证券折价发行。当管理者决定政策时，可能得到一个相反的等级次序。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The impact of public information on investors
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates the trading behavior of institutional and individual investors around both finn-specific news releases in the Wall Street Journal and macro-economic announcements. Raw markdown: nofsinger-2001-the-impact-of-public-information-on-investors…
pages.text: The impact of public information on investors (2001) Paper claim — This study investigates the trading behavior of institutional and individual investors around both finn-specific news releases in the Wall Street Journal and macro-economic announcements. Raw markdown: nofsinger-2001-the-impact-of-public-information-on-investors Bibliographic Record Authors: Nofsinger, JR Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(00)00133-3 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This study investigates the trading behavior of institutional and individual investors around both finn-specific news releases in the Wall Street Journal and macro-economic announcements. For the firm-specific news releases we find that investors conduct a high degree of trading around news releases, especially earnings and dividend news. Institutions buy and sell on both good and bad news, while individual investors only trade on good news. The length of the news article (visibility) is also an important attribute to motivate individual investor trading. Lastly, both institutions and individuals buy large firms after good economic news and sell large firms after bad economic news. The trading of small firms does not appear to be motivated by macro-news. (C) 2001 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了机构投资者和个人投资者围绕《华尔街日报》中公司特定新闻发布以及宏观经济公告的交易行为。对于公司特定新闻发布，我们发现投资者围绕新闻发布进行大量交易，尤其是盈利和股利新闻。机构在好消息和坏消息上都进行买卖，而个人投资者只在好消息上交易。新闻文章的长度（能见度）也是激励个人投资者交易的一个重要属性。最后，在好的经济新闻之后，机构和个人都买入大型企业，在坏的经济新闻之后卖出大型企业。小型企业的交易似乎并非由宏观新闻驱动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Share repurchases and firm performance: new evidence on the agency costs of free cash flow
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper we examine tender offer share repurchases to differentiate between the information signaling and free cash flow hypotheses. Raw markdown: nohel-1998-share-repurchases-and-firm-performance-new-evidence-on Bibliographic Record Authors: Nohel, T, Tarhan,…
pages.text: Share repurchases and firm performance: new evidence on the agency costs of free cash flow (1998) Paper claim — In this paper we examine tender offer share repurchases to differentiate between the information signaling and free cash flow hypotheses. Raw markdown: nohel-1998-share-repurchases-and-firm-performance-new-evidence-on Bibliographic Record Authors: Nohel, T, Tarhan, V Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(98)00022-1 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract In this paper we examine tender offer share repurchases to differentiate between the information signaling and free cash flow hypotheses. Previous work in this area has focused on announcement period returns. While we also examine announcement returns, our primary emphasis is on operating performance changes surrounding repurchases. We argue that the information contained in changes in operating performance, and its determinants, enables us to differentiate between the two hypotheses. Our primary finding is that operating performance following repurchases improves only in low-growth firms, and that these gains are generated by more efficient utilization of assets, and asset sales, rather than improved growth opportunities. Thus, repurchases do not appear to be pure financial transactions meant to change the firm's capital structure but are part of a restructuring package meant to shrink the assets of the firm. This evidence leads us to conclude that the positive investor reaction to repurchases is best explained by the free cash flow hypothesis. (C) 1998 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察要约收购式股份回购，以区分信息信号假说与自由现金流假说。该领域以往的研究侧重于公告期收益。虽然我们也考察公告收益，但我们的主要重点是回购前后经营业绩的变化。我们认为，经营业绩变化中所包含的信息及其决定因素使我们能够区分这两种假说。我们的主要发现是，回购后经营业绩仅在低增长企业中有所改善，而且这些收益是由更高效地利用资产和资产出售所产生的，而非改善的增长机会。因此，回购似乎并非旨在改变企业资本结构的纯财务交易，而是旨在收缩企业资产的重组方案的一部分。这一证据使我们得出结论：投资者对回购的正面反应最好用自由现金流假说来解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: The monitoring rationale for dividends and the interaction of capital structure and dividend decisions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops an agency-cost framework for the simultaneous determination of a firm's capital structure and dividend decisions. Raw markdown: noronha-1996-the-monitoring-rationale-for-dividends-and-the-interaction Bibliographic Record Authors: Noronha, GM,…
pages.text: The monitoring rationale for dividends and the interaction of capital structure and dividend decisions (1996) Paper claim — This paper develops an agency-cost framework for the simultaneous determination of a firm's capital structure and dividend decisions. Raw markdown: noronha-1996-the-monitoring-rationale-for-dividends-and-the-interaction Bibliographic Record Authors: Noronha, GM, Shome, DK, Morgan, GE Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(95)00010-0 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative) Abstract This paper develops an agency-cost framework for the simultaneous determination of a firm's capital structure and dividend decisions. In the model, simultaneity is contingent on the applicability of Easterbrook's (1984) monitoring rationale for paying dividends, which, in turn, is hypothesized to depend on the existence of alternative sources of monitoring. Estimations of the Rozeff (1982) specification for dividend payout for subsamples stratified according to the prevalence of non-dividend monitoring mechanisms and growth-induced capital market monitoring, confirm the sample-specific validity of the monitoring rationale. A simultaneous system of equations is then estimated and, consistent with our hypothesis, simultaneity between capital structure and dividend decisions is observed only for the subsample in which the monitoring rationale for dividends is found applicable. 摘要（中文） 本文建立了一个代理成本框架，用于同时决定企业的资本结构和股利决策。在该模型中，同时性取决于伊斯特布鲁克（Easterbrook，1984）支付股利的监督理由的适用性，而这一理由被假设取决于是否存在替代性监督来源。针对根据非股利监督机制和成长引致的资本市场监督的普遍程度所分层的子样本，对罗泽夫（Rozeff，1982）股利支付设定的估计，确认了该监督理由在特定样本中的有效性。随后估计了一个联立方程组，与我们的假设相一致，只有在监督理由被发现适用的子样本中，才观察到资本结构与股利决策之间的同时性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Why do firms announce open-market repurchase programs?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Empirically, a price increase accompanies the announcement of an open-market stock repurchase program, even though the announcement is not a commitment. Raw markdown: oded-2005-why-do-firms-announce-open-market-repurchase-programs Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Why do firms announce open-market repurchase programs? (2005) Paper claim — Empirically, a price increase accompanies the announcement of an open-market stock repurchase program, even though the announcement is not a commitment. Raw markdown: oded-2005-why-do-firms-announce-open-market-repurchase-programs Bibliographic Record Authors: Oded, J Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhh004 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal, trade-off) Abstract Empirically, a price increase accompanies the announcement of an open-market stock repurchase program, even though the announcement is not a commitment. In fact, for many announced programs no shares are ever actually repurchased. This article explores this puzzle. In the single-firm-type version of the model, the option that a firm grants itself by announcing a program does not generate announcement returns. In equilibrium, long-run gains from the informed trading that the option creates are offset by short-run costs from the market's accounting for this adverse selection. Based on this trade-off, I construct a signaling (two-type) model that can deliver announcement returns. In the separating equilibrium, good firms do not incur any cost when they announce programs. Their gains from informed trading in the long run offset the cost of announcement incurred in the short run. Mimicry is costly, because a bad firm's long-run gains from informed trading cannot compensate for the short-run cost of announcing. 摘要（中文） 从经验上看，公开市场股票回购计划的公告伴随着价格上涨，尽管该公告并非一项承诺。事实上，对于许多已宣布的计划，从未实际回购任何股份。本文探讨这一难题。在该模型的单一企业类型版本中，企业通过宣布计划而授予自身的期权并不产生公告收益。在均衡中，该期权所创造的知情交易的长期收益，被市场对这种逆向选择进行计价所产生的短期成本所抵消。基于这种权衡，我构建了一个能够产生公告收益的信号传递（两类型）模型。在分离均衡中，好企业在宣布计划时不承担任何成本。它们从长期知情交易中的收益抵消了短期承担的公告成本。模仿是有代价的，因为坏企业从长期知情交易中的收益无法补偿宣布计划的短期成本。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Stock repurchases: How firms choose between a self tender offer and an open-market program
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In practice, open-market stock repurchase programs outnumber self tender offers by approximately 10-1. Raw markdown: oded-2011-stock-repurchases-how-firms-choose-between-a-self Bibliographic Record Authors: Oded, J Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011…
pages.text: Stock repurchases: How firms choose between a self tender offer and an open-market program (2011) Paper claim — In practice, open-market stock repurchase programs outnumber self tender offers by approximately 10-1. Raw markdown: oded-2011-stock-repurchases-how-firms-choose-between-a-self Bibliographic Record Authors: Oded, J Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2011.05.006 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(stock repurchase)；影响机制(agency, information asymmetry, signal) Abstract In practice, open-market stock repurchase programs outnumber self tender offers by approximately 10-1. This evidence is puzzling given that tender offers are more efficient in disbursing free cash and in signaling undervaluation - the two main motivations suggested in the literature for repurchasing shares. We provide a theoretical model to explore this puzzle. In the model, tender offers disburse free cash quickly but induce information asymmetry and hence require a price premium. Open-market programs disburse free cash slowly, and hence do not require a price premium, but because they are slow, result in partial free cash waste. The model predicts that the likelihood that a tender offer will be chosen over an open-market program increases with the agency costs of free cash and decreases with uncertainty (risk), information asymmetry, ownership concentration, and liquidity. These predictions are generally consistent with the empirical evidence. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在实践中，公开市场股票回购计划的数量约为要约收购的10倍。鉴于要约收购在吐出自由现金以及传递低估信号——文献所提出的回购股份的两个主要动机——方面更为高效，这一证据令人费解。我们提供一个理论模型来探究这一难题。在模型中，要约收购能迅速吐出自由现金，但会诱发信息不对称，因而需要一个价格溢价。公开市场计划缓慢地吐出自由现金，因而不需要价格溢价，但由于其缓慢，会导致部分自由现金的浪费。模型预测，选择要约收购而非公开市场计划的可能性随自由现金的代理成本增加而上升，随不确定性（风险）、信息不对称、所有权集中度和流动性增加而下降。这些预测总体上与实证证据相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Overinvestment, corporate governance, and dividend initiations
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Firms with low Tobin's Q and high cash flow have significantly more positive dividend initiation announcement returns than do other firms. Raw markdown: officer-2011-overinvestment-corporate-governance-and-dividend-initiations Bibliographic Record Authors: Officer,…
pages.text: Overinvestment, corporate governance, and dividend initiations (2011) Paper claim — Firms with low Tobin's Q and high cash flow have significantly more positive dividend initiation announcement returns than do other firms. Raw markdown: officer-2011-overinvestment-corporate-governance-and-dividend-initiations Bibliographic Record Authors: Officer, MS Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2010.06.004 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, overinvestment, signal) Abstract Firms with low Tobin's Q and high cash flow have significantly more positive dividend initiation announcement returns than do other firms. I interpret this result as consistent with the hypothesis that reductions in the agency costs of overinvestment at firms with poor investment opportunities and ample cash flow are reflected in higher dividend initiation announcement returns. Further tests, such as examining the impact of governance metrics on initiation announcement returns following the dividend tax cut of 2003 and examining the long-run cash-retention policies of dividend-initiating firms, are consistent with this interpretation. There is also some evidence that is consistent with the cash flow signaling hypothesis, as dividend-initiating firms with low Tobin's Q and low pre-initiation cash flow experience substantial revisions in analysts' earnings forecasts and significantly positive initiation announcement returns. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 托宾q低而现金流高的企业，其股利启动公告回报显著比其他企业更为正面。我将这一结果解释为与以下假说相一致：投资机会差而现金流充裕的企业在过度投资代理成本方面的降低，反映在更高的股利启动公告回报中。进一步的检验，如考察治理指标对2003年股利减税之后启动公告回报的影响，以及考察股利启动企业的长期现金留存政策，都与这一解释相一致。也有一些证据与现金流信号假说相一致，因为托宾q低且启动前现金流低的股利启动企业经历了分析师盈利预测的大幅上调以及显著为正的启动公告回报。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Expected EPS and EPS growth as determinants of value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops a parsimonious model relating a firm's price per share to, (i), next year expected earnings per share (or 12 months forward eps), (ii), short-term growth (FY-2 versus FY-1) in eps, (iii), long-term (asymptotic) growth in eps, and, (iv),…
pages.text: Expected EPS and EPS growth as determinants of value (2005) Paper claim — This paper develops a parsimonious model relating a firm's price per share to, (i), next year expected earnings per share (or 12 months forward eps), (ii), short-term growth (FY-2 versus FY-1) in eps, (iii), long-term (asymptotic) growth in eps, and, (iv), cost-of-equity capital. Raw markdown: ohlson-2005-expected-eps-and-eps-growth-as-determinants-of Bibliographic Record Authors: Ohlson, JA, Juettner-Nauroth, BE Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-005-1535-3 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, standard)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper develops a parsimonious model relating a firm's price per share to, (i), next year expected earnings per share (or 12 months forward eps), (ii), short-term growth (FY-2 versus FY-1) in eps, (iii), long-term (asymptotic) growth in eps, and, (iv), cost-of-equity capital. The model assumes that the present value of dividends per share (dps) determines price, but it does not restrict how the dps-sequence is expected to evolve. All of these aspects of the model contrast sharply with the standard (Gordon/Williams) text-book approach, which equates the growth rates of expected eps and dps and fixes the growth rate and the payout rate. Though the constant growth model arises as a peculiar special case, the analysis in this paper rests on more general principles, including dividend policy irrelevancy. A second key result inverts the valuation formula to show how one expresses cost-of-capital as a function of the forward eps to price ratio and the two measures of growth in expected eps. This expression generalizes the text-book equation in which cost-of-capital equals the dps-yield plus the growth in expected eps. 摘要（中文） 本文提出了一个简约模型，将企业的每股价格与以下因素联系起来：（i）下一年预期的每股盈余（或未来12个月的eps），（ii）eps的短期增长（第二财年相对于第一财年），（iii）eps的长期（渐近）增长，以及（iv）股权资本成本。该模型假设每股股利（dps）的现值决定价格，但不限制dps序列预期如何演变。模型的所有这些方面都与标准的（Gordon/Williams）教科书方法形成鲜明对比，后者将预期eps与dps的增长率等同起来，并固定增长率和支付率。虽然固定增长模型作为一个特殊情形出现，但本文的分析建立在更一般的原理之上，包括股利政策无关性。第二个关键结果对估值公式进行反演，展示了如何将资本成本表示为远期eps对价格比率以及两个预期eps增长度量的函数。这一表达式推广了教科书中资本成本等于dps收益率加预期eps增长的方程。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: On accounting-based valuation formulae
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper considers accounting-based valuation formulae. Raw markdown: ohlson-2005-on-accounting-based-valuation-formulae Bibliographic Record Authors: Ohlson, JA Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-005-1534-4 Relevance score: 3.5分…
pages.text: On accounting-based valuation formulae (2005) Paper claim — This paper considers accounting-based valuation formulae. Raw markdown: ohlson-2005-on-accounting-based-valuation-formulae Bibliographic Record Authors: Ohlson, JA Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-005-1534-4 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper considers accounting-based valuation formulae. Its initial focus is on two problems related to residual income valuation (RIV). First, insofar valuation depends on theresent value of expected dividends per share, applying RIV requires clean surplus accounting on a per share basis. Awkwardly, equity transactions that change the number of shares outstanding generally imply eps not equivalent to Delta bvps - dps. A clean surplus equality holds only if one "re-conceptualizes" either end-of-period bvps or cps as a forced "plug". Second, one cannot circumvent the per share issue by evaluating RIV on a total dollar value basis unless one introduces relatively subtle MM-type restrictions. In light of RIV's unsatisfactory aspects, the paper proposes an alternative to RIV. This new approach maintains a strict eps-focus. It derives by replacing bvps, in RIV with eps, I capitalized (i.e. divided by r). One obtains a formula such that the current market price equals next-period expected earnings capitalized plus the present value of expected abnormal earnings growth, referred to as AEG. A number of propositions then demonstrate the advantages of the AEG approach as compared to RIV. These results follow because eps(t+1) capitalized generally approximates market price better than bvps(t). 摘要（中文） 本文考察基于会计的估值公式。其最初的焦点是与剩余收益估值（RIV）相关的两个问题。首先，就估值取决于每股预期股利现值而言，应用RIV要求以每股为基础的净盈余会计（clean surplus accounting）。尴尬的是，改变流通股数量的股权交易通常意味着每股收益不等于每股账面价值变化减去每股股利。只有当人们将期末每股账面价值或每股现金重新概念化为一个强制的“配平项”（plug）时，净盈余等式才成立。其次，除非引入相对微妙的MM式限制条件，否则无法通过以总美元价值为基础评估RIV来规避每股问题。鉴于RIV这些令人不满意的方面，本文提出了RIV的一种替代方案。这一新方法维持严格的每股收益焦点。它通过将RIV中的每股账面价值替换为资本化的（即除以r的）每股收益而推导得出。人们得到一个公式，使得当前市场价格等于资本化的下期预期盈利加上预期异常盈利增长（称为AEG）的现值。随后一系列命题证明了AEG方法相比RIV的优势。这些结果之所以成立，是因为资本化的每股收益(t+1)通常比每股账面价值(t)更好地近似市场价格。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Accounting Data and Value: The Basic Results
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops the basic results relating equity value to accounting data - earnings, book values, and dividends. Raw markdown: ohlson-2009-accounting-data-and-value-the-basic-results Bibliographic Record Authors: Ohlson, JA Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING…
pages.text: Accounting Data and Value: The Basic Results (2009) Paper claim — This paper develops the basic results relating equity value to accounting data - earnings, book values, and dividends. Raw markdown: ohlson-2009-accounting-data-and-value-the-basic-results Bibliographic Record Authors: Ohlson, JA Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1506/car.26.1.8 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract This paper develops the basic results relating equity value to accounting data - earnings, book values, and dividends. It contributes by stating all results in simple analytical terms and by gradually bringing out constructs that lead to more sophisticated modeling. A thorough analysis of permanent earnings and economic earnings provides the starting point because of their status as benchmark models. The paper then proceeds by adding features that lead to models with empirical content. Four themes recur throughout. First, the analysis considers both earnings and book values and it shows how their differential properties influence the conceptualization of value. Second, earnings dominate book values as a relevant valuation attribute. Third, much of the analysis centers on explaining the price-to-forward-earnings ratio. Fourth, all insights exploit the (Modigliani and Miller) notion that wealth creation can be conceptualized as being something quite distinct from wealth distribution. 摘要（中文） 本文发展了将权益价值与会计数据——盈余、账面价值和股利——相联系的基本结果。它的贡献在于用简单的解析术语陈述所有结果，并逐步引出通向更为复杂建模的构念。对永久盈余（permanent earnings）和经济盈余（economic earnings）的透彻分析成为出发点，因为它们具有基准模型的地位。随后本文通过添加使模型具有经验内容的特征而推进。有四个主题贯穿始终。第一，分析同时考虑盈余和账面价值，并表明它们的差异性质如何影响价值的概念化。第二，作为一个相关的估值属性，盈余支配账面价值。第三，大部分分析围绕解释价格与前瞻盈余之比（price-to-forward-earnings ratio）展开。第四，所有见解都利用了（Modigliani和Miller的）这样一个理念，即财富创造可以被概念化为与财富分配截然不同的某种东西。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Share reacquisitions, surplus cash, and agency problems
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Share repurchases help alleviate agency costs of surplus cash by restricting management's scope to waste corporate resources. Raw markdown: oswald-2008-share-reacquisitions-surplus-cash-and-agency-problems Bibliographic Record Authors: Oswald, D, Young, S Journal:…
pages.text: Share reacquisitions, surplus cash, and agency problems (2008) Paper claim — Share repurchases help alleviate agency costs of surplus cash by restricting management's scope to waste corporate resources. Raw markdown: oswald-2008-share-reacquisitions-surplus-cash-and-agency-problems Bibliographic Record Authors: Oswald, D, Young, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2007.05.010 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract Share repurchases help alleviate agency costs of surplus cash by restricting management's scope to waste corporate resources. But why do self-interested managers agree to disgorge surplus cash in the first place? This study examines the intervening effect of managerial monitoring and incentive alignment mechanisms on the decision to distribute excess cash through a share repurchase. Findings indicate that repurchases substitute for cash retention decisions that would otherwise prove costly for shareholders, and that better managerial incentive alignment and closer monitoring by external shareholders are important factors stimulating such payouts. (C) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 股份回购有助于通过限制管理层浪费公司资源的空间来缓解盈余现金的代理成本。但为什么自利的经理人一开始会同意吐出盈余现金呢？本研究考察了经理人监督和激励协同机制对通过股份回购分配多余现金这一决策的中介影响。研究结果表明，回购替代了那些原本会对股东造成代价的现金留存决策，并且更好的经理人激励协同以及外部股东更密切的监督是刺激此类支付的重要因素。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Signal strength adjustment behavior: Evidence from share repurchases
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper extends the signaling hypothesis by investigating the signal strength adjustment behavior with respect to the announcement of an open market repurchase (OMR). Raw markdown: ota-2022-signal-strength-adjustment-behavior-evidence-from-share-repurchases…
pages.text: Signal strength adjustment behavior: Evidence from share repurchases (2022) Paper claim — This paper extends the signaling hypothesis by investigating the signal strength adjustment behavior with respect to the announcement of an open market repurchase (OMR). Raw markdown: ota-2022-signal-strength-adjustment-behavior-evidence-from-share-repurchases Bibliographic Record Authors: Ota, K, Lau, D, Kawase, H Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2022.106545 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper extends the signaling hypothesis by investigating the signal strength adjustment behavior with respect to the announcement of an open market repurchase (OMR). Given that an OMR is a non-binding commitment for the repurchasing firm, the stock market would likely scrutinize the credibility of the undervaluation signal from the OMR announcement of the firm. This may compel the manager to engage in various mechanisms in order to strengthen the undervaluation signal of the OMR announcement. This paper investigates whether managers of repurchasing firms would modify the terms of the OMR program when the simultaneous announcements of bad news threaten the credibility of the signal from the OMR announcements. Consistent with our signal strength adjustment hypothesis, we find that managers of repurchasing firms increase (shorten) the repurchase plan size (period) with the magnitude of bad news in the simultaneous announcements. Our results also show that the stock market reacts positively to the signal strength adjustments, indicating that they are informative to the market. These results hold after using various techniques to control for sample selection bias.(c) 2022 The Author(s). Published by Elsevier B.V. This is an open access article under the CC BY license ( http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ) 摘要（中文） 本文通过考察围绕公开市场回购（OMR）公告的信号强度调整行为，扩展了信号假说。鉴于OMR对回购企业而言是一项非约束性承诺，股票市场可能会审视企业OMR公告所发出的低估信号的可信度。这可能迫使管理者采取各种机制以强化OMR公告的低估信号。本文考察，当同时发布的坏消息威胁到OMR公告信号的可信度时，回购企业的管理者是否会修改OMR计划的条款。与我们的信号强度调整假说一致，我们发现回购企业的管理者会随同时公告中坏消息的程度而增加（缩短）回购计划的规模（期限）。我们的结果还表明，股票市场对信号强度调整作出正面反应，表明这些调整对市场具有信息含量。在使用各种技术控制样本选择偏差之后，这些结果依然成立。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Family control and loan collateral: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a sample of 612 listed Chinese non-SOEs from 2006 to 2009, we show that the use of collateral is higher in family-controlled firms. Raw markdown: pan-2016-family-control-and-loan-collateral-evidence-from-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Pan, XF, Tian, GG…
pages.text: Family control and loan collateral: Evidence from China (2016) Paper claim — Using a sample of 612 listed Chinese non-SOEs from 2006 to 2009, we show that the use of collateral is higher in family-controlled firms. Raw markdown: pan-2016-family-control-and-loan-collateral-evidence-from-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Pan, XF, Tian, GG Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2016.02.003 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract Using a sample of 612 listed Chinese non-SOEs from 2006 to 2009, we show that the use of collateral is higher in family-controlled firms. This effect is more pronounced when family firms have a larger control ownership wedge, family representation in management, and are led by a descendant chairman/CEO. We further document that having multiple large shareholders, paying higher dividends, having completed the split-share structure reform and being located in provinces with more competitive credit markets can mitigate the incentive of controlling families to engage in expropriation and reduce the level of collateral required. Overall, we contend that in China, the risk of expropriation associated with family control leads to an increased credit risk and, in turn, higher collateral being required by banks. Crown Copyright (C) 2016 Published by Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 使用2006至2009年间612家中国上市非国有企业的样本，我们表明抵押品的使用在家族控制企业中更高。当家族企业拥有更大的控制权与所有权楔子（control ownership wedge）、家族在管理层中有代表、并由后代董事长/CEO领导时，这一效应更为显著。我们进一步记录到，拥有多个大股东、派发更高股利、已完成股权分置改革以及位于信贷市场更具竞争性省份的企业，可以缓解控制性家族进行侵占的动机，并降低所需抵押品的水平。总体而言，我们认为在中国，与家族控制相关的侵占风险导致信用风险增加，进而导致银行要求更高的抵押品。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Revisiting Asset Pricing Puzzles in an Exchange Economy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that several well-known asset pricing puzzles are largely mitigated if we endow the representative agent with an arbitrarily small minimum consumption level. Raw markdown: parlour-2011-revisiting-asset-pricing-puzzles-in-an-exchange-economy Bibliographic…
pages.text: Revisiting Asset Pricing Puzzles in an Exchange Economy (2011) Paper claim — We show that several well-known asset pricing puzzles are largely mitigated if we endow the representative agent with an arbitrarily small minimum consumption level. Raw markdown: parlour-2011-revisiting-asset-pricing-puzzles-in-an-exchange-economy Bibliographic Record Authors: Parlour, CA, Stanton, R, Walden, J Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhq130 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We show that several well-known asset pricing puzzles are largely mitigated if we endow the representative agent with an arbitrarily small minimum consumption level. This allows us to solve the model for parameter values where the standard "Lucas tree" model is not defined. For these parameters, disasters become more important, and the market risk premium therefore higher, even though consumption is less risky. Our model yields reasonable risk premia, Sharpe ratios, and discount rates; excess price volatility; and a high market price-dividend ratio. We derive closed-form solutions for all variables of interest. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，如果赋予代表性主体一个任意小的最低消费水平，则若干著名的资产定价难题在很大程度上得到缓解。这使我们能够在标准"Lucas树"模型无法定义的参数值下求解该模型。对于这些参数，灾难变得更为重要，因而市场风险溢价更高，尽管消费的风险更小。我们的模型产生了合理的风险溢价、夏普比率和贴现率；产生了过度的价格波动；以及很高的市场价格-股利比。我们为所有关心的变量推导出了闭式解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Financial Flexibility, Bank Capital Flows, and Asset Prices
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In our parsimonious general-equilibrium model of banking and asset pricing, intermediaries have the expertise to monitor and reallocate capital. Raw markdown: parlour-2012-financial-flexibility-bank-capital-flows-and-asset-prices Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Financial Flexibility, Bank Capital Flows, and Asset Prices (2012) Paper claim — In our parsimonious general-equilibrium model of banking and asset pricing, intermediaries have the expertise to monitor and reallocate capital. Raw markdown: parlour-2012-financial-flexibility-bank-capital-flows-and-asset-prices Bibliographic Record Authors: Parlour, CA, Stanton, R, Walden, J Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2012.01770.x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract In our parsimonious general-equilibrium model of banking and asset pricing, intermediaries have the expertise to monitor and reallocate capital. We study financial development, intraeconomy capital flows, the size of the banking sector, the value of intermediation, expected market returns, and the risk of bank crashes. Asset pricing implications include: a markets dividend yield is related to its financial flexibility, and capital flows should be important in explaining expected returns and the risk of bank crashes. Our predictions are broadly consistent with the aggregate behavior of U.S. capital markets since 1950. 摘要（中文） 在我们简约的银行业与资产定价一般均衡模型中，中介机构拥有监控和重新配置资本的专业能力。我们研究了金融发展、经济体内部资本流动、银行业部门规模、中介价值、预期市场收益和银行崩盘风险。资产定价方面的含义包括：市场的股利收益率与其财务灵活性相关，且资本流动在解释预期收益和银行崩盘风险方面应当很重要。我们的预测与1950年以来美国资本市场的总体行为大体一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
