pages.title: Taxes and dividend policy under alternative tax regimes
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines changes in corporate dividend policy around the introduction of a dividend imputation tax system. Raw markdown: pattenden-2008-taxes-and-dividend-policy-under-alternative-tax-regimes Bibliographic Record Authors: Pattenden, K, Twite, G Journal:…
pages.text: Taxes and dividend policy under alternative tax regimes (2008) Paper claim — This paper examines changes in corporate dividend policy around the introduction of a dividend imputation tax system. Raw markdown: pattenden-2008-taxes-and-dividend-policy-under-alternative-tax-regimes Bibliographic Record Authors: Pattenden, K, Twite, G Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2007.09.002 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper examines changes in corporate dividend policy around the introduction of a dividend imputation tax system. This represented a significant change to the Australian tax framework and allows us to test the effect of differential taxation on corporate dividend policy. Consistent with the tax preference for the distribution of dividends, we find dividend initiations, all dividend payout measures and dividend reinvestment plans increased with the introduction of dividend imputation. Similarly we find that gross dividend payouts are more volatile under dividend imputation. Finally, we find that the increase in dividend payout and initiations differs across firms. In particular, we find that the higher the level of available franking tax credits the higher the firm's gross dividend payout and the more likely the firm is to initiate a dividend. (c) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察在引入股利抵免税制前后企业股利政策的变化。这代表了澳大利亚税收框架的一次重大变化，使我们能够检验差异化征税对企业股利政策的影响。与股利分配的税收偏好相一致，我们发现，随着股利抵免的引入，股利启动、所有股利支付度量以及股利再投资计划都有所增加。同样，我们发现，在股利抵免制下，总股利支付更加波动。最后，我们发现，股利支付和启动的增加在不同企业间存在差异。特别是，我们发现，可用的税收抵免额水平越高，企业的总股利支付就越高，企业启动股利的可能性也越大。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: On Comparing Cash Flow and Accrual Accounting Models for Use in Equity Valuation: A Response to Lundholm and O'Keefe (CAR, Summer 2001)
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A claim is commonly made that cash flow and accrual accounting methods for valuing equities must always yield equivalent valuations. Raw markdown: penman-2001-on-comparing-cash-flow-and-accrual-accounting-models Bibliographic Record Authors: Penman, SH Journal:…
pages.text: On Comparing Cash Flow and Accrual Accounting Models for Use in Equity Valuation: A Response to Lundholm and O'Keefe (CAR, Summer 2001) (2001) Paper claim — A claim is commonly made that cash flow and accrual accounting methods for valuing equities must always yield equivalent valuations. Raw markdown: penman-2001-on-comparing-cash-flow-and-accrual-accounting-models Bibliographic Record Authors: Penman, SH Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1506/DT0R-JNEG-QL60-7CBP Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract A claim is commonly made that cash flow and accrual accounting methods for valuing equities must always yield equivalent valuations. A recent paper by Lundholm and O'Keefe 2001, for example, claims that, because of this equivalence, there is nothing to be learned from empirical comparison of valuation models. So they dismiss recent research that has shown that accrual accounting residual income models and earnings capitalization models perform, over a range of conditions, better than cash flow or dividend discount models. This paper demonstrates, with examples, that the claim is misguided. Practice inevitably involves forecasting over finite, truncated horizons, and the accounting specified in a model - cash versus accrual accounting in particular - is pertinent to valuation with finite-horizon forecasting. Indeed, the issue of choosing a valuation model is an issue of specifying pro forma accounting, and so, for finite-horizon forecasts, one cannot be indifferent to the accounting. 摘要（中文） 人们普遍宣称，用于股权估值的现金流会计方法和权责发生制会计方法必须始终产生等价的估值。例如，Lundholm和O'Keefe（2001）近期的一篇论文宣称，由于这种等价性，从估值模型的实证比较中无可学习。因此他们否定了近期研究，这些研究表明权责发生制会计的剩余收益模型和收益资本化模型在一系列条件下的表现优于现金流或股利贴现模型。本文用例子证明这一宣称是错误的。实践不可避免地涉及在有限的、截断的视野上进行预测，而模型中所规定的会计——特别是现金会计与权责发生制会计——与有限视野预测下的估值相关。实际上，选择估值模型的问题就是设定形式化会计的问题，因此对于有限视野预测，人们不可能对会计漠不关心。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A Matter of Principle: Accounting Reports Convey Both Cash-Flow News and Discount-Rate News
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper modifies the standard returns-earnings regression in accounting research to show that financial reports convey both cash-flow news and discount-rate (expected-return) news. Raw markdown: penman-2019-a-matter-of-principle-accounting-reports-convey-both…
pages.text: A Matter of Principle: Accounting Reports Convey Both Cash-Flow News and Discount-Rate News (2019) Paper claim — This paper modifies the standard returns-earnings regression in accounting research to show that financial reports convey both cash-flow news and discount-rate (expected-return) news. Raw markdown: penman-2019-a-matter-of-principle-accounting-reports-convey-both Bibliographic Record Authors: Penman, SH, Yehuda, N Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2018.3187 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper modifies the standard returns-earnings regression in accounting research to show that financial reports convey both cash-flow news and discount-rate (expected-return) news. The paper points to the realization principle, associated as it is with the resolution of risk, as the accounting feature that conveys expected-return news. The modified returns-earnings regressions indicate that the information so conveyed pertains to priced risk. In corroboration, the paper also shows that the identified expected-return news forecasts changes in both stock return betas and earnings betas, and expected-return news predicts future returns, whereas cash-flow news does not. The analysis yields a number of additional insights: financial statements distinguish expected-return news associated with operations from that associated with financing activities; given accounting information, there is not much news in dividends; and, in comparing the information content of earnings versus cash flows, cash flows largely convey expected-return news rather than cash-flow news. In sum, the paper shows that the objective of the Financial Accounting Standards Board and International Accounting Standards Board to provide information about the amount and uncertainty of future cash flows is (as least, partially) satisfied by accounting principles underlying current financial reporting. 摘要（中文） 本文修改了会计研究中标准的收益-盈余回归，以表明财务报告同时传递现金流消息和贴现率（预期收益）消息。本文指出，实现原则（realization principle）由于与风险的解决相关联，是传递预期收益消息的会计特征。修改后的收益-盈余回归表明，如此传递的信息与被定价的风险相关。作为佐证，本文还表明，所识别的预期收益消息能够预测股票收益贝塔和盈余贝塔的变化，且预期收益消息能够预测未来收益，而现金流消息则不能。分析产生了若干额外洞见：财务报表将与经营相关的预期收益消息与与融资活动相关的预期收益消息区分开来；在给定会计信息的条件下，股利中没有太多消息；且在比较盈余与现金流的信息内容时，现金流主要传递预期收益消息而非现金流消息。总之，本文表明，财务会计准则委员会和国际会计准则委员会提供关于未来现金流数量和不确定性信息的目标，（至少部分地）由支撑当前财务报告的会计原则所满足。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a new approach to modeling dynamics in cash flows extracted from daily firm-level dividend announcements. Raw markdown: pettenuzzo-2020-cash-flow-news-and-stock-price-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: Pettenuzzo, D, Sabbatucci, R, Timmermann, A…
pages.text: Cash Flow News and Stock Price Dynamics (2020) Paper claim — We develop a new approach to modeling dynamics in cash flows extracted from daily firm-level dividend announcements. Raw markdown: pettenuzzo-2020-cash-flow-news-and-stock-price-dynamics Bibliographic Record Authors: Pettenuzzo, D, Sabbatucci, R, Timmermann, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1111/jofi.12901 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We develop a new approach to modeling dynamics in cash flows extracted from daily firm-level dividend announcements. We decompose daily cash flow news into a persistent component, jumps, and temporary shocks. Empirically, we find that the persistent cash flow component is a highly significant predictor of future growth in dividends and consumption. Using a log-linearized present value model, we show that news about the persistent dividend growth component predicts stock returns consistent with asset pricing constraints implied by this model. News about the daily dividend growth process also helps explain concurrent return volatility and the probability of jumps in stock returns. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一种新方法，用以对从公司层面每日股利公告中提取的现金流动态进行建模。我们将每日现金流信息分解为一个持久性成分、跳跃以及暂时性冲击。实证上，我们发现持久性现金流成分是未来股利和消费增长的高度显著的预测变量。利用对数线性化的现值模型，我们表明关于持久性股利增长成分的信息可以预测股票收益，其结果与该模型所隐含的资产定价约束相一致。关于每日股利增长过程的信息还有助于解释同期收益波动率以及股票收益出现跳跃的概率。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Raw markdown: piatti-2020-dividend-growth-predictability-and-the-price-dividend-ratio Bibliographic Record Authors: Piatti, I, Trojani, F Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2018.3155 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Asymptotic tests over-reject the null of no predictability in present-value models. We develop a nonparametric testing approach in state-space models, implying reliable finite sample inference under weak assumptions on price-dividend ratio and dividend shocks. We find sharp evidence of return predictability in postwar U.S. data but less consistent evidence of dividend predictability, which is significant only using cash-flow proxies reflecting information from mergers and acquisitions. These findings reconcile the diverging conclusions of present-value models and common predictive regressions in a way that is robust to the choice of the predictive variables, the sample period, and alternative cash-flow proxies. 摘要（中文） 渐近检验在现值模型中过度拒绝了无可预测性的原假设。我们在状态空间模型中提出了一种非参数检验方法，在对股利-价格比和股利冲击施加较弱假设的情况下，可实现可靠的有限样本推断。我们发现在二战后美国数据中存在收益可预测性的显著证据，但股利可预测性的证据不那么一致，只有在使用反映并购信息的现金流代理变量时才显著。这些发现以一种对预测变量选择、样本期以及备选现金流代理变量均稳健的方式，调和了现值模型与常见预测回归之间的分歧结论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Despite serious governance concerns revealed in Rule 144A and/or Regulation S Global Depositary Receipt (GDR) circulars, institutional investors voluntarily purchase these illiquid securities. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Raising capital in emerging markets with restricted Global Depositary Receipts (2010) Paper claim — Despite serious governance concerns revealed in Rule 144A and/or Regulation S Global Depositary Receipt (GDR) circulars, institutional investors voluntarily purchase these illiquid securities. Raw markdown: pinegar-2010-raising-capital-in-emerging-markets-with-restricted-global Bibliographic Record Authors: Pinegar, JM, Ravichandran, R Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2010.06.007 Relevance score: 9.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, institution, regulat, rule)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Despite serious governance concerns revealed in Rule 144A and/or Regulation S Global Depositary Receipt (GDR) circulars, institutional investors voluntarily purchase these illiquid securities. Like issuers of Level Ill American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), GDR issuers exhibit strong pre-offer performance, with higher average Tobin's q ratios, sales growth rates, sales levels, returns on equity, and dividend payout ratios than their home-market counterparts. However, GDRs are issued predominantly by firms in emerging markets, while ADRs are issued mostly by firms in developed markets. After controlling for country and industry effects, we find that ADR issuers are larger and that they employ more reputable underwriters than GDR issuers do, but no other significant differences emerge. Notwithstanding their similarities, GDRs have larger discounts than ADRs, suggesting that legal bonding provides benefits that reputational bonding cannot fully replicate. However, within the sample of GDRs, pre-offer performance attributes also influence pricing. Specifically, discounts vary inversely with issue size but directly with firm size, suggesting that economies of scale exist in the GDR issue process and that potential agency costs are higher in larger firms. GDR discounts also vary inversely with incremental returns on equity in all partitions of the data, indicating the importance of pre-offer profitability in establishing the reputation of the issuing firm and in increasing the GDR offer price. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 尽管在规则144A和/或条例S全球存托凭证（GDR）募集说明书中揭示了严重的治理顾虑，机构投资者仍自愿购买这些流动性差的证券。与三级美国存托凭证（ADR）的发行人一样，GDR发行人表现出强劲的发行前业绩，其平均托宾q比率、销售增长率、销售水平、净资产收益率和股利支付率均高于其本国市场同行。然而，GDR主要由新兴市场的企业发行，而ADR主要由发达市场的企业发行。在控制了国家和行业效应之后，我们发现ADR发行人规模更大、聘用的承销商比GDR发行人更有声誉，但未出现其他显著差异。尽管两者相似，GDR的折价比ADR更大，这表明法律约束提供了声誉约束无法完全复制的收益。然而，在GDR样本内，发行前业绩属性也影响定价。具体而言，折价与发行规模成反比，但与企业规模成正比，这表明GDR发行过程存在规模经济，且较大企业的潜在代理成本更高。在数据的所有分区中，GDR折价还与净资产收益率的增量成反比，这表明发行前盈利能力在确立发行企业声誉和提高GDR发行价格中的重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Does the contribution of corporate cash holdings and dividends to firm value depend on governance? A cross-country analysis (2006) Paper claim — Agency theories predict that the value of corporate cash holdings is less in countries with poor investor protection because of the greater ability of controlling shareholders to extract private benefits from cash holdings in such countries. Raw markdown: pinkowitz-2006-does-the-contribution-of-corporate-cash-holdings-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Pinkowitz, L, Stulz, R, Williamson, R Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2006.01003.x Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, investor protection)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract Agency theories predict that the value of corporate cash holdings is less in countries with poor investor protection because of the greater ability of controlling shareholders to extract private benefits from cash holdings in such countries. Using various specifications of the valuation regressions of Farna and French (1998), we find that the relation between cash holdings and firm value is much weaker in countries with poor investor protection than in other countries. In further support of the importance of agency theories, the relation between dividends and firm value is weaker in countries with stronger investor protection. 摘要（中文） 代理理论预测，在投资者保护较差的国家，公司现金持有的价值较低，因为在这类国家控股股东从现金持有中攫取私人收益的能力更强。使用Fama和French（1998）估值回归的各种设定，我们发现，在投资者保护较差的国家，现金持有与企业价值之间的关系比其他国家弱得多。进一步支持代理理论重要性的是，在投资者保护较强的国家，股利与企业价值之间的关系较弱。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper shows that belief differences have strong effects on asset prices in consumption-based asset-pricing models with long-run risks. Raw markdown: pohl-2021-asset-pricing-with-heterogeneous-agents-and-long-run Bibliographic Record Authors: Pohl, W,…
pages.text: Asset pricing with heterogeneous agents and long-run risk (2021) Paper claim — This paper shows that belief differences have strong effects on asset prices in consumption-based asset-pricing models with long-run risks. Raw markdown: pohl-2021-asset-pricing-with-heterogeneous-agents-and-long-run Bibliographic Record Authors: Pohl, W, Schmedders, K, Wilms, O Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.01.005 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper shows that belief differences have strong effects on asset prices in consumption-based asset-pricing models with long-run risks. Belief heterogeneity leads to time-varying consumption and wealth shares of the agents. This time variation can resolve several asset-pricing puzzles, including the large countercyclical variation of expected risk premia, the volatility of the price-dividend ratio, the predictability of cash flows and re-turns, and the large predictability of returns in recessions. These findings show that belief differences, a widely observed attribute of investors, significantly improve the explanatory power of long-run risk asset-pricing models. (c) 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文表明，在具有长期风险的基于消费的资产定价模型中，信念差异对资产价格具有强烈影响。信念异质性导致主体的消费份额和财富份额随时间变化。这种时间变化能够解决若干资产定价谜题，包括预期风险溢价的大幅逆周期变化、价格—股利比率的波动性、现金流和收益的可预测性以及衰退期收益的高度可预测性。这些发现表明，信念差异这一被广泛观察到的投资者属性，显著提高了长期风险资产定价模型的解释力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Earnings components, accounting bias and equity valuation (2005) Paper claim — In this paper we address three issues in accounting-based equity valuation: (i) How are valuation parameters related to earnings persistence and accounting conservatism when earnings components aggregate, or "add up", in valuation? (ii) What does aggregation of earnings components in valuation imply for abnormal earnings dynamics? and (iii) When is an earnings component "irrelevant" and "core" earnings the relevant construct for valuation? Assuming linear valuation, no-arbitrage, dividend irrelevance and clean surplus accounting, we show that when earnings components aggregate. Raw markdown: pope-2005-earnings-components-accounting-bias-and-equity-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Pope, PF, Wang, PG Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2005 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-005-4207-4 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(replace) Abstract In this paper we address three issues in accounting-based equity valuation: (i) How are valuation parameters related to earnings persistence and accounting conservatism when earnings components aggregate, or "add up", in valuation? (ii) What does aggregation of earnings components in valuation imply for abnormal earnings dynamics? and (iii) When is an earnings component "irrelevant" and "core" earnings the relevant construct for valuation? Assuming linear valuation, no-arbitrage, dividend irrelevance and clean surplus accounting, we show that when earnings components aggregate. valuation expressions and abnormal earnings dynamics are generalizations of the Ohlson (1995) model, incorporating simple adjustments for accounting conservatism. When "core" earnings are the relevant earnings construct, valuation expressions closely resemble the aggregation case, but core (abnormal) earnings replaces clean surplus (abnormal) earnings. We demonstrate that an earnings component can be irrelevant in valuation even when it is predictable. 摘要（中文） 在本文中，我们讨论了基于会计的股权估值中的三个问题：（i）当盈余成分在估值中聚合，或“相加”时，估值参数如何与盈余持久性和会计稳健性相关联？（ii）盈余成分在估值中的聚合对异常盈余动态意味着什么？（iii）何时某一盈余成分“不相关”，而“核心”盈余才是估值的相关构念？在假定线性估值、无套利、股利无关性和干净盈余会计的前提下，我们表明当盈余成分聚合时，估值表达式和异常盈余动态是Ohlson（1995）模型的推广，纳入了对会计稳健性的简单调整。当“核心”盈余是相关的盈余构念时，估值表达式与聚合情形非常相似，但核心（异常）盈余取代了干净盈余（异常）盈余。我们证明，即使某一盈余成分是可预测的，它在估值中也可能不相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — As the dust settles on the recent frenzy of private equity deals (including transactions topping $20 billion), what lessons can companies glean? Directors and executives of public companies may now be slightly less fearful of imminent takeover, yet the pressure…
pages.text: If Private Equity Sized Up Your Business (2007) Paper claim — As the dust settles on the recent frenzy of private equity deals (including transactions topping $20 billion), what lessons can companies glean? Directors and executives of public companies may now be slightly less fearful of imminent takeover, yet the pressure remains: They face shareholders who wonder why they aren't getting private-equity-level returns. Raw markdown: pozen-2007-if-private-equity-sized-up-your-business Bibliographic Record Authors: Pozen, RC Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 2007 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, monitor, reform)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend) Abstract As the dust settles on the recent frenzy of private equity deals (including transactions topping $20 billion), what lessons can companies glean? Directors and executives of public companies may now be slightly less fearful of imminent takeover, yet the pressure remains: They face shareholders who wonder why they aren't getting private-equity-level returns. Rather than dismiss the value private equity has created as manipulated or aberrant, public company leaders should recognize the disciplined management that often underlies it. Pozen, a longtime leader in the financial services industry, finds that in the aftermath of buyouts, companies undergo five major thrusts of reform. These translate into five key questions that directors should pose to senior management: Have we left too much cash on our balance sheet instead of raising our cash dividends or buying back shares? Do we have the optimal capital structure, with the lowest weighted after-tax cost of total capital, including debt and equity? Do we have an operating plan that will significantly increase shareholder value, with specific metrics to monitor performance? Are the compensation rewards for our top executives tied closely enough to increases in shareholder value, with real penalties for nonperformance? Finally, does our board have enough industry experts who have made the time commitments and been given the financial incentives necessary to maximize shareholder value? The era of private equity is far from over - the top funds have become very large and are likely to play an influential role in future market cycles. Boards that ask these questions, and act on them, won't just beat the takeover artists to the punch. They will build stronger businesses. 摘要（中文） 随着近期私募股权交易（包括金额超过200亿美元的交易）狂潮尘埃落定，企业能从中汲取哪些教训？上市公司的董事和高管现在或许对迫在眉睫的收购稍感不那么恐惧，但压力依然存在：他们面对的股东会疑惑为何自己没有获得私募股权级别的回报。上市公司领导者不应把私募股权创造的价值斥之为被操纵的或反常的，而应认识到其背后往往蕴含的严格管理。作为金融服务业的长期领军人物，Pozen发现，在收购完成后，企业会经历五大改革推动。这些转化为董事应向高级管理层提出的五个关键问题：我们是否在资产负债表上留存了过多现金，而没有提高现金股利或回购股份？我们是否拥有最优资本结构，即包括债务和权益在内的总资本加权税后成本最低？我们是否拥有一项能够显著提升股东价值、并配有监控业绩的具体指标的经营计划？我们对高层高管的薪酬奖励是否与股东价值的提升足够紧密地挂钩，并对不达标设有真正的惩罚？最后，我们的董事会是否拥有足够多的行业专家，他们投入了时间承诺并被给予了实现股东价值最大化所必需的财务激励？私募股权时代远未结束——顶级基金已变得非常庞大，很可能在未来的市场周期中发挥有影响力的作用。提出这些问题并据此行动的董事会，将不只是抢在收购高手之前出手，他们还将建立更强大的企业。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study examines the influence of Mexico's efforts to improve corporate governance on firm performance and transparency. Raw markdown: price-2011-the-impact-of-governance-reform-on-performance-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Price, R, Román, FJ, Rountree, B…
pages.text: The impact of governance reform on performance and transparency (2011) Paper claim — This study examines the influence of Mexico's efforts to improve corporate governance on firm performance and transparency. Raw markdown: price-2011-the-impact-of-governance-reform-on-performance-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Price, R, Román, FJ, Rountree, B Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2010.08.005 Relevance score: 11.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, compliance, enforce, governance, institution, monitor, reform, transparency)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency) Abstract This study examines the influence of Mexico's efforts to improve corporate governance on firm performance and transparency. We utilize compliance data from the Code of 'Best' Corporate Practices, disclosed annually by public firms in Mexico, as a measure of corporate governance strength. We document a significant increase in compliance over 2000-2004 indicating Mexican companies view non-compliance as costly. However, we find no association between the governance index and firm performance, nor is there a relation with transparency. Instead, we find firms with greater compliance resort to the more costly mechanism of making dividend payments (higher propensity to pay and greater yield) to reduce agency conflicts. We conclude these associations are the direct result of the institutional features of the Mexican business environment, which is characterized by concentrated ownership of insiders, interlocked boards of directors, a lack of insider trading enforcement, and generally poor protection of minority investors. Our results show that monitoring mechanisms alone are not enough to fundamentally change economic behavior. (C) 2010 Elsevier BM. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察墨西哥改善公司治理的努力对企业绩效和透明度的影响。我们利用墨西哥上市公司每年披露的《最佳公司实践准则》的合规数据作为公司治理强度的度量。我们记录到2000至2004年期间合规度显著增加，表明墨西哥公司将不合规视为代价高昂。然而，我们发现治理指数与企业绩效之间没有关联，与透明度之间也没有关系。相反，我们发现合规度更高的企业诉诸更为昂贵的机制——进行股利派发（更高的派发倾向和更大的收益率）来减少代理冲突。我们得出结论，这些关联是墨西哥商业环境制度特征的直接结果，该环境的特点是内部人所有权集中、董事会交叉任职、缺乏内幕交易执法以及对少数股东投资者普遍薄弱的保护。我们的结果表明，仅靠监督机制不足以从根本上改变经济行为。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Earnings conference calls and stock returns: The incremental informativeness of textual tone
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Quarterly earnings conference calls are becoming a more pervasive tool for corporate disclosure. Raw markdown: price-2012-earnings-conference-calls-and-stock-returns-the-incremental Bibliographic Record Authors: Price, SM, Doran, JS, Peterson, DR, Bliss, BA…
pages.text: Earnings conference calls and stock returns: The incremental informativeness of textual tone (2012) Paper claim — Quarterly earnings conference calls are becoming a more pervasive tool for corporate disclosure. Raw markdown: price-2012-earnings-conference-calls-and-stock-returns-the-incremental Bibliographic Record Authors: Price, SM, Doran, JS, Peterson, DR, Bliss, BA Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2011.10.013 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Quarterly earnings conference calls are becoming a more pervasive tool for corporate disclosure. However, the extent to which the market embeds information contained in the tone (i.e. sentiment) of conference call wording is unknown. Using computer aided content analysis, we examine the incremental informativeness of quarterly earnings conference calls and the corresponding market reaction. We find that conference call linguistic tone is a significant predictor of abnormal returns and trading volume. Furthermore, conference call tone dominates earnings surprises over the 60 trading days following the call. The question and answer portion of the call has incremental explanatory power for the post-earnings-announcement drift and this significance is primarily concentrated in firms that do not pay dividends, illustrating differences in investor behavior based on the level of cash flow uncertainty. Additionally, we find that a context specific linguistic dictionary is more powerful than a more widely used general dictionary (Harvard IV-4 Psychosocial). (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 季度盈利电话会议正日益成为一种更普遍的公司披露工具。然而，市场在多大程度上嵌入电话会议措辞的语气（即情绪）所包含的信息尚不清楚。使用计算机辅助的内容分析，我们考察季度盈利电话会议的增量信息含量以及相应的市场反应。我们发现电话会议的语言语气是异常收益和交易量的显著预测因子。此外，在电话会议后的60个交易日内，电话会议语气的作用超过了盈利意外。电话会议的问答部分对盈余公告后漂移（post-earnings-announcement drift）具有增量解释力，且这种显著性主要集中在不派发股利的企业中，这说明了基于现金流不确定性水平的投资者行为差异。此外，我们发现特定情境的语言词典比更广泛使用的通用词典（哈佛IV-4心理社会词典）更为有力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Can investors restrict managerial behavior in distressed firms?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this article, we show that only distressed firms not identified as distressed by creditors are able to transfer wealth from creditors to shareholders. Raw markdown: pryshchepa-2013-can-investors-restrict-managerial-behavior-in-distressed-firms Bibliographic…
pages.text: Can investors restrict managerial behavior in distressed firms? (2013) Paper claim — In this article, we show that only distressed firms not identified as distressed by creditors are able to transfer wealth from creditors to shareholders. Raw markdown: pryshchepa-2013-can-investors-restrict-managerial-behavior-in-distressed-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Pryshchepa, O, Aretz, K, Banerjee, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.08.006 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(payout) Abstract In this article, we show that only distressed firms not identified as distressed by creditors are able to transfer wealth from creditors to shareholders. Using the number of years to future bankruptcy as a proxy for genuine distress and measures based on observable firm characteristics as proxies for perceived distress, genuinely distressed firms incorrectly perceived as healthy cut payouts to shareholders more slowly and invest more aggressively as uncertainty increases than correctly identified distressed firms. Consistent with the idea that incorrectly identified distressed firms actively hide their troubles, we show that they tend to follow more aggressive accounting policies and often resort to earnings misstatements. We also show that they are often not restricted by covenants and can borrow further debt capital at affordable rates, suggesting that a lack of monitoring by creditors allows them to transfer wealth to shareholders. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 在本文中，我们表明只有那些未被债权人识别为陷入困境的困境企业，才能够将财富从债权人转移给股东。使用距未来破产的年数作为真实困境的代理变量，并使用基于可观察企业特征的度量作为感知困境的代理变量，我们发现被错误地感知为健康的真实困境企业，相比被正确识别的困境企业，随着不确定性增加，更缓慢地削减对股东的派现并更激进地投资。与“被错误识别的困境企业主动掩盖其困境”这一观点一致，我们表明它们倾向于采用更激进的会计政策，并常常诉诸盈余错报。我们还表明，它们常常不受契约条款约束，并能以可负担的利率进一步借入债务资本，这表明债权人监督的缺失使它们能够将财富转移给股东。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The risk-shifting value of payout: Evidence from bank enforcement actions
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper reexamines whether investors value payout and why. Raw markdown: pugachev-2022-the-risk-shifting-value-of-payout-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Pugachev, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2019.07.015…
pages.text: The risk-shifting value of payout: Evidence from bank enforcement actions (2022) Paper claim — This paper reexamines whether investors value payout and why. Raw markdown: pugachev-2022-the-risk-shifting-value-of-payout-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Pugachev, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2019.07.015 Relevance score: 11.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, regulat)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative) Abstract This paper reexamines whether investors value payout and why. I study abnormal stock returns around regulatory enforcement actions that restrict bank dividends and repurchases. Market reactions are significantly worse for enforced banks that pay out than for those that do not. Withstanding alternative explanations and parallel trend concerns, these results present rare, causal evidence of a value to corporate distribution. The cross-section of abnormal returns suggests that risk-shifting, not agency cost-reduction, drives payout. In my sample of distressed banks, especially around financial crises, the ability to shift risk through payout has value. (c) 2019 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文重新审视投资者是否重视支付以及原因何在。我研究了限制银行股利和回购的监管执法行动前后的异常股票回报。对于进行支付的受执法银行，市场反应明显比不进行支付的银行更差。在经受住替代性解释和平行趋势顾虑后，这些结果提供了关于企业分配价值的罕见因果证据。异常回报的横截面表明，驱动支付的是风险转移，而非代理成本的降低。在我的困境银行样本中，尤其是在金融危机前后，通过支付来转移风险的能力具有价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Social Trust and Dividend Payouts: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Chinese firms in low-trust provinces pay significantly higher cash dividends than those in high-trust provinces, consistent with social trust substituting for formal governance mechanisms and reducing the pressure on firms to pay dividends as a governance device.…
pages.text: Social Trust and Dividend Payouts: Evidence from China (2022) Paper claim — Chinese firms in low-trust provinces pay significantly higher cash dividends than those in high-trust provinces, consistent with social trust substituting for formal governance mechanisms and reducing the pressure on firms to pay dividends as a governance device. Raw markdown: qin-2022-social-trust-and-dividend-payouts-evidence-from-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Qin, Wei; Liang, Quanxi; Jiao, Yan; Lu, Meiting; Shan, Yaowen Journal: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2022.101726 Abstract Social trust helps to reduce information asymmetry and agency conflicts between insiders and investors, and thus alleviates the pressure on firms to pay cash dividends. Consistent with this view, we find that Chinese firms in low-trust regions make higher dividend payouts than those in high-trust regions. The negative effect of trust is more pronounced in firms with lower information transparency and weaker corporate governance. We additionally find a lower market reaction to dividend announcements for firms in high-trust areas, and moreover that the role of social trust is more important for firms that are lacking in political connections and located in areas with weak institutions. Our results are robust to alternative measures of social trust and dividends and the use of the instrumental variable approach to alleviate endogeneity concerns. Key Findings Chinese firms in low-trust provinces pay significantly higher cash dividends than those in high-trust provinces (coefficient on Trust: −0.081 for Dividend1, −0.090 for Dividend2), consistent with social trust substituting for formal governance as an informal institution that reduces agency conflicts and information asymmetry. The negative effect of social trust on dividends is more pronounced for firms with lower information transparency and weaker corporate governance, indicating that trust operates as a governance substitute rather than a complement. IV estimation using historical number of wars in a province and number of distinct dialects as instruments confirms the causal relationship; results are also robust across seven alternative measures of social trust including blood donation rates and 1930s grain lending interest rates. Firms in high-trust regions experience significantly lower market reactions to dividend announcements, corroborating the view that the signaling function of dividends is attenuated when investors already have access to richer, more reliable information. The trust–dividend relationship is stronger in regions with weaker marketization and less effective legal systems, and for non-politically connected firms — consistent with social trust as an informal institution that substitutes for formal legal and political governance channels. This negative trust–dividend finding in China contrasts with positive trust–dividend findings in the U.S. (Hasan and Habib, 2020), together supporting La Porta et al.'s (2000) dual agency model of dividends operating differently under strong vs. weak formal institutions. pages.text: Dividend Predictability Around the World (2014) Paper claim — We show that dividend-growth predictability by the dividend yield is the rule rather than the exception in global equity markets. Raw markdown: rangvid-2014-dividend-predictability-around-the-world Bibliographic Record Authors: Rangvid, J, Schmeling, M, Schrimpf, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109014000477 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We show that dividend-growth predictability by the dividend yield is the rule rather than the exception in global equity markets. Dividend predictability is weaker, however, in large and developed markets where dividends are smoothed more, the typical firm is large, and volatility is lower. Our findings suggest that the apparent lack of dividend predictability in the United States does not uniformly extend to other countries. Rather, cross-country patterns in dividend predictability are driven by differences in firm characteristics and the extent to which dividends are smoothed. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，在全球股票市场中，以股利收益率预测股利增长是常规现象而非例外。然而，在规模较大且发达的市场中，股利预测能力较弱，这些市场中股利被更多地平滑、典型企业规模较大且波动率较低。我们的发现表明，美国表面上缺乏股利可预测性的现象并不能一致地推广到其他国家。相反，股利可预测性的跨国模式是由企业特征的差异以及股利被平滑的程度所驱动的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: The market reaction to the choice of accounting method for stock splits and large stock dividends (1997) Paper claim — Prior research has used inaccurate classification rules to distinguish between stock splits and stock dividends. Raw markdown: rankine-1997-the-market-reaction-to-the-choice-of-accounting Bibliographic Record Authors: Rankine, G, Stice, EK Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1997 DOI: 10.2307/2331171 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Prior research has used inaccurate classification rules to distinguish between stock splits and stock dividends. The CRSP classification of two-for-one stock distributions agrees with the actual accounting treatment only 23% of the time. In addition, the accounting treatment impacts the announcement period reaction-two-for-one distributions accounted for as stock dividends are associated with five-day announcement period returns of 2.70%, significantly greater that the 0.93% announcement returns for distributions accounted for as stock splits. Announcement returns are positively related to earnings growth in the two years following the distribution for stock dividend firms but not for stock split firms. The accounting choice appears to be used to confirm management's private information about future earnings revealed at the time of the distribution announcement. 摘要（中文） 先前研究使用了不准确的分类规则来区分股票拆分与股票股利。CRSP对二比一股票分配的分类仅在23%的情况下与实际会计处理相符。此外，会计处理会影响公告期反应——被作为股票股利处理的二比一分配，与2.70%的五日公告期收益相关，显著高于被作为股票拆分处理的分配的0.93%的公告收益。对于股票股利公司而言，公告收益与分配后两年的盈余增长正相关，但对于股票拆分公司则不然。会计选择似乎被用于确认管理层在分配公告时所披露的关于未来盈余的私人信息。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a novel approach to measure the value that shareholders assign to financial flexibility. Raw markdown: rapp-2014-the-value-of-financial-flexibility-and-corporate-financial Bibliographic Record Authors: Rapp, MS, Schmid, T, Urban, D Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: The value of financial flexibility and corporate financial policy (2014) Paper claim — We propose a novel approach to measure the value that shareholders assign to financial flexibility. Raw markdown: rapp-2014-the-value-of-financial-flexibility-and-corporate-financial Bibliographic Record Authors: Rapp, MS, Schmid, T, Urban, D Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.08.004 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We propose a novel approach to measure the value that shareholders assign to financial flexibility. In contrast to existing proxies for financial constraints, our measure is market-based, forward-looking and not directly influenced by past financial decisions. We find that firms for which shareholders consider financial flexibility more valuable have lower dividend payouts, prefer share repurchases to dividends, and exhibit lower leverage ratios. Moreover, these firms tend to accumulate more cash. Our analysis contributes to the growing literature on financial flexibility and indicates that in line with prior survey evidence financial flexibility considerations shape corporate financial policy. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们提出一种新颖的方法来度量股东赋予财务灵活性的价值。与现有的财务约束代理变量不同，我们的度量是基于市场的、前瞻性的，且不直接受过去财务决策的影响。我们发现，股东认为财务灵活性更有价值的企业股利支付更低，偏好股份回购而非股利，并表现出更低的杠杆率。此外，这些企业倾向于积累更多现金。我们的分析对不断增长的财务灵活性文献有所贡献，并表明，与先前的调查证据一致，财务灵活性考量塑造了企业财务政策。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: 10 Ways to create shareholder value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Executives have developed tunnel vision in their pursuit of shareholder value, focusing on short-term performance at the expense of investing in longterm growth. Raw markdown: rappaport-2006-10-ways-to-create-shareholder-value Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: 10 Ways to create shareholder value (2006) Paper claim — Executives have developed tunnel vision in their pursuit of shareholder value, focusing on short-term performance at the expense of investing in longterm growth. Raw markdown: rappaport-2006-10-ways-to-create-shareholder-value Bibliographic Record Authors: Rappaport, A Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 2006 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(buyback, dividend) Abstract Executives have developed tunnel vision in their pursuit of shareholder value, focusing on short-term performance at the expense of investing in longterm growth. Its time to broaden that perspective and begin shaping business strategies in light of the competitive landscape, not the shareholder list. In this article, Alfred Rappaport offers ten basic principles to help executives create lasting shareholder value. For starters, companies should not manage earnings or provide earnings guidance those that fail to embrace this first principle of shareholder value will almost certainly be unable to rest. Additionally, leaders should make strategic deci'sions and acquisitions and carry assets that maxmize expected value, even if near-term earnings are negatively affected as a result. During times when there are no credible value-creating opportunities to invest in the business, companies should avoid using excess cash to make investments that look good on the surface but might end up destroying value, such as ill-advised, overpriced acquisitions. it would be better to return the cash to shareholders in the form of dividends and buybacks. Rappaport also offers guidelines for establishing effective, pay incentives at every level of management; emphasizes that senior executives need to lay their wealth on the line just as shareholders do; and urges companies to embrace full disclosure, an antidote short-term earnings obsession that serves to investor uncertainty, which could reduce the cost of,capital and increase the share price. The author notes that a few types of companies high-tech start-ups, for example, and severely capital-constrained organizations cannot afford to ignore market pressures for short-term performance. Most companies with a sound, well-executed business model however, could better realize their potential for creating,shareholder value by adopting the ten principles. 摘要（中文） 高管们在追求股东价值的过程中形成了狭隘视野，将注意力集中于短期业绩而牺牲了对长期增长的投资。是时候拓宽这一视野，并根据竞争格局而非股东名单来塑造经营战略了。在本文中，Alfred Rappaport提出了十项基本原则，以帮助高管创造持久的股东价值。首先，公司不应管理盈余或提供盈余指引——那些未能践行这一股东价值首要原则的公司几乎肯定无法安然无恙。此外，领导者应做出使预期价值最大化的战略决策、收购和资产持有，即便近期盈余因此受到负面影响。当没有可信的、能创造价值的经营投资机会时，公司应避免用过剩现金进行那些表面看好、但最终可能摧毁价值的投资，例如考虑不周、定价过高的收购。更好的做法是以股利和回购的形式将现金返还给股东。Rappaport还就在各级管理层建立有效的薪酬激励提供了指引；强调高级管理者需要像股东一样将自己的财富置于风险之中；并敦促公司践行充分披露，这是对短期盈余痴迷的一剂解药，有助于减少投资者的不确定性，从而可能降低资本成本并提高股价。作者指出，少数几类公司——例如高科技初创企业和资本严重受限的组织——无法忽视追求短期业绩的市场压力。然而，大多数拥有稳健、执行良好的商业模式的公司，通过采纳这十项原则，能够更好地实现其创造股东价值的潜力。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Ownership, managerial control and the governance of companies listed on the Brussels stock exchange
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines how corporate control is exerted in companies listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange. Raw markdown: renneboog-2000-ownership-managerial-control-and-the-governance-of-companies Bibliographic Record Authors: Renneboog, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING…
pages.text: Ownership, managerial control and the governance of companies listed on the Brussels stock exchange (2000) Paper claim — This paper examines how corporate control is exerted in companies listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange. Raw markdown: renneboog-2000-ownership-managerial-control-and-the-governance-of-companies Bibliographic Record Authors: Renneboog, L Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2000 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(99)00128-4 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative, replace, substitut) Abstract This paper examines how corporate control is exerted in companies listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange. There are several alternative corporate governance mechanisms which may play a role in disciplining poorly performing management: blockholders (holding companies, industrial companies, families and institutions), the market for partial control, debt policy, and board composition. Even if there is redundancy of substitute forms of discipline, some mechanisms may dominate. We find that top managerial turnover is strongly related to poor performance measured by stock returns, accounting earnings in relation to industry peers and dividend cuts and omissions. Tobit models reveal that there is little relation between ownership and managerial replacement, although industrial companies resort to disciplinary actions when performance is poor. When industrial companies increase their share stake or acquire a new stake in a poorly performing company, there is evidence of an increase in executive board turnover, which suggests a partial market for control. There is little relation between changes in ownership concentration held by institutions and holding companies, and disciplining. Still, high leverage and decreasing solvency and liquidity variables are also followed by increased disciplining, as are a high proportion of non-executive directors and the separation of the functions of CEO and chairman. (C) 2000 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G3; G32; G38. 摘要（中文） 本文考察在布鲁塞尔证券交易所上市的公司如何行使公司控制权。存在若干种可能在约束业绩不佳的管理层方面发挥作用的替代性公司治理机制：大股东（控股公司、工业公司、家族和机构）、部分控制权市场、债务政策和董事会构成。即使存在替代性约束形式的冗余，某些机制也可能占主导地位。我们发现，高层管理者更替与以股票回报、相对于行业同行的会计盈利以及股利削减和停发所衡量的业绩不佳密切相关。Tobit模型显示，所有权与管理层更替之间关系甚微，尽管工业公司在业绩不佳时会诉诸约束行动。当工业公司增持股份或在一家业绩不佳的公司中获取新股份时，有证据表明执行董事会更替增加，这表明存在部分控制权市场。机构和控股公司所持股权集中度的变化与约束之间关系甚微。不过，高杠杆以及偿付能力和流动性变量的下降之后，约束也会增加，董事会中非执行董事比例高以及首席执行官与董事长职能分离的情况亦是如此。JEL分类：G3; G32; G38。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Patterns in payout policy and payout channel choice (2011) Paper claim — We study the decision to distribute funds as well as the choice of the payout channel (i.e. Raw markdown: renneboog-2011-patterns-in-payout-policy-and-payout-channel-choice Bibliographic Record Authors: Renneboog, L, Trojanowski, G Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2010.10.028 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency) Abstract We study the decision to distribute funds as well as the choice of the payout channel (i.e. dividends, repurchases, or both). Our analysis of the payout policy of UK firms demonstrates that the importance of share repurchases is increasing, but dividends still constitute a vast proportion of the total payout. We document that there is a relation between the presence of blockholders and the choice of the payout channel. We find that payout decisions are influenced by directors' liquidity needs but are not consistent with the agency theory of payout. We also reject the tax-clientele explanation for payout choices. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究分配资金的决策以及支付渠道（即股利、回购或两者兼有）的选择。我们对英国企业支付政策的分析表明，股份回购的重要性正在上升，但股利仍占总支付的绝大部分。我们记录到，大股东的存在与支付渠道的选择之间存在关系。我们发现，支付决策受董事流动性需求的影响，但与支付的代理理论不一致。我们还否定了支付选择的税收群体解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Seize Advantage in a Downturn
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Downturns offer a rare opportunity to outmaneuver rivals. Raw markdown: rhodes-2009-seize-advantage-in-a-downturn Bibliographic Record Authors: Rhodes, D, Stelter, D Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 2009 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes:…
pages.text: Seize Advantage in a Downturn (2009) Paper claim — Downturns offer a rare opportunity to outmaneuver rivals. Raw markdown: rhodes-2009-seize-advantage-in-a-downturn Bibliographic Record Authors: Rhodes, D, Stelter, D Journal: HARVARD BUSINESS REVIEW Year: 2009 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(monitor)；股利政策(buyback, dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Downturns offer a rare opportunity to outmaneuver rivals. But to do so, you must first systematically assess your organization's ability to weather the storm and take corrective action. David Rhodes and Daniel Stelter, of the Boston Consulting Group, offer a comprehensive approach to tackling this simultaneously defensive and offensive challenge. For some companies, the outcome of this process will be a program of immediate actions that represent a turbocharged version of business as usual. For others, it will be a painful realization that nothing short of an urgent corporate turnaround will suffice. To stabilize the business, companies must (1) protect their financial fundamentals by, for example, monitoring and maximizing cash flow, managing customer credit risk, reducing working capital, and optimizing their financial structure and financing options; (2) protect their existing business operations by reducing costs, increasing organizational efficiency, aggressively managing the top line, rethinking their product portfolio and pricing, reining in investment plans, and divesting noncore businesses; and (3) work to maximize their valuation relative to rivals by being proactive in their investor relations and favoring dividends over share buybacks. To seize advantage, companies must make farsighted investments, identify opportunistic and potentially transformative mergers, and consider possible redefinitions of their business models. This recession handbook will help companies not only to survive the recession but also to thrive in its aftermath. 摘要（中文） 经济衰退期提供了超越竞争对手的难得机会。但要做到这一点，你必须首先系统地评估自己组织抵御风暴的能力并采取纠正措施。波士顿咨询集团的David Rhodes与Daniel Stelter提出了一套全面的方法，用以应对这一兼具防御性与进攻性的挑战。对某些公司而言，这一过程的结果将是一套立即行动的方案，即业务照常运营的强化版本。对另一些公司而言，则是痛苦地认识到唯有紧急的公司转型才足以应对。为稳定业务，公司必须：（1）保护其财务基本面，例如监控并最大化现金流、管理客户信用风险、削减营运资本、优化其财务结构与融资选择；（2）保护其现有经营业务，通过削减成本、提高组织效率、积极管理营收、重新审视其产品组合与定价、控制投资计划以及剥离非核心业务；（3）努力相对于竞争对手最大化自身估值，做法是在投资者关系上积极主动，并偏好股利而非股票回购。为抓住优势，公司必须进行有远见的投资、识别机会性且具有潜在变革性的并购，并考虑可能的商业模式重新定义。这份衰退期操作手册将帮助公司不仅在衰退中存活，还能在衰退后蓬勃发展。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: How do underwriters value initial public offerings? An empirical analysis of the French IPO market
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates how French underwriters value the stocks of companies they bring public. Raw markdown: roosenboom-2007-how-do-underwriters-value-initial-public-offerings-an Bibliographic Record Authors: Roosenboom, P Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING…
pages.text: How do underwriters value initial public offerings? An empirical analysis of the French IPO market (2007) Paper claim — This paper investigates how French underwriters value the stocks of companies they bring public. Raw markdown: roosenboom-2007-how-do-underwriters-value-initial-public-offerings-an Bibliographic Record Authors: Roosenboom, P Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1506/car.24.4.7 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper investigates how French underwriters value the stocks of companies they bring public. Underwriters often use several valuation methods to determine their fair value estimate of the initial public offering (IPO) firm's equity. We investigate five of these valuation methods: peer group multiples valuation, the dividend discount model, the discounted cash flow model, the economic value-added method, and underwriter-specific methods. We document that underwriters base their choice for a particular valuation method on firm characteristics, aggregate stock market returns, and aggregate stock market volatility in the period before the IPO. In addition, we examine how underwriters combine the value estimates of the valuation methods they use into a fair value estimate by assigning weights to these value estimates. We demonstrate that these weights also depend on firm-specific factors, aggregate stock market returns, and aggregate stock market volatility. Finally, we show that underwriters discount their fair value estimate to set the preliminary offer price of the shares. This discount is higher for IPO firms with greater valuation uncertainty and lower for companies that are brought to the market by more reputable underwriters and that are forecasted to be more profitable. 摘要（中文） 本文研究了法国承销商如何对其带领上市的公司股票进行估值。承销商经常使用多种估值方法来确定其对首次公开发行（IPO）公司股权的公允价值估计。我们考察了其中五种估值方法：同类公司群倍数估值、股利贴现模型、贴现现金流模型、经济增加值法以及承销商特定方法。我们记录到承销商基于公司特征、总体股票市场收益以及IPO前时期的总体股票市场波动率来选择某一特定估值方法。此外，我们考察了承销商如何通过对这些价值估计赋予权重，将其所使用的估值方法的价值估计组合成一个公允价值估计。我们证明这些权重也取决于公司特定因素、总体股票市场收益以及总体股票市场波动率。最后，我们表明承销商对其公允价值估计打折扣以设定股票的初步发行价。对于估值不确定性较大的IPO公司，这一折扣更高；对于由声誉更高的承销商带领上市、且被预测更具盈利能力的公司，这一折扣更低。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper investigates how underwriters set the IPO firm's fair value, an ex-ante estimate of the market value, using a unique dataset of 228 reports from French underwriters. Raw markdown: roosenboom-2012-valuing-and-pricing-ipos Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Valuing and pricing IPOs (2012) Paper claim — This paper investigates how underwriters set the IPO firm's fair value, an ex-ante estimate of the market value, using a unique dataset of 228 reports from French underwriters. Raw markdown: roosenboom-2012-valuing-and-pricing-ipos Bibliographic Record Authors: Roosenboom, P Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2012.01.009 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This paper investigates how underwriters set the IPO firm's fair value, an ex-ante estimate of the market value, using a unique dataset of 228 reports from French underwriters. These reports are issued before the IPO shares start trading on the stock market and detail how underwriters determined fair value. We document that underwriters often employ multiples valuation, dividend discount models and discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis to determine fair value but that all of these valuation methods suffer from a positive bias with respect to equilibrium market value. We also analyze how this fair value estimate is subsequently used as a basis for IPO pricing. We report that underwriters deliberately discount the fair value estimate when setting the preliminary offer price. Part of the intentional price discount can be recovered by higher price updates. We find that, controlling for other factors such as investor demand, part of underpricing stems from this intentional price discount. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文利用来自法国承销商的228份报告这一独特数据集，研究了承销商如何设定IPO公司的公允价值，即对市场价值的事前估计。这些报告在IPO股票开始在股票市场交易之前发布，并详细说明承销商如何确定公允价值。我们记录到承销商经常使用倍数估值、股利贴现模型和贴现现金流（DCF）分析来确定公允价值，但所有这些估值方法相对于均衡市场价值都存在正向偏差。我们还分析了这一公允价值估计随后如何被用作IPO定价的基础。我们报告称，承销商在设定初步发行价时会刻意对公允价值估计打折扣。这种有意的价格折扣的一部分可以通过更高的价格更新来收回。我们发现，在控制诸如投资者需求等其他因素后，抑价的一部分来源于这种有意的价格折扣。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Institutional ownership, volatility and dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find that the sign of the correlation between institutional ownership and volatility depends on the firm's dividend policy: institutional ownership is negatively (positively) related to volatility among non-dividend (dividend) paying stocks. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Institutional ownership, volatility and dividends (2009) Paper claim — We find that the sign of the correlation between institutional ownership and volatility depends on the firm's dividend policy: institutional ownership is negatively (positively) related to volatility among non-dividend (dividend) paying stocks. Raw markdown: rubin-2009-institutional-ownership-volatility-and-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Rubin, A, Smith, DR Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2008.11.008 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract We find that the sign of the correlation between institutional ownership and volatility depends on the firm's dividend policy: institutional ownership is negatively (positively) related to volatility among non-dividend (dividend) paying stocks. The empirical results are consistent with an interaction between institutional preference for low volatility and the tendency of higher levels of institutional ownership to increase volatility through their trading behavior. This result is robust to many control variables and possible endogeneity concerns. Supporting our conjecture that institutions herd on dividend signals we find that the correlation between turnover and institutional ownership is higher for dividend paying stocks, and that the positive correlation between turnover and institutional ownership is higher on dividend declaration days. Finally, we also find that the level of institutional ownership drops following an increase in volatility for both dividend payers and non-payers, and that volatility rises following increased institutional ownership for dividend paying stocks. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，机构持股与波动率之间相关性的符号取决于企业的股利政策：在不派发股利（派发股利）的股票中，机构持股与波动率负相关（正相关）。实证结果与以下相互作用相一致：机构对低波动率的偏好，与更高水平的机构持股通过其交易行为增加波动率的倾向之间的相互作用。这一结果对众多控制变量和可能的内生性问题都是稳健的。为支持我们关于机构在股利信号上羊群行为的猜想，我们发现换手率与机构持股之间的相关性在派发股利的股票中更高，且换手率与机构持股之间的正相关在股利宣告日更高。最后，我们还发现，对于股利派发者和非派发者，机构持股水平在波动率上升后都会下降，且对于派发股利的股票，波动率在机构持股增加后会上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using the Delaware Supreme Court's Time-Warner decision of July 1989 as a focal point, we study defeated takeover bids before and after July 1989 to assess the direct effects of stronger takeover impediments on takeover defense tactics used to defeat bids and the…
pages.text: Have changing takeover defense rules and strategies entrenched management and damaged shareholders? The case of defeated takeover bids (2010) Paper claim — Using the Delaware Supreme Court's Time-Warner decision of July 1989 as a focal point, we study defeated takeover bids before and after July 1989 to assess the direct effects of stronger takeover impediments on takeover defense tactics used to defeat bids and the resulting shareholder wealth outcomes and managerial turnover. Raw markdown: ryngaert-2010-have-changing-takeover-defense-rules-and-strategies-entrenched Bibliographic Record Authors: Ryngaert, M, Scholten, R Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2009.09.002 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Using the Delaware Supreme Court's Time-Warner decision of July 1989 as a focal point, we study defeated takeover bids before and after July 1989 to assess the direct effects of stronger takeover impediments on takeover defense tactics used to defeat bids and the resulting shareholder wealth outcomes and managerial turnover. We find that firms that defeated takeover bids after July 1989 shifted away from the use of active takeover defenses (repurchases, special dividends, greenmail, and leverage increases). Nevertheless, shareholders of firms that defeat a takeover experienced slightly better wealth outcomes in the 1990s than in the 1980s. We also find increased managerial turnover rates after defeating a takeover bid post Time-Warner, suggesting that managers that defeat hostile takeover bids did not become more entrenched due to greater takeover impediments relative to prior years. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 以特拉华州最高法院1989年7月的Time-Warner判决为焦点，我们研究1989年7月前后被击退的收购要约，以评估更强的收购阻碍对用于击退要约的收购防御策略以及由此产生的股东财富结果和管理层更替的直接影响。我们发现，1989年7月之后击退收购要约的公司减少了对主动型收购防御手段（回购、特别股利、绿票讹诈（greenmail）以及增加杠杆）的使用。尽管如此，击退收购的公司股东在20世纪90年代经历的财富结果略好于80年代。我们还发现，在Time-Warner判决之后击退收购要约之后管理层更替率上升，这表明，相较于此前的年份，尽管存在更大的收购阻碍，击退敌意收购要约的管理者并未因此变得更加壕沟自保（entrenched）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Understanding stock price volatility: The role of earnings
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In an efficient capital market, asset prices vary when investors change their expectations about cash flows, discount rates, or both. Raw markdown: sadka-2007-understanding-stock-price-volatility-the-role-of-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Sadka, G Journal:…
pages.text: Understanding stock price volatility: The role of earnings (2007) Paper claim — In an efficient capital market, asset prices vary when investors change their expectations about cash flows, discount rates, or both. Raw markdown: sadka-2007-understanding-stock-price-volatility-the-role-of-earnings Bibliographic Record Authors: Sadka, G Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2007 DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2006.00230.x Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract In an efficient capital market, asset prices vary when investors change their expectations about cash flows, discount rates, or both. Using dividends to measure cash flows, previous research shows that the aggregate dividend-price ratio varies due to changes in expected discount rates (returns) rather than expected cash flows. In contrast, using accounting earnings instead of dividends as a measure of cash flows, this paper shows that as much as 70% of the variation in the dividend-price ratio can be explained by changes in expected earnings. Moreover, the paper documents a significant negative correlation between expected returns and expected earnings, suggesting that variations in a common factor to both may generate significant price volatility. The results are consistent with the dividend-policy irrelevance hypothesis. 摘要（中文） 在有效资本市场中，当投资者改变其对现金流、贴现率或二者的预期时，资产价格会发生变动。以往研究以股利来度量现金流，表明总量股利—价格比的变动源于预期贴现率（收益）而非预期现金流的变化。相比之下，本文使用会计盈余而非股利作为现金流的度量，表明股利—价格比变动中高达70%可由预期盈余的变化所解释。此外，本文记录到预期收益与预期盈余之间存在显著的负相关，这表明二者共同因素的变动可能产生显著的价格波动。这些结果与股利政策无关性假说相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Curse and blessing: The effect of the dividend ban on euro area bank valuations and syndicated lending
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — At the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic, the European Central Bank issued a strong recommendation towards banks to halt dividend payouts. Raw markdown: sanders-2024-curse-and-blessing-the-effect-of-the-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Sanders, E, Simoens, M,…
pages.text: Curse and blessing: The effect of the dividend ban on euro area bank valuations and syndicated lending (2024) Paper claim — At the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic, the European Central Bank issued a strong recommendation towards banks to halt dividend payouts. Raw markdown: sanders-2024-curse-and-blessing-the-effect-of-the-dividend Bibliographic Record Authors: Sanders, E, Simoens, M, Vander Vennet Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2024.107190 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract At the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic, the European Central Bank issued a strong recommendation towards banks to halt dividend payouts. The goal of this de facto dividend ban was to boost banks' capital to ensure the supply of credit. However, given the importance of dividends for investors, this unprecedented measure is likely to have impacted bank valuations. Hence, banks may have chosen to preserve their higher capital buffers to boost payouts after the lifting of the ban, rendering the intended positive effect on credit supply a priori uncertain. We first investigate the effect of the dividend ban announcement on euro area banks' valuations and find a significantly negative impact. Second, we show that banks significantly expanded credit supply in the syndicated loan market, without counteracting effect of the negative stock market reaction. Our findings are corroborated when we exploit the multi -bank nature of syndicated loans in a within -loan setup. 摘要（中文） 在新冠疫情爆发之际，欧洲中央银行向银行发出强烈建议，要求停止股利派现。这一事实上的股利禁令的目标是提振银行资本以确保信贷供给。然而，鉴于股利对投资者的重要性，这一史无前例的举措很可能已经影响了银行估值。因此，银行可能选择保留其较高的资本缓冲，以便在禁令解除后提升派现，从而使原本意图对信贷供给产生的正面效应先验地变得不确定。我们首先考察股利禁令公告对欧元区银行估值的影响，发现存在显著为负的影响。其次，我们表明银行在银团贷款市场上显著扩大了信贷供给，且未受到股市负面反应的抵消作用。当我们在同一贷款内的设定中利用银团贷款的多银行性质时，我们的研究结果得到了进一步印证。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: DO DIVIDENDS SIGNAL EARNINGS - THE CASE OF OMITTED DIVIDENDS (1994) Paper claim — Considerable evidence exists to support the hypothesis that the payment of dividends provides information that helps investors and analysts value the firm. Raw markdown: sant-1994-do-dividends-signal-earnings-the-case-of-omitted Bibliographic Record Authors: SANT, R, COWAN, AR Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00063-8 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract Considerable evidence exists to support the hypothesis that the payment of dividends provides information that helps investors and analysts value the firm. We find that dividend omissions precede increases in return variance, beta and the dispersion of analyst forecasts of earnings. However, the variance of actual earnings also increases after dividend omissions. An increase in the variance of earnings implies a decrease in the predictability of earnings even if there is no change in information availability. The evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that managers omit dividends because earnings become inherently less predictable. In other words, managers use dividends as a signaling mechanism. We also report a negative association between stock-price reactions to omission announcements and changes in beta, but not changes in total return variance or earnings variance, consistent with increases in priced estimation risk. 摘要（中文） 存在大量证据支持如下假说，即股利的支付提供了有助于投资者和分析师对企业进行估值的信息。我们发现股利取消先于收益方差、贝塔（beta）以及分析师盈利预测离散度的增加。然而，实际盈利的方差在股利取消后也会增加。盈利方差的增加意味着盈利可预测性的下降，即使信息可得性没有变化。该证据与如下假说一致，即管理者取消股利是因为盈利本质上变得不那么可预测。换言之，管理者将股利用作一种信号传递机制。我们还报告了对取消公告的股价反应与贝塔变化之间存在负向关联，但与总收益方差或盈利方差的变化则不然，这与被计价的估计风险（priced estimation risk）的增加相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Early and late calls of convertible bonds: Theory and evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Many convertible bonds are called too early or too late relative to the perfect markets decision rule of Ingersoll (1977a,b). Raw markdown: sarkar-2003-early-and-late-calls-of-convertible-bonds-theory Bibliographic Record Authors: Sarkar, S Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Early and late calls of convertible bonds: Theory and evidence (2003) Paper claim — Many convertible bonds are called too early or too late relative to the perfect markets decision rule of Ingersoll (1977a,b). Raw markdown: sarkar-2003-early-and-late-calls-of-convertible-bonds-theory Bibliographic Record Authors: Sarkar, S Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(02)00260-1 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Many convertible bonds are called too early or too late relative to the perfect markets decision rule of Ingersoll (1977a,b). We re-examine the convertible call decision under corporate taxation and possible default prior to maturity. Our model predicts that early calls will be associated with high coupon and low call premium, dividend income, volatility, tax rate and interest rate; and late calls will be associated with high call premium, dividend income, tax rate and interest rate, and low coupon and volatility. These implications are supported by empirical tests carried out with five years of convertible call data. (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 许多可转换债券相对于Ingersoll（1977a,b）的完美市场决策规则被过早或过晚地赎回。我们在企业税收和到期前可能违约的情况下重新考察可转换债券的赎回决策。我们的模型预测，提前赎回将与高票息、低赎回溢价、股利收入、波动率、税率和利率相关；而延迟赎回将与高赎回溢价、股利收入、税率和利率，以及低票息和低波动率相关。这些含义得到了以五年可转换债券赎回数据进行的实证检验的支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Contracts Between Firms and Shareholders
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Theory predicts the existence of explicit bilateral contracts between firms and expert shareholders. Raw markdown: schoenfeld-2020-contracts-between-firms-and-shareholders Bibliographic Record Authors: Schoenfeld, J Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year:…
pages.text: Contracts Between Firms and Shareholders (2020) Paper claim — Theory predicts the existence of explicit bilateral contracts between firms and expert shareholders. Raw markdown: schoenfeld-2020-contracts-between-firms-and-shareholders Bibliographic Record Authors: Schoenfeld, J Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1111/1475-679X.12297 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(information asymmetry) Abstract Theory predicts the existence of explicit bilateral contracts between firms and expert shareholders. I assemble and analyze a large-scale data set of these contracts. Using block investments from 1996 to 2018, I find that these contracts involve mainly corporate owners and activist owners, and often specify covenants pertaining to financing, trading, directorships, dividends, joint ventures, corporate investment, financial reporting, and information access. I also find that some of the contract covenants are stated in terms of accounting information, and that the prevalence of these contracts is significantly positively associated with measures of information asymmetry between managers and shareholders. Overall, this study provides some of the first systematic evidence on explicit bilateral contracts between firms and shareholders. 摘要（中文） 理论预测在企业与专家型股东之间存在明确的双边合约。我组建并分析了一个关于这些合约的大规模数据集。使用1996年至2018年的大宗投资数据，我发现这些合约主要涉及公司所有者和维权型所有者，并且常常规定与融资、交易、董事席位、股利、合资企业、公司投资、财务报告和信息获取相关的契约条款。我还发现，一些合约条款是以会计信息的形式表述的，并且这些合约的普遍程度与管理者和股东之间信息不对称的度量显著正相关。总体而言，本研究提供了关于企业与股东之间明确双边合约的首批系统性证据之一。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Identifying Long-Run Risks: A Bayesian Mixed-Frequency Approach
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We document that consumption growth rates are far from i.i.d. Raw markdown: schorfheide-2018-identifying-long-run-risks-a-bayesian-mixed-frequency Bibliographic Record Authors: Schorfheide, F, Song, DH, Yaron, A Journal: ECONOMETRICA Year: 2018 DOI:…
pages.text: Identifying Long-Run Risks: A Bayesian Mixed-Frequency Approach (2018) Paper claim — We document that consumption growth rates are far from i.i.d. Raw markdown: schorfheide-2018-identifying-long-run-risks-a-bayesian-mixed-frequency Bibliographic Record Authors: Schorfheide, F, Song, DH, Yaron, A Journal: ECONOMETRICA Year: 2018 DOI: 10.3982/ECTA14308 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We document that consumption growth rates are far from i.i.d. and have a highly persistent component. First, we estimate univariate and multivariate models of cash-flow (consumption, output, dividends) growth that feature measurement errors, time-varying volatilities, and mixed-frequency observations. Monthly consumption data are important for identifying the stochastic volatility process; yet the data are contaminated, which makes the inclusion of measurement errors essential for identifying the predictable component. Second, we develop a novel state-space model for cash flows and asset prices that imposes the pricing restrictions of a representative-agent endowment economy with recursive preferences. To estimate this model, we use a particle MCMC approach that exploits the conditional linear structure of the approximate equilibrium. Once asset return data are included in the estimation, we find even stronger evidence for the persistent component and are able to identify three volatility processes: the one for the predictable cash-flow component is crucial for asset pricing, whereas the other two are important for tracking the data. Our model generates asset prices that are largely consistent with the data in terms of sample moments and predictability features. The state-space approach allows us to track over time the evolution of the predictable component, the volatility processes, the decomposition of the equity premium into risk factors, and the variance decomposition of asset prices. 摘要（中文） 我们记录了消费增长率远非独立同分布，且具有高度持久性的成分。首先，我们估计了现金流（消费、产出、股利）增长的单变量和多变量模型，这些模型具有测量误差、时变波动率以及混合频率观测的特征。月度消费数据对于识别随机波动率过程很重要；然而，这些数据受到污染，这使得纳入测量误差对于识别可预测成分至关重要。其次，我们为现金流和资产价格开发了一个新颖的状态空间模型，该模型施加了具有递归偏好的代表性主体禀赋经济的定价约束。为估计该模型，我们采用了一种粒子MCMC方法，该方法利用了近似均衡的条件线性结构。一旦将资产收益数据纳入估计，我们就发现了更强的持久性成分证据，并能够识别出三个波动率过程：其中针对可预测现金流成分的波动率过程对资产定价至关重要，而另外两个对于追踪数据很重要。我们的模型生成的资产价格在样本矩和可预测性特征方面与数据在很大程度上相一致。状态空间方法使我们能够随时间追踪可预测成分的演变、波动率过程、股权溢价按风险因子的分解以及资产价格的方差分解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Changes of numeraire for pricing futures, forwards, and options
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A change of numeraire argument is used to derive a general option parity, or equivalence, result relating American call and put prices, acid to obtain new expressions for futures and forward prices. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Changes of numeraire for pricing futures, forwards, and options (1999) Paper claim — A change of numeraire argument is used to derive a general option parity, or equivalence, result relating American call and put prices, acid to obtain new expressions for futures and forward prices. Raw markdown: schroder-1999-changes-of-numeraire-for-pricing-futures-forwards-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Schroder, M Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/12.5.1143 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract A change of numeraire argument is used to derive a general option parity, or equivalence, result relating American call and put prices, acid to obtain new expressions for futures and forward prices. The general parity result unifies and extends a number of existing results. The new futures and forward pricing formulas are often simpler to compute in multifactor models than existing alternatives. We also extend previous work by deriving a general formula relating exchange options to ordinary call options. A number of applications to diffusion models, including stochastic volatility, stochastic interest rate, and stochastic dividend rate models, and jump-diffusion models are examined. 摘要（中文） 本文使用变换计价单位的论证，推导出一个将美式看涨期权和看跌期权价格相联系的一般期权平价（或等价）结果，并获得期货和远期价格的新表达式。这一一般平价结果统一并扩展了若干现有结果。新的期货和远期定价公式在多因子模型中通常比现有替代方案更易于计算。我们还通过推导一个将交换期权与普通看涨期权相联系的一般公式，扩展了此前的工作。文中考察了对扩散模型（包括随机波动率、随机利率和随机股利率模型）以及跳跃-扩散模型的若干应用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE NATURE OF INFORMATION CONVEYED BY PURE CAPITAL STRUCTURE CHANGES
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study investigates the information conveyed by intrafirm exchange offers. Raw markdown: shah-1994-the-nature-of-information-conveyed-by-pure-capital Bibliographic Record Authors: SHAH, K Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1994 DOI:…
pages.text: THE NATURE OF INFORMATION CONVEYED BY PURE CAPITAL STRUCTURE CHANGES (1994) Paper claim — This study investigates the information conveyed by intrafirm exchange offers. Raw markdown: shah-1994-the-nature-of-information-conveyed-by-pure-capital Bibliographic Record Authors: SHAH, K Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1016/0304-405X(94)90031-0 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This study investigates the information conveyed by intrafirm exchange offers. I find that leverage increases and leverage decreases convey qualitatively different information. Leverage-increasing offers appear to lower investors' assessment of risk of the firm's common stock, but do not appear to change their expectations of cash flows; leverage-decreasing offers appear to lower investors' expected cash flows, but do not appear to change their assessment of risk. The nature of changes in leverage, capital outlays, and dividends is also asymmetric. Further, I find that, for leverage-increasing offers, corporate control activity does not explain the information content or its asymmetry. 摘要（中文） 本研究考察了公司内部交换要约所传递的信息。我发现杠杆增加和杠杆减少传递了性质上不同的信息。杠杆增加的要约似乎降低了投资者对公司普通股风险的评估，但似乎并未改变他们对现金流的预期；杠杆减少的要约似乎降低了投资者的预期现金流，但似乎并未改变他们对风险的评估。杠杆、资本支出和股利变动的性质也是不对称的。此外，我发现对于杠杆增加的要约，公司控制权活动无法解释其信息内容或其不对称性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The role of 'other information' in analysts' forecasts in understanding stock return volatility
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This study identifies "other information" in analysts' forecasts as a legitimate proxy for future cash flows and examines its incremental role in explaining stock return volatility. Raw markdown: shan-2014-the-role-of-other-information-in-analysts-forecasts…
pages.text: The role of "other information" in analysts' forecasts in understanding stock return volatility (2014) Paper claim — This study identifies "other information" in analysts' forecasts as a legitimate proxy for future cash flows and examines its incremental role in explaining stock return volatility. Raw markdown: shan-2014-the-role-of-other-information-in-analysts-forecasts Bibliographic Record Authors: Shan, YW, Taylor, S, Walter, T Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-013-9272-5 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This study identifies "other information" in analysts' forecasts as a legitimate proxy for future cash flows and examines its incremental role in explaining stock return volatility. We suggest that "other information" contains information about fundamentals beyond that reflected in current financial statements and reflects firms' fundamentals on a more timely basis than dividends or earnings. Using standardized regressions, we find volatility increases when current "other information" is more uncertain and increases more in response to unfavorable news compared to favorable news. Variance decomposition analysis shows that the variance contribution of "other information" dominates that of expected-return news. The incremental role of "other information" is at least half of the effect of earnings in explaining future volatility. The results are more pronounced for firms with poor information environments. Overall, our results highlight the importance of including "other information" as an additional cash-flow proxy in future studies of stock prices and volatility. 摘要（中文） 本研究将分析师预测中的"其他信息"（other information）识别为未来现金流的一个合理代理，并考察其在解释股票收益波动性方面的增量作用。我们认为，"其他信息"包含关于基本面的信息，超出了当期财务报表所反映的内容，并比股利或盈余更及时地反映公司的基本面。使用标准化回归，我们发现，当当期"其他信息"更不确定时波动性增加，且相较于有利消息，波动性对不利消息的反应增加更多。方差分解分析表明，"其他信息"的方差贡献超过预期收益消息的方差贡献。在解释未来波动性方面，"其他信息"的增量作用至少是盈余作用的一半。对于信息环境较差的公司而言，这些结果更为显著。总体而言，我们的结果凸显了在未来关于股价和波动性的研究中，将"其他信息"作为一个额外的现金流代理纳入其中的重要性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
