pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We develop a simple parametric model in which hypotheses about predictability, mispricing, and the risk-return tradeoff can be evaluated simultaneously, while allowing for time variation in both risk and expected return. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Payout yield, risk, and mispricing: A Bayesian analysis (2012) Paper claim — We develop a simple parametric model in which hypotheses about predictability, mispricing, and the risk-return tradeoff can be evaluated simultaneously, while allowing for time variation in both risk and expected return. Raw markdown: shanken-2012-payout-yield-risk-and-mispricing-a-bayesian-analysis Bibliographic Record Authors: Shanken, J, Tamayo, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.12.002 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(tradeoff) Abstract We develop a simple parametric model in which hypotheses about predictability, mispricing, and the risk-return tradeoff can be evaluated simultaneously, while allowing for time variation in both risk and expected return. Most of the return predictability based on aggregate payout yield is unrelated to market risk. We consider a range of Bayesian prior beliefs about the risk-return tradeoff and the extent to which predictability is driven by mispricing. The impact of these beliefs on an investor's certainty-equivalent return when choosing between a market index and riskless T-bills is economically significant, in both ex ante and out-of-sample analyses. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们建立了一个简单的参数模型，其中关于可预测性、错误定价和风险-收益权衡的假设可以被同时评估，同时允许风险和预期收益的时变。基于总体支付收益率的大部分收益可预测性与市场风险无关。我们考虑了关于风险-收益权衡以及可预测性由错误定价驱动程度的一系列贝叶斯先验信念。在事前和样本外分析中，这些信念对投资者在市场指数与无风险国库券之间进行选择时的确定性等价收益的影响在经济上是显著的。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: National culture and dividend policy
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This interdisciplinary study examines how national culture affects corporate dividend policies. Raw markdown: shao-2010-national-culture-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Shao, LA, Kwok, CCY, Guedhami, O Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS…
pages.text: National culture and dividend policy (2010) Paper claim — This interdisciplinary study examines how national culture affects corporate dividend policies. Raw markdown: shao-2010-national-culture-and-dividend-policy Bibliographic Record Authors: Shao, LA, Kwok, CCY, Guedhami, O Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1057/jibs.2009.74 Relevance score: 12.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(investor protection, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative, catering, information asymmetry) Abstract This interdisciplinary study examines how national culture affects corporate dividend policies. The dividend puzzle is one of the most studied, yet unresolved, issues in financial economics. Prior theoretical and empirical research has suggested several explanations of the dividend puzzle that are rooted mainly in agency, asymmetric information, "bird in hand'', and pecking order theories. The main intuition behind our analysis is that dividend policy may be determined not only by an objective assessment of the severity of agency and asymmetric information problems within a firm, but also by management's and investors' subjective perceptions of these problems, which hinge on their national culture. Using Schwartz's national culture dimensions, Conservatism and Mastery, we find that Conservatism is positively related and Mastery negatively related to dividend payouts for a sample of 27,462 firm-years from 21 countries between 1995 and 2007. These effects are robust to controls for a wide variety of other determinants of dividend policy - including investor protection, stock market performance, financial system configuration, tax advantage, economic development, and dividend catering premium - and to alternative culture proxies and sub-period windows. Our findings that national culture affects perceptions of and responses to agency and information asymmetry have important implications for policy-makers and multinational enterprises. Journal of International Business Studies (2010) 41, 1391-1414. doi:10.1057/jibs.2009.74 摘要（中文） 这项跨学科研究考察了国家文化如何影响企业股利政策。股利之谜是金融经济学中研究最多但仍未解决的问题之一。既有的理论和实证研究提出了若干对股利之谜的解释，主要植根于代理理论、信息不对称理论、"落袋为安"理论和啄食顺序理论。我们分析背后的主要直觉是，股利政策可能不仅由对企业内部代理和信息不对称问题严重程度的客观评估所决定，还可能由管理者和投资者对这些问题的主观感知所决定，而这些感知取决于他们的国家文化。使用施瓦茨（Schwartz）的国家文化维度——保守主义（Conservatism）和支配性（Mastery），我们在1995年至2007年间来自21个国家的27,462个企业-年度样本中发现，保守主义与股利支付正相关，支配性与股利支付负相关。这些效应在控制了各种其他股利政策决定因素（包括投资者保护、股市表现、金融体系构造、税收优势、经济发展和股利迎合溢价）后，以及在替代性文化代理变量和子时期窗口下，都是稳健的。我们关于国家文化影响对代理和信息不对称的感知与应对的发现，对政策制定者和跨国企业具有重要启示。《国际商务研究杂志》（2010）41, 1391-1414。doi:10.1057/jibs.2009.74 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: National culture and corporate investment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We explore the relation between individualism and horizons and types of corporate investment, based on individualism's implications for risk taking. Raw markdown: shao-2013-national-culture-and-corporate-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Shao, L, Kwok, CCY,…
pages.text: National culture and corporate investment (2013) Paper claim — We explore the relation between individualism and horizons and types of corporate investment, based on individualism's implications for risk taking. Raw markdown: shao-2013-national-culture-and-corporate-investment Bibliographic Record Authors: Shao, L, Kwok, CCY, Zhang, R Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1057/jibs.2013.26 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract We explore the relation between individualism and horizons and types of corporate investment, based on individualism's implications for risk taking. We find that firms in individualistic countries invest more in long-term (risky) than in short-term (safe) assets. Moreover, the effect of individualism on long-term investment hinges on R&D: firms in individualistic countries invest more in R&D projects but not more in physical assets. To test whether risk taking is the channel through which individualism works, we employ two-stage ordinary least squares and other analyses to nullify alternative explanations, such as: (1) uncontrolled institutions determine both individualism and R & D; and (2) firms in individualistic countries invest more in R&D because they have higher investment efficiency, or pick less-risky R&D projects. We further find that individualistic firms tend to employ excess cash to increase R&D rather than increase dividends, and R&D decisions are less reliant on internal financing but more responsive to growth opportunities in individualistic countries. 摘要（中文） 我们基于个人主义对风险承担的含义，探讨个人主义与公司投资的期限和类型之间的关系。我们发现，个人主义国家的公司更多地投资于长期（风险）资产而非短期（安全）资产。此外，个人主义对长期投资的影响取决于研发（R&D）：个人主义国家的公司在研发项目上投资更多，但在实物资产上并非如此。为检验风险承担是否是个人主义发挥作用的渠道，我们采用两阶段普通最小二乘法及其他分析来排除替代解释，例如：(1) 未受控制的制度同时决定个人主义和研发；以及 (2) 个人主义国家的公司在研发上投资更多是因为它们拥有更高的投资效率，或选择风险较低的研发项目。我们进一步发现，个人主义公司倾向于利用过剩现金来增加研发而非增加股利，且在个人主义国家，研发决策较少依赖内部融资，而对成长机会的反应更为敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Independent directors and the propensity to pay dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using data from 944 public companies in 2006, I examine how a firm's propensity to pay dividends is related to (i) board independence and (ii) independent directors' tenure, number of board seats (busy) and equity incentive compensation. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Independent directors and the propensity to pay dividends (2011) Paper claim — Using data from 944 public companies in 2006, I examine how a firm's propensity to pay dividends is related to (i) board independence and (ii) independent directors' tenure, number of board seats (busy) and equity incentive compensation. Raw markdown: sharma-2011-independent-directors-and-the-propensity-to-pay-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Sharma, V Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2011.05.003 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, independent director, policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout) Abstract Using data from 944 public companies in 2006, I examine how a firm's propensity to pay dividends is related to (i) board independence and (ii) independent directors' tenure, number of board seats (busy) and equity incentive compensation. After controlling for the effects of traditional economic, CEO entrenchment and ownership determinants of the propensity to pay dividends, I find evidence of a positive association between the propensity to pay and (i) board independence and (ii) director tenure, and a negative association between the propensity to pay and (i) busy directors and (ii) greater equity incentive compensation in the director pay structure. I find consistent results when the decision is to pay cash dividends or repurchase shares. In further tests, I find that equity incentive compensation in the independent director pay structure is the most pervasive determinant across other dividend measures such as dividend payout, total payout and repurchases. Overall, the findings suggest that the characteristics of independent directors are important determinants of the payout policy. The results also suggest that future corporate governance research could benefit from incorporating characteristics of independent directors rather than limiting governance measures to board independence especially when recent empirical evidence (Linck et al., 2008, 2009) shows convergence, and therefore, narrowing variation in the proportion of outsiders and insiders on a board. (C) 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 使用2006年944家上市公司的数据，我考察企业支付股利的倾向如何与 (i) 董事会独立性以及 (ii) 独立董事的任期、董事席位数（繁忙程度）和股权激励薪酬相关。在控制了支付股利倾向的传统经济、首席执行官壕沟自守和所有权决定因素之后，我发现支付倾向与 (i) 董事会独立性以及 (ii) 董事任期之间存在正相关关系，与 (i) 繁忙董事以及 (ii) 董事薪酬结构中更高的股权激励薪酬之间存在负相关关系。当决策是支付现金股利或回购股份时，我发现了一致的结果。在进一步的检验中，我发现独立董事薪酬结构中的股权激励薪酬，是股利支付、总支付和回购等其他股利度量中最普遍的决定因素。总体而言，这些发现表明，独立董事的特征是支付政策的重要决定因素。结果还表明，未来的公司治理研究可以从纳入独立董事特征中受益，而不是将治理度量局限于董事会独立性，尤其是当近来的实证证据（Linck等，2008, 2009）显示趋同、从而缩小了董事会中外部人与内部人比例的差异之时。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Raw markdown: sheikh-2022-ceo-power-and-the-likelihood-of-paying-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Sheikh, S Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102186 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract This study empirically investigates the relation between CEO power and the likelihood of dividend payouts. It argues that powerful CEOs pay dividends to establish reputation in capital markets to raise external financing at favorable terms. The net expected value of such reputation, however, depends on the likelihood of external financing, which is positively related to low profitability and high cash flow volatility. Empirical results show that powerful CEOs are more likely to pay and increase dividends when their firms face low profitability and high cash flow volatility. 摘要（中文） 本研究实证考察了CEO权力与股利支付可能性之间的关系。文章认为，权力大的CEO派发股利是为了在资本市场上建立声誉，以便以优惠条件筹集外部融资。然而，这种声誉的净预期价值取决于外部融资的可能性，而后者与低盈利能力和高现金流波动性正相关。实证结果表明，当企业面临低盈利能力和高现金流波动性时，权力大的CEO更有可能派发和增加股利。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. My discussion suggests some alternative firm responses, a restructuring of the main tests to be consistent with the theory and predictions, and an interpretation of the magnitude of the observed associations. Overall, the paper addresses an interesting issue, recognizes that executive compensation is endogenous in this event, and adds to the long literature on dividend payout policy. 摘要（中文） Aboody和Kasznik（《会计研究评论》，本期，2008）就企业可能如何应对2003年股利减税构建并检验了横截面预测。我的讨论提出了一些替代性的企业反应、对主要检验进行重构以使其与理论和预测相一致，以及对所观察到的关联幅度的一种解读。总体而言，该论文探讨了一个有趣的议题，认识到高管薪酬在这一事件中是内生的，并为关于股利支付政策的长期文献有所贡献。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: MEASURING ASSET VALUES FOR CASH SETTLEMENT IN DERIVATIVE MARKETS - HEDONIC REPEATED-MEASURES INDEXES AND PERPETUAL FUTURES
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Two proposals are made that may facilitate the creation of derivative market instruments, such as futures contracts, cash settled based on economic indices. Raw markdown: shiller-1993-measuring-asset-values-for-cash-settlement-in-derivative Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: MEASURING ASSET VALUES FOR CASH SETTLEMENT IN DERIVATIVE MARKETS - HEDONIC REPEATED-MEASURES INDEXES AND PERPETUAL FUTURES (1993) Paper claim — Two proposals are made that may facilitate the creation of derivative market instruments, such as futures contracts, cash settled based on economic indices. Raw markdown: shiller-1993-measuring-asset-values-for-cash-settlement-in-derivative Bibliographic Record Authors: SHILLER, RJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1993 DOI: 10.2307/2329020 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Two proposals are made that may facilitate the creation of derivative market instruments, such as futures contracts, cash settled based on economic indices. The first proposal concerns index number construction: indices based on infrequent measurements of nonstandardized items may control for quality change by using a hedonic repeated measures method, an index number construction method that follows individual assets or subjects through time and also takes account of measured quality variables. The second proposal is to establish markets for perpetual claims on cash flows matching indices of dividends or rents. Such markets may help us to measure the prices of the assets generating these dividends or rents even when the underlying asset prices are difficult or impossible to observe directly. A perpetual futures contract is proposed that would cash settle every day in terms of both the change in the futures price and the dividend or rent index for that day. 摘要（中文） 本文提出两项建议，可能有助于创设衍生市场工具，例如基于经济指数进行现金结算的期货合约。第一项建议关乎指数编制：基于对非标准化项目不频繁测量的指数，可通过使用一种享乐重复测量法（hedonic repeated measures method）来控制质量变化，这是一种跟踪个别资产或对象随时间变化、并同时考虑可测量质量变量的指数编制方法。第二项建议是为匹配股利或租金指数的现金流建立永续求偿权市场。此类市场可能有助于我们衡量产生这些股利或租金的资产的价格，即便在标的资产价格难以或无法直接观察时亦然。文中提出了一种永续期货合约，它将根据当日期货价格的变化以及股利或租金指数在每日进行现金结算。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Shareholder Composition and Managerial Compensation (2016) Paper claim — Stock options are used only sparingly in Japan. Raw markdown: shinozaki-2016-shareholder-composition-and-managerial-compensation Bibliographic Record Authors: Shinozaki, S, Moriyasu, H, Uchida, K Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2016 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109016000636 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Stock options are used only sparingly in Japan. Japanese firms are more likely to adopt new stock option plans when they are more (less) owned by arms-length investors (stable and controlling shareholders). Those firms have significantly more independent boards and pay higher dividends surrounding the adoption year than their industry peers. These results suggest that firms adopting stock options endeavor to meet demands for good governance practice from arms-length shareholders and to follow good governance practices in other dimensions. The coexistence of arms-length, stable, and controlling shareholders generates a situation in which stock options are not widely used in Japan. 摘要（中文） 股票期权在日本仅被少量使用。当日本公司更多（更少）地被保持一定距离的（arms-length）投资者（稳定和控股股东）持有时，它们更可能采用新的股票期权计划。这些公司在采用年份前后拥有明显更为独立的董事会，并支付高于其行业同行的股利。这些结果表明，采用股票期权的公司努力满足保持一定距离的股东对良好治理实践的要求，并在其他维度上遵循良好的治理实践。保持一定距离的、稳定的和控股的股东三者并存，产生了一种股票期权在日本未被广泛使用的局面。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The link between dividend policy and institutional ownership
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the relatively neglected link between dividend policy and institutional ownership. Raw markdown: short-2002-the-link-between-dividend-policy-and-institutional-ownership Bibliographic Record Authors: Short, H, Zhang, H, Keasey, K Journal: JOURNAL…
pages.text: The link between dividend policy and institutional ownership (2002) Paper claim — This paper examines the relatively neglected link between dividend policy and institutional ownership. Raw markdown: short-2002-the-link-between-dividend-policy-and-institutional-ownership Bibliographic Record Authors: Short, H, Zhang, H, Keasey, K Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2002 DOI: 10.1016/S0929-1199(01)00030-X Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract This paper examines the relatively neglected link between dividend policy and institutional ownership. It is also the first example of using well-established dividend payout models to examine the potential association between ownership structures and dividend policy. Moreover, the paper presents the first results for the UK, where the institutional framework and ownership structures are different from those of the US. Using a UK panel data set, the role of institutional ownership in association to dividend payout ratios is analysed within the context of the dividend models of Lintner [American Economic Review, 46 (1956) 97], Waud [Journal of the American Statistical Association, 1996] and Fama and Babiak [Journal of the American Statistical Association, 63 (1968) 1132]. The results consistently produce strong support for the hypothesis that a positive association exists between dividend payout policy and institutional ownership. Furthermore, the results for an earnings trend model suggest a positive earnings trend component to the association between institutional ownership and the dividend payout ratio. In addition, there is some evidence in support of the hypothesis that a negative association exists between dividend payout policy and managerial ownership. (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了股利政策与机构持股之间相对被忽视的联系。这也是首次运用成熟的股利支付模型来考察所有权结构与股利政策之间潜在关联的例子。此外，本文首次给出了英国的结果，而英国的制度框架与所有权结构不同于美国。利用英国的面板数据集，本文在Lintner（American Economic Review, 46 (1956) 97）、Waud（Journal of the American Statistical Association, 1996）以及Fama和Babiak（Journal of the American Statistical Association, 63 (1968) 1132）的股利模型框架下，分析了机构持股与股利支付率的关联作用。结果一致地为以下假说提供了强有力的支持：股利支付政策与机构持股之间存在正相关关系。此外，盈余趋势模型的结果表明，机构持股与股利支付率之间的关联存在正向的盈余趋势成分。另外，也有一些证据支持股利支付政策与管理层持股之间存在负相关关系的假说。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — The tax burden on equity securities has varied substantially over time and remains a source of continuing policy debate. Raw markdown: sialm-2009-tax-changes-and-asset-pricing Bibliographic Record Authors: Sialm, C Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2009 DOI:…
pages.text: Tax Changes and Asset Pricing (2009) Paper claim — The tax burden on equity securities has varied substantially over time and remains a source of continuing policy debate. Raw markdown: sialm-2009-tax-changes-and-asset-pricing Bibliographic Record Authors: Sialm, C Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2009 DOI: 10.1257/aer.99.4.1356 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract The tax burden on equity securities has varied substantially over time and remains a source of continuing policy debate. This paper investigates whether investors were compensated for the tax burden of equity securities over the period between 1913 and 2006. Taxes on equity securities vary over time due to changes in dividend and capital gains tax rates and due to changes in corporate payout policies. Equity taxes also vary across firms due to persistent differences in propensities to pay dividends. The results indicate an economically plausible and statistically significant tax capitalization over time and cross-sectionally. (JEL G10, G12, H22, H24, N21, N22) 摘要（中文） 股权证券的税收负担随时间大幅变化，至今仍是持续的政策辩论焦点。本文考察在1913年至2006年期间，投资者是否因股权证券的税收负担而获得补偿。股权证券的税收随时间变化，原因在于股利税率和资本利得税率的变化以及公司支付政策的变化。由于派发股利意愿的持续性差异，股权税收也在公司之间存在差异。结果表明，随时间和横截面均存在经济上合理且统计上显著的税收资本化。(JEL G10, G12, H22, H24, N21, N22) Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividend tax capitalization and liquidity
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We provide a new explanation for cross-sectional variation in dividend tax capitalization. Raw markdown: sikes-2015-dividend-tax-capitalization-and-liquidity Bibliographic Record Authors: Sikes, SA, Verrecchia, RE Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2015…
pages.text: Dividend tax capitalization and liquidity (2015) Paper claim — We provide a new explanation for cross-sectional variation in dividend tax capitalization. Raw markdown: sikes-2015-dividend-tax-capitalization-and-liquidity Bibliographic Record Authors: Sikes, SA, Verrecchia, RE Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-015-9323-1 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We provide a new explanation for cross-sectional variation in dividend tax capitalization. Our analysis is twofold. First, we conduct a theoretical analysis that shows that liquidity (illiquidity) mitigates (magnifies) the positive effect of dividend taxes on expected rates of return documented in prior literature. Second, we conduct an empirical analysis centered around the Jobs and Growth Tax Relief and Reconciliation Act of 2003, which reduced the difference between the maximum statutory dividend and capital gains tax rates, and find results consistent with our theory. We also provide results suggesting that institutional ownership's mitigating effect on dividend tax capitalization documented in prior studies is attributable to stocks with greater institutional ownership being more liquid and not to the "marginal investor" being insensitive to dividend taxes. 摘要（中文） 我们为股利税资本化的横截面差异提供了一种新的解释。我们的分析有两方面。首先，我们进行了理论分析，表明流动性（非流动性）会缓解（放大）先前文献所记录的股利税对预期收益率的正向影响。其次，我们围绕2003年《就业与增长税收减免协调法案》进行了实证分析，该法案缩小了最高法定股利税率与资本利得税率之间的差异，我们发现结果与我们的理论相一致。我们还提供了结果表明，先前研究所记录的机构持股对股利税资本化的缓解效应，可归因于机构持股更高的股票流动性更强，而非归因于"边际投资者"对股利税不敏感。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines how the relation between earnings and payout policy has evolved over the last three decades. Raw markdown: skinner-2008-the-evolving-relation-between-earnings-dividends-and-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Skinner, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: The evolving relation between earnings, dividends, and stock repurchases (2008) Paper claim — This paper examines how the relation between earnings and payout policy has evolved over the last three decades. Raw markdown: skinner-2008-the-evolving-relation-between-earnings-dividends-and-stock Bibliographic Record Authors: Skinner, DJ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.05.003 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, stock repurchase) Abstract This paper examines how the relation between earnings and payout policy has evolved over the last three decades. Three principal groups of payers have emerged: firms that pay dividends and make regular repurchases, firms that make regular repurchases, and firms that make occasional repurchases. Firms that only pay dividends are largely extinct. Repurchases are increasingly used in place of dividends, even for firms that continue to pay dividends. While other factors help explain the timing of repurchases, the overall level of repurchases is fundamentally determined by earnings. The results suggest that repurchases are now the dominant form of payout. (C) 2007 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察收益与支付政策之间的关系在过去三十年里如何演变。出现了三大类支付者：既派息又进行常规回购的企业、进行常规回购的企业，以及偶尔进行回购的企业。仅派息的企业已基本消失。回购越来越多地被用来替代股利，即便对于继续派息的企业也是如此。虽然其他因素有助于解释回购的时机，但回购的总体水平从根本上由收益决定。这些结果表明，回购如今已成为主导性的支付形式。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Over the past 30 years, there have been significant changes in the distribution of earnings-cross-sectional variation has increased, with increasing left skewness-as well as in corporate payout policy, with many fewer firms paying dividends and the emergence of…
pages.text: What do dividends tell us about earnings quality? (2011) Paper claim — Over the past 30 years, there have been significant changes in the distribution of earnings-cross-sectional variation has increased, with increasing left skewness-as well as in corporate payout policy, with many fewer firms paying dividends and the emergence of stock repurchases. Raw markdown: skinner-2011-what-do-dividends-tell-us-about-earnings-quality Bibliographic Record Authors: Skinner, DJ, Soltes, E Journal: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1007/s11142-009-9113-8 Relevance score: 9.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend, payout, stock repurchase) Abstract Over the past 30 years, there have been significant changes in the distribution of earnings-cross-sectional variation has increased, with increasing left skewness-as well as in corporate payout policy, with many fewer firms paying dividends and the emergence of stock repurchases. We investigate whether the informativeness of payout policy with respect to earnings quality changes over this period. We find that the reported earnings of dividend-paying firms are more persistent than those of other firms and that this relation is remarkably stable over time. We also find that dividend payers are less likely to report losses and those losses that they do report tend to be transitory losses driven by special items. These results do not hold as strongly for stock repurchases, consistent with them representing less of a commitment than dividends. 摘要（中文） 在过去30年中，盈利分布发生了显著变化——横截面差异增大，左偏度增加——企业支付政策也发生了显著变化，支付股利的企业大幅减少，股票回购兴起。我们考察在此期间支付政策相对于盈利质量的信息量是否发生变化。我们发现，支付股利企业的报告盈利比其他企业更具持续性，且这一关系在整个时期内非常稳定。我们还发现，股利支付者更不可能报告亏损，且它们所报告的亏损往往是由特殊项目驱动的暂时性亏损。这些结果对于股票回购不那么强烈地成立，这与回购比股利代表更少的承诺相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine whether an adverse event at one bank generates externalities for the banking industry, and assess whether the population of commercial banks is homogeneous. Raw markdown: slovin-1999-an-analysis-of-contagion-and-competitive-effects-at Bibliographic…
pages.text: An analysis of contagion and competitive effects at commercial banks (1999) Paper claim — We examine whether an adverse event at one bank generates externalities for the banking industry, and assess whether the population of commercial banks is homogeneous. Raw markdown: slovin-1999-an-analysis-of-contagion-and-competitive-effects-at Bibliographic Record Authors: Slovin, MB, Sushka, ME, Polonchek, JA Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(99)00036-7 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(enforce, regulat)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We examine whether an adverse event at one bank generates externalities for the banking industry, and assess whether the population of commercial banks is homogeneous. We find dividend reductions are negative events for both announcing money center and regional banks, but only reductions at money center banks have negative, contagion-type externalities. Dividend reductions at regional banks have positive competitive effects on geographic rivals. Regulatory enforcement actions induce negative valuation effects that are idiosyncratic to targeted banks, but actions against regional banks generate positive competitive effects on geographic rivals. Our evidence suggests that regional banking markets are not contestable. (C) 1999 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification: G21; G28. 摘要（中文） 我们考察一家银行的不利事件是否会为银行业产生外部性，并评估商业银行群体是否是同质的。我们发现，股利削减对宣布削减的货币中心银行和区域性银行都是负面事件，但只有货币中心银行的削减才具有负面的、传染型的外部性。区域性银行的股利削减对地理上的竞争对手具有正面的竞争效应。监管执法行动会诱发对目标银行特有的负面估值效应，但针对区域性银行的行动会对地理上的竞争对手产生正面的竞争效应。我们的证据表明，区域性银行市场是不可竞争的（not contestable）。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. We document robust empirical relations among corporate policy decisions and various firm characteristics. Our evidence suggests contracting theories are more important in explaining cross-sectional variation in observed financial, dividend, and compensation policies than either tax-based or signaling theories. 摘要（中文） 我们考察对公司融资政策、股利政策和薪酬政策选择的各种解释。我们记录了公司政策决策与各种公司特征之间稳健的实证关系。我们的证据表明，在解释所观察到的融资、股利和薪酬政策的横截面差异方面，契约理论比基于税收或信号传递的理论更为重要。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: An appraisal of shareholder proportional liability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Shareholders of corporations have their liability for actions of the corporation limited by law. Raw markdown: sollars-2001-an-appraisal-of-shareholder-proportional-liability Bibliographic Record Authors: Sollars, GG Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2001…
pages.text: An appraisal of shareholder proportional liability (2001) Paper claim — Shareholders of corporations have their liability for actions of the corporation limited by law. Raw markdown: sollars-2001-an-appraisal-of-shareholder-proportional-liability Bibliographic Record Authors: Sollars, GG Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1023/A:1010768824610 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract Shareholders of corporations have their liability for actions of the corporation limited by law. Unlike the equity holder in a partnership or proprietorship, the assets that a shareholder has distinct from her holdings in the enterprise can not be taken to satisfy liabilities arising from actions of the enterprise itself. This paper argues that a reasonable principle of fairness argues for an alternative to limited liability, proportional liability. Proportional liability makes a shareholder liable for the same proportion of a corporation's excess of liabilities over assets that her number of shares bears to the total number of shares outstanding. The key idea is that it is unfair in situations in which explicit agreements can not be reached for shareholders to bear only limited risk when they may receive gains from stock dividends and appreciation that are not limited to any pre-determined amount. Proportional liability has not been much examined in the financial literature. Good utilitarian arguments have been given for limited liability over unlimited liability for corporate shareholders, but these arguments do not clearly support the choice of limited liability over proportional liability. 摘要（中文） 公司的股东其对公司行为所负的责任受法律限制。与合伙企业或独资企业的权益持有人不同，股东在其对企业持股之外所拥有的资产，不能被用于清偿由企业自身行为所产生的负债。本文认为，一个合理的公平原则支持一种替代有限责任的方案，即比例责任（proportional liability）。比例责任使股东按其所持股份数占已发行股份总数的比例，对公司负债超过资产的部分承担相同比例的责任。核心思想是：在无法达成明确协议的情形下，让股东仅承担有限风险是不公平的，因为他们可能从股票股利和增值中获得不受任何预定金额限制的收益。比例责任在金融文献中未受到太多考察。关于公司股东采用有限责任而非无限责任，人们已给出了很好的功利主义论证，但这些论证并未明确支持选择有限责任而非比例责任。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Digital Finance and Dividend Policy: Evidence from China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Regional digital finance development positively and causally affects corporate dividend payouts in China, operating through channels of reduced information asymmetry (which diminishes insiders' incentive to retain cash) and alleviated financing constraints. Raw…
pages.text: Digital Finance and Dividend Policy: Evidence from China (2025) Paper claim — Regional digital finance development positively and causally affects corporate dividend payouts in China, operating through channels of reduced information asymmetry (which diminishes insiders' incentive to retain cash) and alleviated financing constraints. Raw markdown: song-2025-digital-finance-and-dividend-policy-evidence-from-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Song, Yunxing; Lee, Suin; Wang, Bin Journal: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2025.102704 Abstract This study investigates the effect of digital finance on dividend payouts. Using the digital finance index from PKU-DFICC and a sample of Chinese listed firms, we find a positive relation between digital finance and dividend payouts. Supporting our hypothesis that digital finance reduces information asymmetry and increases insiders' incentive to pay out dividends, the positive relation is stronger for firms with severe information asymmetry. Additionally, digital finance's role in reducing financing constraints also promotes dividend payouts. Overall, our findings suggest noteworthy implications of digital finance on financial markets via dividend payout policy. Key Findings Regional digital finance development (PKU-DFICC index) is positively and significantly associated with all three dividend measures across 18,381 firm-year observations for 2,507 Chinese listed firms (2011–2021); a one-SD increase in digital finance corresponds to a 14.8% increase in mean DVE and 27.5% increase in mean DVC. The effect is more pronounced for firms with greater information asymmetry — firms with low analyst coverage, non-SOE ownership, small size, and higher managerial ownership — consistent with digital finance reducing insiders' opacity-enabled incentive to withhold dividends. Digital finance reduces financing constraints (KZ index), and financing constraints in turn negatively predict dividends; this two-stage pattern is consistent with a financing-constraints mediation channel running from digital finance to payout policy. Causal identification via DID (exploiting the 2016 G20 Digital Inclusive Finance Senior Principles as a regional shock differentially affecting central/western China) and 2SLS-IV (mobile phone users per 100 people as an instrument) both confirm a positive causal effect on dividends. Of the three digital finance sub-dimensions, DF_Breadth (coverage) and DF_Depth (usage intensity) drive the effect; DF_Digital (digitization of inclusive finance for individuals/SMEs) is not significant, implying that the dividend channel operates through corporate-facing financial services rather than individual-facing inclusive finance. pages.title: Buyback behaviour and the option funding hypothesis
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We study how stock option grants are funded through share repurchases under conditions of option exercisability and moneyness. Raw markdown: sonika-2020-buyback-behaviour-and-the-option-funding-hypothesis Bibliographic Record Authors: Sonika, R, Shackleton, MB…
pages.text: Buyback behaviour and the option funding hypothesis (2020) Paper claim — We study how stock option grants are funded through share repurchases under conditions of option exercisability and moneyness. Raw markdown: sonika-2020-buyback-behaviour-and-the-option-funding-hypothesis Bibliographic Record Authors: Sonika, R, Shackleton, MB Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2020.105800 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure, regulat)；股利政策(buyback, share repurchase) Abstract We study how stock option grants are funded through share repurchases under conditions of option exercisability and moneyness. Using daily repurchase disclosures by U.K. firms, we corroborate our hypothesis that driven by flexibility, firms repurchase early in an option schedule while options are out-of-money and before becoming exercisable. Our findings show that when daily stock prices are below weighted average option exercise price and when options are not immediately exercisable, firms (a) increase daily repurchase volume (value), (b) increase repurchase frequency, and (c) have lower relative repurchase prices. We further evidence this by examining the change in treasury regulation that enabled firms to hold on to repurchased shares rather than cancelling them. Our findings show a strong support for option funding motives in the post-treasury regulation period when repurchase flexibility is greater. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究在期权可行权性和价内价外状态的条件下，如何通过股份回购来为股票期权授予提供资金。使用英国企业的每日回购披露数据，我们印证了如下假设，即出于灵活性的驱动，企业在期权计划早期、当期权处于价外且尚未变得可行权之前进行回购。我们的发现表明，当每日股价低于加权平均期权行权价格且期权尚不可立即行权时，企业 (a) 增加每日回购量（价值），(b) 提高回购频率，以及 (c) 拥有更低的相对回购价格。我们通过考察一项使企业能够持有回购股份而非将其注销的库存股监管变化，进一步证明了这一点。我们的发现为库存股监管后回购灵活性更大的时期内的期权融资动机提供了有力支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Stock price volatility in a multiple security overlapping generations model
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — A number of empirical studies have reached the conclusion that stock: price volatility cannot be fully explained within the standard dividend discount model This article proposes a resolution based upon a model that contains both a random supply of risky assets and…
pages.text: Stock price volatility in a multiple security overlapping generations model (1998) Paper claim — A number of empirical studies have reached the conclusion that stock: price volatility cannot be fully explained within the standard dividend discount model This article proposes a resolution based upon a model that contains both a random supply of risky assets and finitely lived agents who trade in a multiple security environment As the analysis shows there exist 2(K) equilibria when K securities trade. Raw markdown: spiegel-1998-stock-price-volatility-in-a-multiple-security-overlapping Bibliographic Record Authors: Spiegel, M Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/11.2.419 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract A number of empirical studies have reached the conclusion that stock: price volatility cannot be fully explained within the standard dividend discount model This article proposes a resolution based upon a model that contains both a random supply of risky assets and finitely lived agents who trade in a multiple security environment As the analysis shows there exist 2(K) equilibria when K securities trade. The low volatility equilibria have properties analogous to those found in the infinitely lived agent models of Campbell and Kyle (1991) and Wang (1993, 1994). In contrast; the high-volatility equilibria have very different characteristics. Within the high-volatility equilibria very large price variances can be generated with very small supply shocks Adding securities to the economy further reduces the required supply shocks. Using previously established empirical results the model can reconcile tbe data with supply shocks that are less than 10% as large as observed return shocks. These results are shown to hold even when the dividend process is mean reverting. 摘要（中文） 许多实证研究得出结论，股价波动无法在标准股利贴现模型内得到完全解释。本文提出一种基于如下模型的解决方案：该模型既包含风险资产的随机供给，又包含在多证券环境中交易的有限存活期主体。分析表明，当K种证券交易时，存在2的K次方个均衡。低波动率均衡具有与Campbell和Kyle（1991）以及Wang（1993、1994）无限存活期主体模型中所发现的类似性质。相比之下，高波动率均衡具有极为不同的特征。在高波动率均衡内，极小的供给冲击就能产生极大的价格方差。向经济中增加证券会进一步减小所需的供给冲击。利用先前确立的实证结果，该模型能够用不到观测收益冲击10%大小的供给冲击来调和数据。这些结果被证明即使在股利过程均值回复时也成立。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Disclosure and Recognition Requirements: Corporate Investment Decisions with Externalities
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper examines the effects of disclosure and recognition requirements on investment decisions when shareholders have limited liability. Raw markdown: sridhar-2001-disclosure-and-recognition-requirements-corporate-investment-decisions-with Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Disclosure and Recognition Requirements: Corporate Investment Decisions with Externalities (2001) Paper claim — This paper examines the effects of disclosure and recognition requirements on investment decisions when shareholders have limited liability. Raw markdown: sridhar-2001-disclosure-and-recognition-requirements-corporate-investment-decisions-with Bibliographic Record Authors: Sridhar, SS, Magee, RP Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2001 DOI: 10.1506/DD01-GWP2-CM4Y-C7JK Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(disclosure)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper examines the effects of disclosure and recognition requirements on investment decisions when shareholders have limited liability. Firms' investment projects have either high initial pollution prevention costs or high subsequent clean-up costs, and their liability for clean-up costs may be either individual or joint and several. Even with individual liability for clean-up costs, shareholders' limited liability creates an incentive to select the latter project type and to impose costs on the rest of the economy. This tendency is exacerbated when clean-up liability is joint and several. We show that a disclosure requirement cannot have an unambiguous effect on the selection of the "cleaner" project. However, an accrual requirement, together with an accounting-based dividend restriction, is shown to promote choice of the project that imposes lower expected costs on the rest of the economy. Moreover, we find that it is possible for a recognition requirement to have a greater impact in a joint-and-several liability regime than in an individual liability regime. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了在股东承担有限责任时，披露与确认要求对投资决策的影响。企业的投资项目要么具有较高的初始污染预防成本，要么具有较高的后续清理成本，且其对清理成本的责任可能是个别责任，也可能是连带责任。即便在对清理成本承担个别责任的情况下，股东的有限责任也会产生选择后一类项目并将成本强加给经济体其余部分的激励。当清理责任为连带责任时，这种倾向会加剧。我们表明，披露要求对"更清洁"项目的选择不可能产生明确的影响。然而，一项应计要求连同一项基于会计的股利限制，被证明能够促进对那些给经济体其余部分强加较低预期成本的项目的选择。此外，我们发现，在连带责任制度下，确认要求有可能比在个别责任制度下产生更大的影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: CEO inside debt holdings and risk-shifting: Evidence from bank payout policies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Bank payouts divert cash to shareholders, while leaving behind riskier and less liquid assets to repay debt holders in the future. Raw markdown: srivastav-2014-ceo-inside-debt-holdings-and-risk-shifting-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Srivastav, A, Armitage,…
pages.text: CEO inside debt holdings and risk-shifting: Evidence from bank payout policies (2014) Paper claim — Bank payouts divert cash to shareholders, while leaving behind riskier and less liquid assets to repay debt holders in the future. Raw markdown: srivastav-2014-ceo-inside-debt-holdings-and-risk-shifting-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: Srivastav, A, Armitage, S, Hagendorff, J Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2014 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2014.06.016 Relevance score: 6.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy, regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Bank payouts divert cash to shareholders, while leaving behind riskier and less liquid assets to repay debt holders in the future. Bank payouts, therefore, constitute a type of risk-shifting that benefits equity holders at the expense of debt holders. In this paper, we provide insights on how CEO incentives stemming from inside debt (primarily defined benefit pensions and deferred compensation) impact bank payout policy in a manner that protects debt holder interests. We show that CEOs with higher inside debt relative to inside equity are associated with more conservative bank payout policies. Specifically, CEOs paid with more inside debt are more likely to cut payouts and to cut payouts by a larger amount. Reductions in payouts occur through a decrease in both dividends and repurchases. Our results also hold over a subsample of TARP banks where we expect the link between risk-shifting and payouts to be of particular relevance because it involves wealth transfers from the taxpayer to equity holders. We conclude that inside debt can help in addressing risk-shifting concerns by aligning the interests of CEOs with those of creditors, regulators, and in the case of TARP banks, the taxpayer. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 银行派现将现金转移给股东，同时留下风险更高、流动性更差的资产以在未来偿还债权人。因此，银行派现构成了一种风险转移，它以损害债权人利益为代价使股权持有人受益。在本文中，我们提供了关于源于内部债务（主要是固定收益养老金和递延薪酬）的CEO激励如何以保护债权人利益的方式影响银行派现政策的见解。我们表明，内部债务相对于内部股权较高的CEO与更保守的银行派现政策相关。具体而言，以更多内部债务支付薪酬的CEO更有可能削减派现，且削减的幅度更大。派现的减少通过股利和回购的双重减少来实现。我们的结果在TARP银行子样本中也成立，在这一子样本中，我们预期风险转移与派现之间的联系尤为相关，因为它涉及从纳税人到股权持有人的财富转移。我们得出结论，内部债务能够通过使CEO的利益与债权人、监管者、以及在TARP银行情形下与纳税人的利益相一致，从而有助于解决风险转移担忧。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — When a rate of return is regressed on a lagged stochastic regressor, such as a dividend yield, the regression disturbance is correlated with the regressor's innovation. Raw markdown: stambaugh-1999-predictive-regressions Bibliographic Record Authors: Stambaugh, RF…
pages.text: Predictive regressions (1999) Paper claim — When a rate of return is regressed on a lagged stochastic regressor, such as a dividend yield, the regression disturbance is correlated with the regressor's innovation. Raw markdown: stambaugh-1999-predictive-regressions Bibliographic Record Authors: Stambaugh, RF Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1999 DOI: 10.1016/S0304-405X(99)00041-0 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract When a rate of return is regressed on a lagged stochastic regressor, such as a dividend yield, the regression disturbance is correlated with the regressor's innovation. The OLS estimator's finite-sample properties, derived here, can depart substantially from the standard regression setting. Bayesian posterior distributions for the regression parameters are obtained under specifications that differ with respect to (i) prior beliefs about the autocorrelation of the regressor and (ii) whether the initial observation of the regressor is specified as fixed or stochastic. The posteriors differ across such specifications, and asset allocations in the presence of estimation risk exhibit sensitivity to those differences. (C) 1999 Elsevier Science S.A. All rights reserved. JEL classification. C32; C11; G11. 摘要（中文） 当把收益率对一个滞后的随机回归变量（例如股利收益率）进行回归时，回归扰动项与该回归变量的新息（innovation）相关。本文推导出的OLS估计量的有限样本性质，可能与标准回归情形有实质性的偏离。在关于（i）对回归变量自相关的先验信念以及（ii）回归变量的初始观测值被设定为固定还是随机这两方面存在差异的设定下，本文得到了回归参数的贝叶斯后验分布。后验分布在不同设定之间存在差异，且在存在估计风险时的资产配置对这些差异表现出敏感性。JEL分类：C32；C11；G11。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Actual share reacquisitions in open-market repurchase programs
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Unlike Dutch auction repurchases and tender offers, open-market repurchase programs do not precommit firms to acquire a specified number of shares. Raw markdown: stephens-1998-actual-share-reacquisitions-in-open-market-repurchase-programs Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: Actual share reacquisitions in open-market repurchase programs (1998) Paper claim — Unlike Dutch auction repurchases and tender offers, open-market repurchase programs do not precommit firms to acquire a specified number of shares. Raw markdown: stephens-1998-actual-share-reacquisitions-in-open-market-repurchase-programs Bibliographic Record Authors: Stephens, CP, Weisbach, MS Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1998 DOI: 10.1111/0022-1082.115194 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(share repurchase)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Unlike Dutch auction repurchases and tender offers, open-market repurchase programs do not precommit firms to acquire a specified number of shares. In a sample of 450 programs from 1981 to 1990, firms on average acquire 74 to 82 percent of the shares announced as repurchase targets within three years of the repurchase announcement. We find that share repurchases are negatively related to prior stock price performance, suggesting that firms increase their purchasing depending on its degree of perceived undervaluation. In addition, repurchases are positively related to levels of cash flow, which is consistent with liquidity arguments. 摘要（中文） 与荷兰式拍卖回购和要约收购不同，公开市场回购计划并不使公司预先承诺收购指定数量的股份。在1981年至1990年间的450个计划的样本中，公司平均在回购公告后三年内收购了宣布为回购目标的股份的74%至82%。我们发现股份回购与此前的股价表现负相关，这表明公司根据其被感知的低估程度增加购买。此外，回购与现金流水平正相关，这与流动性论点相一致。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The mystery of zero-leverage firms
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We present the puzzling evidence that, from 1962 to 2009, an average 10.2% of large public nonfinancial US firms have zero debt and almost 22% have less than 5% book leverage ratio. Raw markdown: strebulaev-2013-the-mystery-of-zero-leverage-firms Bibliographic…
pages.text: The mystery of zero-leverage firms (2013) Paper claim — We present the puzzling evidence that, from 1962 to 2009, an average 10.2% of large public nonfinancial US firms have zero debt and almost 22% have less than 5% book leverage ratio. Raw markdown: strebulaev-2013-the-mystery-of-zero-leverage-firms Bibliographic Record Authors: Strebulaev, IA, Yang, BZ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2013.02.001 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We present the puzzling evidence that, from 1962 to 2009, an average 10.2% of large public nonfinancial US firms have zero debt and almost 22% have less than 5% book leverage ratio. Zero-leverage behavior is a persistent phenomenon. Dividend-paying zero-leverage firms pay substantially higher dividends, are more profitable, pay higher taxes, issue less equity, and have higher cash balances than control firms chosen by industry and size. Firms with higher Chief Executive Officer (CEO) ownership and longer CEO tenure are more likely to have zero debt, especially if boards are smaller and less independent. Family firms are also more likely to be zero-levered. (C) 2013 Published by Elsevier B.V. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了这样一个令人费解的证据：从1962到2009年，平均有10.2%的美国大型上市非金融企业零负债，且近22%的账面杠杆率低于5%。零杠杆行为是一种持续存在的现象。支付股利的零杠杆企业相比按行业和规模选取的对照企业，支付的股利显著更高、盈利能力更强、缴税更多、发行股权更少，且现金余额更高。首席执行官（CEO）持股更高、CEO任期更长的企业更有可能零负债，尤其是在董事会规模较小且独立性较低时。家族企业也更有可能零杠杆。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: A simple nonparametric approach to derivative security valuation (1996) Paper claim — Canonical valuation uses historical time series to predict the probability distribution of the discounted Value of primary assets' discounted prices plus accumulated dividends at any future date. Raw markdown: stutzer-1996-a-simple-nonparametric-approach-to-derivative-security-valuation Bibliographic Record Authors: Stutzer, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 1996 DOI: 10.2307/2329532 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Canonical valuation uses historical time series to predict the probability distribution of the discounted Value of primary assets' discounted prices plus accumulated dividends at any future date. Then the axiomatically-rationalized maximum entropy principle is used to estimate risk-neutral (equivalent martingale) probabilities that correctly price the primary assets, as well as any predesignated subset of derivative securities whose payoffs occur at this date. Valuation of other derivative securities proceeds by calculation of its discounted, risk-neutral expected value. Both simulation and empirical evidence suggest that canonical Valuation has merit. 摘要（中文） 标准估值法（canonical valuation）使用历史时间序列来预测在未来任一日期基础资产贴现价格加累积股利的贴现价值的概率分布。然后，运用经公理化论证的最大熵原理来估计风险中性（等价鞅）概率，使其能够正确地为基础资产以及在该日期支付的任何预先指定的衍生证券子集定价。对其他衍生证券的估值通过计算其贴现的、风险中性的期望值来进行。模拟证据和经验证据都表明标准估值法具有其价值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Feedback from stock prices to cash flows occurs because information revealed by firms' stock prices influences the actions of competitors. Raw markdown: subrahmanyam-2013-financial-market-shocks-and-the-macroeconomy Bibliographic Record Authors: Subrahmanyam, A,…
pages.text: Financial Market Shocks and the Macroeconomy (2013) Paper claim — Feedback from stock prices to cash flows occurs because information revealed by firms' stock prices influences the actions of competitors. Raw markdown: subrahmanyam-2013-financial-market-shocks-and-the-macroeconomy Bibliographic Record Authors: Subrahmanyam, A, Titman, S Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hht058 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Feedback from stock prices to cash flows occurs because information revealed by firms' stock prices influences the actions of competitors. We explore the implications of feedback within a noisy rational expectations setting with incumbent publicly traded firms and privately held new entrants. In this setting the equilibrium relation among stock prices and both future dividends and aggregate output depends on the strategic environment in which these firms operate. In general, under reasonable conditions, the relations between prices, dividends, and economic output in our framework are consistent with empirical evidence in the macroliterature. We also generate new, potentially testable, implications. 摘要（中文） 从股价到现金流的反馈之所以发生，是因为公司股价所揭示的信息会影响竞争对手的行动。我们在一个具有在位上市公司和私人持有的新进入者的噪声理性预期框架内探讨反馈的含义。在此框架下，股价与未来股利以及总产出之间的均衡关系取决于这些公司所处的策略环境。总体而言，在合理条件下，我们框架中价格、股利与经济产出之间的关系与宏观文献中的实证证据相一致。我们还生成了新的、潜在可检验的推论。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We investigate the liquidity management of firms following the inception of credit default swaps (CDS) markets on their debt, which allow hedging and speculative trading on credit risk to be carried out by creditors and other parties. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Credit default swaps, exacting creditors and corporate liquidity management (2017) Paper claim — We investigate the liquidity management of firms following the inception of credit default swaps (CDS) markets on their debt, which allow hedging and speculative trading on credit risk to be carried out by creditors and other parties. Raw markdown: subrahmanyam-2017-credit-default-swaps-exacting-creditors-and-corporate-liquidity Bibliographic Record Authors: Subrahmanyam, MG, Tang, DYJ, Wang, SQ Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2017.02.001 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract We investigate the liquidity management of firms following the inception of credit default swaps (CDS) markets on their debt, which allow hedging and speculative trading on credit risk to be carried out by creditors and other parties. We find that reference firms hold more cash after CDS trading commences on their debt. The increase in cash holdings is more pronounced for CDS firms that do not pay dividends and have a higher marginal value of liquidity. For CDS firms with higher cash flow volatility, these increased cash holdings do not entail higher leverage. Overall, our findings are consistent with the view that CDS-referenced firms adopt more conservative liquidity policies to avoid negotiations with more exacting creditors. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们研究了企业在其债务上的信用违约互换（CDS）市场设立之后的流动性管理，该市场允许债权人及其他各方对信用风险进行对冲和投机交易。我们发现，参照公司在其债务的CDS交易开始后持有更多现金。对于不派息且流动性边际价值较高的CDS公司，现金持有量的增加更为明显。对于现金流波动率较高的CDS公司，这些增加的现金持有量并不伴随更高的杠杆。总体而言，我们的发现与以下观点相一致：被CDS参照的公司采取更为保守的流动性政策，以避免与更为苛刻的债权人进行谈判。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine whether and how payout policy affects credit risk using evidence from the credit default swap (CDS) market. Raw markdown: sun-2021-corporate-payout-policy-and-credit-risk-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Sun, CZ, Wang, SJ, Zhang, C Journal:…
pages.text: Corporate Payout Policy and Credit Risk: Evidence from Credit Default Swap Markets (2021) Paper claim — We examine whether and how payout policy affects credit risk using evidence from the credit default swap (CDS) market. Raw markdown: sun-2021-corporate-payout-policy-and-credit-risk-evidence-from Bibliographic Record Authors: Sun, CZ, Wang, SJ, Zhang, C Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2020.3753 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We examine whether and how payout policy affects credit risk using evidence from the credit default swap (CDS) market. CDS spreads increase substantially in response to announcements of dividend cuts, especially during recessions and among firms ex-periencing financial distress. CDS spreads also react more strongly to permanent and less anticipated dividend cuts. The size of the CDS reaction is more pronounced for financial firms, which are inherently more opaque. In contrast, CDS spreads react weakly to dividend raises and share repurchases. The results show that the information effect of dividend changes dominates the wealth-transfer effect. 摘要（中文） 我们利用信用违约互换（CDS）市场的证据，考察支付政策是否以及如何影响信用风险。CDS利差在股利削减公告后大幅上升，尤其是在衰退期间以及陷入财务困境的企业中。CDS利差对永久性且更少被预期的股利削减也反应更强烈。CDS反应的规模对本质上更不透明的金融企业更为显著。相比之下，CDS利差对股利提高和股份回购反应微弱。这些结果表明，股利变化的信息效应主导了财富转移效应。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: MARKET FOR INFORMATION - EXPERIMENTAL-EVIDENCE (1992) Paper claim — Predictions of the noisy rational expectations equilibrium (REE) model are found to be relatively accurate for both asset and information markets in the laboratory. Raw markdown: sunder-1992-market-for-information-experimental-evidence Bibliographic Record Authors: SUNDER, S Journal: ECONOMETRICA Year: 1992 DOI: 10.2307/2951588 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Predictions of the noisy rational expectations equilibrium (REE) model are found to be relatively accurate for both asset and information markets in the laboratory. When information about an asset's uncertain dividend is sold to a fixed number of highest bidders, prices, allocations, efficiency, and distribution of profit predictions of the full revelation REE model in the asset market dominate the predictions of the Walrasian model; demand for information shifts to the left and its price declines close to zero. When the price of information is fixed at a relatively high level, the number of informed agents and the informativeness of the asset market tends to adjust to permit the informed agents to recover their investment in information. 摘要（中文） 在实验室中，噪声理性预期均衡（REE）模型的预测对于资产市场和信息市场都被发现相对准确。当关于某资产不确定股利的信息被出售给固定数量的最高出价者时，资产市场中价格、配置、效率和利润分布的预测方面，完全揭示的REE模型的预测支配了瓦尔拉斯模型的预测；对信息的需求向左移动，其价格下降至接近于零。当信息价格被固定在一个相对较高的水平时，获得信息的主体数量以及资产市场的信息含量往往会进行调整，以使获得信息的主体能够收回其在信息上的投资。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Bubbles and Information: An Experiment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Asymmetric distribution of information, although omnipresent in real markets, is rarely considered in experimental economics. Raw markdown: sutter-2012-bubbles-and-information-an-experiment Bibliographic Record Authors: Sutter, M, Huber, J, Kirchler, M Journal:…
pages.text: Bubbles and Information: An Experiment (2012) Paper claim — Asymmetric distribution of information, although omnipresent in real markets, is rarely considered in experimental economics. Raw markdown: sutter-2012-bubbles-and-information-an-experiment Bibliographic Record Authors: Sutter, M, Huber, J, Kirchler, M Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.1110.1365 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract Asymmetric distribution of information, although omnipresent in real markets, is rarely considered in experimental economics. We study whether information about imminent future dividends can abate bubbles in experimental asset markets. We find that markets with asymmetrically informed traders have significantly smaller bubbles than markets with symmetrically informed or uninformed traders. Hence, fundamental values are better reflected in market prices-implying higher market efficiency-when some traders know more than others about future dividends. This suggests that bubbles are abated when traders know that a subset of them have an edge (in information) over others. 摘要（中文） 尽管信息的非对称分布在真实市场中无处不在，但在实验经济学中却鲜被考虑。我们研究关于未来股利的即时信息能否抑制实验资产市场中的泡沫。我们发现，拥有信息不对称交易者的市场比拥有信息对称或未获信息交易者的市场的泡沫显著更小。因此，当一些交易者对未来股利比其他人了解更多时，市场价格能更好地反映基础价值——这意味着更高的市场效率。这表明，当交易者知道他们当中的一部分人在（信息上）比其他人拥有优势时，泡沫会被抑制。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Board directors? foreign experience and firm dividend payouts
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We find that Chinese-listed firms are more likely to pay dividends and implement larger payout ratios when their directors have foreign experience. Raw markdown: tao-2022-board-directors-foreign-experience-and-firm-dividend-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Board directors? foreign experience and firm dividend payouts (2022) Paper claim — We find that Chinese-listed firms are more likely to pay dividends and implement larger payout ratios when their directors have foreign experience. Raw markdown: tao-2022-board-directors-foreign-experience-and-firm-dividend-payouts Bibliographic Record Authors: Tao, QZ, Wei, KCJ, Xiang, XM, Yi, B Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2022 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2022.102237 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, independent director, investor protection, reform, regulat)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract We find that Chinese-listed firms are more likely to pay dividends and implement larger payout ratios when their directors have foreign experience. This finding remains after using various methods to address potential endogeneity concerns. The positive association is stronger for lowgrowth firms, non-state-owned firms, and when directors obtain foreign experience in countries with stronger investor protection. The effect of directors' foreign experience on dividend payouts is also more pronounced for independent directors than for executive directors. Directors with foreign experience appear to overcome the weak investor protection environment as the effects are more pronounced among poorly governed firms and before the regulatory dividend reforms in 2013. Overall, our findings identify a mechanism through which better governance practices are propagated. 摘要（中文） 我们发现，当董事拥有海外经历时，中国上市企业更可能支付股利并实施更大的支付率。这一发现在使用各种方法处理潜在内生性顾虑之后依然成立。这一正相关关系对于低成长企业、非国有企业，以及董事在投资者保护更强的国家获得海外经历的情形更强。董事海外经历对股利支付的影响，对于独立董事也比执行董事更为显著。拥有海外经历的董事似乎克服了薄弱的投资者保护环境，因为这些效应在治理不佳的企业中、以及在2013年监管股利改革之前更为显著。总体而言，我们的发现识别出了一种更好治理实践得以传播的机制。 Key Findings Chinese listed firms with a higher proportion of directors who have foreign experience are significantly more likely to pay dividends and have larger payout ratios; a one-standard-deviation increase in Directors FE is associated with a 2.17 percentage-point increase in the likelihood of paying dividends. The effect is primarily driven by independent directors rather than executive directors (1.93 pp vs. 0.92 pp on dividend likelihood), consistent with FE directors using dividends as a monitoring tool to reduce agency costs of free cash flows. The positive effect is stronger for non-SOE firms, low-growth (mature) firms, firms with weak corporate governance, and when foreign experience is gained in countries with stronger investor protection — all consistent with FE directors substituting for absent formal governance. The effect of directors' foreign experience on dividend payouts is more pronounced before the 2013 CSRC/SSE dividend regulations, demonstrating that external regulatory requirements substitute for the governance role of FE directors. Both foreign study experience and foreign work experience contribute independently to higher dividend payouts, and results are robust to IV estimation (using Christian missionary college count and board network instruments) and Heckman selection correction. Notes Full text available via PDF (markitdown conversion).

pages.excerpt: Paper claim — To what extent can agents' learning and incomplete information about the ''true'' underlying model generating stock returns explain findings of excess volatility and predictability of returns in the stock market? In this paper we analyse two models of recursive…
pages.text: Excess volatility and predictability of stock prices in autoregressive dividend models with learning (1996) Paper claim — To what extent can agents' learning and incomplete information about the ''true'' underlying model generating stock returns explain findings of excess volatility and predictability of returns in the stock market? In this paper we analyse two models of recursive learning in the stock market when dividends follow a (trend-)stationary autoregressive process. Raw markdown: timmermann-1996-excess-volatility-and-predictability-of-stock-prices-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Timmermann, A Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 1996 DOI: 10.2307/2297792 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law, rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract To what extent can agents' learning and incomplete information about the ''true'' underlying model generating stock returns explain findings of excess volatility and predictability of returns in the stock market? In this paper we analyse two models of recursive learning in the stock market when dividends follow a (trend-)stationary autoregressive process. The asymptotic convergence properties of the models are characterized and we decompose the variation in stock prices into rational expectations and recursive learning components with different rates of convergence. A present-value learning rule is found to generate substantial excess volatility in stock prices even in very large samples, and also seems capable of explaining the positive correlation between stock returns and the lagged dividend yield. Self-referential learning, where agents' learning affect the law of motion of the process they are estimating, is shown to generate some additional volatility in stock prices, though of a magnitude much smaller than present value learning. 摘要（中文） 行为主体的学习以及对生成股票收益的"真实"底层模型的不完全信息，在多大程度上能够解释股票市场中收益过度波动和可预测性的发现？在本文中，我们分析了当股利遵循一个（去趋势）平稳自回归过程时，股票市场中的两个递归学习模型。我们刻画了这些模型的渐近收敛性质，并将股票价格的变动分解为具有不同收敛速度的理性预期成分和递归学习成分。我们发现，一个现值学习规则即便在非常大的样本中也能产生可观的股票价格过度波动，并且似乎也能够解释股票收益与滞后股利收益率之间的正相关。自指涉（self-referential）学习——即行为主体的学习会影响他们所估计过程的运动规律——被证明会在股票价格中产生一些额外的波动，尽管其幅度远小于现值学习。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and financial health: Evidence from US bank holding companies
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Using a large sample of U.S. Raw markdown: tripathy-2021-dividends-and-financial-health-evidence-from-us-bank Bibliographic Record Authors: Tripathy, N, Wu, D, Zheng, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101808 Relevance…
pages.text: Dividends and financial health: Evidence from US bank holding companies (2021) Paper claim — Using a large sample of U.S. Raw markdown: tripathy-2021-dividends-and-financial-health-evidence-from-us-bank Bibliographic Record Authors: Tripathy, N, Wu, D, Zheng, Y Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2020.101808 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Using a large sample of U.S. bank holding companies from 1986 to 2020, we show that there is a positive relationship between banks? dividends lagged by one quarter and their financial health in the current quarter. We also find that this positive relationship is more pronounced for banks with lower capital adequacy and during the 2007?2009 financial crisis, indicating that it is more necessary for banks with these characteristics to use dividends to convey information regarding their financial health. Our additional analyses suggest that total payout is also positively associated with bank financial health, and that the positive relationship between dividends and financial health applies to private banks as well, but that the magnitude is weaker for them than for public banks. Our overall findings primarily complement a risk reduction hypothesis in corporate finance and bank payout policies. 摘要（中文） 我们使用1986年至2020年美国银行控股公司的大样本，表明银行滞后一个季度的股利与其当季的财务健康状况之间存在正向关系。我们还发现，这一正向关系在资本充足率较低的银行以及2007—2009年金融危机期间更为明显，这表明具有这些特征的银行更有必要利用股利来传递有关其财务健康状况的信息。我们的补充分析表明，总派现也与银行财务健康状况正相关，并且股利与财务健康之间的正向关系同样适用于私人银行，但对它们而言其幅度弱于上市银行。我们的总体研究结果主要补充了公司金融和银行派现政策中的风险降低假说。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Why Do Firms Pay Dividends?: Evidence from an Early and Unregulated Capital Market (2013) Paper claim — Why do firms pay dividends? To answer this question, we use a hand-collected data set of companies traded on the London stock market between 1825 and 1870. Raw markdown: turner-2013-why-do-firms-pay-dividends-evidence-from-an Bibliographic Record Authors: Turner, JD, Ye, Q, Zhan, WW Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfs048 Relevance score: 10.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(institution, regulat, rule)；股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(agency, catering) Abstract Why do firms pay dividends? To answer this question, we use a hand-collected data set of companies traded on the London stock market between 1825 and 1870. As tax rates were effectively zero, the capital market was unregulated, and there were no institutional stockholders, we can rule out these potential determinants ex ante. We find that, even though they were legal, share repurchases were not used by firms to return cash to shareholders. Instead, our evidence provides support for the information-communication explanation for dividends, while providing little support for agency, illiquidity, catering, or behavioral explanations. 摘要（中文） 企业为何支付股利？为回答这一问题，我们使用了一个手工收集的数据集，涉及1825年至1870年间在伦敦股票市场交易的公司。由于税率实际上为零、资本市场不受监管、且没有机构股东，我们可以事先排除这些潜在的决定因素。我们发现，尽管股份回购当时是合法的，但企业并未将其用于向股东返还现金。相反，我们的证据支持股利的信息-沟通解释，而对代理、非流动性、迎合或行为解释几乎没有提供支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The Role of Share Repurchases for Firms' Social and Environmental Sustainability
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article embarks on ethical trade-offs at the sustainability/finance interface by contrasting shareholders' interest in short-term financial returns with society's interest in counteracting ecological and social grievances. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: The Role of Share Repurchases for Firms' Social and Environmental Sustainability (2023) Paper claim — This article embarks on ethical trade-offs at the sustainability/finance interface by contrasting shareholders' interest in short-term financial returns with society's interest in counteracting ecological and social grievances. Raw markdown: vaupel-2023-the-role-of-share-repurchases-for-firms-social Bibliographic Record Authors: Vaupel, M, Bendig, D, Fischer-Kreer, D, Brettel, M Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-022-05076-3 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(buyback, share repurchase)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract This article embarks on ethical trade-offs at the sustainability/finance interface by contrasting shareholders' interest in short-term financial returns with society's interest in counteracting ecological and social grievances. Scrutinizing share repurchases, we investigate a firm's communicated sustainability orientation (i.e., its environmental and social value orientation) as well as its environmental and social sustainability performance. Our results are based on a large-scale panel dataset of 491 U.S. firms observed from 2004 to 2016. The dataset combines share buyback data with sustainability orientation scores from shareholder letters and sustainability performance ratings. The econometric models suggest no association between social value orientation and repurchase volumes, but a significantly negative relationship between environmental value orientation and buybacks in a cubic form. Executive stock options partially attenuate this relationship. Share repurchases in turn negatively affect future environmental and social performance. This study grasps the consequences of firms' short-term shareholder satisfaction and discusses its ethical implications in the context of firms' contribution to sustainable development, thereby providing important insights to the business ethics discourse. 摘要（中文） 本文着眼于可持续性/金融交汇处的伦理权衡，将股东对短期财务回报的利益与社会对抵消生态和社会弊病的利益相对照。通过审视股份回购，我们考察企业所传达的可持续性导向（即其环境和社会价值导向）以及其环境和社会可持续性绩效。我们的结果基于一个大规模面板数据集，包含2004至2016年观测的491家美国企业。该数据集将股票回购数据与来自股东信函的可持续性导向评分以及可持续性绩效评级相结合。计量模型表明，社会价值导向与回购规模之间没有关联，但环境价值导向与回购之间存在显著为负的三次方形式的关系。高管股票期权部分减弱了这种关系。而股份回购反过来对未来的环境和社会绩效产生负面影响。本研究把握了企业短期股东满足的后果，并在企业对可持续发展贡献的背景下讨论其伦理含义，从而为商业伦理讨论提供了重要见解。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Myers and Majluf (1984) showed that in a world of asymmetric information, managers of overvalued firms issue equity, while managers of undervalued firms use cash, if available. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: STRATEGIC CONSIDERATIONS, THE PECKING ORDER HYPOTHESIS, AND MARKET REACTIONS TO EQUITY FINANCING (1993) Paper claim — Myers and Majluf (1984) showed that in a world of asymmetric information, managers of overvalued firms issue equity, while managers of undervalued firms use cash, if available. Raw markdown: viswanath-1993-strategic-considerations-the-pecking-order-hypothesis-and-market Bibliographic Record Authors: VISWANATH, PV Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 1993 DOI: 10.2307/2331287 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(distribution, dividend)；影响机制(information asymmetry, signal) Abstract Myers and Majluf (1984) showed that in a world of asymmetric information, managers of overvalued firms issue equity, while managers of undervalued firms use cash, if available. This paper shows that, in a multiperiod world, managers of undervalued firms may find it optimal to issue stock, even though cash is available. Consequently, the market does not interpret all announcements of equity issues as signals of firm overvaluation. The paper also generates predictions regarding the effect of information asymmetry and investment opportunities on i) dividend policy, and ii) the cross-sectional distribution of market reactions when an equity issue is announced. 摘要（中文） Myers和Majluf（1984）表明，在信息不对称的世界里，被高估企业的经理会发行股票，而被低估企业的经理若有现金则会动用现金。本文表明，在多期世界中，被低估企业的经理即便有现金可用，也可能发现发行股票是最优的。因此，市场并不会把所有股票发行公告都解读为企业被高估的信号。本文还就信息不对称和投资机会对以下两方面的影响作出了预测：(i)股利政策，以及(ii)股票发行公告时市场反应的横截面分布。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dividends and share repurchases in the European Union
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We examine cash dividends and share repurchases from 1989 to 2005 in the 15 nations that were members of the European Union before May 2004. Raw markdown: voneije-2008-dividends-and-share-repurchases-in-the-european-union Bibliographic Record Authors: von Eije, H,…
pages.text: Dividends and share repurchases in the European Union (2008) Paper claim — We examine cash dividends and share repurchases from 1989 to 2005 in the 15 nations that were members of the European Union before May 2004. Raw markdown: voneije-2008-dividends-and-share-repurchases-in-the-european-union Bibliographic Record Authors: von Eije, H, Megginson, WL Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2007.11.002 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, payout, share repurchase) Abstract We examine cash dividends and share repurchases from 1989 to 2005 in the 15 nations that were members of the European Union before May 2004. As ill the United States, the fraction of European firms paying dividends declines, while total real dividends paid increase and share repurchases surge. We also show that financial reporting frequency is associated with higher payout, and that privatized companies account for almost one-quarter of total cash dividends and share repurchases. Our regression analyses indicate that increasing fractions of retained earnings to equity do not increase the likelihood of cash payouts, whereas company age does. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们考察了1989年至2005年间，在2004年5月之前即为欧盟成员的15个国家的现金股利和股份回购。与美国一样，支付股利的欧洲企业比例下降，而支付的实际股利总额增加、股份回购激增。我们还表明，财务报告频率与更高的支付相关，且私有化企业占现金股利和股份回购总额的近四分之一。我们的回归分析表明，留存收益占股权比例的上升不会增加现金支付的可能性，而企业年龄则会。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: A MODEL OF INTERTEMPORAL ASSET PRICES UNDER ASYMMETRIC INFORMATION
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper presents a dynamic asset-pricing model under asymmetric information. Raw markdown: wang-1993-a-model-of-intertemporal-asset-prices-under-asymmetric Bibliographic Record Authors: WANG, J Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 1993 DOI: 10.2307/2298057…
pages.text: A MODEL OF INTERTEMPORAL ASSET PRICES UNDER ASYMMETRIC INFORMATION (1993) Paper claim — This paper presents a dynamic asset-pricing model under asymmetric information. Raw markdown: wang-1993-a-model-of-intertemporal-asset-prices-under-asymmetric Bibliographic Record Authors: WANG, J Journal: REVIEW OF ECONOMIC STUDIES Year: 1993 DOI: 10.2307/2298057 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(information asymmetry) Abstract This paper presents a dynamic asset-pricing model under asymmetric information. Investors have different information concerning the future growth rate of dividends. They rationally extract information from prices as well as dividends and maximize their expected utility. The model has a closed-form solution to the rational expectations equilibrium. We find that existence of uninformed investors increases the risk premium. Supply shocks can affect the risk premium only under asymmetric information. Information asymmetry among investors can increase price volatility and negative autocorrelation in returns. Less-informed investors may rationally behave like price chasers. 摘要（中文） 本文提出了一个信息不对称下的动态资产定价模型。投资者拥有关于股利未来增长率的不同信息。他们理性地从价格以及股利中提取信息，并最大化其预期效用。该模型对理性预期均衡有一个封闭形式解。我们发现不知情投资者的存在提高了风险溢价。供给冲击只有在信息不对称下才能影响风险溢价。投资者之间的信息不对称会增加价格波动率和收益的负自相关。信息较少的投资者可能理性地表现得像价格追逐者。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
