pages.title: A Long-Run Risks Model of Asset Pricing with Fat Tails
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We explore the effects of fat tails on the equilibrium implications of the long-run risks model of asset pricing by introducing innovations with dampened power law to consumption and dividends growth processes. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: A Long-Run Risks Model of Asset Pricing with Fat Tails (2010) Paper claim — We explore the effects of fat tails on the equilibrium implications of the long-run risks model of asset pricing by introducing innovations with dampened power law to consumption and dividends growth processes. Raw markdown: wang-2010-a-long-run-risks-model-of-asset-pricing Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, ZG, Bidarkota, PV Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfp015 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We explore the effects of fat tails on the equilibrium implications of the long-run risks model of asset pricing by introducing innovations with dampened power law to consumption and dividends growth processes. We estimate the model structural parameters by maximum likelihood. We find that the stochastic volatility model with fat tails can generate implied risk premium, expected risk free rate and their volatilities comparable to the magnitudes observed in data. The model with fat tails leads to a significant increase in implied risk premia over the benchmark Gaussian model, but similar values for other equilibrium quantities of interest. 摘要（中文） 我们探究了肥尾对资产定价长期风险模型均衡含义的影响，方法是向消费和股利增长过程引入具有阻尼幂律的新息。我们通过最大似然估计模型的结构参数。我们发现，带肥尾的随机波动率模型能够生成与数据中观测到的量级相当的隐含风险溢价、预期无风险利率及其波动率。相比基准的高斯模型，带肥尾的模型使隐含风险溢价显著增加，但对其他关心的均衡量则得到相似的数值。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Managerial entrenchment, equity payout and capital structure
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — I develop a contingent claims model to examine the impacts of managerial entrenchment on capital structure and security valuation. Raw markdown: wang-2011-managerial-entrenchment-equity-payout-and-capital-structure Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, H Journal:…
pages.text: Managerial entrenchment, equity payout and capital structure (2011) Paper claim — I develop a contingent claims model to examine the impacts of managerial entrenchment on capital structure and security valuation. Raw markdown: wang-2011-managerial-entrenchment-equity-payout-and-capital-structure Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, H Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2011 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2010.07.018 Relevance score: 5.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(payout)；影响机制(agency, substitut) Abstract I develop a contingent claims model to examine the impacts of managerial entrenchment on capital structure and security valuation. The analysis shows that managers' self-interested leverage choices deviate significantly from the optimal leverages that maximize firm values, partially explaining the suboptimal leverage ratios observed empirically (Graham, 2000). Both the extent and sensitivity of the deviations are affected by firm characteristics, debt features and default solutions. The shareholder-manager conflicts over risk level and cash payout vary dynamically with a firm's financial health. Managerial entrenchment does not mitigate the agency problems of debt since managers' discretionary decisions on milking properties or asset substitution could be driven by incentives to increase their own utility. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我建立了一个或有求偿权模型来考察管理层壕沟自守（entrenchment）对资本结构和证券估值的影响。分析表明，管理者出于自利的杠杆选择显著偏离使公司价值最大化的最优杠杆，这部分解释了实证中观察到的次优杠杆比率（Graham, 2000）。偏离的程度和敏感性都受到公司特征、债务特性和违约解决方案的影响。股东与管理者在风险水平和现金派现方面的冲突随公司财务健康状况动态变化。管理层壕沟自守并不能缓解债务的代理问题，因为管理者在榨取资产（milking properties）或资产替代方面的自由裁量决策，可能是由提高自身效用的动机所驱动。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Do firms' relationships with principal customers/suppliers affect shareholders' income?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper, we examine whether a firm's relationship with its principal customers/suppliers affects its payout policies. Raw markdown: wang-2012-do-firms-relationships-with-principal-customers-suppliers-affect Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, J Journal:…
pages.text: Do firms' relationships with principal customers/suppliers affect shareholders' income? (2012) Paper claim — In this paper, we examine whether a firm's relationship with its principal customers/suppliers affects its payout policies. Raw markdown: wang-2012-do-firms-relationships-with-principal-customers-suppliers-affect Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, J Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2012 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2012.06.007 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract In this paper, we examine whether a firm's relationship with its principal customers/suppliers affects its payout policies. A firm has customer-supplier relationships when its business depends on a small number of major customers/suppliers. The extant literature indicates two channels through which customer-supplier relationships might negatively affect a firm's dividend payments: 1) the high financial distress costs associated with relationship-specific investments and 2) the information certification effect of the principle customer. Consistent with expectations, our study reveals a negative relationship between a firm's dependence on customer-supplier relationships and its dividend payments. This result is robust to various model specifications and consistent with evidence regarding the time-series properties of dividends. Moreover, we find that high financial distress costs associated with relationship-specific investments are the key channel through which a firm's customer-supplier relationship affects its dividend payments. Overall, our results suggest that a firm's relationship with its non-financial stakeholders, such as principal customers/suppliers, is an important determinant of its shareholders' income. (C) 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文考察公司与其主要客户/供应商的关系是否影响其派现政策。当一家公司的业务依赖于少数几个主要客户/供应商时，它就具有客户—供应商关系。现有文献指出客户—供应商关系可能对公司股利支付产生负面影响的两条途径：1）与关系专用性投资相关的高财务困境成本，以及2）主要客户的信息认证效应。与预期相一致，我们的研究揭示了公司对客户—供应商关系的依赖与其股利支付之间存在负向关系。这一结果对各种模型设定都是稳健的，并且与关于股利时间序列特性的证据相一致。此外，我们发现，与关系专用性投资相关的高财务困境成本是公司客户—供应商关系影响其股利支付的关键途径。总体而言，我们的结果表明，公司与其非金融利益相关者（如主要客户/供应商）的关系是其股东收入的一个重要决定因素。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Real effects of share repurchases legalization on corporate behaviors
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We use staggered share repurchases legalization from 1985 to 2010 across the world to examine its impact on corporate behaviors. Raw markdown: wang-2021-real-effects-of-share-repurchases-legalization-on-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, ZG, Yin, QE, Yu,…
pages.text: Real effects of share repurchases legalization on corporate behaviors (2021) Paper claim — We use staggered share repurchases legalization from 1985 to 2010 across the world to examine its impact on corporate behaviors. Raw markdown: wang-2021-real-effects-of-share-repurchases-legalization-on-corporate Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, ZG, Yin, QE, Yu, LP Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.10.008 Relevance score: 5.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract We use staggered share repurchases legalization from 1985 to 2010 across the world to examine its impact on corporate behaviors. We find that share-repurchasing firms do not cut dividends as a substitution. The cash for repurchasing shares comes more from internal cash than external debt issuance, leading to reductions in capital expenditures and R&D expenses. While this strategy boosts stock prices, it results in lower long-run Tobin's Q, profitability, growth, and innovation, accompanied by lower insider ownership. Tax benefits and paying out temporary earnings are two primary reasons that firms repurchase. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们利用1985至2010年间全球各地交错实施的股份回购合法化，来考察其对公司行为的影响。我们发现，回购股份的企业并未削减股利作为替代。用于回购股份的现金更多来自内部现金而非外部债务发行，导致资本支出和研发费用的减少。虽然这一策略推高了股价，但它导致了更低的长期托宾Q、盈利能力、增长和创新，并伴随着更低的内部人持股。税收利益和派发暂时性盈余是企业回购的两个主要原因。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. Synthesis pages citing this source draw on the abstract above.

pages.title: Investor communication and payout policy: a field experiment
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We conduct a field experiment to examine whether brief, unsolicited messages can influence corporate dividend policies. Raw markdown: wang-2025-investor-communication-and-payout-policy-a-field-experiment Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, XQ, Xie, J, Zhang, BH,…
pages.text: Investor communication and payout policy: a field experiment (2025) Paper claim — We conduct a field experiment to examine whether brief, unsolicited messages can influence corporate dividend policies. Raw markdown: wang-2025-investor-communication-and-payout-policy-a-field-experiment Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, XQ, Xie, J, Zhang, BH, Zhao, XF Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfaf044 Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, policy)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(agency, alternative, signal) Abstract We conduct a field experiment to examine whether brief, unsolicited messages can influence corporate dividend policies. Messages highlighting investor concerns rooted in four dividend theories were sent to publicly listed firms. We find that messages framed around agency concerns significantly increase dividend payouts among past payers, particularly those with weaker governance. This effect is robust across alternative specifications and validated by a post-experiment survey. In contrast, messages based on bird-in-hand, signaling, or tax-clientele theories have no significant impact. Our findings suggest that dividend policy is more malleable than traditionally assumed and highlight the role of managerial perceptions in financial decision-making. 摘要（中文） 我们进行了一项田野实验，以考察简短、未经请求的信息能否影响企业股利政策。我们向公开上市企业发送了突出植根于四种股利理论的投资者关切的信息。我们发现，围绕代理关切构建的信息显著增加了过去支付过股利的企业（尤其是治理较弱的企业）的股利支付。这一效应在替代性设定下依然稳健，并经一项实验后调查得到验证。相比之下，基于落袋为安、信号或税收群体理论的信息则没有显著影响。我们的发现表明，股利政策比传统假设的更具可塑性，并凸显了管理者感知在财务决策中的作用。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Limited Firm Insurance and Aggregate Implications
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies the impacts of financial shocks on firm insurance, firm dynamics, and macroeconomic implications. Raw markdown: wang-2025-limited-firm-insurance-and-aggregate-implications Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, YC Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year:…
pages.text: Limited Firm Insurance and Aggregate Implications (2025) Paper claim — This paper studies the impacts of financial shocks on firm insurance, firm dynamics, and macroeconomic implications. Raw markdown: wang-2025-limited-firm-insurance-and-aggregate-implications Bibliographic Record Authors: Wang, YC Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2023.01627 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper studies the impacts of financial shocks on firm insurance, firm dynamics, and macroeconomic implications. A key departure from the literature is that firms provide wage insurance contracts to risk-averse workers in a long-term relationship. Such contracts endogenously impose a form of inflexible debt liability to firms, and make firms with limited financial net worth more vulnerable to shocks than others. In our model, firms have heterogenous productivity and financial net worth, and also firms face financial frictions. Search and matching in the labor market endogenously determines the value of wage contract, and thus the level of liability to the firm. We have three new findings: (1) The wage dynamics of the quantitative model are consistent with those in empirical studies, with significant insurance against firm-level idiosyncratic shocks, and also a weak comovement between aggregate wage and GDP when there are aggregate shocks. (2) Firms with limited financial resources are hit by financial shocks significantly more than others, with larger negative impacts on dividends, credit borrowing, firm value, and firm entry; the endogenous wage insurance also becomes more limited, and there are more separations. These impacts on both firms and workers are different from-and cannot be accounted for by-standard models with a representative firm or worker. (3) Quantitative exercises for the Great Recession in the United States suggest that aggregate productivity shocks and financial shocks play different roles; without financial shocks, we cannot account for the dynamics of financial variables, including the reduced credit borrowing, spikes in credit spreads, and large drops in dividend payments. Lastly, we provide microlevel empirical supports for our model implications. 摘要（中文） 本文研究金融冲击对企业保险、企业动态和宏观经济的影响。与文献的一个关键区别在于，企业在长期关系中向风险厌恶的工人提供工资保险合同。这类合同内生地对企业施加了一种缺乏灵活性的债务负债形式，使得金融净值有限的企业比其他企业更易受到冲击。在我们的模型中，企业具有异质的生产率和金融净值，同时企业还面临金融摩擦。劳动力市场中的搜寻与匹配内生地决定了工资合同的价值，从而决定了企业的负债水平。我们有三项新发现：（1）该定量模型的工资动态与实证研究中的结果一致，即对企业层面特质冲击存在显著的保险，并且在存在总体冲击时总体工资与GDP之间存在弱共动。（2）金融资源有限的企业受金融冲击的打击显著大于其他企业，对股利、信贷借款、企业价值和企业进入产生更大的负面影响；内生的工资保险也变得更加有限，并出现更多的雇佣关系解除。这些对企业和工人的影响与采用代表性企业或工人的标准模型不同，且无法由后者解释。（3）针对美国大衰退的定量分析表明，总体生产率冲击和金融冲击扮演不同角色；没有金融冲击，我们无法解释金融变量的动态，包括信贷借款减少、信用利差飙升以及股利支付大幅下降。最后，我们为模型的推论提供了微观层面的经验支持。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Price volatility and investor behavior in an overlapping generations model with information asymmetry
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper studies an overlapping generations model with multiple securities and heterogeneously informed agents. Raw markdown: watanabe-2008-price-volatility-and-investor-behavior-in-an-overlapping Bibliographic Record Authors: Watanabe, M Journal: JOURNAL OF…
pages.text: Price volatility and investor behavior in an overlapping generations model with information asymmetry (2008) Paper claim — This paper studies an overlapping generations model with multiple securities and heterogeneously informed agents. Raw markdown: watanabe-2008-price-volatility-and-investor-behavior-in-an-overlapping Bibliographic Record Authors: Watanabe, M Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCE Year: 2008 DOI: 10.1111/j.1540-6261.2008.01315.x Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(information asymmetry) Abstract This paper studies an overlapping generations model with multiple securities and heterogeneously informed agents. The model produces multiple equilibria, including highly volatile equilibria that can exhibit strong or weak correlations between asset returns-even when asset supplies and future dividends are uncorrelated across assets. Less informed agents rationally behave like trend-followers, while better informed agents follow contrarian strategies. Trading volume has a hump-shaped relation with information precision and is positively correlated with absolute price changes. Finally, accurate information increases the volatility and correlation of stock returns in the highly volatile, strongly correlated equilibrium. 摘要（中文） 本文研究了一个具有多种证券和异质知情主体的世代交叠模型。该模型产生了多重均衡，包括高波动均衡，这些均衡即使在资产供给和未来股利在各资产之间不相关时也可以表现出资产收益之间的强或弱相关性。信息较少的主体理性地表现得像趋势追随者，而信息较充分的主体则遵循逆向策略。交易量与信息精度呈驼峰形关系，并与绝对价格变动正相关。最后，准确的信息在高波动、强相关的均衡中提高了股票收益的波动率和相关性。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Trust in Financial Markets: Evidence from Reactions to Earnings News (2023) Paper claim — This paper studies the effect of trust on the perceived credibility of earnings news. Raw markdown: wei-2023-trust-in-financial-markets-evidence-from-reactions-to Bibliographic Record Authors: Wei, CS, Zhang, L Journal: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE Year: 2023 DOI: 10.1287/mnsc.2022.4569 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(audit)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal) Abstract This paper studies the effect of trust on the perceived credibility of earnings news. Using earnings response coefficients, we find that firms located in low-trust regions of the United States experience significantly lower stock price reactions to earnings news. Additional tests indicate that managers can counterbalance investors' dependence on trust by employing reputable auditors or signaling the quality of their earnings using dividends to improve the perceived credibility of their financial reports. Overall, our findings suggest that trust affects the pricing of earnings news in capital markets. 摘要（中文） 本文研究信任对盈利新闻感知可信度的影响。使用盈利反应系数，我们发现位于美国低信任地区的企业对盈利新闻的股价反应显著更低。额外的检验表明，管理者可以通过聘请声誉良好的审计师，或使用股利来发出盈利质量信号，从而抵消投资者对信任的依赖，以改善其财务报告的感知可信度。总体而言，我们的发现表明，信任影响资本市场中盈利新闻的定价。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: THE PARTICIPATION DIVIDEND OF TAXATION: HOW CITIZENS IN CONGO ENGAGE MORE WITH THE STATE WHEN IT TRIES TO TAX THEM
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article provides evidence from a fragile state that citizens demand more of a voice in the government when it tries to Lax them. Raw markdown: weigel-2020-the-participation-dividend-of-taxation-how-citizens-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Weigel, JL Journal:…
pages.text: THE PARTICIPATION DIVIDEND OF TAXATION: HOW CITIZENS IN CONGO ENGAGE MORE WITH THE STATE WHEN IT TRIES TO TAX THEM (2020) Paper claim — This article provides evidence from a fragile state that citizens demand more of a voice in the government when it tries to Lax them. Raw markdown: weigel-2020-the-participation-dividend-of-taxation-how-citizens-in Bibliographic Record Authors: Weigel, JL Journal: QUARTERLY JOURNAL OF ECONOMICS Year: 2020 DOI: 10.1093/qje/qjaa019 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(compliance, governance)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This article provides evidence from a fragile state that citizens demand more of a voice in the government when it tries to Lax them. 1 examine a field experiment randomizing property tax collection across 356 neighborhoods of a large Congolese city. The tax campaign was the first time most citizens had been registered by the state or asked to pay formal taxes. It raised property tax compliance from 0.1% in control to 11.6% in treatment. It also increased political participation by about 5 percentage points (31%): citizens in taxed neighborhoods were more likely to attend town hall meetings hosted by the government or submit evaluations of its performance. To participate in these ways, the average citizen incurred costs equal to their daily household income, and treated citizens spent 43% more than control. Treated citizens also positively updated about the provincial government, perceiving more revenue, less leakage, and a greater responsibility to provide public goods. The results suggest that broadening the tax base has a "participation dividend," a key idea in historical accounts of the emergence of inclusive governance in early modern Europe and a common justification for donor support of tax programs in weak states. 摘要（中文） 本文提供了来自一个脆弱国家的证据，表明当政府试图向公民征税时，公民会要求在政府中拥有更大的话语权。我考察了一项田野实验，该实验在刚果一座大城市的356个社区之间随机安排财产税征收。这场税收行动是大多数公民首次被国家登记或被要求缴纳正式税款。它使财产税遵从率从对照组的0.1%提高到处理组的11.6%。它还使政治参与提高了约5个百分点（31%）：被征税社区的公民更可能参加政府举办的市政厅会议或提交对政府绩效的评价。为了以这些方式参与，普通公民付出了相当于其家庭每日收入的成本，且受处理的公民比对照组多花费43%。受处理的公民还对省级政府进行了正面的信念更新，认为其收入更多、渗漏更少、提供公共物品的责任更大。这些结果表明，扩大税基具有一种"参与红利"，这是关于近代早期欧洲包容性治理兴起的历史叙述中的一个关键理念，也是捐助者支持弱国税收计划的一个常见理由。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Preference heterogeneity and asset prices: An exact solution
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We introduce a general equilibrium model of a multi-agent, pure-exchange economy and find a set of conditions that enable us to obtain explicit closed-form solutions to the equilibrium interest rate, stock price, risk premium and stock market volatility when…
pages.text: Preference heterogeneity and asset prices: An exact solution (2010) Paper claim — We introduce a general equilibrium model of a multi-agent, pure-exchange economy and find a set of conditions that enable us to obtain explicit closed-form solutions to the equilibrium interest rate, stock price, risk premium and stock market volatility when investors have heterogenous risk aversions. Raw markdown: weinbaum-2010-preference-heterogeneity-and-asset-prices-an-exact-solution Bibliographic Record Authors: Weinbaum, D Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2010.02.009 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 股利政策(distribution, dividend) Abstract We introduce a general equilibrium model of a multi-agent, pure-exchange economy and find a set of conditions that enable us to obtain explicit closed-form solutions to the equilibrium interest rate, stock price, risk premium and stock market volatility when investors have heterogenous risk aversions. Because the market is dynamically complete, full risk sharing obtains and a representative agent can be constructed, though the risk aversion of this agent fluctuates over time with the state of the economy, as the relative wealth distribution of the individual investors changes. We show that preference heterogeneity can cause asset prices to be significantly more volatile than the underlying dividends and that it can lead to leverage-like effects in volatility, in the sense that volatility increases after stock-market declines. (C) 2010 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们引入了一个关于多主体纯交换经济体的一般均衡模型，并找到一组条件，使我们能够在投资者具有异质风险规避时，获得均衡利率、股票价格、风险溢价和股票市场波动性的显式闭式解。由于市场是动态完全的，可以实现充分的风险分担，并可以构建一个代表性主体，尽管随着经济状态的变化，随着各个投资者相对财富分布的改变，该主体的风险规避会随时间波动。我们表明，偏好异质性能够使资产价格的波动性显著大于基础股利的波动性，并且它能够导致波动性中出现类似杠杆的效应，即波动性在股市下跌之后上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: FINANCIAL POLICY, INTERNAL CONTROL, AND PERFORMANCE SEALED-AIR-CORPORATIONS LEVERAGED SPECIAL DIVIDEND (1994) Paper claim — This paper examines the role of financial policy as a catalyst for organizational change. Raw markdown: wruck-1994-financial-policy-internal-control-and-performance-sealed-air Bibliographic Record Authors: WRUCK, KH Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1016/0304-405X(94)90023-X Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(internal control, policy)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract This paper examines the role of financial policy as a catalyst for organizational change. The subject is Sealed Air Corporation, a company with substantial free cash flow that undertakes a leveraged special dividend. While the stock price response to announcement is typical, Sealed Air exhibits dramatic, sustained, post-dividend performance improvement. Evidence indicates this performance results from managers' conscious and successful use of financial leverage as a tool to disrupt the status quo and promote internal change, including establishing a new objective, changing compensation systems, and reorganizing manufacturing and capital budgeting processes. 摘要（中文） 本文考察财务政策作为组织变革催化剂的作用。研究对象是Sealed Air公司，一家拥有大量自由现金流并进行了一次杠杆化特别股利派发的公司。虽然股价对公告的反应属于典型情形，但Sealed Air表现出显著且持续的股利派发后业绩改善。证据表明，这一业绩源于经理人有意识且成功地将财务杠杆作为一种工具，用以打破现状并推动内部变革，包括确立新目标、改变薪酬体系以及重组制造和资本预算流程。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: The q-Theory Approach to Understanding the Accrual Anomaly
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Interpreting accruals as working capital investment, we hypothesize based on q-theory that firms optimally adjust their accruals in response to discount rate changes. Raw markdown: wu-2010-the-q-theory-approach-to-understanding-the-accrual Bibliographic Record…
pages.text: The q-Theory Approach to Understanding the Accrual Anomaly (2010) Paper claim — Interpreting accruals as working capital investment, we hypothesize based on q-theory that firms optimally adjust their accruals in response to discount rate changes. Raw markdown: wu-2010-the-q-theory-approach-to-understanding-the-accrual Bibliographic Record Authors: Wu, J, Zhang, L, Zhang, XF Journal: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2009.00353.x Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Interpreting accruals as working capital investment, we hypothesize based on q-theory that firms optimally adjust their accruals in response to discount rate changes. A higher discount rate means less profitable investments and lower accruals, and a lower discount rate means more profitable investments and higher accruals. Our evidence supports this optimal investment hypothesis: (1) adding an investment factor into standard factor regressions substantially reduces the magnitude of the accrual anomaly, often to insignificant levels; (2) accruals covary negatively with discount rate estimates from the dividend discounting model, and for the most part, with estimates from the residual income model; (3) accruals with low accounting reliability covary more with capital investment than accruals with high accounting reliability; and (iv) expected returns to accruals-based trading strategies are time-varying, suggesting that the deterioration of the accrual effect in recent years might be temporary and likely to mean-revert in the near future. 摘要（中文） 将应计项目诠释为营运资本投资，我们基于q理论假设企业会响应贴现率变化而最优地调整其应计项目。较高的贴现率意味着盈利性较低的投资和较低的应计项目，而较低的贴现率意味着盈利性较高的投资和较高的应计项目。我们的证据支持这一最优投资假说：（1）在标准因子回归中加入一个投资因子会大幅降低应计异象的量级，往往降至不显著的水平；（2）应计项目与来自股利贴现模型的贴现率估计负协变，并且在很大程度上也与来自剩余收益模型的估计负协变；（3）会计可靠性低的应计项目与资本投资的协变程度高于会计可靠性高的应计项目；以及（4）应计交易策略的预期收益是时变的，这表明近年来应计效应的减弱可能是暂时的，且很可能在不久的将来均值回复。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — I study the driving forces behind dividend smoothing by developing a dynamic agency model in which dividends signal the earnings persistence of firms. Raw markdown: wu-2018-what-s-behind-smooth-dividends-evidence-from-structural Bibliographic Record Authors: Wu, YF…
pages.text: What's behind Smooth Dividends? Evidence from Structural Estimation (2018) Paper claim — I study the driving forces behind dividend smoothing by developing a dynamic agency model in which dividends signal the earnings persistence of firms. Raw markdown: wu-2018-what-s-behind-smooth-dividends-evidence-from-structural Bibliographic Record Authors: Wu, YF Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 2018 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/hhx119 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, signal, substitut) Abstract I study the driving forces behind dividend smoothing by developing a dynamic agency model in which dividends signal the earnings persistence of firms. In equilibrium, managers treat dividends and earnings as informational substitutes. They smooth dividends relative to earnings to smooth negative news releases and lower their turnover risk. Empirical estimates of the model parameters imply that 39% of observed dividend smoothness among U.S. firms is driven by managers' own career concerns, not shareholders' preferences. Managers cut investments and adjust external financing policies to accommodate this career-concern-based dividend smoothing. These effects lead to a 2% decline in firm value. 摘要（中文） 我通过构建一个动态代理模型来研究股利平滑背后的驱动力量，在该模型中股利传递了企业收益持续性的信号。在均衡中，经理人将股利和收益视为信息上的替代品。他们相对于收益平滑股利，以平滑负面消息的发布并降低其被更替的风险。对模型参数的实证估计表明，在美国企业中，所观察到的股利平滑度有39%是由经理人自身的职业顾虑而非股东偏好所驱动的。经理人削减投资并调整外部融资政策以适应这种基于职业顾虑的股利平滑。这些效应导致企业价值下降2%。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Estimating the Effect of a Universal Cash Transfer on Birth Outcomes
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Babies in the United States fare worse than their peers in other high-income countries, and their well-being is starkly unequal along socioeconomic and racialized lines. Raw markdown: wyndhamdouds-2024-estimating-the-effect-of-a-universal-cash-transfer…
pages.text: Estimating the Effect of a Universal Cash Transfer on Birth Outcomes (2024) Paper claim — Babies in the United States fare worse than their peers in other high-income countries, and their well-being is starkly unequal along socioeconomic and racialized lines. Raw markdown: wyndhamdouds-2024-estimating-the-effect-of-a-universal-cash-transfer Bibliographic Record Authors: Wyndham-Douds, K, Cowan, SK Journal: AMERICAN SOCIOLOGICAL REVIEW Year: 2024 DOI: 10.1177/00031224241268059 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Babies in the United States fare worse than their peers in other high-income countries, and their well-being is starkly unequal along socioeconomic and racialized lines. Newborn health predicts adult well-being, making these inequalities consequential. Policymakers and scholars seeking to improve newborn health and reduce inequality have recently looked to direct cash transfers as a viable intervention. We examine the only unconditional cash transfer in the United States, the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD), to learn if giving pregnant people money improves their newborns' health. Alaska has paid its residents a significant dividend annually since 1982. The dividend's size varies yearly and is exogenous to Alaskans and the local economy, permitting us to make causal claims. After accounting for fertility selection, we find that receiving cash during pregnancy has no meaningful effect on newborn health. Current theory focuses on purchasing power and status mechanisms to delineate how money translates into health. It cannot illuminate this null finding. This case illustrates a weakness with current theory: it does not provide clear expectations for interventions. We propose four components that must be considered in tandem to predict whether proposed interventions will work. 摘要（中文） 在美国，婴儿的境况比其他高收入国家的同龄人更差，并且他们的福祉沿社会经济和种族界线呈现出鲜明的不平等。新生儿健康预示着成年后的福祉，使这些不平等具有深远影响。寻求改善新生儿健康和减少不平等的政策制定者和学者最近将目光转向直接现金转移作为一种可行的干预措施。我们考察了美国唯一的无条件现金转移——阿拉斯加永久基金分红（PFD），以了解给予孕妇金钱是否能改善其新生儿的健康。阿拉斯加自1982年以来每年向其居民支付可观的分红。分红金额逐年变化，且对阿拉斯加人和当地经济而言是外生的，这使我们能够作出因果判断。在考虑了生育选择之后，我们发现怀孕期间获得现金对新生儿健康没有实质性影响。当前理论侧重于购买力和地位机制来阐明金钱如何转化为健康，但它无法解释这一零结果。这一案例说明了当前理论的一个弱点：它没有为干预措施提供清晰的预期。我们提出了必须综合考虑的四个组成部分，以预测拟议的干预措施是否会奏效。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Procyclicality of the comovement between dividend growth and consumption growth
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Duffee (2005) shows that the amount of consumption risk (i.e., the conditional covariance between market returns and consumption growth) is procyclical. Raw markdown: xu-2021-procyclicality-of-the-comovement-between-dividend-growth-and Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Procyclicality of the comovement between dividend growth and consumption growth (2021) Paper claim — Duffee (2005) shows that the amount of consumption risk (i.e., the conditional covariance between market returns and consumption growth) is procyclical. Raw markdown: xu-2021-procyclicality-of-the-comovement-between-dividend-growth-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Xu, NR Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.07.013 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow) Abstract Duffee (2005) shows that the amount of consumption risk (i.e., the conditional covariance between market returns and consumption growth) is procyclical. In light of this "Duffee Puzzle," I empirically demonstrate that the conditional covariance between dividend growth (i.e., the immediate cash flow part of market returns) and consumption growth is (1) procyclical and (2) a consistent source of procyclicality in the puzzle. Moreover, I solve an external habit formation model that incorporates realistic joint dynamics of dividend growth and consumption growth. The procyclical dividend-consumption comovement entails two new procyclical terms in the amount of consumption risk via cash flow and valuation channels, respectively. These two procyclical terms play an important role in generating a realistic magnitude of consumption risk. In contrast to extant habit formation models, the conditional equity premium no longer increases monotonically when a negative consumption shock arrives because it might lower the amount of risk while increasing the price of risk. (C) 2020 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） Duffee（2005）表明，消费风险的量（即市场收益与消费增长之间的条件协方差）是顺周期的。鉴于这一“Duffee之谜”，我从实证角度证明，股利增长（即市场收益中即期现金流的部分）与消费增长之间的条件协方差（1）是顺周期的，并且（2）是该谜题中顺周期性的一个稳定来源。此外，我求解了一个外部习惯形成模型，该模型纳入了股利增长与消费增长现实的联合动态。顺周期的股利-消费共动通过现金流渠道和估值渠道分别在消费风险量中引入了两个新的顺周期项。这两个顺周期项在生成现实量级的消费风险方面发挥了重要作用。与现有的习惯形成模型不同，当出现负向消费冲击时，条件股权溢价不再单调上升，因为它在提高风险价格的同时可能降低风险量。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: STOCK INDEX FUTURES MISPRICING - PROFIT OPPORTUNITIES OR RISK PREMIA
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper reports empirical evidence on stock index futures pricing based on about four years of synchronous hourly data from the UK. Raw markdown: yadav-1994-stock-index-futures-mispricing-profit-opportunities-or-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: YADAV, PK,…
pages.text: STOCK INDEX FUTURES MISPRICING - PROFIT OPPORTUNITIES OR RISK PREMIA (1994) Paper claim — This paper reports empirical evidence on stock index futures pricing based on about four years of synchronous hourly data from the UK. Raw markdown: yadav-1994-stock-index-futures-mispricing-profit-opportunities-or-risk Bibliographic Record Authors: YADAV, PK, POPE, PF Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 1994 DOI: 10.1016/0378-4266(94)00026-3 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(rule)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper reports empirical evidence on stock index futures pricing based on about four years of synchronous hourly data from the UK. Reported index values are based on firm quotes. Identified arbitrage opportunities are therefore actually exploitable and economically significant. The analysis controls for cash market settlement procedures. The results show that ex-ante trading rules would have generated attractive profits after transaction costs and after the risks of dividend uncertainties, marking to market and possible delays in execution are considered. The far contract and the near contract tend to be mispriced in the same direction. The mild tendency of futures to be overpriced in rising markets and underpriced in falling markets appears to be unimportant. Finally, significant positive relationships are observed between the absolute magnitude of mispricing and time to maturity and between mispricing and index option implied volatility. 摘要（中文） 本文报告了基于英国约四年同步小时数据的股指期货定价的实证证据。所报告的指数值基于确定报价。因此，所识别的套利机会实际上是可利用的且在经济上显著。分析控制了现金市场结算程序。结果表明，在考虑交易成本以及股利不确定性、逐日盯市和可能的执行延迟等风险之后，事前交易规则本可产生可观的利润。远期合约和近期合约往往在同一方向上被错误定价。期货在上涨市场中被高估、在下跌市场中被低估的轻微倾向似乎并不重要。最后，观测到错误定价的绝对量级与到期时间之间，以及错误定价与指数期权隐含波动率之间，存在显著的正相关关系。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Capital Tax Reform and the Real Economy: The Effects of the 2003 Dividend Tax Cut (2015) Paper claim — This paper tests whether the 2003 dividend tax cut-one of the largest reforms ever to a US capital tax rate-stimulated corporate investment and increased labor earnings, using a quasi-experimental design and US corporate tax returns from years 1996-2008. Raw markdown: yagan-2015-capital-tax-reform-and-the-real-economy-the Bibliographic Record Authors: Yagan, D Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 2015 DOI: 10.1257/aer.20130098 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract This paper tests whether the 2003 dividend tax cut-one of the largest reforms ever to a US capital tax rate-stimulated corporate investment and increased labor earnings, using a quasi-experimental design and US corporate tax returns from years 1996-2008. I estimate that the tax cut caused zero change in corporate investment and employee compensation. Economically, the statistical precision challenges leading estimates of the cost-of-capital elasticity of investment, or undermines models in which dividend tax reforms affect the cost of capital. Either way, it may be difficult to implement an alternative dividend tax cut that has substantially larger near-term effects. 摘要（中文） 本文采用准实验设计以及1996-2008年的美国公司纳税申报数据，检验2003年股利减税——美国资本税率有史以来最大规模的改革之一——是否刺激了公司投资并提高了劳动收入。我估计该减税对公司投资和员工薪酬造成的变化为零。从经济意义上看，其统计精度对主流的投资资本成本弹性估计构成了挑战，或者削弱了那些认为股利税改革会影响资本成本的模型。无论哪种情形，都可能难以实施一项能带来实质性更大近期效应的替代性股利减税。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Leasing and debt financing: Substitutes or complements?
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Traditional finance theories typically treat leases and debt as substitutes. Raw markdown: yan-2006-leasing-and-debt-financing-substitutes-or-complements Bibliographic Record Authors: Yan, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2006 DOI:…
pages.text: Leasing and debt financing: Substitutes or complements? (2006) Paper claim — Traditional finance theories typically treat leases and debt as substitutes. Raw markdown: yan-2006-leasing-and-debt-financing-substitutes-or-complements Bibliographic Record Authors: Yan, A Journal: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS Year: 2006 DOI: 10.1017/S0022109000002593 Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract Traditional finance theories typically treat leases and debt as substitutes. However, the empirical findings on the relation between leases and debt are mixed. This paper reinvestigates this relation. I present a model to incorporate different theories on the substitutability and complementarity between leases and debt, and I test the model implications empirically in a GMM framework that simultaneously controls for endogeneity problems and firms' fixed effects. The findings suggest that leases and debt are substitutes instead of complements. I also investigate the variation in the substitutability between leases and debt, and find that in those firms with more growth options or larger marginal tax rates, or in those firms paying no dividends, the substitutability is more pronounced, i.e., the cost of new debt increases to a larger degree with extra leases. 摘要（中文） 传统金融理论通常将租赁和债务视为替代品。然而，关于租赁与债务之间关系的实证发现是混合的。本文重新考察了这一关系。我提出了一个模型来纳入关于租赁与债务之间替代性和互补性的不同理论，并在一个GMM框架中对模型推论进行实证检验，该框架同时控制了内生性问题和公司固定效应。研究发现表明，租赁和债务是替代品而非互补品。我还考察了租赁与债务之间替代性的变动，发现在那些拥有更多增长期权或更高边际税率的公司，或在那些不派息的公司中，替代性更为明显，即新债务的成本随额外租赁的增加而以更大的幅度上升。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Dynamic capital structure with heterogeneous beliefs and market timing
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper builds a dynamic trade-off model of corporate financing with differences in belief between the insider manager and outside investors. Raw markdown: yang-2013-dynamic-capital-structure-with-heterogeneous-beliefs-and-market Bibliographic Record Authors:…
pages.text: Dynamic capital structure with heterogeneous beliefs and market timing (2013) Paper claim — This paper builds a dynamic trade-off model of corporate financing with differences in belief between the insider manager and outside investors. Raw markdown: yang-2013-dynamic-capital-structure-with-heterogeneous-beliefs-and-market Bibliographic Record Authors: Yang, BZ Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2013.05.003 Relevance score: 4.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(trade-off) Abstract This paper builds a dynamic trade-off model of corporate financing with differences in belief between the insider manager and outside investors. The optimal leverage depends on differences of opinion and can differ significantly from that in standard trade-off models. The manager's market timing behavior leads to several stylized facts, such as the low average debt ratios affirms in the cross section, the substantial presence of zero-debt firms that pay larger dividends and keep higher cash balances than other firms, and negative long-run abnormal returns following stock issuance. Market timing behavior leads to substantial losses of firm value through excessive financing activities. Market timing and debt conservatism depend negatively on shareholder control of the firm. (C) 2013 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 本文构建了一个考虑内部人管理者与外部投资者之间信念差异的公司融资动态权衡模型。最优杠杆取决于意见分歧，并可能与标准权衡模型中的最优杠杆显著不同。管理者的市场择时（market timing）行为导致了若干典型化事实，例如横截面上公司较低的平均债务比率、大量存在的零债务公司（其支付的股利更多、持有的现金余额高于其他公司），以及股票发行后的负向长期异常收益。市场择时行为通过过度的融资活动导致公司价值的大量损失。市场择时和债务保守主义与股东对公司的控制呈负相关。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Value Return Predictability across Asset Classes and Commonalities in Risk Premia
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We show that returns to value strategies in individual equities, industries, commodities, currencies, global government bonds, and global stock indexes are predictable in the time series by their respective value spreads. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Value Return Predictability across Asset Classes and Commonalities in Risk Premia (2021) Paper claim — We show that returns to value strategies in individual equities, industries, commodities, currencies, global government bonds, and global stock indexes are predictable in the time series by their respective value spreads. Raw markdown: yara-2021-value-return-predictability-across-asset-classes-and-commonalities Bibliographic Record Authors: Yara, FB, Boons, M, Tamoni, A Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCE Year: 2021 DOI: 10.1093/rof/rfaa011 Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract We show that returns to value strategies in individual equities, industries, commodities, currencies, global government bonds, and global stock indexes are predictable in the time series by their respective value spreads. In all these asset classes, expected value returns vary by at least as much as their unconditional level. A single common component of the value spreads captures about two-thirds of value return predictability and the remainder is asset class specific. We argue that common variation in value premia is consistent with rationally time-varying expected returns, because (i) common value is closely associated with standard proxies for risk premia, such as the dividend yield, intermediary leverage, and illiquidity, and (ii) value premia are globally high in bad times. 摘要（中文） 我们表明，个股、行业、商品、货币、全球政府债券和全球股票指数中价值策略的收益，在时间序列上可由各自的价值利差进行预测。在所有这些资产类别中，预期价值收益的变动幅度至少与其无条件水平相当。价值利差中的单一共同成分可解释约三分之二的价值收益可预测性，其余部分则为特定资产类别所特有。我们认为，价值溢价的共同变动与理性时变预期收益是一致的，因为：（一）共同价值成分与风险溢价的标准代理变量密切相关，例如股利收益率、中介机构杠杆和非流动性；（二）价值溢价在坏时期于全球范围内均处于高位。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.text: Does board gender diversity increase dividend payouts? Analysis of global evidence (2019) Paper claim — Employing 63,464 firm-year observations of 8876 companies in 22 countries from 2000 to 2013, we conduct a series of multiple regression analyses that reveal a significantly positive relationship between board gender diversity and dividend payouts. Raw markdown: ye-2019-does-board-gender-diversity-increase-dividend-payouts-analysis Bibliographic Record Authors: Ye, DZ, Deng, J, Liu, Y, Szewczy, SH, Chen, X Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2019 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2019.04.002 Relevance score: 7.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance, institution)；股利政策(dividend, payout) Abstract Employing 63,464 firm-year observations of 8876 companies in 22 countries from 2000 to 2013, we conduct a series of multiple regression analyses that reveal a significantly positive relationship between board gender diversity and dividend payouts. The empirical results confirm that board gender diversity facilitates corporate governance and consequently promotes dividend payouts. We also show that a good institutional environment may weaken the effect of board gender diversity on dividend payouts. Institutional ownership is positively associated with board gender diversity and that corporate dividend payouts increase when female senior executives have shareholdings. The findings of our analysis are robust after controlling for potential endogeneity concerns. 摘要（中文） 我们运用2000年至2013年间22个国家8876家公司的63464个企业—年度观测值，进行了一系列多元回归分析，揭示出董事会性别多元化与股利支付之间存在显著的正向关系。实证结果证实，董事会性别多元化有助于公司治理，从而促进股利支付。我们还表明，良好的制度环境可能削弱董事会性别多元化对股利支付的效应。机构所有权与董事会性别多元化呈正相关，且当女性高管持股时企业股利支付增加。我们的分析结果在控制了潜在内生性问题后依然稳健。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Determinants and consequences of shareholder proposals: The cases of board election, charter amendment, and profit disposal
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — By investigating shareholder proposals in Japan during 2004-2013, this study aims to address the question whether exercising legally powerful shareholder rights has an impact on the management. Raw markdown:…
pages.text: Determinants and consequences of shareholder proposals: The cases of board election, charter amendment, and profit disposal (2017) Paper claim — By investigating shareholder proposals in Japan during 2004-2013, this study aims to address the question whether exercising legally powerful shareholder rights has an impact on the management. Raw markdown: yeh-2017-determinants-and-consequences-of-shareholder-proposals-the-cases Bibliographic Record Authors: Yeh, TM Journal: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE Year: 2017 DOI: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.05.004 Relevance score: 8.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance)；股利政策(buyback, dividend, payout) Abstract By investigating shareholder proposals in Japan during 2004-2013, this study aims to address the question whether exercising legally powerful shareholder rights has an impact on the management. Compared with their counterparts in the United States, Japanese shareholders are entitled to more statutory rights, including binding shareholder resolutions on issues relating to board election, charter amendment, and profit disposal. The empirical tests reveal several important results. First, different types of shareholder proposals are triggered by varying firm characteristics. Second, resolutions on the board election and charter amendments relating to corporate governance receive higher votes than those for profit disposal. Voting outcome is also positively associated with foreign shareholding, duration of the general meeting, and the firm's history of receiving proposals. Moreover, resolutions initiated by large shareholders have positive impacts on the target firms, which reported positive announcement-associated abnormal returns. Improvements in the operating performance are observed for firms passing board election resolutions and firms receiving charter amendment proposals from large shareholders. The management also increased share buyback and dividend payout in response to demands by large shareholders, although there was no significant change in the post-resolution operating performance. Overall, the results indicate that statutorily powerful shareholder rights, when exercised by large shareholders, can have a positive impact. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 通过考察2004—2013年间日本的股东提案，本研究旨在探讨行使具有法律效力的强大股东权利是否对管理层产生影响。与美国的同行相比，日本股东享有更多的法定权利，包括在董事选举、章程修订和利润处置等事项上具有约束力的股东决议。实证检验揭示了若干重要结果。第一，不同类型的股东提案由不同的企业特征所触发。第二，与公司治理相关的董事选举决议和章程修订决议获得的赞成票高于利润处置决议。投票结果还与外国持股、股东大会持续时间以及企业收到提案的历史正相关。此外，由大股东发起的决议对目标企业产生正面影响，这些企业报告了正的公告相关异常回报。对于通过董事选举决议的企业以及收到大股东章程修订提案的企业，观察到了经营业绩的改善。管理层也响应大股东的要求增加了股份回购和股利支付，尽管决议后的经营业绩没有显著变化。总体而言，结果表明，当法定的强大股东权利由大股东行使时，能够产生正面影响。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Signaling, investment opportunities, and dividend announcements
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This article examines potential explanations for the wealth effects surrounding dividend change announcements. Raw markdown: yoon-1995-signaling-investment-opportunities-and-dividend-announcements Bibliographic Record Authors: Yoon, PS, Starks, LT Journal: REVIEW…
pages.text: Signaling, investment opportunities, and dividend announcements (1995) Paper claim — This article examines potential explanations for the wealth effects surrounding dividend change announcements. Raw markdown: yoon-1995-signaling-investment-opportunities-and-dividend-announcements Bibliographic Record Authors: Yoon, PS, Starks, LT Journal: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES Year: 1995 DOI: 10.1093/rfs/8.4.995 Relevance score: 6.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow, free cash flow, signal) Abstract This article examines potential explanations for the wealth effects surrounding dividend change announcements. We find that new information concerning managers' investment policies is not revealed at the time of the dividend announcement. We also find that dividend increases (decreases) are associated with subsequent significant increases (decreases) in capital expenditures over the three years following the dividend change, and that dividend change announcements are associated with revisions in analysts' forecasts of current earnings. These results are consistent with the cash flow signaling hypothesis rather than the free cash flow hypothesis as an explanation for the observed stock price reactions to dividend change announcements. 摘要（中文） 本文考察了股利变动公告前后财富效应的潜在解释。我们发现，在股利公告时并未披露有关管理者投资政策的新信息。我们还发现，股利增加（减少）与随后三年内资本支出的显著增加（减少）相关联，并且股利变动公告与分析师对当期盈余预测的修正相关。这些结果与现金流信号传递假说相一致，而非与自由现金流假说相一致，可作为对观察到的股价对股利变动公告反应的解释。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Family Control and Ownership Monitoring in Family-Controlled Firms in Japan
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper focuses on a type of firms that have been traditionally neglected in both family business and governance research, namely, family-controlled, publicly-listed firms. Raw markdown: yoshikawa-2010-family-control-and-ownership-monitoring-in-family-controlled…
pages.text: Family Control and Ownership Monitoring in Family-Controlled Firms in Japan (2010) Paper claim — This paper focuses on a type of firms that have been traditionally neglected in both family business and governance research, namely, family-controlled, publicly-listed firms. Raw markdown: yoshikawa-2010-family-control-and-ownership-monitoring-in-family-controlled Bibliographic Record Authors: Yoshikawa, T, Rasheed, AA Journal: JOURNAL OF MANAGEMENT STUDIES Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1111/j.1467-6486.2009.00891.x Relevance score: 7.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(governance, monitor)；股利政策(dividend, payout)；影响机制(expropri) Abstract This paper focuses on a type of firms that have been traditionally neglected in both family business and governance research, namely, family-controlled, publicly-listed firms. Although principal-agent conflicts may be less prevalent in such firms, family control can potentially give rise to principal-principal conflicts, leading to expropriation of the wealth of minority owners by family owners. Superior firm performance and the willingness to distribute the profits through dividend payments would suggest the absence of such expropriation. Based on a sample of 210 OTC firms in Japan, we examined the relationships between family control and dividend payouts and profitability. Our results indicate that family control was positively related to dividend payouts. Further, we found that while foreign ownership interacted with family control to reduce dividend payouts and increase profitability, bank ownership did not have such an effect. 摘要（中文） 本文关注一类在家族企业研究和治理研究中历来被忽视的企业，即家族控制的公开上市企业。尽管在此类企业中委托—代理冲突可能不那么普遍，但家族控制可能引发委托人—委托人冲突，导致家族所有者侵占小股东的财富。卓越的企业业绩以及通过股利支付分配利润的意愿将表明不存在此类侵占。基于日本210家场外交易（OTC）企业的样本，我们考察了家族控制与股利支付和盈利能力之间的关系。我们的结果表明，家族控制与股利支付呈正相关。此外，我们发现，虽然外资所有权与家族控制交互作用会降低股利支付并提高盈利能力，但银行所有权没有这种效应。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Tunneling and dividend payouts: A tale of agency conflicts in China
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In China, RPT-based tunneling by controlling shareholders is negatively associated with dividend payout ratios, contrary to U.S. evidence, because minority shareholders lack awareness of the harm done by RPTs and controlling shareholders feel no need to signal…
pages.text: Tunneling and dividend payouts: A tale of agency conflicts in China (2026) Paper claim — In China, RPT-based tunneling by controlling shareholders is negatively associated with dividend payout ratios, contrary to U.S. evidence, because minority shareholders lack awareness of the harm done by RPTs and controlling shareholders feel no need to signal fairness through dividends. Raw markdown: zeng-2025-tunneling-and-dividend-payouts-a-tale-of-agency-conflicts-in-china Bibliographic Record Authors: Zeng, Sipeng; Qu, Zhi; Zhou, Kuo Journal: Journal of Accounting and Public Policy Year: 2026 (available online January 2026) DOI: 10.1016/j.jaccpubpol.2025.107401 Sample: A-share listed firms, China, 2002–2022; 4,852 firms, 35,108 firm-year observations Abstract Related party transactions (RPTs) are often viewed as a means for majority shareholders to tunnel, while dividends ensure fair payout to both majority and minority shareholders. Using a sample of Chinese listed firms from 2002 to 2022, our study documents a negative relationship between RPT-based tunneling and the dividend payout ratio, a finding that is contrary to the existing literature on the relationship between the tunneling effect and dividend payout ratios in the U.S. market. In addition, our study finds that external monitoring, as opposed to internal governance, significantly limits the ability of large shareholders to reduce dividend payouts through tunneling. Further mechanism analysis shows that RPT tunneling reduces dividend payments by reducing available free cash flow. Minority shareholders' insufficient awareness of the damage of controlling shareholders' tunneling through related party transactions is an important reason for the existence of this negative correlation in China. Key Findings RPT frequency is negatively associated with both the likelihood and level of dividend payouts at 1% significance; a one-standard-deviation increase in #RPTs corresponds to a 17.27% reduction in dividends relative to the sample mean. Non-business RPTs (those involving directors, officers, or major shareholders as counterparties) drive the negative effect; business RPTs are insignificant, consistent with non-business RPTs serving as opportunistic tunneling vehicles. China's staggered non-tradable share reform (2005–2009), used as a natural experiment, confirms the causal channel: post-reform, when dividends became equitable distributions rather than additional tunneling tools, large shareholders engaged in RPTs further reduced dividend payouts. Internal governance instruments (CEO duality, board size) do not moderate the negative RPT–dividend relationship, consistent with the limited effectiveness of internal governance in Chinese emerging markets. External monitoring (institutional investor ownership and analyst coverage) significantly attenuates the negative association, supporting external monitoring as a functional substitute for weak internal governance. The mechanism operates through free cash flow: RPTs reduce FCFE by 1.61% per standard deviation increase in #RPTs, and only outflow-type RPTs reduce dividends, consistent with tunneling that depletes firm cash. pages.title: The Entrenchment Problem, Corporate Governance Mechanisms, and Firm Value
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of two main corporate governance mechanisms, the board of directors and auditing, in mitigating the equity discounts arising from the potential entrenchment problem between inside and outside shareholders. Raw…
pages.text: The Entrenchment Problem, Corporate Governance Mechanisms, and Firm Value (2010) Paper claim — In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of two main corporate governance mechanisms, the board of directors and auditing, in mitigating the equity discounts arising from the potential entrenchment problem between inside and outside shareholders. Raw markdown: zerni-2010-the-entrenchment-problem-corporate-governance-mechanisms-and-firm Bibliographic Record Authors: Zerni, M, Kallunki, JP, Nilsson, H Journal: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH Year: 2010 DOI: 10.1111/j.1911-3846.2010.01043.x Relevance score: 10.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(audit, board, governance, monitor)；股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(agency, cash flow, free cash flow) Abstract In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of two main corporate governance mechanisms, the board of directors and auditing, in mitigating the equity discounts arising from the potential entrenchment problem between inside and outside shareholders. Overall, the empirical results suggest that both boards with equity incentives and higher quality auditors may act as effective governance mechanisms with positive valuation implications. The monitoring incentives of the board of directors appear to play a key governance role. Specifically, we find that boards where board members have invested their personal wealth in the firm demand more stringent auditing and claim higher dividends, thereby limiting the agency problem of free cash flow. 摘要（中文） 本文考察两种主要的公司治理机制——董事会和审计，在缓解因内部股东与外部股东之间潜在壕沟自守问题所导致的股权折价方面的有效性。总体而言，实证结果表明，具有股权激励的董事会以及质量更高的审计师，都可能充当有效的治理机制，并具有正面的估值影响。董事会的监督激励似乎发挥了关键的治理作用。具体而言，我们发现，董事会成员将其个人财富投资于企业的董事会，会要求更严格的审计并索取更高的股利，从而限制了自由现金流的代理问题。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Shareholder Satisfaction or Societal Benefit? Coalition Support and Goal Prioritization
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Research on the behavioral theory of the firm has established that the profitability goal triggers various firm actions, but it has yet to thoroughly explore which other goals may gain prominence in directing firm resources if the profitability goal has been…
pages.text: Shareholder Satisfaction or Societal Benefit? Coalition Support and Goal Prioritization (2025) Paper claim — Research on the behavioral theory of the firm has established that the profitability goal triggers various firm actions, but it has yet to thoroughly explore which other goals may gain prominence in directing firm resources if the profitability goal has been achieved. Raw markdown: zhang-2025-shareholder-satisfaction-or-societal-benefit-coalition-support-and Bibliographic Record Authors: Zhang, CM, Hu, HW, Yoshikawa, T Journal: JOURNAL OF BUSINESS ETHICS Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1007/s10551-025-06018-5 Relevance score: 4.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(board, governance)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract Research on the behavioral theory of the firm has established that the profitability goal triggers various firm actions, but it has yet to thoroughly explore which other goals may gain prominence in directing firm resources if the profitability goal has been achieved. We identify shareholder satisfaction and societal benefit as two additional organizational goals and predict that when firms have achieved their profitability aspirations, the financial resources allocated to pursue these goals depend on the dominance of coalitions supporting or opposing them. Drawing on the coalition theory within the behavioral theory of the firm, we theorize that the prioritization and pursuit of a goal depend on the relative power of its supporting coalition within a firm's governance body, including top decision-makers like CEOs and board members. By examining 2071 Chinese listed firms, we find that the relative strength of the shareholder-value coalition (supporting shareholder satisfaction) and the state-endorsement coalition (supporting societal benefit) affects firms' resource allocation toward dividend payments and corporate philanthropy in distinct ways. 摘要（中文） 关于企业行为理论的研究已确立盈利能力目标会触发各种企业行动，但它尚未彻底探讨如果盈利能力目标已经实现，还有哪些其他目标可能在引导企业资源方面变得突出。我们识别出股东满足和社会福祉作为两个额外的组织目标，并预测当企业已实现其盈利能力抱负时，配置用于追求这些目标的财务资源取决于支持或反对它们的联盟的主导地位。借鉴企业行为理论中的联盟理论，我们提出，一个目标的优先级排序和追求取决于其支持联盟在企业治理机构（包括CEO和董事会成员等高层决策者）内部的相对权力。通过考察2071家中国上市企业，我们发现股东价值联盟（支持股东满足）和国家背书联盟（支持社会福祉）的相对实力，以不同方式影响企业将资源配置于股利派发和企业慈善。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: 参股企业股利分配与上市公司权益资本成本 (Cash Dividend Payouts from Associates and Joint Ventures, and the Cost of Equity of Listed Firms)
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Higher cash dividend payouts by associates and joint ventures (AJVs) in which a listed firm holds a minority equity stake reduce the listed firm's cost of equity, by lowering downside risk in AJV investment income and by reducing information risk about the…
pages.text: 参股企业股利分配与上市公司权益资本成本 (2026) Paper claim — Higher cash dividend payouts by associates and joint ventures (AJVs) in which a listed firm holds a minority equity stake reduce the listed firm's cost of equity, by lowering downside risk in AJV investment income and by reducing information risk about the reliability of equity-method earnings. Raw markdown: zhang-mingwei-2026-equity-investment-dividends-cost-of-equity Bibliographic Record Authors: Zhang Mingwei (张明威); Cheng Xiaoke (程小可); Zhang Zixi (张子希) Journal: 中央财经大学学报 (Journal of Central University of Finance and Economics) Year: 2026 (Issue 3) DOI: 10.19681/j.cnki.jcufe.2026.03.008 Sample: A-share listed firms, China, 2014–2021; 8,084 firm-year observations Abstract 本文以权益投资行为中的参股企业为切入点，探讨了参股企业投资股利分配对上市公司权益资本成本的影响。研究发现，参股企业股利水平越高，上市公司权益资本成本越低。机制分析表明，参股企业股利分配通过降低参股企业投资收益的下行风险以及提供投资收益匹配的股利信息以减少信息风险，是参股企业股利分配降低上市公司权益资本成本的两个重要机制。进一步研究发现，权益法核算投资收益占比越高、参股企业位于境外时，参股企业股利分配降低上市公司权益资本成本的效果越强。 English summary: This study examines how cash dividends from associates and joint ventures (AJVs) affect listed firms' cost of equity. We find that firms face a lower cost of equity when their AJVs distribute higher cash dividends. This relation operates through two channels: lower downside risk in AJV investment income and lower information risk regarding the reliability of that income. The negative association is more pronounced when AJV investment income accounts for a larger share of net profit and when AJVs are located abroad. Key Findings AJV dividend payout level (JAD) is negatively associated with listed firm cost of equity at 1% significance under both PEG (−0.0009) and MPEG (−0.0012) model estimates; a one-standard-deviation increase in JAD reduces cost of equity by ~1.07% of its mean. Mechanism test 1 (downside risk): the negative JAD–cost-of-equity association is concentrated in firms with high earnings volatility; when profitability is stable, the effect is insignificant—consistent with dividends reducing cash-flow uncertainty for investors. Mechanism test 2 (information risk): the effect is significant only when investor platforms have not yet covered the AJV; once covered, the additional information reduces the marginal value of dividend signals—consistent with AJV dividends substituting for direct information access. Heterogeneity: the effect is stronger when equity-method income comprises a higher fraction of consolidated net profit, and when AJVs are located overseas (where parent monitoring is weaker and information asymmetry is higher). Robustness is confirmed via PSM (propensity score matching), Heckman two-stage, entropy balancing, and instrumental variable approaches; results are consistent across alternative cost-of-equity proxies. Linked Pages dividend-signaling information-asymmetry international-evidence-on-dividends

pages.title: Do US stock prices deviate from their fundamental values? Some new evidence
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — We propose a new methodology to test Fama's [J. Raw markdown: zhong-2003-do-us-stock-prices-deviate-from-their-fundamental Bibliographic Record Authors: Zhong, MS, Darrat, AF, Anderson, DC Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI:…
pages.text: Do US stock prices deviate from their fundamental values? Some new evidence (2003) Paper claim — We propose a new methodology to test Fama's [J. Raw markdown: zhong-2003-do-us-stock-prices-deviate-from-their-fundamental Bibliographic Record Authors: Zhong, MS, Darrat, AF, Anderson, DC Journal: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE Year: 2003 DOI: 10.1016/S0378-4266(01)00259-X Relevance score: 3.5分 Matched themes: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative) Abstract We propose a new methodology to test Fama's [J. Finance 46 (1991) 1575] contention that the present value model (PVM) should be augmented by time-varying expected inflation to more adequately account for actual stock price behavior. Unlike other methods, our testing approach can distinguish between the excess-price movement hypothesis of Shiller [Am. Econ. Rev. 71 (1981) 421] and the dividend-smoothing hypothesis of Marsh and Merton [Am. Econ. Rev. 76 (1986) 483]. We decompose the levels (as opposed to the variances) of stock prices into their fundamental and non-fundamental elements in the context of a multivariate PVM co-integrating framework and utilize the Gonzalo and Granger [J. Bus. Econ. Stat. 13 (1995) 27] procedure to formally test for the statistical significance of the non-fundamental component. Our results from monthly data for the post-WWII period do not support the inflation-augmented PVM since the non-fundamental component continues to achieve significance. This finding persists under alternative model specifications and data frequencies. The apparent failure of the traditional, rational-expectation, PVM model to adequately account for observed market behavior provides another piece of evidence supportive of Shiller's [Am. Econ. Rev. 71 (1981) 591] belief in some form of market "irrationality". (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. 摘要（中文） 我们提出了一种新方法来检验Fama（1991）的论点，即现值模型（PVM）应当被时变的预期通胀所增补，以更充分地解释实际股价行为。与其他方法不同，我们的检验方法能够区分Shiller（1981）的超额价格波动假说和Marsh与Merton（1986）的股利平滑假说。我们在一个多变量PVM协整框架下，将股价水平（而非方差）分解为其基本面成分和非基本面成分，并利用Gonzalo和Granger（1995）程序来正式检验非基本面成分的统计显著性。我们来自二战后时期月度数据的结果不支持通胀增补的PVM，因为非基本面成分继续达到显著性。这一发现在替代的模型设定和数据频率下依然存在。传统的、理性预期的PVM模型显然未能充分解释观察到的市场行为，这提供了另一项支持Shiller（1981）关于某种形式市场“非理性”信念的证据。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.title: Import competition and disappearing dividends
pages.excerpt: Paper claim — Import competition has had an enormous impact on the US economy. Raw markdown: zhou-2013-import-competition-and-disappearing-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Zhou, J, Booth, L, Chang, B Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI:…
pages.text: Import competition and disappearing dividends (2013) Paper claim — Import competition has had an enormous impact on the US economy. Raw markdown: zhou-2013-import-competition-and-disappearing-dividends Bibliographic Record Authors: Zhou, J, Booth, L, Chang, B Journal: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES Year: 2013 DOI: 10.1057/jibs.2012.36 Relevance score: 8.5分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(cash dividend, dividend, share repurchase)；影响机制(substitut) Abstract Import competition has had an enormous impact on the US economy. This paper looks at whether such competition has increased the risk of US firms and is a factor that can partly explain the Fama-French disappearing dividends phenomenon. We show that firms facing more import competition do face more uncertainty in their future performance, and are less likely to pay a dividend. Import penetration through a risk channel has significant explanatory power, even after we include a variety of controls suggested in the literature, as well as Herfindahl index that controls for market power. Further, we can explain a significant part of the disappearing dividends phenomenon. Finally, we also find evidence that import competition contributes to the substitution of share repurchases for cash dividends. We are the first to document the impact that increased import competition and "globalization" have had on the dividend policy of US firms. Journal of International Business Studies (2013) 44, 138-154. doi: 10.1057/jibs.2012.36 摘要（中文） 进口竞争对美国经济产生了巨大影响。本文考察这种竞争是否增加了美国企业的风险，以及它是否是能够部分解释法玛-弗伦奇（Fama-French）股利消失现象的一个因素。我们表明，面临更激烈进口竞争的企业在其未来业绩上确实面临更多不确定性，且更不可能支付股利。进口渗透通过风险渠道具有显著的解释力，即使在我们纳入了文献中建议的各种控制变量以及控制市场势力的赫芬达尔指数（Herfindahl index）之后依然如此。此外，我们能够解释股利消失现象的很大一部分。最后，我们还发现证据表明，进口竞争促成了用股份回购替代现金股利。我们首次记录了进口竞争加剧和"全球化"对美国企业股利政策所产生的影响。《国际商务研究杂志》（2013）44, 138-154。doi: 10.1057/jibs.2012.36 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus. pages.excerpt: Paper claim — This paper develops a model in which managers voluntarily choose debt to credibly constrain their own future empire-building. Raw markdown: zwiebel-1996-dynamic-capital-structure-under-managerial-entrenchment Bibliographic Record Authors: Zwiebel, J Journal:…
pages.text: Dynamic capital structure under managerial entrenchment (1996) Paper claim — This paper develops a model in which managers voluntarily choose debt to credibly constrain their own future empire-building. Raw markdown: zwiebel-1996-dynamic-capital-structure-under-managerial-entrenchment Bibliographic Record Authors: Zwiebel, J Journal: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW Year: 1996 DOI: n/a Relevance score: 3.0分 Matched themes: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend) Abstract This paper develops a model in which managers voluntarily choose debt to credibly constrain their own future empire-building. Dynamically consistent capital structure is derived as the optimal response in each period of partially entrenched managers trading-off empire-building ambitions with the need to ensure sufficient efficiency to prevent control challenges. A policy of capital structure coordinated with dividends follows naturally, as do implications for the level, frequency, and maturity structure of debt as a function of outside investment opportunities. Additionally, the model yields new testable implications for security design, and changes in debt and empire-building over managerial careers. 摘要（中文） 本文构建了一个模型，其中管理者自愿选择债务，以可信地约束自己未来的帝国建造行为。动态一致的资本结构被推导为部分固守其位的管理者在每一期的最优响应，他们在帝国建造野心与确保足够效率以防止控制权挑战的需要之间进行权衡。与股利相协调的资本结构政策自然随之而来，关于债务的水平、频率和期限结构作为外部投资机会函数的含义也随之而来。此外，该模型对证券设计，以及对债务和帝国建造在管理者职业生涯中的变化，得出了新的可检验含义。 Notes Abstract-only record — no full text is available for this paper in the corpus.
